To shoot; to dart like lightning; to fulminate; to utter with authority or vehemence. She fulmined out her scorn of laws Salique. Tennyson.

copiousness.definition: The state or quality of being copious; abudance; plenty; also, diffuseness in style. To imitatethe copiousness of Homer. Dryden. Syn. -- Abudance; plenty; richness; exuberance.

entitative.definition: Considered as pure entity; abstracted from all circumstances. Ellis. -- En"ti*ta*tive*ly, adv.

sunken.definition: Lying on the bottom of a river or other water; sunk.

boarder.definition: One who has food statedly at another's table, or meals and lodgings in his house, for pay, or compensation of any kind. 2. (Naut.)  One who boards a ship; one selected to board an enemy's ship. Totten.

yelper.definition: An animal that yelps, or makes a yelping noise. Specifically: (Zoöl.) (a) The avocet; -- so called from its sharp, shrill cry. (b) The tattler. [Local, U. S.].

moonbeam.definition: A ray of light from the moon.

impleader.definition: One who prosecutes or sues another.

zouave.definition: (a) One of an active and hardy body of soldiers in the French service, originally Arabs, but now composed of Frenchmen who wear the Arab dress. (b) Hence, one of a body of soldiers who adopt the dress and drill of the Zouaves, as was done by a number of volunteer regiments in the army of the United.

chatty.definition:
Given to light, familiar talk; talkative. Lady M. W. Montagu.

A porous earthen pot used in India for cooling water, etc.

triens.definition: A Roman copper coin, equal to one third of the as. See 3d As, 2.

coarct.definition: To press together; to crowd; to straiten; to confine closely. Bacon. 2. To restrain; to confine. Ayliffe.

orthognathous.definition: Having the front of the head, or the skull, nearly perpendicular, not retreating backwards above the jaws; -- opposed to Ant: prognathous. See Gnathic index, under Gnathic.

sometime.definition: At a past time indefinitely referred to; once; formerly. Did they not sometime cry "All hail" to me Shak. 2. At a time undefined; once in a while; now and then; sometimes. Sometime we see a cloud that's dragonish, A vapor sometime like a bear or lion. Shak. 3. At one time or other hereafter; as, I w.

ginglymodi.definition: An order of ganoid fishes, including the modern gar pikes and many allied fossil forms. They have rhombic, ganoid scales, a heterocercal tail, paired fins without an axis, fulcra on the fins, and a bony skeleton, with the vertebræ convex in front and concave behind, forming a ball and socket joint.

anthropical.definition: Like or related to man; human. Owen.

jurat.definition: A person under oath; specifically, an officer of the nature of an alderman, in certain municipal corporations in England. Burrill. 2. (Law)  The memorandum or certificate at the end of an asffidavit, or a bill or answer in chancery, showing when, before whom, and (in English practice), where, it was.

pyrosulphuric.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid called also disulphuric acid) obtained by distillation of certain sulphates, as a colorless, thick, oily liquid, H2S2O7 resembling sulphuric acid. It is used in the solution of indigo, in the manufacture of alizarin, and in dehydration.

jihad.definition: A religious war against infidels or Mohammedan heretics; also, any bitter war or crusade for a principle or belief. [Their] courage in war . . . had not, like that of the Mohammedan dervishes of the Sudan, or of Mohammedans anywhere engaged in a jehad, a religious motive and the promise of future bl.

epitome.definition: A work in which the contents of a former work are reduced within a smaller space by curtailment and condensation; a brief summary; an abridgement. [An] epitome of the contents of a very large book. Sydney Smith. 2. A compact or condensed representation of anything. An epitome of English fashionable.

dispersed.definition: Scattered. -- Dis*pers"ed*ly, adv. -- Dis*pers"ed*ness, n. Dispersed harmony (Mus.), harmony in which the tones composing the chord are widely separated, as by an octave or more.

valorous.definition: Possessing or exhibiting valor; brave; courageous; valiant; intrepid. -- Val"or*ous*ly, adv.

manichaeism.definition: The doctrines taught, or system of principles maintained, by the Manichæans.

phyle.definition: A local division of the people in ancient Athens; a clan; a tribe.

exorcist.definition: One who expels evil spirits by conjuration or exorcism. Certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists. Acts xix. 13. 2. A conjurer who can raise spirits. Thou, like an exorcist, hast conjured up My mortified spirit. Shak.

grapplement.definition: A grappling; close fight or embrace. Spenser.

sirvente.definition: A peculiar species of poetry, for the most part devoted to moral and religious topics, and commonly satirical, -- often used by the troubadours of the Middle Ages.

orthographical.definition: Of or pertaining to orthography, or right spelling; also, correct in spelling; as, orthographical rules; the letter was orthographic. 2. (Geom.)  Of or pertaining to right lines or angles. Orthographic or Orthogonal, projection, that projection which is made by drawing lines, from every point to be.

epitrite.definition: A foot consisting of three long syllables and one short syllable. Note: It is so called from being compounded of a spondee (which contains 4 times) with an iambus or a trochee (which contains 3 times). It is called 1st, 2d, 3d, or 4th epitrite according as the short syllable stands 1st, 2d, etc.

infra-red.definition: Lying outside the visible spectrum at its red end; -- said of rays less refrangible than the extreme red rays.

appropinquation.definition: A drawing nigh; approach. Bp. Hall.

unstring.definition: To deprive of a string or strings; also, to take from a string; as, to unstring beads. 2. To loosen the string or strings of; as, to unstring a harp or a bow. 3. To relax the tension of; to loosen. "His garland they unstring." Dryden.  Used also figuratively; as, his nerves were unstrung by fear.

capsule.definition: (Bot.)  a dry fruit or pod which is made up of several parts or carpels, and opens to discharge the seeds, as, the capsule of the poppy, the flax, the lily, etc. 2. (Chem.) (a) A small saucer of clay for roasting or melting samples of ores, etc.; a scorifier. (b) a small, shallow, evaporating dish,.

minimus.definition: A being of the smallest size. Shak. 2. (Anat.)  The little finger; the fifth digit, or that corresponding to it, in either the manus or pes.

trashiness.definition: The quality or state of being trashy.

xenotime.definition: A native phosphate of yttrium occurring in yellowish-brown tetragonal crystals.

exportable.definition: Suitable for exportation; as, exportable products.

stolid.definition: Hopelessly insensible or stupid; not easily aroused or excited; dull; impassive; foolish.

gadding.definition: Going about much, needlessly or without purpose. Envy is a gadding passion, and walketh the streets. Bacon. The good nuns would check her gadding tongue. Tennyson. Gadding car, in quarrying, a car which carries a drilling machine so arranged as to drill a line of holes.

ketone.definition: One of a large class of organic substances resembling the aldehydes, obtained by the distillation of certain salts of organic acids and consisting of carbonyl (CO) united with two hydrocarbon radicals. In general the ketones are colorless volatile liquids having a pungent ethereal odor. Note: The ke.

monopathy.definition: Suffering or sensibility in a single organ or function. -- Mon`o*path"ic, a.

equivalue.definition: To put an equal value upon; to put (something) on a par with another thing. W. Taylor.

abstractedness.definition: The state of being abstracted; abstract character.

benevolence.definition: The disposition to do good; good will; charitableness; love of mankind, accompanied with a desire to promote their happiness. The wakeful benevolence of the gospel. Chalmers. 2. An act of kindness; good done; charity given. 3. A species of compulsory contribution or tax, which has sometimes been ill.

copyist.definition: A copier; a transcriber; an imitator; a plagiarist.

fierasfer.definition: A genus of small, slender fishes, remarkable for their habit of living as commensals in other animals. One species inhabits the gill cavity of the pearl oyster near Panama; another lives within an East Indian holothurian.

hosteler.definition: The keeper of a hostel or inn. 2. A student in a hostel, or small unendowed collede in Oxford or Cambridge. Fuller.

gorcock.definition: The moor cock, or red grouse. See Grouse.

apothegmatical.definition: Pertaining to, or in the manner of, an apotghem; sententious; pithy.

unpaganize.definition: To cause to cease to be pagan; to divest of pagan character. Cudworth.

prelector.definition: A reader of lectures or discourses; a lecturer. Sheldon.

revocability.definition: The quality of being revocable; as, the revocability of a law.

bibitory.definition: Of or pertaining to drinking or tippling.

futurism.definition: A movement or phase of post-impressionism (which see, below).

pityriasis.definition: A superficial affection of the skin, characterized by irregular patches of thin scales which are shed in branlike particles. Pityriasis versicolor Etym: [NL.] (Med.), a parasitic disease of the skin, characterized by the development of reddish or brownish patches.

jenkins.definition: name of contempt for a flatterer of persons high in social or official life; as, the Jenkins employed by a newspaper. [Colloq. Eng. & U.S.] G. W. Curtis.

reciprocornous.definition: Having horns turning backward and then forward, like those of a ram. Ash.

paranymph.definition: (Gr. Antiq.) (a) A friend of the bridegroom who went with him in his chariot to fetch home the bride. Milton. (b) The bridesmaid who conducted the bride to the bridegroom. 2. Hence: An ally; a supporter or abettor. Jer. Taylor.

subastral.definition: Beneath the stars or heavens; terrestrial. Bp. Warburton.

surrogation.definition: The act of substituting one person in the place of another. Killingbeck.

alvine.definition: Of, from, in, or pertaining to, the belly or the intestines; as, alvine discharges; alvine concretions.

evangelize.definition:
To instruct in the gospel; to preach the gospel to; to convert to Christianity; as, to evangelize the world. His apostles whom he sends To evangelize the nations. Milton.

To preach the gospel.

bewail.definition:
To express deep sorrow for, as by wailing; to lament; to wail over. Hath widowed and unchilded many a one, Which to this hour bewail the injury. Shak. Syn. -- To bemoan; grieve. -- See Deplore.

To express grief; to lament. Shak.

monovalent.definition: Having a valence of one; univalent. See Univalent.

felly.definition:
, adv. In a fell or cruel manner; fiercely; barbarously; savagely. Spenser.

The exterior wooden rim, or a segment of the rim, of a wheel, supported by the spokes. [Written also felloe.] Break all the spokes and fellies from her wheel. Shak.

podge.definition: A puddle; a plash. Skinner. 2. Porridge. Halliwell.

inexorably.definition: In an inexorable manner; inflexibly. "Inexorably firm." Thomson.

reduit.definition: A central or retired work within any other work.

skua.definition: Any jager gull; especially, the Megalestris skua; -- called also boatswain.

dey.definition:
A servant who has charge of the dairy; a dairymaid. Chaucer.

The governor of Algiers; -- so called before the French conquest in 1830.

exposedness.definition: The state of being exposed, laid open, or unprotected; as, an exposedness to sin or temptation.

superannuate.definition:
To impair or disquality on account of age or infirmity. Sir T. Browne. 2. To give a pension to, on account of old age or other infirmity; to cause to retire from service on a pension.

To last beyond the year; -- said of annual plants. Bacon.

stag-horned.definition: Having the mandibles large and palmate, or branched somewhat like the antlers of a stag; -- said of certain beetles.

epidermic.definition: Epidermal; connected with the skin or the bark. Epidermic administration of medicine (Med.), the application of medicine to the skin by friction.

aromatize.definition: To impregnate with aroma; to render aromatic; to give a spicy scent or taste to; to perfume. Bacon.

kickable.definition: Capable or deserving of being kicked. "A kickable boy." G. Eliot.

rifling.definition: (a) The act or process of making the grooves in a rifled cannon or gun barrel. (b) The system of grooves in a rifled gun barrel or cannon. Shunt rifling, rifling for cannon, in which one side of the groove is made deeper than the other, to facilitate loading with shot having projections which enter.

inadequate.definition: Not adequate; unequal to the purpose; insufficient; deficient; as, inadequate resources, power, conceptions, representations, etc. Dryden. -- In*ad"e*quate*ly, adv. -- In*ad"e*quate*ness, n.

gentisin.definition: A tasteless, yellow, crystalline substance, obtained from the gentian; -- called also gentianin.

circumflexion.definition: The act of bending, or causing to assume a curved form. 2. A winding about; a turning; a circuity; a fold.

resuscitable.definition: Capable of resuscitation; as, resuscitable plants. Boyle.

indolence.definition: Freedom from that which pains, or harasses, as toil, care, grief, etc. I have ease, if it may not rather be called indolence. Bp. Hough. 2. The quality or condition of being indolent; inaction, or want of exertion of body or mind, proceeding from love of ease or aversion to toil; habitual idleness;.

creatic.definition: Relating to, or produced by, flesh or animal food; as, creatic nausea. [Written also kreatic.].

sennet.definition:
A signal call on a trumpet or cornet for entrance or exit on the stage.

The barracuda.

eggnog.definition: A drink consisting of eggs beaten up with sugar, milk, and (usually) wine or spirits.

effund.definition: To pour out. Dr. H. More.

quadrivalent.definition: Having a valence of four; capable of combining with, being replaced by, or compared with, four monad atoms; tetravalent; -- said of certain atoms and radicals; thus, carbon and silicon are quadrivalent elements.

septuple.definition:
Seven times as much; multiplied by seven; sevenfold.

To multiply by seven; to make sevenfold. Sir J. Herschel.

enhearten.definition: To give heart to; to fill with courage; to embolden. The enemy exults and is enheartened. I. Taylor.

huttoning.definition: Forcible manipulation of a dislocated, stiff, or painful joint.

canaliculated.definition: Having a channel or groove, as in the leafstalks of most palms.

empale.definition:
To make pale. No bloodless malady empales their face. G. Fletcher.

1. To fence or fortify with stakes; to surround with a line of stakes for defense; to impale. All that dwell near enemies empale villages, to save themselves from surprise. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. To inclose; to surround. See Impale. 3.

lecythis.definition: A genus of gigantic trees, chiefly Brazilian, of the order Myrtaceæ, having woody capsules opening by an apical lid. Lecythis Zabucajo yields the delicious sapucaia nuts. L. Ollaria produces the monkey-pots, its capsules. Its bark separates into thin sheets, like paper, used by the natives for cigar.

retex.definition: To annual, as orders. Bp. Hacket.

clinoid.definition: Like a bed; -- applied to several processes on the inner side of the sphenoid bone.

inscriptive.definition: Bearing inscription; of the character or nature of an inscription.

cynarrhodium.definition: A fruit like that of the rose, consisting of a cup formed of the calyx tube and receptacle, and containing achenes.

antheriferous.definition: (a) Producing anthers, as plants. (b) Supporting anthers, as a part of a flower. Gray.

peripatetic.definition:
Walking about; itinerant. 2. Of or pertaining to the philosophy taught by Aristotle (who gave his instructions while walking in the Lyceum at Athens), or to his followers. "The true peripatetic school." Howell.

1. One who walks about; a pedestrian; an itinerant. Tatler. 2. A disciple of Aristotle;.

sortable.definition: Capable of being sorted. 2. Suitable; befitting; proper. con.

rhabdophora.definition: An extinct division of Hydrozoa which includes the graptolities.

strockle.definition: A shovel with a turned-up edge, for frit, sand, etc. [Written also strocal, strocle, strokal.].

palmatifid.definition: Palmate, with the divisions separated but little more than halfway to the common center.

antherozoid.definition: One of the mobile male reproductive bodies in the antheridia of cryptogams.

uncreatedness.definition: The quality or state of being uncreated.

waterlandian.definition: One of a body of Dutch Anabaptists who separated from the Mennonites in the sixteenth century; -- so called from a district in North Holland denominated Waterland.

haematozoon.definition: A parasite inhabiting the blood; esp.: (a) Certain species of nematodes of the genus Filaria, sometimes found in the blood of man, the horse, the dog, etc. (b) The trematode, Bilharzia hæmatobia, which infests the inhabitants of Egypt and other parts of Africa, often causing death.

reintegration.definition: A renewing, or making whole again. See Redintegration.

occultation.definition: (Astron.)  The hiding of a heavenly body from sight by the intervention of some other of the heavenly bodies; -- applied especially to eclipses of stars and planets by the moon, and to the eclipses of satellites of planets by their primaries. 2. Fig.: The state of being occult. The reappearance of s.

counter-couchant.definition: Lying down, with their heads in opposite directions; -- said of animals borne in a coat of arms.

cacodylic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or derived from, cacodyl. Cacodylic acid, a white, crystalline, deliquescent substance, (CH3)2AsO.OH, obtained by the oxidation of cacodyl, and having the properties of an exceedingly stable acid; -- also called alkargen.

mestling.definition: A kind of brass. See Maslin.

gambol.definition:
A skipping or leaping about in frolic; a hop; a sportive prank. Dryden.

To dance and skip about in sport; to frisk; to skip; to play in frolic, like boys or lambs.

fenks.definition: The refuse whale blubber, used as a manure, and in the manufacture of Prussian blue. Ure.

controverse.definition:
Controversy. Spenser.

To dispute; to controvert. "Controversed causes." Hooker.

weasel.definition: Any one of various species of small carnivores belonging to the genus Putorius, as the ermine and ferret. They have a slender, elongated body, and are noted for the quickness of their movements and for their bloodthirsty habit in destroying poultry, rats, etc. The ermine and some other species are b.

enthronize.definition: To place on a throne; hence, to induct into office, as a bishop. There openly enthronized as the very elected king. Knolles.

elliptical.definition: Of or pertaining to an ellipse; having the form of an ellipse; oblong, with rounded ends. The planets move in elliptic orbits. Cheyne. 2. Having a part omitted; as, an elliptical phrase. Elliptic chuck. See under Chuck. -- Elliptic compasses, an instrument arranged for drawing ellipses. -- Elliptic.

rhamphotheca.definition: The horny covering of the bill of birds.

corbiestep.definition: One of the steps in which a gable wall is often finished in place of a continuous slope; -- also called crowstep.

digamma.definition: A letter ( Note: This form identifies it with the Latin F, though in sound it is said to have been nearer V. It was pronounced, probably, much like the English W.

pig-headed.definition: Having a head like a pig; hence, figuratively: stupidity obstinate; perverse; stubborn. B. Jonson. -- Pig"-head`ed*ness, n.

parka.definition: An outer garment made of the skins of birds or mammals, worn by Eskimos, etc.

variformed.definition: Formed with different shapes; having various forms; variform.

pivot.definition: A fixed pin or short axis, on the end of which a wheel or other body turns. 2. The end of a shaft or arbor which rests and turns in a support; as, the pivot of an arbor in a watch. 3. Hence, figuratively: A turning point or condition; that on which important results depend; as, the pivot of an enter.

speculative.definition: Given to speculation; contemplative. The mind of man being by nature speculative. Hooker. 2. Involving, or formed by, speculation; ideal; theoretical; not established by demonstration. Cudworth. 3. Of or pertaining to vision; also, prying; inquisitive; curious. Bacon. 4. Of or pertaining to speculat.

synecdoche.definition: A figure or trope by which a part of a thing is put for the whole (as, fifty sail for fifty ships), or the whole for a part (as, the smiling year for spring), the species for the genus (as, cutthroat for assassin), the genus for the species (as, a creature for a man), the name of the material for th.

mazdean.definition: Of or pertaining to Ahura-Mazda, or Ormuzd, the beneficent deity in the Zoroastrian dualistic system; hence, Zoroastrian.

etherization.definition: (a) The administration of ether to produce insensibility. (b) The state of the system under the influence of ether.

cyathophylloid.definition:
Like, or pertaining to, the family Cyathophyllidæ.

A fossil coral of the family Cyathophyllidæ; sometimes extended to fossil corals of other related families belonging to the group Rugosa; -- also called cup corals. Thay are found in paleozoic rocks.

tetanomotor.definition: An instrument from tetanizing a muscle by irritating its nerve by successive mechanical shocks.

preface.definition: Something spoken as introductory to a discourse, or written as introductory to a book or essay; a proem; an introduction, or series of preliminary remarks. This superficial tale Is but a preface of her worthy praise. Shak. Heaven's high behest no preface needs. Milton. 2. (R. C. Ch.)  The prelude or.

turbulent.definition: Disturbed; agitated; tumultuous; roused to violent commotion; as, the turbulent ocean. Calm region once, And full of peace, now tossed and turbulent. Milton. 2. Disposed to insubordination and disorder; restless; unquiet; refractory; as, turbulent spirits. Sagacious, bold, and turbulent of wit. Dryd.

paleology.definition: The study or knowledge of antiquities, esp. of prehistoric antiquities; a discourse or treatise on antiquities; archæology .

nigh.definition: Not distant or remote in place or time; near. The loud tumult shows the battle nigh. Prior. 2. Not remote in degree, kindred, circumstances, etc.; closely allied; intimate. "Nigh kinsmen." Knolles. Ye ... are made nigh by the blood of Christ. Eph. ii. 13. Syn. -- Near; close; adjacent; contiguous; p.

beauxite.definition:
A ferruginous hydrate of alumina. It is largely used in the preparation of aluminium and alumina, and for the lining of furnaces which are exposed to intense heat.

See Bauxite.

disorganization.definition: The act of disorganizing; destruction of system. 2. The state of being disorganized; as, the disorganization of the body, or of government. The magazine of a pawnbroker in such total disorganization, that the owner can never lay his hands upon any one article at the moment he has occasion for it. Si.

spirograph.definition: An instrument for recording the respiratory movements, as the sphygmograph does those of the pulse.

komenic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or designating, an acid derived from meconic acid. [Written also comenic.].

accompaniment.definition: That which accompanies; something that attends as a circumstance, or which is added to give greater completeness to the principal thing, or by way of ornament, or for the sake of symmetry. Specifically: (Mus.)  A part performed by instruments, accompanying another part or parts performed by voices;.

megatherium.definition: An extinct gigantic quaternary mammal, allied to the ant-eaters and sloths. Its remains are found in South America.

stainer.definition: One who stains or tarnishes. 2. A workman who stains; as, a stainer of wood.

slum.definition: A foul back street of a city, especially one filled with a poor, dirty, degraded, and often vicious population; any low neighborhood or dark retreat; -- usually in the plural; as, Westminster slums are haunts for theives. Dickens. 2. pl. (Mining)  Same as Slimes.

penetrable.definition: Capable of being penetrated, entered, or pierced. Used also figuratively. And pierce his only penetrable part. Dryden. I am not made of stones, But penetrable to your kind entreats. Shak. -- Pen"e*tra*ble*ness, n. -- Pen"e*tra*bly, adv.

horribleness.definition: The state or quality of being horrible; dreadfulness; hideousness. The horribleness of the mischief. Sir P. Sidney.

supplementation.definition: The act of supplementing. C. Kingsley.

polybasic.definition: Capable of neutralizing, or of combining with, several molecules of a monacid base; having several hydrogen atoms capable of being replaced by basic radicals; -- said of certain acids; as, sulphuric acid is polybasic.

corival.definition:
A rival; a corrival.

To rival; to pretend to equal. Shak.

recite.definition: To repeat, as something already prepared, written down, committed to memory, or the like; to deliver from a written or printed document, or from recollection; to rehearse; as, to recite the words of an author, or of a deed or covenant. 2. To tell over; to go over in particulars; to relate; to narrat.

explate.definition: To explain; to unfold. Like Solon's self explatest the knotty laws. B. Jonson.

acroterial.definition: Pertaining to an acroterium; as, ornaments. P. Cyc.

upsilon.definition: The 20th letter (U, u) of the Greek alphabet, a vowel having originally the sound of oo as in room, becoming before the 4th century b. c. that French u or Ger. ü. Its equivalent in English is u or y.

febrifugal.definition: Having the quality of mitigating or curing fever. Boyle.

submentum.definition: The basal part of the labium of insects. It bears the mentum.

trusty.definition: Admitting of being safely trusted; justly deserving confidence; fit to be confided in; trustworthy; reliable. Your trusty and most valiant servitor. Shak. 2. Hence, not liable to fail; strong; firm. His trusty sword he called to his aid. Spenser. 3. Involving trust; as, a trusty business. Shak.

orthotropal.definition: Having the axis of an ovule or seed straight from the hilum and chalaza to the orifice or the micropyle; atropous. Note: This word has also been used (but improperly) to describe any embryo whose radicle points towards, or is next to, the hilum.

phonograph.definition: A character or symbol used to represent a sound, esp. one used in phonography. 2. (Physics)  An instrument for the mechanical registration and reproduction of audible sounds, as articulate speech, etc. It consists of a rotating cylinder or disk covered with some material easily indented, as tinfoil,.

abscess.definition: A collection of pus or purulent matter in any tissue or organ of the body, the result of a morbid process. Cold abscess, an abscess of slow formation, unattended with the pain and heat characteristic of ordinary abscesses, and lasting for years without exhibiting any tendency towards healing; a chro.

supposition.definition: The act of supposing, laying down, imagining, or considering as true or existing, what is known not to be true, or what is not proved. 2. That which is supposed; hypothesis; conjecture; surmise; opinion or belief without sufficient evidence. This is only an infallibility upon supposition that if a t.

torpid.definition: Having lost motion, or the power of exertion and feeling; numb; benumbed; as, a torpid limb. Without heat all things would be torpid. Ray. 2. Dull; stupid; sluggish; inactive. Sir M. Hale.

illusory.definition: Deceiving, or tending of deceive; fallacious; illusive; as, illusory promises or hopes.

devout.definition: Devoted to religion or to religious feelings and duties; absorbed in religious exercises; given to devotion; pious; reverent; religious. A devout man, and one that feared God. Acts x. 2. We must be constant and devout in the worship of God. Rogers. 2. Expressing devotion or piety; as, eyes devout; s.

baldachin.definition: A rich brocade; baudekin. 2. (Arch.)  A structure in form of a canopy, sometimes supported by columns, and sometimes suspended from the roof or projecting from the wall; generally placed over an altar; as, the baldachin in St. Peter's. 3. A portable canopy borne over shrines, etc., in procession. [W.

arterialize.definition: To transform, as the venous blood, into arterial blood by exposure to oxygen in the lungs; to make arterial.

caltrap.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of herbaceous plants (Tribulus) of the order Zygophylleæ, having a hard several-celled fruit, armed with stout spines, and resembling the military instrument of the same name. The species grow in warm countries, and are often very annoying to cattle. 2. (Mil.)  An instrument with fou.

russification.definition: The act or process of being Russified.

compressive.definition: Compressing, or having power or tendency to compress; as, a compressive force.

telephote.definition: A telelectric apparatus for producing images of visible objects at a distance.

prothonotary.definition: A chief notary or clerk. " My private prothonotary." Herrick. 2. Formerly, a chief clerk in the Court of King's Bench and in the Court of Common Pleas, now superseded by the master. [Eng.] Wharton. Burrill. 3. A register or chief clerk of a court in certain States of the United States. 4. (R. C. Ch.

cassareep.definition: A condiment made from the sap of the bitter cassava (Manihot utilissima) deprived of its poisonous qualities, concentrated by boiling, and flavored with aromatics. See Pepper pot.

numerically.definition: In a numerical manner; in numbers; with respect to number, or sameness in number; as, a thing is numerically the same, or numerically different.

mooner.definition: One who abstractedly wanders or gazes about, as if moonstruck. Dickens.

bluish.definition: Somewhat blue; as, bluish veins. "Bluish mists." Dryden. -- Blu"ish*ly, adv. -- Blu"ish*ness, n.

caranx.definition: A genus of fishes, common on the Atlantic coast, including the yellow or goldon mackerel.

cisatlantic.definition: On this side of the Atlantic Ocean; -- used of the eastern or the western side, according to the standpoint of the writer. Story.

consolidant.definition: Serving to unite or consolidate; having the quality of consolidating or making firm.

infantine.definition: Infantile; childish. A degree of credulity next infantine. Burke.

carpale.definition: One of the bones or cartilages of the carpus; esp. one of the series articulating with the metacarpals.

coiner.definition: One who makes or stamps coin; a maker of money; -- usually, a maker of counterfeit money. Precautions such as are employed by coiners and receivers of stolen goods. Macaulay. 2. An inventor or maker, as of words. Camden.

photo-epinasty.definition: A disproportionately rapid growth of the upper surface of dorsiventral organs, such as leaves, through the stimulus of exposure to light. Encyc. Brit.

diarrheal.definition: Of or pertaining to diarrhea; like diarrhea.

manis.definition: A genus of edentates, covered with large, hard, triangular scales, with sharp edges that overlap each other like tiles on a roof. They inhabit the warmest parts of Asia and Africa, and feed on ants. Called also Scaly anteater. See Pangolin.

doliolum.definition: A genus of freeswimming oceanic tunicates, allied to Salpa, and having alternate generations.

lightroom.definition: A small room from which the magazine of a naval vessel is lighted, being separated from the magazine by heavy glass windows.

bronzing.definition: The act or art of communicating to articles in metal, wood, clay, plaster, etc., the appearance of bronze by means of bronze powders, or imitative painting, or by chemical processes. Tomlinson. 2. A material for bronzing.

convolvulus.definition: A large genus of plants having monopetalous flowers, including the common bindweed (C. arwensis), and formerly the morning-glory, but this is now transferred to the genus Ipomæa. The luster of the long convolvuluses That coiled around the stately stems. Tennyson.

semolina.definition: The fine, hard parts of wheat, rounded by the attrition of the millstones, -- used in cookery.

heroic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or like, a hero; of the nature of heroes; distinguished by the existence of heroes; as, the heroic age; an heroic people; heroic valor. 2. Worthy of a hero; bold; daring; brave; illustrious; as, heroic action; heroic enterprises. 3. (Sculpture & Painting)  Larger than life size,.

pyaemic.definition: Of or pertaining to pyæmia; of the nature of pyæmia.

polytungstic.definition: Containing several tungsten atoms or radicals; as, polytungstic acid. Polytungstic acid (Chem.), any one of several complex acids of tungsten containing more than one atom of tungsten.

theodicy.definition: A vindication of the justice of God in ordaining or permitting natural and moral evil. 2. That department of philosophy which treats of the being, perfections, and government of God, and the immortality of the soul. Krauth-Fleming.

expectative.definition:
Constituting an object of expectation; contingent. Expectative grace, a mandate given by the pope or a prince appointing a successor to any benefice before it becomes vacant. Foxe.

Something in expectation; esp., an expectative grace. Milman.

shikaree.definition: A sportsman; esp., a native hunter. [India].

evaporometer.definition: An instrument for ascertaining the quantity of a fluid evaporated in a given time; an atmometer.

pleasing.definition:
Giving pleasure or satisfaction; causing agreeable emotion; agreeable; delightful; as, a pleasing prospect; pleasing manners. "Pleasing harmony." Shak. "Pleasing features." Macaulay. -- Pleas"ing*ly, adv. -- Pleas"ing*ness, n. Syn. -- Gratifying; delightful; agreeable. See Pleasant.

An object of pl.

cizar.definition: To clip with scissors. Beau. & Fl.

inaffability.definition: Want of affability or sociability; reticence.

depolarizer.definition: A substance used to prevent polarization, as upon the negative plate of a voltaic battery.

anemonin.definition: An acrid, poisonous, crystallizable substance, obtained from some species of anemone.

laelaps.definition: A genus of huge, carnivorous, dinosaurian reptiles from the Cretaceous formation of the United States. They had very large hind legs and tail, and are supposed to have been bipedal. Some of the species were about eighteen feet high.

blazonment.definition: The act or blazoning; blazoning; emblazonment.

grubble.definition: To feel or grope in the dark. Dryden.

raceabout.definition: A small sloop-rigged racing yacht carrying about six hundred square feet of sail, distinguished from a knockabout by having a short bowsprit.

sapience.definition: The quality of being sapient; wisdom; sageness; knowledge. Cowper. Woman, if I might sit beside your feet, And glean your scattered sapience. Tennyson.

understrapper.definition: A petty fellow; an inferior agent; an underling. This was going to the fountain head at once, not applying to the understrappers. Goldsmith.

oolite.definition: A variety of limestone, consisting of small round grains, resembling the roe of a fish. It sometimes constitutes extensive beds, as in the European Jurassic. See the Chart of Geology.

overinform.definition: To inform, fill, or animate, excessively. Johnson.

tripetaloid.definition: Having the form or appearance of three petals; appearing as if furnished with three petals.

misbecome.definition: Not to become; to suit ill; not to befit or be adapted to. Macaulay. Thy father will not act what misbecomes him. Addison.

able-minded.definition: Having much intellectual power. -- A`ble-mind"ed*ness, n.

gestant.definition: Bearing within; laden; burdened; pregnant. "Clouds gestant with heat." Mrs. Browning.

perficient.definition:
Making or doing throughly; efficient; effectual. Blackstone.

One who performs or perfects a work; especially, one who endows a charity.

vomitory.definition:
Causing vomiting; emetic; vomitive.

1. An emetic; a vomit. Harvey. 2. Etym: [L. vomitorium.] (Arch.)  A principal door of a large ancient building, as of an amphitheater. Sixty-four vomitories . . . poured forth the immense multitude. Gibbon.

partitive.definition:
Denoting a part; as, a partitive genitive.

A word expressing partition, or denoting a part.

indies.definition: A name designating the East Indies, also the West Indies. Our king has all the Indies in his arms. Shak.

crustaceousness.definition: The state or quality of being crustaceous or having a crustlike shell.

riddling.definition: Speaking in a riddle or riddles; containing a riddle. "Riddling triplets." Tennyson. -- Rid"dling, adv.

twaddle.definition:
To talk a weak and silly manner, like one whose faculties are decayed; to prate; to prattle. Stanyhurst.

Silly talk; gabble; fustian. I have put in this chapter on fighting . . . because of the cant and twaddle that's talked of boxing and fighting with fists now-a-days. T. Hughes.

balcony.definition: (Arch.)  A platform projecting from the wall of a building, usually resting on brackets or consoles, and inclosed by a parapet; as, a balcony in front of a window. Also, a projecting gallery in places of amusement; as, the balcony in a theater. 2. A projecting gallery once common at the stern of lar.

universalism.definition: The doctrine or belief that all men will be saved, or made happy, in the future state.

polymerization.definition: The act or process of changing to a polymeric form; the condition resulting from such change.

mallotus.definition: A genus of small Arctic fishes. One American species, the capelin (Mallotus villosus), is extensively used as bait for cod.

gallows.definition: A frame from which is suspended the rope with which criminals are executed by hanging, usually consisting of two upright posts and a crossbeam on the top; also, a like frame for suspending anything. So they hanged Haman on the gallows. Esther vii. 10. If I hang, I'll make a fat pair of gallows. Shak.

benumb.definition: To make torpid; to deprive of sensation or sensibility; to stupefy; as, a hand or foot benumbed by cold. The creeping death benumbed her senses first. Dryden.

almoner.definition: One who distributes alms, esp. the doles and alms of religious houses, almshouses, etc.; also, one who dispenses alms for another, as the almoner of a prince, bishop, etc.

doretree.definition: A doorpost. "As dead as a doretree." Piers Plowman.

triandrian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Triandria; having three distinct and equal stamens in the same flower.

linnaean.definition: Of or pertaining to Linnæus, the celebrated Swedish botanist. Linnaean system (Bot.), the system in which the classes are founded mainly upon the stamens, and the orders upon the pistils; the artificial or sexual system.

greasiness.definition: The quality or state of being greasy, oiliness; unctuousness; grossness.

fireworm.definition: The larva of a small tortricid moth which eats the leaves of the cranberry, so that the vines look as if burned; -- called also cranberry worm.

lalo.definition: The powdered leaves of the baobab tree, used by the Africans to mix in their soup, as the southern negroes use powdered sassafras. Cf. Couscous.

moder.definition:
A mother. Chaucer. 2. The principal piece of an astrolabe, into which the others are fixed.

To moderate.

concludent.definition: Bringing to a close; decisive; conclusive. Arguments highly consequential and concludent to my purpose. Sir M. Hale.

regratery.definition: The act or practice of regrating.

scare.definition: To frighten; to strike with sudden fear; to alarm. The noise of thy crossbow Will scare the herd, and so my shoot is lost. Shak. To scare away, to drive away by frightening. -- To scare up, to find by search, as if by beating for game. [Slang] Syn. -- To alarm; frighten; startle; affright; terrify.

margined.definition: Having a margin. Hawthorne. 2. (Zoöl.)  Bordered with a distinct line of color.

noun.definition: A word used as the designation or appellation of a creature or thing, existing in fact or in thought; a substantive. Note: By some grammarians the term noun is so used as to include adjectives, as being descriptive; but in general it is limited to substantives.

subcorneous.definition: (a) Situated under a horny part or layer. (b) Partially horny.

instrumentalness.definition: Usefulness or agency, as means to an end; instrumentality. Hammond.

infucate.definition: To stain; to paint; to daub.

untrained.definition: Not trained. Shak. 2. Not trainable; indocile. Herbert.

unintelligence.definition: Absence or lack of intelligence; unwisdom; ignorance. Bp. Hall.

octant.definition: (Geom.)  The eighth part of a circle; an arc of 45 degrees. 2. (Astron. & Astrol.)  The position or aspect of a heavenly body, as the moon or a planet, when half way between conjunction, or opposition, and quadrature, or distant from another body 45 degrees. 3. An instrument for measuring angles (ge.

cicisbeism.definition: The state or conduct of a cicisbeo.

revengeful.definition: Full of, or prone to, revenge; vindictive; malicious; revenging; wreaking revenge. If thy revengeful heart can not forgive. Shak. May my hands . . . Never brandish more rebvengeful steel. Shak. Syn. -- Vindictive; vengeful; resentful; malicious. -- Re*venge"ful*ly, adv. -- Re*venge"ful*ness, n.

foe.definition: See Fiend, and cf. Feud a quarrel. 1. One who entertains personal enmity, hatred, grudge, or malice, against another; an enemy. A man's foes shall be they of his own household. Matt. x. 36 2. An enemy in war; a hostile army. 3. One who opposes on principle; an opponent; an adversary; an ill- wisher;.

lecanomancy.definition: divination practiced with water in a basin, by throwing three stones into it, and invoking the demon whose aid was sought.

pathognomy.definition: Expression of the passions; the science of the signs by which human passions are indicated.

allottee.definition: One to whom anything is allotted; one to whom an allotment is made.

communicant.definition:
One who partakes of, or is entitled to partake of, the sacrament of the Lord's supper; a church member. A never-failing monthly communicant. Atterbury. 2. One who communicates. Foxe.

Communicating. Coleridge.

misapply.definition: To apply wrongly; to use for a wrong purpose; as, to misapply a name or title; to misapply public money.

wlatsome.definition: Loathsome; disgusting; hateful. Murder is . . . wlatsom and abhominable to God. Chaucer.

pinacoid.definition: A plane parallel to two of the crystalline axes.

weeping-ripe.definition: Ripe for weeping; ready to weep. Shak.

pithsome.definition: Pithy; robust. "Pithsome health and vigor." R. D. Blackmore.

dimerous.definition: Composed of, or having, two parts of each kind. Note: A dimerous flower has two sepals, two petals, two stamens, and two pistils.

chilostoma.definition: An extensive suborder of marine Bryozoa, mostly with calcareous shells. They have a movable lip and a lid to close the aperture of the cells. [Also written Chillostomata.].

dizzy.definition: Having in the head a sensation of whirling, with a tendency to fall; vertiginous; giddy; hence, confused; indistinct. Alas! his brain was dizzy. Drayton. 2. Causing, or tending to cause, giddiness or vertigo. To climb from the brink of Fleet Ditch by a dizzy ladder. Macaulay. 3. Without distinct tho.

tuille.definition: In plate armor, a suspended plate in from of the thigh. See Illust. of Tasses.

disentomb.definition: To take out from a tomb; a disinter.

scrolled.definition: Formed like a scroll; contained in a scroll; adorned with scrolls; as, scrolled work.

nearctic.definition: Of or pertaining to a region of the earth's surface including all of temperate and arctic North America and Greenland. In the geographical distribution of animals, this region is marked off as the habitat certain species.

devastate.definition: To lay waste; to ravage; to desolate. Whole countries . . . were devastated. Macaulay. Syn. -- To waste; ravage; desolate; destroy; demolish; plunder; pillage.

mooress.definition: A female Moor; a Moorish woman.

palmette.definition: A floral ornament, common in Greek and other ancient architecture; -- often called the honeysuckle ornament.

amplectant.definition: Clasping a support; as, amplectant tendrils. Gray.

denitrify.definition: To deprive of, or free from, nitrogen.

obumbrate.definition: To shade; to darken; to cloud. Howell.

turbant.definition: A turban. Milton. I see the Turk nodding with his turbant. Howell.

foreclose.definition: To shut up or out; to preclude; to stop; to prevent; to bar; to exclude. The embargo with Spain foreclosed this trade. Carew. To foreclose a mortgager (Law), to cut him off by a judgment of court from the power of redeeming the mortgaged premises, termed his equity of redemption. -- To foreclose a m.

goldfish.definition: (a) A small domesticated cyprinoid fish (Carassius auratus); -- so named from its color. It is native of China, and is said to have been introduced into Europe in 1691. It is often kept as an ornament, in small ponds or glass globes. Many varieties are known. Called also golden fish, and golden carp.

deprivable.definition: Capable of being, or liable to be, deprived; liable to be deposed. Kings of Spain . . . deprivable for their tyrannies. Prynne.

ulmic.definition: Pertaining to ulmin; designating an acid obtained from ulmin.

preventative.definition: That which prevents; -- incorrectly used instead of preventive.

suprascalpular.definition: Situated above, or on the anterior side of, the scapula.

sonship.definition: The state of being a son, or of bearing the relation of a son; filiation. Dr. H. More.

battledoor.definition: An instrument, with a handle and a flat part covered with parchment or crossed with catgut, used to strike a shuttlecock in play; also, the play of battledoor and shuttlecock. 2. Etym: [OE. battleder.]  A child's hornbook. Halliwell.

drubber.definition: One who drubs. Sir W. Scott.

egad.definition: An exclamation expressing exultation or surprise, etc.

boned.definition: Having (such) bones; -- used in composition; as, big-boned; strong-boned. No big-boned men framed of the Cyclops' size. Shak. 2. Deprived of bones; as, boned turkey or codfish. 3. Manured with bone; as, boned land.

unchurch.definition: To expel, or cause to separate, from a church; to excommunicate. Sir M. Hale. 2. To deprive of the character, privileges, and authority of a church. South.

grouser.definition: (Dredging, Pile Driving, etc.) A pointed timber attached to a boat and sliding vertically, to thrust into the ground as a means of anchorage.

docimology.definition: A treatise on the art of testing, as in assaying metals, etc.

myoepithelial.definition: (Biol.)  Derived from epithelial cells and destined to become a part of the muscular system; -- applied to structural elements in certain embryonic forms. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having the characteristics of both muscle and epithelium; as, the myoepithelial cells of the hydra.

self-educated.definition: Educated by one's own efforts, without instruction, or without pecuniary assistance from others.

aspirator.definition: (Chem.)  An apparatus for passing air or gases through or over certain liquids or solids, or for exhausting a closed vessel, by means of suction. 2. (Med.)  An instrument for the evacuation of the fluid contents of tumors or collections of blood.

trifloral.definition: Three-flowered; having or bearing three flowers; as, a triflorous peduncle.

cuckoobud.definition: A species of Ranunculus (R. bulbosus); -- called also butterflower, buttercup, kingcup, goldcup. Shak.

virent.definition: Green; not withered. Sir T. Browne.

disorganize.definition: To destroy the organic structure or regular system of (a government, a society, a party, etc.); to break up (what is organized); to throw into utter disorder; to disarrange. Lyford . . . attempted to disorganize the church. Eliot (1809).

agistment.definition: (a) Formerly, the taking and feeding of other men's cattle in the king's forests. (b) The taking in by any one of other men's cattle to graze at a certain rate. Mozley & W. (c) The price paid for such feeding. (d) A charge or rate against lands; as, an agistment of sea banks, i. e., charge for banks.

self-examination.definition: An examination into one's own state, conduct, and motives, particularly in regard to religious feelings and duties.

desidiousness.definition: The state or quality of being desidiose, or indolent. N. Bacon.

fondon.definition: A large copper vessel used for hot amalgamation.

musketoon.definition: A short musket. 2. One who is armed with such a musket.

eulogistic.definition: Of or pertaining to eulogy; characterized by eulogy; bestowing praise; panegyrical; commendatory; laudatory; as, eulogistic speech or discourse. -- Eu"lo*gis"tic*al*ly, adv.

meditatist.definition: One who is given to meditation.

bunk.definition:
A wooden case or box, which serves for a seat in the daytime and for a bed at night. [U.S.] 2. One of a series of berths or bed places in tiers. 3. A piece of wood placed on a lumberman's sled to sustain the end of heavy timbers. [Local, U.S.]

To go to bed in a bunk; -- sometimes with in. [Colloq.

dispair.definition: To separate (a pair). I have . . . dispaired two doves. Beau. & Fl.

volutation.definition: A rolling of a body; a wallowing. Sir T. Browne.

mechanician.definition: One skilled in the theory or construction of machines; a machinist. Boyle.

plantain.definition: (Bot.)  A treelike perennial herb (Musa paradisiaca) of tropical regions, bearing immense leaves and large clusters of the fruits called plantains. See Musa. 2. The fruit of this plant. It is long and somewhat cylindrical, slightly curved, and, when ripe, soft, fleshy, and covered with a thick but t.

mauve.definition: A color of a delicate purple, violet, or lilac. Mauve aniline (Chem.), a dyestuff produced artificially by the oxidation of commercial aniline, and the first discovered of the so-called coal- tar, or aniline, dyes. It consists of the sulphate of mauveïne, and is a dark brown or bronze amorphous powd.

bemoan.definition: To express deep grief for by moaning; to express sorrow for; to lament; to bewail; to pity or sympathize with. Implores their pity, and his pain bemoans. Dryden. Syn. -- See Deplore.

pedestal.definition: (Arch.)  The base or foot of a column, statue, vase, lamp, or the like; the part on which an upright work stands. It consists of three parts, the base, the die or dado, and the cornice or surbase molding. See Illust. of Column. Build him a pedestal, and say, "Stand there!" Cowper. 2. (a) (Railroad C.

outbuild.definition: To exceed in building, or in durability of building.

entoblast.definition: The inner germ layer; endoderm. See Nucleolus.

naperian.definition: Of, pertaining to, or discovered by, Napier, or Naper. Naperian logarithms. See under Logarithms. NAPIER'S BONES; NAPIER'S RODS Na"pi*er's bones`, Na"pi*er's rods`.  A set of rods, made of bone or other material, each divided into nine spaces, and containing the numbers of a column of the multiplica.

euchlorine.definition: A yellow or greenish yellow gas, first prepared by Davy, evolved from potassium chlorate and hydrochloric acid. It is supposed to consist of chlorine tetroxide with some free chlorine.

hypozoic.definition: Anterior in age to the lowest rocks which contain organic remains. Lyell.

pern.definition:
To take profit of; to make profitable. Sylvester.

The honey buzzard.

prog.definition: To wander about and beg; to seek food or other supplies by low arts; to seek for advantage by mean shift or tricks. [Low] A perfect artist in progging for money. Fuller. I have been endeavoring to prog for you. Burke. 2. To steal; to rob; to filch. [Low] Johnson. 3. To prick; to goad; to progue. [Sc.

pronucleus.definition: One of the two bodies or nuclei (called male and female pronuclei) which unite to form the first segmentation nucleus of an impregnated ovum. Note: In the maturing of the ovum preparatory to impregnation, a part of the germinal vesicle (see Polar body, under Polar) becomes converted into a number of.

phosphinic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, certain acids analogous to the phosphonic acids, but containing two hydrocarbon radicals, and derived from the secondary phosphines by oxidation.

sursolid.definition: The fifth power of a number; as, a is the sursolid of a, or 32 that of 2. Hutton.

clearwing.definition: A lepidop terous insect with partially transparent wings, of the family Ægeriadæ, of which the currant and peach-tree borers are examples.

zenith.definition: That point in the visible celestial hemisphere which is vertical to the spectator; the point of the heavens directly overhead; -- opposed to nadir. From morn To noon he fell, from noon to dewy eve, A summer's day; and with the setting sun Dropped from the zenith, like a falling star. Milton. 2. henc.

symptom.definition: (Med.)  Any affection which accompanies disease; a perceptible change in the body or its functions, which indicates disease, or the kind or phases of disease; as, the causes of disease often lie beyond our sight, but we learn their nature by the symptoms exhibited. Like the sick man, we are expiring.

tribrach.definition: A poetic foot of three short syllables, as, mèlì\'dcs.

megascope.definition: A modification of the magic lantern, used esp. for throwing a magnified image of an opaque object on a screen, solar or artificial light being used.

tug.definition: To pull or draw with great effort; to draw along with continued exertion; to haul along; to tow; as, to tug a loaded cart; to tug a ship into port. There sweat, there strain, tug the laborious oar. Roscommon. 2. To pull; to pluck. To ease the pain, His tugged cars suffered with a strain. Hudibras.

actinolitic.definition: Of the nature of, or containing, actinolite.

swifter.definition:
(a) A rope used to retain the bars of the capstan in their sockets while men are turning it. (b) A rope used to encircle a boat longitudinally, to strengthen and defend her sides. (c) The forward shroud of a lower mast.

To tighten, as slack standing rigging, by bringing the opposite shrouds nearer.

counterpart.definition: A part corresponding to another part; anything which answers, or corresponds, to another; a copy; a duplicate; a facsimile. In same things the laws of Normandy agreed with the laws of England, so that they seem to be, as it were, copies or counterparts one of another. Sir M. Hale. 2. (Law)  One of t.

teleost.definition: One of the Teleosti. Also used adjectively.

heroical.definition: Heroic. Spectator. -- He*ro"ic*al*ly, adv. -- He*ro"ic*al*ness, n.

sizy.definition: Sizelike; viscous; glutinous; as, sizy blood. Arbuthnot.

ephor.definition: A magistrate; one of a body of five magistrates chosen by the people of ancient Sparta. They exercised control even over the king.

julaceous.definition: Like an ament, or bearing aments; amentaceous.

barbarousness.definition: The quality or state of being barbarous; barbarity; barbarism.

agreeably.definition: In an agreeably manner; in a manner to give pleasure; pleasingly. "Agreeably entertained." Goldsmith. 2. In accordance; suitably; consistently; conformably; -- followed by to and rarely by with. See Agreeable, 4. The effect of which is, that marriages grow less frequent, agreeably to the maxim above.

turriculated.definition: Furnished with, or formed like, a small turret or turrets; somewhat turreted.

interjoin.definition: To join mutually; to unite. Shak.

chert.definition: An impure, massive, flintlike quartz or hornstone, of a dull color.

saffron.definition: (Bot.)  A bulbous iridaceous plant (Crocus sativus) having blue flowers with large yellow stigmas. See Crocus. 2. The aromatic, pungent, dried stigmas, usually with part of the stile, of the Crocus sativus. Saffron is used in cookery, and in coloring confectionery, liquors, varnishes, etc., and was.

provect.definition: Carried forward; advanced. "Provect in years." Sir T. Flyot.

chemisette.definition: An under-garment, worn by women, usually covering the neck, shoulders, and breast.

clubhand.definition: A short, distorted hand; also, the deformity of having such a hand.

manageability.definition: The state or quality of being manageable; manageableness.

blote.definition: To cure, as herrings, by salting and smoking them; to bloat.

occursion.definition: A meeting; a clash; a collision. Boyle.

serjeantcy.definition: See Sergeant, Sergeantcy, etc. Serjeant-at-arms. See Sergeant- at-arms, under Sergeant.

tightly.definition: In a tight manner; closely; nearly.

diodon.definition: (Zoöl.)  A genus of spinose, plectognath fishes, having the teeth of each jaw united into a single beaklike plate. They are able to inflate the body by taking in air or water, and, hence, are called globefishes, swellfishes, etc. fishes, and sea hedgehogs. 2. (Zoöl.)  A genus of whales.

cursed.definition: Deserving a curse; execrable; hateful; detestable; abominable. Let us fly this cursed place. Milton. This cursed quarrel be no more renewed. Dryden.

flibustier.definition: A buccaneer; an American pirate. See Flibuster.

aloofness.definition: State of being aloof. Rogers (1642). The . . . aloofness of his dim forest life. Thoreau.

fubsy.definition: Plump; chubby; short and stuffy; as a fubsy sofa. [Eng.] A fubsy, good-humored, silly . . . old maid. Mme. D'Arblay.

monopneumona.definition: A suborder of Dipnoi, including the Ceratodus. [Written also monopneumonia.].

mirza.definition: The common title of honor in Persia, prefixed to the surname of an individual. When appended to the surname, it signifies Prince.

subsecutive.definition: Following in a train or succession.

ley.definition:
, & i. To lay; to wager. Chaucer.

Law. Abbott.

See Lye.

Grass or meadow land; a lea.

Fallow; unseeded. Beau. & Fl.

stern-wheel.definition: Having a paddle wheel at the stern; as, a stern-wheel steamer.

calumbin.definition: A bitter principle extracted as a white crystalline substance from the calumba root. [Written also colombin, and columbin].

unreeve.definition: To withdraw, or take out, as a rope from a block, thimble, or the like.

cynical.definition: Having the qualities of a surly dog; snarling; captious; currish. I hope it is no very cynical asperity not to confess obligations where no benefit has been received. Johnson. 2. Pertaining to the Dog Star; as, the cynic, or Sothic, year; cynic cycle. 3. Belonging to the sect of philosophers called.

singsong.definition:
Bad singing or poetry. 2. A drawling or monotonous tone, as of a badly executed song.

Drawling; monotonous.

To write poor poetry. Tennyson.

lignify.definition:
To convert into wood or into a ligneous substance.

To become wood.

winkle.definition: (a) Any periwinkle. Holland. (b) Any one of various marine spiral gastropods, esp., in the United States, either of two species of Fulgar (F. canaliculata, and F. carica). Note: These are large mollusks which often destroy large numbers of oysters by drilling their shells and sucking their blood. St.

abusive.definition: Wrongly used; perverted; misapplied. I am . . . necessitated to use the word Parliament improperly, according to the abusive acceptation thereof. Fuller. 2. Given to misusing; also, full of abuses. [Archaic] "The abusive prerogatives of his see." Hallam. 3. Practicing abuse; prone to ill treat by co.

consultative.definition: Pertaining to consultation; having the privilege or right of conference. "A consultative . . . power." Abp. Bramhall.

wagering.definition: Hazarding; pertaining to the act of one who wagers. Wagering policy. (Com.) See Wager policy, under Policy.

billbug.definition: A weevil or curculio of various species, as the corn weevil. See Curculio.

pilfer.definition:
To steal in small quantities, or articles of small value; to practice petty theft.

To take by petty theft; to filch; to steal little by little. And not a year but pilfers as he goes Some youthful grace that age would gladly keep. Cowper.

coxcomb.definition: (a) A strip of red cloth notched like the comb of a cock, which licensed jesters formerly wore in their caps. (b) The cap itself. 2. The top of the head, or the head itself. We will belabor you a little better, And beat a little more care into your coxcombs. Beau & Fl. 3. A vain, showy fellow; a con.

fabrile.definition: Pertaining to a workman, or to work in stone, metal, wood etc.; as, fabrile skill.

backsight.definition: The reading of the leveling staff in its unchanged position when the leveling instrument has been taken to a new position; a sight directed backwards to a station previously occupied. Cf. Foresight, n., 3.

preen.definition:
A forked tool used by clothiers in dressing cloth.

1. To dress with, or as with, a preen; to trim or dress with the beak, as the feathers; -- said of birds. Derham. 2. To trim up, as trees. Halliwell.

dermoneural.definition: Pertaining to, or in relation with, both dermal and neural structures; as, the dermoneural spines or dorsal fin rays of fishes. Owen.

vanillic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, vanilla or vanillin; resembling vanillin; specifically, designating an alcohol and an acid respectively, vanillin being the intermediate aldehyde.

typification.definition: The act of typifying, or representing by a figure.

creeks.definition: A tribe or confederacy of North American Indians, including the Muskogees, Seminoles, Uchees, and other subordinate tribes. They formerly inhabited Georgia, Florida, and Alabama.

perameles.definition: Any marsupial of the genus Perameles, which includes numerous species found in Australia. They somewhat resemble rabbits in size and form. See Illust. under Bandicoot.

beggarliness.definition: The quality or state of being beggarly; meanness.

fop.definition: One whose ambition it is to gain admiration by showy dress; a coxcomb; an inferior dandy.

tapiser.definition: A maker of tapestry; an upholsterer. Chaucer.

felony.definition: (Feudal Law)  An act on the part of the vassal which cost him his fee by forfeiture. Burrill. 2. (O.Eng.Law)  An offense which occasions a total forfeiture either lands or goods, or both, at the common law, and to which capital or other punishment may be added, according to the degree of guilt. 3. A.

lightly.definition: With little weight; with little force; as, to tread lightly; to press lightly. Yet shall thy grave with rising flowers be drest, And the green turf lie lightly on thy breast. Pope. Him thus intent Ithuriel with his spear Touched lightly. Milton. 2. Swiftly; nimbly; with agility. So mikle was that ba.

prosoma.definition: The anterior of the body of an animal, as of a cephalopod; the thorax of an arthropod.

longicornia.definition: A division of beetles, including a large number of species, in which the antennæ are very long. Most of them, while in the larval state, bore into the wood or beneath the bark of trees, and some species are very destructive to fruit and shade trees. See Apple borer, under Apple, and Locust beetle, u.

unwormed.definition: Not wormed; not having had the worm, or lytta, under the tongue cut out; -- said of a dog.

skeletogenous.definition: Forming or producing parts of the skeleton.

blow-off.definition: A blowing off steam, water, etc.; -- Also, adj.  as, a blow-off cock or pipe. 2. An outburst of temper or excitement.

rente.definition: In France, interest payable by government on indebtedness; the bonds, shares, stocks, etc.,, which represent government indebtedness.

fatherlessness.definition: The state of being without a father.

bepowder.definition: To sprinkle or cover with powder; to powder.

hippurite.definition: A fossil bivalve mollusk of the genus Hippurites, of many species, having a conical, cup-shaped under valve, with a flattish upper valve or lid. Hippurites are found only in the Cretaceous rocks.

preferability.definition: The quality or state of being preferable; preferableness. J. S. Mill.

mesozoic.definition:
Belonging, or relating, to the secondary or reptilian age, or the era between the Paleozoic and Cenozoic. See Chart of Geology.

The Mesozoic age or formation.

helcoplasty.definition: The act or process of repairing lesions made by ulcers, especially by a plastic operation.

efflate.definition: To fill with breath; to puff up. Sir T. Herbert.

wardenship.definition: The office or jurisdiction of a warden.

wooer.definition: One who wooes; one who courts or solicits in love; a suitor. "A thriving wooer." Gibber.

snot.definition:
Mucus secreted in, or discharged from, the nose. [Low] 2. A mean, insignificant fellow. [Low]

To blow, wipe, or clear, as the nose.

corfute.definition: A native or inhabitant of Corfu, an island in the Mediterranean Sea.

reissue.definition:
To issue a second time.

A second or repeated issue.

catholicon.definition: A remedy for all diseases; a panacea.

cancrinite.definition: A mineral occurring in hexagonal crystals, also massive, generally of a yellow color, containing silica, alumina, lime, soda, and carbon dioxide.

footmark.definition: A footprint; a track or vestige. Coleridge.

domiciliation.definition: The act of domiciliating; permanent residence; inhabitancy. Milman.

cashierer.definition: One who rejects, discards, or dismisses; as, a cashierer of monarchs. Burke. CASHIER'S CHECK Cash*ier's" check. (Banking)  A check drawn by a bank upon its own funds, signed by the cashier.

hyalotype.definition: A photographic picture copied from the negative on glass; a photographic transparency. R. Hunt.

stipulator.definition: One who stipulates, contracts, or covenants.

petuntse.definition: Powdered fledspar, kaolin, or quartz, used in the manufacture of porcelain.

engregge.definition: To aggravate; to make worse; to lie heavy on. Chaucer.

unguiculate.definition:
One of the Unguiculata.

1. Furnished with nails, claws, or hooks; clawed. See the Note under Nail, n., 1. 2. (Bot.)  Furnished with a claw, or a narrow stalklike base, as the petals of a carnation.

alalia.definition: Inability to utter articulate sounds, due either to paralysis of the larynx or to that form of aphasia, called motor, or ataxis, aphasia, due to loss of control of the muscles of speech.

bob-cherry.definition: A play among children, in which a cherry, hung so as to bob against the mouth, is to be caught with the teeth.

platinous.definition: Of, pertaining to, or containing, platinum; -- used specifically to designate those compounds in which the element has a lower valence, as contrasted with the platinic compounds; as, platinous chloride (PtCl2).

fen.definition: Low land overflowed, or covered wholly or partially with water, but producing sedge, coarse grasses, or other aquatic plants; boggy land; moor; marsh. 'Mid reedy fens wide spread. Wordsworth. Note: Fen is used adjectively with the sense of belonging to, or of the nature of, a fen or fens. Fen boat,.

ichnoscopy.definition: The search for the traces of anything.

ursa.definition: Either one of the Bears. See the Phrases below. Ursa Major Etym: [L.], the Great Bear, one of the most conspicuous of the northern constellations. It is situated near the pole, and contains the stars which form the Dipper, or Charles's Wain, two of which are the Pointers, or stars which point toward.

presumption.definition: The act of presuming, or believing upon probable evidence; the act of assuming or taking for granted; belief upon incomplete proof. 2. Ground for presuming; evidence probable, but not conclusive; strong probability; reasonable supposition; as, the presumption is that an event has taken place. 3. Tha.

creese.definition: A dagger or short sword used by the Malays, commonly having a serpentine blade. [Written also crease and kris.] From a Malayan creese to a sailor's jackknife. Julian Hawthorne.

midday.definition:
The middle part of the day; noon.

Of or pertaining to noon; meridional; as, the midday sun.

impatience.definition: The quality of being impatient; want of endurance of pain, suffering, opposition, or delay; eagerness for change, or for something expected; restlessness; chafing of spirit; fretfulness; passion; as, the impatience of a child or an invalid. I then, . . . Out of my grief and my impatience, Answered n.

addle.definition:
Liquid filth; mire. 2. Lees; dregs. Wright.

Having lost the power of development, and become rotten, as eggs; putrid. Hence: Unfruitful or confused, as brains; muddled. Dryden.

To make addle; to grow addle; to muddle; as, he addled his brain. "Their eggs were addled." Cowper.

1. To earn by labor.

swagger.definition: To walk with a swaying motion; hence, to walk and act in a pompous, consequential manner. A man who swaggers about London clubs. Beaconsfield. 2. To boast or brag noisily; to be ostentatiously proud or vainglorious; to bluster; to bully. What a pleasant it is . . . to swagger at the bar! Arbuthnot.

param.definition: A white crystalline nitrogenous substance (C2H4N4); -- called also dicyandiamide.

covetousness.definition: Strong desire. When workmen strive to do better than well, They do confound their skill in covetousness. Shak. 2. A strong or inordinate desire of obtaining and possessing some supposed good; excessive desire for riches or money; -- in a bad sense. Covetousness, by a greed of getting more, deprivess.

ablegation.definition: The act of sending abroad. Jer. Taylor.

ichthyosaurus.definition: An extinct genus of marine reptiles; -- so named from their short, biconcave vertebræ, resembling those of fishes. Several species, varying in length from ten to thirty feet, are known from the Liassic, Oölitic, and Cretaceous formations.

enteradenography.definition: A treatise upon, or description of, the intestinal glands.

severity.definition: The quality or state of being severe. Specifically: -- (a) Gravity or austerity; extreme strictness; rigor; harshness; as, the severity of a reprimand or a reproof; severity of discipline or government; severity of penalties. "Strict age, and sour severity." Milton. (b) The quality or power of distr.

shamrock.definition: A trifoliate plant used as a national emblem by the Irish. The legend is that St. Patrick once plucked a leaf of it for use in illustrating the doctrine of the trinity. Note: The original plant was probably a kind of wood sorrel (Oxalis Acetocella); but now the name is given to the white clover (Tri.

sacculo-utricular.definition: Pertaining to the sacculus and utriculus of the ear.

monochronic.definition: Existing at the same time; contemporaneous.

procure.definition: To bring into possession; to cause to accrue to, or to come into possession of; to acquire or provide for one's self or for another; to gain; to get; to obtain by any means, as by purchase or loan. If we procure not to ourselves more woe. Milton. 2. To contrive; to bring about; to effect; to cause.

mydatoxin.definition: A poisonous amido acid, C6H13NO2, separated by Brieger from decaying horseflesh. In physiological action, it is similar to curare.

plugging.definition: The act of stopping with a plug. 2. The material of which a plug or stopple is made.

heron.definition: Any wading bird of the genus Ardea and allied genera, of the family Ardeidæ. The herons have a long, sharp bill, and long legs and toes, with the claw of the middle toe toothed. The common European heron (Ardea cinerea) is remarkable for its directly ascending flight, and was formerly hunted with th.

pilled.definition: Stripped of hair; scant of hair; bald. "Pilled beard." Chaucer.

derelict.definition: Given up or forsaken by the natural owner or guardian; left and abandoned; as, derelict lands. The affections which these exposed or derelict children bear to their mothers, have no grounds of nature or assiduity but civility and opinion. Jer. Taylor. 2. Lost; adrift; hence, wanting; careless; negle.

wych-hazel.definition: The wych-elm; -- so called because its leaves are like those of the hazel.

labyrinthal.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, a labyrinth; intricate; labyrinthian.

howadji.definition: A traveler. 2. A merchant; -- so called in the East because merchants were formerly the chief travelers.

logically.definition: In a logical manner; as, to argue logically.

pantology.definition: A systematic view of all branches of human knowledge; a work of universal information.

hilted.definition: Having a hilt; -- used in composition; as, basket-hilted, cross-hilted.

rightful.definition: Righteous; upright; just; good; -- said of persons. Chaucer. 2. Consonant to justice; just; as, a rightful cause. 3. Having the right or just claim according to established laws; being or holding by right; as, the rightful heir to a throne or an estate; a rightful king. 4. Belonging, held, or posses.

puffing.definition: a. & n. from Puff, v. i. & t. Puffing adder. (Zoöl.) Same as Puff adder (b), under Puff. -- Puffing pig (Zoöl.), the common porpoise.

whirl-blast.definition: A whirling blast or wind. A whirl-blast from behind the hill. Wordsworth.

bawsin.definition: A badger. B. Jonson. 2. A large, unwieldy person. Nares.

metaphosphoric.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, a monobasic acid, HPO3, analogous to nitric acid, and, by heating phosphoric acid, obtained as a crystalline substance, commonly called glacial phosphoric acid.

fridstol.definition: A seat in churches near the altar, to which offenders formerly fled for sanctuary. [Written variously fridstool, freedstool, etc.].

tenth.definition:
Next in order after the ninth; coming after nine others. 2. Constituting or being one of ten equal parts into which anything is divided.

1. The next in order after the ninth; one coming after nine others. 2. The quotient of a unit divided by ten; one of ten equal parts into which anything is divide.

gemmeous.definition: Pertaining to gems; of the nature of gems; resembling gems. Pennant.

temperer.definition: One who, or that which, tempers; specifically, a machine in which lime, cement, stone, etc., are mixed with water.

troop.definition: A collection of people; a company; a number; a multitude. That which should accompany old age --As honor, love, obedience, troops of friends --I must not look to have. Shak. 2. Soldiers, collectively; an army; -- now generally used in the plural. Farewell the plumed troop, and the big wars. Shak. Hi.

cookroom.definition: A room for cookery; a kitchen; the galley or caboose of a ship. Sir W. Raleigh.

recitation.definition: The act of reciting; rehearsal; repetition of words or sentences. Hammond. 2. The delivery before an audience of something committed to memory, especially as an elocutionary exhibition; also, that which is so delivered. 3. (Colleges and Schools)  The rehearsal of a lesson by pupils before their inst.

relais.definition: A narrow space between the foot of the rampart and the scarp of the ditch, serving to receive the earth that may crumble off or be washed down, and prevent its falling into the ditch. Wilhelm.

trapstick.definition: A stick used in playing the game of trapball; hence, fig., a slender leg. Addison.

similary.definition: Similar. Rhyming cadences of similarly words. South.

supercilious.definition: Lofty with pride; haughty; dictatorial; overbearing; arrogant; as, a supercilious officer; asupercilious air; supercilious behavior. -- Su`per*cil"i*ous*ly, adv. -- Su`per*cil"i*ous*ness, n.

myosis.definition: Long-continued contraction of the pupil of the eye.

scincoid.definition: Of or pertaining to the family Scincidæ, or skinks. -- n.  A scincoidian.

sinaic.definition: Of or pertaining to Mount Sinai; given or made at Mount Sinai; as, the Sinaitic law. Sinaitic manuscript, a fourth century Greek manuscript of the part Bible, discovered at Mount Sinai (the greater part of it in 1859) by Tisschendorf, a German Biblical critic; -- called also Codex Sinaiticus.

obligor.definition: The person who binds himself, or gives his bond to another. Blackstone.

uropygium.definition: The prominence at the posterior extremity of a bird's body, which supports the feathers of the tail; the rump; -- sometimes called pope's nose.

checkerboard.definition: A board with sixty-four squares of alternate color, used for playing checkers or draughts.

epignathous.definition: Hook-billed; having the upper mandible longer than the lower.

halmas.definition: The feast of All Saints; Hallowmas.

masseteric.definition: Of or pertaining to the masseter.

lifelong.definition: Lasting or continuing through life. Tennyson.

ovalbumen.definition: The albumin from white of eggs; egg albumin; -- in distinction from serum albumin. See Albumin.

subumbrella.definition: The integument of the under surface of the bell, or disk-shaped body, of a jellyfish.

smitt.definition: Fine clay or ocher made up into balls, used for marking sheep. [Eng.] Woodsward.

gall.definition: (Physiol.)  The bitter, alkaline, viscid fluid found in the gall bladder, beneath the liver. It consists of the secretion of the liver, or bile, mixed with that of the mucous membrane of the gall bladder. 2. The gall bladder. 3. Anything extremely bitter; bitterness; rancor. He hath . . . compassed.

revealable.definition: Capable of being revealed. -- Re*veal"a*ble*ness, n.

habitan.definition: Same as Habitant, 2. General met an emissary . . . sent . . . to ascertain the feelings of the habitans or French yeomanry. W. Irwing.

alnager.definition: A measure by the ell; formerly a sworn officer in England, whose duty was to inspect act measure woolen cloth, and fix upon it a seal.

quintile.definition: The aspect of planets when separated the fifth part of the zodiac, or 72º. Hutton.

woodchat.definition: (a) Any one of several species of Asiatic singing birds belonging to the genera Ianthia and Larvivora. They are closely allied to the European robin. The males are usually bright blue above, and more or less red or rufous beneath. (b) A European shrike (Enneoctonus rufus). In the male the head and n.

excrementitious.definition: Pertaining to, or consisting of, excrement; of the nature of excrement.

seedcake.definition: A sweet cake or cooky containing aromatic seeds, as caraway. Tusser.

laxness.definition: The state of being lax; laxity.

sickless.definition: Free from sickness. Give me long breath, young beds, and sickless ease. Marston.

vinum.definition: Wine, --chiefly used in Pharmacy in the name of solutions of some medicinal substance in wine; as: vina medicata, medicated wines; vinum opii, wine of opium.

incontinent.definition:
Not continent; uncontrolled; not restraining the passions or appetites, particularly the sexual appetite; indulging unlawful lust; unchaste; lewd. 2. (Med.)  Unable to restrain natural evacuations.

One who is unchaste. B. Jonson.

Incontinently; instantly immediately. He says he will return inconti.

dreary.definition: Sorrowful; distressful. " Dreary shrieks." Spenser. 2. Exciting cheerless sensations, feelings, or associations; comfortless; dismal; gloomy. " Dreary shades." Dryden. "The dreary ground." Prior. Full many a dreary anxious hour. Keble. Johnson entered on his vocation in the most dreary part of that.

inuloid.definition: A substance resembling inulin, found in the unripe bulbs of the dahila.

sardius.definition: A precious stone, probably a carnelian, one of which was set in Aaron's breastplate. Ex. xxviii. 17.

bellwort.definition: A genus of plants (Uvularia) with yellowish bell-shaped flowers.
