tarantulated.definition: Bitten by a tarantula; affected with tarantism.

oligochete.definition: Of or pertaining to the Oligochæta.

ruthenium.definition: A rare element of the light platinum group, found associated with platinum ores, and isolated as a hard, brittle steel-gray metal which is very infusible. Symbol Ru. Atomic weight 103.5. Specific gravity 12.26. See Platinum metals, under Platinum.

crossbow.definition: A weapon, used in discharging arrows, formed by placing a bow crosswise on a stock.

areometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the specific gravity of fluids; a form hydrometer.

argillite.definition: Argillaceous schist or slate; clay slate. Its colors is bluish or blackish gray, sometimes greenish gray, brownish red, etc. -- Ar`gil*lit"ic, a.

silvas.definition: Vast woodland plains of South America.

snowberry.definition: A name of several shrubs with white berries; as, the Symphoricarpus racemosus of the Northern United States, and the Chiococca racemosa of Florida and tropical America. Creeping snowberry. (Bot.) See under Creeping.

transumptive.definition: Taking from one to another; metaphorical. "A transumptive kind of speech." Drayton. Fictive, descriptive, digressive, transumptive, and withal definitive. Lowell.

unseam.definition: To open the seam or seams of; to rip; to cut; to cut open. Shak.

clam.definition: (Zoöl.)  A bivalve mollusk of many kinds, especially those that are edible; as, the long clam (Mya arenaria), the quahog or round clam (Venus mercenaria), the sea clam or hen clam (Spisula solidissima), and other species of the United States. The name is said to have been given originally to the Tri.

sixty.definition:
Six times ten; fifty-nine and one more; threescore.

1. The sum of six times ten; sixty units or objects. 2. A symbol representing sixty units, as 60, lx., or LX.

trichiurus.definition: A genus of fishes comprising the hairtails. See Hairtail.

hesitate.definition: To stop or pause respecting decision or action; to be in suspense or uncertainty as to a determination; as, he hesitated whether to accept the offer or not; men often hesitate in forming a judgment. Pope. 2. To stammer; to falter in speaking. Syn. -- To doubt; waver; scruple; deliberate; demur; falt.

principiate.definition: To begin; to initiate. Sir M. Hale.

metol.definition: A whitish soluble powder used as a developer in photography. Chemically, it is the sulphate of methyl-p-amino-m-cresol.

semiamplexicaul.definition: Partially amplexicaul; embracing the stem half round, as a leaf.

jink.definition: To move quickly, esp. with a sudden turn; hence, to dodge; to escape by a quick turn; --obs. or dial., except as a hunting term in pig-sticking. 2.  (Card Playing) In the games of spoilfive and forty-five, to win the game by taking all five tricks; also, to play to win  all five tricks, losing what.

photoglyphic.definition: Pertaining to the art of engraving by the action of light. [Written also photoglyptic.] Photoglyphic engraving, a process of etching on copper, steel, or zinc, by means of the action of light and certain chemicals, so that from the plate impressions may be taken. Sir D. Brewster.

receptibility.definition: The quality or state of being receptible; receivableness. 2. A receptible thing. Glanvill.

noursle.definition: To nurse; to rear; to bring up. [Written also nosel, nousel, nousle, nowsle, nusle, nuzzle, etc.] She noursled him till years he raught. Spenser.

bourgeoisie.definition: The French middle class, particularly such as are concerned in, or dependent on, trade.

fatidical.definition: Having power to foretell future events; prophetic; fatiloquent; as, the fatidical oak. Howell. -- Fa*tid"i*cal*ly, adv.

phanariot.definition: One of the Greeks of Constantinople who after the Turkish conquest became powerful in clerical and other offices under Turkish patronage.

pertinacity.definition: The quality or state of being pertinacious; obstinacy; perseverance; persistency. Macaulay. Syn. -- See Obstinacy.

ashler.definition: (Masonry) (a) Hewn or squared stone; also, masonry made of squared or hewn stone. Rough ashlar, a block of freestone as brought from the quarry. When hammer-dressed it is known as common ashlar. Knight. (b) In the United States especially, a thin facing of squared and dressed stone upon a wall of ru.

merrily.definition: In a merry manner; with mirth; with gayety and laughter; jovially. See Mirth, and Merry. Merrily sing, and sport, and play. Granville.

langteraloo.definition: An old game at cards. See Loo (a) Tatler.

petalism.definition: A form of sentence among the ancient Syracusans by which they banished for five years a citizen suspected of having dangerous influence or ambition. It was similar to the ostracism in Athens; but olive leaves were used instead of shells for ballots.

recompensive.definition: Of the nature of recompense; serving to recompense. Sir T. Browne.

contemporariness.definition: Existence at the same time; contemporaneousness. Howell.

adynamic.definition: (Med.)  Pertaining to, or characterized by, debility of the vital powers; weak. 2. (Physics)  Characterized by the absence of power or force. Adynamic fevers, malignant or putrid fevers attended with great muscular debility.

doublehearted.definition: Having a false heart; deceitful; treacherous. Sandys.

peripateticism.definition: The doctrines or philosophical system of the peripatetics. See Peripatetic, n., 2. Lond. Sat. Rev.

bunion.definition:
Same as Bunyon.

An enlargement and inflammation of a small membranous sac (one of the bursæ muscosæ), usually occurring on the first joint of the great toe.

dere.definition:
To hurt; to harm; to injure. Chaucer.

Harm. Robert of Brunne.

occultism.definition: A certain Oriental system of theosophy. A. P. Sinnett.

ratite.definition: Of or pertaining to the Ratitæ. -- n.  One of the Ratitæ.

ichthyophagist.definition: One who eats, or subsists on, fish.

thereout.definition: Out of that or this. He shall take thereout his handful of the flour. Lev. ii. 2. 2. On the outside; out of doors. Chaucer.

unkingship.definition: The quality or condition of being unkinged; abolition of monarchy. Unkingship was proclaimed, and his majesty's statues thrown down. Evelyn.

cycloid.definition: A curve generated by a point in the plane of a circle when the circle is rolled along a straight line, keeping always in the same plane. Note: The common cycloid is the curve described when the generating point (p) is on the circumference of the generating circle; the curtate cycloid, when that poin.

catheterization.definition: The operation of introducing a catheter.

carvol.definition: One of a species of aromatic oils, resembling carvacrol.

idealism.definition: The quality or state of being ideal. 2. Conception of the ideal; imagery. 3. (Philos.)  The system or theory that denies the existence of material bodies, and teaches that we have no rational grounds to believe in the reality of anything but ideas and their relations.

innocence.definition: The state or quality of being innocent; freedom from that which is harmful or infurious; harmlessness. 2. The state or quality of being morally free from guilt or sin; purity of heart; blamelessness. The silence often of pure innocence Persuades when speaking fails. Shak. Banished from man's life hi.

leaved.definition: Bearing, or having, a leaf or leaves; having folds; -- used in combination; as, a four-leaved clover; a two-leaved gate; long- leaved.

stewartry.definition: An overseer or superintendent. "The stewartry of provisions." Tooke. 2. The office of a steward; stewardship. Byron. 3. In Scotland, the jurisdiction of a steward; also, the lands under such jurisdiction.

aerugo.definition: The rust of any metal, esp. of brass or copper; verdigris.

asystolism.definition: The state or symptoms characteristic of asystole.

deliberate.definition: Weighing facts and arguments with a view a choice or decision; carefully considering the probable consequences of a step; circumspect; slow in determining; -- applied to persons; as, a deliberate judge or counselor. "These deliberate fools." Shak. 2. Formed with deliberation; well-advised; carefully.

preambulation.definition: A walking or going before; precedence. 2. A preamble. Chaucer.

asphyxia.definition: Apparent death, or suspended animation; the condition which results from interruption of respiration, as in suffocation or drowning, or the inhalation of irrespirable gases.

nonunionist.definition: One who does not belong, or refuses to belong, to a trades union.

disrudder.definition: To deprive of the rudder, as a ship.

sheal.definition:
Same as Sheeling. [Scot.]

To put under a sheal or shelter. [Scot.]

To take the husks or pods off from; to shell; to empty of its contents, as a husk or a pod. [Obs. or Prov.Eng. & Scot.] Jamieson. That's a shealed peascod. Shak.

A shell or pod. [Obs. or Prov.Eng.].

blockheadism.definition: That which characterizes a blockhead; stupidity. Carlyle.

charitableness.definition: The quality of being charitable; the exercise of charity.

scarceness.definition: The quality or condition of being scarce; smallness of quantity in proportion to the wants or demands; deficiency; lack of plenty; short supply; penury; as, a scarcity of grain; a great scarcity of beauties. Chaucer. A scarcity of snow would raise a mutiny at Naples. Addison. Praise . . . owes its v.

llama.definition: A South American ruminant (Auchenia llama), allied to the camels, but much smaller and without a hump. It is supposed to be a domesticated variety of the guanaco. It was formerly much used as a beast of burden in the Andes.

disserve.definition: To fail to serve; to do injury or mischief to; to damage; to hurt; to harm. Have neither served nor disserved the interests of any party. Jer. Taylor.

ingenuously.definition: In an ingenuous manner; openly; fairly; candidly; artlessly. Being required to explane himself, he ingeniously confessed. Ludlow.

fecundity.definition: The quality or power of producing fruit; fruitfulness; especially (Biol.), the quality in female organisms of reproducing rapidly and in great numbers. 2. The power of germinating; as in seeds. 3. The power of bringing forth in abundance; fertility; richness of invention; as, the fecundity of God's.

sportule.definition: A charitable gift or contribution; a gift; an alms; a dole; a largess; a sportula. Ayliffe.

strook.definition:
imp. of Strike. Dryden.

A stroke. Chaucer.

burler.definition: One who burls or dresses cloth.

acarus.definition: A genus including many species of small mites.

attagas.definition: A species of sand grouse (Syrrghaptes Pallasii) found in Asia and rarely in southern Europe.

backslide.definition: To slide back; to fall away; esp. to abandon gradually the faith and practice of a religion that has been professed.

pirrie.definition: A rough gale of wind. Sir T. Elyot.

goodly.definition:
Excellently. Spenser.

1. Pleasant; agreeable; desirable. We have many goodly days to see. Shak. 2. Of pleasing appearance or character; comely; graceful; as, a goodly person; goodly raiment, houses. The goodliest man of men since born. Milton. 3. Large; considerable; portly; as, a goodly number. Go.

significator.definition: One who, or that which, signifies. In this diagram there was one significator which pressed remarkably upon our astrologer's attention. Sir W. Scott.

granary.definition: A storehouse or repository for grain, esp. after it is thrashed or husked; a cornbouse; also (Fig.), a region fertile in grain. The exhaustless granary of a world. Thomson.

lithargyrum.definition: Crystallized litharge, obtained by fusion in the form of fine yellow scales.

husbandable.definition: Capable of being husbanded, or managed with economy. Sherwood.

trierarch.definition: (a) The commander of a trireme. (b) At Athens, one who (singly, or jointly with other citizens) had to fit out a trireme for the public service.

scrawl.definition:
See Crawl. Latimer.

To draw or mark awkwardly and irregularly; to write hastily and carelessly; to scratch; to scribble; as, to scrawl a letter. His name, scrawled by himself. Macaulay.

To write unskillfully and inelegantly. Though with a golden pen you scrawl. Swift.

Unskillful or inelegant writ.

bastardize.definition: To make or prove to be a bastard; to stigmatize as a bastard; to declare or decide legally to be illegitimate. The law is so indulgent as not to bastardize the child, if born, though not begotten, in lawful wedlock. Blackstone. 2. To beget out of wedlock. Shak.

wattle.definition: A twig or flexible rod; hence, a hurdle made of such rods. And there he built with wattles from the marsh A little lonely church in days of yore. Tennyson. 2. A rod laid on a roof to support the thatch. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) A naked fleshy, and usually wrinkled and highly colored, process of the skin hangi.

curfew.definition: The ringing of an evening bell, originally a signal to the inhabitants to cover fires, extinguish lights, and retire to rest, -- instituted by William the Conqueror; also, the bell itself. He begins at curfew, and walks till the first cock. Shak. The village curfew, as it tolled profound. Campbell.

postoral.definition: Situated behind, or posterior to, the mouth.

canter.definition: A moderate and easy gallop adapted to pleasure riding. Note: The canter is a thoroughly artificial pace, at first extremely tiring to the horse, and generally only to be produced in him by the restraint of a powerful bit, which compels him to throw a great part of his weight on his haunches . . . Th.

pearlite.definition: A glassy volcanic rock of a grayish color and pearly luster, often having a spherulitic concretionary structure due to the curved cracks produced by contraction in cooling. See Illust. under Perlitic.

unshout.definition: To recall what is done by shouting. Shak.

tinning.definition: The act, art, or process of covering or coating anything with melted tin, or with tin foil, as kitchen utensils, locks, and the like. 2. The covering or lining of tin thus put on.

chargeableness.definition: The quality of being chargeable or expensive. Whitelocke.

aurigation.definition: The act of driving a chariot or a carriage. De Quincey.

gobioid.definition: Like, or pertaining to, the goby, or the genus Gobius. -- n.  A gobioid fish.

canonicity.definition: The state or quality of being canonical; agreement with the canon.

dilatation.definition: Prolixity; diffuse discourse. "What needeth greater dilatation" Chaucer. 2. The act of dilating; expansion; an enlarging on al 3. (Anat.)  A dilation or enlargement of a canal or other organ.

conge.definition:
To take leave with the customary civilities; to bow or courtesy. I have congeed with the duke, done my adieu with his  nearest. Shak.

1. The act of taking leave; parting ceremony; farewell; also, dismissal. Should she pay off old Briggs and give her her congé Thackeray. 2.  The customary act of civ.

apophlegmatic.definition: Designed to facilitate discharges of phlegm or mucus from mouth or nostrils. -- n.  An apohlegmatic medicine.

handspring.definition: A somersault made with the assistance of the hands placed upon the ground.

monotonist.definition: One who talks in the same strain or on the same subject until weariness is produced. Richardson.

judicature.definition: The state or profession of those employed in the administration of justice; also, the dispensing or administration of justice. The honor of the judges in their judicature is the king's honor. Bacon. 2. A court of justice; a judicatory. South. 3. The right of judicial action; jurisdiction; extent jur.

bettor.definition: One who bets; a better. Addison.

geometrical.definition: Pertaining to, or according to the rules or principles of, geometry; determined by geometry; as, a geometrical solution of a problem. Note: Geometric is often used, as opposed to algebraic, to include processes or solutions in which the propositions or principles of geometry are made use of rather t.

carolinian.definition: A native or inhabitant of north or South Carolina.

beal.definition:
A small inflammatory tumor; a pustule.

To gather matter; to swell and come to a head, as a pimple.

glint.definition:
A glimpse, glance, or gleam. [Scot.] "He saw a glint of light." Ramsay.

To glance; to peep forth, as a flower from the bud; to glitter. Burns.

To glance; to turn; as, to glint the eye.

whereto.definition: To which; -- used relatively. "Whereto we have already attained." Phil. iii. 16. Whereto all bonds do tie me day by day. Shak. 2. To what; to what end; -- used interrogatively.

clove.definition:
imp. of Cleave. Cleft. Spenser. Clove hitch (Naut.) See under Hitch. -- Clove hook (Naut.), an iron two-part hook, with jaws overlapping, used in bending chain sheets to the clews of sails; -- called also clip hook. Knight.

A cleft; a gap; a ravine; -- rarely used except as part of a proper name; a.

errancy.definition: A wandering; state of being in error.

olecranal.definition: Of or pertaining to the olecranon.

geometrically.definition: According to the rules or laws of geometry.

gladius.definition: The internal shell, or pen, of cephalopods like the squids.

palladic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or derived from, palladium; -- used specifically to designate those compounds in which the element has a higher valence as contrasted with palladious compounds.

inhume.definition: To deposit, as a dead body, in the earth; to bury; to inter. Weeping they bear the mangled heaps of slain, Inhume the natives in their native plain. Pope. 2. To bury or place in warm earth for chemical or medicinal purposes.

jehovist.definition: One who maintains that the vowel points of the word Jehovah, in Hebrew, are the proper vowels of that word; -- opposed to adonist. 2. The writer of the passages of the Old Testament, especially those of the Pentateuch, in which the Supreme Being is styled Jehovah. See Elohist. The characteristic man.

fosterage.definition: The care of a foster child; the charge of nursing. Sir W. Raleigh.

cantor.definition: A singer; esp. the leader of a church choir; a precentor. The cantor of the church intones the Te Deum. Milman.

coaita.definition: The native name of certain South American monkeys of the genus Ateles, esp. A. paniscus. The black-faced coaita is Ateles ater. See Illustration in Appendix.

reticulum.definition: (a) The second stomach of ruminants, in which folds of the mucous membrane form hexagonal cells; -- also called the honeycomb stomach. (b) The neuroglia.

strigine.definition: Of or pertaining to owls; owl-like.

vivandiere.definition: In Continental armies, especially in the French army, a woman accompanying a regiment, who sells provisions and liquor to the soldiers; a female sutler.

boltrope.definition: A rope stitched to the edges of a sail to strengthen the sail.

amateurship.definition: The quality or character of an amateur.

carbonic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or obtained from, carbon; as, carbonic oxide. Carbonic acid (Chem.), an acid H2CO3, not existing separately, which, combined with positive or basic atoms or radicals, forms carbonates. On common language the term is very generally applied to a compound of carbon and oxygen, CO2, m.

puzzel.definition: A harlot; a drab; a hussy. Shak.

tammy.definition: A kind of woolen, or woolen and cotton, cloth, often highly glazed, -- used for curtains, sieves, strainers, etc. 2. A sieve, or strainer, made of this material; a tamis.

independency.definition: Independence. "Give me," I cried (enough for me), "My bread, and independency!" Pope. 2. (Eccl.)  Doctrine and polity of the Independents.

lepisma.definition: A genus of wingless thysanurous insects having an elongated flattened body, covered with shining scales and terminated by seven unequal bristles. A common species (Lepisma saccharina) is found in houses, and often injures books and furniture. Called also shiner, silver witch, silver moth, and furnit.

snigger.definition:
See Snicker. Thackeray.

See Snicker. Dickens.

noisette.definition: A hybrid rose produced in 1817, by a French gardener, Noisette, of Charleston, South Carolina, from the China rose and the musk rose. It has given rise to many fine varieties, as the Lamarque, the Marechal (or Marshal) Niel, and the Cloth of gold. Most roses of this class have clustered flowers and.

camphorate.definition:
To impregnate or treat with camphor.

A salt of camphoric acid.

Combined or impregnated with camphor. Camphorated oil, an oleaginous preparation containing camphor, much used as an embrocation.

cutlet.definition: A piece of meat, especially of veal or mutton, cut for broiling.

syphilis.definition: The pox, or venereal disease; a chronic, specific, infectious disease, usually communicated by sexual intercourse or by hereditary transmission, and occurring in three stages known as primary, secondary, and tertiary syphilis. See under Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary.Treponema pallidum. Usu. treta.

primariness.definition: The quality or state of being primary, or first in time, in act, or in intention. Norris.

ferme.definition: Rent for a farm; a farm; also, an abode; a place of residence; as, he let his land to ferm. Out of her fleshy ferme fled to the place of pain. Spenser.

blacksmith.definition: A smith who works in iron with a forge, and makes iron utensils, horseshoes, etc. The blacksmith may forge what he pleases. Howell. 2. (Zoöl.)  A fish of the Pacific coast (Chromis, or Heliastes, punctipinnis), of a blackish color.

disclamation.definition: A disavowing or disowning. Bp. Hall.

chaldaic.definition: Of or pertaining to Chaldes. -- n.  The language or dialect of the Chaldeans; Chaldee.

ligneous.definition: Made of wood; consisting of wood; of the nature of, or resembling, wood; woody. It should be tried with shoots of vines and roots of red roses; for it may be they, being of a moreligneous nature, will incorporate with the tree itself. Bacon. Ligneous marble, wood coated or prepared so as to resemble.

myoma.definition: A tumor consisting of muscular tissue.

sparge.definition: To sprinkle; to moisten by sprinkling; as, to sparge paper.

totipalmi.definition: A division of swimming birds including those that have totipalmate feet.

catachrestical.definition: Belonging to, or in the manner of, a catachresis; wrested from its natural sense or form; forced; far-fatched. -- Cat`a*chres"tic*al*ly, adv. [A] catachrestical and improper way of speaking. Jer. Taylor.

wretchedness.definition: The quality or state of being wretched; utter misery. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. A wretched object; anything despicably. Eat worms and such wretchedness. Chaucer.

glover.definition: One whose trade it is to make or sell gloves. Glover's suture or stitch, a kind of stitch used in sewing up wounds, in which the thread is drawn alternately through each side from within outward.

characterless.definition: Destitute of any distinguishing quality; without character or force.

dodo.definition: A large, extinct bird (Didus ineptus), formerly inhabiting the Island of Mauritius. It had short, half-fledged wings, like those of the ostrich, and a short neck and legs; -- called also dronte. It was related to the pigeons.

honey-bag.definition: The receptacle for honey in a honeybee. Shak. Grew.

whirler.definition: One who, or that which, whirls.

babyhood.definition: The state or period of infancy.

recoil.definition: To start, roll, bound, spring, or fall back; to take a reverse motion; to be driven or forced backward; to return. Evil on itself shall back recoil. Milton. The solemnity of her demeanor made it impossible . . . that we should recoil into our ordinary spirits. De Quincey. 2. To draw back, as from an.

leporine.definition: Of or pertaining to a hare; like or characteristic of, a hare.

standish.definition: A stand, or case, for pen and ink. I bequeath to Dean Swift, Esq., my large silver standish. Swift.

bemaze.definition: To bewilder. Intellects bemazed in endless doubt. Cowper.

sagenite.definition: Acicular rutile occurring in reticulated forms imbedded in quartz.

propense.definition: Leaning toward, in a moral sense; inclined; disposed; prone; as, women propense to holiness. Hooker. -- Pro*pense"ly, adv. -- Pro*pense"ness, n.

shingler.definition: One who shingles. 2. A machine for shingling puddled iron.

cornetcy.definition: The commission or rank of a cornet.

enguard.definition: To surround as with a guard. Shak.

sib.definition:
A blood relation. Nash.

Related by blood; akin. [Obs. or Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Sir W. Scott. Your kindred is but . . . little sib to you. Chaucer. [He] is no fairy birn, ne sib at all To elfs, but sprung of seed terrestrial. Spenser.

ultion.definition: The act of taking vengeance; revenge. Sir T. Browne.

hydropathy.definition: The water cure; a mode of treating diseases by the copious and frequent use of pure water, both internally and externally.

amphichroic.definition: Exhibiting or producing two colors, as substances which in the color test may change red litmus to blue and blue litmus to red.

chasuble.definition: The outer vestment worn by the priest in saying Mass, consisting, in the Roman Catholic Church, of a broad, flat, back piece, and a narrower front piece, the two connected over the shoulders only. The back has usually a large cross, the front an upright bar or pillar, designed to be emblematical of.

curvilinead.definition: An instrument for drawing curved lines.

vainly.definition: In a vain manner; in vain.

imperturbable.definition: Incapable of being disturbed or disconcerted; as, imperturbable gravity.

duet.definition: A composition for two performers, whether vocal or instrumental.

snipefish.definition: (a) The bellows fish. (b) A long, slender deep-sea fish (Nemichthys scolopaceus) with a slender beak.

bothy.definition: A wooden hut or humble cot, esp. a rude hut or barrack for unmarried farm servants; a shepherd's or hunter's hut; a booth. [Scot.].

huffingly.definition: Blusteringly; arrogantly. And huffingly doth this bonny Scot ride. Old Ballad.

sectarianism.definition: The quality or character of a sectarian; devotion to the interests of a party; excess of partisan or denominational zeal; adherence to a separate church organization.

endamageable.definition: Capable of being damaged, or injured; damageable.

kistvaen.definition: A Celtic monument, commonly known as a dolmen.

periphrastical.definition: Expressing, or expressed, in more words than are necessary; characterized by periphrase; circumlocutory. Periphrastic conjugation (Gram.), a conjugation formed by the use of the simple verb with one or more auxiliaries.

coafforest.definition: To convert into, or add to, a forest. Howell.

comminatory.definition: Threatening or denouncing punishment; as, comminatory terms. B. Jonson.

tramontana.definition: A dry, cold, violent, northerly wind of the Adriatic.

battue.definition: (a) The act of beating the woods, bushes, etc., for game. (b) The game itself. (c) The wanton slaughter of game. Howitt.

underreckon.definition: To reckon below what is right or proper; to underrate. Bp. Hall.

acetic.definition: (a) Of a pertaining to vinegar; producing vinegar; producing vinegar; as, acetic fermentation. (b) Pertaining to, containing, or derived from, acetyl, as acetic ether, acetic acid. The latter is the acid to which the sour taste of vinegar is due.

passim.definition: Here and there; everywhere; as, this word occurs passim in the poem.

handicraft.definition: A trade requiring skill of hand; manual occupation; handcraft. Addison. 2. A man who earns his living by handicraft; a handicraftsman. Dryden.

patripassian.definition: One of a body of believers in the early church who denied the independent preëxistent personality of Christ, and who, accordingly, held that the Father suffered in the Son; a monarchian. -- Pa`tri*pas"sian*ism, n.

shufflecap.definition: ,.A play performed by shaking money in a hat or cap. Arbuthnot.

bleacher.definition: One who whitens, or whose occupation is to whiten, by bleaching.

atrophy.definition:
A wasting away from want of nourishment; diminution in bulk or slow emaciation of the body or of any part. Milton.

To cause to waste away or become abortive; to starve or weaken.

To waste away; to dwindle.

pilose.definition: Hairy; full of, or made of, hair. The heat-retaining property of the pilose covering. Owen. 2. (Zoöl.)  Clothed thickly with pile or soft down. 3. (Bot.)  Covered with long, slender hairs; resembling long hairs; hairy; as, pilose pubescence.

trias.definition: The formation situated between the Permian and Lias, and so named by the Germans, because consisting of three series of strata, which are called in German the Bunter sandstein, Muschelkalk, and Keuper.

harpy.definition: (Gr. Myth.)  A fabulous winged monster, ravenous and filthy, having the face of a woman and the body of a vulture, with long claws, and the face pale with hunger. Some writers mention two, others three. Both table and provisions vanished guite. With sound of harpies' wings and talons heard. Milton.

tanager.definition: Any one of numerous species of bright-colored singing birds belonging to Tanagra, Piranga, and allied genera. The scarlet tanager (Piranga erythromelas) and the summer redbird (Piranga rubra) are common species of the United States.

taro.definition: A name for several aroid plants (Colocasia antiquorum, var. esculenta, Colocasia macrorhiza, etc.), and their rootstocks. They have large ovate-sagittate leaves and large fleshy rootstocks, which are cooked and used for food in tropical countries.

atmologic.definition: Of or pertaining to atmology. "Atmological laws of heat." Whewell.

reprobationer.definition: One who believes in reprobation. See Reprobation,2. South.

sugary.definition: Resembling or containing sugar; tasting of sugar; sweet. Spenser. 2. Fond of sugar or sweet things; as, a sugary palate.

moulinet.definition: The drum upon which the rope is wound in a capstan, crane, or the like. 2. A machine formerly used for bending a crossbow by winding it up. 3. In sword and saber exercises, a circular swing of the weawon.

excarnation.definition: The act of depriving or divesting of flesh; excarnification; -- opposed to incarnation.

reassume.definition: To assume again or anew; to resume. -- Re`as*sump"tion, n.

untidy.definition: Unseasonable; untimely. "Untidy tales." Piers Plowman. 2. Not tidy or neat; slovenly. -- Un*ti"di*ly, adv. -- Un*ti"di*ness, n.

circumambulate.definition: To walk round about. -- Cir`cum*am`bu*la"tion, n.

seethe.definition:
To decoct or prepare for food in hot liquid; to boil; as, to seethe flesh. [Written also seeth.] Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets. 2 Kings iv. 38.

To be a state of ebullition or violent commotion; to be hot; to boil. 1 Sam. ii. 13. A long Pointe, round which the.

famously.definition: In a famous manner; in a distinguished degree; greatly; splendidly. Then this land was famously enriched With politic grave counsel. Shak.

obitual.definition: Of or pertaining to obits, or days when obits are celebrated; as, obitual days. Smart.

diluvium.definition: A deposit of superficial loam, sand, gravel, stones, etc., caused by former action of flowing waters, or the melting of glacial ice. Note: The accumulation of matter by the ordinary operation of water is termed alluvium.

cimbrian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Cimbri. -- n.  One of the Cimbri. See Cimbric.

benthamic.definition: Of or pertaining to Bentham or Benthamism.

haliography.definition: Description of the sea; the science that treats of the sea.

pert.definition:
Open; evident; apert. Piers Plowman. 2. Lively; brisk; sprightly; smart. Shak. 3. Indecorously free, or presuming; saucy; bold; impertinent. "A very pert manner." Addison. The squirrel, flippant, pert, and full of play. Cowper.

To behave with pertness. Gauden.

outskirt.definition: A part remote from the center; outer edge; border; -- usually in the plural; as, the outskirts of a town. Wordsworth. The outskirts of his march of mystery. Keble.

amphibious.definition: Having the ability to live both on land and in water, as frogs, crocodiles, beavers, and some plants. 2. Pertaining to, adapted for, or connected with, both land and water. The amphibious character of the Greeks was already determined: they were to be lords of land and sea. Hare. 3. Of a mixed natur.

grounding.definition: The act, method, or process of laying a groundwork or foundation; hence, elementary instruction; the act or process of applying a ground, as of color, to wall paper, cotton cloth, etc.; a basis.

talmudism.definition: The teachings of the Talmud, or adherence to them.

sweeper.definition: One who, or that which, sweeps, or cleans by sweeping; a sweep; as, a carpet sweeper. It is oxygen which is the great sweeper of the economy. Huxley.

tansy.definition: (Bot.)  Any plant of the composite genus Tanacetum. The common tansy (T. vulgare) has finely divided leaves, a strong aromatic odor, and a very bitter taste. It is used for medicinal and culinary purposes. 2. A dish common in the seventeenth century, made of eggs, sugar, rose water, cream, and the j.

unyoke.definition: To loose or free from a yoke. "Like youthful steers unyoked, they take their courses." Shak. 2. To part; to disjoin; to disconnect. Shak.

asperne.definition: To spurn; to despise. Sir T. More.

compose.definition: To form by putting together two or more things or parts; to put together; to make up; to fashion. Zeal ought to be composed of the hidhest degrees of all pious affection. Bp. Sprat. 2. To form the substance of, or part of the substance of; to constitute. Their borrowed gold composed The calf in Oreb.

defedation.definition: The act of making foul; pollution.

vitta.definition: (Bot.)  One of the oil tubes in the fruit of umbelliferous plants. 2. (Zoöl.)  A band, or stripe, of color.

questionability.definition: The state or condition of being questionable. Stallo.

scrape.definition: To rub over the surface of (something) with a sharp or rough instrument; to rub over with something that roughens by removing portions of the surface; to grate harshly over; to abrade; to make even, or bring to a required condition or form, by moving the sharp edge of an instrument breadthwise over.

aesthetical.definition: Of or Pertaining to æsthetics; versed in æsthetics; as, æsthetic studies, emotions, ideas, persons, etc. -- Æs*thet"ic*al*ly, adv.

oratorian.definition:
Oratorical. R. North.

See Fathers of the Oratory, under Oratory.

brandling.definition: Same as Branlin, fish and worm.

paraph.definition:
A flourish made with the pen at the end of a signature. In the Middle Ages, this formed a sort of rude safeguard against forgery. Brande & C.

To add a paraph to; to sign, esp. with the initials.

plateau.definition: A flat surface; especially, a broad, level, elevated area of land; a table-land. 2. An ornamental dish for the table; a tray or salver.

archonship.definition: The office of an archon. Mitford.

crossopterygii.definition: An order of ganoid fishes including among living species the bichir (Polypterus). See Brachioganoidei.

euhemerism.definition: The theory, held by Euhemerus, that the gods of mythology were but deified mortals, and their deeds only the amplification in imagination of human acts.

demoniac.definition:
Pertaining to, or characteristic of, a demon or evil spirit; devilish; as, a demoniac being; demoniacal practices. Sarcastic, demoniacal laughter. Thackeray. 2. Influenced or produced by a demon or evil spirit; as, demoniac or demoniacal power. "Demoniac frenzy." Milton.

1. A human being possessed.

connotative.definition: Implying something additional; illative. 2. (Log.)  Implying an attribute. See Connote. Connotative term, one which denotes a subject and implies an attribute. J. S. Mill.

disparager.definition: One who disparages or dishonors; one who vilifies or disgraces.

heartswelling.definition: Rankling in, or swelling, the heart. "Heartswelling hate." Spenser.

hydrometallurgical.definition: Of or pertaining to hydrometallurgy; involving the use of liquid reagents in the treatment or reduction of ores. -- Hy`dro*met`al*lur"gic*al*ly, adv.

splenial.definition:
(a) Designating the splenial bone. (b) Of or pertaining to the splenial bone or splenius muscle. Splenial bone (Anat.), a thin splintlike bone on the inner side of the proximal portion of the mandible of many vertebrates.

The splenial bone.

auscultate.definition: To practice auscultation; to examine by auscultation.

sculler.definition: A boat rowed by one man with two sculls, or short oars. Dryden. 2. One who sculls.

glutaconic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, an acid intermediate between glutaric and aconitic acids.

rose-water.definition: Having the odor of rose water; hence, affectedly nice or delicate; sentimental. "Rose-water philantropy." Carlyle.

birdseed.definition: Canary seed, hemp, millet or other small seeds used for feeding caged birds. BIRD'S-EYE Bird's"-eye`, a. 1. Seen from above, as if by a flying bird; embraced at a glance; hence, generalas, a bird's-eye view. 2. Marked with spots resembling bird's eyes; as, bird's-eye diaper; bird's-eye maple. BIRD'S.

elliptic-lanceolate.definition: Having a form intermediate between elliptic and lanceolate.

tenantless.definition: Having no tenants; unoccupied; as, a tenantless mansion. Shak.

redde.definition: obs. imp. of Read, or Rede. Chaucer.

praecommissure.definition: A transverse commissure in the anterior part of the third ventricle of the brain; the anterior cerebral commissure.

prudentialist.definition: One who is governed by, or acts from, prudential motives. Coleridge.

orphanotrophism.definition: The care and support of orphans. Cotton Mather (1711).

polyeidic.definition: Passing through several distinct larval forms; -- having several distinct kinds of young.

drowsy.definition: Inclined to drowse; heavy with sleepiness; lethargic; dozy. "When I am drowsy." Shak. Dapples the drowsy east with spots of gray. Shak. To our age's drowsy blood Still shouts the inspiring sea. Lowell. 2. Disposing to sleep; lulling; soporific. The drowsy hours, dispensers of all good. Tennyson. 3.

magbote.definition:
Compensation for the injury done by slaying a kinsman. Spelman.

See Mægbote.

acarina.definition: The group of Arachnida which includes the mites and ticks. Many species are parasitic, and cause diseases like the itch and mange.

alienist.definition: One who treats diseases of the mind. Ed. Rev.

towboat.definition: A vessel constructed for being towed, as a canal boat. 2. A steamer used for towing other vessels; a tug.

heam.definition: The afterbirth or secundines of a beast.

viminal.definition: Of or pertaining to twigs; consisting of twigs; producing twigs.

icy-pearled.definition: Spangled with ice. Mounting up in icy-pearled car. Milton. I'D I'd  . A contraction from I would or I had.

versemonger.definition: A writer of verses; especially, a writer of commonplace poetry; a poetaster; a rhymer; -- used humorously or in contempt.

owlery.definition: An abode or a haunt of owls.

mero.definition: Any of several large groupers of warm seas, esp. the guasa (Epinephelus guaza), the red grouper (E. morio), the black grouper (E. nigritas), distinguished as Me"ro de lo al"to, and a species called also rock hind, distinguished as Me"ro ca*brol"la.

hibiscus.definition: A genus of plants (herbs, shrubs, or trees), some species of which have large, showy flowers. Some species are cultivated in India for their fiber, which is used as a substitute for hemp. See Althea, Hollyhock, and Manoe.

fireball.definition: (a) (Mil.) A ball filled with powder or other combustibles, intended to be thrown among enemies, and to injure by explosion; also, to set fire to their works and light them up, so that movements may be seen. (b) A luminous meteor, resembling a ball of fire passing rapidly through the air, and someti.

grazier.definition: One who pastures cattle, and rears them for market. The inhabitants be rather . . . graziers than plowmen. Stow.

sirdar.definition: A native chief in Hindostan; a headman. Malcom.

snet.definition:
The fat of a deer. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.]

The clear of mucus; to blow. "Snetting his nose." Holland.

existent.definition: Having being or existence; existing; being; occurring now; taking place. The eyes and mind are fastened on objects which have no real being, as if they were truly existent. Dryden.

unconcludent.definition: Inconclusive. Locke. -- Un`con*clud"ing*ness, n. Jer. Taylor.

monarchical.definition: Of or pertaining to a monarch, or to monarchy. Burke. -- Mo*nar"chic*al*ly, adv.

horrific.definition: Causing horror; frightful. Let . . . nothing ghastly or horrific be supposed. I. Taylor.

tirralirra.definition: A verbal imitation of a musical sound, as of the note of a lark or a horn. The lark, that tirra lyra chants. Shak. "Tirralira, " by the river, Sang Sir Lancelot. Tennyson.

disrespective.definition: Showing want of respect; disrespectful. Bp. Hall.

pearlins.definition: A kind of lace of silk or thread. [Scot.] Sir W. Scott.

platting.definition: Plaited strips or bark, cane, straw, etc., used for making hats or the like.

tussal.definition: Pertaining to, or manifested by, cough.

inadherent.definition: Not adhering. 2. (Bot.)  Free; not connected with the other organs.

fenny.definition: Pertaining to, or inhabiting, a fen; abounding in fens; swampy; boggy. "Fenny snake." Shak.

crispness.definition: The state or quality of being crisp.

sutlership.definition: The condition or occupation of a sutler.

variometer.definition: An instrument for comparing magnetic forces, esp. in the earth's magnetic field.

isochimal.definition: Pertaining to, having the nature of, or making, isocheims; as, an isocheimal line; an isocheimal chart.

clematis.definition: A genus of flowering plants, of many species, mostly climbers, having feathery styles, which greatly enlarge in the fruit; -- called also virgin's bower.

resoluble.definition: Admitting of being resolved; resolvable; as, bodies resoluble by fire. Boyle. -- Res"o*lu*ble*ness, n.

tractable.definition: Capable of being easily led, taught, or managed; docile; manageable; governable; as, tractable children; a tractable learner. I shall find them tractable enough. Shak. 2. Capable of being handled; palpable; practicable; feasible; as, tractable measures. Holder. --Tract"a*ble*ness, n. -- Tract"a/bly,.

straught.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Stretch.

To stretch; to make straight. [Written also straucht.] [Scot.] Sir W. Scott.

skulker.definition: One who, or that which, skulks.

misfaith.definition: Want of faith; distrust. "[Anger] born of your misfaith." Tennyson.

mummery.definition: Masking; frolic in disguise; buffoonery. The mummery of foreign strollers. Fenton. 2. Farcical show; hypocritical disguise and parade or ceremonies. Bacon.

saccharimetry.definition: The act, process or method of determining the amount and kind of sugar present in sirup, molasses, and the like, especially by the employment of polarizing apparatus.

scrimmage.definition: Formerly, a skirmish; now, a general row or confused fight or struggle. 2. (Football)  The struggle in the rush lines after the ball is put in play.

chaussure.definition: A foot covering of any kind.

outsell.definition: To exceed in amount of sales; to sell more than. 2. To exceed in the price of selling; to fetch more than; to exceed in value. Fuller. Shak.

septal.definition: Of or pertaining to a septum or septa, as of a coral or a shell.

ynambu.definition: A South American tinamou (Rhynchotus rufescens); -- called also perdiz grande, and rufous tinamou. See Illust. of Tinamou.

langaha.definition: A curious colubriform snake of the genus Xyphorhynchus, from Madagascar. It is brownish red, and its hose is prolonged in the form of a sharp blade.

pardie.definition: Certainly; surely; truly; verily; -- originally an oath. [Written also pardee, pardieux, perdie, etc.] He was, parde, an old fellow of yours. Chaucer.

melodramatic.definition: Of or pertaining to melodrama; like or suitable to a melodrama; unnatural in situation or action. -- Mel`o*dra*mat"ic*al*ly, adv.

fatherland.definition: One's native land; the native land of one's fathers or ancestors.

dambonite.definition: A white crystalline, sugary substance obtained from an African caotchouc.

impoundage.definition: The act of impounding, or the state of being impounded. 2. The fee or fine for impounding.

definable.definition: Capable of being defined, limited, or explained; determinable; describable by definition; ascertainable; as, definable limits; definable distinctions or regulations; definable words. -- De*fin"a*bly, adv.

consubstantially.definition: In a consubstantial manner; with identity of substance or nature.

definiteness.definition: The state of being definite; determinateness; precision; certainty.

dewret.definition: To ret or rot by the process called dewretting.

immaterialism.definition: The doctrine that immaterial substances or spiritual being exist, or are possible. 2. (Philos.)  The doctrine that external bodies may be reduced to mind and ideas in a mind; any doctrine opposed to materialism or phenomenalism, esp. a system that maintains the immateriality of the soul; idealism; e.

debutant.definition: A person who makes his (or her) first appearance before the public.

knobby.definition: Full of, or covered with, knobs or hard protuberances. Dr. H. More. 2. Irregular; stubborn in particulars. The informers continued in a knobby kind of obstinacy. Howell. 3. Abounding in rounded hills or mountains; hilly. [U.S.] Bartlett.

annihilate.definition: To reduce to nothing or nonexistence; to destroy the existence of; to cause to cease to be. It impossible for any body to be utterly annihilated. Bacon. 2. To destroy the form or peculiar distinctive properties of, so that the specific thing no longer exists; as, to annihilate a forest by cutting do.

palmetto.definition: A name given to palms of several genera and species growing in the West Indies and the Southern United States. In the United States, the name is applied especially to the Chamærops, or Sabal, Palmetto, the cabbage tree of Florida and the Carolinas. See Cabbage tree, under Cabbage. Royal palmetto, th.

zygospore.definition: (a) Same as Zygosperm. (b) A spore formed by the union of several zoöspores; -- called also zygozoöspore.

bitternut.definition: The swamp hickory (Carya amara). Its thin-shelled nuts are bitter.

placentalia.definition: A division of Mammalia including those that have a placenta, or all the orders above the marsupials.

affreight.definition: To hire, as a ship, for the transportation of goods or freight.

lingel.definition: A shoemaker's thread. 2. A little tongue or thong of leather; a lacing for belts. Crabb.

gelid.definition: Cold; very cold; frozen. "Gelid founts." Thompson.

disimprovement.definition: Reduction from a better to a worse state; as, disimprovement of the earth.

frolicly.definition: In a frolicsome manner; with mirth and gayety. Beau. & Fl.

coagency.definition: Agency in common; joint agency or agent. Coleridge.

scotist.definition: A follower of (Joannes) Duns Scotus, the Franciscan scholastic (d. 1308), who maintained certain doctrines in philosophy and theology, in opposition to the Thomists, or followers of Thomas Aquinas, the Dominican scholastic.

serrated.definition: Notched on the edge, like a saw. 2. (Bot.)  Beset with teeth pointing forwards or upwards; as, serrate leaves. Doubly serrate, having small serratures upon the large ones, as the leaves of the elm. -- Serrate-ciliate, having fine hairs, like the eyelashes, on the serratures; -- said of a leaf. -- Se.

anhima.definition: A South American aquatic bird; the horned screamer or kamichi (Palamedea cornuta). See Kamichi.

heteromera.definition: A division of Coleoptera, having heteromerous tarsi.

breathless.definition: Spent with labor or violent action; out of breath. 2. Not breathing; holding the breath, on account of fear, expectation, or intense interest; attended with a holding of the breath; as, breathless attention. But breathless, as we grow when feeling most. Byron. 3. Dead; as, a breathless body.

refractometer.definition: A contrivance for exhibiting and measuring the refraction of light.

comet-seeker.definition: A telescope of low power, having a large field of view, used for finding comets.

gregge.definition: To make heavy; to increase. Wyclif.

endorhizal.definition: Having the radicle of the embryo sheathed by the cotyledon, through which the embryo bursts in germination, as in many monocotyledonous plants.

ventriloquism.definition: The act, art, or practice of speaking in such a manner that the voice appears to come, not from the person speaking, but from some other source, as from the opposite side of the room, from the cellar, etc.

irredeemable.definition: Not redeemable; that can not be redeemed; not payable in gold or silver, as a bond; -- used especially of such government notes, issued as currency, as are not convertible into coin at the pleasure of the holder. -- Ir`re*deem"a*ble*ness, adv.

inequivalve.definition: Having unequal valves, as the shell of an oyster.

lignose.definition:
Ligneous. Evelyn.

1. (Bot.)  See Lignin. 2. (Chem.)  An explosive compound of wood fiber and nitroglycerin. See Nitroglycerin.

vermiform.definition: Resembling a worm in form or motions; vermicular; as, the vermiform process of the cerebellum. Vermiform appendix (Anat.), a slender blind process of the cæcum in man and some other animals; -- called also vermiform appendage, and vermiform process. Small solid bodies, such as grape seeds or cherry.

pistillody.definition: The metamorphosis of other organs into pistils.

dimensive.definition: Without dimensions; marking dimensions or the limits. Who can draw the soul's dimensive lines Sir J. Davies.

muticous.definition: Without a point or pointed process; blunt.

barehead.definition: Having the head uncovered; as, a bareheaded girl.

cheep.definition:
To chirp, as a young bird.

To give expression to in a chirping tone. Cheep and twitter twenty million loves. Tennyson.

A chirp, peep, or squeak, as of a young bird or mousse.

corybantic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or resembling, the Corybantes or their rites; frantic; frenzied; as, a corybantic dance.

deutoplastic.definition: Pertaining to, or composed of, deutoplasm.

backboard.definition: A board which supports the back wen one is sitting; Note: specifically, the board athwart the after part of a boat. 2. A board serving as the back part of anything, as of a wagon. 3. A thin stuff used for the backs of framed pictures, mirrors, etc. 4. A board attached to the rim of a water wheel to.

southerliness.definition: The quality or state of being southerly; direction toward the south.

phraseology.definition: Manner of expression; peculiarity of diction; style. Most completely national in his . . . phraseology. I. Taylor. 2. A collection of phrases; a phrase book. Syn. -- Diction; style. See Diction.

caparro.definition: A large South American monkey (Lagothrix Humboldtii), with prehensile tail.

voluntariness.definition: The quality or state of being voluntary; spontaneousness; specifically, the quality or state of being free in the exercise of one's will.

jagannath.definition: A particular form of Vishnu, or of Krishna, whose chief idol and worship are at Puri, in Orissa. The idol is considered to contain the bones of Krishna and to possess a soul. The principal festivals are the Snanayatra, when the idol is bathed, and the Rathayatra, when the image is drawn upon a car a.

tymp.definition: A hollow water-cooled iron casting in the upper part of the archway in which the dam stands.

semiconscious.definition: Half conscious; imperfectly conscious. De Quincey.

impolicy.definition: The quality of being impolitic; inexpedience; unsuitableness to the end proposed; bads policy; as, the impolicy of fraud. Bp. Horsley.

vermicide.definition: A medicine which destroys intestinal worms; a worm killer. Pereira.

methaemoglobin.definition: A stable crystalline compound obtained by the decomposition of hemoglobin. It is found in old blood stains.

fitz.definition: A son; -- used in compound names, to indicate paternity, esp. of the illegitimate sons of kings and princes of the blood; as, Fitzroy, the son of the king; Fitzclarence, the son of the duke of Clarence.

bargainor.definition: One who makes a bargain, or contracts with another; esp., one who sells, or contracts to sell, property to another. Blackstone.

impetration.definition: The act of impetrating, or obtaining by petition or entreaty. In way of impertation procuring the removal or allevation of our crosses. Barrow. 2. (Old Eng. Law)  The obtaining of benefice from Rome by solicitation, which benefice belonged to the disposal of the king or other lay patron of the realm.

manducate.definition: To masticate; to chew; to eat. Jer. Taylor.

analepsy.definition: (a) Recovery of strength after sickness. (b) A species of epileptic attack, originating from gastric disorder.

counterprove.definition: To take a counter proof of, or a copy in reverse, by taking an impression directly from the face of an original. See Counter proof, under Counter.

beaupere.definition: A father. Wyclif. 2. A companion. Spenser.

stycerin.definition: A triacid alcohol, related to glycerin, and obtained from certain styryl derivatives as a yellow, gummy, amorphous substance; - - called also phenyl glycerin.

exordial.definition: Pertaining to the exordium of a discourse: introductory. The exordial paragraph of the second epistle. I. Taylor.

erythraean.definition: Red in color. "The erythrean main." Milton.

grudgeful.definition: Full of grudge; envious. "Grudgeful discontent." Spenser.

laryngologist.definition: One who applies himself to laryngology.

seabeach.definition: A beach lying along the sea. "The bleak seabeach." Longfellow.

vanquisher.definition: One who, or that which, vanquishes. Milton.

doughty.definition: Able; strong; valiant; redoubtable; as, a doughty hero. Sir Thopas wex [grew] a doughty swain. Chaucer. Doughty families, hugging old musty quarrels to their hearts, buffet each other from generation to generation. Motley. Note: Now seldom used, except in irony or burlesque.

mahdism.definition: Belief in the coming of the Mahdi; fanatical devotion to the cause of the Mahdi or a pretender to that title. -- Mah"dist (#), n. Mahdism has proved the most shameful and terrible instrument of bloodshed and oppression which the modern world has ever witnessed. E. N. Bennett.

thymene.definition: A liquid terpene obtained from oil of thyme.

solenacean.definition: Any species of marine bivalve shells belonging to the family Solenidæ.

phlegmatic.definition: Watery. "Aqueous and phlegmatic." Sir I. Newton. 2. Abounding in phlegm; as, phlegmatic humors; a phlegmatic constitution. Harvey. 3. Generating or causing phlegm. "Cold and phlegmatic habitations." Sir T. Browne. 4. Not easily excited to action or passion; cold; dull; sluggish; heavy; as, a phlegma.

blancmange.definition: A preparation for desserts, etc., made from isinglass, sea moss, cornstarch, or other gelatinous or starchy substance, with mild, usually sweetened and flavored, and shaped in a mold.

intendant.definition:
One who has the charge, direction, or management of some public business; a superintendent; as, an intendant of marine; an intendant of finance.

Attentive.

halves.definition: pl. of Half. By halves, by one half at once; halfway; fragmentarily; partially; incompletely. I can not believe by halves; either I have faith, or I have it not. J. H. Newman. To go halves. See under Go.

gemitores.definition: A division of birds including the true pigeons.

englishry.definition: The state or privilege of being an Englishman. Cowell. 2. A body of English or people of English descent; -- commonly applied to English people in Ireland. A general massacre of the Englishry. Macaulay.

dismayedness.definition: A state of being dismayed; dejection of courage; dispiritedness.

sottish.definition: Like a sot; doltish; very foolish; drunken. How ignorant are sottish pretenders to astrology! Swift. Syn. -- Dull; stupid; senseless; doltish; infatuate. -- Sot"tish*ly, adv. -- Sot"tish*ness, n.

spicknel.definition: An umbelliferous herb (Meum Athamanticum) having finely divided leaves, common in Europe; -- called also baldmoney, mew, and bearwort. [Written also spignel.].

hierocracy.definition: Government by ecclesiastics; a hierarchy. Jefferson.

ungovernable.definition: Not governable; not capable of being governed, ruled, or restrained; licentious; wild; unbridled; as, ungovernable passions. -- Un*gov"ern*a*bly, adv. Goldsmith.

nimble.definition: Light and quick in motion; moving with ease and celerity; lively; swift. Through the mid seas the nimble pinnace sails. Pope. Note: Nimble is sometimes used in the formation of self-explaining compounds; as, nimble-footed, nimble-pinioned, nimble-winged, etc. Nimble Will (Bot.), a slender, branching.

conscionableness.definition: The quality of being conscionable; reasonableness. Johnson.

digladiation.definition: Act of digladiating. "Sore digladiations and contest." Evelyn.

anachronism.definition: A misplacing or error in the order of time; an error in chronology by which events are misplaced in regard to each other, esp. one by which an event is placed too early; falsification of chronological relation.

ax.definition: A tool or instrument of steel, or of iron with a steel edge or blade, for felling trees, chopping and splitting wood, hewing timber, etc. It is wielded by a wooden helve or handle, so fixed in a socket or eye as to be in the same plane with the blade. The broadax, or carpenter's ax, is an ax for hew.

lucimeter.definition: an instrument for measuring the intensity of light; a photometer.

smartness.definition: The quality or state of being smart.

digitate.definition:
To point out as with the finger. Robinson (Eudoxa).

Having several leaflets arranged, like the fingers of the hand, at the extremity of a stem or petiole. Also, in general, characterized by digitation. -- Dig"i*tate*ly, adv.

streaminess.definition: The state of being streamy; a trailing. R. A. Proctor.

cultrivorous.definition: Devouring knives; swallowing, or pretending to swallow, knives; -- applied to persons who have swallowed, or have seemed to swallow, knives with impunity. Dunglison.

depurgatory.definition: Serving to purge; tending to cleanse or purify. Cotgrave.

underniceness.definition: A want of niceness; indelicacy; impropriety.

drier.definition:
One who, or that which, dries; that which may expel or absorb moisture; a desiccative; as, the sun and a northwesterly wind are great driers of the earth. 2. (Paint.)  Drying oil; a substance mingled with the oil used in oil painting to make it dry quickly.

of Dry, a.

lammergeir.definition: A very large vulture (Gypaëtus barbatus), which inhabits the mountains of Southern Europe, Asia, and Northern Africa. When full- grown it is nine or ten feet in extent of wings. It is brownish black above, with the under parts and neck rusty yellow; the forehead and crown white; the sides of the hea.

overwork.definition:
To work beyond the strength; to cause to labor too much or too long; to tire excessively; as, to overwork a horse. 2. To fill too full of work; to crowd with labor. My days with toil are overwrought. Longfellow. 3. To decorate all over.

To work too much, or beyond one's strength.

Work in excess of.

cudbear.definition: A powder of a violet red color, difficult to moisten with water, used for making violet or purple dye. It is prepared from certain species of lichen, especially Lecanora tartarea. Ure. 2. (Bot.)  A lichen (Lecanora tartarea), from which the powder is obtained.

evangely.definition: Evangel. The sacred pledge of Christ's evangely. Spenser.

matanza.definition: A place where animals are slaughtered for their hides and tallow. [Western U. S.].

awhape.definition: To confound; to terrify; to amaze. Spenser.

semicope.definition: A short cope, or an inferier kind of cope. Chaucer.

gravery.definition: The act, process, or art, of graving or carving; engraving. Either of picture or gravery and embossing. Holland.

supposal.definition: The act of supposing; also, that which is supposed; supposition; opinion. Shak. Interest, with a Jew, never proceeds but upon supposal, at least, of a firm and sufficient bottom. South.

veney.definition: A bout; a thrust; a venew. Beau. & Fl. Three veneys for a dish of stewed prunes. Shak.

hippocrepian.definition: One of an order of fresh-water Bryozoa, in which the tentacles are on a lophophore, shaped like a horseshoe. See Phylactolæma.

aard-vark.definition: An edentate mammal, of the genus Orycteropus, somewhat resembling a pig, common in some parts of Southern Africa. It burrows in the ground, and feeds entirely on ants, which it catches with its long, slimy tongue.

dogday.definition: One of the dog days. Dogday cicada (Zoöl.), a large American cicada (C. pruinosa), which trills loudly in midsummer.

cinch.definition: A strong saddle girth, as of canvas. [West. U. S.] 2. A tight grip.

lurch.definition:
To swallow or eat greedily; to devour; hence, to swallow up. Too far off from great cities, which may hinder business; too near them, which lurcheth all provisions, and maketh everything dear. Bacon.

1. An old game played with dice and counters; a variety of the game of tables. 2. A double score in.

sonorous.definition: Giving sound when struck; resonant; as, sonorous metals. 2. Loud-sounding; giving a clear or loud sound; as, a sonorous voice. 3. Yielding sound; characterized by sound; vocal; sonant; as, the vowels are sonorous. 4. Impressive in sound; high-sounding. The Italian opera, amidst all the meanness and.

onionskin.definition: A kind of thin translucent paper with a glossy finish.

sithens.definition: Since. See Sith, and Sithen. Piers Plowman.

tentaculite.definition: Any one of numerous species of small, conical fossil shells found in Paleozoic rocks. They are supposed to be pteropods.

sequacity.definition: Quality or state of being sequacious; sequaciousness. Bacon.

columbary.definition: A dovecote; a pigeon house. Sir T. Browne.

adscript.definition:
Held to service as attached to the soil; -- said of feudal serfs.

One held to service as attached to the glebe or estate; a feudal serf. Bancroft.

conspectus.definition: A general sketch or outline of a subject; a synopsis; an epitome.

rhemish.definition: Of or pertaining to Rheimis, or Reima, in France. Rhemish Testament, the English version of the New Testament used by Roman Catholics. See Douay Bible.

exsiccant.definition: Having the quality of drying up; causing a drying up. -- n. (Med.)  An exsiccant medicine.

drawbore.definition:
A hole bored through a tenon nearer to the shoulder than the holes through the cheeks are to the edge or abutment against which the shoulder is to rest, so that a pin or bolt, when driven into it, will draw these parts together. Weale.

1. To make a drawbore in; as, to drawbore a tenon. 2. To enlarg.

illuminative.definition: Tending to illuminate or illustrate; throwing light; illustrative. "Illuminative reading." Carlyle.

paraxial.definition: On either side of the axis of the skeleton.

concoctive.definition: Having the power of digesting or ripening; digestive. Hence the concoctive powers, with various art, Subdue the cruder aliments to chyle. J. Armstrong.

isthmus.definition: A neck or narrow slip of land by which two continents are connected, or by which a peninsula is united to the mainland; as, the Isthmus of Panama; the Isthmus of Suez, etc. Isthmus of the fauces. (Anat.) See Fauces.

traveled.definition: Having made journeys; having gained knowledge or experience by traveling; hence, knowing; experienced. [Written also travelled.] The traveled thane, Athenian Aberdeen. Byron.

glamour.definition: A charm affecting the eye, making objects appear different from what they really are. 2. Witchcraft; magic; a spell. Tennyson. 3. A kind of haze in the air, causing things to appear different from what they really are. The air filled with a strange, pale glamour that seemed to lie over the broad val.

reformative.definition: Forming again; having the quality of renewing form; reformatory. Good.

argentite.definition: Sulphide of silver; -- also called vitreous silver, or silver glance. It has a metallic luster, a lead-gray color, and is sectile like lead.

birthright.definition: Any right, privilege, or possession to which a person is entitled by birth, such as an estate descendible by law to an heir, or civil liberty under a free constitution; esp. the rights or inheritance of the first born. Lest there be any . . . profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold.

perfunctoriness.definition: The quality or state of being perfunctory.

sybarite.definition: A person devoted to luxury and pleasure; a voluptuary.

trustful.definition: Full of trust; trusting. 2. Worthy of trust; faithful; trusty; trustworthy. -- Trust"ful*ly,adv. -- Trust"ful*ness, n.

ornament.definition:
That which embellishes or adorns; that which adds grace or beauty; embellishment; decoration; adornment. The ornament of a meek and quiet spirit. 1 Pet. iii. 4. Like that long-buried body of the king Found lying with his urns and ornaments. Tennyson.

To adorn; to deck; to embellish; to beautify; as.

gordiacea.definition: A division of nematoid worms, including the hairworms or hair eels (Gordius and Mermis). See Gordius, and Illustration in Appendix.

cautionary.definition: Conveying a caution, or warning to avoid danger; as, cautionary signals. 2. Given as a pledge or as security. He hated Barnevelt, for his getting the cautionary towns out of his hands. Bp. Burnet. 3. Wary; cautious. Bacon.

exacerbate.definition: To render more violent or bitter; to irriate; to exasperate; to imbitter, as passions or disease. Broughman.

zwinglian.definition: Of or pertaining to Ulric Zwingli (1481-1531), the reformer of German Switzerland, who maintained that in the Lord's Supper the true body of Christ is present by the contemplation of faith but not in essence or reality, and that the sacrament is a memorial without mystical elements. -- n.  A followe.

ens.definition: (Metaph.)  Entity, being, or existence; an actually existing being; also, God, as the Being of Beings. 2. (Chem.)  Something supposed to condense within itself all the virtues and qualities of a substance from which it is extracted; essence.

aponeurosis.definition: Any one of the thicker and denser of the deep fasciæ which cover, invest, and the terminations and attachments of, many muscles. They often differ from tendons only in being flat and thin. See Fascia.

onomasticon.definition: A collection of names and terms; a dictionary; specif., a collection of Greek names, with explanatory notes, made by Julius Pollux about A.D.180.

fortifier.definition: One who, or that which, fortifies, strengthens, supports, or upholds.

reconnoiter.definition: To examine with the eye to make a preliminary examination or survey of; esp., to survey with a view to military or engineering operations. 2. To recognize. Sir H. Walpole.

polychord.definition:
Having many strings.

(a) A musical instrument of ten strings. (b) An apparatus for coupling two octave notes, capable of being attached to a keyed instrument.

capriole.definition:
(Man.)  A leap that a horse makes with all fours, upwards only, without advancing, but with a kick or jerk of the hind legs when at the height of the leap. 2. A leap or caper, as in dancing. "With lofty turns and caprioles." Sir J. Davies.

To perform a capriole. Carlyle.

oxymethylene.definition: Formic aldehyde, regarded as a methylene derivative.

universally.definition: In a universal manner; without exception; as, God's laws are universally binding on his creatures.

dualistic.definition: Consisting of two; pertaining to dualism or duality. Dualistic system or theory (Chem.), the theory, originated by Lavoisier and developed by Berzelius, that all definite compounds are binary in their nature, and consist of two distinct constituents, themselves simple or complex, and possessed of op.

neutrally.definition: In a neutral manner; without taking part with either side; indifferently.

justiciable.definition: Proper to be examined in a court of justice. Bailey.

imrigh.definition: A peculiar strong soup or broth, made in Scotland. [Written also imrich.].

gainly.definition: Handily; readily; dexterously; advantageously. Dr. H. More.

homogenesis.definition: That method of reproduction in which the successive generations are alike, the offspring, either animal or plant, running through the same cycle of existence as the parent; gamogenesis; -- opposed to heterogenesis.

microform.definition: A microscopic form of life; an animal or vegetable organism microscopic size.

bacterioscopic.definition: Relating to bacterioscopy; as, a bacterioscopic examination.

hexagonal.definition: Having six sides and six angles; six-sided. Hexagonal system. (Crystal.) See under Crystallization.

sententiosity.definition: The quality or state of being sententious. Sir T. Browne.

severally.definition: Separately; distinctly; apart from others; individually. There must be an auditor to check and revise each severally by itself. De Quincey.

binaural.definition: Of or pertaining to, or used by, both ears.

mucamide.definition: The acid amide of mucic acid, obtained as a white crystalline substance.

manubrial.definition: Of or pertaining to a manubrium; shaped like a manubrium; handlelike.

aphetism.definition: An aphetized form of a word. New Eng. Dict.

mercurialize.definition:
(Med.)  To affect with mercury. 2. (Photography)  To treat with mercury; to expose to the vapor of mercury.

To be sprightly, fantastic, or capricious.

mistrust.definition:
Want of confidence or trust; suspicion; distrust. Milton.

1. To regard with jealousy or suspicion; to suspect; to doubt the integrity of; to distrust. I will never mistrust my wife again. Shak. 2. To forebode as near, or likely to occur; to surmise. By a divine instinct, men's minds mistrust Ensuin.

paleozooelogy.definition: The science of extinct animals, a branch of paleontology.

enneapetalous.definition: Having nine petals, or flower leaves.

resuscitation.definition: The act of resuscitating, or state of being resuscitated. The subject of resuscitation by his sorceries. Sir W. Scott.

sermonical.definition: Like, or appropriate to, a sermon; grave and didactic. "Conversation . . . satirical or sermonic." Prof. Wilson. "Sermonical style." V. Knox.

thecodactyl.definition: Any one of a group of lizards of the Gecko tribe, having the toes broad, and furnished with a groove in which the claws can be concealed.

epical.definition: Epic. -- Ep"ic*al*ly, adv. Poems which have an epical character. Brande & C. His [Wordsworth's] longer poems (miscalled epical). Lowell.

splasher.definition: One who, or that which, splashes. 2. One of the guarde over the wheels, as of a carriage, locomotive, etc. Weale. 3. A guard to keep off splashes from anything.

recarnify.definition: To convert again into flesh. Howell.

physograde.definition: Any siphonophore which has an air sac for a float, as the Physalia.

pugnacity.definition: Inclination or readiness to fight; quarrelsomeness. " A national pugnacity of character." Motley.

oviparity.definition: Generatuon by means of ova. See Generation.

pendulous.definition: Depending; pendent loosely; hanging; swinging. Shak. "The pendulous round earth. Milton. 2. Wavering; unstable; doubtful. "A pendulous state of mind." Atterbury. 3. (Bot.)  Inclined or hanging downwards, as a flower on a recurved stalk, or an ovule which hangs from the upper part of the ovary.

direption.definition: The act of plundering, despoiling, or snatching away. Speed.

epizoic.definition:
Living upon the exterior of another animal; ectozoic; -- said of external parasites.

Living upon the exterior of another animal; ectozoic; -- said of external parasites.

siliciureted.definition: Combined or impregnated with silicon. [Obsoles.] Siliciureted hydrogen. (Chem.) Hydrogen silicide.

mahratta.definition:
One of a numerous people inhabiting the southwestern part of India. Also, the language of the Mahrattas; Mahrati. It is closely allied to Sanskrit. -- a.  Of or pertaining to the Mahrattas. [Written also Maratha.]

A Sanskritic language of western India, prob. descended from the Maharastri Prakrit,.

lyken.definition: To please; -- chiefly used impersonally. " Sith it lyketh you." Chaucer.

encyclic.definition:
Sent to many persons or places; intended for many, or for a whole order of men; general; circular; as, an encyclical letter of a council, of a bishop, or the pope.

An encyclical letter, esp. one from a pope. Shipley.

puckish.definition: Resembling Puck; merry; mischievous. "Puckish freaks." J. R. Green.

basined.definition: Inclosed in a basin. "Basined rivers." Young.

gothamist.definition: A wiseacre; a person deficient in wisdom; -- so called from Gotham, in Nottinghamshire, England, noted for some pleasant blunders. Bp. Morton.

gulgul.definition: A cement made in India from sea shells, pulverized and mixed with oil, and spread over a ship's bottom, to prevent the boring of worms.

racket-tailed.definition: Having long and spatulate, or racket-shaped, tail feathers.

deloul.definition: A special breed of the dromedary used for rapid traveling; the swift camel; -- called also herire, and maharik.

resonant.definition: Returning, or capable of returning, sound; fitted to resound; resounding; echoing back. Through every hour of the golden morning, the streets were resonant with female parties of young and old. De Quincey.

foreignism.definition: Anything peculiar to a foreign language or people; a foreign idiom or custom. It is a pity to see the technicalities of the so-called liberal professions distigured by foreignisms. Fitzed. Hall.

cuish.definition: Defensive armor for the thighs. [ Written also cuisse, and quish.].

refiner.definition: One who, or that which, refines.

bicycling.definition: The use of a bicycle; the act or practice of riding a bicycle.

anonymously.definition: In an anonymous manner; without a name. Swift.

mirage.definition: An optical effect, sometimes seen on the ocean, but more frequently in deserts, due to total reflection of light at the surface common to two strata of air differently heated. The reflected image is seen, commonly in an inverted position, while the real object may or may not be in sight. When the su.

abaxial.definition: Away from the axis or central line; eccentric. Balfour.

cyamellone.definition: A complex derivative of cyanogen, regarded as an acid, and known chiefly in its salts; -- called also hydromellonic acid.

redressless.definition: Not having redress; such as can not be redressed; irremediable. Sherwood.

aery.definition:
An aerie.

Aërial; ethereal; incorporeal; visionary. [Poetic] M. Arnold.

clarty.definition: Sticky and foul; muddy; filthy; dirty. Halliwell.

pycnodontini.definition: An extinct order of ganoid fishes. They had a compressed body, covered with dermal ribs (pleurolepida) and with enameled rhomboidal scales.

phylactocarp.definition: A branch of a plumularian hydroid specially modified in structure for the protection of the gonothecæ.

tripping.definition:
Quick; nimble; stepping lightly and quickly. 2. (Her.)  Having the right forefoot lifted, the others remaining on the ground, as if he were trotting; trippant; -- said of an animal, as a hart, buck, and the like, used as a bearing.

1. Act of one who, or that which, trips. 2. A light dance. Other tr.

instrumentally.definition: By means of an instrument or agency; as means to an end. South. They will argue that the end being essentially beneficial, the means become instrumentally so. Burke. 2. With instruments of music; as, a song instrumentally accompanied. Mason.

deliciate.definition: To delight one's self; to indulge in feasting; to revel.

kohnur.definition: A famous diamond, surrendered to the British crown on the annexation of the Punjab. According to Hindoo legends, it was found in a Golconda mine, and has been the property of various Hindoo and Persian rulers.

lend.definition: To allow the custody and use of, on condition of the return of the same; to grant the temporary use of; as, to lend a book; -- opposed to borrow. Give me that ring. I'll lend it thee, my dear, but have no power To give it from me. Shak. 2. To allow the possession and use of, on condition of the retu.

reflexive.definition: Etym: [Cf. F. réflexif.]  Bending or turned backward; reflective; having respect to something past. Assurance reflexive can not be a divine faith. Hammond. 2. Implying censure. "What man does not resent an ugly reflexive word" South. 3. (Gram.)  Having for its direct object a pronoun which refers to.

metallization.definition: The act or process of metallizing.

promulgation.definition: The act of promulgating; publication; open declaration; as, the promulgation of the gospel. South.

michaelmas.definition: The feat of the archangel Michael, a church festival, celebrated on the 29th of September. Hence, colloquially, autumn. Michaelmas daisy. (Bot.) See under Daisy.

ixtil.definition: The fine, soft fiber of the bromeliaceous plant Bromelia sylvestris.

ensober.definition: To make sober. Sad accidents to ensober his spirits. Jer. Taylor.

wanness.definition: The quality or state of being wan; a sallow, dead, pale color; paleness; pallor; as, the wanness of the cheeks after a fever.

elucidative.definition: Making clear; tending to elucidate; as, an elucidative note.

ooerial.definition: A wild, bearded sheep inhabiting the Ladakh mountains. It is reddish brown, with a dark beard from the chin to the chest.

choree.definition:
See Choreus.

(a) a trochee. (b) A tribrach.

rarefaction.definition: The act or process of rarefying; the state of being rarefied; - - opposed to condensation; as, the rarefaction of air.

unlooked-for.definition: Not looked for; unexpected; as, an unlooked-for event.

cauponize.definition: To sell wine or victuals. Warburfon.

polka.definition: A dance of Polish origin, but now common everywhere. It is performed by two persons in common time. 2. (Mus.)  A lively Bohemian or Polish dance tune in 2-4 measure, with the third quaver accented. Polka jacket, a kind of knit jacket worn by women.

undecylic.definition: Related to, derived from, or containing, undecyl; specifically, designating that member of the fatty acids which corresponds to undecane, and is obtained as a white crystalline substance, C11H22O2.

fusel.definition: A hot, acrid, oily liquid, accompanying many alcoholic liquors (as potato whisky, corn whisky, etc.), as an undesirable ingredient, and consisting of several of the higher alcohols and compound ethers, but particularly of amyl alcohol; hence, specifically applied to amyl alcohol.

nombles.definition: The entrails of a deer; the umbles. [Written also numbles.] Johnson.

albinism.definition: The state or condition of being an albino: abinoism; leucopathy.

palliative.definition:
Serving to palliate; serving to extenuate or mitigate.

That which palliates; a palliative agent. Sir W. Scott.

waistband.definition: The band which encompasses the waist; esp., one on the upper part of breeches, trousers, pantaloons, skirts, or the like. 2. A sash worn by women around the waist.
