peristome.definition: (Bot.)  The fringe of teeth around the orifice of the capsule of mosses. It consists of 4, 8, 16, 32, or 64 teeth, and may be either single or double. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) The lip, or edge of the aperture, of a spiral shell. (b) The membrane surrounding the mouth of an invertebrate animal.

orthophony.definition: The art of correct articulation; voice training.

hydrocyanide.definition: A compound of hydrocyanic acid with a base; -- distinguished from a cyanide, in which only the cyanogen so combines.

thespian.definition: Of or pertaining to Thespis; hence, relating to the drama; dramatic; as, the Thespian art. -- n.  An actor.

hydrostatically.definition: According to hydrostatics, or to hydrostatic principles. Bentley.

amazonian.definition: Pertaining to or resembling an Amazon; of masculine manners; warlike. Shak. 2. Of or pertaining to the river Amazon in South America, or to its valley.

preachership.definition: The office of a preacher. "The preachership of the Rolls." Macaulay.

hamated.definition: Hooked, or set with hooks; hamate. Swift.

phototaxy.definition: The influence of light on the movements of low organisms, as various infusorians, the zoöspores of certain algæ, etc.; also, the tendency to follow definite directions of motion or assume definite positions under such influence. If the migration is toward the source of light, it is termed positive p.

puffiness.definition: The quality or state of being puffy.

echinoidea.definition: The class Echinodermata which includes the sea urchins. They have a calcareous, usually more or less spheroidal or disk-shaped, composed of many united plates, and covered with movable spines. See Spatangoid, Clypeastroid. [Written also Echinidea, and Echinoida.].

torso.definition: The human body, as distinguished from the head and limbs; in sculpture, the trunk of a statue, mutilated of head and limbs; as, the torso of Hercules.

disciplinable.definition: Capable of being disciplined or improved by instruction and training. 2. Liable or deserving to be disciplined; subject to disciplinary punishment; as, a disciplinable offense.

ismaelian.definition: One of a sect of Mohammedans who favored the pretensions of the family of Mohammed ben Ismael, of the house Ali.

pistillaceous.definition: Growing on, or having nature of, the pistil; of or pertaining to a pistil. Barton.

caddie.definition: A Scotch errand boy, porter, or messenger. [Written also cady.] Every Scotchman, from the peer to the cadie. Macaulay.

celibate.definition:
Celibate state; celibacy. He . . . preferreth holy celibate before the estate of marrige. Jer. Taylor. 2. One who is unmarried, esp. a bachelor, or one bound by vows not to marry.

Unmarried; single; as, a celibate state.

thallene.definition: A hydrocarbon obtained from coal-tar residues, and remarkable for its intense yellowish green fluorescence.

orlop.definition: The lowest deck of a vessel, esp. of a ship of war, consisting of a platform laid over the beams in the hold, on which the cables are coiled.

expiatorious.definition: Of an expiatory nature; expiatory. Jer. Taylor.

gusset.definition: A small piece of cloth inserted in a garment, for the purpose of strengthening some part or giving it a tapering enlargement. Seam and gusset and band. Hood. 2. Anything resembling a gusset in a garment; as: (a) (Armor) A small piece of chain mail at the openings of the joints beneath the arms. (b).

hedonics.definition: That branch of moral philosophy which treats of the relation of duty to pleasure; the science of practical, positive enjoyment or pleasure. J. Grote.

pygmy.definition: Of or pertaining to a pygmy; resembling a pygmy or dwarf; dwarfish; very small. " Like that Pygmean race." Milton. Pygmy antelope (Zoöl.), the kleeneboc. -- Pygmy goose (Zoöl.), any species of very small geese of the genus Nettapus, native of Africa, India, and Australia. -- Pygmy owl (Zoöl.), the g.

vaishnava.definition: A worshiper of the god Vishnu in any of his incarnations.

lapling.definition: One who has been fondled to excess; one fond of ease and sensual delights; -- a term of contempt.

hirundine.definition: Like or pertaining to the swallows.

dynamism.definition: The doctrine of Leibnitz, that all substance involves force.

tranquilizing.definition: Making tranquil; calming. " The tranquilizing power of time." Wordsworth. -- Tran"quil*i`zing*ly or Tran"quil*li`zing*ly, adv.

concerted.definition: Mutually contrived or planned; agreed on; as, concerted schemes, signals. Concerted piece (Mus.), a composition in parts for several voices or instrument, as a trio, a quartet, etc.

bescratch.definition: To tear with the nails; to cover with scratches.

uppish.definition: Proud; arrogant; assuming; putting on airs of superiority. T. Brown. -- Up"pish*ly, adv. -- Up"pish*ness, n.

inveterate.definition: Old; long-established. It is an inveterate and received opinion. Bacon. 2. Firmly established by long continuance; obstinate; deep-rooted; of long standing; as, an inveterate disease; an inveterate abuse. Heal the inveterate canker of one wound. Shak. 3. Having habits fixed by long continuance; conf.

contraries.definition: Propositions which directly and destructively contradict each other, but of which the falsehood of one does not establish the truth of the other. If two universals differ in quality, they are contraries; as, every vine is a tree; no vine is a tree. These can never be both true together; but they may.

noctilionid.definition: A South American bat of the genus Noctilio, having cheek pouches and large incisor teeth.

ay.definition:
Ah! alas! "Ay me! I fondly dream `Had ye been there.'" Milton.

Same as Aye.

Yes; yea; -- a word expressing assent, or an affirmative answer to a question. It is much used in viva voce voting in legislative bodies, etc. Note: This word is written I in the early editions of Shakespeare and other old.

uncharnel.definition: To remove from a charnel house; to raise from the grave; to exhume. Byron.

uranite.definition: A general term for the uranium phosphates, autunite, or lime uranite, and torbernite, or copper uranite.

igneous.definition: Pertaining to, having the nature of, fire; containing fire; resembling fire; as, an igneous appearance. 2. (Geol.)  Resulting from, or produced by, the action of fire; as, lavas and basalt are igneous rocks.

circumscriptible.definition: Capable of being circumscribed or limited by bounds.

shill.definition:
To shell. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.]

To put under cover; to sheal. [Prov.ng.] Brockett.

tarsectomy.definition: The operation of excising one or more of the bones of the tarsus.

dyad.definition:
Two units treated as one; a couple; a pair. 2. (Chem.)  An element, atom, or radical having a valence or combining power of two.

Having a valence or combining power of two; capable of being substituted for, combined with, or replaced by, two atoms of hydrogen; as, oxygen and calcium are dyad elemen.

practico.definition: A guide. [Cuba & Phil. Islands]  D. C. Worcester.

sailfish.definition: (a) The banner fish, or spikefish (Histiophorus.) (b) The basking, or liver, shark. (c) The quillback.

fugle.definition: To maneuver; to move hither and thither. Wooden arms with elbow joints jerking and fugling in the air. Carlyle.

constitutionally.definition: In accordance with the constitution or natural disposition of the mind or body; naturally; as, he was constitutionally timid. The English were constitutionally humane. Hallam. 2. In accordance with the constitution or fundamental law; legally; as, he was not constitutionally appointed. Nothing would.

royalism.definition: the principles or conduct of royalists.

scansorial.definition: (a) Capable of climbing; as, the woodpecker is a scansorial bird; adapted for climbing; as, the scansorial foot. (b) Of or pertaining to the Scansores. See Illust. under Aves. Scansorial tail (Zoöl.), a tail in which the feathers are stiff and sharp at the tip, as in the woodpeckers.

acrophony.definition:
The use of a picture symbol of an object to represent phonetically the initial sound of the name of the object.

The use of a picture symbol of an object to represent phonetically the initial sound of the name of the object.

vintry.definition: A place where wine is sold. Ainsworth.

siphonate.definition: Having a siphon or siphons. 2. (Zoöl.)  Belonging to the Siphonata.

dough.definition: Paste of bread; a soft mass of moistened flour or meal, kneaded or unkneaded, but not yet baked; as, to knead dough. 2. Anything of the consistency of such paste. To have one's cake dough. See under Cake.

malleation.definition: The act or process of beating into a plate, sheet, or leaf, as a metal; extension by beating.

hospitium.definition: An inn; a lodging; a hospice. 2. (Law)  An inn of court.

misgive.definition: To give or grant amiss. Laud. 2. Specifically: To give doubt and apprehension to, instead of confidence and courage; to impart fear to; to make irresolute; -- usually said of the mind or heart, and followed by the objective personal pronoun. So doth my heart misgive me in these conflicts What may be.

wickered.definition: Made of, secured by, or covered with, wickers or wickerwork. Ships of light timber, wickered with osier between, and covered over with leather. Milton.

blazonry.definition: Same as Blazon, 3. The principles of blazonry. Peacham. 2. A coat of arms; an armorial bearing or bearings. The blazonry of Argyle. Lord Dufferin. 3. Artistic representation or display.

microscope.definition: An optical instrument, consisting of a lens, or combination of lenses, for making an enlarged image of an object which is too minute to be viewed by the naked eye. Compound microscope, an instrument consisting of a combination of lenses such that the image formed by the lens or set of lenses nearest.

labyrinthodonta.definition: An extinct order of Amphibia, including the typical genus Labyrinthodon, and many other allied forms, from the Carboniferous, Permian, and Triassic formations. By recent writers they are divided into two or more orders. See Stegocephala.

ramshackle.definition:
Loose; disjointed; falling to pieces; out of repair. There came . . . my lord the cardinal, in his ramshackle coach. Thackeray.

To search or ransack; to rummage.

correi.definition: A hollow in the side of a hill, where game usually lies. "Fleet foot on the correi." Sir W. Scott.

rivage.definition: A bank, shore, or coast. [Archaic] Spenser. From the green rivage many a fall Of diamond rillets musical. Tennyson. 2. (O.Eng.Law)  A duty paid to the crown for the passage of vessels on certain rivers.

bombardon.definition: Originally, a deep-toned instrument of the oboe or bassoon family; thence, a bass reed stop on the organ. The name bombardon is now given to a brass instrument, the lowest of the saxhorns, in tone resembling the ophicleide. Grove.

expel.definition: To drive or force out from that within which anything is contained, inclosed, or situated; to eject; as to expel air from a bellows. Did not ye . . . expel me out of my father's house Judg. Xi. 7. 2. To drive away from one's country; to banish. Forewasted all their land, and them expelled. Spenser.

reformation.definition: The act of reforming, or the state of being reformed; change from worse to better; correction or amendment of life, manners, or of anything vicious or corrupt; as, the reformation of manners; reformation of the age; reformation of abuses. Satire lashes vice into reformation. Dryden. 2. Specifically.

shintiyan.definition: A kind of wide loose drawers or trousers worn by women in Mohammedan countries.

bawson.definition: A badger. B. Jonson. 2. A large, unwieldy person. Nares.

self-registering.definition: Registering itself; -- said of any instrument so contrived as to record its own indications of phenomena, whether continuously or at stated times, as at the maxima and minima of variations; as, a self-registering anemometer or barometer.

toyish.definition: Sportive; trifling; wanton. 2. Resembling a toy. --Toy"ish*ly, dv.-Toy"ish*ness, n.

opsiometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the limits of distincts vision in different individuals, and thus determiming the proper focal length of a lens for correcting imperfect sight. Brande & C.

tricky.definition: Given to tricks; practicing deception; trickish; knavish.

yaw.definition:
To rise in blisters, breaking in white froth, as cane juice in the clarifiers in sugar works.

To steer wild, or out of the line of her course; to deviate from her course, as when struck by a heavy sea; -- said of a ship. Just as he would lay the ship's course, all yawing being out of the question.

gyve.definition:
A shackle; especially, one to confine the legs; a fetter. [Written also give.] Like a poor prisoner in his twisted gyves. Shak. With gyves upon his wrist. Hood.

To fetter; to shackle; to chain. Spenser. I will gyve thee in thine own courtship. Shak.

sine.definition: (a) The length of a perpendicular drawn from one extremity of an arc of a circle to the diameter drawn through the other extremity. (b) The perpendicular itself. See Sine of angle, below. Artificial sines, logarithms of the natural sines, or logarithmic sines. -- Curve of sines. See Sinusoid. -- Nat.

finific.definition: A limiting element or quality. The essential finific in the form of the finite. Coleridge.

cronstedtite.definition: A mineral consisting principally of silicate of iron, and crystallizing in hexagonal prisms with perfect basal cleavage; -- so named from the Swedish mineralogist Cronstedt.

defectible.definition: Liable to defect; imperfect. "A defectible understanding." Jer. Taylor.

uninucleated.definition: Possessed of but a single nucleus; as, a uninucleated cell.

acrid.definition: Sharp and harsh, or bitter and not, to the taste; pungent; as, acrid salts. 2. Causing heat and irritation; corrosive; as, acrid secretions. 3. Caustic; bitter; bitterly irritating; as, acrid temper, mind, writing. Acrid poison, a poison which irritates, corrodes, or burns the parts to which it is a.

lazarly.definition: Full of sores; leprous. Shak. Bp. Hall.

antitrochanter.definition: An articular surface on the ilium of birds against which the great trochanter of the femur plays.

pannikel.definition: The brainpan, or skull; hence, the crest. Spenser.

photochronograph.definition: (Physics) An instrument for recording minute intervals of time. The record is made by the power of a magnetic field, due to an electric signaling current, to turn the plane of polarization of light. A flash, coinciding in time and duration with the signal, is thus produced and is photographed on a m.

sapper.definition: One who saps; specifically (Mil.), one who is employed in working at saps, building and repairing fortifications, and the like.

centauromachy.definition: A fight in which centaurs take part, -- a common theme for relief sculpture, as in the Parthenon metopes.

gynandromorphism.definition: An abnormal condition of certain animals, in which one side has the external characters of the male, and the other those of the female.

connascence.definition: The common birth of two or more at the same tome; production of two or more together. Johnson. 2. That which is born or produced with another. 3. The act of growing together. Wiseman.

fourpence.definition: A British silver coin, worth four pence; a groat. 2. A name formerly given in New England to the Spanish half real, a silver coin worth six and a quarter cents.

inculpable.definition: Faultless; blameless; innocent. South. An innocent and incupable piece of ignorance. Killingbeck.

deforest.definition: To clear of forests; to dis U. S. Agric. Reports.

focalize.definition: To bring to a focus; to focus; to concentrate. Light is focalized in the eye, sound in the ear. De Quincey.

coaltit.definition: A small European titmouse (Parus ater), so named from its black color; -- called also coalmouse and colemouse.

numismatical.definition: Of or pertaining to coins; relating to the science of coins or medals.

recession.definition:
The act of receding or withdrawing, as from a place, a claim, or a demand. South. Mercy may rejoice upon the recessions of justice. Jer. Taylor.

The act of ceding back; restoration; repeated cession; as, the recession of conquered territory to its former sovereign.

ileocaecal.definition: Pertaining to the ileum and cæcum.

declarable.definition: Capable of being declared. Sir T. Browne.

bonchretien.definition: A name given to several kinds of pears. See Bartlett.

ghostology.definition: Ghost lore. It seemed even more unaccountable than if it had been a thing of ghostology and witchcraft. Hawthorne.

starosty.definition: A castle and domain conferred on a nobleman for life. [Poland] Brande & C.

syringotome.definition: A small blunt-pointed bistoury, -- used in syringotomy.

dioptra.definition: An optical instrument, invented by Hipparchus, for taking altitudes, leveling, etc.

protocatechuic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or designating, an organic acid which is obtained as a white crystalline substance from catechin, asafetida, oil of cloves, etc., and by distillation itself yields pyrocatechin.

scepticism.definition: etc. See Skeptic, Skeptical, Skepticism, etc.

truffle.definition: Any one of several kinds of roundish, subterranean fungi, usually of a blackish color. The French truffle (Tuber melanosporum) and the English truffle (T. æstivum) are much esteemed as articles of food. Truffle worm (Zoöl.), the larva of a fly of the genus Leiodes, injurious to truffles. Truffle pig.

vocally.definition: In a vocal manner; with voice; orally; with audible sound. 2. In words; verbally; as, to express desires vocally.

gasify.definition:
To convert into gas, or an aëriform fluid, as by the application of heat, or by chemical processes.

To become gas; to pass from a liquid to a gaseous state. Scientific American.

lighthouse.definition: A tower or other building with a powerful light at top, erected at the entrance of a port, or at some important point on a coast, to serve as a guide to mariners at night; a pharos.

averroist.definition: One of a sect of peripatetic philosophers, who appeared in Italy before the restoration of learning; so denominated from Averroes, or Averrhoes, a celebrated Arabian philosopher. He held the doctrine of monopsychism.

panacean.definition: Having the properties of a panacea. "Panacean dews." Whitehead.

hailshot.definition: Small shot which scatter like hailstones. Hayward.

infester.definition: One who, or that which, infests.

red-riband.definition: The European red band fish, or fireflame. See Rend fish.

valentinian.definition: One of a school of Judaizing Gnostics in the second century; -- so called from Valentinus, the founder.

footstep.definition: The mark or impression of the foot; a track; hence, visible sign of a course pursued; token; mark; as, the footsteps of divine wisdom. How on the faltering footsteps of decay Youth presses. Bryant. 2. An inclined plane under a hand printing press.

disfiguration.definition: The act of disfiguring, or the state of being disfigured; defacement; deformity; disfigurement. Gauden.

secrecy.definition: The state or quality of being hidden; as, his movements were detected in spite of their secrecy. The Lady Anne, Whom the king hath in secrecy long married. Shak. 2. That which is concealed; a secret. Shak. 3. Seclusion; privacy; retirement. "The pensive secrecy of desert cell." Milton. 4. The qualit.

decidence.definition: A falling off. Sir T. Browne.

cicala.definition: A cicada. See Cicada. "At eve a dry cicala sung." Tennison.

unmeet.definition: Not meet or fit; not proper; unbecoming; unsuitable; -- usually followed by for. "Unmeet for a wife." Tennyson. And all unmeet our carpet floors. Emerson. -- Un*meet"ly, adv. -- Un*meet"ness, n.

infidelity.definition: Want of faith or belief in some religious system; especially, a want of faith in, or disbelief of, the inspiration of the Scriptures, of the divine origin of Christianity. There is, indeed, no doubt but that vanity is one of the principal causes of infidelity. V. Knox. 2. Unfaithfulness to the marri.

impartial.definition: Not partial; not favoring one more than another; treating all alike; unprejudiced; unbiased; disinterested; equitable; fair; just. Shak. Jove is impartial, and to both the same. Dryden. A comprehensive and impartial view. Macaulay.

insubstantial.definition: Unsubstantial; not real or strong. "Insubstantial pageant." Shak.

compunctious.definition: Of the nature of compunction; caused by conscience; attended with, or causing, compunction. That no compunctious vistings of nature Shake my fell purpose. Shak.

interpleader.definition: One who interpleads. 2. (Law)  A proceeding devised to enable a person, of whom the same debt, duty, or thing is claimed adversely by two or more parties, to compel them to litigate the right or title between themselves, and thereby to relieve himself from the suits which they might otherwise bring.

muraena.definition: A genus of large eels of the family Mirænidæ. They differ from the common eel in lacking pectoral fins and in having the dorsal and anal fins continuous. The murry (Muræna Helenæ) of Southern Europe was the muræna of the Romans. It is highly valued as a food fish.

cochleate.definition: Having the form of a snail shell; spiral; turbinated.

homelike.definition: Like a home; comfortable; cheerful; cozy; friendly.

moroxite.definition: A variety of apatite of a greenish blue color.

stilton.definition: A peculiarly flavored unpressed cheese made from milk with cream added; -- so called from the village or parish of Stilton, England, where it was originally made. It is very rich in fat. Thus, in the outset he was gastronomic; discussed the dinner from the soup to the stilton. C. Lever.

slitter.definition: One who, or that which, slits.

cespitine.definition: An oil obtained by distillation of peat, and containing various members of the pyridine series.

monal.definition: Any Asiatic pheasant of the genus Lophophorus, as the Impeyan pheasant.

tubulidentate.definition: Having teeth traversed by canals; -- said of certain edentates.

whitsun.definition: Of, pertaining to, or observed at, Whitsuntide; as, Whitsun week; Whitsun Tuesday; Whitsun pastorals.

vitalist.definition: A believer in the theory of vitalism; -- opposed to physicist.

muraenoid.definition: Like or pertaining to the genus Muræna, or family Murænidæ.

discourse.definition: The power of the mind to reason or infer by running, as it were, from one fact or reason to another, and deriving a conclusion; an exercise or act of this power; reasoning; range of reasoning faculty. Difficult, strange, and harsh to the discourses of natural reason. South. Sure he that made us with.

suprapubian.definition: Situated above, or anterior to, the pubic bone.

vivency.definition: Manner of supporting or continuing life or vegetation. Sir T. Browne.

fanciless.definition: Having no fancy; without ideas or imagination. A pert or bluff important wight, Whose brain is fanciless, whose blood is white. Armstrong.

tawdriness.definition: Quality or state of being tawdry. A clumsy person makes his ungracefulness more ungraceful by tawdriness of dress. Richardson.

cockaleekie.definition: A favorite soup in Scotland, made from a capon highly seasoned, and boiled with leeks and prunes.

scraffle.definition: To scramble or struggle; to wrangle; also, to be industrious. Halliwell.

nightingale.definition: (Zoöl.)  A small, plain, brown and gray European song bird (Luscinia luscinia). It sings at night, and is celebrated for the sweetness of its song. 2. (Zoöl.)  A larger species (Lucinia philomela), of Eastern Europe, having similar habits; the thrush nightingale. The name is also applied to other al.

greaten.definition:
To make great; to aggrandize; to cause to increase in size; to expand. A minister's [business] is to greaten and exalt [his king]. Ken.

To become large; to dilate. My blue eyes greatening in the looking-glass. Mrs. Browning.

desecate.definition: To cut, as with a scythe; to mow.

scrubby.definition: Of the nature of scrub; small and mean; stunted in growth; as, a scrubby cur. "Dense, scrubby woods." Duke of Argull.

brahmo-somaj.definition: A modern reforming theistic sect among the Hindos. [Written also Brahma-samaj.].

enclavement.definition: The state of being an enclave. [Recent].

rescussee.definition: The party in whose favor a rescue is made. Crabb.

jument.definition: A beast; especially, a beast of burden. Fitter for juments than men to feed on. Burton.

revestture.definition: Vesture. Richrevesture of cloth of gold. E. Hall.

indifferent.definition: Not mal Dangers are to me indifferent. Shak. Everything in the world is indifferent but sin. Jer. Taylor. His slightest and most indifferent acts . . . were odious in the clergyman's sight. Hawthorne. 2. Neither particularly good, not very bad; of a middle state or quality; passable; mediocre. The s.

campanularian.definition: A hydroid of the family ampanularidæ, characterized by having the polyps or zooids inclosed in bell-shaped calicles or hydrothecæ.

enounce.definition: To announce; to declare; to state, as a proposition or argument. Sir W. Hamilton. 2. To utter; to articulate. The student should be able to enounce these [sounds] independently. A. M. Bell.

splutter.definition:
To speak hastily and confusedly; to sputter. Carleton.

A confused noise, as of hasty speaking.

losingly.definition: In a manner to incur loss.

bookbinder.definition: One whose occupation is to bind books.

functionate.definition: To execute or perform a function; to transact one's regular or appointed business.

leathery.definition: Resembling leather in appearance or consistence; tough. "A leathery skin." Grew.

protozooen.definition: (a) One of the Protozoa. (b) A single zooid of a compound protozoan.

testudinarious.definition: Of or pertaining to the shell of a tortoise; resembling a tortoise shell; having the color or markings of a tortoise shell.

subcontract.definition: A contract under, or subordinate to, a previous contract.

rondeau.definition: A species of lyric poetry so composed as to contain a refrain or repetition which recurs according to a fixed law, and a limited number of rhymes recurring also by rule. Note: When the rondeau was called the rondel it was mostly written in fourteen octosyllabic lines of two rhymes, as in the rondels.

doctorate.definition:
The degree, title, or rank, of a doctor.

To make (one) a doctor. He was bred . . . in Oxford and there doctorated. Fuller.

toothache.definition: Pain in a tooth or in the teeth; odontalgia. Toothache grass (Bot.), a kind of grass (Ctenium Americanum) having a very pungent taste. -- Toothache tree. (Bot.) (a) The prickly ash. (b) A shrub of the genus Aralia (A. spinosa).

coxcombical.definition: Befitting or indicating a coxcomb; like a coxcomb; foppish; conceited. -- Cox*comb"ic*al*ly, adv. Studded all over in coxcombical fashion with little brass nails. W. Irving.

oread.definition: One of the nymphs of mountains and grottoes. Like a wood nymph light, Oread or Dryad. Milton.

udderless.definition: Destitute or deprived of an udder. 2. Hence, without mother's milk; motherless; as, udderless lambs. [Poetic] Keats.

podotheca.definition: The scaly covering of the foot of a bird or reptile.

truss.definition: A bundle; a package; as, a truss of grass. Fabyan. Bearing a truss of trifles at his back. Spenser. Note: A truss of hay in England is 56 lbs. of old and 60 lbs. of new hay; a truss of straw is 36 lbs. 2. A padded jacket or dress worn under armor, to protect the body from the effects of friction; al.

unshackle.definition: To loose from shackles or bonds; to set free from restraint; to unfetter. Addison.

bolivian.definition: Of or pertaining to Bolivia. -- n.  A native of Bolivia.

unite.definition: To put together so as to make one; to join, as two or more constituents, to form a whole; to combine; to connect; to join; to cause to adhere; as, to unite bricks by mortar; to unite iron bars by welding; to unite two armies. 2. Hence, to join by a legal or moral bond, as families by marriage, natio.

obtrusionist.definition: One who practices or excuses obtrusion. Gent. Mag.

plausible.definition: Worthy of being applauded; praiseworthy; commendable; ready. Bp. Hacket. 2. Obtaining approbation; specifically pleasing; apparently right; specious; as, a plausible pretext; plausible manners; a plausible delusion. "Plausible and popular arguments." Clarendon. 3. Using specious arguments or discour.

illiterature.definition: Want of learning; illiteracy. Ayliffe. Southey.

flare.definition: To burn with an unsteady or waving flame; as, the candle flares. 2. To shine out with a sudden and unsteady light; to emit a dazzling or painfully bright light. 3. To shine out with gaudy colors; to flaunt; to be offensively bright or showy. With ribbons pendant, flaring about her head. Shak. 4. To.

quater-cousin.definition: A cousin within the first four degrees of kindred.

myrialiter.definition: A metric measure of capacity, containing ten thousand liters. It is equal to 2641.7 wine gallons.

vouchsafement.definition: The act of vouchsafing, or that which is vouchsafed; a gift or grant in condescension. Glanvill.

palpus.definition: A feeler; especially, one of the jointed sense organs attached to the mouth organs of insects, arachnids, crustaceans, and annelids; as, the mandibular palpi, maxillary palpi, and labial palpi. The palpi of male spiders serve as sexual organs. Called also palp. See Illust. of Arthrogastra and Orthop.

syriac.definition: Of or pertaining to Syria, or its language; as, the Syriac version of the Pentateuch. -- n.  The language of Syria; especially, the ancient language of that country.

addle-headed.definition: Dull-witted; stupid. "The addle-brained Oberstein." Motley. Dull and addle-pated. Dryden.

gnathostoma.definition: A comprehensive division of vertebrates, including all that have distinct jaws, in contrast with the leptocardians and marsipobranchs (Cyclostoma), which lack them. [Written also Gnathostomata.].

mutiny.definition: Insurrection against constituted authority, particularly military or naval authority; concerted revolt against the rules of discipline or the lawful commands of a superior officer; hence, generally, forcible resistance to rightful authority; insubordination. In every mutiny against the discipline of.

trimorphic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or characterized by, trimorphism; -- contrasted with monomorphic, dimorphic, and polymorphic.

sideral.definition: Relating to the stars. 2. (Astrol.)  Affecting unfavorably by the supposed influence of the stars; baleful. "Sideral blast." Milton.

helical.definition: Of or pertaining to, or in the form of, a helix; spiral; as, a helical staircase; a helical spring. -- Hel"i*cal*ly, adv.

maori.definition: One of the aboriginal inhabitants of New Zealand; also, the original language of New Zealand. -- a.  Of or pertaining to the Maoris or to their language.

caudex.definition: The sterm of a tree., esp. a sterm without a branch, as of a palm or a tree fern; also, the pernnial rootstock of an herbaceous plant.

jew.definition: Originally, one belonging to the tribe or kingdom of Judah; after the return from the Babylonish captivity, any member of the new state; a Hebrew; an Israelite. Jew's frankincense, gum styrax, or benzoin. -- Jew's mallow (Bot.), an annual herb (Corchorus olitorius) cultivated in Syria and Egypt as a.

bipalmate.definition: Palmately branched, with the branches again palmated.

paramours.definition: By or with love, esp. the love of the sexes; -- sometimes written as two words. For par amour, I loved her first ere thou. Chaucer.

drumhead.definition: The parchment or skin stretched over one end of a drum. 2. The top of a capstan which is pierced with sockets for levers used in turning it. See Illust. of Capstan. Drumhead court-martial (Mil.), a summary court-martial called to try offenses on the battlefield or the line of march, when, sometimes,.

weather-board.definition: To nail boards upon so as to lap one over another, in order to exclude rain, snow, etc. Gwilt.

wispen.definition: Formed of a wisp, or of wisp; as, a wispen broom.

meagerness.definition: The state or quality of being meager; leanness; scantiness; barrenness.

compositae.definition: A large family of dicotyledonous plants, having their flowers arranged in dense heads of many small florets and their anthers united in a tube. The daisy, dandelion, and asters, are examples.

trillium.definition: A genus of liliaceous plants; the three-leaved nightshade; -- so called because all the parts of the plant are in threes.

acetimetry.definition: The act or method of ascertaining the strength of vinegar, or the proportion of acetic acid contained in it. Ure.

matronly.definition: Advanced in years; elderly. 2. Like, or befitting, a matron; grave; sedate.

pentateuch.definition: The first five books of the Old Testament, collectively; -- called also the Law of Moses, Book of the Law of Moses, etc.

xylotomy.definition: Art of preparing sections (transverse, tangential, or radial) of wood, esp. by means of a microtome, for microscopic examination.

melanagogue.definition: A medicine supposed to expel black bile or choler.

diminuendo.definition: In a gradually diminishing manner; with abatement of tone; decrescendo; -- expressed on the staff by Dim., or Dimin., or the sign.

ingesta.definition: That which is introduced into the body by the stomach or alimentary canal; -- opposed to egesta.

squirter.definition: One who, or that which, squirts.

thanatopsis.definition: A view of death; a meditation on the subject of death. Bryant.

gradely.definition: Decent; orderly. Halliwell. -- adv.  Decently; in order.

whencesoever.definition: From what place soever; from what cause or source soever. Any idea, whencesoever we have it. Locke. WHENE'ER When*e'er, adv. & conj.  Whenever.

furbelow.definition:
A plaited or gathered flounce on a woman's garment.

To put a furbelow on; to ornament.

eleventh.definition:
Next after the tenth; as, the eleventh chapter. 2. Constituting one of eleven parts into which a thing is divided; as, the eleventh part of a thing. 3. (Mus.)  Of or pertaining to the interval of the octave and the fourth.

1. The quotient of a unit divided by eleven; one of eleven equal parts. 2. (.

mesomycetes.definition: One of the three classes into which the fungi are divided in Brefeld's classification. -- Mes`o*my*ce"tous (#), a.

euphorbia.definition: Spurge, or bastard spurge, a genus of plants of many species, mostly shrubby, herbaceous succulents, affording an acrid, milky juice. Some of them are armed with thorns. Most of them yield powerful emetic and cathartic products.

ceorl.definition: A freeman of the lowest class; one not a thane or of the servile classes; a churl.

abbotship.definition: The state or office of an abbot.

eumenides.definition: A euphemistic name for the Furies of Erinyes.

rove.definition:
To draw through an eye or aperture. 2. To draw out into falkes; to card, as wool. Jamieson. 3. To twist slightly; to bring together, as slivers of wool or cotton, and twist slightly before spinning.

1. A copper washer upon which the end of a nail is clinched in boat building. 2. A roll or sliver of.

pseudonavicula.definition: One of the minute spindle-shaped embryos of Gregarinæ and some other Protozoa.

coincident.definition:
Having coincidence; occupying the same place; contemporaneous; concurrent; -- followed by with. Christianity teaches nothing but what is perfectly suitable to, and coincident with, the ruling principles of a virtuous and well- inclined man. South.

One of two or more coincident events; a coincidence.

favorer.definition: One who favors; one who regards with kindness or friendship; a well-wisher; one who assists or promotes success or prosperity. [Written also favourer.] And come to us as favorers, not as foes. Shak.

tentful.definition: As much, or as many, as a tent will hold.

plagal.definition: Having a scale running from the dominant to its octave; -- said of certain old church modes or tunes, as opposed to those called authentic, which ran from the tonic to its octave. Plagal cadence, a cadence in which the final chord on the tonic is preceded by the chord on the subdominant.

ebrious.definition: Inclined to drink to excess; intoxicated; tipsy. M. Collins.

halteres.definition: Balancers; the rudimentary hind wings of Diptera.

duel.definition:
A combat between two persons, fought with deadly weapons, by agreement. It usually arises from an injury done or an affront given by one to the other. Trial by duel (Old Law), a combat between two persons for proving a cause; trial by battel.

To fight in single combat.

windpipe.definition: The passage for the breath from the larynx to the lungs; the trachea; the weasand. See Illust. under Lung.

youngth.definition: Youth. Youngth is a bubble blown up with breath. Spenser.

causeless.definition:
Self-originating; uncreated. 2. Without just or sufficient reason; groundless. My fears are causeless and ungrounded. Denham.

Without cause or reason.

unreproachable.definition: Not liable to be reproached; irreproachable.

bissextile.definition: Leap year; every fourth year, in which a day is added to the month of February on account of the excess of the tropical year (365 d. 5 h. 48 m. 46 s.) above 365 days. But one day added every four years is equivalent to six hours each year, which is 11 m. 14 s. more than the excess of the real year.

palmcrist.definition: The palma Christi. (Jonah iv. 6, margin, and Douay version, note.).

hepatization.definition: (Chem.)  Impregnating with sulphureted hydrogen gas. 2. Etym: [Cf. F. hépatisation.] (Med.)  Conversion into a substance resembling the liver; a state of the lungs when gorged with effused matter, so that they are no longer pervious to the air.

unempirically.definition: Not empirically; without experiment or experience.

acrobatic.definition: Pertaining to an acrobat. -- Ac`ro*bat"ic*al*ly, adv.

elaeolite.definition: A variety of hephelite, usually massive, of greasy luster, and gray to reddish color. Elæolite syenite, a kind of syenite characterized by the presence of elæolite.

sensuality.definition: The quality or state of being sensual; devotedness to the gratification of the bodily appetites; free indulgence in carnal or sensual pleasures; luxuriousness; voluptuousness; lewdness. Those pampered animals That rage in savage sensuality. Shak. They avoid dress, lest they should have affections ta.

oakum.definition: The material obtained by untwisting and picking into loose fiber old hemp ropes; -- used for calking the seams of ships, stopping leaks, etc. 2. The coarse portion separated from flax or hemp in nackling. Knight. White oakum, that made from untarred rope.

hardener.definition: One who, or that which, hardens; specif., one who tempers tools.

nittings.definition: The refuse of good ore. Raymond.

rawhead.definition: A specter mentioned to frighten children; as, rawhead and bloodybones.

dufrenite.definition: A mineral of a blackish green color, commonly massive or in nodules. It is a hydrous phosphate of iron.

androus.definition: A terminal combining form: Having a stamen or stamens; staminate; as, monandrous, with one stamen; polyandrous, with many stamens.

trickery.definition: The art of dressing up; artifice; stratagem; fraud; imposture.

evincible.definition: Capable of being proved or clearly brought to light; demonstrable. Sir. M. Hale. --E*vin"ci*bly, adv.

croisado.definition: A holy war; a crusade. Bacon.

cledge.definition: The upper stratum of fuller's earth.

brawler.definition: One that brawls; wrangler. Common brawler (Law), one who disturbs a neighborhood by brawling (and is therefore indictable at common law as a nuisance). Wharton.

woolsack.definition: A sack or bag of wool; specifically, the seat of the lord chancellor of England in the House of Lords, being a large, square sack of wool resembling a divan in form.

hakim.definition:
A wise man; a physician, esp. a Mohammedan. [India]

A Mohammedan title for a ruler; a judge. [India].

altimetry.definition: The art of measuring altitudes, or heights.

refrangible.definition: Capable of being refracted, or turned out of a direct course, in passing from one medium to another, as rays of light. -- Re*fran"gi*ble*ness, n.

bow-pen.definition: Bow-compasses carrying a drawing pen. See Bow-compass.

waster.definition: One who, or that which, wastes; one who squanders; one who consumes or expends extravagantly; a spendthrift; a prodigal. He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster. Prov. xviii. 9. Sconces are great wasters of candles. Swift. 2. An imperfection in the wick of a can.

lectica.definition: A kind of litter or portable couch.

montgolfier.definition: A balloon which ascends by the buoyancy of air heated by a fire; a fire balloon; -- so called from two brothers, Stephen and Joseph Montgolfier, of France, who first constructed and sent up a fire balloon.

cephalocercal.definition: Relating to the long axis of the body.

bruin.definition: A bear; -- so called in popular tales and fables.

zollverein.definition: Literally, a customs union; specifically, applied to the several customs unions successively formed under the leadership of Prussia among certain German states for establishing liberty of commerce among themselves and common tariff on imports, exports, and transit. Note: In 1834 a zollverein was est.

hemisphere.definition: A half sphere; one half of a sphere or globe, when divided by a plane passing through its center. 2. Half of the terrestrial globe, or a projection of the same in a map or picture. 3. The people who inhabit a hemisphere. He died . . . mourned by a hemisphere. J. P. Peters. ten Cerebral hemispheres.

quiritation.definition: A crying for help. Bp. Hall.

jocular.definition: Given to jesting; jocose; as, a jocular person. 2. Sportive; merry. "Jocular exploits." Cowper. The style is serious and partly jocular. Dryden.

trapezate.definition: Having the form of a trapezium; trapeziform.

personalism.definition: The quality or state of being personal; personality.

elaiodic.definition: Derived from castor oil; ricinoleic; as, elaiodic acid.

subtriangular.definition: Nearly, but not perfectly, triangular. Darwin.

aeroplane.definition: A flying machine, or a small plane for experiments on flying, which floats in the air only when propelled through it.

romanticist.definition: One who advocates romanticism in modern literature. J. R. Seeley.

easy-chair.definition: An armichair for ease or repose. "Laugh . . . in Rabelais' easy-chair." Pope.

pilgrim.definition:
A wayfarer; a wanderer; a traveler; a stranger. Strangers and pilgrims on the earth. Heb. xi. 13. 2. One who travels far, or in strange lands, to visit some holy place or shrine as a devotee; as, a pilgrim to Loretto; Canterbury pilgrims. See Palmer. P. Plowman.

Of or pertaining to a pilgrim, or pi.

ilmenium.definition: A supposed element claimed to have been discovered by R.Harmann.

turn-sick.definition:
Giddy. Bacon.

A disease with which sheep are sometimes affected; gid; sturdy. See Gid.

duumviral.definition: Of or belonging to the duumviri or the duumvirate.

pronged.definition: Having prongs or projections like the tines of a fork; as, a three-pronged fork.

strombite.definition: A fossil shell of the genus Strombus.

omination.definition: The act of ominating; presaging. Fuller.

overgrassed.definition: Overstocked, or overgrown, or covered, with grass. Spenser.

araneous.definition: Cobweblike; extremely thin and delicate, like a cobweb; as, the araneous membrane of the eye. See Arachnoid. Derham.

dizzily.definition: In a dizzy manner or state.

anorthopia.definition: Distorted vision, in which straight lines appear bent.

glowlamp.definition: (Chem.)  An aphlogistic lamp. See Aphlogistic. 2. (Elect.)  An incandescent lamp. See Incandescent, a.

coasting.definition:
Sailing along or near a coast, or running between ports along a coast. Coasting trade, trade carried on by water between neighboring ports of the same country, as distinguished fron foreign trade or trade involving long voyages. -- Coasting vessel, a vessel employed in coasting; a coaster.

1. A sai.

supradecompound.definition: More than decompound; divided many times.

parr.definition: (a) A young salmon in the stage when it has dark transverse bands; -- called also samlet, skegger, and fingerling. (b) A young leveret.

pantaloon.definition: Aridiculous character, or an old dotard, in the Italian comedy; also, a buffoon in pantomimes. Addison. The sixth age shifts Into the lean and slippered pantaloon. Shak. 2. pl.  A bifurcated garment for a man, covering the body from the waist downwards, and consisting of breeches and stockings in on.

hent.definition: To seize; to lay hold on; to catch; to get. Piers Plowman. Spenser. This cursed Jew him hente and held him fast. Chaucer. But all that he might of his friendes hente On bookes and on learning he it spente. Chaucer.

tantra.definition: A ceremonial treatise related to Puranic and magic literature; esp., one of the sacred works of the worshipers of Sakti. -- Tan"tric (-trik), a.

reasonless.definition: Destitute of reason; as, a reasonless man or mind. Shak. 2. Void of reason; not warranted or supported by reason; unreasonable. This proffer is absurd and reasonless. Shak.

comestible.definition:
Suitable to be eaten; eatable; esculent. Some herbs are most comestible. Sir T. Elyot.

Something suitable to be eaten; -- commonly in the plural. Thackeray.

wagon-roofed.definition: Having a roof, or top, shaped like an inverted U; wagon-headed.

introversion.definition: The act of introverting, or the state of being introverted; the act of turning the mind inward. Berkeley.

zebrule.definition: A cross between a male zebra and a female horse.

lunged.definition: Having lungs, or breathing organs similar to lungs.

dalles.definition: A rapid, esp. one where the channel is narrowed between rock walls. [Northwestern U. S. & Canada] The place below, where the compressed river wound like a silver thread among the flat black rocks, was the far-famed Dalles of the Columbia. F. H. Balch.

elan.definition: Ardor inspired by passion or enthusiasm.

cental.definition:
A weight of one hundred pounds avoirdupois; -- called in many parts of the United States a Hundredweight.

Relating to a hundred. Cental system, the method of buying and selling by the cental, or hundredweight.

rinser.definition: One who, or that which, rinses.

overcount.definition: To rate too high; to outnumber. Shak.

excisable.definition: Liable or subject to excise; as, tobacco in an excisable commodity.

emmet.definition: An ant. Emmet hunter (Zoöl.), the wryneck.

predominant.definition: Having the ascendency over others; superior in strength, influence, or authority; prevailing; as, a predominant color; predominant excellence. Those help . . . were predominant in the king's mind. Bacon. Foul subordination is predominant. Shak. Syn. -- Prevalent; superior; prevailing; ascendant; rul.

cogitable.definition: Capable of being brought before the mind as a throught or idea; conceivable; thinkable. Creation is cogitable by us only as a putting forth of divine power. Sir W. Hamilton.

poikilothermic.definition: Having a varying body temperature. See Homoiothermal.

pygal.definition: Situated in the region of the rump, or posterior end of the backbone; -- applied especially to the posterior median plates in the carapace of chelonians.

seether.definition: A pot for boiling things; a boiler. Like burnished gold the little seether shone. Dryden.

stang.definition:
imp. of Sting. [Archaic]

1. A long bar; a pole; a shaft; a stake. 2. In land measure, a pole, rod, or perch. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Swift. Stang ball, a projectile consisting of two half balls united by a bar; a bar shot. See Illust. of Bar shot, under Bar. -- To ride the stang, to be carried on a po.

anabaptistic.definition: Relating or attributed to the Anabaptists, or their doctrines. Milton. Bp. Bull.

thaneship.definition: The state or dignity of a thane; thanehood; also, the seignioralty of a thane.

derailment.definition: The act of going off, or the state of being off, the rails of a railroad.

veteranize.definition: To reënlist for service as a soldier. [U.S.] Gen. W. T. Sherman.

foots.definition: The settlings of oil, molasses, etc., at the bottom of a barrel or hogshead. Simmonds.

luff.definition: (a) The side of a ship toward the wind. (b) The act of sailing a ship close to the wind. (c) The roundest part of a ship's bow. (d) The forward or weather leech of a sail, especially of the jib, spanker, and other fore-and-aft sails. Luff tackle, a purchase composed of a double and single block and.

spatangoidea.definition: An order of irregular sea urchins, usually having a more or less heart-shaped shell with four or five petal-like ambulacra above. The mouth is edentulous and situated anteriorly, on the under side.

inconsonancy.definition: Want of consonance or harmony of sound, action, or thought; disagreement.

domiciliate.definition: To establish in a permanent residence; to domicile. 2. To domesticate. Pownall.

pungent.definition: Causing a sharp sensation, as of the taste, smell, or feelings; pricking; biting; acrid; as, a pungent spice. Pungent radish biting infant's tongue. Shenstone. The pungent grains of titillating dust. Pope. 2. Sharply painful; penetrating; poignant; severe; caustic; stinging. With pungent pains on ev.

stubbedness.definition: The quality or state of being stubbed.

countermark.definition: A mark or token added to those already existing, in order to afford security or proof; as, an additional or special mark put upon a package of goods belonging to several persons, that it may not be opened except in the presence of all; a mark added to that of an artificer of gold or silver work by t.

babingtonite.definition: A mineral occurring in triclinic crystals approaching pyroxene in angle, and of a greenish black color. It is a silicate of iron, manganese, and lime.

friction.definition: The act of rubbing the surface of one body against that of another; attrition; in hygiene, the act of rubbing the body with the hand, with flannel, or with a brush etc., to excite the skin to healthy action. 2. (Mech.)  The resistance which a body meets with from the surface on which it moves. It ma.

debilitation.definition: The act or process of debilitating, or the condition of one who is debilitated; weakness.

grievance.definition: A cause of uneasiness and complaint; a wrong done and suffered; that which gives ground for remonstrance or resistance, as arising from injustice, tyranny, etc.; injury. 2. Grieving; grief; affliction. The . . . grievance of a mind unreasonably yoked. Milton. Syn. -- Burden; oppression; hardship; tr.

daphnia.definition: A genus of the genus Daphnia.

certiorari.definition: A writ issuing out of chancery, or a superior court, to call up the records of a inferior court, or remove a cause there depending, in order that the party may have more sure and speedy justice, or that errors and irreguarities may be corrected. It is obtained upon complaint of a party that he has n.

gnathic.definition: Of or pertaining to the jaw. Gnathic index, in a skull, the ratio of the distance from the middle of the nasofrontal suture to the basion (taken equal to 100), to the distance from the basion to the middle of the front edge of the upper jaw; -- called also alveolar index. Skulls with the gnathic ind.

sacrament.definition: The oath of allegiance taken by Roman soldiers; hence, a sacred ceremony used to impress an obligation; a solemn oath-taking; an oath. I'll take the sacrament on't. Shak. 2. The pledge or token of an oath or solemn cobenant; a sacred thing; a mystery. God sometimes sent a light of fire, and pillar o.

empassion.definition: To move with passion; to affect strongly. See Impassion. Those sights empassion me full near. Spenser.

antilogy.definition: A contradiction between any words or passages in an author. Sir W. Hamilton.

exculpation.definition: The act of exculpating from alleged fault or crime; that which exculpates; excuse. These robbers, however, were men who might have made out a strong case in exculpation of themselves. Southey.

chorepiscopus.definition: A "country" or suffragan bishop, appointed in the ancient church by a diocesan bishop to exercise episcopal jurisdiction in a rural district.

mactation.definition: The act of killing a victim for sacrifice.

lammergeier.definition: A very large vulture (Gypaëtus barbatus), which inhabits the mountains of Southern Europe, Asia, and Northern Africa. When full- grown it is nine or ten feet in extent of wings. It is brownish black above, with the under parts and neck rusty yellow; the forehead and crown white; the sides of the hea.

thymus.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, the thymus gland. -- n.  The thymus gland. Thymus gland, or Thymus body, a ductless gland in the throat, or in the neighboring region, of nearly all vertebrates. In man and other mammals it is the throat, or neck, sweetbread, which lies in the upper part of the tho.

penniform.definition: Having the form of a feather or plume.

compositive.definition: Having the quality of entering into composition; compounded.

elegancy.definition: The state or quality of being elegant; beauty as resulting from choice qualities and the complete absence of what deforms or impresses unpleasantly; grace given by art or practice; fine polish; refinement; -- said of manners, language, style, form, architecture, etc. That grace that elegance affords.

razzia.definition: A plundering and destructive incursion; a foray; a rai.

timberman.definition: A man employed in placing supports of timber in a mine. Weale.

doucepere.definition: One of the twelve peers of France, companions of Charlemagne in war. [Written also douzepere.] Big-looking like a doughty doucepere. Spenser.

hackbolt.definition: The greater shearwater or hagdon. See Hagdon.

divertive.definition: Tending to divert; diverting; amusing; interesting. Things of a pleasant and divertive nature. Rogers.

entresol.definition: A low story between two higher ones, usually between the ground floor and the first story; mezzanine. Parker.

languid.definition: Drooping or flagging from exhaustion; indisposed to exertion; without animation; weak; weary; heavy; dull. " Languid, powerless limbs. " Armstrong. Fire their languid souls with Cato's virtue. Addison. 2. Slow in progress; tardy. " No motion so swift or languid." Bentley. 3. Promoting or indicating.

cackling.definition: The broken noise of a goose or a hen.

balefire.definition: A signal fire; an alarm fire. Sweet Teviot! on thy silver tide The glaring balefires blaze no more. Sir W. Scott.

repleader.definition: A second pleading, or course of pleadings; also, the right of pleading again. Whenever a repleader is granted, the pleadings must begin de novo. Blackstone.

rawness.definition: The quality or state of being raw.

sophistication.definition: The act of sophisticating; adulteration; as, the sophistication of drugs. Boyle.

eider.definition: Any species of sea duck of the genus Somateria, esp. Somateria mollissima, which breeds in the northern parts of Europe and America, and lines its nest with fine down (taken from its own body) which is an article of commerce; -- called also eider duck. The American eider (S. Dresseri), the king eide.

transformer.definition: One who, or that which, transforms. Specif. (Elec.), an apparatus for producing from a given electrical current another current of different voltage.

inarticulate.definition: Not uttered with articulation or intelligible distinctness, as speech or words. Music which is inarticulate poesy. Dryden. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) Not jointed or articulated; having no distinct body segments; as, an inarticulate worm. (b) Without a hinge; -- said of an order (Inarticulata or Ecardines) of br.

smirch.definition:
To smear with something which stains, or makes dirty; to smutch; to begrime; to soil; to sully. I'll . . . with a kind of umber smirch my face. Shak.

A smutch; a dirty stain.

quattrocento.definition: The fifteenth century, when applied to Italian art or literature; as, the sculpture of the quattrocento; quattrocento style. --Quat`tro*cen"tist (#), n.

compliable.definition: Capable of bending or yielding; apt to yield; compliant. Another compliable mind. Milton. The Jews . . . had made their religion compliable, and accemodated to their passions. Jortin.

interpolation.definition: The act of introducing or inserting anything, especially that which is spurious or foreign. 2. That which is introduced or inserted, especially something foreign or spurious. Bentley wrote a letter . . . . upon the scriptural glosses in our present copies of Hesychius, which he considered interpolat.

aviseful.definition: Watchful; circumspect. With sharp, aviseful eye. Spenser.

emodin.definition: An orange-red crystalline substance, C15H10O5, obtained from the buckthorn, rhubarb, etc., and regarded as a derivative of anthraquinone; -- so called from a species of rhubarb (Rheum emodei).

porcelainized.definition: Baked like potter's lay; -- applied to clay shales that have been converted by heat into a substance resembling porcelain.

scaphopoda.definition: A class of marine cephalate Mollusca having a tubular shell open at both ends, a pointed or spadelike foot for burrowing, and many long, slender, prehensile oral tentacles. It includes Dentalium, or the tooth shells, and other similar shells. Called also Prosopocephala, and Solenoconcha.

gurglet.definition: A porous earthen jar for cooling water by evaporation.

duster.definition: One who, or that which, dusts; a utensil that frees from dust. Specifically: (a) (Paper Making) A revolving wire-cloth cylinder which removes the dust from rags, etc. (b) (Milling)  A blowing machine for separating the flour from the bran. 2. A light over-garment, worn in traveling to protect the cl.

cowslip.definition: A common flower in England (Primula veris) having yellow blossoms and appearing in early spring. It is often cultivated in the United States. 2. In the United States, the marsh marigold (Caltha palustris), appearing in wet places in early spring and often used as a pot herb. It is nearer to a butter.

patter.definition: To strike with a quick succession of slight, sharp sounds; as, pattering rain or hail; pattering feet. The stealing shower is scarce to patter heard. Thomson. 2. To mutter; to mumble; as, to patter with the lips. Tyndale. Etym: [In this sense, and in the following, perh. from paternoster.] 3. To tal.

menial.definition:
Belonging to a retinue or train of servants; performing servile office; serving. Two menial dogs before their master pressed. Dryden. 2. Pertaining to servants, esp. domestic servants; servile; low; mean. " Menial offices." Swift.

1. A domestic servant or retainer, esp. one of humble rank; one empl.

perfuncturate.definition: To perform in a perfunctory manner; to do negligently.

lodged.definition: Lying down; -- used of beasts of the chase, as couchant is of beasts of prey.

utriculate.definition: Resembling a bladder; swollen like a bladder; inflated; utricular. Dana.

cobaltine.definition: A mineral of a nearly silver-white color, composed of arsenic, sulphur, and cobalt.

judge-made.definition: Created by judges or judicial decision; -- applied esp. to law applied or established by the judicial interpretation of statutes so as extend or restrict their scope, as to meet new cases, to provide new or better remedies, etc., and often used opprobriously of acts of judicial interpretation consid.

merostomata.definition: A class of Arthropoda, allied to the Crustacea. It includes the trilobites, Eurypteroidea, and Limuloidea. All are extinct except the horseshoe crabs of the last group. See Limulus.

heterodont.definition:
Having the teeth differentiated into incisors, canines, and molars, as in man; -- opposed to homodont.

Any animal with heterodont dentition.

lampblack.definition: The fine impalpable soot obtained from the smoke of carbonaceous substances which have been only partly burnt, as in the flame of a smoking lamp. It consists of finely divided carbon, with sometimes a very small proportion of various impurities. It is used as an ingredient of printers' ink, and vari.

swordsmanship.definition: The state of being a swordsman; skill in the use of the sword. Cowper.

benumbment.definition: Act of benumbing, or state of being benumbed; torpor. Kirby.

meroblast.definition: An ovum, as that of a mammal, only partially composed of germinal matter, that is, consisting of both a germinal portion and an albuminous or nutritive one; -- opposed to holoblast.

vanguard.definition: The troops who march in front of an army; the advance guard; the van.

territorially.definition: In regard to territory; by means of territory.

notate.definition: Marked with spots or lines, which are often colored. Henslow.

pannus.definition: A very vascular superficial opacity of the cornea, usually caused by granulation of the eyelids. Foster.

weather-fend.definition: To defend from the weather; to shelter. Shak. [We] barked the white spruce to weather-fend the roof. Emerson.

phosphor.definition: Phosphorus. Addison. 2. The planet Venus, when appearing as the morning star; Lucifer. [Poetic] Pope. Tennyson.

privy.definition: Of or pertaining to some person exclusively; assigned to private uses; not public; private; as, the privy purse. " Privee knights and squires." Chaucer. 2. Secret; clandestine. " A privee thief." Chaucer. 3. Appropriated to retirement; private; not open to the public. " Privy chambers." Ezek. xxi. 1.

octaemeron.definition: A fast of eight days before a great festival. Shipley.

esurient.definition:
Inclined to eat; hungry; voracious. Bailey. "Poor, but esurient." Carlyle.

One who is hungry or greedy. An insatiable esurient after riches. Wood.

gustoso.definition: Tasteful; in a tasteful, agreeable manner.

reddition.definition: Restoration: restitution: surrender. Howell. 2. Explanation; representation. The reddition or application of the comparison. Chapman.

heddle.definition:
One of the sets of parallel doubled threads which, with mounting, compose the harness employed to guide the warp threads to the lathe or batten in a loom.

To draw (the warp thread) through the heddle-eyes, in weaving.

epigynous.definition: Adnate to the surface of the ovary, so as to be apparently inserted upon the top of it; -- said of stamens, petals, sepals, and also of the disk.

trysting.definition: An appointment; a tryst. Trysting day, an arranged day of meeting or assembling, as of soldiers, friends, and the like. And named a trysting day, And bade his messengers ride forth East and west and south and north, To summon his array. Macaulay. -- Trysting place, a place designated for the assembl.

attaint.definition: To attain; to get act; to hit. 2. (Old Law)  To find guilty; to convict; -- said esp. of a jury on trial for giving a false verdict. Upon sufficient proof attainted of some open act by men of his own condition. Blackstone. 3. (Law)  To subject (a person) to the legal condition formerly resulting fro.

foretell.definition:
To predict; to tell before occurence; to prophesy; to foreshow. Deeds then undone my faithful tongue foretold. Pope. Prodigies, foretelling the future eminence and luster of his character. C. Middleton. Syn. -- To predict; prophesy; prognosticate; augur.

To utter predictions. Acts iii. 24.

mummichog.definition: Any one of several species of small American cyprinodont fishes of the genus Fundulus, and of allied genera; the killifishes; -- called also minnow. [Written also mummychog, mummachog.].

naif.definition: Having a true natural luster without being cut; -- applied by jewelers to a precious stone. 2. Naïve; as, a naïf remark. London Spectator.

indigence.definition: The condition of being indigent; want of estate, or means of comfortable subsistence; penury; poverty; as, helpless, indigence. Cowper. Syn. -- Poverty; penury; destitution; want; need; privation; lack. See Poverty.

renowme.definition: Renown. The glory and renowme of the ancectors. Robynson (More's Utopia).

subbrachiales.definition: A division of soft-finned fishes in which the ventral fins are situated beneath the pectorial fins, or nearly so.

crofter.definition: One who rents and tills a small farm or helding; as, the crofters of Scotland.

philippic.definition: Any one of the series of famous orations of Demosthenes, the Grecian orator, denouncing Philip, king of Macedon. 2. Hence: Any discourse or declamation abounding in acrimonious invective.

inhere.definition: To be inherent; to stick (in); to be fixed or permanently incorporated with something; to cleave (to); to belong, as attributes or qualities. They do but inhere in the subject that supports them. Digby.

earthboard.definition: The part of a plow, or other implement, that turns over the earth; the moldboard.

depressive.definition: Able or tending to depress or cast down. -- De*press"ive*ness, n.

octosyllabical.definition: Consisting of or containing eight syllables.

lorcha.definition: A kind of light vessel used on the coast of China, having the hull built on a European model, and the rigging like that of a Chinese junk. Admiral Foote.

instimulate.definition:
Not to stimulate; to soothe; to quiet. Cheyne.

To stimulate; to excite. Cockerman.

anecdotist.definition: One who relates or collects anecdotes.

palpebral.definition: Of or pertaining to the eyelids.

anaerobia.definition: Anaërobic bacteria. They are called facultative anaërobia when able to live either in the presence or absence of free oxygen; obligate, or obligatory, anaërobia when they thrive only in its absence.

halation.definition: An appearance as of a halo of light, surround the edges of dark object.

two-sided.definition: Having two sides only; hence, double-faced; hypocritical. 2. (Biol.)  Symmetrical.

lathe.definition:
Formerly, a part or division of a county among the Anglo- Saxons. At present it consists of four or five hundreds, and is confined to the county of Kent. [Written also lath.] Brande & C.

1. A granary; a barn. Chaucer. 2. (Mach.)  A machine for turning, that is, for shaping articles of wood, metal,.

atypic.definition: That has no type; devoid of typical character; irregular; unlike the type.

mira.definition: A remarkable variable star in the constellation Cetus (o Ceti).

apercu.definition: A first view or glance, or the perception or estimation so obtained; an immediate apprehension or insight, appreciative rather than analytic. The main object being to develop the several aperçus or insights which furnish the method of such psychology. W. T. Harris. A series of partial and more or le.

cerebrin.definition: A nonphosphorized, nitrogenous substance, obtained from brain and nerve tissue by extraction with boiling alcohol. It is uncertain whether it exists as such in nerve tissue, or is a product of the decomposition of some more complex substance.

lunule.definition: (Anat.)  Anything crescent-shaped; a crescent-shaped part or mark; a lunula, a lune. 2. (Chem.)  A lune. See Lune. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) A small or narrow crescent. (b) A special area in front of the beak of many bivalve shells. It sometimes has the shape of a double crescent, but is oftener heart- shaped.

xanthium.definition: A genus of composite plants in which the scales of the involucre are united so as to form a kind of bur; cocklebur; clotbur.

homograph.definition: One of two or more words identical in orthography, but having different derivations and meanings; as, fair, n., a market, and fair, a., beautiful.

ducker.definition: One who, or that which, ducks; a plunger; a diver. 2. A cringing, servile person; a fawner.

chromospheric.definition: Of or pertaining to the chromosphere.

beatifical.definition: Having the power to impart or complete blissful enjoyment; blissful. "The beatific vision." South. -- Be`a*tif"ic*al*ly, adv.

cashbook.definition: A book in which is kept a register of money received or paid out.

swarthiness.definition: The quality or state of being swarthy; a dusky or dark complexion; tawniness.

limitless.definition: Having no limits; unbounded; boundless. Davies (Wit's Pilgr.).

passiflora.definition: A genus of plants, including the passion flower. It is the type of the order Passifloreæ, which includes about nineteen genera and two hundred and fifty species.

cottagely.definition: Cottagelike; suitable for a cottage; rustic. Jer. Taylor.

cosmolabe.definition: An instrument resembling the astrolabe, formerly used for measuring the angles between heavenly bodies; -- called also pantacosm.

espringal.definition: An engine of war used for throwing viretons, large stones, and other missiles; a springal.

adactylous.definition: (a) Without fingers or without toes. (b) Without claws on the feet (of crustaceous animals).

embarrassment.definition: A state of being embarrassed; perplexity; impediment to freedom of action; entanglement; hindrance; confusion or discomposure of mind, as from not knowing what to do or to say; disconcertedness. The embarrassment which inexperienced minds have often to express themselves upon paper. W. Irving. The e.

fallible.definition: Liable to fail, mistake, or err; liable to deceive or to be deceived; as, all men are fallible; our opinions and hopes are fallible.

bardish.definition: Pertaining to, or written by, a bard or bards. "Bardish impostures." Selden.

cephalotripsy.definition: The act or operation of crushing the head of a fetus in the womb in order to effect delivery.

apteryges.definition: An order of birds, including the genus Apteryx.

gastritis.definition: Inflammation of the stomach, esp. of its mucuos membrane.

cowbird.definition: The cow blackbird (Molothrus ater), an American starling. Like the European cuckoo, it builds no nest, but lays its eggs in the nests of other birds; -- so called because frequently associated with cattle.

succulency.definition: The quality or condition of being succulent; juiciness; as, the succulence of a peach.

selfsame.definition: Precisely the same; the very same; identical. His servant was healed in the selfsame hour. Matt. viii. 13.

dancette.definition: Deeply indented; having large teeth; thus, a fess dancetté has only three teeth in the whole width of the escutcheon.

laminar.definition: In, or consisting of, thin plates or layers; having the form of a thin plate or lamina.

backwards.definition: With the back in advance or foremost; as, to ride backward. 2. Toward the back; toward the rear; as, to throw the arms backward. 3. On the back, or with the back downward. Thou wilt fall backward. Shak. 4. Toward, or in, past time or events; ago. Some reigns backward. Locke. 5. By way of reflection;.

alternativeness.definition: The quality of being alternative, or of offering a choice between two.

denization.definition: The act of making one a denizen or adopted citizen; naturalization. Hallam.

unbeliever.definition: One who does not believe; an incredulous person; a doubter; a skeptic. 2. A disbeliever; especially, one who does not believe that the Bible is a divine revelation, and holds that Christ was neither a divine nor a supernatural person; an infidel; a freethinker. Syn. -- See Infidel.

tailstock.definition: The sliding block or support, in a lathe, which carries the dead spindle, or adjustable center. The headstock supports the live spindle.

diphthong.definition:
(a) A coalition or union of two vowel sounds pronounced in one syllable; as, ou in out, oi in noise; -- called a proper diphthong. (b) A vowel digraph; a union of two vowels in the same syllable, only one of them being sounded; as, ai in rain, eo in people; -- called an improper diphthong.

To form.

geth.definition: the original third pers. sing. pres. of Go. Chaucer.

quinquefid.definition: Sharply cut about halfway to the middle or base into five segments; as, a quinquefid leaf or corolla.

thuggee.definition: The practice of secret or stealthy murder by Thugs. "One of the suppressors of Thuggee." J. D. Hooker.

squarely.definition: In a square form or manner.

chondrin.definition: A colorless, amorphous, nitrogenous substance, tasteless and odorless, formed from cartilaginous tissue by long-continued action of boiling water. It is similar to gelatin, and is a large ingredient of commercial gelatin.

plebification.definition: A rendering plebeian; the act of vulgarizing. You begin with the attempt to popularize learning . . . but you will end in the plebification of knowledge. Coleridge.

lexicographical.definition: Of or pertaining to, or according to, lexicography. -- Lex`i*co*graph"ic*al*ly, adv.

tendrilled.definition: Furnished with tendrils, or with such or so many, tendrils. "The thousand tendriled vine." Southey.

donative.definition: A gift; a largess; a gratuity; a present. "The Romans were entertained with shows and donatives." Dryden. 2. (Eccl. Law)  A benefice conferred on a person by the founder or patron, without either presentation or institution by the ordinary, or induction by his orders. See the Note under Benefice, n.

lithocarp.definition: Fossil fruit; a fruit petrified; a carpolite.

nilotic.definition: Of or pertaining to the river Nile; as, the Nilotic crocodile.

retractor.definition: One who, or that which, retracts. Specifically: (a) In breech-loading firearms, a device for withdrawing a cartridge shell from the barrel. (b) (Surg.)  An instrument for holding apart the edges of a wound during amputation. (c) (Surg.) A bandage to protect the soft parts from injury by the saw duri.

imbiber.definition: One who, or that which, imbibes.

cerebellum.definition: The large lobe of the hind brain in front of and above the medulla; the little brain. It controls combined muscular action. See Brain.

oceanus.definition: The god of the great outer sea, or the river which was believed to flow around the whole earth.

trothplight.definition:
To betroth.

Betrothed; espoused; affianced. Shak.

The act of betrothing, or plighting faith; betrothing. Shak.

unfurl.definition: To loose from a furled state; to unfold; to expand; to open or spread; as, to unfurl sails; to unfurl a flag.

expanse.definition:
That which is expanded or spread out; a wide extent of space or body; especially, the arch of the sky. "The green expanse." Savage. Lights . . . high in the expanse of heaven. Milton. The smooth expanse of crystal lakes. Pope.

To expand. That lies expansed unto the eyes of all. Sir. T. Browne.

overpower.definition:
To excel or exceed in power; to cause to yield; to vanquish; to subdue; as, the light overpowers the eyes. "And overpower'd that gallant few." Wordsworth. Syn. -- To overbear; overcome; vanquish; defeat; crush; overwhelm; overthrow; rout; conquer; subdue.

A dominating power. Bacon.

stinkweed.definition: Stramonium. See Jamestown weed, and Datura.

hemitrope.definition:
Half turned round; half inverted; (Crystallog.) having a twinned structure.

That which is hemitropal in construction; (Crystallog.) a twin crystal having a hemitropal structure.

dotage.definition: Feebleness or imbecility of understanding or mind, particularly in old age; the childishness of old age; senility; as, a venerable man, now in his dotage. Capable of distinguishing between the infancy and the dotage of Greek literature. Macaulay. 2. Foolish utterance; drivel. The sapless dotages of.

digestedly.definition: In a digested or well-arranged manner; methodically.

dodecahedron.definition: A solid having twelve faces. Note: The regular dodecahedron is bounded by twelve equal and regular pentagons; the pyritohedron (see Pyritohedron) is related to it; the rhombic dodecahedron is bounded by twelve equal rhombic faces.

apodeictical.definition: Self-evident; intuitively true; evident beyond contradiction. Brougham. Sir Wm. Hamilton.

umbilication.definition: A slight, navel-like depression, or dimpling, of the center of a rounded body; as, the umbilication of a smallpox vesicle; also, the condition of being umbilicated.

pichiciago.definition: A small, burrowing, South American edentate (Chlamyphorus truncatus), allied to the armadillos. The shell is attached only along the back. [Written also pichyciego.].

circumvallate.definition:
To surround with a rampart or wall. Johnson.

1. Surrounded with a wall; inclosed with a rampart. 2. (Anat.)  Surrounded by a ridle or elevation; as, the circumvallate papillæ, near the base of the tongue.

lobosa.definition: An order of Rhizopoda, in which the pseudopodia are thick and irregular in form, as in the Amoeba.

brandish.definition:
To move or wave, as a weapon; to raise and move in various directions; to shake or flourish. The quivering lance which he brandished bright. Drake. 2. To play with; to flourish; as, to brandish syllogisms.

A flourish, as with a weapon, whip, etc. "Brandishes of the fan." Tailer.

chylaqueous.definition: Consisting of chyle much diluted with water; -- said of a liquid which forms the circulating fluid of some inferior animals.

tapered.definition: Lighted with a taper or tapers; as, a tapered choir. T. Warton.

declaim.definition: To speak rhetorically; to make a formal speech or oration; to harangue; specifically, to recite a speech, poem, etc., in public as a rhetorical exercise; to practice public speaking; as, the students declaim twice a week. 2. To speak for rhetorical display; to speak pompously, noisily, or theatrical.

yachter.definition: One engaged in sailing a jacht.

tided.definition: Affected by the tide; having a tide. "The tided Thames." Bp. Hall.

philanthropist.definition: One who practices philanthropy; one who loves mankind, and seeks to promote the good of others.

counterbuff.definition:
To strike or drive back or in an opposite direction; to stop by a blow or impulse in front. Dryden.

A blow in an opposite direction; a stroke that stops motion or cause a recoil.

stepper.definition: One who, or that which, steps; as, a quick stepper.

double-tonguing.definition: A peculiar action of the tongue by flute players in articulating staccato notes; also, the rapid repetition of notes in cornet playing.

edam.definition: A Dutch pressed cheese of yellow color and fine flavor, made in balls weighing three or four pounds, and usually colored crimson outside; -- so called from the village of Edam, near Amsterdam. Also, cheese of the same type, wherever made.

clothespin.definition: A forked piece of wood, or a small spring clamp, used for fastening clothes on a line.

enterorrhaphy.definition: The operation of sewing up a rent in the intestinal canal.

antipathetical.definition: Having a natural contrariety, or constitutional aversion, to a thing; characterized by antipathy; -- often followed by to. Fuller.

uncurrent.definition: Not current. Specifically: Not passing in common payment; not receivable at par or full value; as, uncurrent notes. Shak.

philatelist.definition: One versed in philately; one who collects postage stamps.

spousal.definition:
Of or pertaining to a spouse or marriage; nuptial; matrimonial; conjugal; bridal; as, spousal rites; spousal ornaments. Wordsworth.

Marriage; nuptials; espousal; -- generally used in the plural; as, the spousals of Hippolita. Dryden. Boweth your head under that blissful yoke . . . Which that men cl.
