perspicacious.definition: Having the power of seeing clearly; quick-sighted; sharp of sight. 2. Fig.: Of acute discernment; keen. -- Per`spi*ca"cious*ly, adv. -- Per`spi*ca"cious*ness, n.

monomerous.definition: (Bot.)  Composed of solitary parts, as a flower with one sepal, one petal, one stamen, and one pistil. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having but one joint; -- said of the foot of certain insects.

thowel.definition: (a) A thole pin. (b) A rowlock. I would sit impatiently thinking with what an unusual amount of noise the oars worked in the thowels. Dickens.

arduously.definition: In an arduous manner; with difficulty or laboriousness.

catelectrotonus.definition: The condition of increased irritability of a nerve in the region of the cathode or negative electrode, on the passage of a current of electricity through it.

reexchange.definition:
To exchange anew; to reverse (a previous exchange).

1. A renewed exchange; a reversal of an exchange. 2. (Com.)  The expense chargeable on a bill of exchange or draft which has been dishonored in a foreign country, and returned to the country in which it was made or indorsed, and then taken up. Bou.

monstrousness.definition: The state or quality of being monstrous, unusual, extraordinary. Shak.

accelerate.definition: To cause to move faster; to quicken the motion of; to add to the speed of; -- opposed to retard. 2. To quicken the natural or ordinary progression or process of; as, to accelerate the growth of a plant, the increase of wealth, etc. 3. To hasten, as the occurence of an event; as, to accelerate our de.

whiteblow.definition: Same as Whitlow grass, under Whitlow.

prolixious.definition: Dilatory; tedious; superfluous. "Lay by all nicety, and prolixious blushes." Shak.

liquefaction.definition: The act or operation of making or becoming liquid; especially, the conversion of a solid into a liquid by the sole agency of heat. 2. The state of being liquid. 3. (Chem. Physics)  The act, process, or method, of reducing a gas or vapor to a liquid by cold or pressure; as, the liquefaction of oxygen.

enallage.definition: A substitution, as of one part of speech for another, of one gender, number, case, person, tense, mode, or voice, of the same word, for another.

detach.definition: To part; to separate or disunite; to disengage; -- the opposite of attach; as, to detach the coats of a bulbous root from each other; to detach a man from a leader or from a party. 2. To separate for a special object or use; -- used especially in military language; as, to detach a ship from a fleet,.

plea.definition: (Law)  That which is alleged by a party in support of his cause; in a stricter sense, an allegation of fact in a cause, as distinguished from a demurrer; in a still more limited sense, and in modern practice, the defendant's answer to the plaintiff's declaration and demand. That which the plaintiff.

dukeship.definition: The quality or condition of being a duke; also, the personality of a duke. Massinger.

dandy.definition: One who affects special finery or gives undue attention to dress; a fop; a coxcomb. 2. (Naut.) (a) A sloop or cutter with a jigger on which a lugsail is set. (b) A small sail carried at or near the stern of small boats; -- called also jigger, and mizzen. 3. A dandy roller. See below. Dandy brush, a.

sedulous.definition: Diligent in application or pursuit; constant, steady, and persevering in business, or in endeavors to effect an object; steadily industrious; assiduous; as, the sedulous bee. What signifies the sound of words in prayer, without the affection of the heart, and a sedulous application of the proper mea.

arundinaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to a reed; resembling the reed or cane.

turbinaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to peat, or turf; of the nature of peat, or turf; peaty; turfy. Sir. W. Scott.

crossette.definition: (a) A return in one of the corners of the architrave of a door or window; -- called also ancon, ear, elbow. (b) The shoulder of a joggled keystone.

sacristy.definition: A apartment in a church where the sacred utensils, vestments, etc., are kept; a vestry.

spade.definition:
(Zoöl.)  A hart or stag three years old. [Written also spaid, spayade.] 2. Etym: [Cf. L. spado.]  A castrated man or beast.

1. An implement for digging or cutting the ground, consisting usually of an oblong and nearly rectangular blade of iron, with a handle like that of a shovel. "With spade and p.

nonylenic.definition: Of, pertaining to, related to, or designating, nonylene or its compounds; as, nonylenic acid.

perishably.definition: In a perishable degree or manner.

picotine.definition: A variety of carnation having petals of a light color variously dotted and spotted at the edges.

acerbity.definition: Sourness of taste, with bitterness and astringency, like that of unripe fruit. 2. Harshness, bitterness, or severity; as, acerbity of temper, of language, of pain. Barrow.

indiligent.definition: Not diligent; idle; slothful. Feltham. -- In*dil"i*gent*ly, adv.

guaiac.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, guaiacum. -- n. Guaiacum.

prerequire.definition: To require beforehand. Some things are prerequired of us. Bp. Hall.

bunchiness.definition: The quality or condition of being bunchy; knobbiness.

lean-to.definition: Having only one slope or pitch; -- said of a roof. -- n.  A shed or slight building placed against the wall of a larger structure and having a single-pitched roof; -- called also penthouse, and to-fall. The outer circuit was covered as a lean-to, all round this inner apartment. De Foe.

propaedeutical.definition: Of, pertaining to, or conveying, preliminary instruction; introductory to any art or science; instructing beforehand.

dolabriform.definition: Shaped like the head of an ax or hatchet, as some leaves, and also certain organs of some shellfish.

megalops.definition: A larva, in a stage following the zoëa, in the development of most crabs. In this stage the legs and abdominal appendages have appeared, the abdomen is relatively long, and the eyes are large. Also used adjectively. 2. A large fish; the tarpum.

fracid.definition: Rotten from being too ripe; overripe. Blount.

hydrated.definition: Formed into a hydrate; combined with water.

somniloquist.definition: One who talks in his sleep.

plumbaginous.definition: Resembling plumbago; consisting of, or containing, plumbago; as, a plumbaginous slate.

penumbra.definition: An incomplete or partial shadow. 2. (Astron.)  The shadow cast, in an eclipse, where the light is partly, but not wholly, cut off by the intervening body; the space of partial illumination between the umbra, or perfect shadow, on all sides, and the full light. Sir I. Newton. Note: The faint shade su.

ceratobranchia.definition: A group of nudibranchiate Mollusca having on the back papilliform or branched organs serving as gills.

hail-fellow.definition: An intimate companion. Hail-fellow well met. Lyly.

bacchus.definition: The god of wine, son of Jupiter and Semele.

lancet.definition: A surgical instrument of various forms, commonly sharp-pointed and two-edged, used in venesection, and in opening abscesses, etc. 2. (Metal.)  An iron bar used for tapping a melting furnace. Knight. Lancet arch (Arch.), a pointed arch, of which the width, or span, is narrow compared with the height.

old-maidish.definition: Like an old maid; prim; precise; particular.

infraction.definition: The act of infracting or breaking; breach; violation; nonobservance; infringement; as, an infraction of a treaty, compact, rule, or law. I. Watts.

ascertainment.definition: The act of ascertaining; a reducing to certainty; a finding out by investigation; discovery. The positive ascertainment of its limits. Burke.

neatly.definition: In a neat manner; tidily; tastefully.

toothing.definition: The act or process of indenting or furnishing with teeth. 2. (Masonry)  Bricks alternately projecting at the end of a wall, in order that they may be bonded into a continuation of it when the remainder is carried up. Toothing plane, a plane of which the iron is formed into a series of small teeth, f.

patricidal.definition: Of or pertaining to patricide; parricidal.

catalogize.definition: To insert in a catalogue; to register; to catalogue. Coles.

zosterops.definition: A genus of birds that comprises the white-eyes. See White-eye.

scuffle.definition: To strive or struggle with a close grapple; to wrestle in a rough fashion. 2. Hence, to strive or contend tumultuously; to struggle confusedly or at haphazard. A gallant man had rather fight to great disadvantage in the field, in an orderly way, than scuffle with an undisciplined rabble. Eikon Basil.

catholicos.definition: The spiritual head of the Armenian church, who resides at Etchmiadzin, Russia, and has ecclesiastical jurisdiction over, and consecrates the holy oil for, the Armenians of Russia, Turkey, and Persia, including the Patriarchs of Constantinople, Jerusalem, and Sis. Note: The Patriarch of Constantinopl.

protogine.definition: A kind of granite or gneiss containing a silvery talcose mineral.

dumose.definition: Abounding with bushes and briers. 2. (Bot.)  Having a compact, bushy form.

saxonist.definition: One versed in the Saxon language.

secretaryship.definition: The office, or the term of office, of a secretary.

siderography.definition: The art or practice of steel engraving; especially, the process, invented by Perkins, of multiplying facsimiles of an engraved steel plate by first rolling over it, when hardened, a soft steel cylinder, and then rolling the cylinder, when hardened, over a soft steel plate, which thus becomes a facsi.

gazet.definition: A Venetian coin, worth about three English farthings, or one and a half cents.

intensitive.definition: Increasing the force or intensity of; intensive; as, the intensitive words of a sentence. H. Sweet.

transmigrant.definition: Migrating or passing from one place or state to another; passing from one residence to another. -- n.  One who transmigrates.

willowy.definition: Abounding with willows. Where willowy Camus lingers with delight. Gray. 2. Resembling a willow; pliant; flexible; pendent; drooping; graceful.

plasterer.definition: One who applies plaster or mortar. "Thy father was a plasterer." Shak. 2. One who makes plaster casts. "The plasterer doth make his figures by addition." Sir H. Wotton.

barbiers.definition: A variety of paralysis, peculiar to India and the Malabar coast; -- considered by many to be the same as beriberi in chronic form.

undermine.definition: To excavate the earth beneath, or the part of, especially for the purpose of causing to fall or be overthrown; to form a mine under; to sap; as, to undermine a wall. A vast rock undermined from one end to the other, and a highway running through it. Addison. 2. Fig.: To remove the foundation or supp.

pistillation.definition: The act of pounding or breaking in a mortar; pestillation. Sir T. Browne.

starthroat.definition: Any humming bird of the genus Heliomaster. The feathers of the throat have a brilliant metallic luster.

third-penny.definition: A third part of the profits of fines and penalties imposed at the country court, which was among the perquisites enjoyed by the earl.

committal.definition: The act of commiting, or the state of being committed; commitment.

olein.definition: A fat, liquid at ordinary temperatures, but solidifying at temperatures below 0° C., found abundantly in both the animal and vegetable kingdoms (see Palmitin). It dissolves solid fats, especially at 30-40° C. Chemically, olein is a glyceride of oleic acid; and, as three molecules of the acid are uni.

aristotype.definition: Orig., a printing-out process using paper coated with silver chloride in gelatin; now, any such process using silver salts in either collodion or gelatin; also, a print so made.

siderostat.definition: An apparatus consisting essentially of a mirror moved by clockwork so as to throw the rays of the sun or a star in a fixed direction; -- a more general term for heliostat.

pexity.definition: Nap of cloth. PEYER'S GLANDS Pey"er's glands`. Etym: [So called from J.K.Peyer, who described them in 1677.] (Anat.)  Pathches of lymphoid nodules, in the walls of the small intestiness; agminated glands; -- called also Peyer's patches. In typhoid fever they become the seat of ulcers which are regar.

exanimation.definition: Deprivation of life or of spirits. Bailey.

atlantes.definition: Figures or half figures of men, used as columns to support an entablature; -- called also telamones. See Caryatides. Oxf. Gloss.

epistemology.definition: The theory or science of the method or grounds of knowledge.

pacifiable.definition: Capable of being pacified or appeased; placable.

caviare.definition: The roes of the sturgeon, prepared and salted; -- used as a relish, esp. in Russia. Note: Caviare was considered a delicacy, by some, in Shakespeare's time, but was not relished by most. Hence Hamlet says of a certain play. "'T was caviare to the general," i. e., above the taste of the common people.

objuration.definition: A binding by oath. Abp. Bramhall.

supposable.definition: Capable of being supposed, or imagined to exist; as, that is not a supposable case. -- Sup*pos"a*ble*ness, n. -- Sup*pos"a*bly, adv.

pontificality.definition: The state and government of the pope; the papacy. Bacon.

lampoon.definition:
A personal satire in writing; usually, malicious and abusive censure written only to reproach and distress. Like her who missed her name in a lampoon, And grieved to find herself decayed so soon. Dryden.

To subject to abusive ridicule expressed in writing; to make the subject of a lampoon. Ribald p.

disappoint.definition: To defeat of expectation or hope; to hinder from the attainment of that which was excepted, hoped, or desired; to balk; as, a man is disappointed of his hopes or expectations, or his hopes, desires, intentions, expectations, or plans are disappointed; a bad season disappoints the farmer of his crops.

instaurator.definition: One who renews or restores to a former condition. Dr. H. More.

hemstitch.definition: To ornament at the head of a broad hem by drawing out a few parallel threads, and fastening the cross threads in successive small clusters; as, to hemstitch a handkerchief.

fetlock.definition: The cushionlike projection, bearing a tuft of long hair, on the back side of the leg above the hoof of the horse and similar animals. Also, the joint of the limb at this point (between the great pastern bone and the metacarpus), or the tuft of hair. Their wounded steeds Fret fetlock deep in gore. Sh.

beplaster.definition: To plaster over; to cover or smear thickly; to bedaub. Beplastered with rouge. Goldsmith.

peddler.definition: One who peddles; a traveling trader; one who travels about, retailing small wares; a hawker. [Written also pedlar and pedler.] "Some vagabond huckster or peddler." Hakluyt.

tregetour.definition: A juggler who produces illusions by the use of elaborate machinery. Divers appearances Such as these subtle tregetours play. Chaucer.

anient.definition: To frustrate; to bring to naught; to annihilate. Chaucer.

belletristical.definition: Occupied with, or pertaining to, belles-lettres. "An unlearned, belletristic trifler." M. Arnold.

clypeastroid.definition: Like or related to the genus Clupeaster; -- applied to a group of flattened sea urchins, with a rosette of pores on the upper side.

govern.definition: To direct and control, as the actions or conduct of men, either by established laws or by arbitrary will; to regulate by authority. "Fit to govern and rule multitudes." Shak. 2. To regulate; to influence; to direct; to restrain; to manage; as, to govern the life; to govern a horse. Govern well thy a.

repartee.definition:
A smart, ready, and witty reply. Cupid was as bad as he; Hear but the youngster's repartee. Prior. Syn. -- Retort; reply. See Retort.

To make smart and witty replies. Prior.

phasma.definition: An apparition; a phantom; an appearance. Hammond. Sir T. Herbert.

pumiced.definition: Affected with a kind of chronic laminitis in which there is a growth of soft spongy horn between the coffin bone and the hoof wall. The disease is called pumiced foot, or pumice foot.

caryatid.definition:
Of or pertaining to a caryatid.

(Arch.) A draped female figure supporting an entablature, in the place of a column or pilaster.

regicidal.definition: Pertaining to regicide, or to one committing it; having the nature of, or resembling, regicide. Bp. Warburton.

mulberry-faced.definition: Having a face of a mulberry color, or blotched as if with mulberry stains.

antediluvial.definition: Before the flood, or Deluge, in Noah's time.

putrilage.definition: That which is undergoing putrefaction; the products of putrefaction.

naumachy.definition: A naval battle; esp., a mock sea fight. 2. (Rom. Antiq.)  A show or spectacle representing a sea fight; also, a place for such exhibitions.

pleiades.definition: (Myth.)  The seven daughters of Atlas and the nymph Pleione, fabled to have been made by Jupiter a constellation in the sky. 2. (Astron.)  A group of small stars in the neck of the constellation Taurus. Job xxxviii. 31. Note: Alcyone, the brightest of these, a star of the third magnitude, was consid.

calymene.definition: A genus of trilobites characteristic of the Silurian age.

top-armor.definition: A top railing supported by stanchions and equipped with netting.

whirlicote.definition: An open car or chariot. Of old time coaches were not known in this island, but chariots, or whirlicotes. Stow.

unballasted.definition: Etym: [Properly p. p. unballast.]  Freed from ballast; having discharged ballast. 2. Etym: [Pref. un- not + ballasted.]  Not furnished with ballast; not kept steady by ballast; unsteady; as, unballasted vessels; unballasted wits. Unballasted by any sufficient weight of plan. De Quincey.

unlodge.definition: To dislodge; to deprive of lodgment. Carew.

irate.definition: Angry; incensed; enraged. [Recent] The irate colonel . . . stood speechless. Thackeray. Mr. Jaggers suddenly became most irate. Dickens.

adjudge.definition: To award judicially in the case of a controverted question; as, the prize was adjudged to the victor. 2. To determine in the exercise of judicial power; to decide or award judicially; to adjudicate; as, the case was adjudged in the November term. 3. To sentence; to condemn. Without reprieve, adjudge.

tibiotarsal.definition: (a) Of or pertaining to both to the tibia and the tarsus; as, the tibiotarsal articulation. (b) Of or pertaining to the tibiotarsus.

touch-needle.definition: A small bar of gold and silver, either pure, or alloyed in some known proportion with copper, for trying the purity of articles of gold or silver by comparison of the streaks made by the article and the bar on a touchstone.

tartrazine.definition: An artificial dyestuff obtained as an orange-yellow powder, and regarded as a phenyl hydrazine derivative of tartaric and sulphonic acids.

ovate-rotundate.definition: Having a form intermediate between that of an egg and a sphere; roundly ovate.

attune.definition: To tune or put in tune; to make melodious; to adjust, as one sound or musical instrument to another; as, to attune the voice to a harp. 2. To arrange fitly; to make accordant. Wake to energy each social aim, Attuned spontaneous to the will of Jove. Beattie.

sclerodermic.definition: (a) Having the integument, or skin, hard, or covered with hard plates. (b) Of or pertaining to the Sclerodermata.

gynandrous.definition: Having stamens inserted in the pistil; belonging to the class Gynandria.

tropologize.definition: To use in a tropological sense, as a word; to make a trope of. If . . . Minerva be tropologized into prudence. Cudworth.

metacromion.definition: A process projecting backward and downward from the acromion of the scapula of some mammals.

prematurity.definition: The quality or state of being premature; early, or untimely, ripeness; as, the prematurity of genius.

corroborative.definition:
Tending to strengthen of confirm.

A medicine that strengthens; a corroborant. Wiseman.

doctoral.definition: Of or relating to a doctor, or to the degree of doctor. Doctoral habit and square cap. Wood.

feuilltonist.definition: A writer of feuilletons. F. Harrison.

carbanil.definition: A mobile liquid, CO.N.C6H5, of pungent odor. It is the phenyl salt of isocyanic acid.

nephrite.definition: A hard compact mineral, of a dark green color, formerly worn as a remedy for diseases of the kidneys, whence its name; kidney stone; a kind of jade. See Jade.

religiosity.definition: The quality of being religious; religious feeling or sentiment; religiousness. M. Arnold.

unisonal.definition: Being in unison; unisonant. -- U*nis"o*nal*ly, adv.

nastiness.definition: The quality or state of being nasty; extreme filthness; dirtiness; also, indecency; obscenity. The nastiness of Plautus and Aristophanes. Dryden.

apostrophize.definition:
To address by apostrophe. 2. To contract by omitting a letter or letters; also, to mark with an apostrophe (') or apostrophes.

To use the rhetorical figure called apostrophe.

ominate.definition: To presage; to foreshow; to foretoken. Dr. H. More.

bonhommie.definition: good nature; pleasant and easy manner.

twitcher.definition: One who, or that which, twitches.

aceldama.definition: The potter's field, said to have lain south of Jerusalem, purchased with the bribe which Judas took for betraying his Master, and therefore called the field of blood. Fig.: A field of bloodshed. The system of warfare . . . which had already converted immense tracts into one universal aceldama. De Qu.

areca.definition: A genus of palms, one species of which produces the areca nut, or betel nut, which is chewed in India with the leaf of the Piper Betle and lime.

penal.definition: Of or pertaining to punishment, to penalties, or to crimes and offenses; pertaining to criminal jurisprudence: as: (a) Enacting or threatening punishment; as, a penal statue; the penal code. (b) Incurring punishment; subject to a penalty; as, a penalact of offense. (c) Inflicted as punishment; used.

devotion.definition: The act of devoting; consecration. 2. The state of being devoted; addiction; eager inclination; strong attachment love or affection; zeal; especially, feelings toward God appropriately expressed by acts of worship; devoutness. Genius animated by a fervent spirit of devotion. Macaulay. 3. Act of devo.

latinism.definition: A Latin idiom; a mode of speech peculiar to Latin; also, a mode of speech in another language, as English, formed on a Latin model. Note: The term is also sometimes used by Biblical scholars to designate a Latin word in Greek letters, or the Latin sense of a Greek word in the Greek Testament.

hypothecator.definition: One who hypothecates or pledges anything as security for the repayment of money borrowed.

post-captain.definition: A captain of a war vessel whose name appeared, or was "posted," in the seniority list of the British navy, as distinguished from a commander whose name was not so posted. The term was also used in the United States navy; but no such commission as post-captain was ever recognized in either service, a.

crocodility.definition: A caption or sophistical mode of arguing.

hot-blooded.definition: Having hot blood; excitable; high-spirited; irritable; ardent; passionate.

gremial.definition:
Of or pertaining to the lap or bosom.

1. A bosom friend. Fuller. 2. (Ecol.)  A cloth, often adorned with gold or silver lace, placed on the bishop's lap while he sits in celebrating mass, or in ordaining priests.

enterotomy.definition: Incision of the intestines, especially in reducing certain cases of hernia.

tinkling.definition: A tinkle, or succession of tinkles. Drowsy tinklings lull the distant folds. Gray. 2. (Zoöl.)  A grackle (Quiscalus crassirostris) native of Jamaica. It often associates with domestic cattle, and rids them of insects.

advoke.definition: To summon; to call. Queen Katharine had privately prevailed with the pope to advoke the cause to Rome. Fuller.

quindecemvir.definition: One of a sacerdotal college of fifteen men whose chief duty was to take care of the Sibylline books.

temptable.definition: Capable of being tempted; liable to be tempted. Cudworth.

nailery.definition: A manufactory where nails are made.

chalet.definition: A herdsman's hut in the mountains of Switzerland. Chalets are summer huts for the Swiss herdsmen. Wordsworth. 2. A summer cottage or country house in the Swiss mountains; any country house built in the style of the Swiss cottages.

telegram.definition: A message sent by telegraph; a telegraphic dispatch. Note: "A friend desires us to give notice that he will ask leave, at some convenient time, to introduce a new word into the vocabulary. It is telegram, instead of telegraphic dispatch, or telegraphic communication." Albany [N. Y.] Evening Journal.

provection.definition: A carrying forward, as of a final letter, to a following word; as, for example, a nickname for an ekename.

jube.definition: (a) chancel screen or rood screen. (b) gallery above such a screen, from which certain parts of the service were formerly read. See Rood loft, under Rood.

spareness.definition: The quality or state of being lean or thin; leanness.

hypermetropy.definition: A condition of the eye in which, through shortness of the eyeball or fault of the refractive media, the rays of light come to a focus behind the retina; farsightedness; -- called also hyperopia. Cf. Emmetropia. Note: In hypermetropia, vision for distant objects, although not better absolutely, is be.

inartificial.definition: Not artificial; not made or elaborated by art; natural; simple; artless; as, an inartificial argument; an inartificial character. -- In*ar`ti*fi"cial*ly, adv. -- In*ar`ti*fi"cial*ness, n.

cubo-octahedral.definition: Presenting a combination of a cube and an octahedron.

eyewitness.definition: One who sees a thing done; one who has ocular view anything. We . . . were eyewitnesses of his majesty. 2 Pet. i. 16.

eversive.definition: Tending to evert or overthrow; subversive; with of. A maxim eversive . . . of all justice and morality. Geddes.

indecimable.definition: Not decimable, or liable to be decimated; not liable to the payment of tithes. Cowell.

entrail.definition:
To interweave; to intertwine. Spenser.

Entanglement; fold. Spenser.

derivative.definition: Obtained by derivation; derived; not radical, original, or fundamental; originating, deduced, or formed from something else; secondary; as, a derivative conveyance; a derivative word. Derivative circulation, a modification of the circulation found in some parts of the body, in which the arteries emp.

caverned.definition: Containing caverns. The wolves yelled on the caverned hill. Byron. 2. Living in a cavern. "Caverned hermit." Pope.

magnetizee.definition: A person subjected to the influence of animal magnetism.

conformableness.definition: The quality of being conformable; conformability.

tellership.definition: The office or employment of a teller.

spattling-poppy.definition: A kind of catchfly (Silene inflata) which is sometimes frothy from the action of captured insects.

antepenultima.definition: The last syllable of a word except two, as -syl in monosyllable.

nuthatch.definition: Any one of several species of birds of the genus Sitta, as the European species (Sitta Europæa). The white-breasted nuthatch (S. Carolinensis), the red-breasted nuthatch (S. Canadensis), the pygmy nuthatch (S. pygmæa), and others, are American.

cherup.definition:
To make a short, shrill, cheerful sound; to chirp. See Chirrup. "Cheruping birds." Drayton.

To excite or urge on by making a short, shrill, cheerful sound; to cherup to. See Chirrup. He cherups brisk ear-erecting steed. Cowper.

A short, sharp, cheerful noise; a chirp; a chirrup; as, the cherup of.

duboisine.definition: An alkaloid obtained from the leaves of an Australian tree (Duboisia myoporoides), and regarded as identical with hyoscyamine. It produces dilation of the pupil of the eye.

reyse.definition:
To raise. Chaucer.

To go on a military expedition. Chaucer.

ryal.definition:
Royal. Chaucer.

See Rial, and old English coin.

caoutchouc.definition: A tenacious, elastic, gummy substance obtained from the milky sap of several plants of tropical South America (esp. the euphorbiaceous tree Siphonia elastica or Hevea caoutchouc), Asia, and Africa. Being impermeable to liquids and gases, and not readly affected by exposure to air, acids, and alkalie.

preapprehension.definition: An apprehension or opinion formed before examination or knowledge. Sir T. Browne.

motto.definition: (Her.)  A sentence, phrase, or word, forming part of an heraldic achievment. 2. A sentence, phrase, or word, prefixed to an essay, discourse, chapter, canto, or the like, suggestive of its subject matter; a short, suggestive expression of a guiding principle; a maxim. It was the motto of a bishop em.

grilse.definition: A young salmon after its first return from the sea.

planet-struck.definition: Affected by the influence of planets; blasted. Milton. Like planet-stricken men of yore He trembles, smitten to the core By strong compunction and remorse. Wordsworth.

manswear.definition: To swear falsely. Same as Mainswear.

ovate-oblong.definition: Oblong. with one end narrower than the other; ovato-oblong.

quebracho.definition: A Chilian apocynaceous tree (Aspidosperma Quebracho); also, its bark, which is used as a febrifuge, and for dyspnoea of the lung, or bronchial diseases; -- called also white quebracho, to distinguish it from the red quebracho, a Mexican anacardiaceous tree (Loxopterygium Lorentzii) whose bark is sai.

recidivation.definition: A falling back; a backsliding. Hammond.

pantheistic.definition: Of or pertaining to pantheism; founded in, or leading to, pantheism. -- Pan`the*is"tic*al*ly, adv.

vesicularia.definition: Any one of numerous species of marine Bryozoa belonging to Vesicularia and allied genera. They have delicate tubular cells attached in clusters to slender flexible stems.

fluor.definition: A fluid state. Sir I. Newton. 2. Menstrual flux; catamenia; menses. 3. (Min.)  See Fluorite.

harrage.definition: To harass; to plunder from. Fuller.

displace.definition: To change the place of; to remove from the usual or proper place; to put out of place; to place in another situation; as, the books in the library are all displaced. 2. To crowd out; to take the place of. Holland displaced Portugal as the mistress of those seas. London Times. 3. To remove from a sta.

schizont.definition: In certain Sporozoa, a cell formed by the growth of a sporozoite or merozoite (in a cell or corpuscle of the host) which segment by superficial cleavage, without encystment or conjugation, into  merozoites.

emissive.definition: Sending out; emitting; as, emissive powers.

tyran.definition: A tyrant. Lordly love is such a tyran fell. Spenser.

cacao.definition: A small evergreen tree (Theobroma Cacao) of South America and the West Indies. Its fruit contains an edible pulp, inclosing seeds about the size of an almond, from which cocoa, chocolate, and broma are prepared.

perambulator.definition: One who perambulates. 2. A surveyor's instrument for measuring distances. It consists of a wheel arranged to roll along over the ground, with an apparatus of clockwork, and a dial plate upon which the distance traveled is shown by an index. See Odometer. 3. A low carriage for a child, propelled by p.

hegelism.definition: The system of logic and philosophy set forth by Hegel, a German writer (1770-1831).

hygroscopicity.definition: The property possessed by vegetable tissues of absorbing or discharging moisture according to circumstances.

harmine.definition: An alkaloid accompanying harmaline (in the Peganum harmala), and obtained from it by oxidation. It is a white crystalline substance.

flyblow.definition:
To deposit eggs upon, as a flesh fly does on meat; to cause to be maggoty; hence, to taint or contaminate, as if with flyblows. Bp. Srillingfleet.

One of the eggs or young larvæ deposited by a flesh fly, or blowfly.

nutritious.definition: Nourishing; promoting growth, or preventing decay; alimental. -- Nu*tri"tious*ly, adv. -- Nu*tri"tious*ness, n.

nonjurorism.definition: The doctrines, or action, of the Nonjurors.

amnesty.definition:
Forgetfulness; cessation of remembrance of wrong; oblivion. 2. An act of the sovereign power granting oblivion, or a general pardon, for a past offense, as to subjects concerned in an insurrection.

To grant amnesty to.

azureous.definition: Of a fine blue color; azure.

cottontail.definition: The American wood rabbit (Lepus sylvaticus); -- also called Molly cottontail.

impendency.definition: The state of impending; also, that which impends. "Impendence of volcanic cloud." Ruskin.

perimetric.definition: Of or pertaining to the perimeter, or to perimetry; as, a perimetric chart of the eye.

bicapsular.definition: Having two capsules; as, a bicapsular pericarp.

gelding.definition:
A castrated animal; -- usually applied to a horse, but formerly used also of the human male. They went down both into the water, Philip and the gelding, and Philip baptized him. Wyclif (Acts viii. 38).

from Geld, v. t.

stibonium.definition: The hypothetical radical SbH4, analogous to ammonium; -- called also antimonium.

misgovernment.definition: Bad government; want of government. Shak.

prolificate.definition: To make prolific; to fertilize; to impregnate. Sir T. Browne.

conterminable.definition: Having the same bounds; terminating at the same time or place; conterminous. Love and life not conterminable. Sir H. Wotton.

bedpost.definition: One of the four standards that support a bedstead or the canopy over a bedstead. 2. Anciently, a post or pin on each side of the bed to keep the clothes from falling off. See Bedstaff. Brewer.

evocate.definition: To call out or forth; to summon; to evoke. Stackhouse.

septiferous.definition:
Bearing a partition; -- said of the valves of a capsule.

Conveying putrid poison; as, the virulence of septiferous matter.

accrete.definition:
To grow together. 2. To adhere; to grow (to); to be added; -- with to.

To make adhere; to add. Earle.

1. Characterized by accretion; made up; as, accrete matter. 2. (Bot.)  Grown together. Gray.

altarage.definition: The offerings made upon the altar, or to a church. 2. The profit which accrues to the priest, by reason of the altar, from the small tithes. Shipley.

astrometer.definition: An instrument for comparing the relative amount of the light of stars.

reformatory.definition:
Tending to produce reformation; reformative.

An institution for promoting the reformation of offenders. Magistrates may send juvenile offenders to reformatories instead of to prisons. Eng. Cyc.

waggish.definition: Like a wag; mischievous in sport; roguish in merriment or good humor; frolicsome. "A company of waggish boys." L'Estrange. 2. Done, made, or laid in waggery or for sport; sportive; humorous; as, a waggish trick. -- Wag"gish*ly, adv. -- Wag"gish*ness, n.

pomelo.definition: A variety of shaddock, called also grape fruit.

alleluiah.definition: An exclamation signifying Praise ye Jehovah. Hence: A song of praise to God. See Hallelujah, the commoner form. I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia. Rev. xix. 1.

ethnography.definition: That branch of knowledge which has for its subject the characteristics of the human family, developing the details with which ethnology as a comparative science deals; descriptive ethnology. See Ethnology.

rater.definition:
One who rates or estimates.

One who rates or scolds.

bacillus.definition: A variety of bacterium; a microscopic, rod-shaped vegetable organism.

turdiformes.definition: A division of singing birds including the thrushes and allied kinds.

odium.definition: Hatred; dislike; as, his conduct brought him into odium, or, brought odium upon him. 2. The quality that provokes hatred; offensiveness. She threw the odium of the fact on me. Dryden. Odium theologicum ( Etym: [L.], the enmity peculiar to contending theologians. Syn. -- Hatred; abhorrence; detestati.

diagonial.definition: Diagonal; diametrical; hence; diametrically opposed. Sin can have no tenure by law at all, but is rather an eternal outlaw, and in hostility with law past all atonement; both diagonal contraries, as much allowing one another as day and night together in one hemisphere. Milton.

implicate.definition: To infold; to fold together; to interweave. The meeting boughs and implicated leaves. Shelley. 2. To bring into connection with; to involve; to connect; -- applied to persons, in an unfavorable sense; as, the evidence implicates many in this conspiracy; to be implicated in a crime, a discreditable t.

brawner.definition: A boor killed for the table.

linguistics.definition: The science of languages, or of the origin, signification, and application of words; glossology.

wart.definition: (Med.)  A small, usually hard, tumor on the skin formed by enlargement of its vascular papillæ, and thickening of the epidermis which covers them. 2. An excrescence or protuberance more or less resembling a true wart; specifically (Bot.), a glandular excrescence or hardened protuberance on plants. F.

reasoner.definition: One who reasons or argues; as, a fair reasoner; a close reasoner; a logical reasoner.

upstay.definition: To sustain; to support. "His massy spear upstayed." Milton.

menispermine.definition: An alkaloid distinct from picrotoxin and obtained from the cocculus indicus (the fruit of Anamirta Cocculus, formerly Menispermum Cocculus) as a white, crystalline, tasteless powder; -- called also menispermina.

watteau.definition: Having the appearance of that which is seen in pictures by Antoine Watteau, a French painter of the eighteenth century; --said esp. of women's garments; as, a Watteau bodice.

hermogenian.definition: A disciple of Hermogenes, and heretical teacher who lived in Africa near the close of the second century. He ha.

selenitical.definition: Of or pertaining to selenite; resembling or containing selenite.

wire-pulling.definition: The act of pulling the wires, as of a puppet; hence, secret influence or management, especially in politics; intrigue.

quilting.definition: The act of stitching or running in patterns, as in making a quilt. 2. A quilting bee. See Bee, 2. 3. The material used for making quilts. 4. (Naut.)  A coating of strands of rope for a water vessel.

pirogue.definition: A dugout canoe; by extension, any small boat. [Written variously periauger, perogue, piragua, periagua, etc.].

astound.definition:
Stunned; astounded; astonished. [Archaic] Spenser. Thus Ellen, dizzy and astound. As sudden ruin yawned around. Sir W. Scott.

1. To stun; to stupefy. No puissant stroke his senses once astound. Fairfax. 2. To astonish; to strike with amazement; to confound with wonder, surprise, or fear. These thou.

hammerable.definition: Capable of being formed or shaped by a hammer. Sherwood.

intercitizenship.definition: The mutual right to civic privileges, in the different States. Bancroft.

phaeton.definition: A four-wheeled carriage (with or without a top), open, or having no side pieces, in front of the seat. It is drawn by one or two horses. 2. See Phaëthon. 3. (Zoöl.)  A handsome American butterfly (Euphydryas, or Melitæa, Phaëton). The upper side of the wings is black, with orange-red spots and margi.

plant-eating.definition: Eating, or subsisting on, plants; as, a plant-eating beetle.

classicalism.definition: A classical idiom, style, or expression; a classicism. 2. Adherence to what are supposed or assumed to be the classical canons of art.

tupaiid.definition: Any one of several species of East Indian and Asiatic insectivores of the family Tupaiidæ, somewhat resembling squirrels in size and arboreal habits. The nose is long and pointed.

livre.definition: A French money of account, afterward a silver coin equal to 20 sous. It is not now in use, having been superseded by the franc.

creaght.definition:
A drove or herd. Haliwell.

To graze. Sir. L. Davies.

cordwain.definition: A term used in the Middle Ages for Spanish leather (goatskin tanned and dressed), and hence, any leather handsomely finished, colored, gilded, or the like. Buskins he wore of costliest cordwain. Spenser.

empiricism.definition: The method or practice of an empiric; pursuit of knowledge by observation and experiment. 2. Specifically, a practice of medicine founded on mere experience, without the aid of science or a knowledge of principles; ignorant and unscientific practice; charlatanry; quackery. 3. (Metaph.)  The philosop.

skeel.definition: A shallow wooden vessel for holding milk or cream. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Grose.

outlier.definition: One who does not live where his office, or business, or estate, is. Bentley. 2. That which lies, or is, away from the main body. 3. (Geol.)  A part of a rock or stratum lying without, or beyond, the main body, from which it has been separated by denudation.

tirwit.definition: The lapwing. 'T IS 'T is.  A common contraction of it is.

biseye.definition: of Besee. Chaucer. Evil biseye, ill looking.

digenea.definition: A division of Trematoda in which alternate generations occur, the immediate young not resembling their parents.

top-dress.definition: To apply a surface dressing of manureto,as land.

half-tongue.definition: A jury, for the trial of a fore foreigner, composed equally of citizens and aliens.

insinuation.definition: The act or process of insinuating; a creeping, winding, or flowing in. By a soft insinuation mix'd With earth's large mass. Crashaw. 2. The act of gaining favor, affection, or influence, by gentle or artful means; -- formerly used in a good sense, as of friendly influence or interposition. Sir H. Wo.

coppery.definition: Mixed with copper; containing copper, or made of copper; like copper.

nutrient.definition: Nutritious; nourishing; promoting growth. -- n.  Any substance which has nutritious qualities, i. e., which nourishes or promotes growth.

fibreless.definition: Having no fibers; destitute of fibers or fiber.

improvisate.definition:
Unpremeditated; impromptu; extempore.

To improvise; to extemporize.

stercoranism.definition: The doctrine or belief of the Stercoranists.

sparpoil.definition: To scatter; to spread; to disperse.

superexaltation.definition: Elevation above the common degree. Holyday.

scleroskeleton.definition: That part of the skeleton which is developed in tendons, ligaments, and aponeuroses.

clutch.definition: A gripe or clinching with, or as with, the fingers or claws; seizure; grasp. "The clutch of poverty." Cowper. An expiring clutch at popularity. Carlyle. But Age, with his stealing steps, Hath clawed me in his clutch. Shak. 2. pl.  The hands, claws, or talons, in the act of grasping firmly; -- often.

mutoscope.definition: A simple form of moving-picture machine in which the series of views, exhibiting the successive phases of a scene, are printed on paper and mounted around the periphery of a wheel. The rotation of the wheel brings them rapidly into sight, one after another, and the blended effect gives a semblance o.

spirality.definition: The quality or states of being spiral.

patronate.definition: The right or duty of a patron; patronage. Westm. Rev.

circumfusile.definition: Capable of being poured or spread round. "Circumfusile gold." Pope.

zygosperm.definition: A spore formed by the union of the contents of two similar cells, either of the same or of distinct individual plants. Zygosperms are found in certain orders of algæ and fungi.

sanded.definition: Covered or sprinkled with sand; sandy; barren. Thomson. 2. Marked with small spots; variegated with spots; speckled; of a sandy color, as a hound. Shak. 3. Short-sighted.

scalar.definition: In the quaternion analysis, a quantity that has magnitude, but not direction; -- distinguished from a vector, which has both magnitude and direction.

elaterium.definition: A cathartic substance obtained, in the form of yellowish or greenish cakes, as the dried residue of the juice of the wild or squirting cucumber (Ecballium agreste, formerly called Momordica Elaterium).

objectify.definition: To cause to become an object; to cause to assume the character of an object; to render objective. J. D. Morell.

languet.definition: Anything resembling the tongue in form or office; specif., the slip of metal in an organ pipe which turns the current of air toward its mouth. 2. That part of the hilt, in certain kinds of swords, which overlaps the scabbard.

omnipresence.definition: Presence in every place at the same time; unbounded or universal presence; ubiquity. His omnipresence fills Land, sea, and air, and every kind that lives. Milton.

globose.definition: Having a rounded form resembling that of a globe; globular, or nearly so; spherical. Milton.

orthoclastic.definition: Breaking in directions at right angles to each other; -- said of the monoclinic feldspars.

calcite.definition: Calcium carbonate, or carbonate of lime. It is rhombohedral in its crystallization, and thus distinguished from aragonite. It includes common limestone, chalk, and marble. Called also calc-spar and calcareous spar. Note: Argentine is a pearly lamellar variety; aphrite is foliated or chalklike; dogto.

amidogen.definition: A compound radical, NH2, not yet obtained in a separate state, which may be regarded as ammonia from the molecule of which one of its hydrogen atoms has been removed; -- called also the amido group, and in composition represented by the form amido.

crepitus.definition: (a) The noise produced bu a sudden discharge of wind from the bowels. (b) Same as Crepitation, 2.

nicene.definition: Of or pertaining to Nice, a town of Asia Minor, or to the ecumenial council held there A. D. 325. Nicene Creed (, a summary of Christian faith, composed and adopted by the Council of Nice, against Arianism, A. D. 325, altered and confirmed by the Council of Constantinople, A. D. 381, and by subseque.

cubebic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, cubebs; as, cubebic acid (a soft olive-green resin extracted from cubebs).

unicursal.definition: That can be passed over in a single course; -- said of a curve when the coördinates of the point on the curve can be expressed as rational algebraic functions of a single parameter th. Note: As th varies minus infinity to plus infinity, to each value of th there corresponds one, and only one, point.

morion.definition:
A kind of open helmet, without visor or beaver, and somewhat resembling a hat. A battered morion on his brow. Sir W. Scott.

A dark variety of smoky quartz.

pyritaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to pyrites. See Pyritic.

vicine.definition:
Near; neighboring; vicinal. Glanvill.

An alkaloid ex tracted from the seeds of the vetch (Vicia sativa) as a white crystalline substance.

glucinic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or containing, glucinum; as, glucinic oxide.

cicatrizant.definition: A medicine or application that promotes the healing of a sore or wound, or the formation of a cicatrix.

acreage.definition: Acres collectively; as, the acreage of a farm or a country.

radish.definition: The pungent fleshy root of a well-known cruciferous plant (Paphanus sativus); also, the whole plant. Radish fly (Zoöl.), a small two-winged fly (Anthomyia raphani) whose larvæ burrow in radishes. It resembles the onion fly. -- Rat-tailed radish (Bot.), an herb (Raphanus caudatus) having a long, slen.

amoebiform.definition: Resembling an amoeba; amoeba-shaped; changing in shape like an amoeba. Amoeboid movement, movement produced, as in the amoeba, by successive processes of prolongation and retraction.

ciborium.definition: (Arch.)  A canopy usually standing free and supported on four columns, covering the high altar, or, very rarely, a secondary altar. 2. (R. C. Ch.)  The coffer or case in which the host is kept; the pyx.

pleonast.definition: One who is addicted to pleonasm. C. Reade.

burrock.definition: A small weir or dam in a river to direct the stream to gaps where fish traps are placed. Knight.

inoppressive.definition: Not oppressive or burdensome. O. Wolcott.

nurseryman.definition: One who cultivates or keeps a nursery, or place for rearing trees, etc.

solanaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to plants of the natural order Solanaceæ, of which the nightshade (Solanum) is the type. The order includes also the tobacco, ground cherry, tomato, eggplant, red pepper, and many more.

indelicate.definition: Not delicate; wanting delicacy; offensive to good manners, or to purity of mind; coarse; rude; as, an indelicate word or suggestion; indelicate behavior. Macaulay. -- In*del"i*cate*ly, adv. Syn. -- Indecorous; unbecoming; unseemly; rude; coarse; broad; impolite; gross; indecent; offensive; improper;.

maharajah.definition: A sovereign prince in India; -- a title given also to other persons of high rank.

witticism.definition: A witty saying; a sentence or phrase which is affectedly witty; an attempt at wit; a conceit. Milton. He is full of conceptions, points of epigram, and witticisms; all which are below the dignity of heroic verse. Addison.

blet.definition: A form of decay in fruit which is overripe.

impregnate.definition: To make pregnant; to cause to conceive; to render prolific; to get with child or young. 2. (Biol.)  To come into contact with (an ovum or egg) so as to cause impregnation; to fertilize; to fecundate. 3. To infuse an active principle into; to render frutful or fertile in any way; to fertilize; to imb.

timelessly.definition: In a timeless manner; unseasonably. Milton.

turlupin.definition: One of the precursors of the Reformation; -- a nickname corresponding to Lollard, etc.

anorthite.definition: A mineral of the feldspar family, commonly occurring in small glassy crystals, also a constituent of some igneous rocks. It is a lime feldspar. See Feldspar.

magnifical.definition: Grand; splendid; illustrious; magnificent. 1 Chron. xxii. 5. "Thy magnific deeds." Milton. -- Mag*nif"ic*al*ly, adv.

pseudocoelia.definition: The fifth ventricle in the mammalian brain. See Ventricle. B. G. Wilder.

bepaint.definition: To paint; to cover or color with, or as with, paint. Else would a maiden blush bepaint my cheek. Shak.

zorilla.definition: Either one of two species of small African carnivores of the genus Ictonyx allied to the weasels and skunks. [Written also zoril, and zorille.] Note: The best-known species (Ictonyx zorilla) has black shiny fur with white bands and spots. It has anal glands which produce a very offensive secretion,.

horripilation.definition: A real or fancied bristling of the hair of the head or body, resulting from disease, terror, chilliness, etc.

chignon.definition: A knot, boss, or mass of hair, natural or artificial, worn by a woman at the back of the head. A curl that had strayed from her chignon. H. James.

cannot.definition: Am, is, or are, not able; -- written either as one word or two.

citrus.definition: A genus of trees including the orange, lemon, citron, etc., originally natives of southern Asia.

porphyrite.definition: A rock with a porphyritic structure; as, augite porphyrite.

unsorted.definition: Not sorted; not classified; as, a lot of unsorted goods. 2. Not well selected; ill-chosen. The purpose you undertake is dangerous; the friends you named uncertain; the time itself unsorted. Shak.

encollar.definition: To furnish or surround with a collar.

stratography.definition: A description of an army, or of what belongs to an army.

zoetrope.definition: An optical toy, in which figures made to revolve on the inside of a cylinder, and viewed through slits in its circumference, appear like a single figure passing through a series of natural motions as if animated or mechanically moved.

nix.definition: One of a class of water spirits, commonly described as of a mischievous disposition. The treacherous nixes who entice men to a watery death. Tylor.

reclination.definition: The act of leaning or reclining, or the state of being reclined. 2. (Dialing)  The angle which the plane of the dial makes with a vertical plane which it intersects in a horizontal line. Brande & C. 3. (Surg.)  The act or process of removing a cataract, by applying the needle to its anterior surface.

albertite.definition: A bituminous mineral resembling asphaltum, found in the county of A.

discongruity.definition: Incongruity; disagreement; unsuitableness. Sir M. Hale.

almadie.definition: (a) A bark canoe used by the Africans. (b) A boat used at Calicut, in India, about eighty feet long, and six or seven broad.

retinol.definition: A hydrocarbon oil obtained by the distillation of resin, -- used in printer's ink.

lovelock.definition: A long lock of hair hanging prominently by itself; an earlock; -- worn by men of fashion in the reigns of Elizabeth and James I. Burton. A long lovelock and long hair he wore. Sir W. Scott.

angulation.definition: A making angular; angular formation. Huxley.

meteorous.definition: Of the nature or appearance of a meteor.

huffy.definition: Puffed up; as, huffy bread. 2. Characterized by arrogance or petulance; easily offended.

winkingly.definition: In a winking manner; with the eye almost closed. Peacham.

axinomancy.definition: A species of divination, by means of an ax or hatchet.

besmut.definition: To blacken with smut; to foul with soot.

oophytic.definition: Of or pertaining to an oöphyte.

sight-seeing.definition:
Engaged in, or given to, seeing sights; eager for novelties or curiosities.

The act of seeing sights; eagerness for novelties or curiosities.

sabine.definition:
Of or pertaining to the ancient Sabines, a people of Italy. -- n.  One of the Sabine people.

See Savin.

transmeable.definition: Capable of being passed over or traversed; passable.

codlin.definition: (a) An apple fit to stew or coddle. (b) An immature apple. A codling when 't is almost an apple. Shak. Codling moth (Zoöl.), a small moth (Carpocapsa Pomonella), which in the larval state (known as the apple worm) lives in apples, often doing great damage to the crop.

compasses.definition: An instrument for describing circles, measuring figures, etc., consisting of two, or (rarely) more, pointed branches, or legs, usually joined at the top by a rivet on which they move. Note: The compasses for drawing circles have adjustable pen points, pencil points, etc.; those used for measuring wi.

prolongable.definition: Capable of being prolonged; as, life is prolongable by care. Each syllable being a prolongable quantity. Rush.

uniparous.definition: (Zoöl.)  Producing but one egg or young at a time. 2. (Bot.)  Producing but one axis of inflorescence; -- said of the scorpioid cyme.

junto.definition: A secret council to deliberate on affairs of government or politics; a number of men combined for party intrigue; a faction; a cabal; as, a junto of ministers; a junto of politicians. The puzzling sons of party next appeared, In dark cabals and mighty juntos met. Thomson.

raddle.definition: A long, flexible stick, rod, or branch, which is interwoven with others, between upright posts or stakes, in making a kind of hedge or fence. 2. A hedge or fence made with raddles; -- called also raddle hedge. Todd. 3. An instrument consisting of a woodmen bar, with a row of upright pegs set in it,.

unsatiable.definition: Insatiable. Hooker. -- Un*sa"ti*a*ble*ness, n. -- Un*sa"ti*a*bly, adv.

blunging.definition: The process of mixing clay in potteries with a blunger. Tomlinson.

indin.definition: A dark red crystalline substance, isomeric with and resembling indigo blue, and obtained from isatide and dioxindol.

enwoman.definition: To endow with the qualities of a woman. Daniel.

raking.definition: The act or process of using a rake; the going over a space with a rake. 2. A space gone over with a rake; also, the work done, or the quantity of hay, grain, etc., collected, by going once over a space with a rake.

simplistic.definition: Of or pertaining to simples, or a simplist. Wilkinson.

immaterial.definition: Not consisting of matter; incorporeal; spiritual; disembodied. Angels are spirits immaterial and intellectual. Hooker. 2. Of no substantial consequence; without weight or significance; unimportant; as, it is wholly immaterial whether he does so or not. Syn. -- Unimportant; inconsequential; insignifi.

eucalyn.definition: An unfermentable sugar, obtained as an uncrystallizable sirup by the decomposition of melitose; also obtained from a Tasmanian eucalyptus, -- whence its name.

emulatively.definition: In an emulative manner; with emulation.

imputable.definition: That may be imputed; capable of being imputed; chargeable; ascribable; attributable; referable. A prince whose political vices, at least, were imputable to mental incapacity. Prescott. 2. Accusable; culpable. The fault lies at his door, and she is no wise imputable. Ayliffe.

uncleship.definition: The office or position of an uncle. Lamb.

verbatim.definition: Word for word; in the same words; verbally; as, to tell a story verbatim as another has related it. Verbatim et literatim Etym: [LL.], word for word, and letter for letter.

lagnappe.definition: In Louisiana, a trifling present given to customers by tradesmen; a gratuity. Lagniappe . . .is something thrown in, gratis, for good measure. Mark Twain.

good-bye.definition: Farewell; a form of address used at parting. See the last Note under By, prep. Shak.

bossism.definition: The rule or practices of bosses, esp. political bosses. [Slang, U. S.].

correctional.definition: Tending to, or intended for, correction; used for correction; as, a correctional institution.

mash.definition:
A mesh.

1. A mass of mixed ingredients reduced to a soft pulpy state by beating or pressure; a mass of anything in a soft pulpy state. Specifically (Brewing), ground or bruised malt, or meal of rye, wheat, corn, or other grain (or a mixture of malt and meal) steeped and stirred in hot water for mak.

pemmican.definition: Among the North American Indians, meat cut in thin slices, divested of fat, and dried in the sun. Then on pemican they feasted. Longfellow. 2. Meat, without the fat, cut in thin slices, dried in the sun, pounded, then mixed with melted fat and sometimes dried fruit, and compressed into cakes or in b.

brewery.definition: A brewhouse; the building and apparatus where brewing is carried on.

reliquidation.definition: A second or renewed liquidation; a renewed adjustment. A. Hamilton.

foxery.definition: Behavior like that of a fox; Chaucer.

tactic.definition:
Of or pertaining to the art of military and naval tactics. -- Tac"tic*al*ly, adv.

See Tactics.

thunderstorm.definition: A storm accompanied with lightning and thunder.

curvature.definition: The act of curving, or the state of being bent or curved; a curving or bending, normal or abnormal, as of a line or surface from a rectilinear direction; a bend; a curve. Cowper. The elegant curvature of their fronds. Darwin. 2. (Math.)  The amount of degree of bending of a mathematical curve, or th.

mandible.definition: (Anat.)  The bone, or principal bone, of the lower jaw; the inferior maxilla; -- also applied to either the upper or the lower jaw in the beak of birds. 2. (Zoöl.)  The anterior pair of mouth organs of insects, crustaceaus, and related animals, whether adapted for biting or not. See Illust. of Dipte.

mown.definition: Cut down by mowing, as grass; deprived of grass by mowing; as, a mown field.

self-indulgence.definition: Indulgence of one's appetites, desires, or inclinations; -- the opposite of self-restraint, and self-denial.

frizette.definition:
a fringe of hair or curls worn about the forehead by women.

A curl of hair or silk; a pad of frizzed hair or silk worn by women under the hair to stuff it out.

acceptableness.definition: The quality of being acceptable, or suitable to be favorably received; acceptability.

assertion.definition: The act of asserting, or that which is asserted; positive declaration or averment; affirmation; statement asserted; position advanced. There is a difference between assertion and demonstration. Macaulay. 2. Maintenance; vindication; as, the assertion of one's rights or prerogatives.

triangular.definition: Having three angles; having the form of a triangle. 2. (Bot.)  Oblong or elongated, and having three lateral angles; as, a triangular seed, leaf, or stem. Triangular compasses, compasses with three legs for taking off the angular points of a triangle, or any three points at the same time. -- Triangu.

apical.definition: At or belonging to an apex, tip, or summit. Gray.

gimp.definition:
Smart; spruce; trim; nice. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.]

A narrow ornamental fabric of silk, woolen, or cotton, often with a metallic wire, or sometimes a coarse cord, running through it; -- used as trimming for dresses, furniture, etc. Gimp nail, an upholsterer's small nail.

To notch; to indent; to jag.

bucket.definition: A vessel for drawing up water from a well, or for catching, holding, or carrying water, sap, or other liquids. The old oaken bucket, the iron-bound bucket, The moss-covered bucket, which hung in the well. Wordsworth. 2. A vessel (as a tub or scoop) for hoisting and conveying coal, ore, grain, etc. 3.

crowkeeper.definition: A person employed to scare off crows; hence, a scarecrow. Scaring the ladies like a crowkeeper. Shak.

saucy.definition: Showing impertinent boldness or pertness; transgressing the rules of decorum; treating superiors with contempt; impudent; insolent; as, a saucy fellow. Am I not protector, saucy priest Shak. 2. Expressive of, or characterized by, impudence; impertinent; as, a saucy eye; saucy looks. We then have don.

unwist.definition: Not known; unknown. Chaucer. Spenser. 2. Not knowing; unwitting. Wyclif.

anaglyph.definition: Any sculptured, chased, or embossed ornament worked in low relief, as a cameo.

rainy.definition: Abounding with rain; wet; showery; as, rainy day or season.

diffusion.definition: The act of diffusing, or the state of being diffused; a spreading; extension; dissemination; circulation; dispersion. A diffusion of knowledge which has undermined superstition. Burke. 2. (Physiol.)  The act of passing by osmosis through animal membranes, as in the distribution of poisons, gases, et.

tontine.definition: An annuity, with the benefit of survivorship, or a loan raised on life annuities with the benefit of survivorship. Thus, an annuity is shared among a number, on the principle that the share of each, at his death, is enjoyed by the survivors, until at last the whole goes to the last survivor, or to t.

abhorrence.definition: Extreme hatred or detestation; the feeling of utter dislike.

unkind.definition:
Having no race or kindred; childless. [Obs. & R.] Shak.

1. Not kind; contrary to nature, or the law of kind or kindred; unnatural. "Such unkind abominations." Chaucer. 2. Wanting in kindness, sympathy, benevolence, gratitude, or the like; cruel; harsh; unjust; ungrateful. He is unkind that recompen.

tympanize.definition:
To drum. Coles.

To stretch, as a skin over the head of a drum; to make into a drum or drumhead, or cause to act or sound like a drum. "Tympanized, as other saints of God were." Oley.

corncrake.definition: A bird (Crex crex or C. pratensis) which frequents grain fields; the European crake or land rail; -- called also corn bird.

topek.definition: An ESkimo house made of material other than snow, esp. one having walls of turf, driftwood, rock, or skin, and a roof of skins of the walrus or seal. In Alaska it is often partially underground and covered with timber and turf. Topeks are also used by Indians of the lower Yukon region.

wintergreen.definition: A plant which keeps its leaves green through the winter. Note: In England, the name wintergreen is applied to the species of Pyrola which in America are called English wintergreen, and shin leaf (see Shin leaf, under Shin.) In America, the name wintergreen is given to Gaultheria procumbens, a low ev.

dissimilar.definition: Not similar; unlike; heterogeneous; as, the tempers of men are as dissimilar as their features. This part very dissimilar to any other. Boyle.

paspy.definition: A kind of minuet, in triple time, of French origin, popular in the reign of Queen Elizabeth and for some time after; -- called also passing measure, and passymeasure. Percy Smith.

quas.definition: A kind of beer. Same as Quass.

sharock.definition: An East Indian coin of the value of 12.

defeasance.definition: A defeat; an overthrow. After his foes' defeasance. Spenser. 2. A rendering null or void. 3. (Law)  A condition, relating to a deed, which being performed, the deed is defeated or rendered void; or a collateral deed, made at the same time with a feoffment, or other conveyance, containing conditions,.

ricochet.definition: A rebound or skipping, as of a ball along the ground when a gun is fired at a low angle of elevation, or of a fiat stone thrown along the surface of water. Ricochet firing (Mil.), the firing of guns or howitzers, usually with small charges, at an elevation of only a few degrees, so as to cause the b.

armisonant.definition: Rustling in arms; resounding with arms.

decalitre.definition: A measure of capacity in the metric system; a cubic volume of ten liters, equal to about 610.24 cubic inches, that is, 2.642 wine gallons.

regenerator.definition: One who, or that which, regenerates. 2. (Mech.)  A device used in connection with hot-air engines, gas-burning furnaces, etc., in which the incoming air or gas is heated by being brought into contact with masses of iron, brick, etc., which have been previously heated by the outgoing, or escaping, ho.

legerdemainist.definition: One who practices sleight of hand; a prestidigitator.

sapient.definition: Wise; sage; discerning; -- often in irony or contempt. Where the sapient king Held dalliance with his fair Egyptian spouse. Milton. Syn. -- Sage; sagacious; knowing; wise; discerning.

perpetration.definition: The act of perpetrating; a doing; -- commonly used of doing something wrong, as a crime. 2. The thing perpetrated; an evil action.

chalybeous.definition: Steel blue; of the color of tempered steel.

hamal.definition: In Turkey and other Oriental countries, a porter or burden bearer; specif., in Western India, a palanquin bearer.

inactivity.definition: The state or quality of being inactive; inertness; as, the inactivity of matter. 2. Idleness; habitual indisposition to action or exertion; want of energy; sluggishness. The gloomy inactivity of despair. Cook.

reseizure.definition: A second seizure; the act of seizing again. Bacon.

cobishop.definition: A joint or coadjutant bishop. Ayliffe.

chorometry.definition: The art of surveying a region or district.

statuette.definition: A small statue; -- usually applied to a figure much less than life size, especially when of marble or bronze, or of plaster or clay as a preparation for the marble or bronze, as distinguished from a figure in terra cotta or the like. Cf. Figurine.

modest.definition: Restraining within due limits of propriety; not forward, bold, boastful, or presumptious; rather retiring than pushing one's self forward; not obstructive; as, a modest youth; a modest man. 2. Observing the proprieties of the sex; not unwomanly in act or bearing; free from undue familiarity, indecen.

dentate-sinuate.definition: Having a form intermediate between dentate and sinuate.

alchemist.definition: One who practices alchemy. You are alchemist; make gold. Shak.

swingletail.definition: The thrasher, or fox shark. See Thrasher.

disfellowship.definition: To exclude from fellowship; to refuse intercourse with, as an associate. An attempt to disfellowship an evil, but to fellowship the evildoer. Freewill Bapt. Quart.

dephlegmedness.definition: A state of being freed from water. Boyle.

overshoot.definition:
To shoot over or beyond. "Not to overshoot his game." South. 2. To pass swiftly over; to fly beyond. Hartle. 3. To exceed; as, to overshoot the truth. Cowper. To overshoot one's self, to venture too far; to assert too much.

To fly beyond the mark. Collier.

turnhalle.definition: A building used as a school of gymnastics.

assail.definition: To attack with violence, or in a vehement and hostile manner; to assault; to molest; as, to assail a man with blows; to assail a city with artillery. No rude noise mine ears assailing. Cowper. No storm can now assail The charm he wears within. Keble. 2. To encounter or meet purposely with the view o.

epanody.definition: The abnormal change of an irregular flower to a regular form; - - considered by evolutionists to be a reversion to an ancestral condition.

hard-mouthed.definition: Not sensible to the bit; not easily governed; as, a hard- mouthed horse.

bedagat.definition: The sacred books of the Buddhists in Burmah. Malcom.

elvanite.definition: The rock of an elvan vein, or the elvan vein itself; an elvan course.

hysterogenic.definition: Producing hysteria; as, the hysterogenicpressure points on the surface of the body, pressure upon which is said both to produce and arrest an attack of hysteria. De Watteville.

gormandize.definition: To eat greedily; to swallow voraciously; to feed ravenously or like a glutton. Shak.

fillip.definition:
To strike with the nail of the finger, first placed against the ball of the thumb, and forced from that position with a sudden spring; to snap with the finger. "You filip me o' the head." Shak. 2. To snap; to project quickly. The use of the elastic switch to fillip small missiles with. Tylor.

1. A.

curship.definition: The state of being a cur; one who is currish. [Jocose] How durst he, I say, oppose thy curship! Hudibras.

girdler.definition: One who girdles. 2. A maker of girdles. 3. (Zoöl.)  An American longicorn beetle (Oncideres cingulatus) which lays its eggs in the twigs of the hickory, and then girdles each branch by gnawing a groove around it, thus killing it to provide suitable food for the larvæ.

disarm.definition: To deprive of arms; to take away the weapons of; to deprive of the means of attack or defense; to render defenseless. Security disarms the best-appointed army. Fuller. The proud was half disarmed of pride. Tennyson. 2. To deprive of the means or the disposition to harm; to render harmless or innocuo.

limicoline.definition: Shore-inhabiting; of or pertaining to the Limicolæ.

choral.definition:
Of or pertaining to a choir or chorus; singing, sung, or adapted to be sung, in chorus or harmony. Choral service, a service of song.

A hymn tune; a simple sacred tune, sung in unison by the congregation; as, the Lutheran chorals. [Sometimes written chorale.].

dispositively.definition: In a dispositive manner; by natural or moral disposition. Sir T. Browne. Do dispositively what Moses is recorded to have done literally, . . . break all the ten commandments at once. Boyle.

croker.definition: A cultivator of saffron; a dealer in saffron. Holinshed.

skinner.definition: One who skins. 2. One who deals in skins, pelts, or hides.

compulsion.definition: The act of compelling, or the state of being compelled; the act of driving or urging by force or by physical or moral constraint; subjection to force. If reasons were as plentiful as blackberries, I would give no man a reason upon compulsion. Shak. With what complusion and laborious flight We sunk t.

seiches.definition: Local oscillations in level observed in the case of some lakes, as Lake Geneva.

faithed.definition: Having faith or a faith; honest; sincere. "Make thy words faithed." Shak.

circler.definition: A mean or inferior poet, perhaps from his habit of wandering around as a stroller; an itinerant poet. Also, a name given to the cyclic poets. See under Cyclic, a. B. Jonson.

corallite.definition: (Min.)  A mineral substance or petrifaction, in the form of coral. 2. (Zoöl.)  One of the individual members of a compound coral; or that part formed by a single coral animal. [Written also corallet.].

meconium.definition: (a) Opium. (b) The contents of the fetal intestine; hence, first excrement.

affirmation.definition: Confirmation of anything established; ratification; as, the affirmation of a law. Hooker. 2. The act of affirming or asserting as true; assertion; -- opposed to negation or denial. 3. That which is asserted; an assertion; a positive as, an affirmation, by the vender, of title to property sold, or of.

sucre.definition: A silver coin of Ecuador, worth 68 cents.

mistaker.definition: One who mistakes. Well meaning ignorance of some mistakers. Bp. Hall.

centesimal.definition: Hundredth. -- n.  A hundredth part. The neglect of a few centesimals. Arbuthnot.

originalness.definition: The quality of being original; originality. Johnson.

stablish.definition: To settle permanently in a state; to make firm; to establish; to fix. 2 Sam. vii. 13.

contradistinctive.definition: having the quality of contradistinction; distinguishing by contrast. -- Con`tra*dis*tinc"tive, n.

fumage.definition: Hearth money. Fumage, or fuage, vulgarly called smoke farthings. Blackstone.

physique.definition: The natural constitution, or physical structure, of a person. With his white hair and splendid physique. Mrs. Stowe.

quirinal.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, the hill Collis Quirinalis, now Monte Quirinale (one of the seven hills of Rome), or a modern royal place situated upon it. Also used substantively.

genethlialogy.definition: Divination as to the destinies of one newly born; the act or art of casting nativities; astrology.

bray.definition:
To pound, beat, rub, or grind small or fine. Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar, . . . yet will not his foolishness depart from him. Prov. xxvii. 22.

1. To utter a loud, harsh cry, as an ass. Laugh, and they Return it louder than an ass can bray. Dryden. 2. To make a harsh, grating, or d.

rammel.definition: Refuse matter. Filled with any rubbish, rammel and broken stones. Holland.

vigoroso.definition: Vigorous; energetic; with energy; -- a direction to perform a passage with energy and force.

curvicaudate.definition: Having a curved or crooked tail.

diphyozooid.definition: One of the free-swimming sexual zooids of Siphonophora.

buccinoid.definition: Resembling the genus Buccinum, or pertaining to the Buccinidæ, a family of marine univalve shells. See Whelk, and Prosobranchiata.

chiliast.definition: One who believes in the second coming of Christ to reign on earth a thousand years; a milllenarian.

jacobin.definition: (Eccl. Hist.)  A Dominican friar; -- so named because, before the French Revolution, that order had a convent in the Rue St. Jacques, Paris. 2. One of a society of violent agitators in France, during the revolution of 1789, who held secret meetings in the Jacobin convent in the Rue St. Jacques, Pari.

clincher.definition: One who, or that which, clinches; that which holds fast. Pope. 2. That which ends a dispute or controversy; a decisive argument.

kshatruya.definition: The military caste, the second of the four great Hindoo castes; also, a member of that caste. See Caste. [India].

misapprehension.definition: A mistaking or mistake; wrong apprehension of one's meaning of a fact; misconception; misunderstanding.

rotal.definition: Relating to wheels or to rotary motion; rotary.

constrict.definition: To draw together; to render narrower or smaller; to bind; to cramp; to contract or ause to shrink. Such things as constrict the fibers. Arbuthnot. Membranous organs inclosing a cavity which their contraction constrict. Todd & Bowman.

falanaka.definition: A viverrine mammal of Madagascar (Eupleres Goudotii), allied to the civet; -- called also Falanouc.

symphyseotomy.definition: The operation of dividing the symphysis pubis for the purpose of facilitating labor; -- formerly called the Sigualtian section. [Written also symphysotomy.] Dunglison.

abash.definition: To destroy the self-possession of; to confuse or confound, as by exciting suddenly a consciousness of guilt, mistake, or inferiority; to put to shame; to disconcert; to discomfit. Abashed, the devil stood, And felt how awful goodness is. Milton. He was a man whom no check could abash. Macaulay. Syn.

chebacco.definition: A narrow-sterned boat formerly much used in the Newfoundland fisheries; -- called also pinkstern and chebec. Bartlett.

kamichi.definition: A curious South American bird (Anhima, or Palamedea, cornuta), often domesticated by the natives and kept with poultry, which it defends against birds of prey. It has a long, slender, hornlike ornament on its head, and two sharp spurs on each wing. Although its beak, feet, and legs resemble those of.

abelian.definition: One of a sect in Africa (4th century), mentioned by St. Augustine, who states that they married, but lived in continence, after the manner, as they pretended, of Abel.

artfulness.definition: The quality of being artful; art; cunning; craft.

fright.definition:
A state of terror excited by the sudden appearance of danger; sudden and violent fear, usually of short duration; a sudden alarm. 2. Anything strange, ugly or shocking, producing a feeling of alarm or aversion. Syn. -- Alarm; terror; consternation. See Alarm.

To alarm suddenly; to shock by causing.

inflatus.definition: A blowing or breathing into; inflation; inspiration. The divine breath that blows the nostrils out To ineffable inflatus. Mrs. Browning.

rescind.definition: To cut off; to abrogate; to annul. The blessed Jesus . . . did sacramentally rescind the impure relics of Adam and the contraction of evil customs. Jer. Taylor. 2. Specifically, to vacate or make void, as an act, by the enacting authority or by superior authority; to repeal; as, to rescind a law, a.

allumette.definition: A match for lighting candles, lamps, etc.

multifariously.definition: With great multiplicity and diversity; with variety of modes and relations.

saltpetre.definition: Potassium nitrate; niter, a white crystalline substance, KNO3, having a cooling saline taste, obtained by leaching from certain soils in which it is produced by the process of nitrification (see Nitrification, 2). It is a strong oxidizer, is the chief constituent of gunpowder, and is also used as an.

puritanic.definition: Of or pertaining to the Puritans, or to their doctrines and practice. 2. Precise in observance of legal or religious requirements; strict; overscrupulous; rigid; -- often used by way of reproach or contempt. Paritanical circles, from which plays and novels were strictly excluded. Macaulay. He had al.

raphaelesque.definition: Like Raphael's works; in Raphael's manner of painting.

esloin.definition: To remove; to banish; to withdraw; to avoid; to eloign. From worldly cares he did himself esloin. Spenser.

illation.definition: The act or process of inferring from premises or reasons; perception of the connection between ideas; that which is inferred; inference; deduction; conclusion. Fraudulent deductions or inconsequent illations from a false conception of things. Sir T. Browne.

primer.definition:
One who, or that which, primes; specifically, an instrument or device for priming; esp., a cap, tube, or water containing percussion powder or other capable for igniting a charge of gunpowder.

First; original; primary. "The primer English kings." Drayton. Primer fine (O. Eng. Law), a fine due to th.

mucksy.definition: Somewhat mucky; soft, sticky, and dirty; muxy. R. D. Blackmore.

rosaceous.definition: (Bot.) (a) Of or pertaining to a natural order of plants (Rosaceæ) of which the rose is the type. It includes also the plums and cherries, meadowsweet, brambles, the strawberry, the hawthorn, applies, pears, service tress, and quinces.
