(b) Like a rose in shape or appearance; as, a rosaceous corolla.

inalienableness.definition: The quality or state of being inalienable; inalienability.

gastroscope.definition: An instrument for viewing or examining the interior of the stomach.

stratigraphic.definition:
Pertaining to, or depended upon, the order or arrangement of strata; as, stratigraphical evidence. -- Strat`i*graph"ic*al*ly, adv.

See Stratographic.

counterrolment.definition: A counter account. See Control. Bacon.

argil.definition: Clay, or potter's earth; sometimes pure clay, or alumina. See Clay.

oxyquinoline.definition: Hydroxy quinoline; a phenol derivative of quinoline, -- called also carbostyril.

galipot.definition: An impure resin of turpentine, hardened on the outside of pine trees by the spontaneous evaporation of its essential oil. When purified, it is called yellow pitch, white pitch, or Burgundy pitch.

petaline.definition: Pertaining to a petal; attached to, or resembling, a petal.

scaldic.definition: Of or pertaining to the scalds of the Norsemen; as, scaldic poetry.

sagitta.definition: (Astron.)  A small constellation north of Aquila; the Arrow. 2. (Arch.)  The keystone of an arch. gwitt. 3. (Geom.)  The distance from a point in a curve to the chord; also, the versed sine of an arc; -- so called from its resemblance to an arrow resting on the bow and string. 4. (Anat.)  The larger.

outgrow.definition: To surpass in growing; to grow more than. Shak. 2. To grow out of or away from; to grow too large, or too aged, for; as, to outgrow clothing; to outgrow usefulness; to outgrow an infirmity.

cutaway.definition: Having a part cut off or away; having the corners rounded or cut away. Cutaway coat, a coat whose skirts are cut away in front so as not to meet at the bottom.

torques.definition: A cervical ring of hair or feathers, distinguished by its color or structure; a collar.

shrubbery.definition: A collection of shrubs. 2. A place where shrubs are planted. Macaulay.

pyroxene.definition: A common mineral occurring in monoclinic crystals, with a prismatic angle of nearly 90º, and also in massive forms which are often laminated. It varies in color from white to dark green and black, and includes many varieties differing in color and composition, as diopside, malacolite, salite, coccol.

kimnel.definition: A tub. See Kemelin. She knew not what a kimnel was Beau. & Fl.

selenonium.definition: A hypothetical radical of selenium, analogous to sulphonium.

socage.definition: A tenure of lands and tenements by a certain or determinate service; a tenure distinct from chivalry or knight's service, in which the obligations were uncertain. The service must be certain, in order to be denominated socage, as to hold by fealty and twenty shillings rent. [Written also soccage.] N.

transposal.definition: The act of transposing, or the state of being transposed; transposition.

kail.definition: (Bot.)  A kind of headless cabbage. Same as Kale, 1. 2. Any cabbage, greens, or vegetables. [OE. or Scot.] 3. A broth made with kail or other vegetables; hence, any broth; also, a dinner. [Scot.] Kail yard, a kitchen garden. [Scot.].

passee.definition: Past; gone by; hence, past one's prime; worn; faded; as, a passée belle. Ld. Lytton.

memorist.definition: One who, or that which, causes to be remembered.

setula.definition: A small, short hair or bristle; a small seta.

indelible.definition: That can not be removed, washed away, blotted out, or effaced; incapable of being canceled, lost, or forgotten; as, indelible characters; an indelible stain; an indelible impression on the memory. 2. That can not be annulled; indestructible. They are endued with indelible power from above. Sprat. In.

hansom.definition: A light, low, two-wheeled covered carriage with the driver's seat elevated behind, the reins being passed over the top. He hailed a cruising hansom . . . " 'Tis the gondola of London," said Lothair. Beaconsfield. HAN'T; HAIN'T Han't.  A contraction of have not, or has not, used in illiterate speech.

kist.definition:
A chest; hence, a coffin. [Scot. & Prov. End.] Jamieson. Halliwell.

A stated payment, especially a payment of rent for land; hence, the time for such payment. [India].

phonolite.definition: A compact, feldspathic, igneous rock containing nephelite, haüynite, etc. Thin slabs give a ringing sound when struck; -- called also clinkstone.

rutilant.definition: Having a reddish glow; shining. Parchments . . . colored with this rutilant mixture. Evelin.

exceptless.definition: Not exceptional; usual. My general and exceptless rashness. Shak.

sug.definition: A kind of worm or larva. Walton.

manchet.definition: Fine white bread; a loaf of fine bread. [Archaic] Bacon. Tennyson.

bisector.definition: One who, or that which, bisects; esp. (Geom.) a straight line which bisects an angle.

encrinoidea.definition: That order of the Crinoidea which includes most of the living and many fossil forms, having jointed arms around the margin of the oral disk; -- also called Brachiata and Articulata. See Illusts. under Comatula and Crinoidea.

ochreated.definition: Wearing or furnished with an ochrea or legging; wearing boots; booted. A scholar undertook...to address himself ochreated unto the vice chancellor. Fuller. 2. (Bot.)  Provided with ochrea, or sheathformed stipules, as the rhubarb, yellow dock, and knotgrass.

apogamy.definition: The formation of a bud in place of a fertilized ovule or oöspore. De Bary.

embarge.definition: To put in a barge. [Poetic] Drayton.

cesspool.definition: A cistern in the course, or the termination, of a drain, to collect sedimentary or superfluous matter; a privy vault; any receptace of filth. [Written also sesspool.].

cardecu.definition: A quarter of a crown. The bunch of them were not worth a cardecu. Sir W. Scott.

alterative.definition:
Causing ateration. Specifically:  Gradually changing, or tending to change, a morbid state of the functions into one of health. Burton.

A medicine or treatment which gradually induces a change, and restores healthy functions without sensible evacuations.

apriority.definition: The quality of being innate in the mind, or prior to experience; a priori reasoning.

ironwort.definition: An herb of the Mint family (Sideritis), supposed to heal sword cuts; also, a species of Galeopsis.

pulverization.definition: The action of reducing to dust or powder.

scotchman.definition: A native or inhabitant of Scotland; a Scot; a Scotsman. 2. (Naut.)  A piece of wood or stiff hide placed over shrouds and other rigging to prevent chafe by the running gear. Ham. Nav. Encyc.

resider.definition: One who resides in a place.

dioptre.definition: A unit employed by oculists in numbering glasses according to the metric system; a refractive power equal to that of a glass whose principal focal distance is one meter.

arenilitic.definition: Of or pertaining to sandstone; as, arenilitic mountains. Kirwan.

bungling.definition: Unskillful; awkward; clumsy; as, a bungling workman. Swift. They make but bungling work. Dryden.

ungka.definition: The siamang; -- called also ungka ape.

stagnant.definition: That stagnates; not flowing; not running in a current or steam; motionless; hence, impure or foul from want of motion; as, a stagnant lake or pond; stagnant blood in the veins. 2. Not active or brisk; dull; as, business in stagnant. That gloomy slumber of the stagnant soul. Johnson. For him a stagna.

figurehead.definition: (Naut.)  The figure, statue, or bust, on the prow of a ship. 2. A person who allows his name to be used to give standing to enterprises in which he has no responsible interest or duties; a nominal, but not real, head or chief.

stethoscopist.definition: One skilled in the use of the stethoscope.

viable.definition: Capable of living; born alive and with such form and development of organs as to be capable of living; -- said of a newborn, or a prematurely born, infant. Note: Unless he [an infant] is born viable, he acquires no rights, and can not transmit them to his heirs, and is considered as if he had never.

mousseline.definition: Muslin. Mousseline de laine (. Etym: [F., muslin of wool.] Muslin delaine. See under Muslin. -- Mousseline glass, a kind of thin blown glassware, such as wineglasses, etc.

immortelle.definition: A plant with a conspicuous, dry, unwithering involucre, as the species of Antennaria, Helichrysum, Gomphrena, etc. See Everlasting.

titillation.definition: The act of tickling, or the state of being tickled; a tickling sensation. A. Tucker. 2. Any pleasurable sensation. Those titillations that reach no higher than the senses. Glanvill.

corporeality.definition: The state of being corporeal; corporeal existence.

refrigeration.definition: The act or process of refrigerating or cooling, or the state of being cooled.

androgynous.definition: Uniting both sexes in one, or having the characteristics of both; being in nature both male and female; hermaphroditic. Owen. The truth is, a great mind must be androgynous. Coleridge. 2. (Bot.)  Bearing both staminiferous and pistilliferous flowers in the same cluster.

sinter.definition: Dross, as of iron; the scale which files from iron when hammered; -- applied as a name to various minerals. Calcareous sinter, a loose banded variety of calcite formed by deposition from lime-bearing waters; calcareous tufa; travertine. -- Ceraunian sinter, fulgurite. -- Siliceous sinter, a light ce.

saccharone.definition: (a) A white crystalline substance, C6H8O6, obtained by the oxidation of saccharin, and regarded as the lactone of saccharonic acid. (b) An oily liquid, C6H10O2, obtained by the reduction of saccharin.

indicavit.definition: A writ of prohibition against proceeding in the spiritual court in certain cases, when the suit belongs to the common-law courts. Wharton (Law Dict. ).

antidotical.definition: Serving as an antidote. -- An`ti*dot"ic*al*ly, adv.

appeasement.definition: The act of appeasing, or the state of being appeased; pacification. Hayward.

neutrophile.definition: One of a group of leucocytes whose granules stain only with neutral dyes. -- Neu"tro*phil"ic (#), a., Neu*troph"i*lous (#), a.

prebendate.definition: To invest with the office of prebendary; to present to a prebend. Grafton.

mistura.definition: (a) A mingled compound in which different ingredients are contained in a liquid state; a mixture. See Mixture, n., 4. (b) Sometimes, a liquid medicine containing very active substances, and which can only be administered by drops. Dunglison.

approvement.definition: Approbation. I did nothing without your approvement. Hayward. 2. (Eng. Law)  a confession of guilt by a prisoner charged with treason or felony, together with an accusation of his accomplish and a giving evidence against them in order to obtain his own pardon. The term is no longer in use; it corres.

scolytid.definition: Any one of numerous species of small bark-boring beetles of the genus Scolytus and allied genera. Also used adjectively.

inordination.definition: Deviation from custom, rule, or right; irregularity; inordinacy. South. Every inordination of religion that is not in defect, is properly called superstition. Jer. Taylor.

zoutch.definition: To stew, as flounders, eels, etc., with just enough or liquid to cover them. Smart.

alloxantin.definition: A substance produced by acting upon uric with warm and very dilute nitric acid.

disagreement.definition: The state of disagreeing; a being at variance; dissimilitude; diversity. 2. Unsuitableness; unadaptedness. 3. Difference of opinion or sentiment. 4. A falling out, or controversy; difference. Syn. -- Difference; diversity; dissimilitude; unlikeness; discrepancy; variance; dissent; misunderstanding;.

smash.definition:
To break in pieces by violence; to dash to pieces; to crush. Here everything is broken and smashed to pieces. Burke.

To break up, or to pieces suddenly, as the result of collision or pressure.

1. A breaking or dashing to pieces; utter destruction; wreck. 2. Hence, bankruptcy.

dispensatory.definition:
Granting, or authorized to grant, dispensations. "Dispensatory power." Bp. Rainbow.

A book or medicinal formulary containing a systematic description of drugs, and of preparations made from them. It is usually, but not always, distinguished from a pharmacopoeia in that it issued by private parties,.

suffruticose.definition: Woody in the lower part of the stem, but with the yearly branches herbaceous, as sage, thyme, hyssop, and the like.

prurigo.definition: A papular disease of the skin, of which intense itching is the chief symptom, the eruption scarcely differing from the healthy cuticle in color.

victuals.definition: Food for human beings, esp. when it is cooked or prepared for the table; that which supports human life; provisions; sustenance; meat; viands. Then had we plenty of victuals. Jer. xliv. 17.

convival.definition: pertaining to a feast or to festivity; convivial. "A convival dish." Sir T. Browne.

gesticulation.definition: The act of gesticulating, or making gestures to express passion or enforce sentiments. 2. A gesture; a motion of the body or limbs in speaking, or in representing action or passion, and enforcing arguments and sentiments. Macaulay. 3. Antic tricks or motions. B. Jonson.

nebulation.definition: The condition of being nebulated; also, a clouded, or ill- defined, color mark.

cagmag.definition: A tough old goose; hence, coarse, bad food of any kind. Halliwell.

matriarch.definition: The mother and ruler of a family or of her descendants; a ruler by maternal right.

consummative.definition: Serving to consummate; completing. "The final, the consummative procedure of philosophy." Sir W. Hamilton.

indigest.definition:
Crude; unformed; unorganized; undigested. "A chaos rude and indigest." W. Browne. "Monsters and things indigest." Shak.

Something indigested. Shak.

subspecies.definition: A group somewhat lessdistinct than speciesusually are, but based on characters more important than those which characterize ordinary varieties; often, a geographical variety or race.

samurai.definition: In the former feudal system of Japan, the class or a member of the class, of military retainers of the daimios, constituting the gentry or lesser nobility. They possessed power of life and death over the commoners, and wore two swords as their distinguishing mark. Their special rights and privileges.

inboard.definition: (Naut.)  Inside the line of a vessel's bulwarks or hull; the opposite of outboard; as, an inboard cargo; haul the boom inboard. 2. (Mech.)  From without inward; toward the inside; as, the inboard stroke of a steam engine piston, the inward or return stroke.

faint.definition: Lacking strength; weak; languid; inclined to swoon; as, faint with fatigue, hunger, or thirst. 2. Wanting in courage, spirit, or energy; timorous; cowardly; dejected; depressed; as, "Faint heart ne'er won fair lady." Old Proverb. 3. Lacking distinctness; hardly perceptible; striking the senses feebl.

provoke.definition: To call forth; to call into being or action; esp., to incense to action, a faculty or passion, as love, hate, or ambition; hence, commonly, to incite, as a person, to action by a challenge, by taunts, or by defiance; to exasperate; to irritate; to offend intolerably; to cause to retaliate. Obey his.

ambitus.definition: The exterior edge or border of a thing, as the border of a leaf, or the outline of a bivalve shell. 2. (Rom. Antiq.)  A canvassing for votes.

absinthate.definition: A combination of absinthic acid with a base or positive radical.

referendary.definition: One to whose decision a cause is referred; a referee. Bacon. 2. An officer who delivered the royal answer to petitions. "Referendaries, or masters of request." Harmar. 3. Formerly, an officer of state charged with the duty of procuring and dispatching diplomas and decrees.

high-proof.definition: Highly rectified; very strongly alcoholic; as, high-proof spirits. 2. So as to stand any test. "We are high-proof melancholy." Shak.

pawnor.definition: One who pawns or pledges anything as security for the payment of borrowed money or of a debt.

double-headed.definition: Having two heads; bicipital. Double-headed rail (Railroad), a rail whose flanges are duplicates, so that when one is worn the other may be turned uppermost.

dextrality.definition: The state of being on the right-hand side; also, the quality of being right-handed; right-handedness. Sir T. Browne.

nullifier.definition: One who nullifies or makes void; one who maintains the right to nullify a contract by one of the parties.

microtomy.definition: The art of using the microtome; investigation carried on with the microtome.

strategical.definition: Of or pertaining to strategy; effected by artifice. -- Stra*te"gic*al*ly, adv. Strategic line (Mil.), a line joining strategic points. -- Strategic point (Mil.), any point or region in the theater or warlike operations which affords to its possessor an advantage over his opponent, as a mountain pass.

green-leek.definition: An Australian parrakeet (Polytelis Barrabandi); -- called also the scarlet-breasted parrot.

thrack.definition: To load or burden; as, to thrack a man with property. South.

vanity.definition: The quality or state of being vain; want of substance to satisfy desire; emptiness; unsubstantialness; unrealness; falsity. Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity. Eccl. i. 2. Here I may well show the vanity of that which is reported in the story of Walsingham. Sir.

ampliate.definition:
To enlarge. To maintain and ampliate the external possessions of your empire. Udall.

Having the outer edge prominent; said of the wings of insects.

spumescence.definition: The state of being foamy; frothiness.

sexennial.definition: Lasting six years, or happening once in six years. -- n.  A sexennial event.

sulphone.definition: Any one of a series of compounds analogous to the ketones, and consisting of the sulphuryl group united with two hydrocarbon radicals; as, dimethyl sulphone, (CH.SO.

swingeing.definition: Huge; very large. Arbuthnot. Byron. -- Swinge"ing*ly, adv. Dryden.

polyconic.definition: Pertaining to, or based upon, many cones. Polyconic projection (Map Making), a projection of the earth's surface, or any portion thereof, by which each narrow zone is projected upon a conical surface that touches the sphere along this zone, the conical surface being then unrolled. This projection di.

croup.definition:
The hinder part or buttocks of certain quadrupeds, especially of a horse; hence, the place behind the saddle. So light to the croup the fair lady he swung, So light to the saddle before her he sprung. Sir W. Scott.

An inflammatory affection of the larynx or trachea, accompanied by a hoarse, ringing.

dartle.definition: To pierce or shoot through; to dart repeatedly: -- frequentative of dart. My star that dartles the red and the blue. R. Browning.

griddle.definition: An iron plate or pan used for cooking cakes. 2. A sieve with a wire bottom, used by miners.

closehanded.definition: Covetous; penurious; stingy; closefisted. -- Close"hand`ed*ness, n.

cosmographer.definition: One who describes the world or universe, including the heavens and the earth. The name of this island is nowhere found among the old and ancient cosmographers. Robynson (More's Utopia).

epacris.definition: A genus of shrubs, natives of Australia, New Zealand, etc., having pretty white, red, or purple blossoms, and much resembling heaths.

ottrelite.definition: A micaceous mineral occurring in small scales. It is characteristic of certain crystalline schists.

ulva.definition: A genus of thin papery bright green seaweeds including the kinds called sea lettuce.

ferrandine.definition: A stuff made of silk and wool. I did buy a colored silk ferrandine. Pepys.

prevene.definition: To come before; to anticipate; hence, to hinder; to prevent. Philips.

exserted.definition: Standing out; projecting beyond some other part; as, exsert stamens. A small portion of the basal edge of the shell exserted. D. H. Barnes.

kindless.definition: Destitute of kindness; unnatural. "Kindless villain." Shak.

excogitation.definition: The act of excogitating; a devising in the thoughts; invention; contrivance.

zetetic.definition:
Seeking; proceeding by inquiry. Zetetic method (Math.), the method used for finding the value of unknown quantities by direct search, in investigation, or in the solution of problems. Hutton.

A seeker; -- a name adopted by some of the Pyrrhonists.

necessitarian.definition:
Of or pertaining to the doctrine of philosophical necessity in regard to the origin and existence of things, especially as applied to the actings or choices of the will; -- opposed to libertarian.

One who holds to the doctrine of necessitarianism.

erase.definition: To rub or scrape out, as letters or characters written, engraved, or painted; to efface; to expunge; to cross out; as, to erase a word or a name. 2. Fig.: To obliterate; to expunge; to blot out; -- used of ideas in the mind or memory. Burke.

caper.definition:
To leap or jump about in a sprightly manner; to cut capers; to skip; to spring; to prance; to dance. He capers, he dances, he has eyes of youth. Shak.

A frolicsome leap or spring; a skip; a jump, as in mirth or dancing; a prank. To cut a caper, to frolic; to make a sportive spring; to play a prank.

chrysanthemum.definition: A genus of composite plants, mostly perennial, and of many species including the many varieties of garden chrysanthemums (annual and perennial), and also the feverfew and the oxeye daisy.

squillitic.definition: Of or pertaining to squills. "Squillitic vinegar." Holland.

pelf.definition: Money; riches; lucre; gain; -- generally conveying the idea of something ill-gotten or worthless. It has no plural. "Mucky pelf." Spenser. "Paltry pelf." Burke. Can their pelf prosper, not got by valor or industry Fuller.

cymous.definition: Having the nature of a cyme, or derived from a cyme; bearing, or pertaining to, a cyme or cymes.

nereis.definition: (Class. Myth.)  A Nereid. See Nereid. 2. (Zoöl.)  A genus, including numerous species, of marine chætopod annelids, having a well-formed head, with two pairs of eyes, antennæ, four pairs of tentacles, and a protrusile pharynx, armed with a pair of hooked jaws.

obediently.definition: In an obedient manner; with obedience.

romanize.definition:
To Latinize; to fill with Latin words or idioms. Dryden. 2. To convert to the Roman Catholic religion.

1. To use Latin words and idioms. "Apishly Romanizing." Milton. 2. To conform to Roman Catholic opinions, customs, or modes of speech.

serapis.definition: An Egyptian deity, at first a symbol of the Nile, and so of fertility; later, one of the divinities of the lower world. His worship was introduced into Greece and Rome.

trispaston.definition: A machine with three pulleys which act together for raising great weights. Brande & C.

rostelliform.definition: Having the form of a rostellum, or small beak.

fameless.definition: Without fame or renown. -- Fame"less*ly, adv.

cranioclast.definition: An instrument for crushing the head of a fetus, to facilitate delivery in difficult eases.

smartweed.definition: An acrid plant of the genus Polygonum (P. Hydropiper), which produces smarting if applied where the skin is tender.

perspectively.definition: Optically; as through a glass. You see them perspectively. Shak. 2. According to the rules of perspective.

dilated.definition: Expanded; enlarged. Shak. 2. (Bot.)  Widening into a lamina or into lateral winglike appendages. 3. (Zoöl.)  Having the margin wide and spreading.

ductible.definition: Capable of being drawn out Feltham.

clift.definition:
A cliff. That gainst the craggy clifts did loudly roar. Spenser.

1. A cleft of crack; a narrow opening. 2. The fork of the legs; the crotch. Chaucer.

astragal.definition: (Arch.)  A convex molding of rounded surface, generally from half to three quarters of a circle. 2. (Gun.)  A round molding encircling a cannon near the mouth.

childship.definition: The state or relation of being a child.

monamide.definition: An amido compound with only one amido group.

hemispherical.definition: Containing, or pertaining to, a hemisphere; as, a hemispheric figure or form; a hemispherical body.

counterfeiter.definition: One who counterfeits; one who copies or imitates; especially, one who copies or forges bank notes or coin; a forger. The coin which was corrupted by counterfeiters. Camden. 2. One who assumes a false appearance or semblance; one who makes false pretenses. Counterfeiters of devotion. Sherwood.

discoure.definition: To discover. That none might her discoure. Spenser.

alcyonium.definition: A genus of fleshy Alcyonaria, its polyps somewhat resembling flowers with eight fringed rays. The term was also formerly used for certain species of sponges.

feldspathose.definition: Pertaining to, or consisting of, feldspar.

verrucose.definition: Covered with wartlike elevations; tuberculate; warty; verrucous; as, a verrucose capsule.

reposure.definition: Rest; quiet. In the reposure of most soft content. Marston.

moldery.definition: Covered or filled with mold; consisting of, or resembling, mold.

complicacy.definition: A state of being complicate or intricate. Mitford.

chromid.definition: One of the Chromidæ, a family of fresh-water fishes abundant in the tropical parts of America and Africa. Some are valuable food fishes, as the bulti of the Nile.

ancome.definition: A small ulcerous swelling, coming suddenly; also, a whitlow. Boucher.

hyoglossal.definition: (a) Pertaining to or connecting the tongue and hyodean arch; as, the hyoglossal membrane. (b) Of or pertaining to the hyoglossus muscle.

nosel.definition: To nurse; to lead or teach; to foster; to nuzzle. If any man use the Scripture . . . to nosel thee in anything save in Christ, he is a false prophet. Tyndale.

tike.definition:
A tick. See 2d Tick.

1. A dog; a cur. "Bobtail tike or trundle-tail." Shak. 2. A countryman or clown; a boorish person.

deathbird.definition: Tengmalm's or Richardson's owl (Nyctale Tengmalmi); -- so called from a superstition of the North American Indians that its note presages death.

rheocrat.definition: A kind of motor speed controller permitting of very gradual variation in speed and of reverse. It is especially suitable for use with motor driven machine tools.

fibula.definition: A brooch, clasp, or buckle. Mere fibulæ, without a robe to clasp. Wordsworth. 2. (Anat.)  The outer and usually the smaller of the two bones of the leg, or hind limb, below the knee. 3. (Surg.)  A needle for sewing up wounds.

oppositely.definition: In a situation to face each other; in an opposite manner or direction; adversely. Winds from all quarters oppositely blow. May.

capitolian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Capitol in Rome. "Capitolian Jove." Macaulay. Capitoline games (Antiq.), annual games instituted at Rome by Camillus, in honor of Jupter Capitolinus, on account of the preservation of the Capitol from the Gauls; when reinstituted by Domitian, arter a period of neglect, they w.

perfidious.definition: Guilty of perfidy; violating good faith or vows; false to trust or confidence reposed; teacherous; faithless; as, a perfidious friend. Shak. 2. Involving, or characterized by, perfidy. "Involved in this perfidious fraud." Milton.

hemigamous.definition: Having one of the two florets in the same spikelet neuter, and the other unisexual, whether male or female; -- said of grasses.

nakedly.definition: In a naked manner; without covering or disguise; manifestly; simply; barely.

chop-logic.definition: One who bandies words or is very argunentative. [Jocular] Shak.

binominal.definition: Of or pertaining to two names; binomial.

weir.definition: A dam in a river to stop and raise the water, for the purpose of conducting it to a mill, forming a fish pond, or the like. 2. A fence of stakes, brushwood, or the like, set in a stream, tideway, or inlet of the sea, for taking fish. 3. A long notch with a horizontal edge, as in the top of a vertica.

retaliate.definition: To return the like for; to repay or requite by an act of the same kind; to return evil for (evil). [Now seldom used except in a bad sense.] One ambassador sent word to the duke's son that his visit should be retaliated. Sir T. Herbert. It is unlucky to be obliged to retaliate the injuries of authors.

trama.definition: The loosely woven substance which lines the chambers within the gleba in certain Gasteromycetes.

aestivation.definition: (Zoöl.)  The state of torpidity induced by the heat and dryness of summer, as in certain snails; -- opposed to hibernation. 2. (Bot.)  The arrangement of the petals in a flower bud, as to folding, overlapping, etc.; prefloration. Gray. [Spelt also estivation.].

arioso.definition: In the smooth and melodious style of an air; ariose.

sear.definition: [OE. seer, AS. seár (assumed) fr. seárian to wither; akin to D. zoor dry, LG. soor, OHG. soren to to wither, Gr. sush) to dry, to wither, Zend hush to dry. sq. root152. Cf. Austere, Sorrel, a.] Dry; withered; no longer green; -- applied to leaves. Milton. I have lived long enough; my way of life Is.

quahaug.definition: An American market clam (Venus mercenaria). It is sold in large quantities, and is highly valued as food. Called also round clam, and hard clam. Note: The name is also applied to other allied species, as Venus Mortoni of the Gulf of Mexico.

butchering.definition: The business of a butcher. 2. The act of slaughtering; the act of killing cruelly and needlessly. That dreadful butchering of one another. Addison.

saturnine.definition: Born under, or influenced by, the planet Saturn. 2. Heavy; grave; gloomy; dull; -- the opposite of mercurial; as, a saturnine person or temper. Addison. 3. (Old Chem.)  Of or pertaining to lead; characterized by, or resembling, lead, which was formerly called Saturn. [Archaic] Saturnine colic (Med.).

vernage.definition: A kind of sweet wine from Italy. Chaucer.

laity.definition: The people, as distinguished from the clergy; the body of the people not in orders. A rising up of the laity against the sacerdotal caste. Macaulay. 2. The state of a layman. Ayliffe. 3. Those who are not of a certain profession, as law or medicine, in distinction from those belonging to it.

paracorolla.definition: A secondary or inner corolla; a corona, as of the Narcissus.

lutherism.definition: The doctrines taught by Luther or held by the Lutheran Church.

practisant.definition: An agent or confederate in treachery. Shak.

disvalue.definition:
To undervalue; to depreciate. Shak.

Disesteem; disregard. B. Jonson.

stalk-eyed.definition: Having the eyes raised on a stalk, or peduncle; -- opposed to sessile-eyed. Said especially of podophthalmous crustaceans. Stalked- eyed crustaceans. (Zoöl.) See Podophthalmia.

fluxure.definition: The quality of being fluid. Fielding. 2. Fluid matter. Drayton.

wynn.definition:
One of the runes adopted into the Anglo-Saxon, or Old English, alphabet. It had the value of modern English w, and was replaced from about a. d. 1280 at first by uu, later by w. X.

A kind of timber truck, or carriage.

persic.definition: Of or relating to Persia. -- n.  The Persian language.

burglar.definition: One guilty of the crime of burglary. Burglar alarm, a device for giving alarm if a door or window is opened from without.

ovate.definition: Shaped like an egg, with the lower extremity broadest. 2. (Bot.)  Having the shape of an egg, or of the longitudinal sectior of an egg, with the broader end basal. Gray.

thoria.definition: A rare white earthy substance, consisting of the oxide of thorium; -- formerly called also thorina.

minutely.definition:
In a minute manner; with minuteness; exactly; nicely.

Happening every minute; continuing; unceasing. Throwing themselves absolutely upon God's minutely providence. Hammond.

At intervals of a minute; very often and regularly. J. Philips. Minutely proclaimed in thunder from heaven. Hammond.

ruralize.definition:
To render rural; to give a rural appearance to.

To become rural; to go into the country; to rusticate.

expectoration.definition: The act of ejecting phlegm or mucus from the throat or lungs, by coughing, hawking, and spitting. 2. That which is expectorated, as phlegm or mucus.

lactometer.definition: An instrument for estimating the purity or richness of milk, as a measuring glass, a specific gravity bulb, or other apparatus.

simultaneity.definition: The quality or state of being simultaneous; simultaneousness.

enfeoffment.definition: (a) The act of enfeoffing. (b) The instrument or deed by which one is invested with the fee of an estate.

self-defensive.definition: Defending, or tending to defend, one's own person, property, or reputation.

pessimize.definition: To hold or advocate the doctrine of pessimism. London Sat. Rev.

nummulitic.definition: Of, like, composed of, containing, nummulites; as, nummulitic beds.

contravene.definition: To meet in the way of opposition; to come into conflict with; to oppose; to contradict; to obstruct the operation of; to defeat. So plain a proposition . . . was not likely to be contravened. Southey. 2. To violate; to nullify; to be inconsistent with; as, to contravene a law. Laws that place the su.

gyre.definition:
A circular motion, or a circle described by a moving body; a turn or revolution; a circuit. Quick and more quick he spins in giddy gyres. Dryden. Still expanding and ascending gyres. Mrs. Browning.

To turn round; to gyrate. Bp. Hall. Drayton.

cyclostome.definition:
A division of Bryozoa, in which the cells have circular apertures.

Pertaining to the Cyclostomi.

unicolorous.definition: Having the surface of a uniform color.

illuminator.definition: One whose occupation is to adorn books, especially manuscripts, with miniatures, borders, etc. See Illuminate, v. t., 3. 2. A condenser or reflector of light in optical apparatus; also, an illuminant.

appulsion.definition: A driving or striking against; an appulse.

trackwalker.definition: A person employed to walk over and inspect a section of tracks.

low-churchism.definition: The principles of the low-church party.

honorific.definition: Conferring honor; tending to honor. London. Spectator.

evulsion.definition: The act of plucking out; a rooting out.

gasification.definition: The act or process of converting into gas.

arachnoidal.definition: Pertaining to the arachnoid membrane; arachnoid.

circumdenudation.definition: Denudation around or in the neighborhood of an object. Hills of circumdenudation, hills which have been produced by surface erosion; the elevations which have been left, after denudation of a mass of high ground. Jukes.

jelly.definition: Anything brought to a gelatinous condition; a viscous, translucent substance in a condition between liquid and solid; a stiffened solution of gelatin, gum, or the like. 2. The juice of fruits or meats boiled with sugar to an elastic consistence; as, currant jelly; calf's-foot jelly. Jelly bag, a bag.

abolishment.definition: The act of abolishing; abolition; destruction. Hooker.

directress.definition: A woman who directs. Bp. Hurd.

slape.definition: Slippery; smooth; crafty; hypocritical. Slape ale, plain ale, as opposed to medicated or mixed ale.

anhele.definition: To pant; to be breathlessly anxious or eager (for). They anhele . . . for the fruit of our convocation. Latimer.

enharmonical.definition: (Anc. Mus.)  Of or pertaining to that one of the three kinds of musical scale (diatonic, chromatic, enharmonic) recognized by the ancient Greeks, which consisted of quarter tones and major thirds, and was regarded as the most accurate. 2. (Mus.) (a) Pertaining to a change of notes to the eye, while,.

excursion.definition: A running or going out or forth; an expedition; a sally. Far on excursion toward the gates of hell. Milton. They would make excursions and waste the country. Holland. 2. A journey chiefly for recreation; a pleasure trip; a brief tour; as, an excursion into the country. 3. A wandering from a subject;.

overrule.definition: To rule over; to govern or determine by superior authority. 2. To rule or determine in a contrary way; to decide against; to abrogate or alter; as, God overrules the purposes of men; the chairman overruled the point of order. His passion and animosity overruled his conscience. Clarendon. These [diff.

giddiness.definition: The quality or state of being giddy.

stand-by.definition: One who, or that which, stands by one in need; something upon which one relies for constant use or in an emergency.

instinct.definition:
Urged or sas, birds instinct with life. The chariot of paternal deity . . . Itself instinct with spirit, but convoyed By four cherubic shapes. Milton. A noble performance, instinct with sound principle. Brougham.

1. Natural inward impulse; unconscious, involuntary, or unreasoning prompting to any m.

stramineous.definition: Strawy; consisting of straw. Robinson. 2. Chaffy; like straw; straw-colored. Burton.

tubal.definition: Of or pertaining to a tube; specifically, of or pertaining to one of the Fallopian tubes; as, tubal pregnancy.

omegoid.definition: Having the form of the Greek capital letter Omega (.

pollinate.definition:
Pollinose.

To apply pollen to (a stigma). -- Pol`li*na"tion, n. (Bot.).

tunk.definition: A sharp blow; a thump. [Prov. Eng. or Colloq. U. S.].

trigeminal.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, the fifth pair of cranial nerves, which divide on each side of the head into three main branches distributed to the orbits, jaws, and parts of the mouth; trifacial.

nameless.definition: Without a name; not having been given a name; as, a nameless star. Waller. 2. Undistinguished; not noted or famous. A nameless dwelling and an unknown name. Harte. 3. Not known or mentioned by name; anonymous; as, a nameless writer."Nameless pens." Atterbury. 4. Unnamable; indescribable; inexpressib.

sudoriferous.definition: Producing, or secreting, sweat; sudoriparous. Sudoriferous glands (Anat.), small convoluted tubular glands which are situated in the subcutaneous tissues and discharge by minute orifices in the surface of the skin; the sweat glands.

sextodecimo.definition:
Having sixteen leaves to a sheet; of, or equal to, the size of one fold of a sheet of printing paper when folded so as to make sixteen leaves, or thirty-two pages; as, a sextodecimo volume.

A book composed of sheets each of which is folded into sixteen leaves; hence, indicating, more or less defini.

polycotyledonary.definition: Having the villi of the placenta collected into definite patches, or cotyledons.

uncoif.definition: To deprive of the coif or cap. Young.

fritinancy.definition: A chirping or creaking, as of a cricket. Sir T. Browne.

pestalozzian.definition: Belonging to, or characteristic of, a system of elementary education which combined manual training with other instruction, advocated and practiced by Jean Henri Pestalozzi (1746-1827), a Swiss teacher. -- n.  An advocate or follower of the system of Pestalozzi.

circularity.definition: The quality or state of being circular; a circular form.

rivality.definition: Rivalry; competition. 2. Equality, as of right or rank. hak.

intestate.definition:
Without having made a valid will; without a will; as, to die intestate. Blackstone. Airy succeeders of intestate joys. Shak. 2. Not devised or bequeathed; not disposed of by will; as, an intestate estate.

A person who dies without making a valid will. Blackstone.

screamer.definition: Any one of three species of South American birds constituting the family Anhimidæ, and the suborder Palamedeæ. They have two spines on each wing, and the head is either crested or horned. They are easily tamed, and then serve as guardians for other poultry. The crested screamers, or chajas, belong t.

sitten.definition: p. p. of Sit, for sat.

simious.definition: Of or pertaining to the Simian. That strange simious, schoolboy passion of giving pain to others. Sydney Smith.

coalite.definition:
To unite or coalesce. Let them continue to coalite. Bolingbroke.

To cause to unite or coalesce. Time has by degrees blended . . . and coalited the conquered with the conquerors. Burke.

raki.definition: A kind of ardent spirits used in southern Europe and the East, distilled from grape juice, grain, etc.

geothermometer.definition: A thermometer specially constructed for measuring temperetures at a depth below the surface of the ground.

preemptioner.definition: One who holds a prior to purchase certain public land. Abbott.

anomalistic.definition: Irregular; departing from common or established rules. 2. (Astron.)  Pertaining to the anomaly, or angular distance of a planet from its perihelion. Anomalistic month. See under Month. -- Anomalistic revolution, the period in which a planet or satellite goes through the complete cycles of its change.

rouleau.definition: A little roll; a roll of coins put up in paper, or something resembling such a roll.

bogwood.definition: The wood of trees, esp. of oaks, dug up from peat bogs. It is of a shining black or ebony color, and is largely used for making ornaments.

euphonium.definition: A bass instrument of the saxhorn family.

abecedary.definition:
Pertaining to, or formed by, the letters of the alphabet; alphabetic; hence, rudimentary. Abecedarian psalms, hymns, etc., compositions in which (like the 119th psalm in Hebrew) distinct portions or verses commence with successive letters of the alphabet. Hook.

A primer; the first principle or rudi.

phagedenical.definition: Of, like, or pertaining to, phagedena; used in the treatment of phagedena; as, a phagedenic ulcer or medicine. -- n.  A phagedenic medicine.

compensatory.definition: Serving for compensation; making amends. Jer. Taylor.

pumpet.definition: A pompet. Pumpet ball (Print.), a ball for inking types; a pompet.

rareness.definition: The state or quality of being rare. And let the rareness the small gift commend. Dryden.

cob.definition: The top or head of anything. W. Gifford. 2. A leader or chief; a conspicuous person, esp. a rich covetous person. All cobbing country chuffs, which make their bellies and their bags their god, are called rich cobs. Nash. 3. The axis on which the kernels of maize or indian corn grow. [U. S.] 4. (Zoöl.

tauricornous.definition: Having horns like those of a bull. Sir T. Browne.

aladinist.definition: One of a sect of freethinkers among the Mohammedans.

trottoir.definition: Footpath; pavement; sidewalk. Headless bodies trailed along the trottoirs. Froude.

weightiness.definition: The quality or state of being weighty; weight; force; importance; impressiveness.

tetramethylene.definition: (a) A hypothetical hydrocarbon, C4H8, analogous to trimethylene, and regarded as the base of well-known series or derivatives. (b) Sometimes, an isomeric radical used to designate certain compounds which are really related to butylene.

aciniform.definition: Having the form of a cluster of grapes; clustered like grapes. 2. Full of small kernels like a grape.

mesmeric.definition: Of, pertaining to, or induced by, mesmerism; as, mesmeric sleep.

campaned.definition: Furnished with, or bearing, campanes, or bells.

epicele.definition: A cavity formed by the invagination of the outer wall of the body, as the atrium of an amphioxus and possibly the body cavity of vertebrates.

curvilinearity.definition: The state of being curvilinear or of being bounded by curved lines.

freethinker.definition: One who speculates or forms opinions independently of the authority of others; esp., in the sphere or religion, one who forms opinions independently of the authority of revelation or of the church; an unbeliever; -- a term assumed by deists and skeptics in the eighteenth century. Atheist is an old-f.

bereave.definition: To make destitute; to deprive; to strip; -- with of before the person or thing taken away. Madam, you have bereft me of all words. Shak. Bereft of him who taught me how to sing. Tickell. 2. To take away from. All your interest in those territories Is utterly bereft you; all is lost. Shak. 3. To take.

muslin.definition: A thin cotton, white, dyed, or printed. The name is also applied to coarser and heavier cotton goods; as, shirting and sheeting muslins. Muslin cambric. See Cambric. -- Muslin delaine, a light woolen fabric for women's dresses. See Delaine. [Written also mousseline de laine.].

posttertiary.definition: Following, or more recent than, the Tertiary; Quaternary.

forswearer.definition: One who rejects of renounces upon oath; one who swears a false oath.

slick.definition:
See Schlich.

Sleek; smooth. "Both slick and dainty." Chapman.

To make sleek or smoth. "Slicked all with sweet oil." Chapman.

A wide paring chisel.

clogging.definition: Anything which clogs. Dr. H. More.

phakoscope.definition: An instrument for studying the mechanism of accommodation.

bastardy.definition: The state of being a bastard; illegitimacy. 2. The procreation of a bastard child. Wharton.

systemic.definition: Of or relating to a system; common to a system; as, the systemic circulation of the blood. 2. (Anat. & Physiol.)  Of or pertaining to the general system, or the body as a whole; as, systemic death, in distinction from local death; systemic circulation, in distinction from pulmonic circulation; syste.

epispadias.definition: A deformity in which the urethra opens upon the top of the penis, instead of at its extremity.

quech.definition: A word occurring in a corrupt passage of Bacon's Essays, and probably meaning, to stir, to move.

netify.definition: To render neat; to clean; to put in order. Chapman.

overween.definition: To think too highly or arrogantly; to regard one's own thinking or conclusions too highly; hence, to egotistic, arrogant, or rash, in opinion; to think conceitedly; to presume. They that overween, And at thy growing virtues fret their spleen. Milton.

meloplasty.definition: The process of restoring a cheek which has been destroyed wholly or in part.

spirochaeta.definition: A genus of Spirobacteria similar to Spirillum, but distinguished by its motility. One species, the Spirochæte Obermeyeri, is supposed to be the cause of relapsing fever.

viscountcy.definition: The dignity or jurisdiction of a viscount. Sir B. Burke.

isohyetose.definition: Of or pertaining to lines connecting places on the earth's surface which have a mean annual rainfall. -- n.  An isohyetose line.

translatitious.definition: Metaphorical; tralatitious; also, foreign; exotic. Evelyn.

averruncate.definition: To avert; to ward off. Hudibras. 2. To root up. Johnson.

deictic.definition: Direct; proving directly; -- applied to reasoning, and opposed to elenchtic or refutative.

patness.definition: Fitness or appropriateness; striking suitableness; convenience. The description with equal patness may suit both. Barrow.

behold.definition:
To have in sight; to see clearly; to look at; to regard with the eyes. When he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived. Num. xxi. 9. Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world. John. i. 29. Syn. -- To scan; gaze; regard; descry; view; discern.

To direct the eyes to, or fix them up.

fidicinal.definition: Of or pertaining to a stringed instrument.

ebriety.definition: Drunkenness; intoxication by spirituous liquors; inebriety. "Ruinous ebriety." Cowper.

nunciature.definition: The office of a nuncio. Clarendon.

barse.definition: The common perch. See 1st Bass. Halliwell.

faded.definition: That has lost freshness, color, or brightness; grown dim. "His faded cheek." Milton. Where the faded moon Made a dim silver twilight. Keats.

ecthoreum.definition: The slender, hollow thread of a nettling cell or cnida. See Nettling cell. [Written also ecthoræum.].

muzzle-loader.definition: A firearm which receives its charge through the muzzle, as distinguished from one which is loaded at the breech.

enigma.definition: A dark, obscure, or inexplicable saying; a riddle; a statement, the hidden meaning of which is to be discovered or guessed. A custom was among the ancients of proposing an enigma at festivals. Pope. 2. An action, mode of action, or thing, which cannot be satisfactorily explained; a puzzle; as, his c.

leonine.definition: Pertaining to, or characteristic of, the lion; as, a leonine look; leonine repacity. -- Le"o*nine*ly, adv. Leonine verse, a kind of verse, in which the end of the line rhymes with the middle; -- so named from Leo, or Leoninus, a Benedictine and canon of Paris in the twelfth century, who wrote largel.

emblement.definition: The growing crop, or profits of a crop which has been sown or planted; -- used especially in the plural. The produce of grass, trees, and the like, is not emblement. Wharton's Law Dict.

sexly.definition: Pertaining to sex. Should I ascribe any of these things unto myself or my sexly weakness, I were not worthy to live. Queen Elizabeth.

cambrian.definition:
(Geog.)  Of or pertaining to Cambria or Wales. 2. (Geol.)  Of or pertaining to the lowest subdivision of the rocks of the Silurian or Molluscan age; -- sometimes described as inferior to the Silurian. It is named from its development in Cambria or Wales. See the Diagram under Geology.

1. A native o.

dislive.definition: To deprive of life. Telemachus dislived Amphimedon. Chapman.

revive.definition: To return to life; to recover life or strength; to live anew; to become reanimated or reinvigorated. Shak. The Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into again, and he revived. 1 Kings xvii. 22. 2. Hence, to recover from a state of oblivion, obscurity, neglect, or depression.

hostile.definition: Belonging or appropriate to an enemy; showing the disposition of an enemy; showing ill will and malevolence, or a desire to thwart and injure; occupied by an enemy or enemies; inimical; unfriendly; as, a hostile force; hostile intentions; a hostile country; hostile to a sudden change. Syn. -- Warlik.

egilopical.definition: Pertaining to, of the nature of, or affected with, an ægilops, or tumor in the corner of the eye.

romaic.definition: Of or relating to modern Greece, and especially to its language. -- n.  The modern Greek language, now usually called by the Greeks Hellenic or Neo-Hellenic. Note: The Greeks at the time of the capture of Constantinople were proud of being "Romai^oi, or Romans . . . Hence the term Romaic was the nam.

backbite.definition:
To wound by clandestine detraction; to censure meanly or spitefully (as absent person); to slander or speak evil of (one absent). Spenser.

To censure or revile the absent. They are arrant knaves, and will backbite. Shak.

tinkering.definition: The act or work of a tinker.

interanimate.definition: To animate or inspire mutually. Donne.

falsehood.definition: Want of truth or accuracy; an untrue assertion or representation; error; misrepresentation; falsity. Though it be a lie in the clock, it is but a falsehood in the hand of the dial when pointing at a wrong hour, if rightly following the direction of the wheel which moveth it. Fuller. 2. A deliberate.

sanious.definition: (Med.)  pertaining to sanies, or partaking of its nature and appearance; thin and serous, with a slight bloody tinge; as, the sanious matter of an ulcer. 2. (med.)  Discharging sanies; as, a sanious ulcer.

clayish.definition: Partaking of the nature of clay, or containing particles of it.

suberone.definition: (a) The hypothetical ketone of suberic acid. (b) A colorless liquid, analogous suberone proper, having a pleasant peppermint odor. It is obtained by the distillation of calcium suberate.

exculpate.definition: To clear from alleged fault or guilt; to prove to be guiltless; to relieve of blame; to acquit. He exculpated himself from being the author of the heroic epistle. Mason. I exculpate him further for his writing against me. Milman. Syn. -- To exonerate; absolve; clear; acquit; excuse; vindicate; justi.

jargonic.definition: Of or pertaining to the mineral jargon.

glandular.definition: Containing or supporting glands; consisting of glands; pertaining to glands.

mesocoele.definition: The cavity of the mesencephalon; the iter.

skinless.definition: Having no skin, or a very thin skin; as, skinless fruit.

polytheize.definition: To adhere to, advocate, or inculcate, the doctrine of polytheism. Milman.

subarctic.definition: Approximately arctic; belonging to a region just without the arctic circle.

blackness.definition: The quality or state of being black; black color; atrociousness or enormity in wickedness. They're darker now than blackness. Donne.

jingling.definition: The act or process of producing a jingle; also, the sound itself; a chink. "The jingling of the guinea." Tennyson.

awaken.definition: To rouse from sleep or torpor; to awake; to wake. [He] is dispatched Already to awaken whom thou nam'st. Cowper. Their consciences are thoroughly awakened. Tillotson. Syn. -- To arouse; excite; stir up; call forth.

myodynamics.definition: The department of physiology which deals with the principles of muscular contraction; the exercise of muscular force or contraction.

hypnologist.definition: One who is versed in hypnology.

illaqueable.definition: Capable of being insnared or entrapped. Cudworth.

disenslave.definition: To free from bondage or slavery; to disenthrall. He shall disenslave and redeem his soul. South.

livingness.definition: The state or quality of being alive; possession of energy or vigor; animation; quickening.

hangnest.definition: A nest that hangs like a bag or pocket. 2. A bird which builds such a nest; a hangbird.

hyblaean.definition: Pertaining to Hybla, an ancient town of Sicily, famous for its bees.

sciatherical.definition: Belonging to a sundial. Sir T. Browne. -- Sci`a*ther"ic*al*ly, adv. J. Gregory.

picea.definition: A genus of coniferous trees of the northen hemisphere, including the Norway spruce and the American black and white spruces. These trees have pendent cones, which do not readily fall to pieces, in this and other respects differing from the firs.

undermasted.definition: Having masts smaller than the usual dimension; -- said of vessels. Totten.

zoneless.definition: Not having a zone; ungirded. The reeling goddess with the zoneless waist. Cowper. In careless folds, loose fell her zoneless vest. Mason.

nanny.definition: A diminutive of Ann or Anne, the proper name. Nanny goat, a female goat.

recompose.definition: To compose again; to form anew; to put together again or repeatedly. The far greater number of the objects presented to our observation can only be decomposed, but not actually recomposed. Sir W. Hamilton. 2. To restore to composure; to quiet anew; to tranquilize; as, to recompose the mind. Jer. Tay.

deliverable.definition: Capable of being, or about to be, delivered; necessary to be delivered. Hale.

neoplasia.definition: Growth or development of new material; neoplasty.

obscurantism.definition: The system or the principles of the obscurants. C. Kingsley.

neuralgia.definition: A disease, the chief symptom of which is a very acute pain, exacerbating or intermitting, which follows the course of a nervous branch, extends to its ramifications, and seems therefore to be seated in the nerve. It seems to be independent of any structural lesion. Dunglison.

eudiometry.definition: The art or process of determining he constituents of a gaseous mixture by means of the eudiometer, or for ascertaining the purity of the air or the amount of oxygen in it.

syndesmology.definition: That part of anatomy which treats of ligaments.

appose.definition:
To place opposite or before; to put or apply (one thing to another). The nymph herself did then appose, For food and beverage, to him all best meat. Chapman. 2. To place in juxtaposition or proximity.

To put questions to; to examine; to try. See Pose. To appose him without any accuser, and that sec.

chlorocruorin.definition: A green substance, supposed to be the cause of the green color of the blood in some species of worms. Ray Lankester.

vindicator.definition: One who vindicates; one who justifies or maintains. Locke.

gyro-pigeon.definition: A flying object simulating a pigeon in flight, when projected from a spring trap. It is used as a flying target in shooting matches. Knight.

durukuli.definition: A small, nocturnal, South American monkey (Nyctipthecus trivirgatus). [Written also douroucouli.].

superiorly.definition: In a superior position or manner.

supervise.definition:
To oversee for direction; to superintend; to inspect with authority; as, to supervise the construction of a steam engine, or the printing of a book. 2. To look over so as to read; to peruse. Shak. Syn. -- See Superintend.

Supervision; inspection.

praecipe.definition: (a) A writ commanding something to be done, or requiring a reason for neglecting it. (b) A paper containing the particulars of a writ, lodged in the office out of which the writ is to be issued. Wharton.

disengagement.definition: The act of disengaging or setting free, or the state of being disengaged. It is easy to render this disengagement of caloric and light evident to the senses. Transl. of Lavoisier. A disengagement from earthly trammels. Sir W. Jones. 2. Freedom from engrossing occupation; leisure. Disengagement is ab.

quartan.definition:
Of or pertaining to the fourth; occurring every fourth day, reckoning inclusively; as, a quartan ague, or fever.

1. (Med.)  An intermittent fever which returns every fourth day, reckoning inclusively, that is, one in which the interval between paroxysms is two days. 2. A measure, the fourth part of.

dur.definition: Major; in the major mode; as, C dur, that is, C major.

sloughing.definition: The act of casting off the skin or shell, as do insects and crustaceans; ecdysis.

tetrarchical.definition: Of or pertaining to a tetrarch or tetrarchy. Bolingbroke.

epigraphy.definition: The science of inscriptions; the art of engraving inscriptions or of deciphering them.

react.definition:
To act or perform a second time; to do over again; as, to react a play; the same scenes were reacted at Rome.

1. To return an impulse or impression; to resist the action of another body by an opposite force; as, every body reacts on the body that impels it from its natural state. 2. To act upon eac.

ambulation.definition: The act of walking. Sir T. Browne.

phalaena.definition: A linnæan genus which included the moths in general.

linum.definition: A genus of herbaceous plants including the flax (Linum usitatissimum).

numerative.definition: Of or pertaining to numeration; as, a numerative system. Eng. Cyc.

spellbind.definition: To bind or hold by, or as if by, a spell or charm; to fascinate, esp. by eloquence of speech, as in a political campaign. - - Spell"bind`er (#), n.

antitheist.definition: A disbeliever in the existence of God.

assessor.definition: One appointed or elected to assist a judge or magistrate with his special knowledge of the subject to be decided; as legal assessors, nautical assessors. Mozley & W. 2. One who sits by another, as next in dignity, or as an assistant and adviser; an associate in office. Whence to his Son, The assesso.

enoptomancy.definition: Divination by the use of a mirror.

titularity.definition: The quality or state of being titular. Sir T. Browne.

intelligently.definition: In an intelligent manner; with intelligence.

antiochian.definition: Pertaining to Antiochus, a contemporary with Cicero, and the founder of a sect of philosophers. 2. Of or pertaining to the city of Antioch, in Syria. Antiochian epoch (Chron.), a method of computing time, from the proclamation of liberty granted to the city of Antioch, about the time of the battle o.

burgess.definition: An inhabitant of a borough or walled town, or one who possesses a tenement therein; a citizen or freeman of a borough. Blackstone. Note: "A burgess of a borough corresponds with a citizen of a city." Burrill. 2. One who represents a borough in Parliament. 3. A magistrate of a borough. 4. An inhabita.

enhancer.definition: One who enhances; one who, or that which, raises the amount, price, etc.

dropping.definition: The action of causing to drop or of letting drop; falling. 2. pl.  That which falls in drops; the excrement or dung of animals. Dropping bottle, an instrument used to supply small quantities of a fluid to a test tube or other vessel. -- Dropping fire, a continued irregular discharge of firearms. --.

pillowed.definition: Provided with a pillow or pillows; having the head resting on, or as on, a pillow. Pillowedon buckler cold and hard. Sir W. Scott.

araguato.definition: A South American monkey, the ursine howler (Mycetes ursinus). See Howler, n., 2.

pitcher.definition:
One who pitches anything, as hay, quoits, a ball, etc.; specifically (Baseball), the player who delivers the ball to the batsman. 2. A sort of crowbar for digging. Mortimer.

1. A wide-mouthed, deep vessel for holding liquids, with a spout or protruding lip and a handle; a water jug or jar with a la.

drysalter.definition: A dealer in salted or dried meats, pickles, sauces, etc., and in the materials used in pickling, salting, and preserving various kinds of food Hence drysalters usually sell a number of saline substances and miscellaneous drugs. Brande & C.

unturned.definition: Not turned; not revolved or reversed. To leave no stone unturned, to leave nothing untried for accomplishing one's purpose. [He] left unturned no stone To make my guilt appear, and hide his own. Dryden.

athleticism.definition: The practice of engaging in athletic games; athletism.

polythelism.definition: The condition of having more than two teats, or nipples.

cambistry.definition: The science of exchange, weight, measures, etc.

ethiop.definition: A native or inhabitant of Ethiopia; also, in a general sense, a negro or black man.

laic.definition:
Of or pertaining to a layman or the laity. "Laical literature." Lowell. An unprincipled, unedified, and laic rabble. Milton.

A layman. Bp. Morton.

justness.definition: The quality of being just; conformity to truth, propriety, accuracy, exactness, and the like; justice; reasonableness; fairness; equity; as, justness of proportions; the justness of a description or representation; the justness of a cause. In value the satisfaction I had in seeing it represented wit.

categorize.definition: To insert in a category or list; to class; to catalogue.

flock.definition: A company or collection of living creatures; -- especially applied to sheep and birds, rarely to persons or (except in the plural) to cattle and other large animals; as, a flock of ravenous fowl. Milton. The heathen . . . came to Nicanor by flocks. 2 Macc. xiv. 14. 2. A Christian church or congregat.

danseuse.definition: a professional female dancer; a woman who dances at a public exhibition as in a ballet.

one-sided.definition: Having one side only, or one side prominent; hence, limited to one side; partial; unjust; unfair; as, a one-sided view or statement. "Unguarded and one-sided language." T. Arnold. 2. (Bot.)  Growing on one side of a stem; as, one-sided flowers. -- One`-sid"ed-ly, adv. -- One`-sid"ed*ness, n.

pariah.definition: One of an aboriginal people of Southern India, regarded by the four castes of the Hindoos as of very low grade. They are usually the serfs of the Sudra agriculturalists. See Caste. Balfour (Cyc. of India). 2. An outcast; one despised by society. Pariah dog (Zoöl.), a mongrel race of half-wild dogs w.

civility.definition: The state of society in which the relations and duties of a citizen are recognized and obeyed; a state of civilization. Monarchies have risen from barbarrism to civility, and fallen again to ruin. Sir J. Davies. The gradual depature of all deeper signification from the word civility has obliged the.

whally.definition: Having the iris of light color; -- said of horses. "Whally eyes." Spenser.

albuminin.definition: The substance of the cells which inclose the white of birds' eggs.

glycoluric.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, glycol and urea; as, glycoluric acid, which is called also hydantoic acid.

centrale.definition: The central, or one of the central, bones of the carpus or or tarsus. In the tarsus of man it is represented by the navicular.

gryphaea.definition: A genus of cretaceous fossil shells allied to the oyster.

modillion.definition: The enriched block or horizontal bracket generally found under the cornice of the Corinthian and Composite entablature, and sometimes, less ornamented, in the Ionic and other orders; -- so called because of its arrangement at regulated distances.

myxa.definition: The distal end of the mandibles of a bird.

mockery.definition: The act of mocking, deriding, and exposing to contempt, by mimicry, by insincere imitation, or by a false show of earnestness; a counterfeit appearance. It is, as the air, invulnerable, And our vain blows malicious mockery. Shak. Grace at meals is now generally so performed as to look more like a mo.

undercrest.definition: To support as a crest; to bear. [Obs. & R.] Shak.

attainable.definition: Capable of being attained or reached by efforts of the mind or body; capable of being compassed or accomplished by efforts directed to the object. The highest pitch of perfection attainable in this life. Addison. 2. Obtainable. General Howe would not permit the purchase of those articles [clothes an.

eleuthero-petalous.definition: Having the petals free, that is, entirely separate from each other; -- said of both plant and flower.

endosarc.definition: The semifluid, granular interior of certain unicellular organisms, as the inner layer of sarcode in the amoeba; entoplasm; endoplasta.

virtuosoship.definition: The condition, pursuits, or occupation of a virtuoso. Bp. Hurd.

religieuse.definition: A person bound by monastic vows; a nun; a monk.

concerto.definition: A composition (usually in symphonic form with three movements) in which one instrument (or two or three) stands out in bold relief against the orchestra, or accompaniment, so as to display its qualities or the performer's skill.

tributary.definition: Paying tribute to another, either from compulsion, as an acknowledgment of submission, or to secure protection, or for the purpose of purchasing peace. [Julius] unto Rome made them tributary. Chaucer. 2. Hence, subject; subordinate; inferior. He to grace his tributary gods. Milton. 3. Paid in tribut.

toman.definition: A money of account in Persia, whose value varies greatly at different times and places. Its average value may be reckoned at about two and a half dollars.

autoecious.definition: Passing through all its stages on one host, as certain parasitic fungi; -- contrasted with heterocious.

inquirable.definition: Capable of being inquired into; subject or liable to inquisition or inquest. Bacon.

ashes.definition: The earthy or mineral particles of combustible substances remaining after combustion, as of wood or coal. 2. Specifically: The remains of the human body when burnt, or when "returned to dust" by natural decay. Their martyred blood and ashes sow. Milton. The coffins were broken open. The ashes were s.

balm.definition: (Bot.)  An aromatic plant of the genus Melissa. 2. The resinous and aromatic exudation of certain trees or shrubs. Dryden. 3. Any fragrant ointment. Shak. 4. Anything that heals or that mitigates pain. "Balm for each ill." Mrs. Hemans. Balm cricket (Zoöl.), the European cicada. Tennyson. -- Balm of.

impatiens.definition: A genus of plants, several species of which have very beautiful flowers; -- so called because the elastic capsules burst when touched, and scatter the seeds with considerable force. Called also touch-me-not, jewelweed, and snapweed. I. Balsamina (sometimes called lady's slipper) is the common garden.

margarodite.definition: A hidrous potash mica related to muscovite.

pigmented.definition: Colored; specifically (Biol.), filled or imbued with pigment; as, pigmented epithelial cells; pigmented granules.

verbalism.definition: Something expressed verbally; a verbal remark or expression.

desultorily.definition: In a desultory manner; without method; loosely; immethodically.

pulvillus.definition: One of the minute cushions on the feet of certain insects.

inexpansible.definition: Incapable of expansion, enlargement, or extension. Tyndall.

parapet.definition: (Arch.)  A low wall, especially one serving to protect the edge of a platform, roof, bridge, or the like. 2. (Fort.)  A wall, rampart, or elevation of earth, for covering soldiers from an enemy's fire; a breastwork. See Illust. of Casemate.

joyless.definition: Not having joy; not causing joy; unenjoyable. -- Joy"less*ly, adv. -- Joy"less*ness, n. With downcast eyes the joyless victor sat. Dryden. Youth and health and war are joyless to him. Addison. [He] pining for the lass, Is joyless of the grove, and spurns the growing grass. Dryden.

subscript.definition:
Written below or underneath; as, iota subscript. (See under Iota.) Specifically (Math.), said of marks, figures, or letters (suffixes), written below and usually to the right of other letters to distinguish them; as, a, n, 2, in the symbols Xa, An, Y2. See Suffix, n., 2, and Subindex.

Anything writ.

sweepstakes.definition: A winning of all the stakes or prizes; a sweepstake. 2. sing. or pl.  The whole money or other things staked at a horse race, a given sum being put up for each horse, all of which goes to the winner, or is divided among several, as may be previously agreed. 3. A race for all the sums staked or prize.

catarrh.definition: An inflammatory affection of any mucous membrane, in which there are congestion, swelling, and an altertion in the quantity and quality of mucus secreted; as catarrh of the stomach; catarrh of the bladder. Note: In America, the term catarrh is applied especially to a chronic inflammation of, and hyp.

hastener.definition: One who hastens. 2. That which hastens; especially, a stand or reflector used for confining the heat of the fire to meat while roasting before it.

namation.definition: A distraining or levying of a distress; an impounding. Burrill.

neal.definition:
To anneal. Chaucer.

To be tempered by heat. Bacon.

outness.definition: The state of being out or beyond; separateness. 2. (Metaph.)  The state or quality of being distanguishable from the perceiving mind, by being in space, and possessing marerial quality; externality; objectivity. The outness of the objects of sense. Sir W. Hamiltom.

tentaculated.definition: Having tentacles, or organs like tentacles; tentacled.

antipyretic.definition: Efficacious in preventing or allaying fever. -- n.  A febrifuge.

circuitous.definition: Going round in a circuit; roundabout; indirect; as, a circuitous road; a circuitous manner of accompalishing an end. -- Cir*cu"i*tous*ly, adv. -- Cir*cu"i*tous*ness, n. Syn. -- Tortuous; winding; sinuous; serpentine.

paneling.definition: A forming in panels; panelwork. [Written also panelling.].

bulbar.definition: Of or pertaining to bulb; especially, in medicine, pertaining to the bulb of the spinal cord, or medulla oblongata; as, bulbar paralysis.

barrulet.definition: A diminutive of the bar, having one fourth its width.

accountantship.definition: The office or employment of an accountant.

futtock.definition: One of the crooked timbers which are scarfed together to form the lower part of the compound rib of a vessel; one of the crooked transverse timbers passing across and over the keel. Futtock plates (Naut.), plates of iron to which the dead-eyes of the topmast rigging are secured. -- Futtock shrouds,.

conglomeration.definition: The act or process of gathering into a mass; the state of being thus collected; collection; accumulation; that which is conglomerated; a mixed mass. Bacon.

autostability.definition: Automatic stability; also, inherent stability. An aëroplane is inherently stable if it keeps in steady poise by virtue of its shape and proportions alone; it is automatically stable if it keeps in steady poise by means of self-operative mechanism.

petrolatum.definition: A semisolid unctuous substance, neutral, and without taste or odor, derived from petroleum by distilling off the lighter portions and purifying the residue. It is a yellowish, fatlike mass, transparent in thin layers, and somewhat fluorescent. It is used as a bland protective dressing, and as a subs.

gaysome.definition: Full of gayety. Mir. for Mag.

grizzle.definition: Gray; a gray color; a mixture of white and black. Shak.

pterosaurian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Pterosauria.

ten-strike.definition: (Tenpins)  A knocking down of all ten pins at one delivery of the ball. [U. S.] 2. Any quick, decisive stroke or act. [Colloq. U.S.].

prore.definition: The prow or fore part of a ship. [Poetic] "Galleys with vermilion prores." Pope.

ghyll.definition: A ravine. See Gill a woody glen. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Wordsworth.

twankay.definition: See Note under Tea, n., 1. 'T WAS 'T was.  A contraction of it was.

mechanic.definition: The art of the application of the laws of motion or force to construction. 2. A mechanician; an artisan; an artificer; one who practices any mechanic art; one skilled or employed in shaping and uniting materials, as wood, metal, etc., into any kind of structure, machine, or other object, requiring t.

water-closet.definition: A privy; especially, a privy furnished with a contrivance for introducing a stream of water to cleanse it.

saltpetrous.definition: Pertaining to saltpeter, or partaking of its qualities; impregnated with saltpeter.

siderolite.definition: A kind of meteorite. See under Meteorite.

thermostat.definition: A self-acting apparatus for regulating temperature by the unequal expansion of different metals, liquids, or gases by heat, as in opening or closing the damper of a stove, or the like, as the heat becomes greater or less than is desired.

bark.definition:
To strip the bark from; to peel. 2. To abrade or rub off any outer covering from; as to bark one's heel. 3. To girdle. See Girdle, v. t., 3. 4. To cover or inclose with bark, or as with bark; as, to bark the roof of a hut.

1. To make a short, loud, explosive noise with the vocal organs; -- said of.

bollandists.definition: The Jesuit editors of the "Acta Sanctorum", or Lives of the Saints; -- named from John Bolland, who began the work.

loving-kindness.definition: Tender regard; mercy; favor. Ps. lxxxix. 33.

yttro-tantalite.definition: A tantalate of uranium, yttrium, and calcium, of a brown or black color.

nucament.definition: A catkin or ament; the flower cluster of the hazel, pine, willow, and the like.

seasonable.definition: Occurring in good time, in due season, or in proper time for the purpose; suitable to the season; opportune; timely; as, a seasonable supply of rain. Mercy is seasonable in the time of affliction. Ecclus. xxxv. 20. -- Sea"son*a*ble*ness, n. -- Sea"son*a*bly, adv.

slammerkin.definition: A slut; a slatternly woman. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.].

quinogen.definition: A hypothetical radical of quinine and related alkaloids.

tyne.definition:
To lose. [Obs. or Scot.] "His bliss gan he tyne." Piers Plowman. Sir W. Scott.

To become lost; to perish. Spenser.

A prong or point of an antler.

Anxiety; tine. "With labor and long tyne." Spenser.

odalwoman.definition: A man or woman having odal, or able to share in it by inheritance.

drumly.definition: Turbid; muddy. [Scot. & Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Wodroephe (1623). Burns.

olived.definition: Decorated or furnished with olive trees. T. Warton.

popish.definition: Of or pertaining to the pope; taught or ordained by the pope; hence, of or pertaining to the Roman Catholic Church; -- often used opprobriously. -- Pop"ish*ly, adv. -- Pop"ish*ness, n.

gyropigeon.definition: A flying object simulating a pigeon in flight, when projected from a spring trap. It is used as a flying target in shooting matches. Knight.

stout.definition: Strong; lusty; vigorous; robust; sinewy; muscular; hence, firm; resolute; dauntless. With hearts stern and stout. Chaucer. A stouter champion never handled sword. Shak. He lost the character of a bold, stout, magnanimous man. Clarendon. The lords all stand To clear their cause, most resolutely stout.

putrifacted.definition: Putrefied. What vermin bred of putrifacted slime. Marston.

coprolite.definition: A piece of petrified dung; a fossil excrement.

unabsorbable.definition: Not absorbable; specifically (Physiol.), not capable of absorption; unable to pass by osmosis into the circulating blood; as, the unabsorbable portion of food.

flatulently.definition: In a flatulent manner; with flatulence.

communion.definition: The act of sharing; community; participation. "This communion of goods." Blackstone. 2. Intercourse between two or more persons; esp., intimate association and intercourse implying sympathy and confidence; interchange of thoughts, purposes, etc.; agreement; fellowship; as, the communion of saints. W.

croak.definition: To make a low, hoarse noise in the throat, as a frog, a raven, or a crow; hence, to make any hoarse, dismal sound. Loud thunder to its bottom shook the bog, And the hoarse nation croaked. Pope. 2. To complain; especially, to grumble; to forebode evil; to utter complaints or forebodings habitually. M.

gradate.definition: To grade or arrange (parts in a whole, colors in painting, etc.), so that they shall harmonize. 2. (Chem.)  To bring to a certain strength or grade of concentration; as, to gradate a saline solution.

therewith.definition: With that or this. "I have learned in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content." Phil. iv. 11. 2. In addition; besides; moreover. To speak of strength and therewith hardiness. Chaucer. 3. At the same time; forthwith. Johnson.

headrope.definition: That part of a boltrope which is sewed to the upper edge or head of a sail.

retinal.definition: Of or pertaining to the retina. Retinal purple (Physiol. Chem.), the visual purple.

cocaine.definition: A powerful alkaloid, C17H21NO4, obtained from the leaves of coca. It is a bitter, white, crystalline substance, and is remarkable for producing local insensibility to pain.

podalgia.definition: pain in the foot, due to gout, rheumatism, etc.

athwart.definition: Across; from side to side of. Athwart the thicket lone. Tennyson. 2. (Naut.)  Across the direction or course of; as, a fleet standing athwart our course. Athwart hawse, across the stem of another vessel, whether in contact or at a small distance. -- Athwart ships, across the ship from side to side,.

sirocco.definition: An oppressive, relaxing wind from the Libyan deserts, chiefly experienced in Italy, Malta, and Sicily.

preparator.definition: One who prepares beforehand, as subjects for dissection, specimens for preservation in collections, etc. Agassiz.

ambrosial.definition: Consisting of, or partaking of the nature of, ambrosia; delighting the taste or smell; delicious. "Ambrosial food." "Ambrosial fragrance." Milton. 2. Divinely excellent or beautiful. "Shakes his ambrosial curls." Pope.

determinate.definition: Having defined limits; not uncertain or arbitrary; fixed; established; definite. Quantity of words and a determinate number of feet. Dryden. 2. Conclusive; decisive; positive. The determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God. Acts ii. 23. 3. Determined or resolved upon. My determinate voyage. Shak.

inquinate.definition: To defile; to pollute; to contaminate; to befoul. Sir T. Browne.

catechumenical.definition: Of or pertaining to catechumens; as, catechumenical instructions.

dosimetry.definition: Measurement of doses; specif., a system of therapeutics which uses but few remedies, mostly alkaloids, and gives them in doses fixed by certain rules. --Do`si*met"ric (#), a. --Do*sim"e*trist (#), n.
