saurognathous.definition: Having the bones of the palate arranged as in saurians, the vomer consisting of two lateral halves, as in the woodpeckers. (Pici).

misgiving.definition: Evil premonition; doubt; distrust. "Suspicious and misgivings." South.

expedition.definition: The quality of being expedite; efficient promptness; haste; dispatch; speed; quickness; as to carry the mail with expedition. With winged expedition Swift as the lightning glance. 2. A sending forth or setting forth the execution of some object of consequence; progress. Putting it straight in expedi.

harmonize.definition: To agree in action, adaptation, or effect on the mind; to agree in sense or purport; as, the parts of a mechanism harmonize. 2. To be in peace and friendship, as individuals, families, or public organizations. 3. To agree in vocal or musical effect; to form a concord; as, the tones harmonize perfect.

discompany.definition: To free from company; to dissociate. It she be alone now, and discompanied. B. Jonson.

kain.definition: Poultry, etc., required by the lease to be paid in kind by a tenant to his landlord. Wharton (Law Dict.).

flabbergast.definition: To astonish; to strike with wonder, esp. by extraordinary statements. [Jocular] Beaconsfield.

astrofell.definition: A bitter herb, probably the same as aster, or starwort. Spenser.

mainpernor.definition: A surety, under the old writ of mainprise, for a prisoner's appearance in court at a day. Note: Mainpernors differ from bail in that a man's bail may imprison or surrender him before the stipulated day of appearance; mainpernors can do neither; they are bound to produce him to answer all charges wha.

chartless.definition: Without a chart; having no guide. 2. Not mapped; uncharted; vague. Barlow.

relumine.definition: To light anew; to rekindle. Shak. 2. To illuminate again.

unconcerning.definition: Not interesting of affecting; insignificant; not belonging to one. Addison.

full-blown.definition: Fully expanded, as a blossom; as, a full-bloun rose. Denham. 2. Fully distended with wind, as a sail. Dryden.

characterize.definition: To make distinct and recognizable by peculiar marks or traits; to make with distinctive features. European, Asiatic, Chinese, African, and Grecian faces are Characterized. Arbuthot. 2. To engrave or imprint. Sir M. Hale. 3. To indicate the character of; to describe. Under the name of Tamerlane he in.

languorous.definition: Producing, or tending to produce, languor; characterized by languor. [Obs. or Poetic] Whom late I left in languorous constraint. Spenser. To wile the length from languorous hours, and draw The sting from pain. Tennyson.

amphibian.definition:
Of or pertaining to the Amphibia; as, amphibian reptiles.

One of the Amphibia.

drowse.definition:
To sleep imperfectly or unsoundly; to slumber; to be heavy with sleepiness; to doze. "He drowsed upon his couch." South. In the pool drowsed the cattle up to their knees. Lowell.

To make heavy with sleepiness or imperfect sleep; to make dull or stupid. Milton.

A slight or imperfect sleep; a doze.

mesonephric.definition: Of or pertaining to the mesonephros; as, the mesonephric, or Wolffian, duct.

screenings.definition: The refuse left after screening sand, coal, ashes, etc.

perpetuate.definition:
To make perpetual; to cause to endure, or to be continued, indefinitely; to preserve from extinction or oblivion; to eternize. Addison. Burke.

Made perpetual; perpetuated. Southey.

vigesimo-quarto.definition:
Having twenty-four leaves to a sheet; as, a vigesimo-quarto form, book, leaf, size, etc.

A book composed of sheets each of which is folded into twenty- four leaves; hence, indicating more or less definitely a size of book so made; -- usually written 24mo, or 24º.

thymiatechny.definition: The art of employing perfumes in medicine. Dunglison.

stiffness.definition: The quality or state of being stiff; as, the stiffness of cloth or of paste; stiffness of manner; stiffness of character. The vices of old age have the stiffness of it too. South.

bout.definition: As much of an action as is performed at one time; a going and returning, as of workmen in reaping, mowing, etc.; a turn; a round. In notes with many a winding bout Of linked sweetness long drawn out. Milton. The prince . . . has taken me in his train, so that I am in no danger of starving for this b.

depurate.definition:
Depurated; cleansed; freed from impurities. Boyle.

To free from impurities, heterogeneous matter, or feculence; to purify; to cleanse. To depurate the mass of blood. Boyle.

elysium.definition: A dwelling place assigned to happy souls after death; the seat of future happiness; Paradise. 2. Hence, any delightful place. An Elysian more pure and bright than that pf the Greeks. I. Taylor.

lardacein.definition: A peculiar amyloid substance, colored blue by iodine and sulphuric acid, occurring mainly as an abnormal infiltration into the spleen, liver, etc.

credible.definition: Capable of being credited or believed; worthy of belief; entiled to confidence; trustworthy. Things are made credible either by the known condition and quality of the utterer or by the manifest likelihood of truth in themselves. Hooker. A very diligent and observing person, and likewise very sober a.

autohypnotic.definition: Pert. to autohypnotism; self-hypnotizing. -- n.  An autohypnotic person.

sangaree.definition: Wine and water sweetened and spiced, -- a favorite West Indian drink.

gesture.definition: Manner of carrying the body; position of the body or limbs; posture. Accubation, or lying down at meals, was a gesture used by many nations. Sir T. Browne. 2. A motion of the body or limbs expressive of sentiment or passion; any action or posture intended to express an idea or a passion, or to enfor.

spritefully.definition: See Sprightful, Sprightfully, Sprightliness, Sprightly, etc.

dishonor.definition: Lack of honor; disgrace; ignominy; shame; reproach. It was not meet for us to see the king's dishonor. Ezra iv. 14. His honor rooted in dishonor stood. Tennyson. 2. (Law)  The nonpayment or nonacceptance of commercial paper by the party on whom it is drawn. Syn. -- Disgrace; ignominy; shame; censure.

diabolify.definition: To ascribed diabolical qualities to; to change into, or to represent as, a devil. Farindon.

arguable.definition: Capable of being argued; admitting of debate.

inceptor.definition: A beginner; one in the rudiments. Johnson. 2. One who is on the point of taking the degree of master of arts at an English university. Walton.

spinstry.definition: The business of one who spins; spinning. Milton.

latibulum.definition: A concealed hiding place; a burrow; a lair; a hole.

prettiness.definition: The quality or state of being pretty; -- used sometimes in a disparaging sense. A style . . . without sententious pretension or antithetical prettiness. Jeffrey.

coppering.definition: The act of covering with copper. 2. An envelope or covering of copper.

cress.definition: A plant of various species, chiefly cruciferous. The leaves have a moderately pungent taste, and are used as a salad and antiscorbutic. Note: The garden cress, called also peppergrass, is the Lepidium sativum; the water cress is the Nasturtium officinale. Various other plants are sometimes called cr.

gland.definition: (Anat.) (a) An organ for secreting something to be used in, or eliminated from, the body; as, the sebaceous glands of the skin; the salivary glands of the mouth. (b) An organ or part which resembles a secreting, or true, gland, as the ductless, lymphatic, pineal, and pituitary glands, the functions.

countersway.definition: A swaying in a contrary direction; an opposing influence. A countersway of restraint, curbing their wild exorbitance. Milton.

mainsheet.definition: One of the ropes by which the mainsail is hauled aft and trimmed.

cerotin.definition: A white crystalline substance, C27H55.OH, obtained from Chinese wax, and regarded as an alcohol of the marsh gas series; -- called also cerotic alcohol, ceryl alcohol.

ephemerist.definition: One who studies the daily motions and positions of the planets. Howell. 2. One who keeps an ephemeris; a journalist.

theomachist.definition: One who fights against the gods; one who resists God of the divine will.

halidom.definition: Holiness; sanctity; sacred oath; sacred things; sanctuary; -- used chiefly in oaths. [Archaic] So God me help and halidom. Piers Plowman. By my halidom, I was fast asleep. Shak. 2. Holy doom; the Last Day. Shipley.

materially.definition: In the state of matter. I do not mean that anything is separable from a body by fire that was not materially preëxistent in it. Boyle. 2. In its essence; substantially. An ill intention is certainly sufficient to spoil . . . an act in itself materially good. South. 3. In an important manner or degre.

perturbative.definition: Tending to cause perturbation; disturbing. Sir J. Herschel.

beet.definition: (Bot.)  A biennial plant of the genus Beta, which produces an edible root the first year and seed the second year. 2. The root of plants of the genus Beta, different species and varieties of which are used for the table, for feeding stock, or in making sugar. Note: There are many varieties of the co.

numismatology.definition: The science which treats of coins and medals, in their relation to history; numismatics.

discretional.definition: Left to discretion; unrestrained except by discretion or judgment; as, an ambassador with discretionary powers.

elinguation.definition: Punishment by cutting out the tongue.

warehouseman.definition: One who keeps a warehouse; the owner or keeper of a dock warehouse or wharf store. 2. One who keeps a wholesale shop or store for Manchester or woolen goods. [Eng.] Warehouseman's itch (Med.), a form of eczema occurring on the back of the hands of warehousemen.

inaniloquous.definition: Given to talking inanely; loquacious; garrulous.

imposer.definition: One who imposes. The imposers of these oaths might repent. Walton.

rogatory.definition: Seeking information; authorized to examine witnesses or ascertain facts; as, a rogatory commission. Woolsey.

dodecastyle.definition: Having twelve columns in front. -- n.  A dodecastyle portico, or building.

pers.definition: Light blue; grayish blue; -- a term applied to different shades at different periods. -- n.  A cloth of sky-blue color. "A long surcoat of pers." Chaucer.

swagman.definition: A bushman carrying a swag and traveling on foot; -- called also swagsman, swagger, and swaggie.

solarium.definition: An apartment freely exposed to the sun; anciently, an apartment or inclosure on the roof of a house; in modern times, an apartment in a hospital, used as a resort for convalescents. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any one of several species of handsome marine spiral shells of the genus Solarium and allied genera. The s.

laager.definition:
A camp, esp. one with an inclosure of travelers' wagons for temporary defense. [South Africa] Wagons . . . can be readily formed into a laager, a camp, by being drawn into a circle, with the oxen placed inside and so kept safe from the attacks of wild beasts. James Bryce.

To form into, or camp in,.

filch.definition: To steal or take privily (commonly, that which is of little value); to pilfer. Fain would they filch that little food away. Dryden. But he that filches from me my good name, Robs me of that which not enriches him, And makes me poor indeed. Shak.

concurring.definition: Agreeing. Concurring figure (Geom.), one which, being laid on another, exactly meets every part of it, or one which correspondends with another in all its parts.

augur.definition: (Rom. Antiq.)  An official diviner who foretold events by the singing, chattering, flight, and feeding of birds, or by signs or omens derived from celestial phenomena, certain appearances of quadrupeds, or unusual occurrences. 2. One who foretells events by omens; a soothsayer; a diviner; a prophet.

eardrum.definition: The tympanum. See Illust. of Ear.

fumy.definition: Producing fumes; fumous. "Drowned in fumy wine." H. Brooke.

leet.definition:
of Let, to allow. Chaucer.

A portion; a list, esp. a list of candidates for an office. [Scot.]

A court-leet; the district within the jurisdiction of a court- leet; the day on which a court-leet is held. Shak. Note: The original intent of the court-leet was to view the frankpledges or freemen withi.

briny.definition: Of or pertaining to brine, or to the sea; partaking of the nature of brine; salt; as, a briny taste; the briny flood.

oily.definition: Consisting of oil; containing oil; having the nature or qualities of oil; unctuous; oleaginous; as, oily matter or substance. Bacon. 2. Covered with oil; greasy; hence, resembling oil; as, an oily appearance. 3. Smoothly subservient; supple; compliant; plausible; insinuating. "This oily rascal." Sha.

gipoun.definition: A short cassock. [Written also gepoun, gypoun, jupon, juppon.].

opposeless.definition: Not to be effectually opposed; irresistible. "Your great opposeless wills." Shak.

coldness.definition: The state or quality of being cold.

homilist.definition: One who prepares homilies; one who preaches to a congregation.

classify.definition: To distribute into classes; to arrange according to a system; to arrnge in sets according to some method founded on common properties or characters. Syn. -- To arrange; distibute; rank.

phratry.definition: A subdivision of a phyle, or tribe, in Athens.

try-square.definition: An instrument used by carpenters, joiners, etc., for laying off right angles off right angles, and testing whether work is square.

myricin.definition: A silky, crystalline, waxy substance, forming the less soluble part of beeswax, and regarded as a palmitate of a higher alcohol of the paraffin series; -- called also myricyl alcohol.

nymphish.definition: Relating to nymphs; ladylike. "Nymphish war." Drayton.

panegyrize.definition:
To praise highly; to extol in a public speech; to write or deliver a panegyric upon; to eulogize.

To indulge in panegyrics. Mitford.

unsincerity.definition: The quality or state of being unsincere or impure; insincerity. Boyle.

crunodal.definition: Possessing, or characterized by, a crunode; -- used of curves.

healthiness.definition: The state of being healthy or healthful; freedom from disease.

sparble.definition: To scatter; to disperse; to rout. The king's host was sparbled and chased. Fabyan.

doorsill.definition: The sill or threshold of a door.

serenade.definition:
(a) Music sung or performed in the open air at nights; -- usually applied to musical entertainments given in the open air at night, especially by gentlemen, in a spirit of gallantry, under the windows of ladies. (b) A piece of music suitable to be performed at such times.

To entertain with a serena.

manation.definition: The act of issuing or flowing out.

astray.definition: Out of the right, either in a literal or in a figurative sense; wandering; as, to lead one astray. Ye were as sheep going astray. 1 Pet. ii. 25.

essoin.definition: (Eng. Law)  An excuse for not appearing in court at the return of process; the allegation of an excuse to the court. 2. Excuse; exemption. From every work he challenged essoin. Spenser. Essoin day (Eng. Law), the first general return day of the term, on which the court sits to receive essoins. Black.

stoping.definition: The act of excavating in the form of stopes.

blameworthy.definition: Deserving blame; culpable; reprehensible. -- Blame"wor`thi*ness, n.

cohesibility.definition: The state of being cohesible. Good.

equate.definition: To make equal; to reduce to an average; to make such an allowance or correction in as will reduce to a common standard of comparison; to reduce to mean time or motion; as, to equate payments; to equate lines of railroad for grades or curves; equated distances. Palgrave gives both scrolle and scrowe.

camelry.definition: Troops that are mounted on camels.

contemplate.definition: To look at on all sides or in all its bearings; to view or consider with continued attention; to regard with deliberate care; to meditate on; to study. To love, at least contemplate and admire, What I see excellent. Milton. We thus dilate Our spirits to the size of that they contemplate. Byron. 2. T.

linden.definition: (a) A handsome tree (Tilia Europæa), having cymes of light yellow flowers, and large cordate leaves. The tree is common in Europe. (b) In America, the basswood, or Tilia Americana.

lacunous.definition: Furrowed or pitted; having shallow cavities or lacunæ; as, a lacunose leaf.

mythologue.definition: A fabulous narrative; a myth. May we not ... consider his history of the fall as an excellent mythologue, to account for the origin of human evil Geddes.

immutation.definition: Change; alteration; mutation. Dr. H. More.

incommodity.definition: Inconvenience; trouble; annoyance; disadvantage; encumbrance. [Archaic] Bunyan. A great incommodity to the body. Jer. Taylor. Buried him under a bulk of incommodities. Hawthorne.

glumella.definition: One of the pelets or inner chaffy scales of the flowers or spikelets of grasses.

strong-water.definition: An acid. 2. Distilled or ardent spirits; intoxicating liquor.

strigose.definition: Set with stiff, straight bristles; hispid; as, a strigose leaf.

coquet.definition:
To attempt to attract the notice, admiration, or love of; to treat with a show of tenderness or regard, with a view to deceive and disappoint. You are coquetting a maid of honor. Swift.

To trifle in love; to stimulate affection or interest; to play the coquette; to deal playfully instead of serious.

ormuzd.definition: The good principle, or being, of the ancient Persian religion. See Ahriman.

shallow-bodied.definition: Having a moderate depth of hold; -- said of a vessel.

redemptory.definition: Paid for ransom; serving to redeem. "Hector's redemptory price." Chapman.

equinox.definition: The time when the sun enters one of the equinoctial points, that is, about March 21 and September 22. See Autumnal equinox, Vernal equinox, under Autumnal and Vernal. When descends on the Atlantic The gigantic Stormwind of the equinox. Longfellow. 2. Equinoctial wind or storm. Dryden.

protooerganism.definition: An organism whose nature is so difficult to determine that it might be referred to either the animal or the vegetable kingdom.

seminification.definition: Propagation from seed. Sir M. Hale.

bromine.definition: One of the elements, related in its chemical qualities to chlorine and iodine. Atomic weight 79.8. Symbol Br. It is a deep reddish brown liquid of a very disagreeable odor, emitting a brownish vapor at the ordinary temperature. In combination it is found in minute quantities in sea water, and in man.

garran.definition: See Galloway. [Scot. garron or gerron. Jamieson.].

ooetocoid.definition: A half oviparous, or an oviparous, mammal; a marsupial or monotreme.

ataman.definition: A hetman, or chief of the Cossacks.

chaplain.definition: An ecclesiastic who has a chapel, or who performs religious service in a chapel. 2. A clergyman who is officially atteched to the army or navy, to some public institution, or to a family or court, for the purpose of performing divine service. 3. Any person (clergyman or layman) chosen to conduct rel.

pneumonia.definition: Inflammation of the lungs. Note: Catarrhal pneumonia, or Broncho-pneumonia, is inflammation of the lung tissue, associated with catarrh and with marked evidences of inflammation of bronchial membranes, often chronic; -- also called lobular pneumonia, from its affecting single lobules at a time. -- C.

horologiographer.definition: A maker of clocks, watches, or dials.

solemness.definition: Solemnness. Some think he wanted solemnes. Sir H. Wotton.

vaporous.definition: Having the form or nature of vapor. Holland. 2. Full of vapors or exhalations. Shak. The warmer and more vaporous air of the valleys. Derham. 3. Producing vapors; hence, windy; flatulent. Bacon. The food which is most vaporous and perspirable is the most easily digested. Arbuthnot. 4. Unreal; unsubs.

carlot.definition: A churl; a boor; a peasant or countryman. Shak.

meterage.definition: The act of measuring, or the cost of measuring.

homology.definition: The quality of being homologous; correspondence; relation; as, the homologyof similar polygons. 2. (Biol.)  Correspondence or relation in type of structure in contradistinction to similarity of function; as, the relation in structure between the leg and arm of a man; or that between the arm of a man.

up-over.definition: Designating a method of shaft excavation by drifting to a point below, and then raising instead of sinking.

sarcel.definition: One of the outer pinions or feathers of the wing of a bird, esp. of a hawk.

chelidonic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or derived from, the celandine. Cheidonic acid, a weak acid extracted fron the celandine (Chelidonium majus), as a white crystalline substance.

underhanded.definition: Underhand; clandestine. 2. Insufficiently provided with hands or workers; short-handed; sparsely populated. Norway . . . might defy the world, . . . but it is much underhanded now. Coleridge.

marteline.definition: A small hammer used by marble workers and sculptors.

ratihabition.definition: Confirmation or approbation, as of an act or contract. Jer. Tailor.

murther.definition: Murder, n. & v. [Obs. or Prov.] "The treason of the murthering." Chaucer.

longly.definition: With longing desire. Shak. 2. For a long time; hence, wearisomely.

pyruvil.definition: A complex nitrogenous compound obtained by heating together pyruvic acid and urea.

foinery.definition: Thrusting with the foil; fencing with the point, as distinguished from broadsword play. Marston.

weber.definition: The standard unit of electrical quantity, and also of current. See Coulomb, and Amp.

matronhood.definition: The state of being a matron.

percept.definition: That which is perceived. Sir W. Hamilton. The modern discussion between percept and concept, the one sensuous, the other intellectual. Max Müller.

veneration.definition: The act of venerating, or the state of being venerated; the highest degree of respect and reverence; respect mingled with awe; a feeling or sentimental excited by the dignity, wisdom, or superiority of a person, by sacredness of character, by consecration to sacred services, or by hallowed associati.

extravagantly.definition: In an extravagant manner; wildly; excessively; profusely.

spinnaker.definition: A large triangular sail set upon a boom, -- used when running before the wind.

undreamed.definition: Not dreamed, or dreamed of; not thof. Unpathed waters, undreamed shores. Shak.

andiron.definition: A utensil for supporting wood when burning in a fireplace, one being placed on each side; a firedog; as, a pair of andirons.

armadillo.definition: (a) Any edentate animal if the family Dasypidæ, peculiar to America. The body and head are incased in an armor composed of small bony plates. The armadillos burrow in the earth, seldom going abroad except at night. When attacked, they curl up into a ball, presenting the armor on all sides. Their fle.

lyencephala.definition: A group of Mammalia, including the marsupials and monotremes; - - so called because the corpus callosum is rudimentary.

creaturize.definition: To make like a creature; to degrade Degrade and creaturize that mundane soul. Cudworth.

cerastes.definition: A genus of poisonous African serpents, with a horny scale over each eye; the horned viper.

hopbind.definition: The climbing stem of the hop. Blackstone.

yearling.definition:
An animal one year old, or in the second year of its age; -- applied chiefly to cattle, sheep, and horses.

Being a year old. "A yearling bullock to thy name small smoke." Pope.

trichord.definition: An instrument, as a lyre or harp, having three strings.

aclinic.definition: Without inclination or dipping; -- said the magnetic needle balances itself horizontally, having no dip. The aclinic line is also termed the magnetic equator. Prof. August.

cotyloid.definition: (a) Shaped like a cup; as, the cotyloid cavity, which receives the head of the thigh bone. (b) Pertaining to a cotyloid cavity; as, the cotyloid ligament, or notch.

ungain.definition: Ungainly; clumsy; awkward; also, troublesome; inconvenient. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Beau. & Pl.

apostolic.definition: Pertaining to an apostle, or to the apostles, their times, or their peculiar spirit; as, an apostolical mission; the apostolic age. 2. According to the doctrines of the apostles; delivered or taught by the apostles; as, apostolic faith or practice. 3. Of or pertaining to the pope or the papacy; papa.

scunner.definition:
To cause to loathe, or feel disgust at. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.]

To have a feeling of loathing or disgust; hence, to have dislike, prejudice, or reluctance. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.] C. Kingsley.

A feeling of disgust or loathing; a strong prejudice; abhorrence; as, to take a scunner against some one. [Scot.

crib.definition: A manger or rack; a feeding place for animals. The steer lion at one crib shall meet. Pope. 2. A stall for oxen or other cattle. Where no oxen are, the crib is clean. Prov. xiv. 4. 3. A small inclosed bedstead or cot for a child. 4. A box or bin, or similar wooden structure, for storing grain, salt,.

sunflower.definition: Any plant of the genus Helianthus; -- so called probably from the form and color of its flower, which is large disk with yellow rays. The commonly cultivated sunflower is Helianthus annuus, a native of America.

courche.definition: A square piece of linen used formerly by women instead of a cap; a kerchief. [Scot.] [Written also curch.] Jamieson.

woodcutter.definition: A person who cuts wood. 2. An engraver on wood.

flemish.definition: Pertaining to Flanders, or the Flemings. -- n.  The language or dialect spoken by the Flemings; also, collectively, the people of Flanders. Flemish accounts (Naut.), short or deficient accounts. [Humorous]Ham. Nav. Encyc. -- Flemish beauty (Bot.), a well known pear. It is one of few kinds which have.

frightful.definition: Full of fright; affrighted; frightened. See how the frightful herds run from the wood. W. Browne. 2. Full of that which causes fright; exciting alarm; impressing terror; shocking; as, a frightful chasm, or tempest; a frightful appearance. Syn. -- Terrible; dreadful; alarming; fearful; terrific; awfu.

invariable.definition:
Not given to variation or change; unalterable; unchangeable; always uniform. Physical laws which are invariable. I. Taylor. -- In*va"ri*a*ble*ness, n. -- In*va"ri*a*bly, adv.

An invariable quantity; a constant.

knoppern.definition: A kind of gall produced by a gallfly on the cup of an acorn, -- used in tanning and dyeing.

puncher.definition: One who, or that which, punches.

chromatoscope.definition: A reflecting telescope, part of which is made to rotate eccentrically, so as to produce a ringlike image of a star, instead of a point; -- used in studying the scintillation of the stars.

coda.definition: A few measures added beyond the natural termination of a composition.

snotty.definition: Foul with snot; hence, mean; dirty. -- Snort"ti*ly, adb. -- Snot"ti*ness, n.

humiliation.definition: The act of humiliating or humbling; abasement of pride; mortification. Bp. Hopkins. 2. The state of being humiliated, humbled, or reduced to lowliness or submission. The former was a humiliation of Deity; the latter a humiliation of manhood. Hooker.

heathendom.definition: That part of the world where heathenism prevails; the heathen nations, considered collectively. 2. Heathenism. C. Kingsley.

electrometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the quantity or intensity of electricity; also, sometimes, and less properly, applied to an instrument which indicates the presence of electricity (usually called an electroscope). Balance electrometer. See under Balance.

ptyalism.definition: Salivation, or an excessive flow of saliva. Quain.

commutator.definition: A piece of apparatus used for reversing the direction of an electrical current; an attachment to certain electrical machines, by means of which alternating currents are made to be continuous or to have the same direction.

alveated.definition: Formed or vaulted like a beehive.

braggadocio.definition: A braggart; a boaster; a swaggerer. Dryden. 2. Empty boasting; mere brag; pretension.

fuero.definition: (a) A code; a charter; a grant of privileges. (b) A custom having the force of law. (c) A declaration by a magistrate. (d) A place where justice is administered. (e) The jurisdiction of a tribunal. Burrill.

nitre.definition: (Chem.)  A white crystalline semitransparent salt; potassium nitrate; saltpeter. See Saltpeter. 2. (Chem.)  Native sodium carbonate; natron. For though thou wash thee with niter, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me. Jer. ii. 22. Cubic niter, a deliquescent salt, sodium ni.

cavil.definition:
To raise captious and frivolous objections; to find fault without good reason. You do not well in obstinacy To cavil in the course of this contract. Shak.

To cavil at. Milton.

A captious or frivolous objection. All the cavils of prejudice and unbelief. Shak.

One who cavils. Cavilers at the style.

unman.definition: To deprive of the distinctive qualities of a human being, as reason, or the like. South. 2. To emasculate; to deprive of virility. 3. To deprive of the courage and fortitude of a man; to break or subdue the manly spirit in; to cause to despond; to dishearten; to make womanish. Let's not unman each o.

velocipede.definition: A light road carriage propelled by the feet of the rider. Originally it was propelled by striking the tips of the toes on the roadway, but commonly now by the action of the feet on a pedal or pedals connected with the axle of one or more of the wheels, and causing their revolution. They are made in.

antiquate.definition: To make old, or obsolete; to make antique; to make old in such a degree as to put out of use; hence, to make void, or abrogate. Christianity might reasonably introduce new laws, and antiquate or abrogate old one. Sir M. Hale.

apishly.definition: In an apish manner; with servile imitation; foppishly.

gregarine.definition: An order of Protozoa, allied to the Rhizopoda, and parasitic in other animals, as in the earthworm, lobster, etc. When adult, they have a small, wormlike body inclosing a nucleus, but without external organs; in one of the young stages, they are amoebiform; -- called also Gregarinida, and Gregarinar.

amylogen.definition: That part of the starch granule or granulose which is soluble in water.

enfranchisement.definition: Releasing from slavery or custody. Shak. 2. Admission to the freedom of a corporation or body politic; investiture with the privileges of free citizens. Enfranchisement of copyhold (Eng. Law), the conversion of a copyhold estate into a freehold. Mozley & W.

hagiographal.definition: , Pertaining to the hagiographa, or to sacred writings.

paseng.definition: The wild or bezoar goat. See Goat.

liquefiable.definition: Capable of being changed from a solid to a liquid state.

self-willed.definition: Governed by one's own will; not yielding to the wishes of others; obstinate.

tesseral.definition: Of, pertaining to, or containing, tesseræ. 2. (Crystallog.)  Isometric.

polygraphical.definition: Pertaining to, or employed in, polygraphy; as, a polygraphic instrument. 2. Done with a polygraph; as, a polygraphic copy.

crapulence.definition: The sickness occasioned by intemperance; surfeit. Bailey.

hyp.definition:
An abbreviation of hypochonaria; -- usually in plural. Heaven send thou hast not got the hyps. Swift.

To make melancholy. W. Irving.

biuret.definition: A white, crystalline, nitrogenous substance, C2O2N3H5, formed by heating urea. It is intermediate between urea and cyanuric acid.

ordinate.definition:
Well-ordered; orderly; regular; methodical. "A life blissful and ordinate." Chaucer. Ordinate figure (Math.), a figure whose sides and angles are equal; a regular figure.

The distance of any point in a curve or a straight line, measured on a line called the axis of ordinates or on a line parallel t.

caliphate.definition: The office, dignity, or government of a caliph or of the caliphs.

centrolecithal.definition: Having the food yolk placed at the center of the ovum, segmentation being either regular or unequal. Balfour.

tornado.definition: A violent whirling wind; specifically (Meteorol.), a tempest distinguished by a rapid whirling and slow progressive motion, usually accompaned with severe thunder, lightning, and torrents of rain, and commonly of short duration and small breadth; a small cyclone.

trochee.definition: A foot of two syllables, the first long and the second short, as in the Latin word ante, or the first accented and the second unaccented, as in the English word motion; a choreus.

afoul.definition: In collision; entangled. Totten. To run afoul of, to run against or come into collision with, especially so as to become entangled or to cause injury.

peppermint.definition: (Bot.)  An aromatic and pungent plant of the genus Mentha (M. piperita), much used in medicine and confectionery. 2. A volatile oil (oil of peppermint) distilled from the fresh herb; also, a well-known essence or spirit (essence of peppermint) obtained from it. 3. A lozenge of sugar flavored with pe.

comforter.definition: One who administers comfort or consolation. Let no comforter delight mine ear But such a one whose wrongs do suit with mine. Shak. 2. (Script.)  The Holy Spirit, -- reffering to his office of comforting believers. But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he s.

eupittone.definition: A yellow, crystalline substance, resembling aurin, and obtained by the oxidation of pittacal; -- called also eupittonic acid. [Written also eupitton.].

dreadnaught.definition: A fearless person. 2. Hence: A garment made of very thick cloth, that can defend against storm and cold; also, the cloth itself; fearnaught.

miseducate.definition: To educate in a wrong manner.

insinuative.definition: Stealing on or into the confidence or affections; having power to gain favor. "Crafty, insinuative, plausible men." Bp. Reynolds. 2. Using insinuations; giving hints; insinuating; as, insinuative remark.

weather-beaten.definition: Beaten or harassed by the weather; worn by exposure to the weather, especially to severe weather. Shak.

decemviral.definition: Pertaining to the decemvirs in Rome.

extensionist.definition: One who favors or advocates extension.

armure.definition: Armor. Chaucer. 2. A variety of twilled fabric ribbed on the surface.

ambrosian.definition:
Ambrosial. . Jonson.

Of or pertaining to St. Ambrose; as, the Ambrosian office, or ritual, a formula of worship in the church of Milan, instituted by St. Ambrose. Ambrosian chant, the mode of signing or chanting introduced by St. Ambrose in the 4th century.

bouncing.definition: Stout; plump and healthy; lusty; buxom. Many tall and bouncing young ladies. Thackeray. 2. Excessive; big. "A bouncing reckoning." B. & Fl. Bouncing Bet (Bot.), the common soapwort (Saponaria officinalis). Harper's Mag.

brachycatalectic.definition: A verse wanting two syllables at its termination.

panduriform.definition: Obovate, with a concavity in each side, like the body of a violin; fiddle-shaped; as, a panduriform leaf; panduriform color markings of an animal.

preacquaint.definition: To acquaint previously or beforehand. Fielding.

furry.definition: Covered with fur; dressed in fur. "Furry nations." Thomson. 2. Consisting of fur; as, furry spoils. Dryden. 3. Resembling fur.

angelize.definition: To raise to the state of an angel; to render angelic. It ought not to be our object to angelize, nor to brutalize, but to humanize man. W. Taylor.

stail.definition: A handle, as of a mop; a stale. [Eng.].

adjournal.definition: Adjournment; postponement. "An adjournal of the Diet." Sir W. Scott.

halieutics.definition: A treatise upon fish or the art of fishing; ichthyology.

pali.definition:
pl. of Palus.

A dialect descended from Sanskrit, and like that, a dead language, except when used as the sacred language of the Buddhist religion in Farther India, etc.

incontiguous.definition: Not contiguous; not adjoining or in contact; separate. Boyle. -- In`con*tig"u*ous*ly, adv.

residual.definition: Pertaining to a residue; remaining after a part is taken. Residual air (Physiol.), that portion of air contained in the lungs which can not be expelled even by the most violent expiratory effort. It amounts to from 75 to 100 cubic inches. Cf. Supplemental air, under Supplemental. -- Residual error.

scrobicula.definition: One of the smooth areas surrounding the tubercles of a sea urchin.

gelable.definition: Capable of being congealed; capable of being converted into jelly.

encephalotomy.definition: The act or art of dissecting the brain.

tristigmatose.definition: Having, or consisting of, three stigmas. Gray.

apocynaceous.definition: Belonging to, or resembling, a family of plants, of which the dogbane (Apocynum) is the type.

fustiness.definition: A fusty state or quality; moldiness; mustiness; an ill smell from moldiness.

numeration.definition: The act or art of numbering. Numeration is but still the adding of one unit more, and giving to the whole a new name or sign. Locke. 2. The act or art of reading numbers when expressed by means of numerals. The term is almost exclusively applied to the art of reading numbers written in the scale of.

somatist.definition: One who admits the existence of material beings only; a materialist. Glanvill.

tropidine.definition: An alkaloid, C8H13N, obtained by the chemical dehydration of tropine, as an oily liquid having a coninelike odor.

iodize.definition: To treat or impregnate with iodine or its compounds; as, to iodize a plate for photography. R. Hunt.

conformer.definition: One who conforms; one who complies with established forms or doctrines.

pospolite.definition: A kind of militia in Poland, consisting of the gentry, which, in case of invasion, was summoned to the defense of the country.

dayspring.definition: The beginning of the day, or first appearance of light; the dawn; hence, the beginning. Milton. The tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us. Luke i. 78.

subintestinal.definition: Situated under, or on the ventral side of, the intestine.

eocene.definition: Pertaining to the first in time of the three subdivisions into which the Tertiary formation is divided by geologists, and alluding to the approximation in its life to that of the present era; as, Eocene deposits. -- n.  The Eocene formation. Lyell.

greenhood.definition: A state of greenness; verdancy. Chaucer.

lanthopine.definition: An alkaloid found in opium in small quantities, and extracted as a white crystalline substance.

oleandrine.definition: One of several alkaloids found in the leaves of the oleander.

hydropult.definition: A machine for throwing water by hand power, as a garden engine, a fire extinguisher, etc.

areolar.definition: Pertaining to, or like, an areola; filled with interstices or areolæ. reolar tissue (Anat.), a form of fibrous connective tissue in which the fibers are loosely arranged with numerous spaces, or areolæ, between them.

wool-hall.definition: A trade market in the woolen districts. [Eng.].

halichondriae.definition: An order of sponges, having simple siliceous spicules and keratose fibers; -- called also Keratosilicoidea.

inapprehensive.definition: Not apprehensive; regardless; unconcerned. Jer. Taylor.

rampageous.definition: Characterized by violence and passion; unruly; rampant. [Prov. or Low] In the primitive ages of a rampageous antiquity. Galt.

behn.definition: (a) The Centaurea behen, or saw-leaved centaury. (b) The Cucubalus behen, or bladder campion, now called Silene inflata. (c) The Statice limonium, or sea lavender.

savin.definition: (a) A coniferous shrub (Juniperus Sabina) of Western Asia, occasionally found also in the northern parts of the United States and in British America. It is a compact bush, with dark-colored foliage, and produces small berries having a glaucous bloom. Its bitter, acrid tops are sometimes used in medi.

unifollilate.definition: Having only one leaflet, as the leaves of the orange tree.

orography.definition: That branch of science which treats of mountains and mountain systems; orology; as, the orography of Western Europe.

incommunicating.definition: Having no communion or intercourse with each other. Sir M. Hale.

levity.definition: The quality of weighing less than something else of equal bulk; relative lightness, especially as shown by rising through, or floating upon, a contiguous substance; buoyancy; -- opposed to gravity. He gave the form of levity to that which ascended; to that which descended, the form of gravity. Sir.

repertory.definition: A place in which things are disposed in an orderly manner, so that they can be easily found, as the index of a book, a commonplace book, or the like. 2. A treasury; a magazine; a storehouse. 3. Same as Répertoire.

standpipe.definition: (Engin.)  A vertical pipe, open at the top, between a hydrant and a reservoir, to equalize the flow of water; also, a large vertical pipe, near a pumping engine, into which water is forced up, so as to give it sufficient head to rise to the required level at a distance. 2. (Steam Boiler)  A supply p.

eggery.definition: A place where eggs are deposited (as by sea birds) or kept; a nest of eggs.

itinerant.definition: Passing or traveling about a country; going or preaching on a circuit; wandering; not settled; as, an itinerant preacher; an itinerant peddler. The king's own courts were then itinerant, being kept in the king's palace, and removing with his household in those royal progresses which he continually m.

rhetic.definition:
Pertining to, or of the same horizon as, certain Mesozoic strata of the Rhetian Alps. These strata are regarded as closing the Triassic period. See the Chart of Geology.

Same as Rhætic.

humblehead.definition: Humble condition or estate; humility. Chaucer.

overdevelop.definition: To develop excessively; specif. (Photog.),  to subject (a plate or film) too long to the developing process.

astoop.definition: In a stooping or inclined position. Gay.

elaeagnus.definition: A genus of shrubs or small trees, having the foliage covered with small silvery scales; oleaster.

methodistical.definition: Of or pertaining to methodists, or to the Methodists. -- Meth`o*dis"tic*al*ly, adv.

spermologist.definition: One who treats of, or collects, seeds. Bailey.

ureameter.definition: An apparatus for the determination of the amount of urea in urine, in which the nitrogen evolved by the action of certain reagents, on a given volume of urine, is collected and measured, and the urea calculated accordingly.

silvern.definition: Made of silver. [Archaic.] Wyclif (Acts xix. 24). Speech is silvern; silence is golden. Old Proverb.

emulable.definition: Capable of being emulated. Some imitable and emulable good. Abp. Leighton.

transplace.definition: To remove across some space; to put in an opposite or another place. It [an obelisk] was transplaced . . . from the left side of the Vatican into a more eminent place. Bp. Wilkins.

baudekin.definition: The richest kind of stuff used in garments in the Middle Ages, the web being gold, and the woof silk, with embroidery : -- made originally at Bagdad. [Spelt also baudkin, baudkyn, bawdekin, and baldakin.] Nares.

incontestability.definition: The quality or state of being incontestable.

dug.definition:
A teat, pap, or nipple; -- formerly that of a human mother, now that of a cow or other beast. With mother's dug between its lips. Shak.

of Dig.

heteromorphy.definition: The state or quality of being heteromorphic.

intervary.definition: To alter or vary between; to change. Rush.

homopterous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Homoptera.

husking.definition: The act or process of stripping off husks, as from Indian corn. 2. A meeting of neighbors or friends to assist in husking maize; -- called also husking bee. [U.S.] "A red ear in the husking." Longfellow.

zooelogy.definition: That part of biology which relates to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct. 2. A treatise on this science.

crisscross.definition:
A mark or cross, as the signature of a person who is unable to write. 2. A child's game played on paper or on a slate, consisting of lines arranged in the form of a cross.

To mark or cover with cross lines; as, a paper was crisscrossed with red marks.

1. In opposite directions; in a way to cross s.

imbrangle.definition: To entangle as in a cobweb; to mix confusedly. Hudibras. Physiology imbrangled with an inapplicable logic. Coleridge.

gamophyllous.definition: Composed of leaves united by their edges (coalescent). Gray.

bottony.definition: Having a bud or button, or a kind of trefoil, at the end; furnished with knobs or buttons. Cross bottony (Her.), a cross having each arm terminating in three rounded lobes, forming a sort of trefoil.

uranin.definition: An alkaline salt of fluorescein, obtained as a brownish red substance, which is used as a dye; -- so called from the peculiar yellowish green fluorescence (resembling that of uranium glass) of its solutions. See Fluorescein.

epigrammatize.definition: To represent by epigrams; to express by epigrams.

neologic.definition: Of or pertaining to neology; employing new words; of the nature of, or containing, new words or new doctrines. A genteel neological dictionary. Chesterfield.

chemotaxis.definition: The sensitiveness exhibited by small free-swimming organisms, as bacteria, zoöspores of algæ, etc., to chemical substances held in solution. They may be attracted (positive chemotaxis) or repelled (negative chemotaxis). -- Chem`o*tac"tic (#), a. -- Chem`o*tac"tic*al*ly, adv.

politicalism.definition: Zeal or party spirit in politics.

conviviality.definition: The good humor or mirth indulged in upon festive occasions; a convivial spirit or humor; festivity.

shafting.definition: Shafts, collectivelly; a system of connected shafts for communicating motion.

ventilator.definition: A contrivance for effecting ventilation; especially, a contrivance or machine for drawing off or expelling foul or stagnant air from any place or apartment, or for introducing that which is fresh and pure.

insupportable.definition: Incapable of being supported or borne; unendurable; insufferable; intolerable; as, insupportable burdens; insupportable pain. -- In`sup*port"a*ble*ness, n. -- In`sup*port"a*bly, adv.

browning.definition: The act or operation of giving a brown color, as to gun barrels, etc. 2. (Masonry)  A smooth coat of brown mortar, usually the second coat, and the preparation for the finishing coat of plaster.

intersocial.definition: Pertaining to the mutual intercourse or relations of persons in society; social.

negatively.definition: In a negative manner; with or by denial. "He answered negatively." Boyle. 2. In the form of speech implying the absence of something; -- opposed to positively. negatively, by showing wherein it does not consist, and positively, by showing wherein it does consist. South. Negatively charged or electri.

bilk.definition:
To frustrate or disappoint; to deceive or defraud, by nonfulfillment of engagement; to leave in the lurch; to give the slip to; as, to bilk a creditor. Thackeray.

1. A thwarting an adversary in cribbage by spoiling his score; a balk. 2. A cheat; a trick; a hoax. Hudibras. 3. Nonsense; vain words. B.

octandrian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Octandria; having eight distinct stamens.

immortalist.definition: One who holds the doctrine of the immortality of the soul. Jer. Taylor.

leeangle.definition: A heavy weapon of the Australian aborigines with a sharp- pointed end, about nine inches in length, projecting at right angles from the main part.

aplanogamete.definition: A nonmotile gamete, found in certain lower algæ.

chattel.definition: Any item of movable or immovable property except the freehold, or the things which are parcel of it. It is a more extensive term than goods or effects. Note: Chattels are personal or real: personal are such as are movable, as goods, plate, money; real are such rights in land as are less than a freeh.

conjugally.definition: In a conjugal manner; matrimonially; connubially.

spinthariscope.definition: A small instrument containing a minute particle of a radium compound mounted in front of a fluorescent screen and viewed with magnifying lenses. The tiny flashes produced by the continual bombardment of the screen by the a rays are thus rendered visible. -- Spin*thar`i*scop"ic (#), a.

rectitude.definition: Straightness. Johnson. 2. Rightness of principle or practice; exact conformity to truth, or to the rules prescribed for moral conduct, either by divine or human laws; uprightness of mind; uprightness; integrity; honesty; justice. 3. Right judgment. Sir G. C. Lewis. Syn. -- See Justice.

traction.definition: The act of drawing, or the state of being drawn; as, the traction of a muscle. 2. Specifically, the act of drawing a body along a plane by motive power, as the drawing of a carriage by men or horses, the towing of a boat by a tug. 3. Attraction; a drawing toward. 4. The adhesive friction of a wheel.

jointweed.definition: A slender, nearly leafless, American herb (Polygonum articulatum), with jointed spikes of small flowers.

unchristian.definition:
Not Christian; not converted to the Christian faith; infidel. 2. Contrary to Christianity; not like or becoming a Christian; as, unchristian conduct.

To make unchristian. South.

antiptosis.definition: The putting of one case for another.

wagnerite.definition: A fluophosphate of magnesia, occurring in yellowish crystals, and also in massive forms.

diclinous.definition: Having the stamens and pistils in separate flowers. Gray.

aphrasia.definition: (a) = Dumbness. (b) A disorder of speech in which words can be uttered but not intelligibly joined together.

grower.definition: One who grows or produces; as, a grower of corn; also, that which grows or increases; as, a vine may be a rank or a slow grower.

unsacrament.definition: To deprive of sacramental character or efficacy; as, to unsacrament the rite of baptism.

plumbeous.definition: Consisting of, or resembling, lead. J. Ellis. 2. Dull; heavy; stupid. J. P. Smith.

metabolic.definition: (Biol.)  Of or pertaining to metamorphosis; pertaining to, or involving, change. 2. (Physiol.)  Of or pertaining to metabolism; as, metabolic activity; metabolic force.

pearmain.definition: The name of several kinds of apples; as, the blue pearmain, winter pearmain, and red pearmain.

semaphore.definition: A signal telegraph; an apparatus for giving signals by the disposition of lanterns, flags, oscillating arms, etc.

orthotomy.definition: The property of cutting at right angles.

self-assertion.definition: The act of asserting one's self, or one's own rights or claims; the quality of being self-asserting.

turnsole.definition: (Bot.) (a) A plant of the genus Heliotropium; heliotrope; -- so named because its flowers are supposed to turn toward the sun. (b) The sunflower. (c) A kind of spurge (Euphorbia Helioscopia). (d) The euphorbiaceous plant Chrozophora tinctoria. 2. (Chem.) (a) Litmus. (b) A purple dye obtained from th.

lettuce.definition: A composite plant of the genus Lactuca (L. sativa), the leaves of which are used as salad. Plants of this genus yield a milky juice, from which lactucarium is obtained. The commonest wild lettuce of the United States is L. Canadensis. Hare's lettuce, Lamb's lettuce. See under Hare, and Lamb. -- Lett.

woolgathering.definition:
Indulging in a vagrant or idle exercise of the imagination; roaming upon a fruitless quest; idly fanciful.

Indulgence in idle imagination; a foolish or useless pursuit or design. His wits were a woolgathering, as they say. Burton.

muscoid.definition:
Mosslike; resembling moss.

A term formerly applied to any mosslike flowerless plant, with a distinct stem, and often with leaves, but without any vascular system.

inescate.definition: To allure; to lay a bait for. To inescate and beguile young women! Burton.

spiraeic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or derived from, the meadowsweet (Spiræa); formerly, designating an acid which is now called salicylic acid.

inclusa.definition: A tribe of bivalve mollusks, characterized by the closed state of the mantle which envelops the body. The ship borer (Teredo navalis) is an example.

deciliter.definition: A measure of capacity or volume in the metric system; one tenth of a liter, equal to 6.1022 cubic inches, or 3.38 fluid ounces.

emmenagogue.definition: A medicine that promotes the menstrual discharge.

weaponed.definition: Furnished with weapons, or arms; armed; equipped.

corah.definition: Plain; undyed; -- applied to Indian silk. -- n.  Corah silk.

afforestation.definition: The act of converting into forest or woodland. Blackstone.

benzoline.definition: (a) Same as Benzole. (b) Same as Amarine. Watts.

discoverable.definition: Capable of being discovered, found out, or perceived; as, many minute animals are discoverable only by the help of the microscope; truths discoverable by human industry.

usher.definition: An officer or servant who has the care of the door of a court, hall, chamber, or the like; hence, an officer whose business it is to introduce strangers, or to walk before a person of rank. Also, one who escorts persons to seats in a church, theater, etc. "The ushers and the squires." Chaucer. These.

concinnous.definition: Characterized by concinnity; neat; elegant. The most concinnous and most rotund of proffessors, M. Heyne. De Quiency.

enigmatize.definition: To make, or talk in, enigmas; to deal in riddles.

leptology.definition: A minute and tedious discourse on trifling things.

ingrediency.definition: Entrance; ingress. Sir M. Hale. 2. The quality or state of being an ingredient or component part. Boyle.

slushy.definition: Abounding in slush; characterized by soft mud or half-melted snow; as, the streets are slushy; the snow is slushy. "A dark, drizzling, slushy day." Blackw. Mag.

tegmentum.definition: A covering; -- applied especially to the bundles of longitudinal fibers in the upper part of the crura of the cerebrum.

chronophotograph.definition: One of a set of photographs of a moving object, taken for the purpose of recording and exhibiting successive phases of the motion. --Chron`o*pho*tog"ra*phy, n.

cousinhood.definition: The state or condition of a cousin; also, the collective body of cousins; kinsfolk.

uptrain.definition: To train up; to educate. "Daughters which were well uptrained." Spenser.

web-footed.definition: Having webbed feet; palmiped; as, a goose or a duck is a web- footed fowl.

opitulation.definition: The act of helping or aiding; help. Bailey.

sexed.definition: Belonging to sex; having sex; distinctively male of female; as, the sexed condition.

sceneman.definition: The man who manages the movable scenes in a theater.

anthrenus.definition: A genus of small beetles, several of which, in the larval state, are very destructive to woolen goods, fur, etc. The common "museum pest" is A. varius; the carpet beetle is A. scrophulariæ. The larvæ are commonly confounded with moths.

baptization.definition: Baptism. Their baptizations were null. Jer. Taylor.

assuetude.definition: Accustomedness; habit; habitual use. Assuetude of things hurtful doth make them lose their force to hurt. Bacon.

schizorhinal.definition: (Anat.)  Having the nasal bones separate. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having the anterior nostrils prolonged backward in the form of a slit.

uplean.definition: To lean or incline upon anything. Spenser.

jacksmith.definition: A smith who makes jacks. See 2d Jack, 4, c. Dryden.

camis.definition: A light, loose dress or robe. [Also written camus.] All in a camis light of purple silk. Spenser.

outright.definition: Immediately; without delay; at once; as, he was killed outright. 2. Completely; utterly. Cardinal Manning.

growse.definition: To shiver; to have chills. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Ray.

carmagnole.definition: A popular or Red Rebublican song and dance, of the time of the first French Revolution. They danced and yelled the carmagnole. Compton Reade. 2. A bombastic report from the French armies.

fondling.definition:
The act of caressing; manifestation of tenderness. Cyrus made no . . . amorous fondling To fan her pride, or melt her guardless heart. Mickle.

1. A person or thing fondled or caressed; one treated with foolish or doting affection. Fondlings are in danger to be made fools. L'Estrange. 2. A fool; a s.

habituation.definition: The act of habituating, or accustoming; the state of being habituated.

amyl.definition: A hydrocarbon radical, C5H11, of the paraffine series found in amyl alcohol or fusel oil, etc.

stare.definition:
The starling.

1. To look with fixed eyes wide open, as through fear, wonder, surprise, impudence, etc.; to fasten an earnest and prolonged gaze on some object. For ever upon the ground I see thee stare. Chaucer. Look not big, nor stamp, nor stare, nor fret. Shak. 2. To be very conspicuous on accoun.

theism.definition: The belief or acknowledgment of the existence of a God, as opposed to atheism, pantheism, or polytheism.

catastrophist.definition: One who holds the theory or catastrophism.

ponderable.definition: Capable of being weighed; having appreciable weight. -- Pon"der*a*ble*ness, n.

unadulterated.definition: Not adulterated; pure. "Unadulterate air." Cowper. -- Un`a*dul"ter*ate*ly, adv.

underwitted.definition: Weak in intellect; half-witted; silly. Bp. Kennet.

misconfident.definition: Having a mistaken confidence; wrongly trusting. Bp. Hall.

scat.definition:
Go away; begone; away; -- chiefly used in driving off a cat.

Tribute. "Seizing scatt and treasure." Longfellow.

A shower of rain. Wright.

cerotic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, beeswax or Chinese wax; as, cerotic acid or alcohol.

ladylove.definition: A sweetheart or mistress. LADY'S BEDSTRAW La"dy's bed"straw`, (Bot.)  The common bedstraw (Galium verum); also, a slender-leaved East Indian shrub (Pharnaceum Mollugo), with white flowers in umbels. LADY'S BOWER La"dy's bow"er. (Bot.)  A climbing plant with fragrant blossoms (Clematis vitalba). Note.

ophidian.definition:
One of the Ophidia; a snake or serpent.

Of or pertaining to the Ophidia; belonging to serpents.

anchorage.definition: The act of anchoring, or the condition of lying at anchor. 2. A place suitable for anchoring or where ships anchor; a hold for an anchor. 3. The set of anchors belonging to a ship. 4. Something which holds like an anchor; a hold; as, the anchorages of the Brooklyn Bridge. 5. Something on which one m.

filibusterism.definition: The characteristics or practices of a filibuster. Bartlett.

draffy.definition: Dreggy; waste; worthless. The dregs and draffy part. Beau. & Fl.

counterwheel.definition: To cause to wheel or turn in an opposite direction.

paludism.definition: The morbid phenomena produced by dwelling among marshes; malarial disease or disposition.

theurgic.definition: Of or pertaining to theurgy; magical. Theurgic hymns, songs of incantation.

bushman.definition: A woodsman; a settler in the bush. 2. (Ethnol.)  One of a race of South African nomads, living principally in the deserts, and not classified as allied in race or language to any other people.

stew.definition:
A small pond or pool where fish are kept for the table; a vivarium. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Chaucer. Evelyn. 2. An artificial bed of oysters. [Local, U.S.]

To boil slowly, or with the simmering or moderate heat; to seethe; to cook in a little liquid, over a gentle fire, without boiling; as, to stew me.

concentrator.definition: An apparatus for the separation of dry comminuted ore, by exposing it to intermittent puffs of air. Knight.

encrinal.definition: Relating to encrinites; containing encrinites, as certain kinds of limestone.

unmarry.definition: To annul the marriage of; to divorce. Milton.

abscession.definition: A separating; removal; also, an abscess. Gauden. Barrough.

crag.definition:
A steep, rugged rock; a cough, broken cliff, or point of a rock, on a ledge. From crag to crag the signal fiew. Sir W. Scott. 2. (Geol.)  A partially compacted bed of gravel mixed with shells, of the Tertiary age.

1. The neck or throat And bear the crag so stiff and so state. Spenser. 2. The neck p.

harefoot.definition: (Zoöl.)  A long, narrow foot, carried (that is, produced or extending) forward; -- said of dogs. 2. (Bot)  A tree (Ochroma Laqopus) of the West Indies, having the stamens united somewhat in the form of a hare's foot. Harefoot clover (Bot.), a species of clover (Trifolium arvense) with soft and silky.

cirriferous.definition: Bearing cirri, as many plants and animals.

sprinkler.definition: One who sprinkles. 2. An instrument or vessel used in sprinkling; specifically, a watering pot.

cometary.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, a comet. Cheyne.

accension.definition: The act of kindling or the state of being kindled; ignition. Locke.

accompt.definition: See Account. Note: Accompt, accomptant, etc., are archaic forms.

adar.definition: The twelfth month of the Hebrew ecclesiastical year, and the sixth of the civil. It corresponded nearly with March.

thurst.definition: The ruins of the fallen roof resulting from the removal of the pillars and stalls. Raymond.

upsodown.definition: Upside down. [Obs. or Colloq.] Wyclif. In man's sin is every manner order or ordinance turned upsodown. Chaucer.

oscillate.definition: To move backward and forward; to vibrate like a pendulum; to swing; to sway. 2. To vary or fluctuate between fixed limits; to act or move in a fickle or fluctuating manner; to change repeatedly, back and forth. The amount of superior families oscillates rather than changes, that is, it fluctuates wi.

relaxant.definition: A medicine that relaxes; a laxative.

unaccomplished.definition: Not accomplished or performed; unfinished; also, deficient in accomplishment; unrefined.

amir.definition:
Emir. 2. One of the Mohammedan nobility of Afghanistan and Scinde.

Same as Ameer.

coverer.definition: One who, or that which, covers.

griffon.definition: (Myth.)  A fabulous monster, half lion and half eagle. It is often represented in Grecian and Roman works of art. 2. (Her.)  A representation of this creature as an heraldic charge. 3. (Zoöl.)  A species of large vulture (Gyps fulvus) found in the mountainous parts of Southern Europe, North Africa,.

tollbooth.definition:
A place where goods are weighed to ascertain the duties or toll. He saw Levy . . . sitting at the tollbooth. Wyclif (Mark ii. 14). 2. In Scotland, a burgh jail; hence, any prison, especially a town jail. Sir W. Scott.

To imprison in a tollbooth. That they might tollbooth Oxford men. Bp. Corbet.

king-post.definition: A member of a common form of truss, as a roof truss. It is strictly a tie, intended to prevent the sagging of the tiebeam in the middle. If there are struts, supporting the main rafters, they often bear upon the foot of the king-post. Called also crown-post. KING'S BENCH King's Bench. (Law)  Formerl.

chariotee.definition: A light, covered, four-wheeled pleasure carriage with two seats.

sodamide.definition: A greenish or reddish crystalline substance, NaNH2, obtained by passing ammonia over heated sodium.

unharness.definition: To strip of harness; to loose from harness or gear; as, to unharness horses or oxen. Cowper. 2. To disarm; to divest of armor. Holinshed.

nom.definition: Name. Nom de guerre (, literally, war name; hence, a fictitious name, or one assumed for a time. -- Nom de plume (, literally, pen name; hence, a name assumed by an author as his or her signature.

donya.definition: Lady; mistress; madam; -- a title of respect used in Spain, prefixed to the Christian name of a lady.

pentoic.definition: Pertaining to, or desingating, an acid (called also valeric acid) derived from pentane.

poetize.definition: To write as a poet; to compose verse; to idealize. I versify the truth, not poetize. Donne.

lame.definition: (a) Moving with pain or difficulty on account of injury, defect, or temporary obstruction of a function; as, a lame leg, arm, or muscle. (b) To some degree disabled by reason of the imperfect action of a limb; crippled; as, a lame man. "Lame of one leg." Arbuthnot. "Lame in both his feet." 2 Sam. ix.

impedite.definition:
Hindered; obstructed. Jer. Taylor.

To impede. Boyle.

impeachment.definition: The act of impeaching, or the state of being impeached; as: (a) Hindrance; impediment; obstruction. Willing to march on to Calais, Without impeachment. Shak. (b) A calling to account; arraignment; especially, of a public officer for maladministration. The consequence of Coriolanus' impeachment had l.

loud-voiced.definition: Having a loud voice; noisy; clamorous. Byron.

ootype.definition: The part of the oviduct of certain trematode worms in which the ova are completed and furnished with a shell.

hatting.definition: The business of making hats; also, stuff for hats.

semicubical.definition: Of or pertaining to the square root of the cube of a quantity. Semicubical parabola, a curve in which the ordinates are proportional to the square roots of the cubes of the abscissas.

saliency.definition: Quality of being salient; hence, vigor. "A fatal lack of poetic saliency." J. Morley.

canny.definition: Artful; cunning; shrewd; wary. 2. Skillful; knowing; capable. Sir W. Scott. 3. Cautious; prudent; safe.. Ramsay. 4. Having pleasing of useful qualities; gentle. Burns. 5. Reputed to have magical powers. Sir W. Scott. No canny, not safe, not fortunate; unpropitious. [Scot.].

subnotochordal.definition: Situated on the ventral side of the notochord; as, the subnotochordal rod.

viscerate.definition: To deprive of the viscera, or entrails; to eviscerate; to disembowel.

inseparably.definition: In an inseparable manner or condition; so as not to be separable. Bacon. And cleaves through life inseparably close. Cowper.

cocoanut.definition: The large, hard-shelled nut of the cocoa palm. It yields an agreeable milky liquid and a white meat or albumen much used as food and in making oil.

zooephagous.definition: Feeding on animals. Note: This is a more general term than either sarcophagous or carnivorous.

tampon.definition:
A plug introduced into a natural or artificial cavity of the body in order to arrest hemorrhage, or for the application of medicine.

To plug with a tampon.

embody.definition:
To form into a body; to invest with a body; to collect into a body, a united mass, or a whole; to incorporate; as, to embody one's ideas in a treatise. [Written also imbody.] Devils embodied and disembodied. Sir W. Scott. The soul, while it is embodied, can no more be divided from sin. South.

To un.

blustering.definition: Exhibiting noisy violence, as the wind; stormy; tumultuous. A tempest and a blustering day. Shak. 2. Uttering noisy threats; noisy and swaggering; boisterous. "A blustering fellow." L'Estrange.

malignancy.definition: The state or quality of being malignant; extreme malevolence; bitter enmity; malice; as, malignancy of heart. 2. Unfavorableness; evil nature. The malignancy of my fate might perhaps distemner yours. Shak. 3. (Med.)  Virulence; tendency to a fatal issue; as, the malignancy of an ulcer or of a fever.

versability.definition: The quality or state of being versable. Sterne.

hangbird.definition: The Baltimore oriole (Icterus galbula); -- so called because its nest is suspended from the limb of a tree. See Baltimore oriole.

dog-fox.definition: (a) A male fox. See the Note under Dog, n., 6. Sir W. Scott. (b) The Arctic or blue fox; -- a name also applied to species of the genus Cynalopex.

felicity.definition: The state of being happy; blessedness; blissfulness; enjoyment of good. Our own felicity we make or find. Johnson. Finally, after this life, to attain everlasting joy and felicity. Book of Common Prayer. 2. That which promotes happiness; a successful or gratifying event; prosperity; blessing. the fe.

sacchulmic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, an acid obtained as a dark amorphous substance by the long-continued boiling of sucrose with very dilute sulphuric acid. It resembles humic acid. [Written also sacculmic.].

damageable.definition: Capable of being injured or impaired; liable to, or susceptible of, damage; as, a damageable cargo. 2. Hurtful; pernicious. That it be not demageable unto your royal majesty. Hakluit.

ineffervescible.definition: Not capable or susceptible of effervescence.

unpreach.definition: To undo or overthrow by preaching. De Foe.

dissepiment.definition: A separating tissue; a partition; a septum. 2. (Bot.)  One of the partitions which divide a compound ovary into cells. 3. (Zoöl.)  One of the transverse, calcareous partitions between the radiating septa of a coral.

oblite.definition: Indistinct; slurred over. "Obscure and oblite mention." Fuller.

affectionateness.definition: The quality of being affectionate; fondness; affection.

disastrous.definition: Full of unpropitious stellar influences; unpropitious; ill-boding. The moon In dim eclipse, disastrous twilight sheds. Milton. 2. Attended with suffering or disaster; very unfortunate; calamitous; ill-fated; as, a disastrous day; a disastrous termination of an undertaking. Wherein I spake of most di.

picard.definition: One of a sect of Adamites in the fifteenth century; -- so called from one Picard of Flanders. See Adamite.

tirade.definition: A declamatory strain or flight of censure or abuse; a rambling invective; an oration or harangue abounding in censorious and bitter language. Here he delivers a violent tirade against persons who profess to know anything about angels. Quarterly Review.

bedim.definition: To make dim; to obscure or darken. Shak.

sugariness.definition: The quality or state of being sugary, or sweet.

synagogical.definition: Of or pertaining to a synagogue.

staves.definition: pl. of Staff. "Banners, scarves and staves." R. Browning. Also (stavz),  pl. of Stave.

incalculability.definition: The quality or state of being incalculable.

veratric.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, plants of the genus Veratrum. Veratric acid (Chem.), an acid occurring, together with veratrine, in the root of white hellebore (Veratrum album), and in sabadilla seed; -- extracted as a white crystalline substance which is related to protocatechuic acid.

hexoic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, hexane; as, hexoic acid.

rit.definition: 3d pers. ssing. pres. of Ride, contracted from rideth. Chaucer.

marron.definition: A large chestnut. Holland. 2. A chestnut color; maroon. 3. (Pyrotechny & Mil.)  A paper or pasteboard box or shell, wound about with strong twine, filled with an explosive, and ignited with a fuse, -- used to make a noise like a cannon. [Written also maroon.].

overwax.definition: To wax or grow too rapindly or too much. R. of Gloucester.

capivi.definition: A balsam of the Spanish West Indies. See Copaiba.

congruity.definition: The state or quality of being congruous; the relation or agreement between things; fitness; harmony; correspondence; consistency. With what congruity doth the church of Rome deny that her enemies do at all appertain to the church of Christ Hooker. A whole sentence may fail of its congruity by wantin.

weasel-faced.definition: Having a thin, sharp face, like a weasel.

misrepute.definition: To have in wrong estimation; to repute or estimate erroneously.

sciascope.definition: A device for determining the refractive state of the eye by observing the movements of the retinal lights and shadows. -- Ski*as"co*py (#), Ski*as"co*py (#), n.

pulsate.definition: To throb, as a pulse; to beat, as the heart. The heart of a viper or frog will continue to pulsate long after it is taken from the body. E. Darwin.

lyra.definition: (Astron.)  A northern constellation, the Harp, containing a white star of the first magnitude, called Alpha Lyræ, or Vega. 2. (Anat.)  The middle portion of the ventral surface of the fornix of the brain; -- so called from the arrangement of the lines with which it is marked in the human brain.

subtleness.definition: The quality or state of being subtle; subtlety.

unfolder.definition: One who, or that which, unfolds.

acrospore.definition: A spore borne at the extremity of the cells of fructification in fungi.

undervaluation.definition: The act of undervaluing; a rate or value not equal to the real worth.

grayback.definition: (a) The California gray whale. (b) The redbreasted sandpiper or knot. (c) The dowitcher. (d) The body louse.

andromede.definition: A meteor appearing to radiate from a point in the constellation Andromeda, -- whence the name. A shower of these meteors takes place every year on November 27th or 28th. The Andromedes are also called Bielids, as they are connected with Biela's comet and move in its orbit.

hobnob.definition:
Have or have not; -- a familiar invitation to reciprocal drinking. Shak. 2. At random; hit or miss. (Obs.) Holinshed.

1. To drink familiarly (with another). [ Written also hob-a-nob.] 2. To associate familiarly; to be on intimate terms.

Familiar, social intercourse. W. Black.

spoon.definition:
See Spoom. We might have spooned before the wind as well as they. Pepys.

1. An implement consisting of a small bowl (usually a shallow oval) with a handle, used especially in preparing or eating food. "Therefore behoveth him a full long spoon That shall eat with a fiend," thus heard I say. Chaucer.

stubbed.definition: Reduced to a stub; short and thick, like something truncated; blunt; obtuse. 2. Abounding in stubs; stubby. A bit of stubbed ground, once a wood. R. Browning. 3. Not nice or delicate; hardy; rugged. "Stubbed, vulgar constitutions." Berkley.

pantascopic.definition: Viewing all; taking a view of the whole. See under Camera.

graille.definition: A halfround single-cut file or fioat, having one curved face and one straight face, -- used by comb makers. Knight.

sufficiency.definition: The quality or state of being sufficient, or adequate to the end proposed; adequacy. His sufficiency is such that he bestows and possesses, his plenty being unexhausted. Boyle. 2. Qualification for any purpose; ability; capacity. A substitute or most allowed sufficiency. Shak. I am not so confident.

seraphine.definition: A wind instrument whose sounding parts are reeds, consisting of a thin tongue of brass playing freely through a slot in a plate. It has a case, like a piano, and is played by means of a similar keybord, the bellows being worked by the foot. The melodeon is a portable variety of this instrument.

double-shade.definition: To double the natural darkness of (a place). Milton.

statoblast.definition: One of a peculiar kind of internal buds, or germs, produced in the interior of certain Bryozoa and sponges, especially in the fresh- water species; -- also called winter buds. Note: They are protected by a firm covering, and are usually destined to perpetuate the species during the winter season. Th.

suffocation.definition: The act of suffocating, or the state of being suffocated; death caused by smothering or choking. Note: The term suffocation is sometimes employed synonymously with asphyxia. In the strict medico-legal sense it signifies asphyxia induced by obstruction of the respiration otherwise than by direct pres.

plastid.definition: (Biol.)  A formative particle of albuminous matter; a monad; a cytode. See the Note under Morphon. Haeckel. 2. (Bot.)  One of the many minute granules found in the protoplasm of vegetable cells. They are divided by their colors into three classes, chloroplastids, chromoplastids, and leucoplastids.

caulicle.definition: A short caulis or stem, esp. the rudimentary stem seen in the embryo of seed; -- otherwise called a radicle.

nereidian.definition: Any annelid resembling Nereis, or of the family Lycoridæ or allied families.

alimentariness.definition: The quality of being alimentary; nourishing quality.

saponul.definition: A soapy mixture obtained by treating an essential oil with an alkali; hence, any similar compound of an essential oil. [Written also saponule.].

anticous.definition: Facing toward the axis of the flower, as in the introrse anthers of the water lily.

catapasm.definition: A compound medicinal powder, used by the ancients to sprinkle on ulcers, to absorb perspiration, etc. Dunglison.

beaconage.definition: Money paid for the maintenance of a beacon; also, beacons, collectively.

seemingly.definition: In appearance; in show; in semblance; apparently; ostensibly. This the father seemingly complied with. Addison.

delegacy.definition: The act of delegating, or state of being delegated; deputed power. By way of delegacy or grand commission. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. A body of delegates or commissioners; a delegation. Burton.

gige.definition: The leather strap by which the shield of a knight was slung across the shoulder, or across the neck and shoulder. Meyrick (Ancient Armor).

phoronomics.definition: The science of motion; kinematics. Weisbach.

interfascicular.definition: Between fascicles or bundles; as, the interfascicular spaces of connective tissue.

scortatory.definition: Pertaining to lewdness or fornication; lewd.

eyeball.definition: The ball or globe of the eye.

full-blooded.definition: Having a full supply of blood. 2. Of pure blood; thoroughbred; as, a full-blooded horse.

feria.definition: A week day, esp. a day which is neither a festival nor a fast. Shipley.

misprint.definition:
To print wrong.

A mistake in printing; a deviation from the copy; as, a book full of misprints.

ferricyanic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, a ferricyanide. Ferricyanic acid (Chem.), a brown crystalline substance, H6(CN)12Fe2, obtained from potassium ferricyanide, and regarded as the type of the ferricyanides; -- called also hydro-ferricyanic acid, hydrogen ferricyanide, etc.

ticketing.definition: A periodical sale of ore in the English mining districts; -- so called from the tickets upon which are written the bids of the buyers.

petrohyoid.definition: Pertaining to petrous, oe periotic, portion of the skull and the hyoid arch; as, the petrohyoid muscles of the frog.

bolus.definition: A rounded mass of anything, esp. a large pill.

hutch.definition:
To place in huts; to live in huts; as, to hut troops in winter quarters. The troops hutted among the heights of Morristown. W. Irving.

1. A chest, box, coffer, bin, coop, or the like, in which things may be stored, or animals kept; as, a grain hutch; a rabbit hutch. 2. A measure of two Winchester b.

dough-baked.definition: Imperfectly baked; hence, not brought to perfection; unfinished; also, of weak or dull understanding. Halliwell.

faintish.definition: Slightly faint; somewhat faint. -- Faint"ish*ness, n.

triliteralness.definition: The quality of being triliteral; as, the triliterality of Hebrew roots. W. D. Whitney.

novaculite.definition: A variety of siliceous slate, of which hones are made; razor stone; Turkey stone; hone stone; whet slate.

equibalance.definition:
Equal weight; equiponderance.

To make of equal weight; to balance equally; to counterbalance; to equiponderate.

irpe.definition: A fantastic grimace or contortion of the body. Smirks and irps and all affected humors. B. Jonson .

ugrian.definition: A Mongolian race, ancestors of the Finns. [Written also Uigrian.].
