antinational.definition: Antagonistic to one's country or nation, or to a national government.

sagittate.definition: Shaped like an arrowhead; triangular, with the two basal angles prolonged downward.

proverbialist.definition: One who makes much use of proverbs in speech or writing; one who composes, collects, or studies proverbs.

brooklime.definition: A plant (Veronica Beccabunga), with flowers, usually blue, in axillary racemes. The American species is V. Americana. [Formerly written broklempe or broklympe.].

unalienable.definition: Inalienable; as, unalienable rights. Swift. -- Un*al"ien*a*bly, adv.

tripodian.definition: An ancient stringed instrument; -- so called because, in form, it resembled the Delphic tripod.

accommodating.definition: Affording, or disposed to afford, accommodation; obliging; as an accommodating man, spirit, arrangement.

gazetteer.definition: A writer of news, or an officer appointed to publish news by authority. Johnson. 2. A newspaper; a gazette. Burke. 3. A geographical dictionary; a book giving the names and descriptions, etc., of many places. 4. An alphabetical descriptive list of anything.

chainlet.definition: A small chain. Sir W. Scott.

indiscerptible.definition: Not discerpible; inseparable. Bp. Butler. -- In`dis*cerp"i*ble*ness, n., In`dis*cerp"ti*ble*ness, n. -- In`dis*cerp"ti*bly, adv.

laryngotracheal.definition: Pertaining to both larynx and trachea; as, the laryngotracheal cartilage in the frog.

bicostate.definition: Having two principal ribs running longitudinally, as a leaf.

photosphere.definition: A sphere of light; esp., the luminous envelope of the sun.

squatter.definition: One who squats; specifically, one who settles unlawfully upon land without a title. In the United States and Australia the term is sometimes applied also to a person who settles lawfully upon government land under permission and restrictions, before acquiring title. In such a tract, squatters and tr.

blur.definition: To render obscure by making the form or outline of confused and uncertain, as by soiling; to smear; to make indistinct and confused; as, to blur manuscript by handling it while damp; to blur the impression of a woodcut by an excess of ink. But time hath nothing blurred those lines of favor Which the.

ransomless.definition: Incapable of being ransomed; without ransom. Shak.

swashbuckler.definition: A bully or braggadocio; a swaggering, boastful fellow; a swaggerer. Milton.

coot.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) A wading bird with lobate toes, of the genus Fulica. The common European or bald coot is F. atra (see under bald); the American is F. Americana. (b) The surf duck or scoter. In the United States all the species of (Edemia are called coots. See Scoter. "As simple as a coot." Halliwell. 2.

tripartite.definition: Divided into three parts; triparted; as, a tripartite leaf. 2. Having three corresponding parts or copies; as, to make indentures tripartite. A. Smith. 3. Made between three parties; as, a tripartite treaty.

uxorial.definition: Dotingly fond of, or servilely submissive to, a wife; uxorious; also, becoming a wife; pertaining to a wife. The speech [of Zipporah, Ex. iv. 25] is not a speech of reproach or indignation, but of uxorial endearment. Geddes.

chute.definition: A framework, trough, or tube, upon or through which objects are made to slide from a higher to a lower level, or through which water passes to a wheel. 2. See Shoot.

rasp.definition:
To rub or file with a rasp; to rub or grate with a rough file; as, to rasp wood to make it smooth; to rasp bones to powder. 2. Hence, figuratively: To grate harshly upon; to offend by coarse or rough treatment or language; as, some sounds rasp the ear; his insults rasped my temper.

1. A coarse file.

dorse.definition:
Same as dorsal, n. 2. The back of a book. Books, all richly bound, with gilt dorses. Wood.

The Baltic or variable cod (Gadus callarias), by some believed to be the young of the common codfish.

arbuscular.definition: Of or pertaining to a dwarf tree; shrublike. Da Costa.

sphincter.definition:
A muscle which surrounds, and by its contraction tends to close, a natural opening; as, the sphincter of the bladder.

Of, pertaining to, or designating, a sphincter; as, a sphincter muscle.

pelvis.definition: (Anat.)  The pelvic arch, or the pelvic arch together with the sacrum. See Pelvic arch, under Pelvic, and Sacrum. 2. (Zoöl.)  The calyx of a crinoid. Pelvis of the kidney (Anat.), the basinlike cavity into which the ureter expands as it joins the kidney.

kingbird.definition: A small American bird (Tyrannus, or T. Carolinensis), noted for its courage in attacking larger birds, even hawks and eagles, especially when they approach its nest in the breeding season. It is a typical tyrant flycatcher, taking various insects upon the wing. It is dark ash above, and blackish on.

hyalescence.definition: The process of becoming, or the state of being, transparent like glass.

changeless.definition: That can not be changed; constant; as, a changeless purpose. -- Change"less*ness, n.

moira.definition: The deity who assigns to every man his lot.

instructible.definition: Capable of being instructed; teachable; docible. Bacon.

linguiform.definition: Having the form of the tongue; tongue-shaped.

diurna.definition: A division of Lepidoptera, including the butterflies; -- so called because they fly only in the daytime.

soliloquize.definition: To utter a soliloquy; to talk to one's self.

lethargic.definition: Pertaining to, affected with, or resembling, lethargy; morbidly drowsy; dull; heavy. -- Le*thar"gic*al*ly, v. -- Le*thar"gic*al*ness, n. -- Le*thar"gic*ness, n.

goatish.definition: Characteristic of a goat; goatlike. Give your chaste body up to the embraces Of goatish lust. Massinger. -- Goat"ish*ly, adv. -- Goat"ish*ness, n.

proboscidian.definition: Pertaining to the Proboscidea. -- n.  One of the Proboscidea.

kibed.definition: Chapped; cracked with cold; affected with chilblains; as kibed heels. Beau. & Fl.

numerary.definition: Belonging to a certain number; counting as one of a collection or body. A supernumerary canon, when he obtains a prebend, becomes a numerary canon. Ayliffe.

pun.definition:
To pound. He would pun thee into shivers with his fist. Shak.

A play on words which have the same sound but different meanings; an expression in which two different applications of a word present an odd or ludicrous idea; a kind of quibble or equivocation. Addison. A better put on this word was mad.

gowdnook.definition: The saury pike; -- called also gofnick.

fantom.definition: See Phantom. Fantom corn, phantom corn. Grose.

alkaloid.definition: An organic base, especially one of a class of substances occurring ready formed in the tissues of plants and the bodies of animals. Note: Alcaloids all contain nitrogen, carbon, and hydrogen, and many of them also contain oxygen. They include many of the active principles in plants; thus, morphine a.

yestern.definition: Of or pertaining to yesterday; relating to the day last past.

productus.definition: An extinct genus of brachiopods, very characteristic of the Carboniferous rocks.

bulb.definition: (Bot.)  A spheroidal body growing from a plant either above or below the ground (usually below), which is strictly a bud, consisting of a cluster of partially developed leaves, and producing, as it grows, a stem above, and roots below, as in the onion, tulip, etc. It differs from a corm in not being.

cheirotherium.definition: A genus of extinct animals, so named from fossil footprints rudely resembling impressions of the human hand, and believed to have been made by labyrinthodont reptiles. See Illustration in Appendix.

unspilt.definition: Not spilt or wasted; not shed.

alguazil.definition: An inferior officer of justice in Spain; a warrant officer; a constable. Prescott.

lawbreaker.definition: One who disobeys the law; a criminal. -- Law"break`ing, n. & a.

two-cycle.definition: A two-stroke cycle for an internal-combustion engine. --Two"- cy`cle, a.

mum-chance.definition:
A game of hazard played with cards in silence. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Decker. 2. A silent, stupid person. Halliwell.

Silent and idle. Boys can't sit mum-chance always. J. H. Ewing.

playful.definition: Sportive; gamboling; frolicsome; indulging a sportive fancy; humorous; merry; as, a playful child; a playful writer. -- Play"ful*ly, adv. -- Play"ful*ness, n.

leafed.definition: Having (such) a leaf or (so many) leaves; -- used in composition; as, broad-leafed; four-leafed.

seise.definition: See Seize. Spenser. Note: This is the common spelling in the law phrase to be seised of (an estate).

unappropriated.definition: Not specially appropriate; having not special application. J. Warton. 2. Not granted to any person, corporation, or the like, to the exclusion of others; as, unappropriated lands. 3. Not granted for, or applied to, any specific purpose; as, the unappropriated moneys in the treasury.

centrebit.definition: An instrument turning on a center, for boring holes. See Bit, n., 3.

epure.definition: A draught or model from which to build; especially, one of the full size of the work to be done; a detailed drawing.

egotize.definition: To talk or write as an egotist. Cowper.

absterge.definition: To make clean by wiping; to wipe away; to cleanse; hence, to purge. Quincy.

algometer.definition: An instrument for measuring sensations of pain due to pressure. It has a piston rod with a blunted tip which is pressed against the skin. -- Al*gom"e*try (#), n. -- Al`go*met"ric (#), *met"ric*al (#), a. --Al`go*met"ric*al*ly, adv.

parelectronomy.definition: A condition of the muscles induced by exposure to severe cold, in which the electrical action of the muscle is reversed.

triplite.definition: A mineral of a dark brown color, generally with a fibrous, massive structure. It is a fluophosphate of iron and manganese.

gaul.definition: The Anglicized form of Gallia, which in the time of the Romans included France and Upper Italy (Transalpine and Cisalpine Gaul). 2. A native or inhabitant of Gaul.

unfool.definition: To restore from folly, or from being a fool. Shak.

illimitable.definition: Incapable of being limited or bounded; immeasurable; limitless; boundless; as, illimitable space. The wild, the irregular, the illimitable, and the luxuriant, have their appropriate force of beauty. De Quincey. Syn. -- Boundless; limitless; unlimited; unbounded; immeasurable; infinite; immense; vast.

piccadil.definition: A high, stiff collar for the neck; also, a hem or band about the skirt of a garment, -- worn by men in the 17th century.

rhinoplastic.definition: Of or pertaining to rhinoplasty; as, a rhinoplastic operation.

turndown.definition: Capable of being turned down; specif. (Elec.), designating, or pertaining to, an incandescent lamp with a small additional filament which can be made incandescent when only a small amount of light is required. 2.  Made to wear with the upper part turned down; as, a turndown collar.

verily.definition: In very truth; beyond doubt or question; in fact; certainly. Bacon. Trust in the Lord and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the verily thou shalt be fed. Ps. xxxvii. 3.

determinative.definition:
Having power to determine; limiting; shaping; directing; conclusive. Incidents . . . determinative of their course. I. Taylor. Determinative tables (Nat. Hist.), tables presenting the specific character of minerals, plants, etc., to assist in determining the species to which a specimen belongs.

Tha.

treenail.definition: A long wooden pin used in fastening the planks of a vessel to the timbers or to each other. [Written also trenail, and trunnel.].

foreread.definition: To tell beforehand; to signify by tokens; to predestine. Spenser.

delusional.definition: Of or pertaining to delusions; as, delusional monomania.

rigel.definition: A fixed star of the first magnitude in the left foot of the constellation Orion. [Written also Regel.].

chouka.definition: The Indian four-horned antelope; the chikara.

unio.definition: Any one of numerous species of fresh-water mussels belonging to Unio and many allied genera.

venulose.definition: Full of venules, or small veins.

carling.definition: A short timber running lengthwise of a ship, from one transverse desk beam to another; also, one of the cross timbers that strengthen a hath; -- usually in pl.

whimsical.definition: Full of, or characterized by, whims; actuated by a whim; having peculiar notions; queer; strange; freakish. "A whimsical insult." Macaulay. My neighbors call me whimsical. Addison. 2. Odd or fantastic in appearance; quaintly devised; fantastic. "A whimsical chair." Evelyn. Syn. -- Quaint; capricious.

ennead.definition: The number nine or a group of nine. The Enneads, the title given to the works of the philosopher Plotinus, published by his pupil Porphyry; -- so called because each of the six books into which it is divided contains nine chapters.

noncontent.definition: One who gives a negative vote; -- sometimes abridged into noncon. or non con.

unsparing.definition: Not sparing; not parsimonious; liberal; profuse. Burke. 2. Not merciful or forgiving. Milton. -- Un*spar"ing*ly, adv. -- Un*spar"ing*ness, n.

sedum.definition: A genus of plants, mostly perennial, having succulent leaves and cymose flowers; orpine; stonecrop. Gray.

zumbooruk.definition: A small cannon supported by a swiveled rest on the back of a camel, whence it is fired, -- used in the East.

fernticle.definition: A freckle on the skin, resembling the seed of fern.

clatter.definition:
To make a rattling sound by striking hard bodies together; to make a succession of abrupt, rattling sounds. Clattering loud with clamk. Longfellow. 2. To talk fast and noisily; to rattle with the tongue. I see thou dost but clatter. Spenser.

To make a rattling noise with. You clatter still your bra.

stalagmitical.definition: Having the form or structure of stalagmites. -- Stal`ag*mit"ic*al*ly, adv.

aecidium.definition: A form of fruit in the cycle of development of the Rusts or Brands, an order of fungi, formerly considered independent plants.

lyrie.definition: A European fish (Peristethus cataphractum), having the body covered with bony plates, and having three spines projecting in front of the nose; -- called also noble, pluck, pogge, sea poacher, and armed bullhead.

bridestake.definition: A stake or post set in the ground, for guests at a wedding to dance round. Divide the broad bridecake Round about the bridestake. B. Jonson.

ottawas.definition: A tribe of Indians who, when first known, lived on the Ottawa River. Most of them subsequently migrated to the southwestern shore of Lake Superior.

speediness.definition: The quality or state of being speedy.

miscredent.definition: A miscreant, or believer in a false religious doctrine. Holinshed.

enecate.definition: To kill off; to destroy. Harvey.

stereochromy.definition: A style of painting on plastered walls or stone, in which the colors are rendered permanent by sprinklings of water, in which is mixed a proportion of soluble glass (a silicate of soda).

tubful.definition: As much as a tub will hold; enough to fill a tub.

circulatory.definition:
Circular; as, a circulatory letter. Johnson. 2. Circulating, or going round. T. Warton. 3. (Anat.)  Subserving the purposes of circulation; as, circulatory organs; of or pertaining to the organs of circulation; as, circulatory diseases.

A chemical vessel consisting of two portions unequally exposed.

measle.definition:
A leper. [Written also meazel, and mesel.] Wyclif (Matt. x. 8. ).

A tapeworm larva. See 2d Measles, 4.

lichenic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or obtained from, lichens. Lichenic acid. (a) An organic acid, C14H24O3 obtained from Iceland moss. (b) An old name of fumaric acid.

bighorn.definition: The Rocky Mountain sheep (Ovis or Caprovis montana).

rumkin.definition: A popular or jocular name for a drinking vessel.

syphilodermatous.definition: Of or pertaining to the cutaneous manifestations of syphilis.

fangle.definition:
Something new-fashioned; a foolish innovation; a gewgaw; a trifling ornament.

To fashion. To control and new fangle the Scripture. Milton.

aggressor.definition: The person who first attacks or makes an aggression; he who begins hostility or a quarrel; an assailant. The insolence of the aggressor is usually proportioned to the tameness of the sufferer. Ames.

land-poor.definition: Pecuniarily embarrassed through owning much unprofitable land.

incorrupt.definition: Not affected with corruption or decay; unimpaired; not marred or spoiled. 2. Not defiled or depraved; pure; sound; untainted; above the influence of bribes; upright; honest. Milton. Your Christian principles . . . which will preserve you incorrupt as individuals. Bp. Hurd.

bantling.definition: A young or small child; an infant. [Slightly contemptuous or depreciatory.] In what out of the way corners genius produces her bantlings. W. Irving.

chestnut.definition: (Bot.)  The edible nut of a forest tree (Castanea vesce) of Europe and America. Commonly two or more of the nuts grow in a prickly bur. 2. The tree itself, or its light, coarse-grained timber, used for ornamental work, furniture, etc. 3. A bright brown color, like that of the nut. 4. The horse chest.

wedge.definition: A piece of metal, or other hard material, thick at one end, and tapering to a thin edge at the other, used in splitting wood, rocks, etc., in raising heavy bodies, and the like. It is one of the six elementary machines called the mechanical powers. See Illust. of Mechanical powers, under Mechanical.

bronchotome.definition: An instrument for cutting into the bronchial tubes.

demilance.definition: A light lance; a short spear; a half pike; also, a demilancer.

besmoke.definition: To foul with smoke. 2. To harden or dry in smoke. Johnson.

wood-note.definition: A wild or natural note, as of a forest bird. Or sweetest Shakespeare, fancy's child, Warble his native wood-notes wild. Milton.

contrapuntal.definition: Pertaining to, or according to the rules of, counterpoint.

liberality.definition: The quality or state of being liberal; liberal disposition or practice; freedom from narrowness or prejudice; generosity; candor; charity. That liberality is but cast away Which makes us borrow what we can not pay. Denham. 2. A gift; a gratuity; -- sometimes in the plural; as, a prudent man is not i.

uprising.definition: Act of rising; also, a steep place; an ascent. "The steep uprising of the hill." Shak. 2. An insurrection; a popular revolt. J. P. Peters.

lignite.definition: Mineral coal retaining the texture of the wood from which it was formed, and burning with an empyreumatic odor. It is of more recent origin than the anthracite and bituminous coal of the proper coal series. Called also brown coal, wood coal.

luminiferous.definition: Producing light; yielding light; transmitting light; as, the luminiferous ether.

hydrocephalus.definition: An accumulation of liquid within the cavity of the cranium, especially within the ventricles of the brain; dropsy of the brain. It is due usually to tubercular meningitis. When it occurs in infancy, it often enlarges the head enormously.

emmew.definition: To mew or coop up. Shak.

unfounded.definition: Not founded; not built or established. Milton. 2. Having no foundation; baseless; vain; idle; as, unfounded expectations. Paley.

fornicator.definition: An unmarried person, male or female, who has criminal intercourse with the other sex; one guilty of fornication.

malic.definition: Pertaining to, or obtained from, apples; as, malic acid. Malic acid, a hydroxy acid obtained as a substance which is sirupy or crystallized with difficulty, and has a strong but pleasant sour taste. It occurs in many fruits, as in green apples, currants, etc. It is levorotatory or dextrorotatory acc.

bibber.definition: One given to drinking alcoholic beverages too freely; a tippler; -- chiefly used in composition; as, winebibber.

croupous.definition: Relating to or resembling croup; especially, attended with the formation of a deposit or membrance like that found in membranous croup; as, croupous laryngitis. Croupous pneumonia, pneumonia attended with deposition of fibrinous matter in the air vesicles of the lungs; ordinary acute pneumonia.

rontgenize.definition: To render (air or other gas) conducting by the passage of Röntgen rays.

smuggle.definition:
To import or export secretly, contrary to the law; to import or export without paying the duties imposed by law; as, to smuggle lace. 2. Fig.: To convey or introduce clandestinely.

To import or export in violation of the customs laws.

clasper.definition: One who, or that which, clasps, as a tendril. "The claspers of vines." Derham. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) One of a pair of organs used by the male for grasping the female among many of the Crustacea. (b) One of a pair of male copulatory organs, developed on the anterior side of the ventral fins of sharks and ot.

electro-metallurgy.definition: The act or art precipitating a metal electro-chemical action, by which a coating is deposited, on a prepared surface, as in electroplating and electrotyping; galvanoplasty.

igasurine.definition: An alkaloid found in nux vomica, and extracted as a white crystalline substance.

disennoble.definition: To deprive of that which ennobles; to degrade. An unworthy behavior degrades and disennobles a man. Guardian.

delibrate.definition: To strip off the bark; to peel. Ash.

priming.definition: The powder or other combustible used to communicate fire to a charge of gunpowder, as in a firearm. 2. (Paint.)  The first coating of color, size, or the like, laid on canvas, or on a building, or other surface. 3. (Steam Eng.)  The carrying over of water, with the steam, from the boiler, as into th.

salal-berry.definition: The edible fruit of the Gaultheria Shallon, an ericaceous shrub found from California northwards. The berries are about the size of a common grape and of a dark purple color.

subcontracted.definition: Contracted after a former contract. 2. Betrothed for the second time. Shak.

bird-eyed.definition: Quick-sighted; catching a glance as one goes.

calculary.definition:
Of or pertaining to calculi.

A congeries of little stony knots found in the pulp of the pear and other fruits.

troublous.definition: Full of trouble; causing trouble. "In doubtful time of troublous need." Byron. A tall ship tossed in troublous seas. Spenser.

tonicity.definition: The state of healty tension or partial contraction of muscle fibers while at rest; tone; tonus.

brokenness.definition: The state or quality of being broken; unevenness. Macaulay. 2. Contrition; as, brokenness of heart.

gleeman.definition: A name anciently given to an itinerant minstrel or musician.

hortative.definition:
Giving exhortation; advisory; exhortative. Bullokar.

An exhortation.

turpitude.definition: Inherent baseness or vileness of principle, words, or actions; shameful wickedness; depravity. Shak.

generality.definition: The state of being general; the quality of including species or particulars. Hooker. 2. That which is general; that which lacks specificalness, practicalness, or application; a general or vague statement or phrase. Let us descend from generalities to particulars. Landor. The glittering and sounding.

adeniform.definition: Shaped like a gland; adenoid. Dunglison.

pleasantness.definition: The state or quality of being pleasant.

unparadise.definition: To deprive of happiness like that of paradise; to render unhappy. Young.

wren.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of numerous species of small singing birds belonging to Troglodytes and numerous allied of the family Troglodytidæ. Note: Among the species best known are the house wren (Troglodytes aëdon) common in both Europe and America, and the American winter wren (T. hiemalis). See also Cactu.

strangely.definition: As something foreign, or not one's own; in a manner adapted to something foreign and strange. Shak. 2. In the manner of one who does not know another; distantly; reservedly; coldly. You all look strangely on me. Shak. I do in justice charge thee . . . That thou commend it strangely to some place Whe.

besieger.definition: One who besieges; -- opposed to the besieged.

bebirine.definition: An alkaloid got from the bark of the bebeeru, or green heart of Guiana (Nectandra Rodioei). It is a tonic, antiperiodic, and febrifuge, and is used in medicine as a substitute for quinine. [Written also bibirine.].

dataria.definition: Formerly, a part of the Roman chancery; now, a separate office from which are sent graces or favors, cognizable in foro externo, such as appointments to benefices. The name is derived from the word datum, given or dated (with the indications of the time and place of granting the gift or favor).

spiracular.definition: Of or pertaining to a spiracle.

unruliment.definition: Unruliness. "Breaking forth with rude unruliment." Spenser.

chitterlings.definition: The smaller intestines of swine, etc., fried for food.

tidings.definition: Account of what has taken place, and was not before known; news. I shall make my master glad with these tidings. Shak. Full well the busy whisper, circling round, Conveyed the dismal tidings when he frowned. Goldsmith. Note: Although tidings is plural in form, it has been used also as a singular. By.

propulsive.definition: Tending, or having power, to propel; driving on; urging. "[The] propulsive movement of the verse." Coleridge.

adrogation.definition: A kind of adoption in ancient Rome. See Arrogation.

ursal.definition: The ursine seal. See the Note under 1st Seal.

raiser.definition: One who, or that which, raises (in various senses of the verb).

branchiate.definition: Furnished with branchiæ; as, branchiate segments.

ignescent.definition: Emitting sparks of fire when struck with steel; scintillating; as, ignescent stones.

be-all.definition: The whole; all that is to be. [Poetic] Shak.

trendle.definition: A wheel, spindle, or the like; a trundle. The shaft the wheel, the wheel, the trendle turns. Sylvester.

pharisaical.definition: Of or pertaining to the Pharisees; resembling the Pharisees. "The Pharisaic sect among the Jews." Cudworth. 2. Hence: Addicted to external forms and ceremonies; making a show of religion without the spirit of it; ceremonial; formal; hypocritical; self-righteous. "Excess of outward and pharisaical ho.

porosity.definition: The quality or state of being porous; -- opposed to density.

flammability.definition: The quality of being flammable; inflammability. Sir T. Browne.

illumine.definition: To illuminate; to light up; to adorn.

decussate.definition:
To cross at an acute angle; to cut or divide in the form of X; to intersect; -- said of lines in geometrical figures, rays of light, nerves, etc.

1. Crossed; intersected. 2. (Bot.)  Growing in pairs, each of which is at right angles to the next pair above or below; as, decussated leaves or branches.

chromoplastid.definition: A protoplasmic granule of some other color than green; -- also called chromoleucite.

jewbush.definition: A euphorbiaceous shrub of the genus Pedilanthus (P. tithymaloides), found in the West Indies, and possessing powerful emetic and drastic qualities.

glyoxaline.definition: A white, crystalline, organic base, C3H4N2, produced by the action of ammonia on glyoxal, and forming the origin of a large class of derivatives hence, any one of the series of which glyoxaline is a type; -- called also oxaline.

sinapoline.definition: A nitrogenous base, CO.(NH.C3H5)2, related to urea, extracted from mustard oil, and also produced artifically, as a white crystalline substance; -- called also diallyl urea.

insure.definition: To make sure or secure; as, to insure safety to any one. 2. Specifically, to secure against a loss by a contingent event, on certain stipulated conditions, or at a given rate or premium; to give or to take an insurance on or for; as, a merchant insures his ship or its cargo, or both, against the dan.

dogal.definition: Of or pertaining to a doge.

microphthalmia.definition: An unnatural smallness of the eyes, occurring as the result of disease or of imperfect development.

synedral.definition: Growing on the angles of a stem, as the leaves in some species of Selaginella.

historiette.definition: Historical narration on a small scale; a brief recital; a story. Emerson.

formaldehyde.definition: A colorless, volatile liquid, H2CO, resembling acetic or ethyl aldehyde, and chemically intermediate between methyl alcohol and formic acid.

antitoxin.definition: A substance (sometimes the product of a specific micro-organism and sometimes naturally present in the blood or tissues of an animal), capable of producing immunity from certain diseases, or of counteracting the poisonous effects of pathogenic bacteria.

tarquinish.definition: Like a Tarquin, a king of ancient Rome; proud; haughty; overbearing.

arraignment.definition: (Law)  The act of arraigning, or the state of being arraigned; the act of calling and setting a prisoner before a court to answer to an indictment or complaint. 2. A calling to an account to faults; accusation. In the sixth satire, which seems only an Arraignment of the whole sex, there is a latent.

tramrail.definition: An overhead rail forming a track on which a trolley runs to convey a load, as in a shop.

paresis.definition: Incomplete paralysis, affecting motion but not sensation.

superimpregnation.definition: The act of impregnating, or the state of being impregnated, in addition to a prior impregnation; superfetation.

priscillianist.definition: A follower of Priscillian, bishop of Avila in Spain, in the fourth century, who mixed various elements of Gnosticism and Manicheism with Christianity.

xanthoprotein.definition: A yellow acid substance formed by the action of hot nitric acid on albuminous or proteid matter. It is changed to a deep orange- yellow color by the addition of ammonia.

yern.definition:
See 3d Yearn.

Eager; brisk; quick; active. "Her song . . . loud and yern." Chaucer.

shide.definition: A thin board; a billet of wood; a splinter.

aphrodisiac.definition:
Exciting venereal desire; provocative to venery.

That which (as a drug, or some kinds of food) excites to venery.

medium-sized.definition: Having a medium size; as, a medium-sized man.

repand.definition: Having a slightly undulating margin; -- said of leaves.

complexus.definition: A complex; an aggregate of parts; a complication.

bacharach.definition: A kind of wine made at Bacharach on the Rhine.

rooftree.definition: The beam in the angle of a roof; hence, the roof itself. Now for me the woods may wither, now for me the rooftree fall. Tennyson.

isocrymal.definition: Pertaining to, having the nature of, or illustrating, an isocryme; as, an isocrymal line; an isocrymal chart.

oolong.definition: A fragrant variety of black tea having somewhat the flavor of green tea. [Written also oulong.].

mania.definition: Violent derangement of mind; madness; insanity. Cf. Delirium. 2. Excessive or unreasonable desire; insane passion affecting one or many people; as, the tulip mania. Mania a potu Etym: [L.], madness from drinking; delirium tremens. Syn. -- Insanity; derangement; madness; lunacy; alienation; aberratio.

sea-gate.definition: A long, rolling swell of the sea. Ham. Nav. Encyc.

parley.definition:
Mutual discourse or conversation; discussion; hence, an oral conference with an enemy, as with regard to a truce. We yield on parley, but are stormed in vain. Dryden. To beat a parley (Mil.), to beat a drum, or sound a trumpet, as a signal for holding a conference with the enemy.

To speak with anot.

oversell.definition: To sell for a higher price than; to exceed in selling price. One whose beauty Would oversell all Italy. Beau. & Fl. 2. To sell beyond means of delivery. [Brokers'Cant] Oversold market (Brokers' Cant), a market in which stocks or commodities have been sold "short" to such an extent that it is difficu.

luter.definition:
One who plays on a lute.

One who applies lute.

convulse.definition: To contract violently and irregulary, as the muscular parts of an animal body; to shake with irregular spasms, as in excessive laughter, or in agony from grief or pain. With emotions which checked his voice and convulsed his powerful frame. Macaulay. 2. To agitate greatly; to shake violently. The wo.

unglue.definition: To separate, part, or open, as anything fastened with glue. She stretches, gapes, unglues her eyes, And asks if it be time to rise. Swift.

feigning.definition: That feigns; insincere; not genuine; false. -- Feign"ing*ly, adv.

cultrated.definition: Sharp-edged and pointed; shaped like a pruning knife, as the beak of certain birds.

stateswoman.definition: A woman concerned in public affairs. A rare stateswoman; I admire her bearing. B. Jonson.

artocarpeous.definition: Of or pertaining to the breadfruit, or to the genus Artocarpus.

infraorbital.definition: Below the orbit; as, the infraorbital foramen; the infraorbital nerve.

unhitch.definition: To free from being hitched, or as if from being hitched; to unfasten; to loose; as, to unhitch a horse, or a trace.

ravissant.definition: In a half-raised position, as if about to spring on prey.

draughts.definition:
A mild vesicatory. See Draught, n., 3 (c).

A game, now more commonly called checkers. See Checkers. Note: Polish draughts is sometimes played with 40 pieces on a board divided into 100 squares. Am. Cyc.

expediency.definition: The quality of being expedient or advantageous; fitness or suitableness to effect a purpose intended; adaptedness to self- interest; desirableness; advantage; advisability; -- sometimes contradistinguished from moral rectitude. Divine wisdom discovers no expediency in vice. Cogan. To determine conce.

vagarious.definition: Given to, or characterized by, vagaries; capricious; whimsical; crochety.

immemorial.definition: Extending beyond the reach of memory, record, or tradition; indefinitely ancient; as, existing from time immemorial. "Immemorial elms." Tennyson. "Immemorial usage or custom." Sir M. Hale. Time immemorial (Eng. Law.), a time antedating (legal) history, and beyond "legal memory" so called; formerly a.

drupe.definition: A fruit consisting of pulpy, coriaceous, or fibrous exocarp, without valves, containing a nut or stone with a kernel. The exocarp is succulent in the plum, cherry, apricot, peach, etc.; dry and subcoriaceous in the almond; and fibrous in the cocoanut.

unintermission.definition: Want or failure of intermission. Bp. Parker.

lithotomist.definition: One who performs the operation of cutting for stone in the bladder, or one who is skilled in the operation.

thunderbird.definition: An Australian insectivorous singing bird (Pachycephala gutturalis). The male is conspicuously marked with black and yellow, and has a black crescent on the breast. Called also white-throated thickhead, orange-breasted thrust, black-crowned thrush, guttural thrush, and black-breasted flycatcher.

decime.definition: A French coin, the tenth part of a franc, equal to about two cents.

gloss.definition: Bbrightness or luster of a body proceeding from a smooth surface; polish; as, the gloss of silk; cloth is calendered to give it a gloss. It is no part . . . to set on the face of this cause any fairer gloss than the naked truth doth afford. Hooker. 2. A specious appearance; superficial quality or sh.

oxalethyline.definition: A poisonous nitrogenous base (C6H10N2) obtained indirectly from oxamide as a thick transparent oil which has a strong narcotic odor, and a physiological action resembling that of atropine. It is probably related to pyridine.

unkennel.definition: To drive from a kennel or hole; as, to unkennel a fox. 2. Fig.: To discover; to disclose. Shak.

bestialize.definition: To make bestial, or like a beast; to degrade; to brutalize. The process of bestializing humanity. Hare.

shilfa.definition: The chaffinch; -- so named from its call note.

cinquecentist.definition: An Italian of the sixteenth century, esp. a poet or artist. 2.  A student or imitator of the art or literature of the Cinquecento.

merchantman.definition: A merchant. Matt. xiii. 45. 2. A trading vessel; a ship employed in the transportation of goods, as, distinguished from a man-of-war.

stuttering.definition:
The act of one who stutters; -- restricted by some physiologists to defective speech due to inability to form the proper sounds, the breathing being normal, as distinguished from stammering.

Apt to stutter; hesitating; stammering. -- Stut"ter*ing*ly, adv.

copesmate.definition: An associate or companion; a friend; a partner. Misshapen time, copesmate of ugly Night. Shak.

gros.definition: A heavy silk with a dull finish; as, gros de Naples; gros de Tours.

octosyllable.definition:
Octosyllabic.

A word of eight syllables.

inapplicable.definition: Not applicable; incapable of being applied; not adapted; not suitable; as, the argument is inapplicable to the case. J. S. Mill. Syn. -- Unsuitable; unsuited; unadapted; inappropriate; inapposite; irrelevant. -- In*ap"pli*ca*ble*ness, n. -- In*ap"pli*ca*bly, adv.

elvish.definition: Pertaining to elves; implike; mischievous; weird; also, vacant; absent in demeanor. See Elfish. He seemeth elvish by his countenance. Chaucer. 2. Mysterious; also, foolish.

fatalism.definition: The doctrine that all things are subject to fate, or that they take place by inevitable necessity.

hobbly.definition: Rough; uneven; causing one to hobble; as a hobbly road.

wordsman.definition: One who deals in words, or in mere words; a verbalist. "Some speculative wordsman." H. Bushnell.

torbernite.definition: A mineral occurring in emerald-green tabular crystals having a micaceous structure. It is a hydrous phosphate of uranium and copper. Called also copper uranite, and chalcolite.

rug-gowned.definition: Wearing a coarse gown or shaggy garment made of rug. Beau. & Fl.

poachy.definition: Wet and soft; easily penetrated by the feet of cattle; -- said of land.

bulldoze.definition: To intimidate; to restrain or coerce by intimidation or violence; -- used originally of the intimidation of negro voters, in Louisiana. [Slang, U.S.].

ptilopaedic.definition: Having nearly the whole surface of the skin covered with down; dasypædic; -- said of the young of certain birds.

bounteous.definition: Liberal in charity; disposed to give freely; generously liberal; munificent; beneficent; free in bestowing gifts; as, bounteous production. But O, thou bounteous Giver of all good. Cowper. -- Boun"te*ous*ly, adv. -- Boun"te*ous*ness, n.

embark.definition:
To cause to go on board a vessel or boat; to put on shipboard. 2. To engage, enlist, or invest (as persons, money, etc.) in any affair; as, he embarked his fortune in trade. It was the reputation of the sect upon which St. Paul embarked his salvation. South.

1. To go on board a vessel or a boat for.

condensate.definition:
Made dense; condensed. Water . . . thickened or condensate. Peacham.

To condense. Hammond.

bolar.definition: Of or pertaining to bole or clay; partaking of the nature and qualities of bole; clayey.

girandole.definition: An ornamental branched candlestick. 2. A flower stand, fountain, or the like, of branching form. 3. (Pyrotechny)  A kind of revolving firework. 4. (Fort.)  A series of chambers in defensive mines. Farrow.

tarditation.definition: Tardiness. To instruct them to avoid all snares of tarditation, in the Lord's affairs. Herrick.

xerophthalmia.definition: An abnormal dryness of the eyeball produced usually by long- continued inflammation and subsequent atrophy of the conjunctiva.

codicillary.definition: Of the nature of a codicil.

lifeless.definition: Destitute of life, or deprived of life; not containing, or inhabited by, living beings or vegetation; dead, or apparently dead; spiritless; powerless; dull; as, a lifeless carcass; lifeless matter; a lifeless desert; a lifeless wine; a lifeless story. -- Life"less*ly, adv. -- Life"less*ness, n. Syn.

unijugate.definition: Having but one pair of leaflets; -- said of a pinnate leaf.

denominationalism.definition: A denominational or class spirit or policy; devotion to the interests of a sect or denomination.

extender.definition: One who, or that which, extends or stretches anything.

loris.definition: Any one of several species of small lemurs of the genus Stenops. They have long, slender limbs and large eyes, and are arboreal in their habits. The slender loris (S. gracilis), of Ceylon, in one of the best known species. [Written also lori.].

eager.definition: Sharp; sour; acid. "Like eager droppings into milk." Shak. 2. Sharp; keen; bitter; severe. "A nipping and an eager air." "Eager words." Shak. 3. Excited by desire in the pursuit of any object; ardent to pursue, perform, or obtain; keenly desirous; hotly longing; earnest; zealous; impetuous; vehement.

redoubted.definition: Formidable; dread. "Some redoubled knight." Spenser. Lord regent, and redoubted Burgandy. Shak.

inflammation.definition: The act of inflaming, kindling, or setting on fire; also, the state of being inflamed. "The inflammation of fat." Wilkins. 2. (Med.)  A morbid condition of any part of the body, consisting in congestion of the blood vessels, with obstruction of the blood current, and growth of morbid tissue. It is m.

leechcraft.definition: The art of healing; skill of a physician. [Archaic] Chaucer.

shoo.definition: Begone; away; -- an expression used in frightening away animals, especially fowls.

marmorosis.definition: The metamorphism of limestone, that is, its conversion into marble. Geikie.

effront.definition: To give assurance to. Sir T. Browne.

cestuy.definition: He; the one. Cestuy que trust ( Etym: [norm. F.], a person who has the equitable and beneficial interest in property, the legal interest in which is vested in a trustee. Wharton. -- Cestuy que use ( Etym: [Norm. F.], a person for whose use land, etc., is granted to another.

hymenoptera.definition: An extensive order of insects, including the bees, ants, ichneumons, sawflies, etc. Note: They have four membranous wings, with few reticulations, and usually with a thickened, dark spot on the front edge of the anterior wings. In most of the species, the tongue, or lingua, is converted into an orga.

waking.definition: The act of waking, or the state or period of being awake. 2. A watch; a watching. "Bodily pain . . . standeth in prayer, in wakings, in fastings." Chaucer. In the fourth waking of the night. Wyclif (Matt. xiv. 25).

earing.definition:
(a) A line used to fasten the upper corners of a sail to the yard or gaff; -- also called head earing. (b) A line for hauling the reef cringle to the yard; -- also called reef earing. (c) A line fastening the corners of an awning to the rigging or stanchions.

Coming into ear, as corn.

A plowing of.

domicile.definition:
An abode or mansion; a place of permanent residence, either of an individual or a family. 2. (Law)  A residence at a particular place accompanied with an intention to remain there for an unlimited time; a residence accepted as a final abode. Wharton.

To establish in a fixed residence, or a residenc.

evection.definition: The act of carrying up or away; exaltation. Bp. Pearson. 2. (Astron.) (a) An inequality of the moon's motion is its orbit to the attraction of the sun, by which the equation of the center is diminished at the syzygies, and increased at the quadratures by about 1º 20'. (b) The libration of the moon.

mattowacca.definition: An American clupeoid fish (Clupea mediocris), similar to the shad in habits and appearance, but smaller and less esteemed for food; -- called also hickory shad, tailor shad, fall herring, and shad herring.

sphalerite.definition: Zinc sulphide; -- called also blende, black-jack, false galena, etc. See Blende (a).

assoil.definition: To set free; to release. [Archaic] Till from her hands the spright assoiled is. Spenser. 2. To solve; to clear up. Any child might soon be able to assoil this riddle. Bp. Jewel. 3. To set free from guilt; to absolve. [Archaic] Acquitted and assoiled from the guilt. Dr. H. More. Many persons think th.

seditionary.definition: An inciter or promoter of sedition. Bp. Hall.

radicant.definition: Taking root on, or above, the ground; rooting from the stem, as the trumpet creeper and the ivy.

elapine.definition: Like or pertaining to the Elapidæ, a family of poisonous serpents, including the cobras. See Ophidia.

bunn.definition:
A slightly sweetened raised cake or bisquit with a glazing of sugar and milk on the top crust.

See Bun.

methylic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or containing, methyl; specifically, designating methyl alcohol. See under Methyl.

thermotensile.definition: Pertaining to the variation of tensile strength with the temperature.

bagworm.definition: One of several lepidopterous insects which construct, in the larval state, a baglike case which they carry about for protection. One species (Platoeceticus Gloveri) feeds on the orange tree. See Basket worm.

impressibility.definition: The quality of being impressible; susceptibility.

southeastern.definition: Of or pertaining to the southeast; southeasterly.

testator.definition: A man who makes and leaves a will, or testament, at death.

venomous.definition: Full of venom; noxious to animal life; poisonous; as, the bite of a serpent may be venomous. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having a poison gland or glands for the secretion of venom, as certain serpents and insects. 3. Noxious; mischievous; malignant; spiteful; as, a venomous progeny; a venomous writer. Venomous snak.

decree.definition: An order from one having authority, deciding what is to be done by a subordinate; also, a determination by one having power, deciding what is to be done or to take place; edict, law; authoritative ru "The decrees of Venice." Sh There went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus that all the world should be.

lye.definition:
A strong caustic alkaline solution of potassium salts, obtained by leaching wood ashes. It is much used in making soap, etc.

A short side line, connected with the main line; a turn-out; a siding. [Eng.]

A falsehood. See Lie.

tetraspaston.definition: A machine in which four pulleys act together. Brande & C.

ceresin.definition: A white wax, made by bleaching and purifying ozocerite, and used as a substitute for beeswax.

crawl.definition: To move slowly by drawing the body along the ground, as a worm; to move slowly on hands and kness; to creep. A worm finds what it searches after only by feeling, as it crawls from one thing to another. Grew. 2. Hence, to move or advance in a feeble, slow, or timorous manner. He was hardly able to cr.

lugworm.definition: A large marine annelid (Arenicola marina) having a row of tufted gills along each side of the back. It is found burrowing in sandy beaches, both in America and Europe, and is used for bait by European fishermen. Called also lobworm, and baitworm.

maleo.definition: A bird of Celebes (megacephalon maleo), allied to the brush turkey. It makes mounds in which to lay its eggs.

noematical.definition: Of or pertaining to the understanding. Cudworth.

swale.definition:
A valley or low place; a tract of low, and usually wet, land; a moor; a fen. [Prov. Eng. & Local, U.S.]

To melt and waste away; to singe. See Sweal, v.

A gutter in a candle.

froufrou.definition: A rustling, esp. the rustling of a woman's dress.

rigolette.definition: A woman's light scarflike head covering, usually knit or crocheted of wool.

speiss.definition: A regulus consisting essentially of nickel, obtained as a residue in fusing cobalt and nickel ores with silica and sodium carbonate to make smalt.

apologize.definition: To make an apology or defense. Dr. H. More. 2. To make an apology or excuse; to make acknowledgment of some fault or offense, with expression of regret for it, by way of amends; -- with for; as, my correspondent apologized for not answering my letter. To apologize for his insolent language. Froude.

mab.definition: A slattern. 2. The name of a female fairy, esp. the queen of the fairies; and hence, sometimes, any fairy. Shak.

logroller.definition: One who engages in logrolling. [Political cant, U. S.] The jobbers and logrollers will all be against it. The. Nation.

cloy.definition: To fill or choke up; to stop up; to clog. The duke's purpose was to have cloyed the harbor by sinking ships, laden with stones. Speed. 2. To glut, or satisfy, as the appetite; to satiate; to fill to loathing; to surfeit. [Who can] cloy the hungry edge of appetite By bare imagination of a feast Shak.

enlight.definition: To illumine; to enlighten. Which from the first has shone on ages past, Enlights the present, and shall warm the last. Pope.

hoofbound.definition: Having a dry and contracted hoof, which occasions pain and lameness.

squander.definition: To scatter; to disperse. Our squandered troops he rallies. Dryden. 2. To spend lavishly or profusely; to spend prodigally or wastefully; to use without economy or judgment; to dissipate; as, to squander an estate. The crime of squandering health is equal to the folly. Rambler. Syn. -- To spend; expe.

dodd.definition: To cut off, as wool from sheep's tails; to lop or clip off. Halliwell.

entomostracan.definition: Relating to the Entomostraca. -- n.  One of the Entomostraca.

aret.definition: To reckon; to ascribe; to impute. Chaucer.

dislikeful.definition: Full of dislike; disaffected; malign; disagreeable. Spenser.

individualize.definition: The mark as an individual, or to distinguish from others by peculiar properties; to invest with individuality. The peculiarities which individualize and distinguish the humor of Addison. N. Drake.

nodation.definition: Act of making a knot, or state of being knotted.

investigable.definition:
Capable or susceptible of being investigated; admitting research. Hooker.

Unsearchable; inscrutable. So unsearchable the judgment and so investigable the ways thereof. Bale.

textuary.definition:
Contained in the text; textual. Sir T. Browne. 2. Serving as a text; authoritative. Glanvill.

1. One who is well versed in the Scriptures; a textman. Bp. Bull. 2. One who adheres strictly or rigidly to the text.

illocality.definition: Want of locality or place. Cudworth.

unbreast.definition: To disclose, or lay open; to unbosom. P. Fletcher,.

superannuation.definition: The state of being superannuated, or too old for office or business; the state of being disqualified by old age; decrepitude. The world itself is in a state of superannuation. Cowper. Slyness blinking through the watery eye of superannuation. Coleridge.

soliform.definition: Like the sun in form, appearance, or nature; resembling the sun. "Soliform things." Cudworth.

prentice.definition: An apprentice. [Obs. or Colloq.] Piers Plowman. "My accuser is my prentice." Shak.

furring.definition: (Carp.) (a) The leveling of a surface, or the preparing of an air space, by means of strips of board or of larger pieces. See Fur, v. t., 3. (b) The strips thus laid on. 2. (Shipbuilding)  Double planking of a ship's side. 3. A deposit from water, as on the inside of a boiler; also, the operation of.

matricide.definition: The murder of a mother by her son or daughter. 2. Etym: [L. matricida: cf. F. matricide.]  One who murders one's own mother.

cuspidated.definition: Having a sharp end, like the point of a spear; terminating in a hard point; as, a cuspidate leaf.

moth.definition:
A mote. Shak.

1. (Zoöl.)  Any nocturnal lepidopterous insect, or any not included among the butterflies; as, the luna moth; Io moth; hawk moth. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any lepidopterous insect that feeds upon garments, grain, etc.; as, the clothes moth; grain moth; bee moth. See these terms under Clothes, Grai.

solpugid.definition: Of or pertaining to the Solifugæ. -- n.  One of the Solifugæ.

symbiotic.definition: Pertaining to, or characterized by, or living in, a state of symbiosis. -- Sym`bi*ot"ic*al (#), a. -- Sym`bi*ot"ic*al*ly (#), adv.

typesetting.definition: The act or art of setting type.

rheochord.definition: A metallic wire used for regulating the resistance of a circuit, or varying the strength of an electric current, by inserting a greater or less length of it in the circuit.

opuntia.definition: A genus of cactaceous plants; the prickly pear, or Indian fig.

garrulous.definition: Talking much, especially about commonplace or trivial things; talkative; loquacious. The most garrulous people on earth. De Quincey. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having a loud, harsh note; noisy; -- said of birds; as, the garrulous roller. Syn. -- Garrulous, Talkative, Loquacious. A garrulous person indulges in long.

hieron.definition: A consecrateo place; esp., a temple.

flea-beetle.definition: A small beetle of the family Halticidæ, of many species. They have strong posterior legs and leap like fleas. The turnip flea- beetle (Phyllotreta vittata) and that of the grapevine (Graptodera chalybea) are common injurious species.

nougat.definition: A cake, sweetmeat, or confectión made with almonds or other nuts.

urodela.definition: An order of amphibians having the tail well developed and often long. It comprises the salamanders, tritons, and allied animals.

conifer.definition: A tree or shrub bearing cones; one of the order Coniferae, which includes the pine, cypress, and (according to some) the yew.

daubing.definition: The act of one who daubs; that which is daubed. 2. A rough coat of mortar put upon a wall to give it the appearance of stone; rough-cast. 3. In currying, a mixture of fish oil and tallow worked into leather; -- called also dubbing. Knight.

cornu.definition: A horn, or anything shaped like or resembling a horn.

falsism.definition: That which is evidently false; an assertion or statement the falsity of which is plainly apparent; -- opposed to truism.

algaroth.definition: A term used for the Powder of Algaroth, a white powder which is a compound of trichloride and trioxide of antimony. It was formerly used in medicine as an emetic, purgative, and diaphoretic.

juglandine.definition: An alkaloid found in the leaves of the walnut (Juglans regia).

postdiluvian.definition:
Being or happening after the flood in Noah's days.

One who lived after the flood.

primateship.definition: The office, dignity, or position of a primate; primacy.

praxinoscope.definition: An instrument, similar to the phenakistoscope, for presenting to view, or projecting upon a screen, images the natural motions of real objects.

norna.definition: (Scandinavian Myth.)  One of the three Fates, Past, Present, and Future. Their names were Urd, Verdandi, and Skuld. 2. A tutelary deity; a genius.

impunctuality.definition: Neglect of, or failure in, punctuality. A. Hamilton.

stirt.definition: Started; leaped. They privily be stirt into a well. Chaucer.

pharisee.definition: One of a sect or party among the Jews, noted for a strict and formal observance of rites and ceremonies and of the traditions of the elders, and whose pretensions to superior sanctity led them to separate themselves from the other Jews.

xyst.definition: A long and open portico, for athletic exercises, as wrestling, running, etc., for use in winter or in stormy weather.

laurinol.definition: Ordinary camphor; -- so called in allusion to the family name (Lauraceæ) of the camphor trees. See Camphor.

subreligion.definition: A secondary religion; a belief or principle held in a quasi religious veneration. Loyalty is in the English a subreligion. Emerson.

cooperate.definition: To act or operate jointly with another or others; to concur in action, effort, or effect. Whate'er coöperates to the common mirth. Crashaw.

wastrel.definition: Any waste thing or substance; as: (a) Waste land or common land. Carew. (b) A profligate. (c) A neglected child; a street Arab. [Eng.] 2. Anything cast away as bad or useless, as imperfect bricks, china, etc. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.].

scorie.definition: The young of any gull. [Written also scaurie.] [prov. Eng.].

laccin.definition: A yellow amorphous substance obtained from lac.

angiography.definition: A description of blood vessels and lymphatics.

volborthite.definition: A mineral occurring in small six-sided tabular crystals of a green or yellow color. It is a hydrous vanadate of copper and lime.

discus.definition: (a) A quoit; a circular plate of some heavy material intended to be pitched or hurled as a trial of strength and skill. (b) The exercise with the discus. Note: This among the Greeks was one of the chief gymnastic exercises and was included in the Pentathlon (the contest of the five exercises). The c.

musa.definition: A genus of perennial, herbaceous, endogenous plants of great size, including the banana (Musa sapientum), the plantain (M. paradisiaca of Linnæus, but probably not a distinct species), the Abyssinian (M. Ensete), the Philippine Island (M. textilis, which yields Manila hemp), and about eighteen other.

nonet.definition: A composition for nine instruments, rarely for nine voices.

glassmaker.definition: One who makes, or manufactures, glass. -- Glass" mak`ing, or Glass"mak`ing, n.

roam.definition:
To go from place to place without any certain purpose or direction; to rove; to wander. He roameth to the carpenter's house. Chaucer. Daphne roaming through a thorny wood. Shak. Syn. -- To wander; rove; range; stroll; ramble.

To range or wander over. And now wild beasts came forth the woods to roam.

co-sufferer.definition: One who suffers with another. Wycherley.

worldly-wise.definition: Wise in regard to things of this world. Bunyan.

trichromatic.definition: Having or existing in three different phases of color; having three distinct color varieties; -- said of certain birds and insects.

avoirdupois.definition: Goods sold by weight. 2. Avoirdupois weight. 3. Weight; heaviness; as, a woman of much avoirdupois. Avoirdupois weight, a system of weights by which coarser commodities are weighed, such as hay, grain, butter, sugar, tea. Note: The standard Avoirdupois pound of the United States is equivalent to the.

atheize.definition:
To render atheistic or godless. They endeavored to atheize one another. Berkeley.

To discourse, argue, or act as an atheist. -- A"the*i`zer, n. Cudworth.

thermolyze.definition: To subject to thermolysis; to dissociate by heat.

organzine.definition: A kind of double thrown silk of very fine texture, that is, silk twisted like a rope with different strands, so as to increase its strength.

tepor.definition: Gentle heat; moderate warmth; tepidness. Arbuthnot.

roundly.definition: In a round form or manner. 2. Openly; boldly; peremptorily; plumply. He affirms everything roundly. Addison. 3. Briskly; with speed. locke. Two of the outlaws walked roundly forward. Sir W. Scott. 4. Completely; vigorously; in earnest. Shak. 5. Without regard to detail; in gross; comprehensively; ge.

hematophilia.definition: A condition characterized by a tendency to profuse and uncontrollable hemorrhage from the slightest wounds.

kynurenic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid obtained from the urine of dogs. By decomposition the acid yields a nitrogenous base (called kynurin) and carbonic acid. [Written also cynurenic.].

simplist.definition: One skilled in simples, or medicinal plants; a simpler. Sir T. Browne.

hemal.definition: Relating to the blood or blood vessels; pertaining to, situated in the region of, or on the side with, the heart and great blood vessels; -- opposed to neural. Note: As applied to vertebrates, hemal is the same as ventral, the heart and great blood vessels being on the ventral, and the central nervo.

echauguette.definition: A small chamber or place of protection for a sentinel, usually in the form of a projecting turret, or the like. See Castle.

bluing.definition: The act of rendering blue; as, the bluing of steel. Tomlinson. 2. Something to give a bluish tint, as indigo, or preparations used by washerwomen.

brachiopod.definition: One of the Brachiopoda, or its shell.

suburb.definition: An outlying part of a city or town; a smaller place immediately adjacent to a city; in the plural, the region which is on the confines of any city or large town; as, a house stands in the suburbs; a garden situated in the suburbs of Paris. "In the suburbs of a town." Chaucer. [London] could hardly h.

ranunculaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to a natural order of plants (Ranunculaceæ), of which the buttercup is the type, and which includes also the virgin's bower, the monkshood, larkspur, anemone, meadow rue, and peony.

haired.definition: Having hair. "A beast haired like a bear." Purchas. 2. In composition: Having (such) hair; as, red-haired.

twistical.definition: Crooked; tortuous; hence, perverse; unfair; dishonest. [Slang, U. S.] Bartlett.

ravener.definition: One who, or that which, ravens or plunders. Gower. 2. A bird of prey, as the owl or vulture. Holland.

fixation.definition: The act of fixing, or the state of being fixed. An unalterable fixation of resolution. Killingbeck. To light, created in the first day, God gave no proper place or fixation. Sir W. Raleigh. Marked stiffness or absolute fixation of a joint. Quain. A fixation and confinement of thought to a few object.

sithen.definition: Since; afterwards. See 1st Sith. Fortune was first friend and sithen foe. Chaucer.

proser.definition: A writer of prose. 2. One who talks or writes tediously. Sir W. Scott.

beechnut.definition: The nut of the beech tree.

lactodensimeter.definition: A form of hydrometer, specially graduated, for finding the density of milk, and thus discovering whether it has been mixed with water or some of the cream has been removed.

culmination.definition: The attainment of the highest point of altitude reached by a heavently body; passage across the meridian; transit. 2. Attainment or arrival at the highest pitch of glory, power, etc.

glomuliferous.definition: Having small clusters of minutely branched coral-like excrescences. M. C. Cooke.

proletaire.definition: One of the common people; a low person; also, the common people as a class or estate in a country.

evil-minded.definition: Having evil dispositions or intentions; disposed to mischief or sin; malicious; malignant; wicked. -- E"vil-mind`ed*ness, n.

slangy.definition: Of or pertaining to slang; of the nature of slang; disposed to use slang. [Written also slangey.].

erin.definition: An early, and now a poetic, name of Ireland.

hairpin.definition: A pin, usually forked, or of bent wire, for fastening the hair in place, -- used by women.

huntsmanship.definition: The art or practice of hunting, or the qualification of a hunter. Donne. HUNT'S-UP Hunt's"-up`, n.  A tune played on the horn very early in the morning to call out the hunters; hence, any arousing sound or call. Shak. Time plays the hunt's-up to thy sleepy head. Drayton.

kelp.definition: The calcined ashes of seaweed, -- formerly much used in the manufacture of glass, now used in the manufacture of iodine. 2. (Bot.)  Any large blackish seaweed. Note: Laminaria is the common kelp of Great Britain; Macrocystis pyrifera and Nereocystis Lutkeana are the great kelps of the Pacific Ocean.

offspring.definition: The act of production; generation. 2. That which is produced; a child or children; a descendant or descendants, however remote from the stock. To the gods alone Our future offspring and our wives are known. Dryden. 3. Origin; lineage; family. Fairfax.

illimitation.definition: State of being illimitable; want of, or freedom from, limitation. Bp. Hall.

nectariferous.definition: Secreting nectar; -- said of blossoms or their parts.

matie.definition: A fat herring with undeveloped roe. [Written also matty.] [Eng. & Scot.].

appellee.definition: (a) The defendant in an appeal; -- opposed to appellant. (b) The person who is appealed against, or accused of crime; -- opposed to appellor. Blackstone.

spectrograph.definition: (a) An apparatus for photographing or mapping a spectrum. (b) A photograph or picture of a spectrum. -- Spec`tro*graph"ic (#), a. --Spec`tro*graph"ic*al*ly (#), adv. --Spec*trog"ra*phy (#), n.

aeruginous.definition: Of the nature or color of verdigris, or the rust of copper.

polyphore.definition: A receptacle which bears many ovaries.

armor-plated.definition: Covered with defensive plates of metal, as a ship of war; steel-clad. This day will be launched . . . the first armor-plated steam frigate in the possession of Great Britain. Times (Dec. 29, 1860).

piperidine.definition: An oily liquid alkaloid, C5H11N, having a hot, peppery, ammoniacal odor. It is related to pyridine, and is obtained by the decomposition of piperine.

fulmar.definition: One of several species of sea birds, of the family procellariidæ, allied to the albatrosses and petrels. Among the well- known species are the arctic fulmar (Fulmarus glacialis) (called also fulmar petrel, malduck, and mollemock), and the giant fulmar (Ossifraga gigantea).

white-foot.definition: A white mark on the foot of a horse, between the fetlock and the coffin.

redemand.definition:
To demand back; to demand again.

A demanding back; a second or renewed demand.

quoll.definition: A marsupial of Australia (Dasyurus macrurus), about the size of a cat.

scandent.definition: Climbing. Note: Scandent plants may climb either by twining, as the hop, or by twisted leafstalks, as the clematis, or by tendrils, as the passion flower, or by rootlets, as the ivy.

serjeant.definition: See Sergeant, Sergeantcy, etc. Serjeant-at-arms. See Sergeant- at-arms, under Sergeant.

limn.definition: To draw or paint; especially, to represent in an artistic way with pencil or brush. Let a painter carelessly limn out a million of faces, and you shall find them all different. Sir T. Browne. 2. To illumine, as books or parchments, with ornamental figures, letters, or borders.

neaped.definition: Left aground on the height of a spring tide, so that it will not float till the next spring tide; -- called also beneaped.

bursa.definition: Any sac or saclike cavity; especially, one of the synovial sacs, or small spaces, often lined with synovial membrane, interposed between tendons and bony prominences.

pin-tailed.definition: Having a tapered tail, with the middle feathers longest; -- said of birds.

kyke.definition: To look steadfastly; to gaze. [Written also kike, keke.] This Nicholas sat ever gaping upright, As he had kyked on the newe moon. Chaucer.

allantoin.definition: A crystalline, transparent, colorless substance found in the allantoic liquid of the fetal calf; -- formerly called allantoic acid and amniotic acid.

theanthropical.definition: Partaking of, or combining, both divinity and humanity. The gorgeous and imposing figures of his [Homer's] theanthropic sytem. Gladstone.

reviver.definition: One who, or that which, revives.

bash.definition: To abash; to disconcert or be disconcerted or put out of countenance. His countenance was bold and bashed not. Spenser.

foy.definition: Faith; allegiance; fealty. Spenser. 2. A feast given by one about to leave a place. He did at the Dog give me, and some other friends of his, his foy, he being to set sail to-day. Pepys.

dicentra.definition: A genus of herbaceous plants, with racemes of two-spurred or heart-shaped flowers, including the Dutchman's breeches, and the more showy Bleeding heart (D. spectabilis). [Corruptly written dielytra.].

anticlinal.definition: The crest or line in which strata slope or dip in opposite directions.

indorsable.definition: Capable of being indorsed; transferable; convertible.

serio-comical.definition: Having a mixture of seriousness and sport; serious and comical.

apiked.definition: Trimmed. Full fresh and new here gear apiked was. Chaucer.

graafian.definition: Pertaining to, or discovered by, Regnier de Graaf, a Dutch physician. Graafian follicles or vesicles, small cavities in which the ova are developed in the ovaries of mammals, and by the bursting of which they are discharged.

taglioni.definition: A kind of outer coat, or overcoat; -- said to be so named after a celebrated Italian family of professional dancers. He ought certainly to exchange his taglioni, or comfortable greatcoat, for a cuirass of steel. Sir W. Scott.

amido.definition: Containing, or derived from, amidogen. Amido acid, an acid in which a portion of the nonacid hydrogen has been replaced by the amido group. The amido acids are both basic and acid. -- Amido group, amidogen, NH2.

discoid.definition:
Having the form of a disk, as those univalve shells which have the whorls in one plane, so as to form a disk, as the pearly nautilus. Discoid flower (Bot.), a compound flower, consisting of tubular florets only, as a tansy, lacking the rays which are seen in the daisy and sunflower.

Anything having.

experientialism.definition: The doctrine that experience, either that ourselves or of others, is the test or criterion of general knowledge; -- opposed to intuitionists. Experientialism is in short, a philosophical or logical theory, not a philosophical one. G. C. Robertson.

facade.definition: The front of a building; esp., the principal front, having some architectural pretensions. Thus a church is said to have its facade unfinished, though the interior may be in use.

alveary.definition: A beehive, or something resembling a beehive. Barret. 2. (Anat.)  The hollow of the external ear. Quincy.

paradox.definition: A tenet or proposition contrary to received opinion; an assertion or sentiment seemingly contradictory, or opposed to common sense; that which in appearance or terms is absurd, but yet may be true in fact. A gloss there is to color that paradox, and make it appear in show not to be altogether unreas.

viscus.definition: One of the organs, as the brain, heart, or stomach, in the great cavities of the body of an animal; -- especially used in the plural, and applied to the organs contained in the abdomen.

shaps.definition: Chaparajos. [Western U. S.] A pair of gorgeous buckskin shaps, embroidered up the sides and adorned with innumerable ermine skins. The Century.

drome.definition: The crab plover (Dromas ardeola), a peculiar North African bird, allied to the oyster catcher.

grazer.definition: One that grazes; a creature which feeds on growing grass or herbage. The cackling goose, Close grazer, finds wherewith to ease her want. J. Philips.

quarry.definition:
Same as 1st Quarrel. Fairfax.

Quadrate; square.

1. (a) A part of the entrails of the beast taken, given to the hounds. (b) A heap of game killed. 2. The object of the chase; the animal hunted for; game; especially, the game hunted with hawks. "The stone-dead quarry." Spenser. The wily quarry shunn.

egotism.definition: The practice of too frequently using the word I; hence, a speaking or writing overmuch of one's self; self-exaltation; self- praise; the act or practice of magnifying one's self or parading one's own doings. The word is also used in the sense of egoism. His excessive egotism, which filled all object.

sacchulmin.definition: An amorphous huminlike substance resembling sacchulmic acid, and produced together with it.

vermilion.definition: (Chem.)  A bright red pigment consisting of mercuric sulphide, obtained either from the mineral cinnabar or artificially. It has a fine red color, and is much used in coloring sealing wax, in printing, etc. Note: The kermes insect has long been used for dyeing red or scarlet. It was formerly known a.

aread.definition: To tell, declare, explain, or interpret; to divine; to guess; as, to aread a riddle or a dream. Therefore more plain aread this doubtful case. Spenser. 2. To read. Drayton. 3. To counsel, advise, warn, or direct. But mark what I aread thee now. Avaunt! Milton. 4. To decree; to adjudge. [Archaic] Ld.

maid.definition: An unmarried woman; usually, a young unmarried woman; esp., a girl; a virgin; a maiden. Would I had died a maid, And never seen thee, never borne thee son. Shak. Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire Yet my people have forgotten me. Jer. ii. 32. 2. A man who has not had sexual inter.

scutage.definition: Shield money; commutation of service for a sum of money. See Escuage.

spook.definition: A spirit; a ghost; an apparition; a hobgoblin. [Written also spuke.] Ld. Lytton. 2. (Zoöl.)  The chimæra.

geochemistry.definition: The study of the chemical composition of, and of actual or possible chemical changes in, the crust of the earth. -- Ge`o*chem"ic*al (#), a. --Ge`o*chem"ist (#), n.

tenderness.definition: The quality or state of being tender (in any sense of the adjective). Syn. -- Benignity; humanity; sensibility; benevolence; kindness; pity; clemency; mildness; mercy.

praemunire.definition: (a) The offense of introducing foreign authority into England, the penalties for which were originally intended to depress the civil power of the pope in the kingdom. (b) The writ grounded on that offense. Wharton. (c) The penalty ascribed for the offense of præmunire. Wolsey incurred a præmunire, a.

atoll.definition: A coral island or islands, consisting of a belt of coral reef, partly submerged, surrounding a central lagoon or depression; a lagoon island.

rectifiable.definition: Capable of being rectified; as, a rectifiable mistake. 2. (Math.)  Admitting, as a curve, of the construction of a straight l.

knifeboard.definition: A board on which knives are cleaned or polished.

macho.definition: The striped mullet of California (Mugil cephalus, or Mexicanus).

ejecta.definition: Matter ejected; material thrown out; as, the ejecta of a volcano; the ejecta, or excreta, of the body.

tintometer.definition: An apparatus for the determination of colors by comparison with arbitrary standards; a colorimeter.

fluent.definition: Flowing or capable of flowing; liquid; glodding; easily moving. 2. Ready in the use of words; voluble; copious; having words at command; and uttering them with facility and smoothness; as, a fluent speaker; hence, flowing; voluble; smooth; -- said of language; as, fluent speech. With most fluent utt.

fielden.definition: Consisting of fields. The fielden country also and plains. Holland.

nucleolus.definition: A little nucleus. 2. (Biol.)  A small rounded body contained in the nucleus of a cell or a protozoan. Note: It was termed by Agassiz the entoblast. In the protozoa, where it may be situated on one side of the nucleus, it is sometimes called the endoplastule, and is supposed to be concerned in the ma.

nonelectric.definition:
Not electric; conducting electricity.

A substance that is not an electric; that which transmits electricity, as a metal.

semble.definition: To imitate; to make a representation or likeness. Where sembling art may carve the fair effect. Prior. 2. (Law)  It seems; -- chiefly used impersonally in reports and judgments to express an opinion in reference to the law on some point not necessary to be decided, and not intended to be definitely.

insidiate.definition: To lie in ambush for. Heywood.

affecter.definition: One who affects, assumes, pretends, or strives after. "Affecters of wit." Abp. Secker.

hyemation.definition: The passing of a winter in a particular place; a wintering. 2. The act of affording shelter in winter.

outgoer.definition: One who goes out or departs.

ceremonially.definition: According to rites and ceremonies; as, a person ceremonially unclean.

escribed.definition: Drawn outside of; -- used to designate a circle that touches one of the sides of a given triangle, and also the other two sides produced.

cretacic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, the period of time following the Jurassic and preceding the Eocene.

aggravate.definition: To make heavy or heavier; to add to; to increase. "To aggravate thy store." Shak. 2. To make worse, or more severe; to render less tolerable or less excusable; to make more offensive; to enhance; to intensify. "To aggravate my woes." Pope. To aggravate the horrors of the scene. Prescott. The defense.

nationalist.definition: One who advocates national unity and independence; one of a party favoring Irish independence.

nosology.definition: A systematic arrangement, or classification, of diseases. 2. That branch of medical science which treats of diseases, or of the classification of diseases.

diureide.definition: One of a series of complex nitrogenous substances regarded as containing two molecules of urea or their radicals, as uric acid or allantoin. Cf. Ureide.

melaconite.definition: An earthy black oxide of copper, arising from the decomposition of other ores.

spine-tailed.definition: Having the tail quills ending in sharp, naked tips. Spine- tailed swift. (Zoöl.) See Spinetail (a).

crincum.definition: A twist or bend; a turn; a whimsey. Hudibras.

salacious.definition: Having a propensity to venery; lustful; lecherous. Dryden. -- Sa*la"cious*ly, dv. -- Sa*la"cious*ness, n.

gorcrow.definition: The carrion crow; -- called also gercrow.

cassioberry.definition: The fruit of the Viburnum obovatum, a shrub which grows from Virginia to Florida.

insuppressible.definition: That can not be suppressed or concealed; irrepressible. Young. -- In`sup*press"i*bly, adv.

psarolite.definition: A silicified stem of tree fern, found in abundance in the Triassic sandstone.

destituent.definition: Deficient; wanting; as, a destituent condition. Jer. Taylor.

fatner.definition: One who fattens. See Fattener. Arbuthnit.

piliferous.definition: Bearing a single slender bristle, or hair. 2. Beset with hairs.

quahog.definition: An American market clam (Venus mercenaria). It is sold in large quantities, and is highly valued as food. Called also round clam, and hard clam. Note: The name is also applied to other allied species, as Venus Mortoni of the Gulf of Mexico.

homer.definition:
A carrier pigeon remarkable for its ability to return home from a distance.

See Hoemother.

A Hebrew measure containing, as a liquid measure, ten baths, equivalent to fifty-five gallons, two quarts, one pint; and, as a dry measure, ten ephahs, equivalent to six bushels, two pecks, four quarts. [Wri.

cantiniere.definition: A woman who carries a canteen for soldiers; a vivandière.

nonylic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, nonyl or its compounds; as, nonylic acid.

serotinous.definition: Appearing or blossoming later in the season than is customary with allied species.

zander.definition: A European pike perch (Stizostedion lucioperca) allied to the wall-eye; -- called also sandari, sander, sannat, schill, and zant.

dribblet.definition: A small piece or part; a small sum; a small quantity of money in making up a sum; as, the money was paid in dribblets. When made up in dribblets, as they could, their best securities were at an interest of twelve per cent. Burke.

nuisance.definition: That which annoys or gives trouble and vexation; that which is offensive or noxious. Note: Nuisances are public when they annoy citizens in general; private, when they affect individuals only.

israelite.definition: A descendant of Israel, or Jacob; a Hebrew; a Jew.

hypothenar.definition:
Of or pertaining to the prominent part of the palm of the hand above the base of the little finger, or a corresponding part in the forefoot of an animal; as, the hypothenar eminence.

The hypothenar eminence.

alizari.definition: The madder of the Levant. Brande & C.

bedplate.definition: The foundation framing or piece, by which the other parts are supported and held in place; the bed; -- called also baseplate and soleplate.

nide.definition: A nestful; a brood; as, a nide of pheasants.

fictitious.definition: Feigned; imaginary; not real; fabulous; counterfeit; false; not genuine; as, fictitious fame. The human persons are as fictitious as the airy ones. Pope. -- Fic*ti"tious*ly, adv. -- Fic*ti"tious*ness, n.
