harmonics.definition: The doctrine or science of musical sounds. 2. pl. (Mus.)  Secondary and less distinct tones which accompany any principal, and apparently simple, tone, as the octave, the twelfth, the fifteenth, and the seventeenth. The name is also applied to the artificial tones produced by a string or column of a.

cracker.definition: One who, or that which, cracks. 2. A noisy boaster; a swaggering fellow. What cracker is this same that deafs our ears Shak. 3. A small firework, consisting of a little powder inclossed in a thick paper cylinder with a fuse, and exploding with a sharp noise; - - often called firecracker. 4. A thin,.

monotocous.definition: (Bot.)  Bearing fruit but once; monocarpic. 2. (Zoöl.)  Uniparous; laying a single egg.

obliquely.definition: In an oblique manner; not directly; indirectly. "Truth obliquely leveled." Bp. Fell. Declining from the noon of day, The sun obliquely shoots his burning ray. Pope His discourse tends obliquely to the detracting from others. Addison.

smicker.definition:
To look amorously or wantonly; to smirk.

Amorous; wanton; gay; spruce.

velvety.definition: Made of velvet, or like velvet; soft; smooth; delicate.

inwrap.definition: To cover by wrapping; to involve; to infold; as, to inwrap in a cloak, in smoke, etc. 2. To involve, as in difficulty or perplexity; to perplex. Bp. Hall.

arousal.definition: The act of arousing, or the state of being aroused. Whatever has associated itself with the arousal and activity of our better nature. Hare.

morainic.definition: Of or pertaining to a moranie.

chondrule.definition: A peculiar rounded granule of some mineral, usually enstatite or chrysolite, found imdedded more or less aboundantly in the mass of many meteoric stones, which are hence called chondrites.

palmin.definition: (a) A white waxy or fatty substance obtained from castor oil. (b) Ricinolein.

unhouse.definition: To drive from a house or habitation; to dislodge; hence, to deprive of shelter.

polarimeter.definition: An instrument for determining the amount of polarization of light, or the proportion of polarized light, in a partially polarized ray.

richweed.definition: An herb (Pilea pumila) of the Nettle family, having a smooth, juicy, pellucid stem; -- called also clearweed.

carbolize.definition: To apply carbonic acid to; to wash or treat with carbolic acid.

notionality.definition: A notional or groundless opinion. Glanvill.

tachyscope.definition: An early form of antimated-picture machine, devised in 1889 by Otto Anschütz of Berlin, in which the chronophotographs were mounted upon the periphery of a rotating wheel.

disthene.definition: Cyanite or kyanite; -- so called in allusion to its unequal hardness in two different directions. See Cyanite.

hexastichon.definition: A poem consisting of six verses or lines.

communicability.definition: The quality of being communicable; capability of being imparted.

protozooenite.definition: One of the primary, or first-formed, segments of an embryonic arthropod.

tabler.definition: One who boards. 2. One who boards others for hire. B. Jonson.

mediacy.definition: The state or quality of being mediate. Sir W. Hamilton.

cantonment.definition: A town or village, or part of a town or village, assigned to a body of troops for quarters; temporary shelter or place of rest for an army; quarters. Note: When troops are sheltered in huts or quartered in the houses of the people during any suspension of hostilities, they are said to be in cantonme.

melanterite.definition: A hydrous sulphate of iron of a green color and vitreous luster; iron vitriol.

fallowness.definition: A well or opening, through the successive floors of a warehouse or manufactory, through which goods are raised or lowered. [U.S.] Bartlett.

sinusoid.definition: The curve whose ordinates are proportional to the sines of the abscissas, the equation of the curve being y = a sin x. It is also called the curve of sines.

stannel.definition: The kestrel; -- called also standgale, standgall, stanchel, stand hawk, stannel hawk, steingale, stonegall. [Written also staniel, stannyel, and stanyel.] With what wing the staniel checks at it. Shak.

pression.definition: The act of pressing; pressure. Sir I. Newton. 2. (Cartesian Philos.)  An endeavor to move.

beguinage.definition: A collection of small houses surrounded by a wall and occupied by a community of Beguines.

whin.definition: (Bot.) (a) Gorse; furze. See Furze. Through the whins, and by the cairn. Burns. (b) Woad-waxed. Gray. 2. Same as Whinstone. Moor whin or Petty whin (Bot.), a low prickly shrub (Genista Anglica) common in Western Europe. -- Whin bruiser, a machine for cutting and bruising whin, or furze, to feed catt.

sequential.definition: Succeeding or following in order. -- Se*quen"tial*ly, adv.

preoblongata.definition: The anterior part of the medulla oblongata. B. G. Wilder.

scorbutic.definition: Of or pertaining to scurvy; of the nature of, or resembling, scurvy; diseased with scurvy; as, a scorbutic person; scorbutic complaints or symptoms. -- Scor*bu"tic*al*ly, adv.

eavesdropping.definition: The habit of lurking about dwelling houses, and other places where persons meet fro private intercourse, secretly listening to what is said, and then tattling it abroad. The offense is indictable at common law. Wharton.

incondensibility.definition: The quality or state of being incondensable.

undulated.definition: Resembling, or in the nature of, waves; having a wavy surface; undulatory. 2. (Bot.)  Waved obtusely up and down, near the margin, as a leaf or corolla; wavy. 3. (Zoöl.)  Formed with elevations and depressions resembling waves; having wavelike color markings; as, an undulated shell.

collitigant.definition: Disputing or wrangling. -- n.  One who litigates or wrangles.

etymon.definition: An original form; primitive word; root. 2. Original or fundamental signification. Given as the etymon or genuine sense of the word. Coleridge.

sinusoidal.definition: Of or pertaining to a sinusoid; like a sinusoid.

outshine.definition:
To shine forth. "Bright, outshining beams." Shak.

To excel in splendor. A throne of royal state, which far Outshone the wealth of Ormus and of Ind. Milton.

tore.definition:
imp. of Tear.

The dead grass that remains on mowing land in winter and spring. Mortimer.

1. (Arch.)  Same as Torus. 2. (Geom.) (a) The surface described by the circumference of a circle revolving about a straight line in its own plane. (b) The solid inclosed by such a surface; -- sometimes called.

dibranchiata.definition: An order of cephalopods which includes those with two gills, an apparatus for emitting an inky fluid, and either eight or ten cephalic arms bearing suckers or hooks, as the octopi and squids. See Cephalopoda.

chutnee.definition: A warm or spicy condiment or pickle made in India, compounded of various vegetable substances, sweets, acids, etc.

ironmaster.definition: A manufacturer of iron, or large dealer therein. Bp. Hurd.

liberalize.definition: To make liberal; to free from narrow views or prejudices. To open and to liberalize the mind. Burke.

sontag.definition: A knitted worsted jacket, worn over the waist of a woman's dress.

metely.definition: According to measure or proportion; proportionable; proportionate.

electro-vital.definition: Derived from, or dependent upon, vital processes; -- said of certain electric currents supposed by some physiologists to circulate in the nerves of animals.

unbox.definition: To remove from a box or boxes.

subderivative.definition: A word derived from a derivative, and not directly from the root; as, "friendliness" is a subderivative, being derived from "friendly", which is in turn a derivative from "friend.".

replevin.definition: (Law)  A personal action which lies to recover possession of goods and chattle wrongfully taken or detained. Originally, it was a remedy peculiar to cases for wrongful distress, but it may generally now be brought in all cases of wrongful taking or detention. Bouvier. 2. The writ by which goods and.

actinomere.definition: One of the radial segments composing the body of one of the Coelenterata.

borate.definition: A salt formed by the combination of boric acid with a base or positive radical.

casuistic.definition: Of or pertaining to casuists or casuistry.

coinstantaneous.definition: Happening at the same instant. C. Darwin.

loathsome.definition: Fitted to cause loathing; exciting disgust; disgusting. The most loathsome and deadly forms of infection. Macaulay. -- Loath"some*ly. adv. -- Loath"some*ness, n.

psychotherapeutics.definition: The treatment of disease by acting on the mind, as by suggestion; mind cure; psychotherapy.

quab.definition:
An unfledged bird; hence, something immature or unfinished. Ford.

See Quob, v. i.

subcutaneous.definition: Situated under the skin; hypodermic. -- Sub`cu*ta"ne*ous*ly, adv. Subcutaneous operation (Surg.), an operation performed without opening that part of the skin opposite to, or over, the internal section.

subalpine.definition: Inhabiting the somewhat high slopes and summits of mountains, but considerably below the snow line.

zany.definition:
A merry-andrew; a buffoon. Then write that I may follow, and so be Thy echo, thy debtor, thy foil, thy zany. Donne. Preacher at once, and zany of thy age. Pope.

To mimic. Your part is acted; give me leave at distance To zany it. Massinger.

sylvicoline.definition: Of or pertaining to the family of warblers (Sylvicolidæ). See Warbler.

antithesis.definition: (Rhet.)  An opposition or contrast of words or sentiments occurring in the same sentence; as, "The prodigal robs his heir; the miser robs himself." "He had covertly shot at Cromwell; he how openly aimed at the Queen." 2. The second of two clauses forming an antithesis. 3. Opposition; contrast.

shoveler.definition: One who, or that which, shovels. 2. (Zoöl.)  A river duck (Spatula clypeata), native of Europe and America. It has a large bill, broadest towards the tip. The male is handsomely variegated with green, blue, brown, black, and white on the body; the head and neck are dark green. Called also broadbill,.

anisostemonous.definition: Having unequal stamens; having stamens different in number from the petals.

injuriousness.definition: The quality of being injurious or hurtful; harmfulness; injury.

bluebill.definition: A duck of the genus Fuligula. Two American species (F. marila and F. affinis) are common. See Scaup duck.

bilamellated.definition: Formed of two plates, as the stigma of the Mimulus; also, having two elevated ridges, as in the lip of certain flowers.

cynoidea.definition: A division of Carnivora, including the dogs, wolves, and foxes.

planary.definition: Of or pertaining to a plane.

heathery.definition: Heathy; abounding in heather; of the nature of heath.

torpor.definition: Loss of motion, or of the motion; a state of inactivity with partial or total insensibility; numbness. 2. Dullness; sluggishness; inactivity; as, a torpor of the mental faculties.

tuberculocidin.definition: A special substance contained in tuberculin, supposed to be the active agent of the latter freed from various impurities.

elater.definition:
One who, or that which, elates.

1. (Bot.)  An elastic spiral filament for dispersing the spores, as in some liverworts. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any beetle of the family Elateridæ, having the habit, when laid on the back, of giving a sudden upward spring, by a quick movement of the articulation between the abdo.

demicannon.definition: A kind of ordnance, carrying a ball weighing from thirty to thirty-six pounds. Shak.

subdelegate.definition:
A subordinate delegate, or one with inferior powers.

To appoint to act as subdelegate, or as a subordinate; to depete.

hexagram.definition: (a) A figure composed of two equal triangles intersecting so that each side of one triangle is parallel to a side of the other, and the six points coincide with those of a hexagon. (b) In Chinese literature, one of the sixty-four figures formed of six parallel lines (continuous or broken), forming t.

cabalism.definition: The secret science of the cabalists. 2. A superstitious devotion to the mysteries of the religion which one professes. [R] Emerson.

mower.definition: One who, or that which, mows; a mowing machine; as, a lawn mower.

sheriffwick.definition: The office or jurisdiction of sheriff. See Shrievalty.

obnoxious.definition: Subject; liable; exposed; answerable; amenable; -- with to. The writings of lawyers, which are tied obnoxious to their particular laws. Bacon. Esteeming it more honorable to live on the public than to be obnoxious to any private purse. Milton. Obnoxious, first or last, To basest things Milton. 2. Li.

steer.definition:
A young male of the ox kind; especially, a common ox; a castrated taurine male from two to four years old. See the Note under Ox.

To castrate; -- said of male calves.

To direct the course of; to guide; to govern; -- applied especially to a vessel in the water. That with a staff his feeble steps di.

adeption.definition: An obtaining; attainment. In the wit and policy of the capitain consisteth the chief adeption of the victory. Grafton.

paramalic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an organic acid metameric with malic acid.

tobacconing.definition: Smoking tobacco. "Tobacconing is but a smoky play." Sylvester.

putid.definition: Rotten; fetid; stinking; base; worthless. Jer. Taylor. "Thy putid muse." Dr. H. More.

suffragette.definition: A woman who advocates the right to vote for women; a woman suffragist.

rascal.definition: One of the rabble; a low, common sort of person or creature; collectively, the rabble; the common herd; also, a lean, ill- conditioned beast, esp. a deer. He smote of the people seventy men, and fifty thousand of the rascal. Wyclif (1 Kings [1 Samuel] vi. 19). Poor men alone No, no; the noblest deer.

avoyer.definition: A chief magistrate of a free imperial city or canton of Switzerland.

asterism.definition: (Astron.) (a) A constellation. (b) A small cluster of stars. 2. (Printing) (a) An asterisk, or mark of reference. (b) Three asterisks placed in this manner, *, to direct attention to a particular passage. 3. (Crystallog.)  An optical property of some crystals which exhibit a star- shaped by reflecte.

coppled.definition: Rising to a point; conical; copped. Woodward.

protomerite.definition: The second segment of one of the Gregarinæ.

thermoscope.definition: An instrument for indicating changes of temperature without indicating the degree of heat by which it is affected; especially, an instrument contrived by Count Rumford which, as modified by Professor Leslie, was afterward called the differential thermometer.

legatee.definition: One to whom a legacy is bequeathed.

carpologist.definition: One who describes fruits; one versed in carpology.

fusileer.definition: (a) Formerly, a soldier armed with a fusil. Hence, in the plural: (b) A title now borne by some regiments and companies; as, "The Royal Fusiliers," etc.

reengage.definition: To engage a second time or again.

beached.definition: Bordered by a beach. The beached verge of the salt flood. Shak. 2. Driven on a beach; stranded; drawn up on a beach; as, the ship is beached.

superpolitic.definition: More than politic; above or exceeding policy. Milton.

tamaric.definition: A shrub or tree supposed to be the tamarisk, or perhaps some kind of heath. He shall be like tamaric in the desert, and he shall not see when good shall come. Jer. xvii. 6 (Douay version).

coffin.definition: The case in which a dead human body is inclosed for burial. They embalmed him [Joseph], and he was put in a coffin. Gen. 1. 26. 2. A basket. Wyclif (matt. xiv. 20). 3. A casing or crust, or a mold, of pastry, as for a pie. Of the paste a coffin I will rear. Shak. 4. A conical paper bag, used by groc.

pompeian.definition: Of, pertaining to, or characteristic of, Pompeii, an ancient city of Italy, buried by an eruption of Vesuvius in 79 a. d., and partly uncovered by modern excavations.

buff.definition: A sort of leather, prepared from the skin of the buffalo, dressed with oil, like chamois; also, the skins of oxen, elks, and other animals, dressed in like manner. "A suit of buff." Shak. 2. The color to buff; a light yellow, shading toward pink, gray, or brown. A visage rough, Deformed, unfeatured,.

clairaudience.definition: Act of hearing, or the ability to hear, sounds not normally audible; -- usually claimed as a special faculty of spiritualistic mediums, or the like.

manograph.definition: An optical device for making an indicator diagram for high- speed engines. It consists of a light-tight box or camera having at one end a small convex mirror which reflects a beam of light on to the ground glass or photographic plate at the other end. The mirror is pivoted so that it can be moved in.

sclerodermous.definition: (a) Having the integument, or skin, hard, or covered with hard plates. (b) Of or pertaining to the Sclerodermata.

aptly.definition: In an apt or suitable manner; fitly; properly; pertinently; appropriately; readily.

gamogenesis.definition: The production of offspring by the union of parents of different sexes; sexual reproduction; -- the opposite of agamogenesis.

mannered.definition: Having a certain way, esp a. polite way, of carrying and conducting one's self. Give her princely training, that she may be Mannered as she is born. Shak. 2. Affected with mannerism; marked by excess of some characteristic peculiarity. His style is in some degree mannered and confined. Hazlitt.

cabalize.definition: To use cabalistic language. [R] Dr. H. More.

vanadate.definition: A salt of vanadic acid. [Formerly also vanadiate.].

pinniform.definition: Shaped like a fin or feather. Sir J. Hill.

lentigo.definition: A freckly eruption on the skin; freckles.

sorriness.definition: The quality or state of being sorry.

drying.definition: Adapted or tending to exhaust moisture; as, a drying wind or day; a drying room. 2. Having the quality of rapidly becoming dry. Drying oil, an oil which, either naturally or after boiling with oxide of lead, absorbs oxygen from the air and dries up rapidly. Drying oils are used as the bases of many.

myriarch.definition: A captain or commander of ten thousand men.

myeloplax.definition: One of the huge multinucleated cells found in the marrow of bone and occasionally in other parts; a giant cell. See Osteoclast.

twank.definition: To cause to make a sharp twanging sound; to twang, or twangle. Addison.

unarted.definition: Ignorant of the arts. E. Waterhouse. 2. Not artificial; plain; simple. Feltham.

redisseizin.definition: A disseizin by one who once before was adjudged to have dassezed the same person of the same lands, etc.; also, a writ which lay in such a case. Blackstone.

heterocercal.definition: Having the vertebral column evidently continued into the upper lobe of the tail, which is usually longer than the lower one, as in sharks.

dolioform.definition: Barrel-shaped, or like a cask in form.

vinnewed.definition: Moldy; musty. [Written also vinewed.] [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] -- Vin"newed*ness, n. Many of Chaucer's words are become, as it were, vinnewed and hoary with over-long lying. F. Beaumont.

deodorize.definition: To deprive of odor, especially of such as results from impurities.

conscience.definition: Knowledge of one's own thoughts or actions; consciousness. The sweetest cordial we receive, at last, Is conscience of our virtuous actions past. Denham. 2. The faculty, power, or inward principle which decides as to the character of one's own actions, purposes, and affections, warning against and co.

kindle.definition:
To bring forth young. Shak. The poor beast had but lately kindled. Holland.

1. To set on fire; to cause to burn with flame; to ignite; to cause to begin burning; to start; to light; as, to kindle a match, or shavings. His breath kindleth coals. Job xii. 21. 2. Fig.: To inflame, as the passions; to.

scandia.definition: A chemical earth, the oxide of scandium.

agonic.definition: Not forming an angle. Agonic line (Physics), an imaginary line on the earth's surface passing through those places where the magnetic needle points to the true north; the line of no magnetic variation. There is one such line in the Western hemisphere, and another in the Eastern hemisphere.

cosmical.definition: Pertaining to the universe, and having special reference to universal law or order, or to the one grand harmonious system of things; hence; harmonious; orderly. 2. Pertaining to the solar system as a whole, and not to the earth alone. 3. Characteristic of the cosmos or universe; inconceivably great;.

flimflam.definition: A freak; a trick; a lie. Beau. & Fl.

malacostomous.definition: Having soft jaws without teeth, as certain fishes.

flysch.definition: A name given to the series of sandstones and schists overlying the true nummulitic formation in the Alps, and included in the Eocene Tertiary.

parchmentize.definition: To convert to a parchmentlike substance, esp. by sulphuric acid.

scenery.definition: Assemblage of scenes; the scenes of a play; the disposition and arrangement of the scenes in which the action of a play, poem, etc., is laid; representation of place of action or occurence. 2. Sum of scenes or views; general aspect, as regards variety and beauty or the reverse, in a landscape; combi.

ant-bear.definition: An edentate animal of tropical America (the Tamanoir), living on ants. It belongs to the genus Myrmecophaga.

tangle.definition: To unite or knit together confusedly; to interweave or interlock, as threads, so as to make it difficult to unravel the knot; to entangle; to ravel. 2. To involve; to insnare; to entrap; as, to be tangled in lies. "Tangled in amorous nets." Milton. When my simple weakness strays, Tangled in forbidde.

hugger.definition:
One who hugs or embraces.

To conceal; to lurk ambush. Bp. Hall.

confessedly.definition: By confession; without denial. [Written also confessly.].

courant.definition:
Represented as running; -- said of a beast borne in a coat of arms.

1. A piece of music in triple time; also, a lively dance; a coranto. 2. A circulating gazette of news; a newspaper.

hives.definition: (a) The croup. (b) An eruptive disease (Varicella globularis), allied to the chicken pox.

pliability.definition: The quality or state of being pliable; flexibility; as, pliability of disposition. "Pliability of movement." Sir W. Scott.

renunciatory.definition: Pertaining to renunciation; containing or declaring a renunciation; as, renunciatory vows.

wormed.definition: Penetrated by worms; injured by worms; worm-eaten; as, wormed timber.

ectocuniform.definition: One of the bones of the tarsus. See Cuneiform.

pericardial.definition: Of or pertaining to pericardium; situated around the heart. Pericardial fluid (Physiol.), a serous fluid of a pale yellow color contained in the pericardium.

digynian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Digynia; having two styles.

self-adjusting.definition: Capable of assuming a desired position or condition with relation to other parts, under varying circumstances, without requiring to be adjusted by hand; -- said of a piece in machinery. Self-adjusting bearing (Shafting), a bearing which is supported in such a manner that it may tip to accomodate fle.

nitromethane.definition: A nitro derivative of methane obtained as a mobile liquid; -- called also nitrocarbol.

squiry.definition: The body of squires, collectively considered; squirarchy. The flower of chivalry and squiry. Ld. Berbers.

disgage.definition: To free from a gage or pledge; to disengage. Holland.

urith.definition: The bindings of a hedge. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Halliwell.

astone.definition: To stun; to astonish; to stupefy. Chaucer.

vitiate.definition: To make vicious, faulty, or imperfect; to render defective; to injure the substance or qualities of; to impair; to contaminate; to spoil; as, exaggeration vitiates a style of writing; sewer gas vitiates the air. A will vitiated and growth out of love with the truth disposes the understanding to erro.

perivitelline.definition: Situated around the vitellus, or between the vitellus and zona pellucida of an ovum.

cornopean.definition: An obsolete name for the cornet-à-piston.

intestine.definition: Internal; inward; -- opposed to external. Epilepsies, fierce catarrhs, Intestine stone and ulcers. Milton. 2. Internal with regard to a state or country; domestic; not foreign; -- applied usually to that which is evil; as, intestine disorders, calamities, etc. Hoping here to end Intestine war in hea.

scission.definition: The act of dividing with an instrument having a sharp edge. Wiseman.

restrictive.definition: Serving or tending to restrict; limiting; as, a restrictive particle; restrictive laws of trade. 2. Astringent or styptic in effect. Wiseman. -- Re*strict"ive*ly, adv. -- Re*strict"ive*ness, n.

tracheotomy.definition: The operation of making an opening into the windpipe.

mucilaginous.definition: Partaking of the nature of, or resembling, mucilage; moist, soft, and viscid; slimy; ropy; as, a mucilaginous liquid. 2. Of, pertaining to, or secreting, mucilage; as, the mucilaginous glands. 3. Soluble in water, but not in alcohol; yielding mucilage; as, mucilaginous gums or plants. -- Mu`ci*lag"i.

dumb-bell.definition: A weight, consisting of two spheres or spheroids, connected by a short bar for a handle; used (often in pairs) for gymnastic exercise.

asphaltum.definition: Mineral pitch, Jews' pitch, or compact native bitumen. It is brittle, of a black or brown color and high luster on a surface of fracture; it melts and burns when heated, leaving no residue. It occurs on the surface and shores of the Dead Sea, which is therefore called Asphaltites, or the Asphaltic L.

broadpiece.definition: An old English gold coin, broader than a guinea, as a Carolus or Jacobus.

repercussive.definition: Tending or able to repercuss; having the power of sending back; causing to reverberate. Ye repercussive rocks! repeat the sound. W. Pattison. 2. Repellent. "Blood is stanched by astringent and repecussive medicines." Bacon. 3. Driven back; rebounding; reverberated. "Rages loud the repercussive roar.

deviceful.definition: Full of devices; inventive. A carpet, rich, and of deviceful thread. Chapman.

analepsis.definition: (a) Recovery of strength after sickness. (b) A species of epileptic attack, originating from gastric disorder.

fiber-faced.definition: Having a visible fiber embodied in the surface of; -- applied esp. to a kind of paper for checks, drafts, etc.

heedful.definition: Full of heed; regarding with care; cautious; circumspect; attentive; vigilant. Shak. -- Heed"ful*ly, adv. -- Heed"ful*ness, n.

pampas.definition: Vast plains in the central and southern part of the Argentine Republic in South America. The term is sometimes used in a wider sense for the plains extending from Bolivia to Southern Patagonia. Pampas cat (Zoöl.), a South American wild cat (Felis pajeros). It has oblique transverse bands of yellow o.

dactylar.definition: Pertaining to dactyl; dactylic. 2. (Zoöl.)  Of or pertaining to a finger or toe, or to the claw of an insect crustacean.

chargeable.definition: That may be charged, laid, imposed, or imputes; as, a duty chargeable on iron; a fault chargeable on a man. 2. Subject to be charge or accused; liable or responsible; as, revenues chargeable with a claim; a man chargeable with murder. 3. Serving to create expense; costly; burdensome. That we might n.

indigogen.definition: (Chem.)  See Indigo white, under Indigo. 2. (Physiol. Chem.)  Same as Indican, 2.

scantle.definition:
To be deficient; to fail. Drayton.

To scant; to be niggard of; to divide into small pieces; to cut short or down. All their pay Must your discretion scantle; keep it back. J. Webster.

usurp.definition: To seize, and hold in possession, by force, or without right; as, to usurp a throne; to usurp the prerogatives of the crown; to usurp power; to usurp the right of a patron is to oust or dispossess him. Alack, thou dost usurp authority. Shak. Another revolution, to get rid of this illegitimate and us.

dry-stone.definition: Constructed of uncemented stone. "Dry-stone walls." Sir W. Scott.

bezzle.definition:
To plunder; to waste in riot.

To drink to excess; to revel.

ethylidene.definition: An unsymmetrical, divalent, hydrocarbon radical, C2H4 metameric with ethylene but written thus, CH3.CH to distinguish it from the symmetrical ethylene, CH2.CH2. Its compounds are derived from aldehyde. Formerly called also ethidene.

utopia.definition: An imaginary island, represented by Sir Thomas More, in a work called Utopia, as enjoying the greatest perfection in politics, laws, and the like. See Utopia, in the Dictionary of Noted Names in Fiction. 2. Hence, any place or state of ideal perfection.

vesture.definition: A garment or garments; a robe; clothing; dress; apparel; vestment; covering; envelope. Piers Plowman. Approach, and kiss her sacred vesture's hem. Milton. Rocks, precipices, and gulfs, appareled with a vesture of plants. Bentley. There polished chests embroidered vestures graced. Pope. 2. (O. Eng. L.

putrescent.definition: Becoming putrid or rotten. Externally powerful, although putrescent at the core. Motley. 2. Of or pertaining to the process of putrefaction; as, a putrescent smell.

suppositor.definition: An apparatus for the introduction of suppositories into the rectum.

catoptric.definition: Of or pertaining to catoptrics; produced by reflection. Catoptric light, a light in which the rays are concentrated by reflectors into a beam visible at a distance.

colorature.definition: Vocal music colored, as it were, by florid ornaments, runs, or rapid passages.

panton.definition: A horseshoe to correct a narrow, hoofbound heel.

pythonic.definition: Prophetic; oracular; pretending to foretell events.

revigorate.definition:
Having new vigor or strength; invigorated anew. Southey.

To give new vigor to.

counterplot.definition:
To oppose, as another plot, by plotting; to attempt to frustrate, as a stratagem, by stratagem. Every wile had proved abortive, every plot had been counterplotted. De Quinsey.

A plot or artifice opposed to another. L'Estrange.

malignant.definition: Disposed to do harm, inflict suffering, or cause distress; actuated by extreme malevolence or enmity; virulently inimical; bent on evil; malicious. A malignant and a turbaned Turk. Shak. 2. Characterized or caused by evil intentions; pernicious. "Malignant care." Macaulay. Some malignant power upon.

amplificatory.definition: Serving to amplify or enlarge; amplificative. Morell.

supinator.definition: A muscle which produces the motion of supination.

swoln.definition: Contraction of Swollen, p. p. Milton.

translative.definition: tropical; figurative; as, a translative sense. Puttenham.

etrurian.definition: Of or relating to ancient Etruria, in Italy. "Etrurian Shades." Milton, -- n.  A native or inhabitant of ancient Etruria.

backbiting.definition: Secret slander; detraction. Backbiting, and bearing of false witness. Piers Plowman.

depeach.definition: To discharge. As soon as the party . . . before our justices shall be depeached. Hakluyt.

promptitude.definition: The quality of being prompt; quickness of decision and action when occasion demands; alacrity; as, promptitude in obedience. Men of action, of promptitude, and of courage. I. Taylor.

designative.definition: Serving to designate or indicate; pointing out.

ploughman.definition: One who plows, or who holds and guides a plow; hence, a husbandman. Chaucer. Macaulay. 2. A rustic; a countryman; a field laborer. Plowman's spikenard (Bot.), a European composite weed (Conyza squarrosa), having fragrant roots. Dr. Prior.

vorticella.definition: Any one of numerous species of ciliated Infusoria belonging to Vorticella and many other genera of the family Vorticellidæ. They have a more or less bell-shaped body with a circle of vibrating cilia around the oral disk. Most of the species have slender, contractile stems, either simple or branched.

zonaria.definition: A division of Mammalia in which the placenta is zonelike.

schistous.definition: Of or pertaining to schist; having the structure of a schist.

pantisocracy.definition: A Utopian community, in which all should rule equally, such as was devised by Coleridge, Lovell, and Southey, in their younger days.

glaucoma.definition: Dimness or abolition of sight, with a diminution of transparency, a bluish or greenish tinge of the refracting media of the eye, and a hard inelastic condition of the eyeball, with marked increase of tension within the eyeball.

divineness.definition: The quality of being divine; superhuman or supreme excellence. Shak.

dreamland.definition: An unreal, delightful country such as in sometimes pictured in dreams; region of fancies; fairyland. [He] builds a bridge from dreamland for his lay. Lowell.

sarse.definition:
A fine sieve; a searce.

To sift through a sarse.

damascene.definition:
Of or relating to Damascus.

A kind of plume, now called damson. See Damson.

Same as Damask, or Damaskeen, v. t. "Damascened armor." Beaconsfield. "Cast and damascened steel." Ure.

dualism.definition: State of being dual or twofold; a twofold division; any system which is founded on a double principle, or a twofold distinction; as: (a) (Philos.) A view of man as constituted of two original and independent elements, as matter and spirit. (Theol.) (b) A system which accepts two gods, or two origina.

ctenocyst.definition: An organ of the Ctenophora, supposed to be sensory.

tubularia.definition: A genus of hydroids having large, naked, flowerlike hydranths at the summits of long, slender, usually simple, stems. The gonophores are small, and form clusters at the bases of the outer tentacles.

quadra.definition: (a) The plinth, or lowest member, of any pedestal, podium, water table, or the like. (b) A fillet, or listel.

garbel.definition:
Same as Garboard.

Anything sifted, or from which the coarse parts have been taken.

meagre.definition: Destitue of, or having little, flesh; lean. Meager were his looks; Sharp misery had worn him to the bones. Shak. 2. Destitute of richness, fertility, strength, or the like; defective in quantity, or poor in quality; poor; barren; scanty in ideas; wanting strength of diction or affluence of imagery.

foumart.definition: The European polecat; -- called also European ferret, and fitchew. See Polecat. [Written also foulmart, foulimart, and fulimart.].

contuse.definition: To beat, pound, or together. Roots, barks, and seeds contused together. Bacon. 2. To bruise; to injure or disorganize a part without breaking the skin. Contused wound, a wound attended with bruising.

scratchbrush.definition: A stiff wire brush for cleaning iron castings and other metal.

firmament.definition: Fixed foundation; established basis. Custom is the . . . firmament of the law. Jer. Taylor. 2. The region of the air; the sky or heavens. And God said, Let there be a firmament in the miGen. i. 6. And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament. Gen. i. 14. Note: In Scripture, the word denotes an.

abelite.definition: One of a sect in Africa (4th century), mentioned by St. Augustine, who states that they married, but lived in continence, after the manner, as they pretended, of Abel.

mesohepar.definition: A fold of the peritoneum connecting the liver with the dorsal wall of the abdominal cavity.

re-formation.definition: The act of forming anew; a second forming in order; as, the reformation of a column of troops into a hollow square.

cartbote.definition: Wood to which a tenant is entitled for making and repairing carts and other instruments of husbandry.

diamonded.definition: Having figures like a diamond or lozenge. 2. Adorned with diamonds; diamondized. Emerson.

guipure.definition: A term used for lace of different kinds; most properly for a lace of large pattern and heavy material which has no ground or mesh, but has the pattern held together by connecting threads called bars or brides.

bulkhead.definition: (Naut.)  A partition in a vessel, to separate apartments on the same deck. 2. A structure of wood or stone, to resist the pressure of earth or water; a partition wall or structure, as in a mine; the limiting wall along a water front. Bulked line, a line beyond which a wharf must not project; -- usua.

boarding.definition: (Naut.)  The act of entering a ship, whether with a hostile or a friendly purpose. Both slain at one time, as they attempted the boarding of a frigate. Sir F. Drake. 2. The act of covering with boards; also, boards, collectively; or a covering made of boards. 3. The act of supplying, or the state of.

whisky.definition:
A light carriage built for rapid motion; -- called also tim- whiskey.

An intoxicating liquor distilled from grain, potatoes, etc., especially in Scotland, Ireland, and the United States. In the United States, whisky is generally distilled from maize, rye, or wheat, but in Scotland and Ireland it is.

hardiment.definition: Hardihood; boldness; courage; energetic action. Changing hardiment with great Glendower. Shak.

supersalt.definition: An acid salt. See Acid salt (a), under Salt, n.

skirl.definition:
To utter in a shrill tone; to scream. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.]

A shrill cry or sound. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.].

unequalness.definition: The quality or state of being unequal; inequality; unevenness. Jer. Taylor.

kerchered.definition: Covered, or bound round, with a kercher. G. Fletcher.

gumboil.definition: A small suppurting inflamed spot on the gum.

roostcock.definition: The male of the domestic fowl; a cock. Halliwell.

exopodite.definition: The external branch of the appendages of Crustacea.

marlaceous.definition: Resembling marl; partaking of the qualities of marl.

hurtful.definition: Tending to impair or damage; injurious; mischievous; occasioning loss or injury; as, hurtful words or conduct. Syn. -- Pernicious; harmful; baneful; prejudicial; detrimental; disadvantageous; mischievous; injurious; noxious; unwholesome; destructive. -- Hurt"ful*ly, adv. -- Hurt"ful*ness, n.

culler.definition: One who piks or chooses; esp., an inspector who select wares suitable for market.

disseminated.definition: Occurring in small portions scattered through some other substance.

cauterize.definition: To burn or sear with a cautery or caustic. Dunglison. 2. To sear, as the conscience. Jer. Taylor.

unpleat.definition: To remove the plaits of; to smooth. W. Browne.

eructation.definition: The act of belching wind from the stomach; a belch. 2. A violent belching out or emitting, as of gaseous or other matter from the crater of a volcano, geyser, etc.

mistletoe.definition: A parasitic evergreen plant of Europe (Viscum album), bearing a glutinous fruit. When found upon the oak, where it is rare, it was an object of superstitious regard among the Druids. A bird lime is prepared from its fruit. [Written also misletoe, misseltoe, and mistleto.] Lindley. Loudon. Note: The.

hemistichal.definition: Pertaining to, or written in, hemistichs; also, by, or according to, hemistichs; as, a hemistichal division of a verse.

irresuscitable.definition: Incapable of being resuscitated or revived. -- Ir`re*sus"ci*ta*bly, adv.

relievement.definition: The act of relieving, or the state of being relieved; relief; release. [Archaic.].

inquirer.definition: One who inquires or examines; questioner; investigator. Locke. Expert inquirers after truth. Cowper.

mesopterygium.definition: The middle one of the three principal basal cartilages in the fins of fishes. -- Me*sop`ter*yg"i*al, a.

quarreling.definition: Engaged in a quarrel; apt or disposed to quarrel; as, quarreling factions; a quarreling mood. -- Quar"rel*ing*ly, adv.

sos.definition: The letters signified by the signal ( . . . ---. . . ) prescribed by the International Radiotelegraphic Convention of 1912 for use by ships in distress.

pinking.definition: The act of piercing or stabbing. 2. The act or method of decorating fabrics or garments with a pinking iron; also, the style of decoration; scallops made with a pinking iron. Pinking iron. (a) An instrument for scalloping the edges of ribbons, flounces, etc. (b) A sword.

foolfish.definition: (a) The orange filefish. See Filefish. (b) The winter flounder. See Flounder.

gingerly.definition: Cautiously; timidly; fastidiously; daintily. What is't that you took up so gingerly Shak.

self-denial.definition: The denial of one's self; forbearing to gratify one's own desires; self-sacrifice.

caustic.definition: Capable of destroying the texture of anything or eating away its substance by chemical action; burning; corrosive; searing. 2. Severe; satirical; sharp; as, a caustic remark. Caustic curve (Optics), a curve to which the ray of light, reflected or refracted by another curve, are tangents, the reflect.

suctorian.definition: (Zoöl.)  A cartilaginous fish with a mouth adapted for suction, as the lampery. 2. (Zoöl.)  One of the Suctoria.

mustard.definition: (Bot.)  The name of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica (formerly Sinapis), as white mustard (B. alba), black mustard (B. Nigra), wild mustard or charlock (B. Sinapistrum). Note: There are also many herbs of the same family which are called mustard, and have more or less of the flavor o.

cadger.definition:
A packman or itinerant huckster. 2. One who gets his living by trickery or begging. [Prov. or Slang] "The gentleman cadger." Dickens.

One who carries hawks on a cadge.

nonmoral.definition: Not moral nor immoral; having no connection with morals; not in the sphere of morals or ethics; not ethical.

nourishable.definition: Capable of being nourished; as, the nourishable parts of the body. Grew. 2. Capable of giving nourishment. Bp. Hall.

mimosa.definition: A genus of leguminous plants, containing many species, and including the sensitive plants (Mimosa sensitiva, and M. pudica). Note: The term mimosa is also applied in commerce to several kinds bark imported from Australia, and used in tanning; -- called also wattle bark. Tomlinson.

windowed.definition: Having windows or openings. "Looped and windowed raggedness." Shak.

appointer.definition: One who appoints, or executes a power of appointment. Kent.

anastrophe.definition: An inversion of the natural order of words; as, echoed the hills, for, the hills echoed.

hardhack.definition: A very astringent shrub (Spiræa tomentosa), common in pastures. The Potentilla fruticosa in also called by this name.

incase.definition: To inclose in a case; to inclose; to cover or surround with something solid. Rich plates of gold the folding doors incase. Pope.

profound.definition: Descending far below the surface; opening or reaching to a great depth; deep. "A gulf profound." Milton. 2. Intellectually deep; entering far into subjects; reaching to the bottom of a matter, or of a branch of learning; thorough; as, a profound investigation or treatise; a profound scholar; profoun.

unmanhood.definition: Absence or lack of manhood. Chaucer.

whimsicalness.definition: The quality or state of being whimsical; freakishness; whimsical disposition.

baggala.definition: A two-masted Arab or Indian trading vessel, used in Indian Ocean.

reckling.definition: Needing care; weak; feeble; as, a reckling child. H. Taylor. -- n.  A weak child or animal. Tennyson.

claudent.definition: Shutting; confining; drawing together; as, a claudent muscle. Jonson.

rivered.definition: Supplied with rivers; as, a well rivered country.

pleadings.definition: The mutual pleas and replies of the plaintiff and defendant, or written statements of the parties in support of their claims, proceeding from the declaration of the plaintiff, until issue is joined, and the question made to rest on some single point. Blackstone.

apprest.definition: Pressed close to, or lying against, something for its whole length, as against a stem, Gray.

intertubular.definition: Between tubes or tubules; as, intertubular cells; intertubular substance.

wondered.definition: Having performed wonders; able to perform wonderful things. Shak.

jumelle.definition:
Twin; paired; -- said of various objects made or formed in pairs, as a binocular opera glass, a pair of gimmal rings, etc.

A jumelle opera glass, or the like.

boracite.definition: A mineral of a white or gray color occurring massive and in isometric crystals; in composition it is a magnesium borate with magnesium chloride.

peanut.definition: The fruit of a trailing leguminous plant (Arachis hypogæa); also, the plant itself, which is widely cultivated for its fruit. Note: The fruit is a hard pod, usually containing two or three seeds, sometimes but one, which ripen beneath the soil. Called also earthnut, groundnut, and goober.

slough.definition:
Slow. Chaucer.

1. A place of deep mud or mire; a hole full of mire. Chaucer. He's here stuck in a slough. Milton. 2. [Pronounced sloo.]  A wet place; a swale; a side channel or inlet from a river. Note: [In this sense local or provincial; also spelt sloo, and slue.] Slough grass (Bot.), a name in t.

unappropriate.definition:
Inappropriate; unsuitable. 2. Not appropriated. Bp. Warburton.

To take from private possession; to restore to the possession or right of all; as, to unappropriate a monopoly. Milton.

rosmarine.definition:
Dew from the sea; sea dew. That purer brine And wholesome dew called rosmarine. B. Jonson. 2. Rosemary. Spenser. "Biting on anise seed and rosmarine." Bp. Hall.

A fabulous sea animal which was reported to climb by means of its teeth to the tops of rocks to feed upon the dew. And greedly rosmarines.

mesymnicum.definition: A repetition at the end of a stanza.

orient.definition: Rising, as the sun. Moon, that now meet'st the orient sun. Milton. 2. Eastern; oriental. "The orient part." Hakluyt. 3. Bright; lustrous; superior; pure; perfect; pellucid; -- used of gems and also figuratively, because the most perfect jewels are found in the East. "Pearls round and orient." Jer. T.

fatherless.definition: Destitute of a living father; as, a fatherless child. 2. Without a known author. Beau. & Fl.

hydrargochloride.definition: A compound of the bichloride of mercury with another chloride.

walleteer.definition: One who carries a wallet; a foot traveler; a tramping beggar. Wright.

cabesse.definition: The finest kind of silk received from India.

ingluvies.definition: The crop, or craw, of birds.

biennial.definition:
Happening, or taking place, once in two years; as, a biennial election. 2. (Bot.)  Continuing for two years, and then perishing, as plants which form roots and leaves the first year, and produce fruit the second.

1. Something which takes place or appears once in two years; esp. a biennial examinati.

escharine.definition: Like, or pertaining to, the genus Eschara, or family Escharidæ.

ihvh.definition: A transliteration of the four constants forming the Hebrew tetragrammaton or "incommunicable name" of the Supreme Being, which in latter Jewish tradition is not pronounced save with the vowels of adonai or elohim, so that the true pronunciation is lost. Numerous attempts have been made to represent.

solecist.definition: One who commits a solecism. Blackwall.

veadar.definition: The thirteenth, or intercalary, month of the Jewish ecclesiastical calendar, which is added about every third year.

cayugas.definition: ; sing Cayuga. (Ethnol.) A tribe of Indians formerly inbabiting western New-York, forming part of the confederacy called the Five Nations.

ardurous.definition: Burning; ardent. Lo! further on, Where flames the arduous Spirit of Isidore. Cary.

stanchness.definition: The quality or state of being stanch.

liman.definition: The deposit of slime at the mouth of a river; slime.

tot.definition: Anything small; -- frequently applied as a term of endearment to a little child. 2. A drinking cup of small size, holding about half a pint. Halliwell. 3. A foolish fellow. Halliwell.

favosites.definition: A genus of fossil corals abundant in the Silurian and Devonian rocks, having polygonal cells with perforated walls.

carbureted.definition: (Chem.)  Combined with carbon in the manner of a carburet or carbide. 2. Saturated or impregnated with some volatile carbon compound; as, water gas is carbureted to increase its illuminating power. [Written also carburetted.] Carbureted hydrogen gas, any one of several gaseous compounds of carbon an.

neuropathic.definition: Of or pertaining to neuropathy; of the nature of, or suffering from, nervous disease.

fibre-faced.definition: Having a visible fiber embodied in the surface of; -- applied esp. to a kind of paper for checks, drafts, etc.

cancellated.definition: Crossbarres; marked with cross lines. Grew. 2. (Anat.)  Open or spongy, as some porous bones.

twinlike.definition: Closely resembling; being a counterpart. -- Twin"like`ness, n.

backwoodsman.definition: A men living in the forest in or beyond the new settlements, especially on the western frontiers of the older portions of the United States. Fisher Ames.

melee.definition: A fight in which the combatants are mingled.

reluctancy.definition: The state or quality of being reluctant; repugnance; aversion of mind; unwillingness; -- often followed by an infinitive, or by to and a noun, formerly sometimes by against. "Tempering the severity of his looks with a reluctance to the action." Dryden. He had some reluctance to obey the summons. Sir.

chthonophagia.definition: A disease characterized by an irresistible desire to eat earth, observed in some parts of the southern United States, the West Indies, etc.

conversant.definition: Having frequent or customary intercourse; familiary associated; intimately acquainted. I have been conversant with the first persons of the age. Dryden. 2. Familiar or acquainted by use or study; well-informed; versed; -- generally used with with, sometimes with in. Deeply conversant in the Platonic.

stackyard.definition: A yard or inclosure for stacks of hay or grain. A. Smith.

acromion.definition: The outer extremity of the shoulder blade.

polythalamia.definition: A division of Foraminifera including those having a manychambered shell.

etna.definition: A kind of small, portable, cooking apparatus for which heat is furnished by a spirit lamp. There should certainly be an etna for getting a hot cup of coffee in a hurry. V. Baker.

irregular.definition: Not regular; not conforming to a law, method, or usage recognized as the general rule; not according to common form; not conformable to nature, to the rules of moral rectitude, or to established principles; not normal; unnatural; immethodical; unsymmetrical; erratic; no straight; not uniform; as, an.

shieldtail.definition: Any species of small burrowing snakes of the family Uropeltidæ, native of Ceylon and Southern Asia. They have a small mouth which can not be dilated.

mystification.definition: The act of mystifying, or the state of being mystied; also, something designed to, or that does, mystify. The reply of Pope seems very much as though he had been playing off a mystification on his Grace. De Quincey.

turbidly.definition: In a turbid manner; with muddiness or confusion. 2. Proudly; haughtily. [A Latinism. R.] One of great merit turbidly resents them. Young.

plouter.definition:
To wade or move about with splashing; to dabble; also, to potter; trifle; idle. [Scot. & Dial. Eng.] I did not want to plowter about any more. Kipling.

Act of ploutering; floundering; act or sound of splashing. [Scot. & Dial.Eng.].

cabalist.definition: One versed in the cabala, or the mysteries of Jewish traditions. "Studious cabalists." Swift.

mansionry.definition: The state of dwelling or residing; occupancy as a dwelling place. Shak.

spoonful.definition: The quantity which a spoon contains, or is able to contain; as, a teaspoonful; a tablespoonful. 2. Hence, a small quantity. Arbuthnot.

microscopist.definition: One skilled in, or given to, microscopy.

pegador.definition: A species of remora (Echeneis naucrates). See Remora.

aquiparous.definition: Secreting water; -- applied to certain glands. Dunglison.

polychoerany.definition: A government by many chiefs, princes, or rules. Cudworth.

rubiginous.definition: Having the appearance or color of iron rust; rusty-looking.

radicalism.definition: The quality or state of being radical; specifically, the doctrines or principles of radicals in politics or social reform. Radicalism means root work; the uprooting of all falsehoods and abuses. F. W. Robertson.

lithogenous.definition: Stone-producing; -- said of polyps which form coral.

ballistics.definition: The science or art of hurling missile weapons by the use of an engine. Whewell.

stab.definition:
To pierce with a pointed weapon; to wound or kill by the thrust of a pointed instrument; as, to stab a man with a dagger; also, to thrust; as, to stab a dagger into a person. 2. Fig.: To injure secretly or by malicious falsehood or slander; as, to stab a person's reputation.

1. To give a wound with.

indispensableness.definition: The state or quality of being indispensable, or absolutely necessary. S. Clarke.

adreamed.definition: Visited by a dream; -- used in the phrase, To be adreamed, to dream.

threpsology.definition: The doctrine of nutrition; a treatise on nutrition.

rulingly.definition: In a ruling manner; so as to rule.

ferula.definition: A ferule. Beau. & Fl. 2. The imperial scepter in the Byzantine or Eastern Empire.

finery.definition: Fineness; beauty. Don't choose your place of study by the finery of the prospects. I. Watts. 2. Ornament; decoration; especially, excecially decoration; showy clothes; jewels. Her mistress' cast-off finery. F. W. Robertson. 3. Etym: [Cf. Refinery.] (Iron Works)  A charcoal hearth or furnace for the.

monophysite.definition: One of a sect, in the ancient church, who maintained that the human and divine in Jesus Christ constituted but one composite nature. Also used adjectively.

britzska.definition: A long carriage, with a calash top, so constructed as to give space for reclining at night, when used on a journey.

carnose.definition: Of a pertaining to flesh; fleshy. A distinct carnose muscle. Ray. 2. (Bot.)  Of a fleshy consistence; -- applied to succulent leaves, stems, etc.

agama.definition: A genus of lizards, one of the few which feed upon vegetable substances; also, one of these lizards.

superintendency.definition: The act of superintending; superintendence. Boyle.

dismay.definition: To disable with alarm or apprehensions; to depress the spirits or courage of; to deprive or firmness and energy through fear; to daunt; to appall; to terrify. Be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed. Josh. i. 9. What words be these What fears do you dismay Fairfax. 2. To render lifeless; to subdue;.

netsuke.definition: In Japanese costume and decorative art, a small object carved in wood, ivory, bone, or horn, or wrought in metal, and pierced with holes for cords by which it is connected, for convenience, with the inro, the smoking pouch (tabako-ire), and similar objects carried in the girdle. It is now much used.

plectospondyli.definition: An extensive suborder of fresh-water physostomous fishes having the anterior vertebræ united and much modified; the Eventognathi.

marginal.definition: Of or pertaining to a margin. 2. Written or printed in the margin; as, a marginal note or gloss.

complexion.definition: The state of being complex; complexity. Though the terms of propositions may be complex, yet . . . it is proprly called a simple syllogism, since the complexion does not belong to the syllogistic form of it. I. Watts. 2. A combination; a complex. [Archaic] This paragraph is . . . a complexion of sop.

frank-law.definition: The liberty of being sworn in courts, as a juror or witness; one of the ancient privileges of a freeman; free and common law; -- an obsolete expression signifying substantially the same as the American expression civil rights. Abbot.

title-page.definition: The page of a book which contains it title. The world's all title-page; there's no contents. Young.

pairing.definition: The act or process of uniting or arranging in pairs or couples. 2. See To pair off, under Pair, v. i. Pairyng time, the time when birds or other animals pair.

condiment.definition: Something used to give relish to food, and to gratify the taste; a pungment and appetizing substance, as pepper or mustard; seasoning. As for radish and the like, they are for condiments, and not for nourishment. Bacon.

aerostatical.definition: Of or pertaining to aërostatics; pneumatic. 2. Aëronautic; as, an aërostatic voyage.

archaistic.definition: Like, or imitative of, anything archaic; pertaining to an archaism.

ebullient.definition: Boiling up or over; hence, manifesting exhilaration or excitement, as of feeling; effervescing. "Ebullient with subtlety." De Quincey. The ebullient enthusiasm of the French. Carlyle.

supernacular.definition: Like supernaculum; first-rate; as, a supernacular wine. Thackeray.

deforcement.definition: (a) A keeping out by force or wrong; a wrongful withholding, as of lands or tenements, to which another has a right. (b) (Scots Law) Resistance to an officer in the execution of law. Burrill.

interpenetrate.definition:
To penetrate between or within; to penetrate mutually. It interpenetrates my granite mass. Shelley.

To penetrate each the other; to penetrate between bodies or their parts. Interpenetrating molding (Arch.), in late Gothic architecture, a decoration by means of moldings which seem to pass through so.

foursome.definition:
Consisting of four; requiring four participants. [Scot. or Golf]

A game between four players, with two on each side and each side playing but one ball, the partners striking alternately. It is called a mixed foursome when each side consists of a man and a woman.

revellent.definition: Causing revulsion; revulsive. -- n. (Med.)  A revulsive medicine.

entitle.definition: To give a title to; to affix to as a name or appellation; hence, also, to dignify by an honorary designation; to denominate; to call; as, to entitle a book "Commentaries;" to entitle a man "Honorable." That which . . . we entitle patience. Shak. 2. To give a claim to; to qualify for, with a direct o.

filiety.definition: The relation of a son to a father; sonship; -- the correlative of paternity. J. S. Mill.

ponibility.definition: The capability of being placed or located. Barrow.

bryological.definition: Relating to bryology; as, bryological studies.

renerve.definition: To nerve again; to give new vigor to; to reinvigorate.

spathose.definition:
See Spathic.

Having a spathe; resembling a spathe; spatheceous; spathal.

tiddle.definition: To use with tenderness; to fondle. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.].

indescribable.definition: Incapable of being described. -- In`de*scrib"a*bly, adv.

sawfly.definition: Any one of numerous species of hymenopterous insects belonging to the family Tenthredinidæ. The female usually has an ovipositor containing a pair of sawlike organs with which she makes incisions in the leaves or stems of plants in which to lay the eggs. The larvæ resemble those of Lepidoptera.

galvanic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or exhibiting the phenomena of, galvanism; employing or producing electrical currents. Galvanic battery (Elec.), an apparatus for generating electrical currents by the mutual action of certain liquids and metals; -- now usually called voltaic battery. See Battery. -- Galvanic ci.

farmery.definition: The buildings and yards necessary for the business of a farm; a homestead. [Eng.].

pneumonophora.definition: The division of Siphonophora which includes the Physalia and allied genera; -- called also Pneumatophoræ.

hander.definition: One who hands over or transmits; a conveyer in succession. Dryden.

neife.definition: A woman born in the state of villeinage; a female serf. Blackstone.

superfluous.definition: More than is wanted or is sufficient; rendered unnecessary by superabundance; unnecessary; useless; excessive; as, a superfluous price. Shak. An authority which makes all further argument or illustration superfluous. E. Everett. Superfluous interval (Mus.), an interval that exceeds a major or perfec.

drogher.definition: A small craft used in the West India Islands to take off sugars, rum, etc., to the merchantmen; also, a vessel for transporting lumber, cotton, etc., coastwise; as, a lumber drogher. [Written also droger.] Ham. Nar. Encyc.

connotatively.definition: In a connotative manner; expressing connotation.

obtruncation.definition: The act of lopping or cutting off. Cockeram.

cranioscopist.definition: One skilled in, or who practices, cranioscopy. It was found of equal dimension in a literary man whose skull puzzied the cranioscopists. Coleridge.

defendress.definition: A female defender. Defendress of the faith. Stow.

distemperate.definition: Immoderate. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. Diseased; disordered. Wodroephe.

guarana.definition: A preparation from the seeds of Paullinia sorbilis, a woody climber of Brazil, used in making an astringent drink, and also in the cure of headache.

deambulation.definition: A walking abroad; a promenading. Sir T. Elyot.

richness.definition: The quality or state of being rich (in any sense of the adjective).

unprotestantize.definition: To render other than Protestant; to cause to change from Protestantism to some other form of religion; to deprive of some Protestant feature or characteristic. The attempt to unprotestantize the Church of England. Froude.

jugata.definition: The figures of two heads on a medal or coin, either side by side or joined.

doctorly.definition: Like a doctor or learned man. "Doctorly prelates." Foxe.

tillandsia.definition: A genus of epiphytic endogenous plants found in the Southern United States and in tropical America. Tillandsia usneoides, called long moss, black moss, Spanish moss, and Florida moss, has a very slender pendulous branching stem, and forms great hanging tufts on the branches of trees. It is often use.

innodate.definition: To bind up,as in a knot; to include. Fuller.

warsaw.definition: (a) The black grouper (Epinephelus nigritus) of the southern coasts of the United States. (b) The jewfish; -- called also guasa.

mortify.definition: To destroy the organic texture and vital functions of; to produce gangrene in. 2. To destroy the active powers or essential qualities of; to change by chemical action. Chaucer. Quicksilver is mortified with turpentine. Bacon. He mortified pearls in vinegar. Hakewill. 3. To deaden by religious or oth.

risquee.definition: Hazardous; risky; esp., fig., verging upon impropriety; dangerously close to, or suggestive of, what is indecent or of doubtful morality; as, a risqué story.  Henry Austin.

copeck.definition: A Russian copper coin. See Kopeck.

circumscriptive.definition: Circumscribing or tending to circumscribe; marcing the limits or form of.

courteousness.definition: The quality of being courteous; politeness; courtesy.

porcate.definition: Having grooves or furrows broader than the intervening ridges; furrowed.

tidewaiter.definition: A customhouse officer who watches the landing of goods from merchant vessels, in order to secure payment of duties. Swift.

abrenounce.definition: To renounce. "They abrenounce and cast them off." Latimer.

daker.definition: A measure of certain commodities by number, usually ten or twelve, but sometimes twenty; as, a daker of hides consisted of ten skins; a daker of gloves of ten pairs. Burrill.

overpamper.definition: To pamper excessively; to feed or dress too much. Dryton.

dispassioned.definition: Free from passion; dispassionate. "Dispassioned men." Donne.

paraffin.definition: A white waxy substance, resembling spermaceti, tasteless and odorless, and obtained from coal tar, wood tar, petroleum, etc., by distillation. It is used as an illuminant and lubricant. It is very inert, not being acted upon by most of the strong chemical reagents. It was formerly regarded as a defi.

strategist.definition: One skilled in strategy, or the science of directing great military movements.

bezel.definition: The rim which encompasses and fastens a jewel or other object, as the crystal of a watch, in the cavity in which it is set.

whippletree.definition: The pivoted or swinging bar to which the traces, or tugs, of a harness are fastened, and by which a carriage, a plow, or other implement or vehicle, is drawn; a whiffletree; a swingletree; a singletree. See Singletree. [People] cut their own whippletree in the woodlot. Emerson. 2. (Bot.)  The cornel.

chapfallen.definition: Having the lower chap or jaw drooping, -- an indication of humiliation and dejection; crestfallen; discouraged. See Chopfallen.

mutation.definition: Change; alteration, either in form or qualities. The vicissitude or mutations in the superior globe are no fit matter for this present argument. Bacon.

crossbar.definition: A transverse bar or piece, as a bar across a door, or as the iron bar or stock which passes through the shank of an anchor to insure its turning fluke down. Russell. Crossbar shot, a projectile which folds into a sphere for loading, but on leaving the gun expands to a cross with a quarter ball at th.

curtsy.definition: Same as Courtesy, an act of respect.

dolphin.definition: (Zool.) (a) A cetacean of the genus Delphinus and allied genera (esp. D. delphis); the true dolphin. (b) The Coryphæna hippuris, a fish of about five feet in length, celebrated for its surprising changes of color when dying. It is the fish commonly known as the dolphin. See Coryphænoid. Note: The do.

malleus.definition: (Anat.)  The outermost of the three small auditory bones, ossicles; the hammer. It is attached to the tympanic membrane by a long process, the handle or manubrium. See Illust. of Far. 2. (Zoöl.)  One of the hard lateral pieces of the mastax of Rotifera. See Mastax. 3. (Zoöl.)  A genus of bivalve she.

splenization.definition: A morbid state of the lung produced by inflammation, in which its tissue resembles that of the spleen.

limosis.definition: A ravenous appetite caused by disease; excessive and morbid hunger.

liguliflorous.definition: Bearing only ligulate flowers; -- said of a large suborder of composite plants, such as the dandelion, hawkweed, etc.

methodios.definition: The art and principles of method.

bopeep.definition: The act of looking out suddenly, as from behind a screen, so as to startle some one (as by children in play), or of looking out and drawing suddenly back, as if frightened. I for sorrow sung, That such a king should play bopeep, And go the fools among. Shak.

cannibalism.definition: The act or practice of eating human flesh by mankind. Hence; Murderous cruelty; barbarity. Berke.

reign.definition: Royal authority; supreme power; sovereignty; rule; dominion. He who like a father held his reign. Pope. Saturn's sons received the threefold reign Of heaven, of ocean,, and deep hell beneath. Prior. 2. The territory or sphere which is reigned over; kingdom; empire; realm; dominion. Spenser. [God] hi.

vagary.definition: A wandering or strolling. 2. Hence, a wandering of the thoughts; a wild or fanciful freak; a whim; a whimsical purpose. "The vagaries of a child." Spectator. They changed their minds, Flew off, and into strange vagaries fell. Milton.

sumptuous.definition: Involving large outlay or expense; costly; expensive; hence, luxurious; splendid; magnificient; as, a sumptuous house or table; sumptuous apparel. We are too magnificient and sumptuous in our tables and attendance. Atterbury. She spoke, and turned her sumptuous head, with eyes Of shining expectation.

slatternly.definition: Resembling a slattern; sluttish; negligent; dirty. -- adv.  In a slatternly manner.

nonplane.definition: Not lying in one plane; -- said of certain curves.

bagman.definition: A commercial traveler; one employed to solicit orders for manufacturers and tradesmen. Thackeray.

anthropomancy.definition: Divination by the entrails of human being.

orchestrion.definition: A large music box imitating a variety of orchestral instruments.

scritch.definition: A screech. Perhaps it is the owlet's scritch. Coleridge.

interceder.definition: One who intercedes; an intercessor; a mediator. Johnson.

echinodermata.definition: One of the grand divisions of the animal kingdom. By many writers it was formerly included in the Radiata. [Written also Echinoderma.] Note: The species usually have an exterior calcareous skeleton, or shell, made of many pieces, and often covered with spines, to which the name. They may be star-sha.

shutter.definition: One who shuts or closes. 2. A movable cover or screen for a window, designed to shut out the light, to obstruct the view, or to be of some strength as a defense; a blind. 3. A removable cover, or a gate, for closing an aperture of any kind, as for closing the passageway for molten iron from a ladle.

chinch.definition: (Zoöl.)  The bedbug (Cimex lectularius). 2. (Zoöl.)  A bug (Blissus leucopterus), which, in the United States, is very destructive to grass, wheat, and other grains; -- also called chiniz, chinch bug, chink bug. It resembles the bedbug in its disgusting odor.

baffler.definition: One who, or that which, baffles.

gern.definition: To grin or yawn. "[/He] gaped like a gulf when he did gern." Spenser.

disfranchisement.definition: The act of disfranchising, or the state disfranchised; deprivation of privileges of citizenship or of chartered immunities. Sentenced first to dismission from the court, and then to disfranchisement and expulsion from the colony. Palfrey.

annexation.definition: The act of annexing; process of attaching, adding, or appending; the act of connecting; union; as, the annexation of Texas to the United States, or of chattels to the freehold. 2. (a) (Law) The union of property with a freehold so as to become a fixture. Bouvier. (b) (Scots Law) The appropriation of.

delver.definition: One who digs, as with a spade.

fetal.definition: Pertaining to, or connected with, a fetus; as, fetal circulation; fetal membranes.

replenishment.definition: The act of replenishing, or the state of being replenished. 2. That which replenishes; supply. Cowper.

holder-forth.definition: One who speaks in public; an haranguer; a preacher. Addison.

rankness.definition: The condition or quality of being rank.

tetterous.definition: Having the character of, or pertaining to, tetter.

avoset.definition:
A grallatorial bird, of the genus Recurvirostra; the scooper. The bill is long and bend upward toward the tip. The American species is R. Americana. [Written also avocette.]

Same as Avocet.

pink-sterned.definition: Having a very narrow stern; -- said of a vessel.

spurry.definition: An annual herb (Spergula arvensis) with whorled filiform leaves, sometimes grown in Europe for fodder. [Written also spurrey.] Sand spurry (Bot.), any low herb of the genus Lepigonum, mostly found in sandy places.

enthetic.definition: Caused by a morbifie virus implanted in the system; as, an enthetic disease like syphilis.

chaffern.definition: A vessel for heating water. Johnson.

starvation.definition: The act of starving, or the state of being starved. Note: This word was first used, according to Horace Walpole, by Henry Dundas, the first Lord Melville, in a speech on American affairs in 1775, which obtained for him the nickname of Starvation Dundas. "Starvation, we are also told, belongs to the.

isorropic.definition: Of equal value. Isorropic line (in a diagram) (Geom.), the locus of all the points for which a specified function has a constant value. Newcomb.

tophet.definition: A place lying east or southeast of Jerusalem, in the valley of Hinnom. [Written also Topheth.] And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom. 2 Kings xxiii. 10. Note: It seems to have been at first part of the royal garden, but it was afterwards defiled and polluted by the.

polycystidea.definition: A division of Gregarinæ including those that have two or more internal divisions of the body.

paraplegia.definition: Palsy of the lower half of the body on both sides, caused usually by disease of the spinal cord. -- Par`a*pleg"ic, a.

cotarnine.definition: A white, crystalline substance, C12H13NO3, obtained as a product of the decomposition of narcotine. It has weak basic properties, and is usually regarded as an alkaloid.

inhabitancy.definition: The act of inhabiting, or the state of being inhabited; the condition of an inhabitant; residence; occupancy. Ruins yet resting in the wild moors testify a former inhabitance. Carew. 2. (Law)  The state of having legal right to claim the privileges of a recognized inhabitant; especially, the right t.

metope.definition: (Arch.)  The space between two triglyphs of the Doric frieze, which, among the ancients, was often adorned with carved work. See Illust. of Entablature. 2. (Zoöl.)  The face of a crab. Note: In the Parthenon, groups of centaurs and heroes in high relief occupy the metopes.

supersaliency.definition: The act of leaping on anything. Sir T. Browne.

vernant.definition: Flourishing, as in spring; vernal. "Vernant flowers." Milton.

aerie.definition: The nest of a bird of prey, as of an eagle or hawk; also a brood of such birds; eyrie. Shak. Also fig.: A human residence or resting place perched like an eagle's nest.

elfish.definition: Of or relating to the elves; elflike; implike; weird; scarcely human; mischievous, as though caused by elves. "Elfish light." Coleridge. The elfish intelligence that was so familiar an expression on her small physiognomy. Hawthorne.

anacrusis.definition: A prefix of one or two unaccented syllables to a verse properly beginning with an accented syllable.

metropolis.definition: The mother city; the chief city of a kingdom, state, or country. [Edinburgh] gray metropolis of the North. Tennyson. 2. (Eccl.)  The seat, or see, of the metropolitan, or highest church dignitary. The great metropolis and see of Rome. Shak.

osmiamic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, a nitrogenous acid of osmium, H2N2Os2O5, forming a well-known series of yellow salts.

second-sighted.definition: Having the power of second-sight. Addison.

armpit.definition: The hollow beneath the junction of the arm and shoulder; the axilla.

whoremonger.definition: A whoremaster; a lecher; a man who frequents the society of whores.

euisopoda.definition: A group which includes the typical Isopoda.

proteose.definition: One of a class of soluble products formed in the digestion of proteids with gastric and pancreatic juice, and also by the hydrolytic action of boiling dilute acids on proteids. Proteoses are divided into the two groups, the primary and secondary proteoses.

mascotte.definition: A person who is supposed to bring good luck to the household to which he or she belongs; anything that brings good luck.

greenness.definition: The quality of being green; viridity; verdancy; as, the greenness of grass, or of a meadow. 2. Freshness; vigor; newness. 3. Immaturity; unripeness; as, the greenness of fruit; inexperience; as, the greenness of youth.

merchantry.definition: The body of merchants taken collectively; as, the merchantry of a country. 2. The business of a merchant; merchandise. Walpole.

epistler.definition: A writer of epistles, or of an epistle of the New Testament. M. Arnold. 2. (Eccl.)  The ecclesiastic who reads the epistle at the communion service.

dysentery.definition: A disease attended with inflammation and ulceration of the colon and rectum, and characterized by griping pains, constant desire to evacuate the bowels, and the discharge of mucus and blood. Note: When acute, dysentery is usually accompanied with high fevers. It occurs epidemically, and is believed.

assuredness.definition: The state of being assured; certainty; full confidence.

friskal.definition: A leap or caper. B. Jonson.

wottest.definition: 2d pers. sing. pres. of Wit, to know.

swarth.definition:
Swart; swarthy. "A swarth complexion." Chapman.

An apparition of a person about to die; a wraith. Grose.

Sward; short grass. Grassy swarth, close cropped by nibbling sheep. Cowper.

See Swath.

trutination.definition: The act of weighing. Sir T. Browne.

mismanagement.definition: Wrong or bad management; as, he failed through mismagement.

inebrious.definition: Intoxicated, or partially so; intoxicating. T. Brown.

rower.definition: One who rows with an oar.

ambition.definition: The act of going about to solicit or obtain an office, or any other object of desire; canvassing. [I] used no ambition to commend my deeds. Milton. 2. An eager, and sometimes an inordinate, desire for preferment, honor, superiority, power, or the attainment of something. Cromwell, I charge thee, fli.

beatitude.definition: Felicity of the highest kind; consummate bliss. 2. Any one of the nine declarations (called the Beatitudes), made in the Sermon on the Mount (Matt. v. 3-12), with regard to the blessedness of those who are distinguished by certain specified virtues. 3. (R. C. Ch.)  Beatification. Milman. Syn. -- Ble.

dry-boned.definition: Having dry bones, or bones without flesh.

olympiad.definition: A period of four years, by which the ancient Greeks reckoned time, being the interval from one celebration of the Olympic games to another, beginning with the victory of Coroebus in the foot race, which took place in the year 776 b.c.; as, the era of the olympiads.

tyrannous.definition: Tyrannical; arbitrary; unjustly severe; despotic. Sir P. Sidney. -- Tyr"an*nous*ly, adv.

gainstand.definition: To withstand; to resist. Durst . . . gainstand the force of so many enraged desires. Sir P. Sidney.

stoichiometry.definition: The art or process of calculating the atomic proportions, combining weights, and other numerical relations of chemical elements and their compounds.

stimulate.definition: To excite as if with a goad; to excite, rouse, or animate, to action or more vigorous exertion by some pungent motive or by persuasion; as, to stimulate one by the hope of reward, or by the prospect of glory. To excite and stimulate us thereunto. Dr. J. Scott. 2. (Physiol.)  To excite; to irritate;.

tocher.definition: Dowry brought by a bride to her husband. [Scot.] Burns.

troilite.definition: Native iron protosulphide, FeS. It is known only in meteoric irons, and is usually in imbedded nodular masses of a bronze color.

blemishment.definition: The state of being blemished; blemish; disgrace; damage; impairment. For dread of blame and honor's blemishment. Spenser.

whipworm.definition: A nematode worm (Trichocephalus dispar) often found parasitic in the human intestine. Its body is thickened posteriorly, but is very long and threadlike anteriorly.

welkin.definition: The visible regions of the air; the vault of heaven; the sky. On the welkne shoon the sterres lyght. Chaucer. The fair welkin foully overcast. Spenser. When storms the welkin rend. Wordsworth. Note: Used adjectively by Shakespeare in the phase, "Your welkin eye," with uncertain meaning.

bobbish.definition: Hearty; in good spirits. [Low, Eng.] Dickens.

grainer.definition: An infusion of pigeon's dung used by tanners to neutralize the effects of lime and give flexibility to skins; -- called also grains and bate. 2. A knife for taking the hair off skins. 3. One who paints in imitation of the grain of wood, marble, etc.; also, the brush or tool used in graining.

ascitical.definition: Of, pertaining to, or affected by, ascites; dropsical.

palilogy.definition: The repetition of a word, or part of a sentence, for the sake of greater emphasis; as, "The living, the living, he shall praise thee." Is. xxxviii. 19.
