brachiate.definition: Having branches in pairs, decussated, all nearly horizontal, and each pair at right angles with the next, as in the maple and lilac.

damask.definition: Damask silk; silk woven with an elaborate pattern of flowers and the like. "A bed of ancient damask." W. Irving. 2. Linen so woven that a pattern in produced by the different directions of the thread, without contrast of color. 3. A heavy woolen or worsted stuff with a pattern woven in the same way.

drapery.definition: The occupation of a draper; cloth-making, or dealing in cloth. Bacon. 2. Cloth, or woolen stuffs in general. People who ought to be weighing out grocery or measuring out drapery. Macaulay. 3. A textile fabric used for decorative purposes, especially when hung loosely and in folds carefully disturbed.

boggle.definition: To stop or hesitate as if suddenly frightened, or in doubt, or impeded by unforeseen difficulties; to take alarm; to exhibit hesitancy and indecision. We start and boggle at every unusual appearance. Glanvill. Boggling at nothing which serveth their purpose. Barrow. 2. To do anything awkwardly or un.

straitly.definition: In a strait manner; narrowly; strictly; rigorously. Mark i. 43. 2. Closely; intimately.

thomaism.definition: The doctrine of Thomas Aquinas, esp. with respect to predestination and grace.

commote.definition: To commove; to disturb; to stir up. Society being more or less commoted and made uncomfortable. Hawthorne.

intentionally.definition: In an intentional manner; with intention; by design; of purpose.

mastoid.definition: (a) Resembling the nipple or the breast; -- applied specifically to a process of the temporal bone behind the ear. (b) Pertaining to, or in the region of, the mastoid process; mastoidal.

evermore.definition: During eternity; always; forever; for an indefinite period; at all times; -- often used substantively with for. Seek the Lord . . . Seek his face evermore. Ps. cv. 4. And, behold, I am alive for evermore. Rev. i. 18. Which flow from the presence of God for evermore. Tillotson. I evermore did love yo.

palmate.definition:
(Chem.) A salt of palmic acid; a ricinoleate. [Obsoles.]

1. Having the shape of the hand; resembling a hand with the fingers spread. 2. (Bot.)  Spreading from the apex of a petiole, as the divisions of a leaf, or leaflets, so as to resemble the hand with outspread fingers. Gray. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) Havi.

gastrostomy.definition: The operation of making a permanent opening into the stomach, for the introduction of food.

valinch.definition: A tube for drawing liquors from a cask by the bunghole. [Written also velinche.].

convene.definition: To come together; to meet; to unite. In shortsighted men . . . the rays converge and convene in the eyes before they come at the bottom. Sir I. Newton. 2. To come together, as in one body or for a public purpose; to meet; to assemble. Locke. The Parliament of Scotland now convened. Sir R. Baker. Fai.

marshal.definition: Originally, an officer who had the care of horses; a groom. 2. An officer of high rank, charged with the arrangement of ceremonies, the conduct of operations, or the like; as, specifically: (a) One who goes before a prince to declare his coming and provide entertainment; a harbinger; a pursuivant. (.

pured.definition: Purified; refined. "Bread of pured wheat." "Pured gold." Chaucer.

creel.definition: An osier basket, such as anglers use. Sir W. Scott. 2. (Spinning)  A bar or set of bars with skewers for holding paying-off bobbins, as in the roving machine, throstle, and mule.

pluralism.definition: The quality or state of being plural, or in the plural number. 2. (Eccl.)  The state of a pluralist; the holding of more than one ecclesiastical living at a time. [Eng.].

euonymin.definition: A principle or mixture of principles derived from Euonymus atropurpureus, or spindle tree.

oxygenation.definition: The act or process of combining or of treating with oxygen; oxidation.

ornithon.definition: An aviary; a poultry house. Weale.

throw-off.definition: A start in a hunt or a race. [Eng.].

giddy.definition: Having in the head a sensation of whirling or reeling about; having lost the power of preserving the balance of the body, and therefore wavering and inclined to fall; lightheaded; dizzy. By giddy head and staggering legs betrayed. Tate. 2. Promoting or inducing giddiness; as, a giddy height; a giddy.

barmote.definition: A court held in Derbyshire, in England, for deciding controversies between miners. Blount.

gentle-hearted.definition: Having a kind or gentle disposition. Shak. -- Gen"tle-heart`ed*ness, n.

nicking.definition: (a) The cutting made by the hewer at the side of the face. (b) pl.  Small coal produced in making the nicking.

ration.definition: A fixed daily allowance of provisions assigned to a soldier in the army, or a sailor in the navy, for his subsistence. Note: Officers have several rations, the number varying according to their rank or the number of their attendants. 2. Hence, a certain portion or fixed amount dealt out; an allowanc.

synapta.definition: A genus of slender, transparent holothurians which have delicate calcareous anchors attached to the dermal plates. See Illustration in Appendix.

coranto.definition: A sprightly but somewhat stately dance, now out of fashion. It is harder to dance a corant well, than a jig. Sir W. temple. Dancing a coranto with him upon the heath. Macaulay.

uroerythrin.definition: A reddish urinary pigment, considered as the substance which gives to the urine of rheumatism its characteristic color. It also causes the red color often seen in deposits of urates.

proverbial.definition: Mentioned or comprised in a proverb; used as a proverb; hence, commonly known; as, a proverbial expression; his meanness was proverbial. In case of excesses, I take the German proverbial cure, by a hair of the same beast, to be the worst. Sir W. Temple. 2. Of or pertaining to proverbs; resembling a.

holophotal.definition: Causing no loss of light; -- applied to reflectors which throw back the rays of light without perceptible loss.

guttatrap.definition: The inspissated juice of a tree of the genus Artocarpus (A. incisa, or breadfruit tree), sometimes used in making birdlime, on account of its glutinous quality.

foresee.definition:
To see beforehand; to have prescience of; to foreknow. A prudent man foreseeth the evil. Prov. xxii. 3. 2. To provide. Great shoals of people, which go on to populate, without foreseeing means of life. Bacon.

To have or exercise foresight.

whoremasterly.definition: Having the character of a whoremaster; lecherous; libidinous.

conditionate.definition:
Conditional. Barak's answer is faithful, though conditionate. Bp. Hall.

1. To qualify by conditions; to regulate. 2. To put under conditions; to render conditional.

blea.definition: The part of a tree which lies immediately under the bark; the alburnum or sapwood.

stercorianism.definition: The doctrine or belief of the Stercoranists.

austrian.definition: Of or pertaining to Austria, or to its inhabitants. -- n.  A native or an inhabitant of Austria.

cheerry.definition: Cheerful; lively; gay; bright; pleasant; as, a cheery person. His cheery little study, where the sunshine glimmered so pleasantly. Hawthorne.

autunite.definition: A lemon-yellow phosphate of uranium and calcium occurring in tabular crystals with basal cleavage, and in micalike scales. H., 2- 2.5. Sp. gr., 3.05-3.19.

outwing.definition: To surpass, exceed, or outstrip in flying. Garth.

privateersman.definition: An officer or seaman of a privateer.

balmoral.definition: A long woolen petticoat, worn immediately under the dress. 2. A kind of stout walking shoe, laced in front. A man who uses his balmorals to tread on your toes. George Eliot.

choreic.definition: Of the nature of, or pertaining to, chorea; convulsive.

blackball.definition:
A composition for blacking shoes, boots, etc.; also, one for taking impressions of engraved work. 2. A ball of black color, esp. one used as a negative in voting; -- in this sense usually two words.

1. To vote against, by putting a black ball into a ballot box; to reject or exclude, as by voting ag.

astrut.definition: Sticking out, or puffed out; swelling; in a swelling manner. [Archaic] Inflated and astrut with self-conceit. Cowper. 2. In a strutting manner; with a strutting gait.

embryonate.definition: In the state of, or having, an embryonal.

biestings.definition: The first milk given by a cow after calving. B. Jonson. The thick and curdy milk . . . commonly called biestings. Newton. (1574).

wis.definition:
Certainly; really; indeed. "As wis God helpe me." Chaucer.

To think; to suppose; to imagine; -- used chiefly in the first person sing. present tense, I wis. See the Note under Ywis. [Obs. or Poetic] "Howe'er you wis." R. Browning. Nor do I know how long it is (For I have lain entranced, I wis). Col.

concessionnaire.definition: The beneficiary of a concession or grant.

milldam.definition: A dam or mound to obstruct a water course, and raise the water to a height sufficient to turn a mill wheel.

dicyemata.definition: An order of worms parasitic in cephalopods. They are remarkable for the extreme simplicity of their structure. The embryo exists in two forms.

demise.definition: Transmission by formal act or conveyance to an heir or successor; transference; especially, the transfer or transmission of the crown or royal authority to a successor. 2. The decease of a royal or princely person; hence, also, the death of any illustrious person. After the demise of the Queen [of G.

acidic.definition: Containing a high percentage of silica; -- opposed to basic. an acidic solution.

altarwise.definition: In the proper position of an altar, that is, at the east of a church with its ends towards the north and south. Shipley.

neo-kantian.definition:
An adherent of Neo-Kantianism.

Of or pertaining to Neo-Kantianism.

eviternal.definition: Eternal; everlasting. -- Ev`i*ter"nal*ly, adv. Bp. Hall.

leavings.definition: Things left; remnants; relics. 2. Refuse; offal.

besieging.definition: That besieges; laying siege to. -- Be*sie"ging*ly, adv.

abaft.definition:
Behind; toward the stern from; as, abaft the wheelhouse. Abaft the beam. See under Beam.

Toward the stern; aft; as, to go abaft.

riffraff.definition: Sweepings; refuse; the lowest order of society. Beau & Fl.

submetallic.definition: Imperfectly metallic; as, a submetallic luster.

obey.definition: To give ear to; to execute the commands of; to yield submission to; to comply with the orders of. Children, obey your parents in the Lord. Eph. vi. 1. Was she the God, that her thou didst obey Milton. 2. To submit to the authority of; to be ruled by. My will obeyed his will. Chaucer. Afric and India.

rapid-fire.definition: (a) (Gun.) Firing shots in rapid succession. (b) (Ordnance) Capable of being fired rapidly; -- applied to single- barreled guns of greater caliber than small arms, mounted so as to be quickly trained and elevated, with a quick-acting breech mechanism operated by a single motion of a crank or lever (.

nascal.definition: A kind of pessary of medicated wool or cotton, formerly used.

nitter.definition: The horselouse; an insect that deposits nits on horses.

bedchamber.definition: A chamber for a bed; an apartment form sleeping in. Shak. Lords of the bedchamber, eight officers of the royal household, all of noble families, who wait in turn a week each. [Eng.] -- Ladies of the bedchamber, eight ladies, all titled, holding a similar official position in the royal household, dur.

lign-aloes.definition: Aloes wood, or agallochum. See Agallochum. 2. A fragrant tree mentioned in the Bible. Num. xxiv. 6.

philosophaster.definition: A pretender to philosophy. Dr. H. More.

stomacher.definition: One who stomachs. 2. (  An ornamental covering for the breast, worn originally both by men and women. Those worn by women were often richly decorated. A stately lady in a diamond stomacher. Johnson.

metallographic.definition: Pertaining to, or by means of, metallography.

droil.definition:
To work sluggishly or slowly; to plod.

1. A drudge. Beau. & Fl. 2. Mean labor; toil.

knitter.definition: One who, or that which, knits, joins, or unites; a knitting machine. Shak.

angulous.definition: Angular; having corners; hooked. Held together by hooks and angulous involutions. Glanvill.

berretta.definition: A square cap worn by ecclesiastics of the Roman Catholic Church. A cardinal's berretta is scarlet; that worn by other clerics is black, except that a bishop's is lined with green. [Also spelt beretta, biretta, etc.].

protege.definition: One under the care and protection of another.

staving.definition: A cassing or lining of staves; especially, one encircling a water wheel.

heliacal.definition: Emerging from the light of the sun, or passing into it; rising or setting at the same, or nearly the same, time as the sun. Sir T. Browne. Note: The heliacal rising of a star is when, after being in conjunction with the sun, and invisible, it emerges from the light so as to be visible in the morning.

heliconia.definition: One of numerous species of Heliconius, a genus of tropical American butterflies. The wings are usually black, marked with green, crimson, and white.

approvable.definition: Worthy of being approved; meritorious. -- Ap*prov"a*ble*ness, n.

micraster.definition: A genus of sea urchins, similar to Spatangus, abounding in the chalk formation; -- from the starlike disposal of the ambulacral furrows.

detersion.definition: The act of deterging or cleansing, as a sore.

exhaustible.definition: Capable of being exhausted, drained off, or expended. Johnson.

tuscaroras.definition: A tribe of North American Indians formerly living on the Neuse and Tar rivers in North Carolina. They were conquered in 1713, after which the remnant of the tribe joined the Five Nations, thus forming the Six Nations. See Six Nations, under Six.

recurviroster.definition: A bird whose beak bends upward, as the avocet.

regentship.definition: The office of a regent; regency.

jugular.definition:
(Anat.) (a) Of or pertaining to the throat or neck; as, the jugular vein. (b) Of or pertaining to the jugular vein; as, the jugular foramen. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having the ventral fins beneath the throat; -- said of certain fishes.

1. (Anat.)  One of the large veins which return the blood from the head to.

shew.definition:
See Show.

Show. [Obs. except in shewbread.].

droplight.definition: An apparatus for bringing artificial light down from a chandelier nearer to a table or desk; a pendant.

precessional.definition: Of or pertaining to pression; as, the precessional movement of the equinoxes.

awkly.definition: In an unlucky (left-handed) or perverse manner. Holland. 2. Awkwardly. Fuller.

bouilli.definition: Boiled or stewed meat; beef boiled with vegetables in water from which its gravy is to be made; beef from which bouillon or soup has been made.

contraindicate.definition: To indicate, as by a symptom, some method of treatment contrary to that which the general tenor of the case would seem to require. Contraindicating symptoms must be observed. Harvey.

anthraconite.definition: A coal-black marble, usually emitting a fetid smell when rubbed; -- called also stinkstone and swinestone.

supersaturation.definition: The operation of supersaturating, or the state of being supersaturated.

riprap.definition:
A foundation or sustaining wall of stones thrown together without order, as in deep water or on a soft bottom.

To form a riprap in or upon.

assurgency.definition: Act of rising. The . . . assurgency of the spirit through the body. Coleridge.

sassaby.definition: A large African antelope (Alcelaphus tunata), similar to the hartbeest, but having its horns regularly curved.

dentex.definition: An edible European marine fish (Sparus dentex, or Dentex vulgaris) of the family Percidæ.

inequitate.definition: To ride over or through. Dr. H. More.

deplume.definition: To strip or pluck off the feather of; to deprive of of plumage. On the depluming of the pope every bird had his own feather. Fuller. 2. To lay bare; to expose. The exposure and depluming of the leading humbugs of the age. De Quincey.

etymological.definition: Pertaining to etymology, or the derivation of words. -- Et`y*mo*log"ic*al*ly, adv.

zealant.definition: One who is zealous; a zealot; an enthusiast. To certain zealants, all speech of pacification is odious. Bacon.

phenix.definition: (Gr. Myth.)  A bird fabled to exist single, to be consumed by fire by its own act, and to rise again from its ashes. Hence, an emblem of immortality. 2. (Astron.)  A southern constellation. 3. A marvelous person or thing. Latimer.

sobranje.definition: The unicameral national assembly of Bulgaria, elected for a term of five years by universal suffrage of adult males.

tringa.definition: A genus of limicoline birds including many species of sandpipers. See Dunlin, Knot, and Sandpiper.

gnatworm.definition: The aquatic larva of a gnat; -- called also, colloquially, wiggler.

soda.definition: (a) Sodium oxide or hydroxide. (b) Popularly, sodium carbonate or bicarbonate. Caustic soda, sodium hydroxide. -- Cooking soda, sodium bicarbonate. -- Sal soda. See Sodium carbonate, under Sodium. -- Soda alum (Min.), a mineral consisting of the hydrous sulphate of alumina and soda. -- Soda ash, cru.

gloomy.definition: Imperfectly illuminated; dismal through obscurity or darkness; dusky; dim; clouded; as, the cavern was gloomy. "Though hid in gloomiest shade." Milton. 2. Affected with, or expressing, gloom; melancholy; dejected; as, a gloomy temper or countenance. Syn. -- Dark; dim; dusky; dismal; cloudy; moody; s.

toothlet.definition: A little tooth, or like projection.

semimetallic.definition: Of or pertaining to a semimetal; possessing metallic properties in an inferior degree; resembling metal.

weave.definition: To unite, as threads of any kind, in such a manner as to form a texture; to entwine or interlace into a fabric; as, to weave wool, silk, etc.; hence, to unite by close connection or intermixture; to unite intimately. This weaves itself, perforce, into my business. Shak. That in their green shops wea.

engulfment.definition: A swallowing up as if in a gulf.

perpetrable.definition: Capable of being perpetrated. R. North.

bramble.definition: (Bot.)  Any plant of the genus Rubus, including the raspberry and blackberry. Hence: Any rough, prickly shrub. The thorny brambles, and embracing bushes. Shak. 2. (Zoöl.)  The brambling or bramble finch.

circumventor.definition: One who circumvents; one who gains his purpose by cunning.

indocibility.definition: The state of being indocible; indocibleness; indocility.

ambitiousness.definition: The quality of being ambitious; ambition; pretentiousness.

pruriginous.definition: Tending to, or caused by, prurigo; affected by, or of the nature of, prurigo.

futurity.definition: State of being that is yet to come; future state. 2. Future time; time to come; the future. 3. Event to come; a future event. All futurities are naked before the All-seeing Eye. South.

forty-spot.definition: The Tasmanian forty-spotted diamond bird (Pardalotus quadragintus).

mop.definition:
A made-up face; a grimace. "What mops and mowes it makes!" Beau. & Fl.

To make a wry mouth. Shak.

1. An implement for washing floors, or the like, made of a piece of cloth, or a collection of thrums, or coarse yarn, fastened to a handle. 2. A fair where servants are hired. 3. The young of any anim.

deanery.definition: The office or the revenue of a dean. See the Note under Benefice, n., 3. 2. The residence of a dean. Shak. 3. The territorial jurisdiction of a dean. Each archdeaconry is divided into rural deaneries, and each deanery is divided into parishes. Blackstone.

bicallous.definition: Having two callosities or hard spots. Gray.

zonal.definition: Of or pertaining to a zone; having the form of a zone or zones. Zonal equation (Crystallog.), the mathematical relation which belongs to all the planes of a zone, and expresses their common position with reference to the axes. -- Zonal structure (Crystallog.), a structure characterized by the arrang.

nupson.definition: A simpleton; a fool. B. Jonson.

filamentous.definition: Like a thread; consisting of threads or filaments. Gray.

synocil.definition: A sense organ found in certain sponges. It consists of several filaments, each of which arises from a single cell.

falsity.definition: The quality of being false; coutrariety or want of conformity to truth. Probability does not make any alteration, either in the truth or falsity of things. South. 2. That which is false; falsehood; a lie; a false assertion. Men often swallow falsities for truths. Sir T. Brown. Syn. -- Falsehood; lie.

naphtha.definition: (Chem.)  The complex mixture of volatile, liquid, inflammable hydrocarbons, occurring naturally, and usually called crude petroleum, mineral oil, or rock oil. Specifically: That portion of the distillate obtained in the refinement of petroleum which is intermediate between the lighter gasoline and t.

eczema.definition: An inflammatory disease of the skin, characterized by the presence of redness and itching, an eruption of small vesicles, and the discharge of a watery exudation, which often dries up, leaving the skin covered with crusts; -- called also tetter, milk crust, and salt rheum.

advancer.definition: One who advances; a promoter. 2. A second branch of a buck's antler. Howell.

vaginant.definition: Serving to in invest, or sheathe; sheathing. Vaginant leaf (Bot.), a leaf investing the stem or branch by its base, which has the form of a tube.

homological.definition: Pertaining to homology; having a structural affinity proceeding from, or base upon, that kind of relation termed homology. -- Ho`mo*log"ic*al*ly, adv.

commorant.definition:
(Law)  Ordinarily residing; inhabiting. All freeholders within the precinct . . . and all persons commorant therein. Blackstone. 2. (Am. Law)  Inhabiting or occupying temporarily.

A resident. Bp. Hacket.

deictically.definition: In a manner to show or point out; directly; absolutely; definitely. When Christ spake it deictically. Hammond.

conciator.definition: The person who weighs and proportions the materials to be made into glass, and who works and tempers them.

proratable.definition: Capable of being prorated, or divided proportionately. [U.S.].

indulto.definition: A privilege or exemption; an indulgence; a dispensation granted by the pope. 2. (Spain)  A duty levied on all importations.

mammiferous.definition: Having breasts; of, pertaining to, or derived from, the Mammalia.

perspire.definition:
(Physiol.)  To excrete matter through the skin; esp., to excrete fluids through the pores of the skin; to sweat. 2. To be evacuated or excreted, or to exude, through the pores of the skin; as, a fluid perspires.

To emit or evacuate through the pores of the skin; to sweat; to excrete through pores.

surcle.definition: A little shoot; a twig; a sucker. Sir T. Browne.

druidism.definition: The system of religion, philosophy, and instruction, received and taught by the Druids; the rites and ceremonies of the Druids.

schizognathous.definition: Having the maxillo-palatine bones separate from each other and from the vomer, which is pointed in front, as in the gulls, snipes, grouse, and many other birds.

rarity.definition: The quality or state of being rare; rareness; thinness; as, the rarity (contrasted with the density) of gases. 2. That which is rare; an uncommon thing; a thing valued for its scarcity. I saw three rarities of different kinds, which pleased me more than any other shows in the place. Addison.

cumulostratus.definition: A form of cloud. See Cloud.

ecchymose.definition: To discolor by the production of an ecchymosis, or effusion of blood, beneath the skin; -- chiefly used in the passive form; as, the parts were much ecchymosed.

iguanian.definition: Resembling, or pertaining to, the iguana.

actinometric.definition: Pertaining to the measurement of the intensity of the solar rays, either (a) heating, or (b) actinic.

ravishment.definition: The act of carrying away by force or against consent; abduction; as, the ravishment of children from their parents, or a ward from his guardian, or of a wife from her husband. Blackstone. 2. The state of being ravished; rapture; transport of delight; ecstasy. Spencer. In whose sight all things joy,.

cuppy.definition: Hollow; cuplike; also, full of cups, or small depressions. 2.  Characterized by cup shakes; -- said of timber.

kinglet.definition: A little king; a weak or insignificant king. Carlyle. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any one of several species of small singing birds of the genus Regulus and family Sylviidæ. Note: The golden-crowned kinglet (Regulus satrapa), and the rubycrowned kinglet (R. calendula), are the most common American species. The comm.

regrate.definition:
(Masonry)  To remove the outer surface of, as of an old hewn stone, so as to give it a fresh appearance. 2. To offend; to shock. Derham.

To buy in large quantities, as corn, provisions, etc., at a market or fair, with the intention of selling the same again, in or near the same place, at a higher p.

groveling.definition: Lying prone; low; debased. [Written also grovelling.] "A groveling creature." Cowper.

makeless.definition: Matchless. Chaucer. 2. Without a mate. Shak.

interchain.definition: To link together; to unite closely or firmly, as by a chain. Two bosoms interchained with an oath. Shak.

bronchitic.definition: Of or pertaining to bronchitis; as, bronchitic inflammation.

melanosperm.definition: An alga of any kind that produces blackish spores, or seed dust. The melanosperms include the rockweeds and all kinds of kelp. -- Mel`a*no*sper"mous, a.

pandemic.definition: Affecting a whole people or a number of countries; everywhere epidemic. -- n.  A pandemic disease. Harvey.

atticism.definition: A favoring of, or attachment to, the Athenians. 2. The style and idiom of the Greek language, used by the Athenians; a concise and elegant expression.

bland.definition: Mild; soft; gentle; smooth and soothing in manner; suave; as, a bland temper; bland persuasion; a bland sycophant. "Exhilarating vapor bland." Milton. 2. Having soft and soothing qualities; not drastic or irritating; not stimulating; as, a bland oil; a bland diet.

chaldee.definition: Of or pertaining to Chaldea. -- n.  The language or dialect of the Chaldeans; eastern Aramaic, or the Aramaic used in Chaldea. Chaldee Paraphrase, A targum written in Aramaic.

sickening.definition: Causing sickness; specif., causing surfeit or disgust; nauseating. -- Sick"en*ing*ly, adv.

deanship.definition: The office of a dean. I dont't value your deanship a straw. Swift.

oppugn.definition: To fight against; to attack; to be in conflict with; to oppose; to resist. They said the manner of their impeachment they could not but conceive did oppugn the rights of Parliament. Clarendon.

mullein.definition: Any plant of the genus Verbascum. They are tall herbs having coarse leaves, and large flowers in dense spikes. The common species, with densely woolly leaves, is Verbascum Thapsus. Moth mullein. See under Moth. -- Mullein foxglove, an American herb (Seymeria macrophylla) with coarse leaves and yello.

valkyria.definition: One of the maidens of Odin, represented as awful and beautiful, who presided over battle and marked out those who were to be slain, and who also ministered at the feasts of heroes in Valhalla. [Written also Valkyr, and Walkyr.].

cinque-pace.definition: A lively dance (called also galliard), the steps of which were regulated by the number five. Nares. Shak.

echoer.definition: One who, or that which, echoes.

redhorn.definition: Any species of a tribe of butterflies (Fugacia) including the common yellow species and the cabbage butterflies. The antennæ are usually red.

swimmingness.definition: Act or state of swimming; suffusion. "A swimmingness in the eye." Congreve.

canonicals.definition: The dress prescribed by canon to be worn by a clergyman when oficiating. Sometimes, any distinctive professional dress. Full canonicals, the complete costume of an officiating clergyman or ecclesiastic.

inflame.definition: To set on fire; to kindle; to cause to burn, flame, or glow. We should have made retreat By light of the inflamed fleet. Chapman. 2. Fig.: To kindle or intensify, as passion or appetite; to excite to an excessive or unnatural action or heat; as, to inflame desire. Though more,it seems, Inflamed with.

prognathous.definition: Having the jaws projecting beyond the upper part of the face; - - opposed to orthognathous. See Gnathic index, under Gnathic. Their countenances had the true prognathous character. Kane.

ashore.definition: On shore or on land; on the land adjacent to water; to the shore; to the land; aground (when applied to a ship); -- sometimes opposed to aboard or afloat. Here shall I die ashore. Shak. I must fetch his necessaries ashore. Shak.

excrementitial.definition: Pertaining to, or consisting of, excrement; of the nature of excrement.

arenicolite.definition: An ancient wormhole in sand, preserved in the rocks. Dana.

epithelial.definition: Of or pertaining to epithelium; as, epithelial cells; epithelial cancer.

nephalist.definition: One who advocates or practices nephalism.

undersecretary.definition: A secretary who is subordinate to the chief secretary; an assistant secretary; as, an undersecretary of the Treasury.

tubulibranchiata.definition: A group of gastropod mollusks having a tubular shell. Vermetus is an example.

cleavable.definition: Capable of cleaving or being divided.

hin.definition: A Hebrew measure of liquids, containing three quarts, one pint, one gill, English measure. W. H. Ward.

disappendent.definition: Freed from a former connection or dependence; disconnected.

barmy.definition:
Full of barm or froth; in a ferment. "Barmy beer." Dryden.

Full of barm or froth; in a ferment. "Barmy beer."  Dryden.

masser.definition: A priest who celebrates Mass. Bale.

hypothenuse.definition:
The side of a right-angled triangle that is opposite to the right angle.

Same as Hypotenuse.

obole.definition: A weight of twelve grains; or, according to some, of ten grains, or half a scruple. [Written also obol.].

prattle.definition:
To talk much and idly; to prate; hence, to talk lightly and artlessly, like a child; to utter child's talk.

To utter as prattle; to babble; as, to prattle treason. Addison.

Trifling or childish tattle; empty talk; loquacity on trivial subjects; prate; babble. Mere prattle, without practice. Shak.

vesica.definition: A bladder. Vesica piscis. Etym: [L., dish bladder.] (Eccl. Art) A glory, or aureole, of oval shape, or composed of two arcs of circles usually represented as surrounding a divine personage. More rarely, an oval composed of two arcs not representing a glory; a solid oval, etc.

self-communicative.definition: Imparting or communicating by its own powers.

lyceum.definition: A place of exercise with covered walks, in the suburbs of Athens, where Aristotle taught philosophy. 2. A house or apartment appropriated to instruction by lectures or disquisitions. 3. A higher school, in Europe, which prepares youths for the university. 4. An association for debate and literary im.

manes.definition: The benevolent spirits of the dead, especially of dead ancestors, regarded as family deities and protectors. Hail, O ye holy manes! Dryden.

eparchy.definition: A province, prefecture, or territory, under the jurisdiction of an eparch or governor; esp., in modern Greece, one of the larger subdivisions of a monarchy or province of the kingdom; in Russia, a diocese or archdiocese.

chronoscope.definition: An instrument for measuring minute intervals of time; used in determining the velocity of projectiles, the duration of short-lived luminous phenomena, etc.

cripply.definition: Lame; disabled; in a crippled condition. Mrs. Trollope.

closehauled.definition: Under way and moving as nearly as possible toward the direction from which the wind blows; -- said of a sailing vessel.

teratoid.definition: Resembling a monster; abnormal; of a pathological growth, exceedingly complex or highly organized. S. D. Gross.

vexillary.definition:
Of or pertaining to an ensign or standard. 2. (Bot.)  Of or pertaining to the vexillum, or upper petal of papilionaceous flowers. Vexilary æstivation (Bot.), a mode of æstivation in which one large upper petal folds over, and covers, the other smaller petals, as in most papilionaceous plants.

A sta.

trental.definition: (R. C. Ch.)  An office and mass for the dead on the thirtieth day after death or burial. "Their trentals and their shrifts." Spenser. 2. Hence, a dirge; an elegy.

vaccinate.definition: To inoculate with the cowpox by means of a virus, called vaccine, taken either directly or indirectly from cows.

sulphuration.definition: The act or process of combining or impregnating with sulphur or its compounds; also, the state of being so combined or impregnated.

dioxide.definition: (a) An oxide containing two atoms of oxygen in each molecule; binoxide. (b) An oxide containing but one atom or equivalent of oxygen to two of a metal; a suboxide. Carbon dioxide. See Carbonic acid, under Carbonic.

funnel.definition: A vessel of the shape of an inverted hollow cone, terminating below in a pipe, and used for conveying liquids into a close vessel; a tunnel. 2. A passage or avenue for a fluid or flowing substance; specifically, a smoke flue or pipe; the iron chimney of a steamship or the like. Funnel box (Mining),.

furnishment.definition: The act of furnishing, or of supplying furniture; also, furniture. Daniel.

lycanthrope.definition: A human being fabled to have been changed into a wolf; a werewolf. 2. One affected with lycanthropy.

napkin.definition: A little towel, or small cloth, esp. one for wiping the fingers and mouth at table. 2. A handkerchief. Shak. Napkin pattern. See Linen scroll, under Linen. -- Napkin ring, a ring of metal, ivory, or other material, used to inclose a table napkin.

allotropy.definition: The property of existing in two or more conditions which are distinct in their physical or chemical relations. Note: Thus, carbon occurs crystallized in octahedrons and other related forms, in a state of extreme hardness, in the diamond; it occurs in hexagonal forms, and of little hardness, in black.

nipping.definition: Biting; pinching; painful; destructive; as, a nipping frost; a nipping wind.

luny.definition: Crazy; mentally unsound. [Written also loony.] [Law, U.S.].

jenneting.definition: A variety of early apple. See Juneating. [Written also geniting.].

cower.definition:
To stoop by bending the knees; to crouch; to squat; hence, to quail; to sink through fear. Our dame sits cowering o'er a kitchen fire. Dryden. Like falcons, cowering on the nest. Goldsmith.

To cherish with care.

hayrack.definition: A frame mounted on the running gear of a wagon, and used in hauling hay, straw, sheaves, etc.; -- called also hay rigging.

submerge.definition:
To put under water; to plunge. 2. To cover or overflow with water; to inundate; to flood; to drown. I would thou didst, So half my Egypt were submerged. Shak.

To plunge into water or other fluid; to be buried or covered, as by a fluid; to be merged; hence, to be completely included. Some say swallo.

footstool.definition: A low stool to support the feet of one when sitting.

defuse.definition: To disorder; to make shapeless. Shak.

furnisher.definition: One who supplies or fits out.

malevolent.definition: Wishing evil; disposed to injure others; rejoicing in another's misfortune. Syn. -- Ill-disposed; envious; mischievous; evil-minded; spiteful; malicious; malignant; rancorous.

decagon.definition: A plane figure having ten sides and ten angles; any figure having ten angles. A regular decagon is one that has all its sides and angles equal.

penalize.definition: To make penal. 2. (Sport.)  To put a penalty on. See Penalty, 3. [Eng.].

transcalent.definition: Pervious to, or permitting the passage of, heat.

heterogeneous.definition: Differing in kind; having unlike qualities; possessed of different characteristics; dissimilar; -- opposed to homogeneous, and said of two or more connected objects, or of a conglomerate mass, considered in respect to the parts of which it is made up. -- Het`er*o*ge"ne*ous*ly, adv. -- Het`er*o*ge"ne.

puzzler.definition: One who, or that which, puzzles or perplexes. Hebrew, the general puzzler of old heads. Brome.

bifilar.definition: Two-threaded; involving the use of two threads; as, bifilar suspension; a bifilar balance. Bifilar micrometer (often called a bifilar), an instrument form measuring minute distances or angles by means of two very minute threads (usually spider lines), one of which, at least, is movable; -- more comm.

dreadless.definition:
Free from dread; fearless; intrepid; dauntless; as, dreadless heart. "The dreadless angel." Milton. 2. Exempt from danger which causes dread; secure. " safe in his dreadless den." Spenser.

Without doubt. Chaucer.

maranta.definition: A genus of endogenous plants found in tropical America, and some species also in India. They have tuberous roots containing a large amount of starch, and from one species (Maranta arundinacea) arrowroot is obtained. Many kinds are cultivated for ornament.

prolatum.definition: A prolate spheroid. See Ellipsoid of revolution, under Ellipsoid.

kettledrum.definition: (Mus.)  A drum made of thin copper in the form of a hemispherical kettle, with parchment stretched over the mouth of it. Note: Kettledrums, in pairs, were formerly used in martial music for cavalry, but are now chiefly confined to orchestras, where they are called tympani. 2. An informal social part.

incaverned.definition: Inclosed or shut up as in a cavern. Drayton.

morsitation.definition: The act of biting or gnawing.

disquisition.definition: A formal or systematic inquiry into, or discussion of, any subject; a full examination or investigation of a matter, with the arguments and facts bearing upon it; elaborate essay; dissertation. For accurate research or grave disquisition he was not well qualified. Macaulay.

cautel.definition: Caution; prudence; wariness. Fulke. 2. Craft; deceit; falseness. Shak.

outpace.definition: To outgo; to move faster than; to leave behind. Lamb.

photochromic.definition: Of or pertaining to photochromy; produced by photochromy.

municipalize.definition: To bring under municipal oversight or control; as, a municipalized industry. London people are now determined to centralize and to municipalize such services. The Century.

bristle-pointed.definition: Terminating in a very fine, sharp point, as some leaves.

emigrate.definition:
To remove from one country or State to another, for the purpose of residence; to migrate from home. Forced to emigrate in a body to America. Macaulay. They [the Huns] were emigrating from Tartary into Europe in the time of the Goths. J. H. Newman.

Migratory; roving.

synonymous.definition: Having the character of a synonym; expressing the same thing; conveying the same, or approximately the same, idea. -- Syn*on"y*mous*ly, adv. These words consist of two propositions, which are not distinct in sense, but one and the same thing variously expressed; for wisdom and understanding are syno.

stoutly.definition: In a stout manner; lustily; boldly; obstinately; as, he stoutly defended himself.

debellation.definition: The act of conquering or subduing.

dittology.definition: A double reading, or twofold interpretation, as of a Scripture text.

firmamental.definition: Pertaining to the firmament; celestial; being of the upper regions. Dryden.

rechabite.definition: One of the descendants of Jonadab, the son of Rechab, all of whom by his injunction abstained from the use of intoxicating drinks and even from planting the vine. Jer. xxxv. 2-19. Also, in modern times, a member of a certain society of abstainers from alcoholic liquors.

metabolite.definition: A product of metabolism; a substance produced by metabolic action, as urea.

nonsexual.definition: Having no distinction of sex; sexless; neuter.

handy-dandy.definition: A child's play, one child guessing in which closed hand the other holds some small object, winning the object if right and forfeiting an equivalent if wrong; hence, forfeit. Piers Plowman.

misdistinguish.definition: To make wrong distinctions in or concerning. Hooker.

alkalization.definition: The act rendering alkaline by impregnating with an alkali; a conferring of alkaline qualities.

prevenient.definition: Going before; preceding; hence, preventive. "Prevenient grace descending." Milton.

reillumination.definition: The act or process of enlightening again.

roominess.definition: The quality or state of being roomy; spaciousness; as, the roominess of a hall.

inbreathe.definition: To infuse by breathing; to inspire. Coleridge.

star-spangled.definition: Spangled or studded with stars. Star-spangled banner, the popular name for the national ensign of the United States. F. S. Key.

unkent.definition: Unknown; strange. [Obs. or Scot.] W. Browne.

orthographize.definition: To spell correctly or according to usage; to correct in regard to spelling. In the coalesced into ith, which modern reaction has orthographized to i' th'. Earle.

swather.definition: A device attached to a mowing machine for raising the uncut fallen grain and marking the limit of the swath.

almsfolk.definition: Persons supported by alms; almsmen. [Archaic] Holinshed.

westerner.definition: A native or inhabitant of the west.

wingy.definition: Having wings; rapid. With wingy speed outstrip the eastern wind. Addison. 2. Soaring with wings, or as if with wings; volatile airy. [Obs. or R.] Those wingy mysteries in divinity. Sir T. Browne.

noctivagation.definition: A roving or going about in the night. Gayton.

inherence.definition: The state of inhering; permanent existence in something; innateness; inseparable and essential connection. Jer. Taylor.

insignment.definition: A token, mark, or explanation. Sir T. Elyot.

vang.definition: A rope to steady the peak of a gaff.

rosen.definition: Consisting of roses; rosy. ROSENMULLER'S ORGAN; ROSENMUELLER'S ORGAN Ro"sen*mül`ler's or"gan.  [So named from its first describer, J. C. Rosenmüller, a German anatomist.] (Anat.) The parovarium.

vanadous.definition: Of or pertaining to vanadium; obtained from vanadium; -- said of an acid containing one equivalent of vanadium and two of oxygen.

thievish.definition: Given to stealing; addicted to theft; as, a thievish boy, a thievish magpie. 2. Like a thief; acting by stealth; sly; secret. Time's thievish progress to eternity. Shak. 3. Partaking of the nature of theft; accomplished by stealing; dishonest; as, a thievish practice. Or with a base and biosterous s.

escritorial.definition: Of or pertaining to an escritoire.

haddock.definition: A marine food fish (Melanogrammus æglefinus), allied to the cod, inhabiting the northern coasts of Europe and America. It has a dark lateral line and a black spot on each side of the body, just back of the gills. Galled also haddie, and dickie. Norway haddock, a marine edible fish (Sebastes marinus).

burgher.definition: A freeman of a burgh or borough, entitled to enjoy the privileges of the place; any inhabitant of a borough. 2. (Eccl. Hist.)  A member of that party, among the Scotch seceders, which asserted the lawfulness of the burgess oath (in which burgesses profess "the true religion professed within the real.

deliberately.definition: With careful consideration, or deliberation; circumspectly; warily; not hastily or rashly; slowly; as, a purpose deliberately formed.

hals.definition: The neck or throat. Do me hangen by the hals. Chaucer.

suspend.definition: To attach to something above; to hang; as, to suspend a ball by a thread; to suspend a needle by a loadstone. 2. To make to depend; as, God hath suspended the promise of eternal life on the condition of obedience and holiness of life. [Archaic] Tillotson. 3. To cause to cease for a time; to hinder f.

consulter.definition: One who consults, or asks counsel or information.

jards.definition: A callous tumor on the leg of a horse, below the hock.

slouching.definition: Hanging down at the side; limp; drooping; without firmness or shapeliness; moving in an ungainly manner.

chorister.definition: One of a choir; a singer in a chorus. Dryden. 2. One who leads a choir in church music. [U. S.].

cirrigrade.definition: Moving or moved by cirri, or hairlike appendages.

stufa.definition: A jet of steam issuing from a fissure in the earth.

unravelment.definition: The act of unraveling, or the state of being unraveled.

deltohedron.definition: A solid bounded by twelve quadrilateral faces. It is a hemihedral form of the isometric system, allied to the tetrahedron.

imbrute.definition:
To degrade to the state of a brute; to make brutal. And mixed with bestial slime, This essence to incarnate and imbrute. Milton.

To sink to the state of a brute. The soul grows clotted by contagion, Imbodies, and imbrutes, till she quite lose The divine property of her first being. Milton.

schismatize.definition: To make part in schism; to make a breach of communion in the church.

oscan.definition: Of or pertaining to the Osci, a primitive people of Campania, a province of ancient Italy. -- n.  The language of the Osci.

palmaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to palms; of the nature of, or resembling, palms.

icosandrian.definition: Pertaining to the class Icosandria; having twenty or more stamens inserted in the calyx.

peritoneal.definition: Of or pertaining to the peritoneum.

ambry.definition: In churches, a kind of closet, niche, cupboard, or locker for utensils, vestments, etc. 2. A store closet, as a pantry, cupboard, etc. 3. Almonry. [Improperly so used].

miscredulity.definition: Wrong credulity or belief; misbelief. Bp. Hall.

passable.definition: Capable of being passed, traveled, navigated, traversed, penetrated, or the like; as, the roads are not passable; the stream is passablein boats. His body's a passable carcass if it be not hurt; it is a throughfare for steel. Shak. 2. Capable of being freely circulated or disseminated; acceptable; g.

subzonal.definition: Situated under a zone, or zona; -- applied to a membrane between the zona radiata and the umbilical vesicle in the mammal embryo.

corsage.definition: The waist or bodice of a lady's dress; as. a low corsage.

membered.definition: Having limbs; -- chiefly used in composition. 2. (Her.)  Having legs of a different tincture from that of the body; -- said of a bird in heraldic representations.

halloysite.definition: A claylike mineral, occurring in soft, smooth, amorphous masses, of a whitish color.

rapper.definition: One who, or that which, raps or knocks; specifically, the knocker of a door. Sterne. 2. A forcible oath or lie. [Slang] Bp. Parker.

platonist.definition: One who adheres to the philosophy of Plato; a follower of Plato. Hammond.

symbolics.definition: The study of ancient symbols; esp. (Theol.),  that branch of historic theology which treats of creeds and confessions of faith; symbolism; -- called also symbolic.

unrevenued.definition: Not furnished with a revenue. Milton.

forestal.definition: Of or pertaining to forests; as, forestal rights.

costate.definition: Having ribs, or the appearance of ribs; (Bot.) having one or more longitudinal ribs.

supplely.definition: In a supple manner; softly; pliantly; mildly. Cotgrave.

unpinion.definition: To loose from pinions or manacles; to free from restraint. Goldsmith.

cursores.definition: (a) An order of running birds including the ostrich, emu, and allies; the Ratitaæ. (b) A group of running spiders; the wolf spiders.

worsted.definition: Well-twisted yarn spun of long-staple wool which has been combed to lay the fibers parallel, used for carpets, cloth, hosiery, gloves, and the like. 2. Fine and soft woolen yarn, untwisted or lightly twisted, used in knitting and embroidery.

cittern.definition: An instrument shaped like a lute, but strung with wire and played with a quill or plectrum. [Written also cithern.] Shak. Note: Not to be confounded with zither.

thematic.definition: (Gram.)  Of or pertaining to the theme of a word. See Theme, n., 4. 2. (Mus.)  Of or pertaining to a theme, or subject. Thematic catalogue (Mus.), a catalogue of musical works which, besides the title and other particulars, gives in notes the theme, or first few measures, of the whole work or of its.

counterpole.definition: The exact opposite. The German prose offers the counterpole to the French style. De Quincey.

blackbirding.definition: The kidnaping of negroes or Polynesians to be sold as slaves. 2.  The act or practice of collecting natives of the islands near Queensland for service on the Queensland sugar plantations. [Australia].

eye-splice.definition: A splice formed by bending a rope's and back, and fastening it into the rope, forming a loop or eye. See Illust. under Splice.

symphytism.definition: Coalescence; a growing into one with another word. Some of the phrasal adverbs have assumed the form of single words, by that symphytism which naturally attaches these light elements to each other. Earle.

cervical.definition: Of or pertaining to the neck; as, the cervical vertebræ.

anbury.definition: (Far.)  A soft tumor or bloody wart on horses or oxen. 2. A disease of the roots of turnips, etc.; -- called also fingers and toes.

snively.definition: Running at the nose; sniveling pitiful; whining.

pedantocracy.definition: The sway of pedants. J. S. Mill.

unfit.definition:
To make unsuitable or incompetent; to deprive of the strength, skill, or proper qualities for anything; to disable; to incapacitate; to disqualify; as, sickness unfits a man for labor; sin unfits us for the society of holy beings.

Not fit; unsuitable. -- Un*fit"ly, adv. -- Un*fit"ness, n.

parochial.definition: Of or pertaining to a parish; restricted to a parish; as, parochial duties. "Parochial pastors." Bp. Atterbury. Hence, limited; narrow. "The parochial mind." W. Black.

authorial.definition: Of or pertaining to an author. "The authorial Hare.

snuffle.definition:
To speak through the nose; to breathe through the nose when it is obstructed, so as to make a broken sound. One clad in purple Eats, and recites some lamentable rhyme . . . Snuffling at nose, and croaking in his throat. Dryden.

1. The act of snuffing; a sound made by the air passing through the nos.

tranquilization.definition: The act of tranquilizing, or the state of being tranquilized.

claymore.definition: A large two-handed sword used formerly by the Scottish Highlanders.

envy.definition: Malice; ill will; spite. If he evade us there, Enforce him with his envy to the people. Shak. 2. Chagrin, mortification, discontent, or uneasiness at the sight of another's excellence or good fortune, accompanied with some degree of hatred and a desire to possess equal advantages; malicious grudging.

roundhouse.definition: A constable's prison; a lockup, watch-house, or station house. 2. (Naut.) (a) A cabin or apartament on the after part of the quarter-deck, having the poop for its roof; -- sometimes called the coach. (b) A privy near the bow of the vessel. 3. A house for locomotive engines, built circularly around a.

metoposcopy.definition: The study of physiognomy; the art of discovering the character of persons by their features, or the lines of the face.

broad-brimmed.definition: Having a broad brim. A broad-brimmed flat silver plate. Tatler.

erythrogen.definition: (a) Carbon disulphide; -- so called from certain red compounds which it produces in combination with other substances. (b) A substance reddened by acids, which is supposed to be contained in flowers. (c) A crystalline substance obtained from diseased bile, which becomes blood-red when acted on by ni.

mesothelium.definition: Epithelial mesoderm; a layer of cuboidal epithelium cells, formed from a portion of the mesoderm during the differetiation of the germ layers. It constitutes the boundary of the coelum.

copped.definition: Rising to a point or head; conical; pointed; crested. Wiseman.

finochio.definition: An umbelliferous plant (Foeniculum dulce) having a somewhat tuberous stem; sweet fennel. The blanched stems are used in France and Italy as a culinary vegetable.

brontometer.definition: An instrument for noting or recording phenomena attendant on thunderstorms.

glassware.definition: Ware, or articles collectively, made of glass.

pantograph.definition: An instrument for copying plans, maps, and other drawings, on the same, or on a reduced or an enlarged, scale. [Written also pantagraph, and incorrectly pentagraph.] Skew pantograph, a kind of pantograph for drawing a copy which is inclined with respect to the original figure; -- also called plagiog.

popularize.definition: To make popular; to make suitable or acceptable to the common people; to make generally known; as, to popularize philosophy. "The popularizing of religious teaching." Milman.

antlered.definition: Furnished with antlers. The antlered stag. Cowper.

episodial.definition: Pertaining to an episode; by way of episode; episodic.

tractation.definition: Treatment or handling of a subject; discussion. A full tractation of the points controverted. Bp. Hall.

enhydrous.definition: Having water within; containing fluid drops; -- said of certain crystals.

oriskany.definition: Designating, or pertaining to, certain beds, chiefly limestone, characteristic of the latest period of the Silurian age. Oriskany period, a subdivision of the American Paleozoic system intermediate or translational in character between the Silurian and Devonian ages. See Chart of Geology.

insouciant.definition: Careless; heedless; indifferent; unconcerned. J. S. Mill.

pistoleer.definition: One who uses a pistol. Carlyle.

unplight.definition: To unfold; to lay open; to explain. Chaucer.

bedwarf.definition: To make a dwarf of; to stunt or hinder the growth of; to dwarf. Donne.

jacqueminot.definition: A half-hardy, deep crimson rose of the remontant class; -- so named after General Jacqueminot, of France.

yesterweek.definition: The week last past; last week.

furtherer.definition: One who furthers. or helps to advance; a promoter. Shak.

landskip.definition: A landscape. [Obs. except in poetry.] Straight my eye hath caught new pleasures, Whilst the landskip round it measures. Milton.

afflux.definition: A flowing towards; that which flows to; as, an afflux of blood to the head.

ankus.definition: An elephant goad with a sharp spike and hook, resembling a short-handled boat hook. [India] Kipling.

anoxemia.definition: An abnormal condition due to deficient aëration of the blood, as in balloon sickness, mountain sickness. -- An`ox*æ"mic, *e"mic (#), a.

postcornu.definition: The posterior horn of each lateral ventricle of the brain. B. G. Wilder.

rash.definition:
To pull off or pluck violently. 2. To slash; to hack; to slice. Rushing of helms and riving plates asunder. Spenser.

A fine eruption or efflorescence on the body, with little or no elevation. Canker rash. See in the Vocabulary. -- Nettle rash. See Urticaria. -- Rose rash. See Roseola. -- Tooth rash.

intendancy.definition: The office or employment of an intendant. 2. A territorial district committed to the charge of an intendant.

monarcho.definition: The nickname of a crackbrained Italian who fancied himself an emperor. Shak.

spectator.definition: One who on; one who sees or beholds; a beholder; one who is personally present at, and sees, any exhibition; as, the spectators at a show. "Devised and played to take spectators." Shak. Syn. -- Looker-on; beholder; observer; witness.

triandrous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Triandria; having three distinct and equal stamens in the same flower.

subesophageal.definition: Situated beneath the esophagus. [Written also suboesophageal.] Subesophageal ganglion (Zoöl.), a large special ganglion situated beneath the esophagus of arthropods, annelids, and some other invertebrates.

lave.definition:
To wash; to bathe; as, to lave a bruise. His feet the foremost breakers lave. Byron.

To bathe; to wash one's self. In her chaste current oft the goddess laves. Pope.

To lade, dip, or pour out. Dryden.

The remainder; others. [Scot.] Bp. Hall.

branchiferous.definition: Having gills; branchiate; as, branchiferous gastropods.

struthio.definition: A genus of birds including the African ostriches.

capercailzie.definition: A species of grouse (Tetrao uragallus) of large size and fine flavor, found in northern Europe and formerly in Scotland; -- called also cock of the woods. [Written also capercaillie, capercaili.].

vouchsafe.definition:
To condescend to grant; to concede; to bestow. If ye vouchsafe that it be so. Chaucer. Shall I vouchsafe your worship a word or two Shak. It is not said by the apostle that God vouchsafed to the heathens the means of salvation. South. 2. To receive or accept in condescension. Shak.

To condescend; t.

excitability.definition: The quality of being readily excited; proneness to be affected by exciting causes. 2. (Physiol.)  The property manifested by living organisms, and the elements and tissues of which they are constituted, of responding to the action of stimulants; irritability; as, nervous excitability.

derm.definition: The integument of animal; the skin. 2. (Anat.)  See Dermis.

grandfather.definition: A father's or mother's father; an ancestor in the next degree above the father or mother in lineal ascent. Grandfather longlegs. (Zoöl.) See Dady longlegs.

civilized.definition: Reclaimed from savage life and manners; instructed in arts, learning, and civil manners; refined; cultivated. Sale of conscience and duty in open market is not reconcilable with the present state of civilized society. J. Quincy.

vedette.definition: A sentinel, usually on horseback, stationed on the outpost of an army, to watch an enemy and give notice of danger; a vidette.

cascabel.definition: The projection in rear of the breech of a cannon, usually a knob or breeching loop connected with the gun by a neck. In old writers it included all in rear of the base ring. Note: [See Illust. of Cannon.].

electro-gilding.definition: The art or process of gilding copper, iron, etc., by means of voltaic electricity.

unscrupulous.definition: Not scrupulous; unprincipled. -- Un*scru"pu*lous*ly, adv. -- Un*scru"pu*lous*ness, n.

categorematic.definition: Capable of being employed by itself as a term; -- said of a word.

clearage.definition: The act of reforming anything; clearance.

chalchihuitl.definition: The Mexican name for turquoise. See Turquoise.

nauscopy.definition: The power or act of discovering ships or land at considerable distances.

hallucinate.definition: To wander; to go astray; to err; to blunder; -- used of mental processes. Byron.

barruly.definition: Traversed by barrulets or small bars; -- said of the field.

pantologist.definition: One versed in pantology; a writer of pantology.

anglicity.definition: The state or quality of being English.

deesis.definition: An invocation of, or address to, the Supreme Being.

brobdingnagian.definition: Colossal' of extraordinary height; gigantic. -- n.  A giant. [Spelt often Brobdignagian.].

bridle.definition: The head gear with which a horse is governed and restrained, consisting of a headstall, a bit, and reins, with other appendages. 2. A restraint; a curb; a check. I. Watts. 3. (Gun.)  The piece in the interior of a gun lock, which holds in place the timbler, sear, etc. 4. (Naut.) (a) A span of rope,.

interlard.definition: To place lard or bacon amongst; to mix, as fat meat with lean. Whose grain doth rise in flakes, with fatness interlarded. Drayton. 2. Hence: To insert between; to mix or mingle; especially, to introduce that which is foreign or irrelevant; as, to interlard a conservation with oaths or allusions. The.

patroness.definition: A female patron or helper. Spenser. Night, best patroness of grief. Milton.

recto-uterine.definition: Of or pertaining to both the rectum and the uterus.

sepsin.definition: A soluble poison (ptomaine) present in putrid blood. It is also formed in the putrefaction of proteid matter in general.

statued.definition: Adorned with statues. "The statued hall." Longfellow. "Statued niches." G. Eliot.

alexandrine.definition:
Belonging to Alexandria; Alexandrian. Bancroft.

A kind of verse consisting in English of twelve syllables. The needless Alexandrine ends the song, That, like a wounded snake, drags its slow length along. Pope.

gnomically.definition: In a gnomic, didactic, or sententious manner.

slaughterous.definition: Destructive; murderous. Shak. M. Arnold. -- Slaugh"ter*ous*ly, adv.

votarist.definition: A votary. Like a sad votarist in palmer's weed. Milton.

overturn.definition:
To turn or throw from a basis, foundation, or position; to overset; as, to overturn a carriage or a building. 2. To subvert; to destroy; to overthrow. 3. To overpower; to conquer. Milton. Syn. -- To demolish; overthrow. See Demolish.

The act off overturning, or the state of being overturned or subv.

sceptre.definition: A staff or baton borne by a sovereign, as a ceremonial badge or emblem of authority; a royal mace. And the king held out Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. Esther v. 2. 2. Hence, royal or imperial power or authority; sovereignty; as, to assume the scepter. The scepter shall not depart f.

atheistical.definition: Pertaining to, implying, or containing, atheism; -- applied to things; as, atheistic doctrines, opinions, or books. Atheistical explications of natural effects. Barrow. 2. Disbelieving the existence of a God; impious; godless; -- applied to persons; as, an atheistic writer. -- A`the*is"tic*al*ly, ad.

viduation.definition: The state of being widowed or bereaved; loss; bereavement.

miny.definition: Abounding with mines; like a mine. "Miny caverns." Thomson.

pentylic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or containing, pentyl; as, pentylic alcohol.

boggy.definition: Consisting of, or containing, a bog or bogs; of the nature of a bog; swampy; as, boggy land.

protectionist.definition: One who favors protection. See Protection, 4.

overmultiply.definition: To multiply or increase too much; to repeat too often.

dahoon.definition: An evergreen shrub or small tree (Ilex cassine) of the southern United States, bearing red drupes and having soft, white, close- grained wood; -- called also dahoon holly.

fistulose.definition: Formed like a fistula; hollow; reedlike. Craig.

prepossessor.definition: One who possesses, or occupies, previously. R. Brady.

assaying.definition: The act or process of testing, esp. of analyzing or examining metals and ores, to determine the proportion of pure metal.

outbabble.definition: To utter foolishly or excessively; to surpass in babbling. Milton.

eventual.definition: Coming or happening as a consequence or result; consequential. Burke. 2. Final; ultimate. "Eventual success." Cooper. 3. (Law)  Dependent on events; contingent. Marshall.

anallantoic.definition: Without, or not developing, an allantois.

factitious.definition: Made by art, in distinction from what is produced by nature; artificial; sham; formed by, or adapted to, an artificial or conventional, in distinction from a natural, standard or rule; not natural; as, factitious cinnabar or jewels; a factitious taste. -- Fac-ti"tious*ly, adv. -- Fac*ti"tious-ness,.

westing.definition: The distance, reckoned toward the west, between the two meridians passing through the extremities of a course, or portion of a ship's path; the departure of a course which lies to the west of north.

legislator.definition: A lawgiver; one who makes laws for a state or community; a member of a legislative body. The legislators in ancient and heroical times. Bacon. Many of the legislators themselves had taken an oath of abjuration of his Majesty's person and family. E. Phillips.

phonotypy.definition: A method of phonetic printing of the English language, as devised by Mr. Pitman, in which nearly all the ordinary letters and many new forms are employed in order to indicate each elementary sound by a separate character.

ambiguously.definition: In an ambiguous manner; with doubtful meaning.

ventiduct.definition: A passage for wind or air; a passage or pipe for ventilating apartments. Gwilt.

jejune.definition: Lacking matter; empty; void of substance. 2. Void of interest; barren; meager; dry; as, a jejune narrative. - Je*june"ly, adv. -- Je*june"ness, n. Bacon.

crural.definition: Of or pertaining to the thigh or leg, or to any of the parts called crura; as, the crural arteries; crural arch; crural canal; crural ring.

condog.definition: To concur; to agree. [Burlesque] Note: This word appears in early dictionaries as a synonym for the word agree; thus. "Agree; concurre, cohere, condog, condescend." Cockeram.

epidermoid.definition: Like epidermis; pertaining to the epidermis.

milord.definition: Lit., my lord; hence (as used on the Continent), an English nobleman or gentleman.

cookmaid.definition: A female servant or maid who dresses provisions and assists the cook.

godwit.definition: One of several species of long-billed, wading birds of the genus Limosa, and family Tringidæ. The European black-tailed godwit (Limosa limosa), the American marbled godwit (L. fedoa), the Hudsonian godwit (L. hæmastica), and others, are valued as game birds. Called also godwin.

galloping.definition: Going at a gallop; progressing rapidly; as, a galloping horse.

peasant.definition:
A countryman; a rustic; especially, one of the lowest class of tillers of the soil in European countries. Syn. -- Countryman; rustic; swain; hind.

Rustic, rural. Spenser.

inexactly.definition: In a manner not exact or precise; inaccurately. R. A. Proctor.

phycomycetes.definition: A large, important class of parasitic or saprophytic fungi, the algal or algalike fungi. The plant body ranges from an undifferentiated mass of protoplasm to a well-developed and much- branched mycelium. Reproduction is mainly sexual, by the formation of conidia or sporangia; but the group shows eve.

ineffective.definition: Not effective; ineffectual; futile; inefficient; useless; as, an ineffective appeal. The word of God, without the spirit, [is] a dead and ineffective letter. Jer. Taylor.

undeify.definition: To degrade from the state of deity; to deprive of the character or qualities of a god; to deprive of the reverence due to a god. Addison.

spodumene.definition: A mineral of a white to yellowish, purplish, or emerald-green color, occuring in prismatic crystals, often of great size. It is a silicate of aluminia and lithia. See Hiddenite.

cognize.definition: To know or perceive; to recognize. The reasoning faculty can deal with no facts until they are cognized by it. H. Spencer.

bilingualism.definition: Quality of being bilingual. The bilingualism of King's English. Earle.

unwrite.definition: To cancel, as what is written; to erase. Milton.

godlike.definition: Resembling or befitting a god or God; divine; hence, preeminently good; as, godlike virtue. -- God"like`ness, n.

highbinder.definition: A ruffian; one who hounds, or spies upon, another; app. esp. to the members of certain alleged societies among the Chinese. [U. S.].

soja.definition: An Asiatic leguminous herb (Glycine Soja) the seeds of which are used in preparing the sauce called soy.

flowery.definition: Full of flowers; abounding with blossoms. 2. Highly embellished with figurative language; florid; as, a flowery style. Milton. The flowery kingdom, China.

woo.definition:
To solicit in love; to court. Each, like the Grecian artist, wooes The image he himself has wrought. Prior. 2. To court solicitously; to invite with importunity. Thee, chantress, oft the woods among I woo, to hear thy even song. Milton. I woo the wind That still delays his coming. Bryant.

To court;.

dendrology.definition: A discourse or treatise on trees; the natural history of trees.

cirrate.definition: Having cirri along the margin of a part or organ.

epimachus.definition: A genus of highly ornate and brilliantly colored birds of Australia, allied to the birds of Paradise.

grapeshot.definition: A cluster, usually nine in number, of small iron balls, put together by means of cast-iron circular plates at top and bottom, with two rings, and a central connecting rod, in order to be used as a charge for a cannon. Formerly grapeshot were inclosed in canvas bags.

princeling.definition: A petty prince; a young prince.

outluster.definition: To excel in brightness or luster. Shak.

washable.definition: Capable of being washed without damage to fabric or color.

turquois.definition: A hydrous phosphate of alumina containing a little copper; calaite. It has a blue, or bluish green, color, and usually occurs in reniform masses with a botryoidal surface. [Formerly written also turcois, and turkois.] Note: Turquoise is susceptible of a high polish, and when of a bright blue color i.

cassia.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of leguminous plants (herbs, shrubs, or trees) of many species, most of which have purgative qualities. The leaves of several species furnish the senna used in medicine. 2. The bark of several species of Cinnamommum grown in China, etc.; Chinese cinnamon. It is imported as cassia, bu.

whereof.definition: Of which; of whom; formerly, also, with which; -- used relatively. I do not find the certain numbers whereof their armies did consist. Sir J. Davies. Let it work like Borgias' wine, Whereof his sire, the pope, was poisoned. Marlowe. Edward's seven sons, whereof thyself art one. Shak. 2. Of what; --.

tun-bellied.definition: Having a large, protuberant belly, or one shaped like a tun; pot-bellied.

ignominiously.definition: In an ignominious manner; disgracefully; shamefully; ingloriously.

cream-fruit.definition: A plant of Sierra Leone which yields a wholesome, creamy juice.

metallicly.definition: In a metallic manner; by metallic means.

wheeze.definition:
To breathe hard, and with an audible piping or whistling sound, as persons affected with asthma. "Wheezing lungs." Shak.

1. A piping or whistling sound caused by difficult respiration. 2. (Phon.)  An ordinary whisper exaggerated so as to produce the hoarse sound known as the "stage whisper." It is.

stylohyal.definition: A segment in the hyoidean arch between the epihyal and tympanohyal.

interjectionally.definition: In an interjectional manner. G. Eliot.

kingfisher.definition: Any one of numerous species of birds constituting the family Alcedinidæ. Most of them feed upon fishes which they capture by diving and seizing then with the beak; others feed only upon reptiles, insects, etc. About one hundred and fifty species are known. They are found in nearly all parts of the w.

immediacy.definition: The relation of freedom from the interventionof a medium; immediateness. Shak.

intersternal.definition: Between the sternal; -- said of certain membranes or parts of insects and crustaceans.

cryptogamous.definition: Of or pertaining to the series Cryptogamia, or to plants of that series.

milligram.definition: A measure of weight, in the metric system, being the thousandth part of a gram, equal to the weight of a cubic millimeter of water, or .01543 of a grain avoirdupois.

subsensible.definition: Deeper than the reach of the senses. "That subsensible world." Tyndall.

epicoele.definition: A cavity formed by the invagination of the outer wall of the body, as the atrium of an amphioxus and possibly the body cavity of vertebrates.

hypural.definition: Under the tail; -- applied to the bones which support the caudal fin rays in most fishes.

elocation.definition: A removal from the usual place of residence. 2. Departure from the usual state; an ecstasy.

leucocythaemia.definition: A disease in which the white corpuscles of the blood are largely increased in number, and there is enlargement of the spleen, or the lymphatic glands; leuchæmia.

immaturity.definition: The state or quality of being immature or not fully developed; unripeness; incompleteness. When the world has outgrown its intellectual immaturity. Caird.

alectorides.definition: A group of birds including the common fowl and the pheasants.

chaus.definition: a lynxlike animal of Asia and Africa (Lynx Lybicus).

rhigolene.definition: A mixture of volatile hydrocarbons intermediate between gsolene and cymogene. It is obtained in the purification of crude petroleum, and is used as a refregerant.

ctenoidean.definition: Relating to the Ctenoidei. -- n.  One of the Ctenoidei.

iridosmine.definition: The native compound of iridium and osmium. It is found in flattened metallic grains of extreme hardness, and is often used for pointing gold pens.

opercle.definition: (Anat.)  Any one of the bony plates which support the gill covers of fishes; an opercular bone. 2. (Zoöl.)  An operculum.

gemul.definition: A small South American deer (Furcifer Chilensis), with simple forked horns. [Written also guemul.].

suffixion.definition: The act of suffixing, or the state of being suffixed.

coffeeroom.definition: A public room where coffee and other refreshments may be obtained.

enrange.definition: To range in order; to put in rank; to arrange. Spenser. 2. To rove over; to range. Spenser.

parrock.definition: A croft, or small field; a paddock.

rencounter.definition:
To meet unexpectedly; to encounter. 2. To attack hand to hand. Spenser.

To meet unexpectedly; to encounter in a hostile manner; to come in collision; to skirmish.

1. A meeting of two persons or bodies; a collision; especially, a meetingg in opposition or contest; a combat, action, or engagement. T.

devilism.definition: The state of the devil or of devils; doctrine of the devil or of devils. Bp. Hall.

nerka.definition: The most important salmon of Alaska (Oncorhinchus nerka), ascending in spring most rivers and lakes from Alaska to Oregon, Washington, and Idaho; --called also red salmon, redfish, blueback, and sawqui.

workable.definition: Capable of being worked, or worth working; as, a workable mine; workable clay.

polyphase.definition: Having or producing two or more phases; multiphase; as, a polyphase machine, a machine producing two or more pressure waves of electro-motive force, differing in phase; a polyphase current.

blirt.definition: A gust of wind and rain. Ham. Nav. Encyc.

candent.definition: Heated to whiteness; glowing with heat. "A candent vessel." Boyle.

crossjack.definition: The lowest square sail, or the lower yard of the mizzenmast.

leme.definition:
A ray or glimmer of light; a gleam. Chaucer.

To shine. Piers Plowman.

conditory.definition: A repository for holding things; a hinding place.

dankish.definition: Somewhat dank. -- Dank"ish*ness, n. In a dark and dankish vault at home. Shak.

gael.definition: A Celt or the Celts of the Scotch Highlands or of Ireland; now esp., a Scotch Highlander of Celtic origin.

monstrosity.definition: The state of being monstrous, or out of the common order of nature; that which is monstrous; a monster. South. A monstrosity never changes the name or affects the immutability of a species. Adanson (Trans. ).

frisette.definition: a fringe of hair or curls worn about the forehead by women.

lithophosphor.definition: A stone that becomes phosphoric by heat.

osteocolla.definition: A kind of glue obtained from bones. Ure. 2. A cellular calc tufa, which in some places forms incrustations on the stems of plants, -- formerly supposed to have the quality of uniting fractured bones.

exarticulation.definition: Luxation; the dislocation of a joint. Bailey.

uncouth.definition: Unknown. "This uncouth errand." Milton. To leave the good that I had in hand, In hope of better that was uncouth. Spenser. 2. Uncommon; rare; exquisite; elegant. Harness . . . so uncouth and so rish. Chaucer. 3. Unfamiliar; strange; hence, mysterious; dreadful; also, odd; awkward; boorish; as, uncou.

malacostracology.definition: That branch of zoölogical science which relates to the crustaceans; -- called also carcinology.

credulousness.definition: Readiness to believe on slight evidence; credulity. Beyond all credulity is the credulousness of atheists. S. Clarke.

decrown.definition: To deprive of a crown; to discrown. Hakewill.

unyoked.definition: Not yet yoked; not having worn the yoke. 2. Freed or loosed from a yoke. 3. Licentious; unrestrained. Shak.

unforgettable.definition: Not forgettable; enduring in memory. Pungent and unforgettable truths. Emerson.

pongee.definition: A fabric of undyed silk from India and China.

comatose.definition: Relating to, or resembling, coma; drowsy; lethargic; as, comatose sleep; comatose fever.

spindrift.definition: Same as Spoondrift. The ocean waves are broken up by wind, ultimately producing the storm wrack and spindrift of the tempest-tossed sea. J. E. Marr.

ventriculous.definition: Somewhat distended in the middle; ventricular.

vesuvine.definition: A trade name for a brown dyestuff obtained from certain basic azo compounds of benzene; -- called also Bismarck brown, Manchester brown, etc.

yumas.definition: A tribe of Indians native of Arizona and the adjacent parts of Mexico and California. They are agricultural, and cultivate corn, wheat, barley, melons, etc. Note: The a wider sense, the term sometimes includes the Mohaves and other allied tribes.

fretwork.definition: Work adorned with frets; ornamental openwork or work in relief, esp. when elaborate and minute in its parts. Heuce, any minute play of light andshade, dark and light, or the like. Banqueting on the turf in the fretwork of shade and sunshine. Macaulay.

podostomata.definition: An order of Bryozoa of which Rhabdopleura is the type. See Rhabdopleura.

birdbolt.definition: A short blunt arrow for killing birds without piercing them. Hence: Anything which smites without penetrating. Shak.

chatterer.definition: A prater; an idle talker. 2. (Zoöl.)  A bird of the family Ampelidæ -- so called from its monotonous note. The Bohemion chatterer (Ampelis garrulus) inhabits the arctic regions of both continents. In America the cedar bird is a more common species. See Bohemian chatterer, and Cedar bird.

scotticize.definition: To cause to become like the Scotch; to make Scottish.

conjunctively.definition: In conjunction or union; together. Sir T. Browne.

infeasible.definition: Not capable of being done or accomplished; impracticable. Glanvill.

ganesa.definition: The Hindoo god of wisdom or prudence. Note: He is represented as a short, fat, red-colored man, with a large belly and the head of an elephant. Balfour.

pratincole.definition: Any bird of the Old World genus Glareola, or family Glareolidæ, allied to the plovers. They have long, pointed wings and a forked tail.

molar.definition:
Of or pertaining to a mass of matter; -- said of the properties or motions of masses, as distinguished from those of molecules or atoms. Carpenter.

Having power to grind; grinding; as, the molar teeth; also, of or pertaining to the molar teeth. Bacon.

Any one of the teeth back of the incisors and.

cuculoid.definition: Like or belonging to the cuckoos (Cuculidæ).

antispasmodic.definition: Good against spasms. -- n.  A medicine which prevents or allays spasms or convulsions.

gonfalon.definition: The ensign or standard in use by certain princes or states, such as the mediæval republics of Italy, and in more recent times by the pope. 2. A name popularly given to any flag which hangs from a crosspiece or frame instead of from the staff or the mast itself. Standards and gonfalons, 'twixt van an.
