caroche.definition: A kind of pleasure carriage; a coach. To mount two-wheeled caroches. Butler.

crabby.definition: Crabbed; difficult, or perplexing. "Persius is crabby, because ancient." Marston.

birthnight.definition: The night in which a person is born; the anniversary of that night in succeeding years. The angelic song in Bethlehem field, On thy birthnight, that sung thee Savior born. Milton.

cementation.definition: The act or process of cementing. 2. (Chem.)  A process which consists in surrounding a solid body with the powder of other substances, and heating the whole to a degree not sufficient to cause fusion, the physical properties of the body being changed by chemical combination with powder; thus iron be.

coacervate.definition:
Raised into a pile; collected into a crowd; heaped. Bacon.

To heap up; to pile.

bloomy.definition: Full of bloom; flowery; flourishing with the vigor of youth; as, a bloomy spray. But all the bloomy flush of life is fled. Goldsmith. 2. Covered with bloom, as fruit. Dryden.

panicled.definition: Furnished with panicles; arranged in, or like, panicles; paniculate.

self-knowledge.definition: Knowledge of one's self, or of one's own character, powers, limitations, etc.

desiccate.definition:
To dry up; to deprive or exhaust of moisture; to preserve by drying; as, to desiccate fish or fruit. Bodies desiccated by heat or age. Bacon.

To become dry.

rink.definition: The smooth and level extent of ice marked off for the game of curling. 2. An artificial sheet of ice, generally under cover, used for skating; also, a floor prepared for skating on with roller skates, or a building with such a floor.

stilpnomelane.definition: A black or greenish black mineral occurring in foliated flates, also in velvety bronze-colored incrustations. It is a hydrous silicate of iron and alumina.

epicarp.definition: The external or outermost layer of a fructified or ripened ovary. See Illust. under Endocarp.

spectrally.definition: In the form or manner of a specter.

precative.definition: Suppliant; beseeching. Bp. Hopkins. Precatory words (Law), words of recommendation, request, entreaty, wish, or expectation, employed in wills, as distinguished from express directions; -- in some cases creating a trust. Jarman.

unawares.definition: , Without design or preparation; suddenly; without premeditation, unexpectedly. "Mercies lighting unawares." J. H. Newman. Lest unawares we lose This our high place, our sanctuary, our hill. Milton. At unaware, or At unawares, unexpectedly; by surprise. He breaks at unawares upon our walks. Dryden.

eugetic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, eugenol; as, eugetic acid.

dinosaur.definition: One of the Dinosauria. [Written also deinosaur, and deinosaurian.].

torpedo.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of numerous species of elasmobranch fishes belonging to Torpedo and allied genera. They are related to the rays, but have the power of giving electrical shocks. Called also crampfish, and numbfish. See Electrical fish, under Electrical. Note: The common European torpedo (T. vulgaris.

wretch.definition: A miserable person; one profoundly unhappy. "The wretch that lies in woe." Shak. Hovered thy spirit o'er thy sorrowing son, Wretch even then, life's journey just begun Cowper. 2. One sunk in vice or degradation; a base, despicable person; a vile knave; as, a profligate wretch. Note: Wretch is someti.

paedogenesis.definition: Reproduction by young or larval animals.

acidimeter.definition: An instrument for ascertaining the strength of acids. Ure.

peppergrass.definition: (a) Any herb of the cruciferous genus Lepidium, especially the garden peppergrass, or garden cress, Lepidium sativum; -- called also pepperwort. All the species have a pungent flavor. (b) The common pillwort of Europe (Pilularia globulifera). See Pillwort.

proportionable.definition: Capable of being proportioned, or made proportional; also, proportional; proportionate. -- Pro*por"tion*a*ble*ness, n. But eloquence may exist without a proportionable degree of wisdom. Burke. Proportionable, which is no longer much favored, was of our [i. e., English writers'] own coining. Fitzed.

dicastery.definition: A court of justice; judgment hall. J. S. Mill.

keratose.definition:
A tough, horny animal substance entering into the composition of the skeleton of sponges, and other invertebrates; -- called also keratode.

Containing hornlike fibers or fibers of keratose; belonging to the Keratosa.

rousing.definition: Having power to awaken or excite; exciting. I begin to feel Some rousing motions in me. Milton. 2. Very great; violent; astounding; as, a rousing fire; a rousing lie.

globule.definition: A little globe; a small particle of matter, of a spherical form. Globules of snow. Sir I. Newton. These minute globules [a mole's eyes] are sunk . . . deeply in the skull. Paley. 2. (Biol.)  A minute spherical or rounded structure; as blood, lymph, and pus corpuscles, minute fungi, spores, etc. 3. A.

pipewood.definition: An ericaceous shrub (Leucothoë acuminata) of the southern United States, from the wood of which pipe bowls are made.

vertebrated.definition: (Anat.)  Having a backbone, or vertebral column, containing the spinal marrow, as man, quadrupeds, birds, amphibia, and fishes. 2. (Bot.)  Contracted at intervals, so as to resemble the spine in animals. Henslow. 3. (Zoöl.)  Having movable joints resembling vertebræ; -- said of the arms ophiurans. 4.

wadset.definition: A kind of pledge or mortgage. [Written also wadsett.].

thyrohyal.definition: One of the lower segments in the hyoid arch, often consolidated with the body of the hyoid bone and forming one of its great horns, as in man.

aries.definition: (Astron.) (a) The Ram; the first of the twelve signs in the zodiac, which the sun enters at the vernal equinox, about the 21st of March. (b) A constellation west of Taurus, drawn on the celestial globe in the figure of a ram. 2. (Rom. Antiq.)  A battering-ram.

blinding.definition:
Making blind or as if blind; depriving of sight or of understanding; obscuring; as, blinding tears; blinding snow.

A thin coating of sand and fine gravel over a newly paved road. See Blind, v. t., 4.

interopercular.definition: Of or pertaining to the interoperculum. -- n.  The interopercular bone.

interfere.definition: To come in collision; to be in opposition; to clash; as, interfering claims, or commands. 2. To enter into, or take a part in, the concerns of others; to intermeddle; to interpose. To interfere with party disputes. Swift. There was no room for anyone to interfere with his own opinions. Bp. Warburton.

nosocomial.definition: Of or pertaining to a hospital; as, nosocomial atmosphere. Dunglison.

dichlamydeous.definition: Having two coverings, a calyx and in corolla.

reprisal.definition: The act of taking from an enemy by way of reteliation or indemnity. Debatable ground, on which incursions and reprisals continued to take place. Macaulay. 2. Anything taken from an enemy in retaliation. 3. The act of retorting on an enemy by inflicting suffering or death on a prisoner taken from him.

landlord.definition: The lord of a manor, or of land; the owner of land or houses which he leases to a tenant or tenants. 2. The master of an inn or of a lodging house. Upon our arrival at the inn, my companion fetched out the jolly landlord. Addison.

misrepeat.definition: To repeat wrongly; to give a wrong version of. Gov. Winthrop.

respirational.definition: Of or pertaining to respiration; as, respirational difficulties.

sequestral.definition: Of or pertaining to a sequestrum. Quian.

mosque.definition: A Mohammedan church or place of religious worship. [Written also mosk.].

yid.definition: A Jew. [Slang or Colloq.] "Almost any young Yid who goes out from among her people."  John Corbin.

guerdonable.definition: Worthy of reward. Sir G. Buck.

shode.definition:
The parting of the hair on the head. Full straight and even lay his jolly shode. Chaucer. 2. The top of the head; the head. Chaucer.

See Shoad, Shoading.

tellurite.definition: (Chem.)  A salt of tellurous acid. 2. (Min.)  Oxide of tellurium. It occurs sparingly in tufts of white or yellowish crystals.

tube-shell.definition: Any bivalve mollusk which secretes a shelly tube around its siphon, as the watering-shell.

resetter.definition:
One who receives or conceals, as stolen goods or criminal.

One who resets, or sets again.

plagiarist.definition: One who plagiarizes; or purloins the words, writings, or ideas of another, and passes them off as his own; a literary thief; a plagiary.

helleborin.definition: A poisonous glucoside found in several species of hellebore, and extracted as a white crystalline substance with a sharp tingling taste. It possesses the essential virtues of the plant; -- called also elleborin.

modulus.definition: A quantity or coefficient, or constant, which expresses the measure of some specified force, property, or quality, as of elasticity, strength, efficiency, etc.; a parameter. Modulus of a machine, a formula expressing the work which a given machine can perform under the conditions involved in its con.

wardian.definition: Designating, or pertaining to, a kind of glass inclosure for keeping ferns, mosses, etc., or for transporting growing plants from a distance; as, a Wardian case of plants; -- so named from the inventor, Nathaniel B. Ward, an Englishman.

puritan.definition: (Eccl. Hist.)  One who, in the time of Queen Elizabeth and the first two Stuarts, opposed traditional and formal usages, and advocated simpler forms of faith and worship than those established by law; -- originally, a term of reproach. The Puritans formed the bulk of the early population of New Engl.

snaphead.definition: A hemispherical or rounded head to a rivet or bolt; also, a swaging tool with a cavity in its face for forming such a rounded head.

cabinetwork.definition: The art or occupation of working upon wooden furniture requiring nice workmanship; also, such furniture.

libretto.definition: (a) A book containing the words of an opera or extended piece of music. (b) The words themselves.

polyatomic.definition: (a) Having more than one atom in the molecule; consisting of several atoms. (b) Having a valence greater than one.

unciform.definition:
Having the shape of a hook; being of a curved or hooked from; hooklike. Unciform bone (Anat.), a bone of the carpus at the bases of the fourth and fifth metacarpals; the hamatum.

The unciform bone. See Illust. of Perissodactyla.

garnet.definition: A mineral having many varieties differing in color and in their constituents, but with the same crystallization (isometric), and conforming to the same general chemical formula. The commonest color is red, the luster is vitreous, and the hardness greater than that of quartz. The dodecahedron and tra.

corked.definition: having acquired an unpleasant taste from the cork; as, a bottle of wine is corked.

ducat.definition: A coin, either of gold or silver, of several countries in Europe; originally, one struck in the dominions of a duke. Note: The gold ducat is generally of the value of nine shillings and four pence sterling, or somewhat more that two dollars. The silver ducat is of about half this value.

fielded.definition: Engaged in the field; encamped. To help fielded friends. Shak.

lawny.definition:
Having a lawn; characterized by a lawn or by lawns; like a lawn. Musing through the lawny park. T. Warton.

Made of lawn or fine linen. Bp. Hall.

hungrily.definition: In a hungry manner; voraciously. Dryden.

radium.definition: An intensely radioactive metallic element found (combined) in minute quantities in pitchblende, and various other uranium minerals. Symbol, Ra; atomic weight, 226.4. Radium was discovered by M. and Mme. Curie, of Paris, who in 1902 separated compounds of it by a tedious process from pitchblende. Its.

behindhand.definition: In arrears financially; in a state where expenditures have exceeded the receipt of funds. 2. In a state of backwardness, in respect to what is seasonable or appropriate, or as to what should have been accomplished; not equally forward with some other person or thing; dilatory; backward; late; tardy;.

lapps.definition: A branch of the Mongolian race, now living in the northern parts of Norway, Sweden, and the adjacent parts of Russia.

colitis.definition: An inflammation of the large intestine, esp. of its mucous membrane; colonitis.

incertum.definition: Doubtful; not of definite form. Opus incertum (Anc. Arch.), a kind of masonry employed in building walls, in which the stones were not squared nor laid in courses; rubblework.

extinguisher.definition: One who, or that which, extinguishes; esp., a hollow cone or other device for extinguishing a flame, as of a torch or candle.

trematoid.definition: f or pertaining to the Trematodea. See Illustration in Appendix.

mercurify.definition: To obtain mercury from, as mercuric minerals, which may be done by any application of intense heat that expels the mercury in fumes, which are afterward condensed. 2. To combine or mingle mercury with; to impregnate with mercury; to mercurialize.

cyme.definition: A flattish or convex flower cluster, of the centrifugal or determinate type, differing from a corymb chiefly in the order of the opening of the blossoms.

perennibranchiate.definition: (Anat.)  Having branchæ, or gills, through life; -- said especially of certain Amphibia, like the menobranchus. Opposed to caducibranchiate. 2. (Zoöl.)  Belonging to the Perennibranchiata.

debris.definition: (Geol.)  Broken and detached fragments, taken collectively; especially, fragments detached from a rock or mountain, and piled up at the base. 2. Rubbish, especially such as results from the destruction of anything; remains; ruins.

immolate.definition: To sacrifice; to offer in sacrifice; to kill, as a sacrificial victim. Worshipers, who not only immolate to them [the deities] the lives of men, but . . . the virtue and honor of women. Boyle.

predispose.definition: To dispose or incline beforehand; to give a predisposition or bias to; as, to predispose the mind to friendship. 2. To make fit or susceptible beforehand; to give a tendency to; as, debility predisposes the body to disease. Predisposing causes (Med.), causes which render the body liable to disease;.

cannula.definition: A small tube of metal, wood, or India rubber, used for various purposes, esp. for injecting or withdrawing fluids. It is usually associated with a trocar. [Written also canula.].

ennui.definition: A feeling of weariness and disgust; dullness and languor of spirits, arising from satiety or want of interest; tedium. T. Gray.

gnathidium.definition: The ramus of the lower jaw of a bird as far as it is naked; -- commonly used in the plural.

psychomachy.definition: A conflict of the soul with the body.

tipula.definition: Any one of many species of long-legged dipterous insects belonging to Tipula and allied genera. They have long and slender bodies. See Crane fly, under Crane.

consociation.definition: Intimate union; fellowship; alliance; companionship; confederation; association; intimacy. A friendly consociation with your kindred elements. Warburton. 2. A voluntary and permanent council or union of neighboring Congregational churches, for mutual advice and co Note: In Connecticut some of the Co.

loculose.definition: Divided by internal partitions into cells, as the pith of the pokeweed.

cramoisy.definition: Crimson. A splendid seignior, magnificent in cramoisy velevet. Motley.

sensible.definition: Capable of being perceived by the senses; apprehensible through the bodily organs; hence, also, perceptible to the mind; making an impression upon the sense, reason, or understanding; sensible resistance. Air is sensible to the touch by its motion. Arbuthnot. The disgrace was more sensible than the.

soutane.definition: A close garnment with straight sleeves, and skirts reaching to the ankles, and buttoned in front from top to bottom; especially, the black garment of this shape worn by the clergy in France and Italy as their daily dress; a cassock.

corrugant.definition: Having the power of contracting into wrinkles. Johnson.

pipra.definition: Any one of numerous species of small clamatorial birds belonging to Pipra and allied genera, of the family Pipridæ. The male is usually glossy black, varied with scarlet, yellow, or sky blue. They chiefly inhabit South America.

revocatory.definition: Of or pertaining to revocation; tending to, or involving, a revocation; revoking; recalling.

scath.definition: Harm; damage; injury; hurt; waste; misfortune. [Written also scathe.] But she was somedeal deaf, and that was skathe. Chaucer. Great mercy, sure, for to enlarge a thrall, Whose freedom shall thee turn to greatest scath. Spenser. Wherein Rome hath done you any scath, Let him make treble satisfaction.

stirrer.definition: One who, or that which, stirs something; also, one who moves about, especially after sleep; as, an early stirrer. Shak. Stirrer up, an instigator or inciter. Atterbury.

fustigation.definition: A punishment by beating with a stick or club; cudgeling. This satire, composed of actual fustigation. Motley.

iconomania.definition: A mania or infatuation for icons, whether as objects of devotion, bric-a-brac, or curios.

weatherly.definition: Working, or able to sail, close to the wind; as, a weatherly ship. Cooper.

tatt.definition: To make (anything) by tatting; to work at tatting; as, tatted edging.

norroy.definition: The most northern of the English Kings-at-arms. See King-at- arms, under King.

starchedness.definition: The quality or state of being starched; stiffness in manners; formality.

oozy.definition: Miry; containing soft mud; resembling ooze; as, the oozy bed of a river. Pope.

correctify.definition: To correct. When your worship's plassed to correctify a lady. Beau & Fl.

bockelet.definition: A kind of long-winged hawk; -- called also bockerel, and bockeret.

dint.definition: A blow; a stroke. "Mortal dint." Milton. "Like thunder's dint." Fairfax. 2. The mark left by a blow; an indentation or impression made by violence; a dent. Dryden. Every dint a sword had beaten in it [the shield]. Tennyson. 3. Force; power; -- esp. in the phrase by dint of. Now you weep; and, I perc.

wive.definition:
To marry, as a man; to take a wife. Wherefore we pray you hastily to wive. Chaucer.

1. To match to a wife; to provide with a wife. "An I could get me but a wife . . . I were manned, horsed, and wived." Shak. 2. To take for a wife; to marry. I have wived his sister. Sir W. Scott.

arthrogastra.definition: A division of the Arachnida, having the abdomen annulated, including the scorpions, harvestmen, etc.; pedipalpi.

insolvency.definition: (a) The condition of being insolvent; the state or condition of a person who is insolvent; the condition of one who is unable to pay his debts as they fall due, or in the usual course of trade and business; as, a merchant's insolvency. (b) Insufficiency to discharge all debts of the owner; as, the i.

passegarde.definition: A ridge or projecting edge on a shoulder piece to turn the blow of a lance or other weapon from the joint of the armor.

alchemize.definition: To change by alchemy; to transmute. Lovelace.

altarist.definition: (a) A chaplain. (b) A vicar of a church.

disqualification.definition: The act of disqualifying, or state of being disqualified; want of qualification; incompetency; disability; as, the disqualification of men for holding certain offices. 2. That which disqualifies; that which incapacitates or makes unfit; as, conviction of crime is a disqualification of a person for o.

abortionist.definition: One who procures abortion or miscarriage.

diskless.definition: Having no disk; appearing as a point and not expanded into a disk, as the image of a faint star in a telescope.

horseshoe.definition: A shoe for horses, consisting of a narrow plate of iron in form somewhat like the letter U, nailed to a horse's hoof. 2. Anything shaped like a horsehoe crab. 3. (Zoöl.)  The Limulus of horsehoe crab. Horsehoe head (Med.), an old name for the condition of the skull in children, in which the sutures.

seditious.definition: Of or pertaining to sedition; partaking of the nature of, or tending to excite, sedition; as, seditious behavior; seditious strife; seditious words. 2. Disposed to arouse, or take part in, violent opposition to lawful authority; turbulent; factious; guilty of sedition; as, seditious citizens. -- Se*.

fluework.definition: A general name for organ stops in which the sound is caused by wind passing through a flue or fissure and striking an edge above; -- in distinction from reedwork.

rhonchus.definition: An adventitious whistling or snoring sound heard on auscultation of the chest when the air channels are partially obstructed. By some writers the term rhonchus is used as equivalent to râle in its widest sense. See Râle.

theroid.definition: Resembling a beast in nature or habit; marked by animal characteristics; as, theroid idiocy.

unworship.definition:
To deprive of worship or due honor; to dishonor. Wyclif.

Lack of worship or respect; dishonor. Gower.

polygony.definition: Any plant of the genus Polygonum.

lingering.definition: Delaying. 2. Drawn out in time; remaining long; protracted; as, a lingering disease. To die is the fate of man; but to die with lingering anguish is generally his folly. Rambler.

peabird.definition: The wryneck; -- so called from its note.

entomoid.definition: Resembling an insect. -- n.  An object resembling an insect.

screak.definition:
To utter suddenly a sharp, shrill sound; to screech; to creak, as a door or wheel.

A creaking; a screech; a shriek. Bp. Bull.

dermatography.definition: An anatomical description of, or treatise on, the skin.

quintessence.definition: The fifth or last and highest essence or power in a natural body. See Ferment oils, under Ferment. Note: The ancient Greeks recognized four elements, fire, air, water, and earth. The Pythagoreans added a fifth and called it nether, the fifth essence, which they said flew upward at creation and out o.

supersubstantial.definition: More than substantial; spiritual. "The heavenly supersubstantial bread." Jer. Taylor.

hexdecyl.definition: The essential radical, C16H33, of hecdecane.

red-short.definition: Hot-short; brittle when red-hot; -- said of certain kinds of iron. -- Red"-short`ness, n.

angora.definition: A city of Asia Minor (or Anatolia) which has given its name to a goat, a cat, etc. Angora cat (Zoöl.), a variety of the domestic cat with very long and silky hair, generally of the brownish white color. Called also Angola cat. See Cat. -- Angora goat (Zoöl.), a variety of the domestic goat, reared f.

tannage.definition: A tanning; the act, operation, or result of tanning. They should have got his cheek fresh tannage. R. Browning.

reannex.definition: To annex again or anew; to reunite. "To reannex that duchy." Bacon.

creed.definition: A definite summary of what is believed; esp., a summary of the articles of Christian faith; a confession of faith for public use; esp., one which is brief and comprehensive. In the Protestant system the creed is not coördinate with, but always subordinate to, the Bible. Schaff-Herzog Encyc. 2. Any s.

expediently.definition: In an expedient manner; fitly; suitably; conveniently. 2. With expedition; quickly.

securipalp.definition: One of a family of beetles having the maxillary palpi terminating in a hatchet-shaped joint.

basidiospore.definition: A spore borne by a basidium. -- Ba*sid`i*o*spor"ous (, a.

neckcloth.definition: A piece of any fabric worn around the neck.

zoanthacea.definition: A suborder of Actinaria, including Zoanthus and allied genera, which are permanently attached by their bases.

hawked.definition: Curved like a hawk's bill; crooked.

uvular.definition: Of or pertaining to a uvula.

zend-avesta.definition: The sacred writings of the ancient Persian religion, attributed to Zoroaster, but chiefly of a later date.

aldermanlike.definition: Like or suited to an alderman.

diffame.definition: Evil name; bad reputation; defamation. Chaucer.

hypospadias.definition: A deformity of the penis, in which the urethra opens upon its under surface.

carnalize.definition: To make carnal; to debase to carnality. A sensual and carnalized spirit. John Scott.

impatronize.definition: To make lord or master; as, to impatronize one's self of a seigniory. Bacon.

septifragal.definition: Breaking from the partitions; -- said of a method of dehiscence in which the valves of a pod break away from the partitions, and these remain attached to the common axis.

veritas.definition: The Bureau Veritas. See under Bureau.

hooper.definition:
One who hoops casks or tubs; a cooper.

The European whistling, or wild, swan (Olor cygnus); -- called also hooper swan, whooping swan, and elk.

pulpy.definition: Like pulp; consisting of pulp; soft; fleshy; succulent; as, the pulpy covering of a nut; the pulpy substance of a peach or a cherry.

charqui.definition: Jerked beef; beef cut into long strips and dried in the wind and sun. Darwin.

tergite.definition: The dorsal portion of an arthromere or somite of an articulate animal. See Illust. under Coleoptera.

hamesecken.definition: The felonious seeking and invasion of a person in his dwelling house. Bouvier.

sabre.definition:
A sword with a broad and heavy blade, thick at the back, and usually more or less curved like a scimiter; a cavalry sword. Saber fish, or Sabre fish (Zoöl.), the cutlass fish.

To strike, cut, or kill with a saber; to cut down, as with a saber. You send troops to saber and bayonet us into submission.

beeswax.definition: The wax secreted by bees, and of which their cells are constructed.

festivous.definition: Pertaining to a feast; festive. Sir W. Scott.

durion.definition: The fruit of the durio. It is oval or globular, and eight or ten inches long. It has a hard prickly rind, containing a soft, cream-colored pulp, of a most delicious flavor and a very offensive odor. The seeds are roasted and eaten like chestnuts.

administrant.definition: Executive; acting; managing affairs. -- n.  One who administers.

shattery.definition: Easily breaking into pieces; not compact; loose of texture; brittle; as, shattery spar.

endecane.definition: One of the higher hydrocarbons of the paraffin series, C11H24, found as a constituent of petroleum. [Written also hendecane.].

jointing.definition: The act or process of making a joint; also, the joints thus produced. Jointing machine, a planing machine for wood used in furniture and piano factories, etc. -- Jointing plane. See Jointer, 2. -- Jointing rule (Masonry), a long straight rule, used by bricklayers for securing straight joints and fac.

wise-hearted.definition: Wise; knowing; skillful; sapient; erudite; prudent. Ex. xxviii. 3.

disintegrable.definition: Capable of being disintegrated, or reduced to fragments or powder. Argillo-calcite is readily disintegrable by exposure. Kirwan.

kerf.definition: A notch, channel, or slit made in any material by cutting or sawing.

tympanitis.definition: Inflammation of the lining membrane of the middle ear.

phlebolite.definition: A small calcareous concretion formed in a vein; a vein stone.

gasiform.definition: Having a form of gas; gaseous.

youngger.definition: One who is younger; an inferior in age; a junior. "The elder shall serve the younger." Rom. ix. 12.

breeches.definition: A garment worn by men, covering the hips and thighs; smallclothes. His jacket was red, and his breeches were blue. Coleridge. 2. Trousers; pantaloons. Breeches buoy, in the life-saving service, a pair of canvas breeches depending from an annular or beltlike life buoy which is usually of cork. This c.

magdeburg.definition: A city of Saxony. Magdeburg centuries, Magdeburg hemispheres. See under Century, and Hemisphere.

septicidal.definition: Dividing the partitions; -- said of a method of dehiscence in which a pod splits through the partitions and is divided into its component carpels.

glassite.definition: A member of a Scottish sect, founded in the 18th century by John Glass, a minister of the Established Church of Scotland, who taught that justifying faith is "no more than a simple assent to the divine testimone passively recived by the understanding." The English and American adherents of this fait.

persiennes.definition: Window blinds having movable slats, similar to Venetian blinds.

unkempt.definition: Not combed; disheveled; as, an urchin with unkempt hair. 2. Fig.; Not smoothed; unpolished; rough. My rhymes be rugged and unkempt. Spenser.

ruche.definition: A plaited, quilled, or goffered strip of lace, net, ribbon, or other material, -- used in place of collars or cuffs, and as a trimming for women's dresses and bonnets. [Written also rouche.] 2. A pile of arched tiles, used to catch and retain oyster spawn.

lace-winged.definition: Having thin, transparent, reticulated wings; as, the lace- winged flies.

urocerata.definition: A division of boring Hymenoptera, including Tremex and allied genera. See Illust. of Horntail.

exornation.definition: Ornament; decoration; embellishment. Hyperbolical exornations . . . many much affect. Burton.

cornigerous.definition: Horned; having horns; as, cornigerous animals. Sir T. Browne.

fag.definition:
A knot or coarse part in cloth.

fuming.definition: Producing fumes, or vapors. Cadet's fuming liquid (Chem.), alkarsin. -- Fuming liquor of Libsvius (Old Chem.), stannic chloride; the chloride of tin, SnCl4, forming a colorless, mobile liquid which fumes in the air. Mixed with water it solidifies to the so-called butter of tin. -- Fuming sulphuric a.

popple.definition:
To move quickly up and down; to bob up and down, as a cork on rough water; also, to bubble. Cotton.

1. The poplar. [Prov. Eng. & Local, U. S.] 2. Tares. "To sow popple among wheat." Bale.

lodgment.definition: The act of lodging, or the state of being lodged. Any particle which is of size enough to make a lodgment afterwards in the small arteries. Paley. 2. A lodging place; a room. 3. An accumulation or collection of something deposited in a place or remaining at rest. 4. (Mil.)  The occupation and holdin.

money-maker.definition: One who coins or prints money; also, a counterfeiter of money. 2. One who accumulates money or wealth; specifically, one who makes money-getting his governing motive.

pectose.definition: An amorphous carbohydrate found in the vegetable kingdom, esp. in unripe fruits. It is associated with cellulose, and is converted into substances of the pectin group.

replete.definition:
Filled again; completely filled; full; charged; abounding. "His words replete with guile." Milton. When he of wine was replet at his feast. Chaucer. In heads repiete with thoughts of other men. Cowper.

To fill completely, or to satiety.

sthenic.definition: Strong; active; -- said especially of morbid states attended with excessive action of the heart and blood vessels, and characterized by strength and activity of the muscular and nervous system; as, a sthenic fever. Sthenic theory. See Stimulism (a).

triblet.definition: A goldsmith's tool used in making rings. Ainsworth. 2. A steel cylinder round which metal is drawn in the process of forming tubes. Tomlinson. 3. (Blacksmithing)  A tapering mandrel.

diuretic.definition: Tending to increase the secretion and discharge of urine. -- n.  A medicine with diuretic properties. Diuretic salt (Med.), potassium acetate; -- so called because of its diuretic properties.

nettles.definition: (a) The halves of yarns in the unlaid end of a rope twisted for pointing or grafting. (b) Small lines used to sling hammocks under the deck beams. (c) Reef points.

respectless.definition: Having no respect; without regard; regardless. Rather than again Endure, respectless, their so moving cChapman. -- Re*spect"less*ness, n. Shelton.

disfranchise.definition: To deprive of a franchise or chartered right; to dispossess of the rights of a citizen, or of a particular privilege, as of voting, holding office, etc. Sir William Fitzwilliam was disfranchised. Fabyan (1509). He was partially disfranchised so as to be made incapable of taking part in public affair.

decatoic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, decane.

maleyl.definition: A hypothetical radical derived from maleic acid.

crowner.definition: One who, or that which, crowns. Beau. & FL. 2. Etym: [Cf. Coroner.]  A coroner. [Prov. Eng. or Scot.].

metavanadic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, a vanadic acid analogous to metaphosphoric acid.

herringbone.definition: Pertaining to, or like, the spine of a herring; especially, characterized by an arrangement of work in rows of parallel lines, which in the alternate rows slope in different directions. Herringbone stitch, a kind of cross-stitch in needlework, chiefly used in flannel. Simmonds.

inoxidizable.definition: Incapable of being oxidized; as, gold and platinum are inoxidizable in the air.

trochilus.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) A genus of humming birds. It Formerly included all the known species. (b) Any one of several species of wrens and kinglets. (c) The crocodile bird. 2. (Arch.)  An annular molding whose section is concave, like the edge of a pulley; -- called also scotia.

deputable.definition: Fit to be deputed; suitable to act as a deputy. Carlyle.

croquante.definition: A brittle cake or other crisp pastry.

zealous.definition: Filled with, or characterized by, zeal; warmly engaged, or ardent, in behalf of an object. He may be zealous in the salvation of souls. Law. 2. Filled with religious zeal. Shak. -- Zeal"ous*ly, adv. -- Zeal"ous*ness, n.

vaulting.definition: The act of constructing vaults; a vaulted construction. 2. Act of one who vaults or leaps.

solidly.definition: In a solid manner; densely; compactly; firmly; truly.

unhele.definition:
Same as Unheal, n.

To uncover. Spenser. Marston.

accentuate.definition: To pronounce with an accent or with accents. 2. To bring out distinctly; to make prominent; to emphasize. In Bosnia, the struggle between East and West was even more accentuated. London Times. 3. To mark with the written accent.

impregnable.definition:
Not to be stormed, or taken by assault; incapable of being subdued; able to resist attack; unconquerable; as, an impregnable fortress; impregnable virtue. The man's affection remains wholly unconcerned and impregnable. South. -- Im*preg"na*ble*ness, n. -- Im*preg"na*bly, adv.

Capable of being impre.

battalia.definition: Order of battle; disposition or arrangement of troops (brigades, regiments, battalions, etc.), or of a naval force, for action. A drawing up the armies in battalia. Jer. Taylor. 2. An army in battle array; also, the main battalia or body. Shak.

exceptor.definition: One who takes exceptions. T. Burnet.

inimicality.definition: The state or quality of being inimical or hostile; hostility; unfriendliness.

waldgrave.definition: In the old German empire, the head forest keeper.

groschen.definition: A small silver coin and money of account of Germany, worth about two cents. It is not included in the new monetary system of the empire.

swedenborgian.definition: One who holds the doctrines of the New Jerusalem church, as taught by Emanuel Swedenborg, a Swedish philosopher and religious writer, who was born a. d. 1688 and died 1772. Swedenborg claimed to have intercourse with the spiritual world, through the opening of his spiritual senses in 1745. He taught.

rhodian.definition: Of or pertaining to Rhodes, an island of the Mediterranean. -- n.  A native or inhabitant of Rhodes.

jongler.definition: In the Middle Ages, a court attendant or other person who, for hire, recited or sang verses, usually of his own composition. See Troubadour. Vivacity and picturesquenees of the jongleur's verse. J R. Green. 2. A juggler; a conjuror. See Juggler. Milton.

johannes.definition: A Portuguese gold coin of the value of eight dollars, named from the figure of King John which it bears;- often contracted into joe; as, a joe, or a half joe.

prescriptible.definition: Depending on, or derived from, prescription; proper to be prescribed. Grafton.

abdicate.definition: To surrender or relinquish, as sovereign power; to withdraw definitely from filling or exercising, as a high office, station, dignity; as, to abdicate the throne, the crown, the papacy. Note: The word abdicate was held to mean, in the case of James II., to abandon without a formal surrender. The cro.

salvific.definition: Tending to save or secure safety.

looping.definition:
The running together of the matter of an ore into a mass, when the ore is only heated for calcination.

wayfarer.definition: One who travels; a traveler; a passenger.

punt-out.definition: A punt made from the goal line by a player of the side which has made a touchdown to one of his own side for a fair catch, from which an attempt to kick a goal may be made.

startlish.definition: Easily startled; apt to start; startish; skittish; -- said especially of a hourse.

discernible.definition: Capable of being discerned by the eye or the understanding; as, a star is discernible by the eye; the identity of difference of ideas is discernible by the understanding. The effect of the privations and sufferings . . . was discernible to the last in his temper and deportment. Macaulay. Syn. -- Per.

hausen.definition: A large sturgeon (Acipenser huso) from the region of the Black Sea. It is sometimes twelve feet long.

natch.definition: The rump of beef; esp., the lower and back part of the rump. Natch bone, the edgebone, or aitchbone, in beef.

shoring.definition: The act of supporting or strengthening with a prop or shore. 2. A system of props; props, collectively.

accite.definition: To cite; to summon. Our heralds now accited all that were Endamaged by the Elians. Chapman.

steadfastness.definition: The quality or state of being steadfast; firmness; fixedness; constancy. "The steadfastness of your faith." Col. ii. 5. To prove her wifehood and her steadfastness. Chaucer.

implicitness.definition: State or quality of being implicit.

aeroclub.definition: A club or association of persons interested in aëronautics.

chondritic.definition: Granular; pertaining to, or having the granular structure characteristic of, the class of meteorites called chondrites.

rufous.definition: Reddish; of a yellowish red or brownish red color; tawny.

politically.definition: In a political manner. 2. Politicly; artfully. Knolles.

moanful.definition: Full of moaning; expressing sorrow. -- Moan"ful*ly, adv.

resolvedness.definition: Fixedness of purpose; firmness; resolution. Dr. H. More.

entocuniform.definition: One of the bones of the tarsus. See Cuneiform.

ywar.definition: Aware; wary. "Be ywar, and his way shun." Piers Plowman.

assyriologist.definition: One versed in Assyriology; a student of Assyrian archæology.

subinduce.definition: To insinuate; to offer indirectly. Sir E. Dering.

persistency.definition: The quality or state of being persistent; staying or continuing quality; hence, in an unfavorable sense, doggedness; obstinacy. 2. phytolithologist.definition: One versed in phytolithology; a paleobotanist.

maistry.definition: Mastery; superiority; art. See Mastery. Chaucer.

coachdog.definition: One of a breed of dogs trained to accompany carriages; the Dalmatian dog.

disembowel.definition: To take or let out the bowels or interior parts of; to eviscerate. Soon after their death, they are disemboweled. Cook. Roaring floods and cataracts that sweep From disemboweled earth the virgin gold. Thomson. 2. To take or draw from the body, as the web of a spider. "Her disemboweled web." J. Phili.

lima.definition: The capital city of Peru, in South America. Lima bean. (Bot.) (a) A variety of climbing or pole bean (Phaseolus lunatus), which has very large flattish seeds. (b) The seed of this plant, much used for food. -- Lima wood (Bot.), the beautiful dark wood of the South American tree Cæsalpinia echinata.

serranoid.definition: Any fish of the family Serranidæ, which includes the striped bass, the black sea bass, and many other food fishes. -- a. (Zoöl.)  Of or pertaining to the Serranidæ.

slake.definition:
To allay; to quench; to extinguish; as, to slake thirst. "And slake the heavenly fire." Spenser. It could not slake mine ire nor ease my heart. Shak. 2. To mix with water, so that a true chemical combination shall take place; to slack; as, to slake lime.

1. To go out; to become extinct. "His flame.

parergy.definition: Something unimportant, incidental, or superfluous. Sir T. Browne.

zoochlorella.definition: One of the small green granulelike bodies found in the interior of certain stentors, hydras, and other invertebrates.

lodemanage.definition:
Pilotage; skill of a pilot or loadsman. Chaucer.

Pilotage.

hot-brained.definition: Ardent in temper; violent; rash; impetuous; as, hot-brained youth. Dryden.

underpeep.definition: To peep under. "The flame . . . would underpeep her lids." Shak.

gavage.definition: Forced feeding (as of poultry or infants) by means of a tube passed through the mouth down to the stomach.

propagative.definition: Producing by propagation, or by a process of growth.

epipodial.definition: (Anat.)  Pertaining to the epipodialia or the parts of the limbs to which they belong. 2. (Zoöl.)  Pertaining to the epipodium of Mollusca.

successively.definition: In a successive manner. The whiteness, at length, changed successively into blue, indigo, and violet. Sir I. Newton.

interlining.definition: Correction or alteration by writing between the lines; interlineation. Bp. Burnet.

rangle.definition: To range about in an irregular manner. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Halliwell.

legibility.definition: The quality of being legible; legibleness. Sir. D. Brewster.

footfall.definition: A setting down of the foot; a footstep; the sound of a footstep. Shak. Seraphim, whose footfalls tinkled on the tufted floor. Poe.

gambist.definition: A performer upon the viola di gamba. See under Viola.

incarnate.definition:
Not in the flesh; spiritual. I fear nothing . . . that devil carnate or incarnate can fairly do. Richardson.

1. Invested with flesh; embodied in a human nature and form; united with, or having, a human body. Here shalt thou sit incarnate. Milton. He represents the emperor and his wife as two devils.

becurl.definition: To curl; to adorn with curls.

farmstead.definition: A farm with the building upon it; a homestead on a farm. Tennyson. With its pleasant groves and farmsteads. Carlyle.

endolymphatic.definition: (a) Pertaining to, or containing, endolymph; as, the endolymphatic duct. (b) Within a lymphatic vessel; endolymphangial.

exhibitioner.definition: One who has a pension or allowance granted for support. A youth who had as an exhibitioner from Christ's Hospital. G. Eliot.

atellan.definition: Of or pertaining to Atella, in ancient Italy; as, Atellan plays; farcical; ribald. -- n.  A farcical drama performed at Atella.

sarsaparilla.definition: (a) Any plant of several tropical American species of Smilax. castlebuilder.definition: Fig.: one who builds castles in the air or forms visionary schemes. -- Cas"tle*build`ing, n.

covenant.definition: A mutual agreement of two or more persons or parties, or one of the stipulations in such an agreement. Then Jonathan and David made a covenant. 1 Sam. xviiii. 3. menagerie.definition: A piace where animals are kept and trained. 2. A collection of wild or exotic animals, kept for exhibition.

tarsal.definition:
Of or pertaining to the tarsus (either of the foot or eye). -- n.  A tarsal bone or cartilage; a tarsale. Tarsal tetter (Med.), an eruptive disease of the edges of the eyelids; a kind of bleareye.

Same as Tercel.

uchees.definition: A tribe of North American Indians belonging to the Creek confederation.

erne.definition: A sea eagle, esp. the European white-tailed sea eagle (Haliæetus albicilla).

zulus.definition: The most important tribe belonging to the Kaffir race. They inhabit a region on the southeast coast of Africa, but formerly occupied a much more extensive country. They are noted for their warlike disposition, courage, and military skill.

dervish.definition: A Turkish or Persian monk, especially one who professes extreme poverty and leads an austere life.

half-ray.definition: A straight line considered as drawn from a center to an indefinite distance in one direction, the complete ray being the whole line drawn to an indefinite distance in both directions.

osculatrix.definition: A curve whose contact with a given curve, at a given point, is of a higher order (or involves the equality of a greater number of successive differential coefficients of the ordinates of the curves taken at that point) than that of any other curve of the same kind.

quorum.definition: Such a number of the officers or members of any body as is competent by law or constitution to transact business; as, a quorum of the House of Representatives; a constitutional quorum was not present. Note: The term arose from the Latin words, Quorum aliquem vestrum . . . unum esse volumus (of whom.

confidant.definition: One to whom secrets, especially those relating to affairs of love, are confided or intrusted; a confidential or bosom friend. You love me for no other end Than to become my confidant and friend; As such I keep no secret from your sight. Dryden.

sinful.definition: Tainted with, or full of, sin; wicked; iniquitous; criminal; unholy; as, sinful men; sinful thoughts. Piers Plowman. Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity. Isa. i. 4. -- Sin"ful*ly, adv. -- Sin"ful*ness, n.

columnar.definition: Formed in columns; having the form of a column or columns; like the shaft of a column. crispin.definition: A shoemaker; -- jocularly so called from the patron sant of the craft. 2. A member of a union or association of shoemakers.

witch-hazel.definition: The wych-elm. (b) An American shrub or small tree (Hamamelis Virginica), which blossoms late in autumn.

anarchist.definition: An anarch; one who advocates anarchy of aims at the overthrow of civil government.

galliwasp.definition: A West Indian lizard (Celestus occiduus), about a foot long, imagined by the natives to be venomous.

synecdochical.definition: Expressed by synecdoche; implying a synecdoche. Isis is used for Themesis by a synecdochical kind of speech, or by a poetical liberty, in using one for another. Drayton.

pullback.definition: That which holds back, or causes to recede; a drawback; a hindrance. 2. (Arch)  The iron hook fixed to a casement to pull it shut, or to hold it party open at a fixed point.

alkalamide.definition: One of a series of compounds that may be regarded as ammonia in which a part of the hydrogen has been replaced by basic, and another part by acid, atoms or radicals.

devotionalist.definition: One given to devotion, esp. to excessive formal devotion.

bootikin.definition: A little boot, legging, or gaiter. 2. A covering for the foot or hand, worn as a cure for the gout. H. Walpole.

jungermannia.definition: A genus of hepatic mosses, now much circumscribed, but formerly comprising most plants of the order, which is sometimes therefore called Jungermanniaceæ.

digitize.definition: To finger; as, to digitize a pen. Sir T. Browne. computers to convert (information, a signal, an image) into a form expressible in binary notation.

kicksy-wicksy.definition:
That which is restless and uneasy. Note: Kicky-wicky, or, in some editions, Kicksy-wicksy, is applied contemptuously to a wife by Shakespeare, in "All's Well that Ends Well," ii. 3, 297.

Fantastic; restless; as, kicksy-wicksy flames. Nares.

basswood.definition: The bass (Tilia) or its wood; especially, T. Americana. See Bass, the lime tree. All the bowls were made of basswood, White and polished very smoothly. Longfellow.

syllabicate.definition: To form or divide into syllables; to syllabify.

mormondom.definition: The country inhabited by the Mormons; the Mormon people.

amphigory.definition: A nonsense verse; a rigmarole, with apparent meaning, which on further attention proves to be meaningless. [Written also amphigouri.].

elasmobranchiate.definition: Of or pertaining to Elasmobranchii. -- n.  One of the Elasmobranchii.

latently.definition: In a secret or concealed manner; invisibly.

interplay.definition: Mutual action or influence; interaction; as, the interplay of affection.

basipodite.definition: The basal joint of the legs of Crustacea.

kier.definition: A large tub or vat in which goods are subjected to the action of hot lye or bleaching liquor; -- also called keeve.

perioeci.definition: Those who live on the same parallel of latitude but on opposite meridians, so that it is noon in one place when it is midnight in the other. Compare Antoeci.

phonoscope.definition: (a) An instrument for observing or exhibiting the motions or properties of sounding bodies; especially, an apparatus invented by König for testing the quality of musical strings. (b) An instrument for producing luminous figures by the vibrations of sounding bodies.

rabbinist.definition: One among the Jews who adhered to the Talmud and the traditions of the rabbins, in opposition to the Karaites, who rejected the traditions.

magnifiable.definition: Such as can be magnified, or extolled.

dolomize.definition: To convert into dolomite. -- Dol`o*mi*za"tion, n.

pentachord.definition: An ancient instrument of music with five strings. 2. An order or system of five sounds. Busby.

mariner.definition: One whose occupation is to assist in navigating ships; a seaman or sailor. Chaucer. Mariner's compass. See under Compass.

To plunge, or duck into water; to immerse; to douse. 2. Etym: [Cf. OD. doesen to strike, Norw. dusa to break.]  To beat or thrash. Halliwell.

To use the dipping or divining rod, as in search of water, ore, etc. Adams had the reputation of having dowsed successfully for more than a hundred wells. En.

sensori-volitional.definition: Concerned both in sensation and volition; -- applied to those nerve fibers which pass to and from the cerebro-spinal axis, and are respectively concerned in sensation and volition. Dunglison.

ratoon.definition:
Same as Rattoon, n. 2. A rattan cane. Pepys.

Same as Rattoon, v. i.

fling.definition: To cast, send, to throw from the hand; to hurl; to dart; to emit with violence as if thrown from the hand; as, to fing a stone into the pond. 'T is Fate that flings the dice: and, as she flings, Of kings makes peasants, and of peasants kings. Dryden. He . . . like Jove, his lighting flung. Dryden. I.

tumored.definition: Distended; swelled. "His tumored breast." R. Junius.

detached.definition: Separate; unconnected, or imperfectly connected; as, detached parcels. "Extensive and detached empire." Burke. Detached escapement. See Escapement.

acrisia.definition: Inability to judge. 2. (Med.)  Undecided character of a disease.

biodynamical.definition: Of or pertaining to biodynamics, or the doctrine of vital forces or energy.

movent.definition:
Moving. Grew.

That which moves anything.

cursorily.definition: In a running or hasty manner; carelessly.

formulary.definition:
Stated; prescribed; ritual.

1. A book containing stated and prescribed forms, as of oaths, declarations, prayers, medical formulaæ, etc.; a book of precedents. 2. Prescribed form or model; formula.

archchamberlain.definition: A chief chamberlain; -- an officer of the old German empire, whose office was similar to that of the great chamberlain in England.

fringilline.definition: Pertaining to the family Fringillidæ; characteristic of finches; sparrowlike.

incursion.definition: A running into; hence, an entering into a territory with hostile intention; a temporary invasion; a predatory or harassing inroad; a raid. The Scythian, whose incursions wild Have wasted Sogdiana. Milton. The incursions of the Goths disordered the affairs of the Roman Empire. Arbuthnot. 2. Attack; o.

siderographical.definition: Of or pertaining to siderography; executed by engraved plates of steel; as, siderographic art; siderographic impressions.

poor-john.definition: A small European fish, similar to the cod, but of inferior quality. Poor-john and apple pies are all our fare. Sir J. Harrington.

cassinette.definition: A cloth with a cotton wart, and a woof of very fine wool, or wool and silk.

giggyng.definition: The act of fastending the gige or leather strap to the shield. "Gigging of shields." Chaucer.

astrometry.definition: The art of making measurements among the stars, or of determining their relative magnitudes.

franklinic.definition: Of or pertaining to Benjamin Franklin. Franklinic electricity, electricity produced by friction; called also statical electricity.

quits.definition: See the Note under Quit, a.

almain.definition: A German. Also adj.,  German. Shak. 2. The German language. J. Foxe. 3. A kind of dance. See Allemande. Almain rivets, Almayne rivets, or Alman rivets, a sort of light armor from Germany, characterized by overlapping plates, arranged to slide on rivets, and thus afford great flexibility.

janus-faced.definition: Double-faced; deceitful. Janus-faced lock, one having duplicate faces so as to go upon a right or a left hand door, the key entering on either side indifferently. Knight.

orbulina.definition: A genus of minute living Foraminifera having a globular shell.

carthaginian.definition: Of a pertaining to ancient Carthage, a city of northern Africa. -- n.  A native or inhabitant of Carthage.

dent.definition:
A stroke; a blow. "That dent of thunder." Chaucer. 2. A slight depression, or small notch or hollow, made by a blow or by pressure; an indentation. A blow that would have made a dent in a pound of butter. De Quincey.

To make a dent upon; to indent. The houses dented with bullets. Macaulay.

A tooth.

sealer.definition:
One who seals; especially, an officer whose duty it is to seal writs or instruments, to stamp weights and measures, or the like.

A mariner or a vessel engaged in the business of capturing seals.

huckster.definition:
A retailer of small articles, of provisions, and the like; a peddler; a hawker. Swift. 2. A mean, trickish fellow. Bp. Hall.

To deal in small articles, or in petty bargains. Swift.

zarthe.definition: A European bream (Abramis vimba). [Written also zaerthe.].

eldership.definition: The state of being older; seniority. "Paternity an eldership." Sir W. Raleigh. 2. Office of an elder; collectively, a body of elders.

pittance.definition: An allowance of food bestowed in charity; a mess of victuals; hence, a small charity gift; a dole. "A good pitaunce." Chaucer. One half only of this pittance was ever given him in money. Macaulay. 2. A meager portion, quality, or allowance; an inconsiderable salary or compensation. "The small pittan.

uplandish.definition: Of or pertaining to uplands; dwelling on high lands. Chapman. 2. Rude; rustic; unpolished; uncivilized. His presence made the rudest peasant melt, That in the wild, uplandish country dwelt. Marlowe.

actinometer.definition: (a) An instrument for measuring the direct heating power of the sun's rays. (b) An instrument for measuring the actinic effect of rays of light.

parapeptone.definition: An albuminous body formed in small quantity by the peptic digestion of proteids. It can be converted into peptone by pancreatic juice, but not by gastric juice.

insufficient.definition: Not sufficient; not enough; inadequate to any need, use, or purpose; as, the provisions are insufficient in quantity, and defective in quality. "Insufficient for His praise." Cowper. 2. Wanting in strength, power, ability, capacity, or skill; incompetent; incapable; unfit; as, a person insufficient.

horsefly.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any dipterous fly of the family Tabanidæ, that stings horses, and sucks their blood. Note: Of these flies there are numerous species, both in Europe and America. They have a large proboscis with four sharp lancets for piercing the skin. Called also breeze fly. See Illust. under Diptera, and.

intercostal.definition: Between the ribs; pertaining to, or produced by, the parts between the ribs; as, intercostal respiration, in which the chest is alternately enlarged and contracted by the intercostal muscles.

abbreviatory.definition: Serving or tending to abbreviate; shortening; abridging.

reprehension.definition: Reproof; censure; blame; disapproval. This Basilius took as though his mistress had given him a secret reprehension that he had not showed more gratefulness to Dorus. Sir P. Sidney. Syn. -- Censure; reproof; reprimand. See Admonition.

monism.definition: (Metaph.)  That doctrine which refers all phenomena to a single ultimate constituent or agent; -- the opposite of dualism. Note: The doctrine has been held in three generic forms: matter and its phenomena have been explained as a modification of mind, involving an idealistic monism; or mind has been.

rethor.definition: A rhetorician; a careful writer. If a rethor couthe fair endite. Chaucer.

redisburse.definition: To disburse anew; to give, or pay, back. Spenser.

branchiogastropoda.definition: Those Gastropoda that breathe by branchiæ, including the Prosobranchiata and Opisthobranchiata.

umbratious.definition: Suspicious; captious; disposed to take umbrage. [Obs. & R.] Sir H. Wotton.

incense-breathing.definition: Breathing or exhaling incense. "Incense-breathing morn." Gray.

quadrigeminal.definition: Fourfold; having four similar parts, or two pairs of similar parts. Quadrigeminal bodies (Anat.), two pairs of lobes, or elevations, on the dorsal side of the midbrain of most mammals; the optic lobes. The anterior pair are called the nates, and the posterior the testes.

embattled.definition: Having indentations like a battlement. Chaucer. 2. (Her.)  Having the edge broken like battlements; -- said of a bearing such as a fess, bend, or the like. 3. Having been the place of battle; as, an embattled plain or field. J. Baillie.

gradation.definition: The act of progressing by regular steps or orderly arrangement; the state of being graded or arranged in ranks; as, the gradation of castes. 2. The act or process of bringing to a certain grade. 3. Any degree or relative position in an order or series. The several gradations of the intelligent unive.

localize.definition: To make local; to fix in, or assign to, a definite place. H. Spencer. Wordsworth.

myrtiform.definition: Resembling myrtle or myrtle berries; having the form of a myrtle leaf.

acidific.definition: Producing acidity; converting into an acid. Dana.

limewater.definition: Water impregnated with lime; esp., an artificial solution of lime for medicinal purposes.

fourscore.definition:
Four times twenty; eighty.

The product of four times twenty; eighty units or objects.

multiaxial.definition: Having more than one axis; developing in more than a single line or plain; -- opposed to Ant: monoaxial.

nullification.definition: The act of nullifying; a rendering void and of no effect, or of no legal effect. Right of nullification (U. S. Hist.), the right claimed in behalf of a State to nullify or make void, by its sovereign act or decree, an enactment of the general government which it deems unconstitutional.

monocle.definition: An eyeglass for one eye. Simmonds.

petitor.definition: One who seeks or asks; a seeker; an applicant. Fuller.

cheiropterygium.definition: The typical pentadactyloid limb of the higher vertebrates.

ichthyotomy.definition: The anatomy or dissection of fishes.

transpadane.definition: Lying or being on the further side of the river Po with reference to Rome, that is, on the north side; -- opposed to cispadane.

coenoecium.definition: The common tissue which unites the various zooids of a bryozoan.

cofferer.definition: One who keeps treasures in a coffer.

bilaminar.definition: Formed of, or having, two laminæ, or thin plates.

nook-shotten.definition: Full of nooks, angles, or corners. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] That nook-shotten isle of Albion. Shak.

havened.definition: Sheltered in a haven. Blissful havened both from joy and pain. Keats.

heterotropal.definition: Having the embryo or ovule oblique or transverse to the funiculus; amphitropous. Gray.

poecilopod.definition: One of the Poecilopoda. Also used adjectively.

catso.definition: A base fellow; a rogue; a cheat. B. Jonson. CAT'S-PAW Cat's"-paw`, n. 1. (Naut.) (a) A light transitory air which ruffles the surface of the water during a calm, or the ripples made by such a puff of air. (b) A particular hitch or turn in the bight of a rope, into which a tackle may be hooked. 2. A.

periderm.definition: (Bot.)  The outer layer of bark. 2. (Zoöl.)  The hard outer covering of hydroids and other marine animals; the perisarc.

bristle.definition:
A short, stiff, coarse hair, as on the back of swine. 2. (Bot.)  A stiff, sharp, roundish hair. Gray.

1. To erect the bristles of; to cause to stand up, as the bristles of an angry hog; -- sometimes with up. Now for the bare-picked bone of majesty Doth dogged war bristle his angry crest. Shak. Boy,.

offend.definition: To strike against; to attack; to assail. Sir P. Sidney. 2. To displease; to make angry; to affront. A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city. Prov. xviii. 19. 3. To be offensive to; to harm; to pain; to annoy; as, strong light offends the eye; to offend the conscience. 4. To transgr.

graffito.definition: Production of decorative designs by scratching them through a surface of layer plaster, glazing, etc., revealing a different- colored ground; also, pottery or ware so decorated; -- chiefly used attributively.

inaniloquent.definition: Given to talking inanely; loquacious; garrulous.

cates.definition: Provisions; food; viands; especially, luxurious food; delicacies; dainties. Shak. Cates for which Apicius could not pay. Shurchill. Choicest cates and the fiagon's best spilth. R. Browning.

steedless.definition: Having no steed; without a horse.

tightener.definition: That which tightens; specifically (Mach.), a tightening pulley.

perfecter.definition: One who, or that which, makes perfect. "The . . . perfecter of our faith." Barrow.

reproachablr.definition: Deserving reproach; censurable. 2. Opprobrius; scurrilous. Sir T. Elyot. -- Re*proach"a*ble*ness, n. -- Re*proach"a*bly, adv.

caducean.definition: Of or belonging to Mercury's caduceus, or wand.

omnipresent.definition: Present in all places at the same time; ubiquitous; as, the omnipresent Jehovah. Prior.

dodkin.definition: A doit; a small coin. Shelton.

pedantize.definition: To play the pedant; to use pedantic expressions.

astragalomancy.definition: Divination by means of small bones or dice.

inductor.definition: The person who inducts another into an office or benefice. 2. (Elec.)  That portion of an electrical apparatus, in which is the inducing charge or current.

clayes.definition: Wattles, or hurdles, made with stakes interwoven with osiers, to cover lodgments.

torsion.definition: The act of turning or twisting, or the state of being twisted; the twisting or wrenching of a body by the exertion of a lateral force tending to turn one end or part of it about a longitudinal axis, while the other is held fast or turned in the opposite direction. 2. (Mech.)  That force with which a.

geophagist.definition: One who eats earth, as dirt, clay, chalk, etc.

irrevocable.definition: Incapable of being recalled or revoked; unchangeable; irreversible; unalterable; as, an irrevocable promise or decree; irrevocable fate. Firm and irrevocable is my doom. Shak. -- Ir*rev"o*ca*ble*ness, n. -- Ir*rev"o*ca*bly, adv.

aard-wolf.definition: A carnivorous quadruped (Proteles Lalandii), of South Africa, resembling the fox and hyena. See Proteles.

phenology.definition: The science of the relations between climate and periodic biological phenomena, as the migrations and breeding of birds, the flowering and fruiting of plants, etc. -- Phe`no*log"ic*al (#), a. -- Phe`no*log"ic*al*ly, adv. -- Phe*nol"o*gist (#), n.

assimilation.definition: The act or process of assimilating or bringing to a resemblance, likeness, or identity; also, the state of being so assimilated; as, the assimilation of one sound to another. To aspire to an assimilation with God. Dr. H. More. The assimilation of gases and vapors. Sir J. Herschel. 2. (Physiol.)  The.

worshipability.definition: The quality of being worthy to be worshiped. Coleridge.

insurrection.definition: A rising against civil or political authority, or the established government; open and active opposition to the execution of law in a city or state. It is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein. Ezra iv. 19. 2. A.

epulotic.definition: Promoting the skinning over or healing of sores; as, an epulotic ointment. -- n.  An epulotic agent.

booming.definition:
Rushing with violence; swelling with a hollow sound; making a hollow sound or note; roaring; resounding. O'er the sea-beat ships the booming waters roar. Falcone. 2. Advancing or increasing amid noisy excitement; as, booming prices; booming popularity. [Colloq. U. S.]

The act of producing a hollow.

falcade.definition: The action of a horse, when he throws himself on his haunches two or three times, bending himself, as it were, in very quick curvets. Harris.

ingenite.definition: Innate; inborn; inbred; inherent; native; ingenerate. It is naturalor ingenite, which comes by some defect of the organs and overmuch brain. Burton.

intemperant.definition: Intemperate. Such as be intemperant, that is, followers of their naughty appetites and lusts. Udall.

punicial.definition: Of a bright red or purple color.

electrum.definition: Amber. 2. An alloy of gold and silver, of an amber color, used by the ancients. 3. German-silver plate. See German silver, under German.

vent.definition:
Sale; opportunity to sell; market. Shelton. There is no vent for any commodity but of wool. Sir W. Temple.

To sell; to vend. Therefore did those nations vent such spice. Sir W. Raleigh.

A baiting place; an inn.

To snuff; to breathe or puff out; to snort. Spenser.

1. A small aperture; a hole or p.

sustentacular.definition: Supporting; sustaining; as, a sustentacular tissue.

pauciloquent.definition: Uttering few words; brief in speech.

hydride.definition: A compound of the binary type, in which hydrogen is united with some other element.

undersign.definition: To write one's name at the foot or end of, as a letter or any legal instrument. The undersigned, the person whose name is signed, or the persons whose names are signed, at the end of a document; the subscriber or subscribers.

depredable.definition: Liable to depredation. "Made less depredable." Bacon.

cephalaspis.definition: A genus of fossil ganoid fishes found in the old red sandstone or Devonian formation. The head is large, and protected by a broad shield-shaped helmet prolonged behind into two lateral points.

faultful.definition: Full of faults or sins. Shak.

spendthrift.definition:
One who spends money profusely or improvidently; a prodigal; one who lavishes or wastes his estate. Also used figuratively. A woman who was a generous spendthrift of life. Mrs. R. H. Davis.

Prodigal; extravagant; wasteful.

dejected.definition: Cast down; afflicted; low-spirited; sad; as, a dejected look or countenance. -- De*ject"ed*ly, adv. -- De*ject"ed*ness, n.

devilwood.definition: A kind of tree (Osmanthus Americanus), allied to the European olive.

verein.definition: A union, association, or society; -- used in names of German organizations.

shepherdly.definition: Resembling, or becoming to, a shepherd; pastoral; rustic. Jer. Taylor.

transact.definition:
To carry through; to do; perform; to manage; as, to transact commercial business; to transact business by an agent.

To conduct matters; to manage affairs. South.

scuff.definition:
The back part of the neck; the scruff. Ld. Lytton.

To walk without lifting the feet; to proceed with a scraping or dragging movement; to shuffle.

thundrous.definition: Thunderous; sonorous. "Scraps of thunderous epic." Tennyson.

vaporimeter.definition: An instrument for measuring the volume or the tension of any vapor; specifically, an instrument of this sort used as an alcoholometer in testing spirituous liquors.

coursed.definition: Hunted; as, a coursed hare. 2. Arranged in courses; as, coursed masonry.

kaleidophone.definition: An instrument invented by Professor Wheatstone, consisting of a reflecting knob at the end of a vibrating rod or thin plate, for making visible, in the motion of a point of light reflected from the knob, the paths or curves corresponding with the musical notes produced by the vibrations.

multiped.definition:
An insect having many feet, as a myriapod.

Having many feet.

articulus.definition: A joint of the cirri of the Crinoidea; a joint or segment of an arthropod appendage.

winninish.definition: The land-locked variety of the common salmon. [Canada].

effusion.definition: The act of pouring out; as, effusion of water, of blood, of grace, of words, and the like. To save the effusion of my people's blood. Dryden. 2. That which is poured out, literally or figuratively. Wash me with that precious effusion, and I shall be whiter than sow. Eikon Basilike. The light effusio.

polyclinic.definition: A clinic in which diseases of many sorts are treated; especially, an institution in which clinical instruction is given in all kinds of disease.

disavowal.definition: The act of disavowing, disclaiming, or disowning; rejection and denial. An earnest disavowal of fear often proceeds from fear. Richardson.

proleg.definition: One of the fleshy legs found on the abdominal segments of the larvæ of Lepidoptera, sawflies, and some other insects. Those of Lepidoptera have a circle of hooks. Called also proped, propleg, and falseleg.

monochromatic.definition: Consisting of one color, or presenting rays of light of one color only. Monochromatic lamp (Opt.),a lamp whose flame yields rays of some one homogenous light. It is of great importance in optical experiments.

crenulation.definition: A minute crenation. 2. The state of being minutely scalloped.

underhangman.definition: An assistant or deputy hangman. Shak.

nummular.definition: Of or pertaining to coin or money; pecuniary; as, the nummulary talent. 2. (Pathol.)  Having the appearance or form of a coin. "Nummular sputa." Sir T. Watson.

degu.definition: A small South American rodent (Octodon Cumingii), of the family Octodontidæ.

problematic.definition: Having the nature of a problem; not shown in fact; questionable; uncertain; unsettled; doubtful. -- Prob`lem*at"ic*al*ly, adv. Diligent inquiries into remote and problematical guilt leave a gate wide open to . . . informers. Swift.

trochilidist.definition: One who studies, or is versed in, the nature and habits of humming birds, or the Trochilidæ. Gould.

mabolo.definition: A kind of persimmon tree (Diospyros discolor) from the Philippine Islands, now introduced into the East and West Indies. It bears an edible fruit as large as a quince.

orthoptera.definition: An order of mandibulate insects including grasshoppers, locusts, cockroaches, etc. See Illust. under Insect. Note: The anterior wings are usually thickened and protect the posterior wings, which are larger and fold longitudinally like a fan. The Orthoptera undergo no metamorphosis.

plumage.definition: The entire clothing of a bird. Note: It consist of the contour feathers, or the ordinary feathers covering the head, neck, and body; the tail feathers, with their upper and lower coverts; the wing feathers, including primaries, secondaries, and tertiaries, with their coverts; and the down which lies.

degeneration.definition: The act or state of growing worse, or the state of having become worse; decline; degradation; debasement; degeneracy; deterioration. Our degeneration and apostasy. Bates. 2. (Physiol.)  That condition of a tissue or an organ in which its vitality has become either diminished or perverted; a substitu.

gavel.definition:
A gable. Halliwell.

A small heap of grain, not tied up into a bundle. Wright.

1. The mallet of the presiding officer in a legislative body, public assembly, court, masonic body, etc. 2. A mason's setting maul. Knight.

Tribute; toll; custom. See Gabel. Cowell.

rurality.definition: The quality or state of being rural. 2. A rural place. "Leafy ruralities." Carlyle.

sauria.definition: A division of Reptilia formerly established to include the Lacertilia, Crocodilia, Dinosauria, and other groups. By some writers the name is restricted to the Lacertilia.

telephotographic.definition: Designating, or pertaining to, the process of telephotography.

brushwood.definition: Brush; a thicket or coppice of small trees and shrubs. 2. Small branches of trees cut off.

myrobalan.definition: A dried astringent fruit much resembling a prune. It contains tannin, and was formerly used in medicine, but is now chiefly used in tanning and dyeing. Myrobolans are produced by various species of Terminalia of the East Indies, and of Spondias of South America.

haunter.definition: One who, or that which, haunts.

blackstrap.definition: A mixture of spirituous liquor (usually rum) and molasses. No blackstrap to-night; switchel, or ginger pop. Judd. 2. Bad port wine; any commo wine of the Mediterranean; -- so called by sailors.

goff.definition:
A silly clown. Halliwell.

A game. See Golf. [Scot.] Halliwell.

sned.definition:
To lop; to snathe.

See Snath.

electro-physiology.definition: That branch of physiology which treats of electric phenomena produced through physiological agencies.

balkingly.definition: In manner to balk or frustrate.

fainthearted.definition: Wanting in courage; depressed by fear; easily discouraged or frightened; cowardly; timorous; dejected. Fear not, neither be faint-hearted. Is. vii. 4. -- Faint"*heart`ed*ly, adv. -- Faint"*heart`ed*ness, n.

cut-out.definition: (a) (Telegraphy) A species of switch for changing the current from one circuit to another, or for shortening a circuit. (b) (Elec.) A divice for breaking or separating a portion of circuit.

iatromathematical.definition: Of or pertaining to iatromathematicians or their doctrine.

incensed.definition: Angered; enraged. 2. (Her.)  Represented as enraged, as any wild creature depicted with fire issuing from mouth and eyes.

plantigrada.definition: A subdivision of Carnivora having plantigrade feet. It includes the bears, raccoons, and allied species.

aline.definition: To range or place in a line; to bring into line; to align. Evelyn.

whitsunday.definition: (Eccl.)  The seventh Sunday, and the fiftieth day, after Easter; a festival of the church in commemoration of the descent of the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost; Pentecost; -- so called, it is said, because, in the primitive church, those who had been newly baptized appeared at church between Ea.

fairyland.definition: The imaginary land or abode of fairies.

metastatic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or caused by, metastasis; as, a metastatic abscess; the metastatic processes of growth.

desultoriness.definition: The quality of being desultory or without order or method; unconnectedness. The seeming desultoriness of my method. Boyle.

hyporhachis.definition: The stem of an aftershaft or hypoptilum. [Written also hyporachis.].

erythronium.definition: A name originally given (from its red acid) to the metal vanadium.

lazyback.definition: A support for the back, attached to the seat of a carriage.

restaurateur.definition: The keeper of an eathing house or a restaurant.

analemma.definition: (Chem.)  An orthographic projection of the sphere on the plane of the meridian, the eye being supposed at an infinite distance, and in the east or west point of the horizon. 2. An instrument of wood or brass, on which this projection of the sphere is made, having a movable horizon or cursor; -- form.

burg.definition: A fortified town. 2. A borough. [Eng.] See 1st Borough.

calumniation.definition: False accusation of crime or offense, or a malicious and false representation of the words or actions of another, with a view to injure his good name. The calumniation of her principal counselors. Bacon.

mangrove.definition: (Bot.)  The name of one or two trees of the genus Rhizophora (R. Mangle, and R. mucronata, the last doubtfully distinct) inhabiting muddy shores of tropical regions, where they spread by emitting aërial roots, which fasten in the saline mire and eventually become new stems. The seeds also send down.

tetraptote.definition: A noun that has four cases only. Andrews.

vestibular.definition: Of or pertaining to a vestibule; like a vestibule.

botuliform.definition: Having the shape of a sausage. Henslow.

spooler.definition: One who, or that which, spools.

cyma.definition: (Arch.)  A member or molding of the cornice, the profile of which is wavelike in form. 2. (Bot.)  A cyme. See Cyme. Cyma recta, or Cyma, a cyma, hollow in its upper part and swelling below. -- Cyma reversa, or Ogee, a cyma swelling out on the upper part and hollow below.

toff.definition: A fop; a beau; a swell. [Slang, Eng.]  Kipling.

coloboma.definition: A defect or malformation; esp., a fissure of the iris supposed to be a persistent embryonic cleft.

nitty.definition:
Full of nits. B. Jonson.

Shining; elegant; spruce. "O sweet, nitty youth." Marston.

trimmer.definition: One who trims, arranges, fits, or ornaments. 2. One who does not adopt extreme opinions in politics, or the like; one who fluctuates between parties, so as to appear to favor each; a timeserver. Thus Halifax was a trimmer on principle. Macaulay. 3. An instrument with which trimming is done. 4. (Arch.

amazedness.definition: The state of being amazed, or confounded with fear, surprise, or wonder. Bp. Hall.

append.definition: To hang or attach to, as by a string, so that the thing is suspended; as, a seal appended to a record; the inscription was appended to the column. 2. To add, as an accessory to the principal thing; to annex; as, notes appended to this chapter. A further purpose appended to the primary one. I. Taylor.

housework.definition: The work belonging to housekeeping; especially, kitchen work, sweeping, scrubbing, bed making, and the like.

crotalum.definition: A kind of castanet used by the Corybantes.

spotted.definition: Marked with spots; as, a spotted garment or character. "The spotted panther." Spenser. Spotted fever (Med.), a name applied to various eruptive fevers, esp. to typhus fever and cerebro-spinal meningitis. -- Spotted tree (Bot.), an Australian tree (Flindersia maculosa); -- so called because its bark.

shortage.definition: Amount or extent of deficiency, as determined by some requirement or standard; as, a shortage in money accounts.

incivilization.definition: The state of being uncivilized; want of civilization; barbarism.

powderflask.definition: A flask in which gunpowder is carried, having a charging tube at the end.

rasse.definition: A carnivore (Viverricula Mallaccensis) allied to the civet but smaller, native of China and the East Indies. It furnishes a perfume resembling that of the civet, which is highly prized by the Javanese. Called also Malacca weasel, and lesser civet.

rocking.definition: Having a swaying, rolling, or back-and-forth movement; used for rocking. Rocking shaft. (Mach.) See Rock shaft.

receptary.definition:
Generally or popularly admitted or received. Sir T. Browne.

That which is received. "Receptaries of philosophy." Sir T. Browne.

inexist.definition: To exist within; to dwell within. Substances inexisting within the divine mind. A. Tucker.

synpelmous.definition: Having the two main flexor tendons of the toes blended together.
