tormentress.definition: A woman who torments. Fortune ordinarily cometh after to whip and punish them, as the scourge and tormentress of glory and honor. Holland.

wonderstruck.definition: Struck with wonder, admiration, or surprise. Dryden.

silversmith.definition: One whose occupation is to manufacture utensils, ornaments, etc., of silver; a worker in silver.

nares.definition: The nostrils or nasal openings, -- the anterior nares being the external or proper nostrils, and the posterior nares, the openings of the nasal cavities into the mouth or pharynx.

subhyoidean.definition: Situated or performed beneath the hyoid bone; as, subhyoidean laryngotomy.

mister.definition:
A title of courtesy prefixed to the name of a man or youth. It is usually written in the abbreviated form Mr. To call your name, inquire your where, Or whet you think of Mister Some-one's book, Or Mister Other's marriage or decease. Mrs. Browning.

To address or mention by the title Mr.; as, he mist.

jeopardize.definition: To expose to loss or injury; to risk; to jeopard. That he should jeopardize his willful head Only for spite at me. H. Taylor.

perfection.definition: The quality or state of being perfect or complete, so that nothing requisite is wanting; entire development; consummate culture, skill, or moral excellence; the highest attainable state or degree of excellence; maturity; as, perfection in an art, in a science, or in a system; perfection in form or d.

vivacity.definition: The quality or state of being vivacious. Specifically: -- (a) Tenacity of life; vital force; natural vigor. The vivacity of some of these pensioners is little less than a miracle, they lived so long. Fuller. (b) Life; animation; spiritedness; liveliness; sprightliness; as, the vivacity of a discours.

forewarn.definition: To warn beforehand; to give previous warning, admonition, information, or notice to; to caution in advance. We were forewarned of your coming. Shak.

midweek.definition: The middle of the week. Also used adjectively.

cymar.definition: A sight covering; a scarf. See Simar. Her body shaded with a light cymar. Dryden.

liquescency.definition: The quality or state of being liquescent. Johnson.

flyte.definition: Strife; dispute; abusive or upbraiding talk, as in fliting; wrangling. [Obs. or Scot. & Prov. Eng.] The bird of Pallas has also a good "flyte" on the moral side . . . in his suggestion that the principal effect of the nightingale's song is to make women false to their husbands. Saintsbury.

soot.definition: A black substance formed by combustion, or disengaged from fuel in the process of combustion, which rises in fine particles, and adheres to the sides of the chimney or pipe conveying the smoke; strictly, the fine powder, consisting chiefly of carbon, which colors smoke, and which is the result of im.

rationality.definition: The quality or state of being rational; agreement with reason; possession of reason; due exercise of reason; reasonableness. When God has made rationality the common portion of mankind, how came it to be thy inclosure Gov. of Tongue. Well-directed intentions, whose rationalities will never bear a ri.

natant.definition: (Bot.)  Floating in water, as the leaves of water lilies, or submersed, as those of many aquatic plants. 2. (Her.)  Placed horizontally across the field, as if swimmimg toward the dexter side; said of all sorts of fishes except the flying fish.

estafet.definition: A courier who conveys messages to another courier; a military courier sent from one part of an army to another.

inveigle.definition: To lead astray as if blind; to persuade to something evil by deceptive arts or flattery; to entice; to insnare; to seduce; to wheedle. Yet have they many baits and guileful spells To inveigle and invite the un unwary sense. Milton.

intently.definition: In an intent manner; as, the eyes intently fixed. Syn. -- Fixedly; steadfastly; earnestly; attentively; sedulously; diligently; eagerly.

aphrodisian.definition: Pertaining to Aphrodite or Venus. "Aphrodisian dames" [that is, courtesans]. C. Reade.

tolerant.definition: Inclined to tolerate; favoring toleration; forbearing; ingulgent.

maintop.definition: The platform about the head of the mainmast in square-rigged vessels.

phylactery.definition: Any charm or amulet worn as a preservative from danger or disease. 2. A small square box, made either of parchment or of black calfskin, containing slips of parchment or vellum on which are written the scriptural passages Exodus xiii. 2-10, and 11-17, Deut. vi. 4-9, 13- 22. They are worn by Jews on.

incapsulate.definition: To inclose completely, as in a membrane.

witing.definition: Knowledge. "Withouten witing of any other wight." Chaucer.

cephalosome.definition: The anterior region or head of insects and other arthropods. Packard.

weaver.definition: One who weaves, or whose occupation is to weave. "Weavers of linen." P. Plowman. 2. (Zoöl.)  A weaver bird. 3. (Zoöl.)  An aquatic beetle of the genus Gyrinus. See Whirling. Weaver bird (Zoöl.), any one of numerous species of Asiatic, Fast Indian, and African birds belonging to Ploceus and allied ge.

xylotomist.definition: One versed or engaged in xylotomy.

shallow.definition: Not deep; having little depth; shoal. "Shallow brooks, and rivers wide." Milton. 2. Not deep in tone. The sound perfecter and not so shallow and jarring. Bacon. 3. Not intellectually deep; not profound; not penetrating deeply; simple; not wise or knowing; ignorant; superficial; as, a shallow mind; s.

scarmage.definition: A slight contest; a skirmish. See Skirmish. Such cruel game my scarmoges disarms. Spenser.

aster.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of herbs with compound white or bluish flowers; starwort; Michaelmas daisy. 2. (Floriculture)  A plant of the genus Callistephus. Many varieties (called China asters, German asters, etc.) are cultivated for their handsome compound flowers.

classis.definition: A class or order; sort; kind. His opinion of that classis of men. Clarendon. 2. (Eccl.)  An ecclesiastical body or judicat.

smallsword.definition: A light sword used for thrusting only; especially, the sword worn by civilians of rank in the eighteenth century.

sludger.definition:
A bucket for removing mud from a bored hole; a sand pump.

A shovel for sludging out drains, etc.

foreshorten.definition: (Fine Art)  To represent on a plane surface, as if extended in a direction toward the spectator or nearly so; to shorten by drawing in perspective. 2. Fig.: To represent pictorially to the imagination. Songs, and deeds, and lives that lie Foreshortened in the tract of time. Tennyson.

smuggler.definition: One who smuggles. 2. A vessel employed in smuggling.

terete.definition: Cylindrical and slightly tapering; columnar, as some stems of plants.

attenuation.definition: The act or process of making slender, or the state of being slender; emaciation. 2. The act of attenuating; the act of making thin or less dense, or of rarefying, as fluids or gases. 3. The process of weakening in intensity; diminution of virulence; as, the attenuation of virus.

magenta.definition: An aniline dye obtained as an amorphous substance having a green bronze surface color, which dissolves to a shade of red; also, the color; -- so called from Magenta, in Italy, in allusion to the battle fought there about the time the dye was discovered. Called also fuchsine, roseïne, etc.

detectable.definition: Capable of being detected or found out; as, parties not detectable. "Errors detectible at a glance." Latham.

quizzism.definition: The act or habit of quizzing.

drub.definition:
To beat with a stick; to thrash; to cudgel. Soundly Drubbed with a good honest cudgel. L'Estrange.

A blow with a cudgel; a thump. Addison.

wafer.definition: (Cookery)  A thin cake made of flour and other ingredients. Wafers piping hot out of the gleed. Chaucer. The curious work in pastry, the fine cakes, wafers, and marchpanes. Holland. A woman's oaths are wafers -- break with making B. Jonson. 2. (Eccl.)  A thin cake or piece of bread (commonly unleave.

text-hand.definition: A large hand in writing; -- so called because it was the practice to write the text of a book in a large hand and the notes in a smaller hand.

outfitter.definition: One who furnishes outfits for a voyage, a journey, or a business.

profundity.definition: The quality or state of being profound; depth of place, knowledge, feeling, etc. "The vast profundity obscure." Milton.

mischief-maker.definition: One who makes mischief; one who excites or instigates quarrels or enmity.

tryster.definition: One who makes an appointment, or tryst; one who meets with another.

supercilium.definition: The eyebrow, or the region of the eyebrows.

blore.definition: The act of blowing; a roaring wind; a blast. A most tempestuous blore. Chapman.

lister.definition:
A spear armed with three or more prongs, for striking fish. [Scotland]

One who makes a list or roll.

Same as Leister.

bilboquet.definition: The toy called cup and ball.

warm-blooded.definition: Having warm blood; -- applied especially to those animals, as birds and mammals, which have warm blood, or, more properly, the power of maintaining a nearly uniform temperature whatever the temperature of the surrounding air. See Homoiothermal.

caned.definition: Filled with white flakes; mothery; -- said vinegar when containing mother. Halliwell.

incompetent.definition: Not competent; wanting in adequate strength, power, capacity, means, qualifications, or the like; incapable; unable; inadequate; unfit. Incompetent to perform the duties of the place. Macaulay. 2. (Law)  Wanting the legal or constitutional qualifications; inadmissible; as, a person professedly wanti.

purl.definition:
To decorate with fringe or embroidery. "Nature's cradle more enchased and purled." B. Jonson.

1. An embroidered and puckered border; a hem or fringe, often of gold or silver twist; also, a pleat or fold, as of a band. A triumphant chariot made of carnation velvet, enriched withpurl and pearl. Sir P.

spit-venom.definition: Poison spittle; poison ejected from the mouth. Hooker.

attagen.definition: A species of sand grouse (Syrrghaptes Pallasii) found in Asia and rarely in southern Europe.

mise.definition: (Law)  The issue in a writ of right. 2. Expense; cost; disbursement. 3. A tax or tallage; in Wales, an honorary gift of the people to a new king or prince of Wales; also, a tribute paid, in the country palatine of Chester, England, at the change of the owner of the earldom.

brawl.definition: To quarrel noisily and outrageously. Let a man that is a man consider that he is a fool that brawleth openly with his wife. Golden Boke. 2. To complain loudly; to scold. 3. To make a loud confused noise, as the water of a rapid stream running over stones. Where the brook brawls along the painful roa.

parrel.definition: (Naut.)  The rope or collar by which a yard or spar is held to the mast in such a way that it may be hoisted or lowered at pleasure. Totten. 2. A chimney-piece. Halliwell.

equator.definition: (Geog.)  The imaginary great circle on the earth's surface, everywhere equally distant from the two poles, and dividing the earth's surface into two hemispheres. 2. (Astron.)  The great circle of the celestial sphere, coincident with the plane of the earth's equator; -- so called because when the su.

ambush.definition: A disposition or arrangement of troops for attacking an enemy unexpectedly from a concealed station. Hence: Unseen peril; a device to entrap; a snare. Heaven, whose high walls fear no assault or siege Or ambush from the deep. Milton. 2. A concealed station, where troops or enemies lie in wait to att.

ephod.definition: A part of the sacerdotal habit among Jews, being a covering for the back and breast, held together on the shoulders by two clasps or brooches of onyx stones set in gold, and fastened by a girdle of the same stuff as the ephod. The ephod for the priests was of plain linen; that for the high priest wa.

dijudicate.definition: To make a judicial decision; to decide; to determine. Hales.

revealability.definition: The quality or state of being revealable; revealableness.

crustation.definition: An adherent crust; an incrustation. Pepys.

ruination.definition: The act of ruining, or the state of being ruined.

windrow.definition:
A row or line of hay raked together for the purpose of being rolled into cocks or heaps. 2. Sheaves of grain set up in a row, one against another, that the wind may blow between them. [Eng.] 3. The green border of a field, dug up in order to carry the earth on other land to mend it. [Eng.]

To arran.

acquaint.definition:
Acquainted.

1. To furnish or give experimental knowledge of; to make (one) to know; to make familiar; -- followed by with. Before a man can speak on any subject, it is necessary to be acquainted with it. Locke. A man of sorrows and acquainted with grief. Isa. liii. 3. 2. To communicate notice to; t.

grangerism.definition: The practice of illustrating a particular book by engravings collected from other books.

hylozoism.definition: The doctrine that matter possesses a species of life and sensation, or that matter and life are inseparable. Cudworth.

risen.definition: p. p. & a. from Rise. "Her risen Son and Lord." Keble. 2. Obs. imp. pl. of Rise. Chaucer.

merlon.definition: One of the solid parts of a battlemented parapet; a battlement. See Illust. of Battlement.

vitelline.definition: Of or pertaining to the yolk of eggs; as, the vitelline membrane, a smooth, transparent membrane surrounding the vitellus.

bank-sided.definition: Having sides inclining inwards, as a ship; -- opposed to wall- sided.

ferric.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or containing iron. Specifically (Chem.), denoting those compounds in which iron has a higher valence than in the ferrous compounds; as, ferric oxide; ferric acid. Ferric acid (Chem.), an acid, H2FeO4, which is not known in the free state, but forms definite salts, analo.

intelligential.definition: Of or pertaining to the intelligence; exercising or implying understanding; intellectual. "With act intelligential." Milton. 2. Consisting of unembodied mind; incorporeal. Food alike those pure Intelligential substances require. Milton.

adamantine.definition: Made of adamant, or having the qualities of adamant; incapable of being broken, dissolved, or penetrated; as, adamantine bonds or chains. 2. (Min.)  Like the diamond in hardness or luster.

tiling.definition: A surface covered with tiles, or composed of tiles. They . . . let him down through the tiling. Luke v. 19. 2. Tiles, collectively.

gula.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) The upper front of the neck, next to the chin; the upper throat. (b) A plate which in most insects supports the submentum. 2. (Arch.)  A capping molding. Same as Cymatium.

puncticular.definition: Comprised in, or like, a point; exact. [Obs. & R.] Sir T. Browne.

despeed.definition: To send hastily. Despeeded certain of their crew. Speed.

weeder.definition: One who, or that which, weeds, or frees from anything noxious.

moonglade.definition: The bright reflection of the moon's light on an expanse of water. [Poetic].

grasper.definition: One who grasps or seizes; one who catches or holds.

presentiality.definition: State of being actually present. South.

valetudinous.definition: Valetudinarian. "The valetudinous condition of King Edward." Fuller.

primigenous.definition: First formed or generated; original; primigenial. Bp. Hall.

paxwax.definition: The strong ligament of the back of the neck in quadrupeds. It connects the back of the skull with dorsal spines of the cervical vertebræ, and helps to support the head. Called also paxywaxy and packwax.

manteau.definition: A woman's cloak or mantle. 2. A gown worn by women.

pitheci.definition: A division of mammals including the apes and monkeys. Sometimes used in the sense of Primates.

strabismus.definition: An affection of one or both eyes, in which the optic axes can not be directed to the same object, -- a defect due either to undue contraction or to undue relaxation of one or more of the muscles which move the eyeball; squinting; cross-eye.

triumvir.definition: One of tree men united in public office or authority. Note: In later times the triumvirs of Rome were three men who jointly exercised sovereign power. Julius Cæsar, Crassus, and Pompey were the first triumvirs; Octavianus (Augustus), Antony, and Lepidus were the second and last.

ettle.definition: To earn. See Addle, to earn. Boucher.

innixion.definition: Act of leaning upon something; incumbency. Derham.

misstep.definition:
A wrong step; an error of conduct.

To take a wrong step; to go astray.

superjacent.definition: Situated immediately above; as, superjacent rocks.

achlamydate.definition: Not possessing a mantle; -- said of certain gastropods.

relieving.definition: Serving or tending to relieve. Relieving arch (Arch.), a discharging arch. See under Discharge, v. t. -- Relieving tackle. (Naut.) (a) A temporary tackle attached to the tiller of a vessel during gales or an action, in case of accident to the tiller ropes. (b) A strong tackle from a wharf to a caree.

immanence.definition: The condition or quality of being immanent; inherence; an indwelling. [Clement] is mainly concerned in enforcing the immanence of God. Christ is everywhere presented by him as Deity indwelling in the world. A. V. G. Allen.

serrifera.definition: A division of Hymenoptera comprising the sawflies.

verine.definition: An alkaloid obtained as a yellow amorphous substance by the decomposition of veratrine.

cops.definition: The connecting crook of a harrow.

unsay.definition: To recant or recall, as what has been said; to refract; to take back again; to make as if not said. You can say and unsay things at pleasure. Goldsmith.

abolitionism.definition: The principles or measures of abolitionists. Wilberforce.

costiveness.definition: An unnatural retention of the fecal matter of the bowels; constipation. 2. Inability to express one's self; stiffness. A reverend disputant of the same costiveness in public elocution with myself. Wakefield.

intime.definition: Inward; internal; intimate. Sir K. Digby.

invisibility.definition: The state or quality of being invisible; also, that which is invisible. "Atoms and invisibilities." Landor.

deprivation.definition: The act of depriving, dispossessing, or bereaving; the act of deposing or divesting of some dignity. 2. The state of being deprived; privation; loss; want; bereavement. 3. (Eccl. Law)  the taking away from a clergyman his benefice, or other spiritual promotion or dignity. Note: Deprivation may be a.

miscreancy.definition: The quality of being miscreant; adherence to a false religion; false faith. Ayliffe.

plagiocephaly.definition: Oblique lateral deformity of the skull.

quacksalver.definition: One who boasts of his skill in medicines and salves, or of the efficacy of his prescriptions; a charlatan; a quack; a mountebank. Burton.

cyamelide.definition: A white amorphous substance, regarded as a polymeric modification of isocyanic acid.

herr.definition: A title of respect given to gentlemen in Germany, equivalent to the English Mister.

gigue.definition: A piece of lively dance music, in two strains which are repeated; also, the dance.

inheritable.definition: Capable of being inherited; transmissible or descendible; as, an inheritable estate or title. Blackstone. 2. Capable of being transmitted from parent to child; as, inheritable qualities or infirmities. 3. Etym: [Cf. OF. enheritable, inheritable.]  Capable of taking by inheritance, or of receiving by.

infraposition.definition: A situation or position beneath. Kane.

parmesan.definition: Of or pertaining to Parma in Italy. Parmesan cheese, a kind of cheese of a rich flavor, though from skimmed milk, made in Parma, Italy.

enucleate.definition: To bring or peel out, as a kernel from its enveloping husks its enveloping husks or shell. 2. (Med.)  To remove without cutting (as a tumor). 3. To bring to light; to make clear. Sclater (1654).

siesta.definition: A short sleep taken about the middle of the day, or after dinner; a midday nap.

conjurement.definition: Serious injunction; solemn demand or entreaty. Milton.

domesticate.definition: To make domestic; to habituate to home life; as, to domesticate one's self. 2. To cause to be, as it were, of one's family or country; as, to domesticate a foreign custom or word. 3. To tame or reclaim from a wild state; as, to domesticate wild animals; to domesticate a plant.

topical.definition: Of or pertaining to a place; limited; logical application; as, a topical remedy; a topical claim or privilege. 2. (Rhet. & logic)  Pertaining to, or consisting of, a topic or topics; according to topics. 3. Resembling a topic, or general maxim; hence, not demonstrative, but merely probable, as an ar.

morus.definition: A genus of trees, some species of which produce edible fruit; the mulberry. See Mulberry. Note: Morus alba is the white mulberry, a native of India or China, the leaves of which are extensively used for feeding silkworms, for which it furnishes the chief food. -- Morus multicaulis, the many-stemmed.

disinthrallment.definition: A releasing from thralldom or slavery; disenthrallment. [Written also disinthralment.].

denounce.definition: To make known in a solemn or official manner; to declare; to proclaim (especially an evil). Denouncing wrath to come. Milton. I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish. Deut. xxx. 18. 2. To proclaim in a threatening manner; to threaten by some outward sign or expression. His look den.

embracery.definition: An attempt to influence a court, jury, etc., corruptly, by promises, entreaties, money, entertainments, threats, or other improper inducements.

rant.definition:
To rave in violent, high-sounding, or extravagant language, without dignity of thought; to be noisy, boisterous, and bombastic in talk or declamation; as, a ranting preacher. Look where my ranting host of the Garter comes! Shak.

High-sounding language, without importance or dignity of thought; bois.

dew-point.definition: The temperature at which dew begins to form. It varies with the humidity and temperature of the atmosphere.

subsphenoidal.definition: Situated under, or on the ventral side of, the body of the sphenoid bone.

malapropism.definition: A grotesque misuse of a word; a word so used.

pitch-faced.definition: Having the arris defined by a line beyond which the rock is cut away, so as to give nearly true edges; -- said of squared stones that are otherwise quarry-faced.

stillhouse.definition: A house in which distillation is carried on; a distillery.

rimple.definition:
A fold or wrinkle. See Rumple.

To rumple; to wrinkle.

roynish.definition: Mangy; scabby; hence, mean; paltry; troublesome. [Written also roinish.] "The roynish clown." Shak.

crafty.definition: Relating to, or characterized by, craft or skill; dexterous. "Crafty work." Piers Plowman. 2. Possessing dexterity; skilled; skillful. A noble crafty man of trees. Wyclif. 3. Skillful at deceiving others; characterized by craft; cunning; wily. "A pair of crafty knaves." Shak. With anxious care and c.

zinnia.definition: Any plant of the composite genus Zinnia, Mexican herbs with opposite leaves and large gay-colored blossoms. Zinnia elegans is the commonest species in cultivation.

conclavist.definition: One of the two ecclesiastics allowed to attend a cardinal in the conclave.

hyperbolically.definition: (Math.)  In the form of an hyperbola. 2. (Rhet.)  With exaggeration; in a manner to express more or less than the truth. Sir W. Raleigh.

fluviometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the height of water in a river; a river gauge.

examinership.definition: The office or rank of an examiner.

koel.definition: Any one of several species of cuckoos of the genus Eudynamys, found in India, the East Indies, and Australia. They deposit their eggs in the nests of other birds.

cast-iron.definition: Made of cast iron. Hence, Fig.: like cast iron; hardy; unyielding.

huer.definition: One who cries out or gives an alarm; specifically, a balker; a conder. See Balker.

disinvestiture.definition: The act of depriving of investiture. Ogilvie.

rabat.definition:
A polishing material made of potter's clay that has failed in baking.

(a) A clerical linen collar. (b) A kind of clerical scarf fitted to a collar; as, a black silk rabat.

naid.definition: Any one of numerous species of small, fresh-water, chætopod annelids of the tribe Naidina. They belong to the Oligochæta.

hematin.definition: Hematoxylin. 2. (Physiol. Chem.)  A bluish black, amorphous substance containing iron and obtained from blood. It exists the red blood corpuscles united with globulin, and the form of hemoglobin or oxyhemoglobin gives to the blood its red color.

mediaevals.definition: The people who lived in the Middle Ages. Ruskin.

twinkling.definition: The act of one who, or of that which, twinkles; a quick movement of the eye; a wink; a twinkle. Holland. 2. A shining with intermitted light; a scintillation; a sparkling; as, the twinkling of the stars. 3. The time of a wink; a moment; an instant. In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the las.

disprivilege.definition: To deprive of a privilege or privileges.

enteric.definition: Of or pertaining to the enteron, or alimentary canal; intestinal. Enteric fever (Med.), typhoid fever.

ideology.definition: The science of ideas. Stewart. 2. (Metaph.)  A theory of the origin of ideas which derives them exclusively from sensation. Note: By a double blunder in philosophy and Greek, idéologie . . . has in France become the name peculiarly distinctive of that philosophy of mind which exclusively derives our.

satanical.definition: Of or pertaining to Satan; having the qualities of Satan; resembling Satan; extremely malicious or wicked; devilish; infernal. "Satanic strength." "Satanic host." Milton. Detest the slander which, with a Satanic smile, exults over the character it has ruined. Dr. T. Dwight. -- Sa*tan"ic*al*ly, adv.

bailee.definition: The person to whom goods are committed in trust, and who has a temporary possession and a qualified property in them, for the purposes of the trust. Blackstone. Note: In penal statutes the word includes those who receive goods for another in good faith. Wharton.

unfertile.definition: Not fertile; infertile; barren. -- Un*fer"tile*ness, n.

northeaster.definition: A storm, strong wind, or gale, coming from the northeast.

turmeric.definition: (Bot.)  An East Indian plant of the genus Curcuma, of the Ginger family. 2. The root or rootstock of the Curcuma longa. It is externally grayish, but internally of a deep, lively yellow or saffron color, and has a slight aromatic smell, and a bitterish, slightly acrid taste. It is used for a dye, a.

ode.definition: A short poetical composition proper to be set to music or sung; a lyric poem; esp., now, a poem characterized by sustained noble sentiment and appropriate dignity of style. Hangs odes upon hawthorns and elegies on brambles. Shak. O! run; prevent them with thy humble ode, And lay it lowly at his bles.

swampy.definition: Consisting of swamp; like a swamp; low, wet, and spongy; as, swampy land.

oscines.definition: Singing birds; a group of the Passeres, having numerous syringeal muscles, conferring musical ability.

seniority.definition: The quality or state of being senior.

sematrope.definition: An instrument for signaling by reflecting the rays of the sun in different directions. Knight.

tarrier.definition:
One who, or that which, tarries.

A kind of dig; a terrier.

greeter.definition:
One who greets or salutes another.

One who weeps or mourns.

corrival.definition:
A fellow rival; a competitor; a rival; also, a companion. Shak.

Having rivaling claims; emulous; in rivalry. Bp. Fleetwood.

To compete with; to rival.

miner.definition: One who mines; a digger for metals, etc.; one engaged in the business of getting ore, coal, or precious stones, out of the earth; one who digs military mines; as, armies have sappers and miners. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) Any of numerous insects which, in the larval state, excavate galleries in the parenchyma o.

sequestration.definition: (a) (Civil & Com. Law) The act of separating, or setting aside, a thing in controversy from the possession of both the parties that contend for it, to be delivered to the one adjudged entitled to it. It may be voluntary or involuntary. (b) (Chancery) A prerogative process empowering certain commissi.

invigoration.definition: The act of invigorating, or the state of being invigorated.

usitative.definition: Denoting usual or customary action. "The usitative aorist." Alford.

fresh-water.definition: Of, pertaining to, or living in, water not salt; as, fresh-water geological deposits; a fresh-water fish; fresh-water mussels. 2. Accustomed to sail on fresh water only; unskilled as a seaman; as, a fresh-water sailor. 3. Unskilled; raw. "Fresh-water soldiers." Knolles.

imbroglio.definition: An intricate, complicated plot, as of a drama or work of fiction. 2. A complicated and embarrassing state of things; a serious misunderstanding. Wrestling to free itself from the baleful imbroglio. Carlyle.

vicinage.definition: The place or places adjoining or near; neighborhood; vicinity; as, a jury must be of the vicinage. "To summon the Protestant gentleman of the vicinage." Macaulay. Civil war had broken up all the usual ties of vicinage and good neighborhood. Sir W. Scott.

polyhedrical.definition: Having many sides, as a solid body. Polyhedral angle, an angle bounded by three or more plane angles having a common vertex.

stereogram.definition: A diagram or picture which represents objects in such a way as to give the impression of relief or solidity; also, a stereograph.

teaze-hole.definition: The opening in the furnaces through which fuel is introduced.

ding.definition:
To dash; to throw violently. To ding the book a coit's distance from him. Milton. 2. To cause to sound or ring. To ding (anything) in one's ears, to impress one by noisy repetition, as if by hammering.

1. To strike; to thump; to pound. Diken, or delven, or dingen upon sheaves. Piers Plowman. 2. To.

ethenyl.definition: (a) A trivalent hydrocarbon radical, CH3.C. (b) A univalent hydrocarbon radical of the ethylene series, CH2:CH; - - called also vinyl. See Vinyl.

lionship.definition: The state of being a lion. LION'S LEAF Li"on's leaf`. (Bot.)  A South European plant of the genus Leontice (L. leontopetalum), the tuberous roots of which contain so much alkali that they are sometimes used as a substitute for soap. LION'S TAIL Li"on's tail`. (Bot.)  A genus of labiate plants (Leonu.

outcry.definition: A vehement or loud cry; a cry of distress, alarm, opposition, or detestation; clamor. 2. Sale at public auction. Massinger. Thackeray.

betterness.definition: The quality of being better or superior; superiority. Sir P. Sidney. 2. The difference by which fine gold or silver exceeds in fineness the standard.

sabianism.definition: The doctrine of the Sabians; the Sabian religion; that species of idolatry which consists in worshiping the sun, moon, and stars; heliolatry. [Written also Sabæanism.].

clansman.definition: One belonging to the same clan with another.

budding.definition: The act or process of producing buds. 2. (Biol.)  A process of asexual reproduction, in which a new organism or cell is formed by a protrusion of a portion of the animal or vegetable organism, the bud thus formed sometimes remaining attached to the parent stalk or cell, at other times becoming free;.

jangling.definition:
Producing discordant sounds. "A jangling noise." Milton.

1. Idle babbling; vain disputation. From which some, having swerved, have turned aside unto vain jangling. 1 Tim. i. 6. 2. Wrangling; altercation. Lamb.

terpsichore.definition: The Muse who presided over the choral song and the dance, especially the latter.

moonstruck.definition: Mentally affected or deranged by the supposed influence of the moon; lunatic. 2. Produced by the supposed influence of the moon. "Moonstruck madness." Milton. 3. Made sick by the supposed influence of the moon, as a human being; made unsuitable for food, as fishes, by such supposed influence.

machining.definition: Of or pertaining to the machinery of a poem; acting or used as a machine. Dryden.

heterodromous.definition: (Bot.)  Having spirals of changing direction. Gray. 2. (Mech.)  Moving in opposite directions; -- said of a lever, pulley, etc., in which the resistance and the actuating force are on opposite sides of the fulcrum or axis.

genuflect.definition: To bend the knee, as in worship.

consentaneous.definition: Consistent; agreeable; suitable; accordant to; harmonious; concurrent. A good law and consentaneous to reason. Howell. -- Con`sen*ta"ne*ous*ly, adv. -- Con`sen*ta"ne*ous*ness, n.

lope.definition:
of Leap. And, laughing, lope into a tree. Spenser.

1. To leap; to dance. "He that lopes on the ropes." Middleton. 2. To move with a lope, as a horse. [U.S.]

1. A leap; a long step. 2. An easy gait, consisting of long running strides or leaps. [U.S.] The mustang goes rollicking ahead, with the eter.

gleg.definition: Quick of perception; alert; sharp. [Scot.] Jamieson.

apprehension.definition: The act of seizing or taking hold of; seizure; as, the hand is an organ of apprehension. Sir T. Browne. 2. The act of seizing or taking by legal process; arrest; as, the felon, after his apprehension, escaped. 3. The act of grasping with the intellect; the contemplation of things, without affirming,.

rice-shell.definition: Any one of numerous species of small white polished marine shells of the genus Olivella.

horn-mad.definition: Quite mad; -- raving crazy. Did I tell you about Mr. Garrick, that the town are horn-mad after Gray.

symmetrize.definition: To make proportional in its parts; to reduce to symmetry. Burke.

thuja.definition: A genus of evergreen trees, thickly branched, remarkable for the distichous arrangement of their branches, and having scalelike, closely imbricated, or compressed leaves. [Written also thuya.] See Thyine wood. Note: Thuja occidentalis is the Arbor vitæ of the Eastern and Northern United States. T. g.

safeness.definition: The quality or state of being safe; freedom from hazard, danger, harm, or loss; safety; security; as the safeness of an experiment, of a journey, or of a possession.

widower.definition: A man who has lost his wife by death, and has not married again. Shak.

elinguate.definition: To deprive of the tongue. Davies (Holy Roode).

turtling.definition: The act, practice, or art of catching turtles. Marryat.

estrange.definition: To withdraw; to withhold; hence, reflexively, to keep at a distance; to cease to be familiar and friendly with. We must estrange our belief from everything which is not clearly and distinctly evidenced. Glanvill. Had we . . . estranged ourselves from them in things indifferent. Hooker. 2. To divert.

monosaccharid.definition: A simple sugar; any of a number of sugars (including the trioses, tetroses, pentoses, hexoses, etc.), not decomposable into simpler sugars by hydrolysis. Specif., as used by some, a hexose. The monosaccharides are all open-chain compounds containing hydroxyl groups and either an aldehyde group or a.

crackajack.definition:
An individual of marked ability or excellence, esp. in some sport; as, he is a crackajack at tennis. [Slang] 2.  A preparation of popped corn, candied and pressed into small cakes. [U. S.]

Of marked ability or excellence. [Slang].

fluosilicate.definition: A double fluoride of silicon and some other (usually basic) element or radical, regarded as a salt of fluosilicic acid; -- called also silicofluoride.

gyp.definition: A college servant; -- so called in Cambridge, England; at Oxford called a scout. [Cant].

apologetical.definition: Defending by words or arguments; said or written in defense, or by way of apology; regretfully excusing; as, an apologetic essay. "To speak in a subdued and apologetic tone." Macaulay.

beloochee.definition: Of or pertaining to Beloochistan, or to its inhabitants. -- n.  A native or an inhabitant of Beloochistan.

contractility.definition: The quality or property by which bodies shrink or contract. 2. (Physiol.)  The power possessed by the fibers of living muscle of contracting or shortening. Note: When subject to the will, as in the muscles of locomotion, such power is called voluntary contractility; when not controlled by the will,.

theriacal.definition: Of or pertaining to theriac; medicinal. "Theriacal herbs." Bacon.

spherulate.definition: Covered or set with spherules; having one or more rows of spherules, or minute tubercles.

photo-electrical.definition: Pert. to, or capable of developing, photo-electricity.

foreship.definition: The fore part of a ship.

slipstring.definition: One who has shaken off restraint; a prodigal. Cotgrave.

christen.definition: To baptize and give a Christian name to. 2. To give a name; to denominate. "Christen the thing what you will." Bp. Burnet. 3. To Christianize. Jer. Taylor. 4. To use for the first time.

tithonic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or denoting, those rays of light which produce chemical effects; actinic.

angler.definition: One who angles. 2. (Zoöl.)  A fish (Lophius piscatorius), of Europe and America, having a large, broad, and depressed head, with the mouth very large. Peculiar appendages on the head are said to be used to entice fishes within reach. Called also fishing frog, frogfish, toadfish, goosefish, allmouth,.

antiquary.definition:
Pertaining to antiquity. "Instructed by the antiquary times." Shak.

One devoted to the study of ancient times through their relics, as inscriptions, monuments, remains of ancient habitations, statues, coins, manuscripts, etc.; one who searches for and studies the relics of antiquity.

overmast.definition: To furnish (a vessel) with too long or too heavy a mast or masts.

miserableness.definition: The state or quality of being miserable.

sigmoid.definition: Curved in two directions, like the letter S, or the Greek s. Sigmoid flexure (Anat.), the last curve of the colon before it terminates in the rectum. See Illust. under Digestive. -- Sigmoid valves. (Anat.) See Semilunar valves, under Semilunar.

lunitidal.definition: Pertaining to tidal movements dependent on the moon. Bache. Lunitidal interval. See Retard, n.

recoup.definition: (Law)  To keep back rightfully (a part), as if by cutting off, so as to diminish a sum due; to take off (a part) from damages; to deduct; as, where a landlord recouped the rent of premises from damages awarded to the plaintiff for eviction. 2. To get an equivalent or compensation for; as, to recoup.

sepal.definition: A leaf or division of the calyx. Note: When the calyx consists of but one part, it is said to be monosepalous; when of two parts, it is said to be disepalous; when of a variable and indefinite number of parts, it is said to be polysepalous; when of several parts united, it is properly called gamosep.

semiology.definition:
The science or art of signs. Specifically: (a) (Med.) The science of the signs or symptoms of disease; symptomatology. (b) The art of using signs in signaling.

Same as Semeiography, Semeiology, Semeiological.

renitency.definition: The state or quality of being renitent; resistance; reluctance. Sterne. We find a renitency in ourselves to ascribe life and irritability to the cold and motionless fibers of plants. E. Darwin.

peruse.definition: To observe; to examine with care. Myself I then perused, and limb by limb Surveyed. Milton. 2. To read through; to read carefully. Shak.

adminicular.definition: Supplying help; auxiliary; corroborative; explanatory; as, adminicular evidence. H. Spencer.

interlaminar.definition: Between lammellæ or laminæ; as, interlamellar spaces.

inhumanity.definition: The quality or state of being inhuman; cruelty; barbarity. Man's inhumanity to man Makes countless thousands mourn. Burns.

ocellated.definition: Resembling an eye. 2. Marked with eyelike spots of color; as, the ocellated blenny. Ocellated turkey (Zoöl.), the wild turkey of Central America (Meleagris ocellata).

mannish.definition: Resembling a human being in form or nature; human. Chaucer. But yet it was a figure Most like to mannish creature. Gower. 2. Resembling, suitable to, or characteristic of, a man, manlike, masculine. Chaucer. A woman impudent and mannish grown. Shak. 3. Fond of men; -- said of a woman. Chaucer. -- Ma.

thaumaturgist.definition: One who deals in wonders, or believes in them; a wonder worker. Carlyle.

bilaminate.definition: Formed of, or having, two laminæ, or thin plates.

entasia.definition: Tonic spasm; -- applied generically to denote any disease characterized by tonic spasms, as tetanus, trismus, etc.

lantern-jawed.definition: Having lantern jaws or long, thin jaws; as, a lantern-jawed person.

stagehouse.definition: A house where a stage regularly stops for passengers or a relay of horses.

dinosauria.definition: An order of extinct mesozoic reptiles, mostly of large size (whence the name). Notwithstanding their size, they present birdlike characters in the skeleton, esp. in the pelvis and hind limbs. Some walked on their three-toed hind feet, thus producing the large "bird tracks," so-called, of mesozoic sa.

bankrupt.definition: (Old Eng. Low)  A trader who secretes himself, or does certain other acts tending to defraud his creditors. Blackstone. 2. A trader who becomes unable to pay his debts; an insolvent trader; popularly, any person who is unable to pay his debts; an insolvent person. M 3. (Law)  A person who, in accord.

caboodle.definition: The whole collection; the entire quantity or number; -- usually in the phrase the whole caboodle. [Slang, U.S.] Bartlett.

supawn.definition: Boiled Indian meal; hasty pudding; mush. [Written also sepawn, sepon, and suppawn.] [Local, U.S.].

contradictoriness.definition: The quality of being contradictory; opposition; inconsistency. J. Whitaker.

racemed.definition: Arranged in a raceme, or in racemes.

electro-positive.definition: (Physics)  Of such a nature relatively to some other associated body or bodies, as to tend to the negative pole of a voltaic battery, in electrolysis, while the associated body tends to the positive pole; - - the converse or correlative of electro-negative. Note: An element that is electro-positive.

matriarchate.definition: The office or jurisdiction of a matriarch; a matriarchal form of government.

centumvir.definition: One of a court of about one hundred judges chosen to try civil suits. Under the empire the court was increased to 180, and met usually in four sections.

abstersive.definition:
Cleansing; purging. Bacon.

Something cleansing. The strong abstersive of some heroic magistrate. Milton.

dactylopterous.definition: Having the inferior rays of the pectoral fins partially or entirely free, as in the gurnards.

potency.definition: The quality or state of being potent; physical or moral power; inherent strength; energy; ability to effect a purpose; capability; efficacy; influence. "Drugs of potency." Hawthorne. A place of potency and away o' the state. Shak.

bureaucracy.definition: A system of carrying on the business of government by means of departments or bureaus, each under the control of a chief, in contradiction to a system in which the officers of government have an associated authority and responsibility; also, government conducted on this system. 2. Government officia.

arbitrariness.definition: The quality of being arbitrary; despoticalness; tyranny. Bp. Hall.

iconize.definition: To form an image or likeness of. Cudworth.

fritillaria.definition: A genus of liliaceous plants, of which the crown-imperial (Fritillaria imperialis) is one species, and the Guinea-hen flower (F. Meleagris) another. See Crown-imperial.

justle.definition:
To run or strike against each other; to encounter; to clash; to jostle. Shak. The chariots shall rage in the streets; they shall justle one against another in the broad ways. Nahum ii. 4.

To push; to drive; to force by running against; to jostle. We justled one another out, and disputed the post fo.

tableman.definition: A man at draughts; a piece used in playing games at tables. See Table, n., 10. Bacon.

coreopsis.definition: A genus of herbaceous composite plants, having the achenes two- horned and remotely resembling some insect; tickseed. C. tinctoria, of the Western plains, the commonest plant of the genus, has been used in dyeing.

syntonic.definition: Of or pert. to syntony; specif., designating, or pert. to, a system of wireless telegraphy in which the transmitting and receiving apparatus are in syntony with, and only with, one another. -- Syn*ton"ic*al (#), a. --Syn*ton"ic*al*ly, adv.

serpentine.definition:
Resembling a serpent; having the shape or qualities of a serpent; subtle; winding or turning one way and the other, like a moving serpent; anfractuous; meandering; sinuous; zigzag; as, serpentine braid. Thy shape Like his, and color serpentine. Milton.

1. (Min.)  A mineral or rock consisting chiefl.

photonephograph.definition: A nephoscope registering by photography, commonly consisting of a pair of cameras used simultaneously.

bel-accoyle.definition: A kind or favorable reception or salutation.

profanation.definition: The act of violating sacred things, or of treating them with contempt or irreverence; irreverent or too familiar treatment or use of what is sacred; desecration; as, the profanation of the Sabbath; the profanation of a sanctuary; the profanation of the name of God. 2. The act of treating with abuse.

tidal.definition: Of or pertaining to tides; caused by tides; having tides; periodically rising and falling, or following and ebbing; as, tidal waters. The tidal wave of deeper souls Into our inmost being rolls, And lifts us unawares Out of all meaner cares. Longfellow. Tidal air (Physiol.), the air which passes in a.

cerargyrite.definition: Native silver chloride, a mineral of a white to pale yellow or gray color, darkening on exposure to the light. It may be cut by a knife, like lead or horn (hence called horn silver).

chemosynthesis.definition: Synthesis of organic compounds by energy derived from chemical changes or reactions. Chemosynthesis of carbohydrates occurs in the nitrite bacteria through the oxidation of ammonia to nitrous acid, and in the nitrate bacteria through the conversion of nitrous into nitric acid. -- Chem`o*syn*thet"ic.

discloak.definition: To take off a cloak from; to uncloak. B. Jonson.

quinquevalvular.definition: Having five valves, as a pericarp.

masorite.definition: One of the writers of the Masora.

afflict.definition: To strike or cast down; to overthrow. "Reassembling our afflicted powers." Milton. 2. To inflict some great injury or hurt upon, causing continued pain or mental distress; to trouble grievously; to torment. They did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. Exod. i. 11. That whic.

pard.definition: A leopard; a panther. And more pinch-spotted make them Than pard or cat o'mountain. Shak.

gowk.definition:
To make a, booby of one); to stupefy. B. Jonson.

1. The European cuckoo; -- called also gawky. 2. A simpleton; a gawk or gawky.

pardoning.definition: Relating to pardon; having or exercising the right to pardon; willing to pardon; merciful; as, the pardoning power; a pardoning God.

skillet.definition: A small vessel of iron, copper, or other metal, with a handle, used for culinary purpose, as for stewing meat.

marcian.definition: Under the influence of Mars; courageous; bold. Chaucer.

whitleather.definition: Leather dressed or tawed with alum, salt, etc., remarkable for its pliability and toughness; white leather. 2. (Anat.)  The paxwax. See Paxwax.

backsettler.definition: One living in the back or outlying districts of a community. The English backsettlers of Leinster and Munster. Macaulay.

soler.definition: A loft or garret. See Solar, n. Sir W. Scott.

waxwork.definition: Work made of wax; especially, a figure or figures formed or partly of wax, in imitation of real beings. 2. (Bot.)  An American climbing shrub (Celastrus scandens). It bears a profusion of yellow berrylike pods, which open in the autumn, and display the scarlet coverings of the seeds.

accredit.definition: To put or bring into credit; to invest with credit or authority; to sanction. His censure will . . . accredit his praises. Cowper. These reasons . . . which accredit and fortify mine opinion. Shelton. 2. To send with letters credential, as an ambassador, envoy, or diplomatic agent; to authorize, as.

fantast.definition: One whose manners or ideas are fantastic. Coleridge.

psilanthropist.definition: One who believes that Christ was a mere man. Smart.

translocation.definition: removal of things from one place to another; substitution of one thing for another. There happened certain translocations at the deluge. Woodward.

velivolant.definition: Flying with sails; passing under full sail.

parietine.definition: A piece of a fallen wall; a ruin. Burton.

molder.definition:
One who, or that which, molds or forms into shape; specifically (Founding), one skilled in the art of making molds for castings.

To crumble into small particles; to turn to dust by natural decay; to lose form, or waste away, by a gradual separation of the component particles, without the presence o.

pronely.definition: In a prone manner or position.

monte-acid.definition: An acid elevator, as a tube through which acid is forced to some height in a sulphuric acid manufactory.

pernicious.definition:
Quick; swift (to burn). Milton.

Having the quality of injuring or killing; destructive; very mischievous; baleful; malicious; wicked. Let this pernicious hour Stand aye accursed in the calendar. Shak. Pernicious to his health. Prescott. Syn. -- Destructive; ruinous; deadly; noxious; injurious; bane.

zamia.definition: A genus of cycadaceous plants, having the appearance of low palms, but with exogenous wood. See Coontie, and Illust. of Strobile.

inequity.definition: Want of equity; injustice; wrong. "Some form of inequity." H. Spencer.

demency.definition: Dementia; loss of mental powers. See Insanity.

revest.definition:
To clothe again; to cover, as with a robe; to robe. Her, nathless, . . . the enchanterrevest and decked with due habiliments. Spenser. 2. To vest again with possession or office; as, to revest a magistrate with authority.

To take effect or vest again, as a title; to revert to former owner; as, the.

foussa.definition: A viverrine animal of Madagascar (Cryptoprocta ferox). It resembles a cat in size and form, and has retractile claws.

transporting.definition: That transports; fig., ravishing. Your transporting chords ring out. Keble.

longtail.definition: An animal, particularly a log, having an uncut tail. Cf. Curtail. Dog. Note: A longtail was a gentleman's dog, or the dog of one qualified to bunt, other dogs being required to have their tails cut. Cut and longtail, all, gentlefolks and others, as they might come. Shak.

renascent.definition: Springing or rising again into being; being born again, or reproduced. 2. See Renaissant.

inculpate.definition: To blame; to impute guilt to; to accuse; to involve or implicate in guilt. That risk could only exculpate her and not inculpate them -- the probabilities protected them so perfectly. H. James.

exacerbation.definition: The act rendering more violent or bitter; the state of being exacerbated or intensified in violence or malignity; as, exacerbation of passion. 2. (Med.)  A periodical increase of violence in a disease, as in remittent or continious fever; an increased energy of diseased and painful action.

allegorical.definition: Belonging to, or consisting of, allegory; of the nature of an allegory; describing by resemblances; figurative. "An allegoric tale." Falconer. "An allegorical application." Pope. Allegorical being . . . that kind of language which says one thing, but means another. Max Miller. Al`le*gor"ic*al*ly, ad.

distressing.definition:
Causing distress; painful; unpleasant.

In a distressing manner.

oust.definition:
See Oast.

1. To take away; to remove. Multiplication of actions upon the case were rare, formerly, and thereby wager of law ousted. Sir M. Hale. 2. To eject; to turn out. Blackstone. From mine own earldom foully ousted me. Tennyson.

sheldrake.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of several species of large Old World ducks of the genus Tadorna and allied genera, especially the European and Asiatic species. winkle-hawk.definition: A rectangular rent made in cloth; -- called also winkle-hole. [Local, U. S.] Bartlett.

medicamental.definition: Of or pertaining to medicaments or healing applications; having the qualities of medicaments. -- Med`ica*men"tal*ly, adv.

cortex.definition: Bark, as of a tree; hence, an outer covering. 2. (Med.)  Bark; rind; specifically, cinchona bark. 3. (Anat.)  The outer or superficial part of an organ; as, the cortex or gray exterior substance of the brain.

forger.definition: One who forges, makes, of forms; a fabricator; a falsifier. 2. Especially: One guilty of forgery; one who makes or issues a counterfeit document.

arest.definition: A support for the spear when couched for the attack. Chaucer.

gainsome.definition: Gainful. 2. Prepossessing; well-favored. Massinger. 'GAINST; GAINST Gainst, prep.  A contraction of Against.

progressist.definition: One who makes, or holds to, progress; a progressionist.

presignify.definition: To intimate or signify beforehand; to presage.

diorama.definition: A mode of scenic representation, invented by Daguerre and Bouton, in which a painting is seen from a distance through a large opening. By a combination of transparent and opaque painting, and of transmitted and reflected light, and by contrivances such as screens and shutters, much diversity of scen.

overbend.definition:
To bend to excess.

To bend over.

inflex.definition: To bend; to cause to become curved; to make crooked; to deflect. J. Philips.

vidual.definition: Of or pertaining to the state of a widow; widowed. Jer. Taylor.

intercourse.definition: A This sweet intercourse Of looks and smiles. Milton. Sexual intercourse, sexual or carnal connection; coition. Syn. -- Communication; connection; commerce; communion; fellowship; familiarity; acquaintance.

marquetry.definition: Inlaid work; work inlaid with pieces of wood, shells, ivory, and the like, of several colors.

cyclas.definition: A long gown or surcoat (cut off in front), worn in the Middle Ages. It was sometimes embroidered or interwoven with gold. Also, a rich stuff from which the gown was made.

nonmetallic.definition: Not metallic. 2. (Chem.)  Resembling, or possessing the properties of, a nonmetal or metalloid; as, sulphur is a nonmetallic element.

set-off.definition: That which is set off against another thing; an offset. I do not contemplate such a heroine as a set-off to the many sins imputed to me as committed against woman. D. Jerrold. 2. That which is used to improve the appearance of anything; a decoration; an ornament. 3. (Law)  A counterclaim; a cross de.

tonsure.definition: The act of clipping the hair, or of shaving the crown of the head; also, the state of being shorn. 2. (R. C. Ch.) chlorite.definition:
The name of a group of minerals, usually of a green color and micaceous to granular in structure. They are hydrous silicates of alumina, iron, and magnesia. Chlorite slate, a schistose or slaty rock consisting of alumina, iron, and magnesia.

Any salt of chlorous acid; as, chlorite of sodium.

lignin.definition: A substance characterizing wood cells and differing from cellulose in its conduct with certain chemical reagents. Note: Recent authors have distinguished four forms of this substance, naming them lignose, lignin, lignone, and lignireose.

calumny.definition: False accusation of a crime or offense, maliciously made or reported, to the injury of another; malicious misrepresentation; slander; detraction. "Infamouse calumnies." Motley. Be thou as chaste as ice, as pure as snow, thou shalt not escape calumny. Shak.

epichorial.definition: In or of the country. Epichorial superstitions from every district of Europe. De Quincey.

climacteric.definition:
Relating to a climacteric; critical.

1. A period in human life in which some great change is supposed to take place in the constitution. The critical periods are thought by some to be the years produced by multiplying 7 into the odd numbers 3, 5, 7, and 9; to which others add the 81st year. 2. Any.

nominalism.definition: The principles or philosophy of the Nominalists.

bund.definition:
League; confederacy; esp. the confederation of German states.

An embankment against inundation. [India] S. Wells Williams.

bowery.definition:
Shading, like a bower; full of bowers. A bowery maze that shades the purple streams. Trumbull.

A farm or plantation with its buildings. [U.S.Hist.] The emigrants [in New York] were scattered on boweries or plantations; and seeing the evils of this mode of living widely apart, they were advised, in.

inverness.definition: A kind of full sleeveless cape, fitting closely about the neck. Robert's wind-blown head and tall form wrapped in an Inverness cape. Mrs. Humphry Ward.

evolation.definition: A flying out or up. Bp. Hall.

microbacteria.definition: In the classification of Cohn, one of the four tribes of Bacteria. Note: In this classification bacteria are divided into four tribes: 1. Spherobacteria, or spherical bacteria, as the genus Micrococcus. 2. Microbacteria, or bacteria in the form of short rods, including the genus Bacterium. 3. Desmob.

ambassadorial.definition: Of or pertaining to an ambassador. H. Walpole.

sweaty.definition: Moist with sweat; as, a sweaty skin; a sweaty garment. 2. Consisting of sweat; of the nature of sweat. No noisome whiffs or sweaty streams. Swift. 3. Causing sweat; hence, laborious; toilsome; difficult. "The sweaty forge." Prior.

ascititious.definition: Supplemental; not inherent or original; adscititious; additional; assumed. Homer has been reckoned an ascititious name. Pope.

amatorial.definition: Of or pertaining to a lover or to love making; amatory; as, amatorial verses.

hardwareman.definition: One who makes, or deals in, hardware.

adhesion.definition: The action of sticking; the state of being attached; intimate union; as the adhesion of glue, or of parts united by growth, cement, or the like. 2. Adherence; steady or firm attachment; fidelity; as, to error, to a policy. His adhesion to the Tories was bounded by his approbation of their foreign po.

diarchy.definition: A form of government in which the supreme power is vested in two persons.

obstructionist.definition: One who hinders progress; one who obstructs business, as in a legislative body. -- a.  Of or pertaining to obstructionists. [Recent].

alkahest.definition: The fabled "universal solvent" of the alchemists; a menstruum capable of dissolving all bodies. -- Al`ka*hes"tic, a.

sadiron.definition: An iron for smoothing clothes; a flatiron.

prosaicism.definition: The quality or state of being prosaic; a prosaic manner or style. Poe.

saxhorn.definition: A name given to a numerous family of brass wind instruments with valves, invented by Antoine Joseph Sax (known as Adolphe Sax), of Belgium and Paris, and much used in military bands and in orchestras.

low-churchmanship.definition: The state of being a low-churchman.

aphyllous.definition: Destitute of leaves, as the broom rape, certain euphorbiaceous plants, etc.

maturation.definition: The process of bringing, or of coming, to maturity; hence, specifically, the process of suppurating perfectly; the formation of pus or matter.

tithly.definition: Tightly; nimbly. "I have seen him trip it tithly." Beau. & Fl.

southmost.definition: Farthest toward the south; southernmost. Milton.

denote.definition: To mark out plainly; to signify by a visible sign; to serve as the sign or name of; to indicate; to point out; as, the hands of the clock denote the hour. The better to denote her to the doctor. Shak. 2. To be the sign of; to betoken; to signify; to mean. A general expression to denote wickedness of.

cirripedia.definition: An order of Crustacea including the barnacles. When adult, they have a calcareous shell composed of several pieces. From the opening of the shell the animal throws out a group of curved legs, looking like a delicate curl, whence the name of the group. See Anatifa.

hollowness.definition: State of being hollow. Bacon. 2. Insincerity; unsoundness; treachery. South.

facient.definition: One who does anything, good or bad; a doer; an agent. Br. Hacket. 2. (Mach.) (a) One of the variables of a quantic as distinguished from a coefficient. (b) The multiplier. Note: The terms facient, faciend, and factum, may imply that the multiplication involved is not ordinary multiplication, but is.

inhabitation.definition: The act of inhabiting, or the state of being inhabited; indwelling. The inhabitation of the Holy Ghost. Bp. Pearson. 2. Abode; place of dwelling; residence. Milton. 3. Population; inhabitants. Sir T. Browne. The beginning of nations and of the world's inhabitation. Sir W. Raleigh.

phenakistoscope.definition: A revolving disk on which figures drawn in different relative attitudes are seen successively, so as to produce the appearance of an object in actual motion, as an animal leaping, etc., in consequence of the persistence of the successive visual impressions of the retina. It is often arranged so that.

opinable.definition: Capable of being opined or thought. Holland.

gibe.definition:
To cast reproaches and sneering expressions; to rail; to utter taunting, sarcastic words; to flout; to fleer; to scoff. Fleer and gibe, and laugh and flout. Swift.

To reproach with contemptuous words; to deride; to scoff at; to mock. Draw the beasts as I describe them, From their features, while I.

mongoos.definition: A species of ichneumon (Herpestes griseus), native of India. Applied also to other allied species, as the African banded mongoose (Crossarchus fasciatus). [Written also mungoose, mungoos, mungous.].

animative.definition: Having the power of giving life or spirit. Johnson.

auriphrygiate.definition: Embroidered or decorated with gold. Southey.

ebullition.definition: A boiling or bubbling up of a liquid; the motion produced in a liquid by its rapid conversion into vapor. 2. Effervescence occasioned by fermentation or by any other process which causes the liberation of a gas or an aëriform fluid, as in the mixture of an acid with a carbonated alkali. [Formerly wr.

souter.definition: A shoemaker; a cobbler. Chaucer. There is no work better than another to please God: . . . to wash dishes, to be a souter, or an apostle, -- all is one. Tyndale.

photolithographic.definition: Of or pertaining to photolithography; produced by photolithography.

pecora.definition: An extensive division of ruminants, including the antelopes, deer, and cattle.

precipitant.definition: Falling or rushing headlong; rushing swiftly, violently, or recklessly; moving precipitately. They leave their little lives Above the clouds, precipitant to earth. J. Philips. Should he return, that troop so blithe and bold, Precipitant in fear would wing their flight. Pope. 2. Unexpectedly or fooli.

manuducent.definition: One who leads by the hand; a manuductor.

teste.definition: (a) A witness. (b) The witnessing or concluding clause, duty attached; -- said of a writ, deed, or the like. Burrill.

monstrously.definition: In a monstrous manner; unnaturally; extraordinarily; as, monstrously wicked. "Who with his wife is monstrously in love." Dryden.

trachelorrhaphy.definition: The operation of sewing up a laceration of the neck of the uterus.

bathybius.definition: A name given by Prof. Huxley to a gelatinous substance found in mud dredged from the Atlantic and preserved in alcohol. He supposed that it was free living protoplasm, covering a large part of the ocean bed. It is now known that the substance is of chemical, not of organic, origin.

acidify.definition: To make acid; to convert into an acid; as, to acidify sugar. 2. To sour; to imbitter. His thin existence all acidified into rage. Carlyle.

equitation.definition: A riding, or the act of riding, on horseback; horsemanship. The pretender to equitation mounted. W. Irving.

latirostres.definition: The broad-billed singing birds, such as the swallows, and their allies.

stramazoun.definition: A direct descending blow with the edge of a sword. B. Jonson.

fricace.definition: Meat sliced and dressed with strong sauce. King. 2. An unguent; also, the act of rubbing with the unguent.

gallstone.definition: A concretion, or calculus, formed in the gall bladder or biliary passages. See Calculus, n., 1.

algerine.definition:
Of or pertaining to Algiers or Algeria.

A native or one of the people of Algiers or Algeria. Also, a pirate.

psychozoic.definition: Designating, or applied to the Era of man; as, the psychozoic era.

senescence.definition: The state of growing old; decay by time.

embryogenic.definition: Pertaining to the development of an embryo.

supercelestial.definition: Situated above the firmament, or great vault of heaven. Waterland. 2. Higher than celestial; superangelic.

depart.definition: To part; to divide; to separate. Shak. 2. To go forth or away; to quit, leave, or separate, as from a place or a person; to withdraw; -- opposed to arrive; -- often with from before the place, person, or thing left, and for or to before the destination. I will depart to mine own land. Num. x. 30. Er.

barbarian.definition: A foreigner. [Historical] Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me. 2. A man in a rule, savage, or uncivilized state. 3. A person destitute of culture. M. Arnold. 4. A cruel, savage, brutal man;.

lexicon.definition: A vocabulary, or book containing an alphabetical arrangement of the words in a language or of a considerable number of them, with the definition of each; a dictionary; especially, a dictionary of the Greek, Hebrew, or Latin language.

ruff.definition:
(a) A game similar to whist, and the predecessor of it. Nares. (b) The act of trumping, especially when one has no card of the suit led.

To trump.

1. A muslin or linen collar plaited, crimped, or fluted, worn formerly by both sexes, now only by women and children. Here to-morrow with his best ruff.

lincture.definition: Medicine taken by licking with the tongue.

obsignatory.definition: Ratifying; confirming by sealing. Samuel Ward (1643).

isocyanuric.definition: Designating, or pertaining to, an acid isomeric with cyanuric acid, and called also fulminuric acid. See under Fulminuric.

clumpy.definition: Composed of clumps; massive; shapeless. Leigh Hunt.

soupcon.definition: A suspicion; a suggestion; hence, a very small portion; a taste; as, coffee with a soupçon of brandy; a soupçon of coquetry.

stomatoscope.definition: An apparatus for examining the interior of the mouth.

crump.definition: Crooked; bent. Crooked backs and crump shoulders. Jer. Taylor. 2. Hard or crusty; dry baked; as, a crump loaf. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Hallivell.

ptenoglossate.definition: Of or pertaining to the Ptenoglossa.

meccawee.definition: Of or pertaining to Mecca, in Arabia. -- n.  A native or inhabitant of Mecca.

quadriceps.definition: The great extensor muscle of the knee, divided above into four parts which unite in a single tendon at the knee.

pragmatize.definition: To consider, represent, or embody (something unreal) as fact; to materialize. "A pragmatized metaphor." Tylor.

sticked.definition: Stuck. And in the sand her ship sticked so fast. Chaucer. They sticked not to give their bodies to be burnt. Sir T. Browne.

disappointment.definition: The act of disappointing, or the state of being disappointed; defeat or failure of expectation or hope; miscarriage of design or plan; frustration. If we hope for things of which we have not thoroughly considered the value, our disappointment will be greater our pleasure in the fruition of them. Add.

ipecac.definition: An abbreviation of Ipecacuanha, and in more frequent use.

dilaniation.definition: A rending or tearing in pieces; dilaceration.

oestrian.definition: Of or pertaining to the gadflies. -- n.  A gadfly.

appropriament.definition: What is peculiarly one's own; peculiar qualification. If you can neglect Your own appropriaments. Ford.

oblateness.definition: The quality or state of being oblate.

dissilient.definition: Starting asunder; bursting and opening with an elastic force; dehiscing explosively; as, a dissilient pericarp.

anagrammatic.definition: Pertaining to, containing, or making, anagram. -- An`a*gram*mat"ic*al*ly, adv.

astacus.definition: A genus of crustaceans, containing the crawfish of fresh-water lobster of Europe, and allied species of western North America. See Crawfish.

demure.definition: Of sober or serious mien; composed and decorous in bearing; of modest look; staid; grave. Sober, steadfast, and demure. Milton. Nan was very much delighted in her demure way, and that delight showed itself in her face and in her clear bright eyes. W. Black. 2. Affectedly modest, decorous, or serious.

berate.definition: To rate or chide vehemently; to scold. Holland. Motley.

tanka.definition: A kind of boat used in Canton. It is about 25 feet long and is often rowed by women. Called also tankia. S. W. Williams.

antipodagric.definition: Good against gout. -- n.  A medicine for gout.

laundering.definition: The act, or occupation, of one who launders; washing and ironing.

hydrophid.definition: Any sea snake of the genus Hydrophys and allied genera. These snakes are venomous, live upon fishes, and have a flattened tail for swimming.

irreligiousness.definition: The state or quality of being irreligious; ungodliness.

virgo.definition: (a) A sign of the zodiac which the sun enters about the 21st of August, marked thus [ (b) A constellation of the zodiac, now occupying chiefly the sign Libra, and containing the bright star Spica.

mavournin.definition: My darling; -- an Irish term of endearment for a girl or woman. "Erin mavournin."  Campbell.

denomination.definition: The act of naming or designating. 2. That by which anything is denominated or styled; an epithet; a name, designation, or title; especially, a general name indicating a class of like individuals; a category; as, the denomination of units, or of thousands, or of fourths, or of shillings, or of tons.

terrestrify.definition: To convert or reduce into a condition like that of the earth; to make earthy. Sir T. Browne.

facingly.definition: In a facing manner or position.

religionism.definition: The practice of, or devotion to, religion. 2. Affectation or pretense of religion.

disenchant.definition: To free from enchantment; to deliver from the power of charms or spells; to free from fascination or delusion. Haste to thy work; a noble stroke or two Ends all the charms, and disenchants the grove. Dryden.

tolylene.definition: A hydrocarbon radical, C6H4.(CH2)2, regarded as characteristic of certain toluene derivatives.

antinomian.definition:
Of or pertaining to the Antinomians; opposed to the doctrine that the moral law is obligatory.

One who maintains that, under the gospel dispensation, the moral law is of no use or obligation, but that faith alone is necessary to salvation. The sect of Antinomians originated with John Agricola, in G.

dwale.definition: (Bot.)  The deadly nightshade (Atropa Belladonna), having stupefying qualities. 2. (Her.)  The tincture sable or black when blazoned according to the fantastic system in which plants are substituted for the tinctures. 3. A sleeping potion; an opiate. Chaucer.

lactim.definition: One of a series of anhydrides resembling the lactams, but of an imido type; as, isatine is a lactim. Cf. Lactam.

foxlike.definition: Resembling a fox in his characteristic qualities; cunning; artful; foxy.

breathe.definition: To respire; to inhale and exhale air; hence;, to live. "I am in health, I breathe." Shak. Breathes there a man with soul so dead Sir W. Scott. 2. To take breath; to rest from action. Well! breathe awhile, and then to it again! Shak. 3. To pass like breath; noiselessly or gently; to exhale; to emanat.

nexus.definition: Connection; tie. Man is doubtless one by some subtile nexus ... extending from the new-born infant to the superannuated dotard. De Quincey.

cadastral.definition: Of or pertaining to landed property. Cadastral survey, or Cadastral map, a survey, map, or plan on a large scale (Usually topographical map, which exaggerates the dimensions of houses and the breadth of roads and streams, for the sake of distinctness. Brande & C.

youthly.definition: Young; youthful. "All my youthly days." Spenser.

incensebreathing.definition: Breathing or exhaling incense. "Incense-breathing morn." Gray.

sain.definition:
Said. Shak.

To sanctify; to bless so as to protect from evil influence. Sir W. Scott.

decalcify.definition: To deprive of calcareous matter; thus, to decalcify bones is to remove the stony part, and leave only the gelatin.

sanctimony.definition: Holiness; devoutness; scrupulous austerity; sanctity; especially, outward or artificial saintliness; assumed or pretended holiness; hypocritical devoutness. Her pretense is a pilgrimage; . . . which holy undertaking with most austere sanctimony she accomplished. Shak.

unde.definition: Waving or wavy; -- applied to ordinaries, or division lines.

biogenist.definition: A believer in the theory of biogenesis.

heptylene.definition: A colorless liquid hydrocarbon, C7H14, of the ethylene series; also, any one of its isomers. Called also heptene.

travesty.definition:
Disguised by dress so as to be ridiculous; travestied; -- applied to a book or shorter composition.

A burlesque translation or imitation of a work. The second edition is not a recast, but absolutely a travesty of the first. De Quincey.

To translate, imitate, or represent, so as to render ridiculou.

dross.definition: The scum or refuse matter which is thrown off, or falls from, metals in smelting the ore, or in the process of melting; recrement. 2. Rust of metals. Addison. 3. Waste matter; any worthless matter separated from the better part; leavings; dregs; refuse. All world's glory is but dross unclean. Spense.

pumpernickel.definition: A sort of bread, made of unbolted rye, which forms the chief food of the Westphalian peasants. It is acid but nourishing.

negligence.definition: The quality or state of being negligent; lack of due diligence or care; omission of duty; habitual neglect; heedlessness. 2. An act or instance of negligence or carelessness. remarking his beauties, ... I must also point out his negligences and defects. Blair. 3. (Law)  The omission of the care usua.

moon-eye.definition: A eye affected by the moon; also, a disease in the eye of a horse. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) Any species of American fresh-water fishes of the genus Hyodon, esp. H. tergisus of the Great Lakes and adjacent waters. (b) The cisco.

nauseate.definition:
To become squeamish; to feel nausea; to turn away with disgust.

1. To affect with nausea; to sicken; to cause to feel loathing or disgust. 2. To sicken at; to reject with disgust; to loathe. The patient nauseates and loathes wholesome foods. Blackmore.

witwal.definition: (a) The golden oriole. (b) The greater spotted woodpecker.

fatuous.definition: Feeble in mind; weak; silly; stupid; foolish; fatuitous. Glanvill. 2. Without reality; illusory, like the ignis fatuus. Thence fatuous fires and meteors take their birth. Danham.

pinetum.definition: A plantation of pine trees; esp., a collection of living pine trees made for ornamental or scientific purposes.

brayer.definition:
An implement for braying and spreading ink in hand printing.

One that brays like an ass. Pope.

dern.definition:
A gatepost or doorpost. [Local Eng.] C. Kingsley.

1. Hidden; concealed; secret. "Ye must be full dern." Chaucer. 2. Solitary; sad. Dr. H. More.

rhizine.definition: A rootlike filament or hair growing from the stems of mosses or on lichens; a rhizoid.

salep.definition: The dried tubers of various species of Orchis, and Eulophia. It is used to make a nutritious beverage by treating the powdered preparation with hot water. U. S. Disp.

concatenate.definition: To link together; to unite in a series or chain, as things depending on one another. This all things friendly will concatenate. Dr. H. More.

clatch.definition:
A soft or sloppy lump or mass; as, to throw a clatch of mud. 2.  Anything put together or made in a careless or slipshod way; hence, a sluttish or slipshod woman.

To daub or smear, as with lime; to make or finish in a slipshod way. [Scot.].

misy.definition: An impure yellow sulphate of iron; yellow copperas or copiapite.

zoographer.definition: One who describes animals, their forms and habits.

eared.definition: Having (such or so many) ears; -- used in composition; as, long- eared-eared; sharp-eared; full-eared; ten-eared. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having external ears; having tufts of feathers resembling ears. Eared owl (Zoöl.), an owl having earlike tufts of feathers, as the long-eared owl, and short-eared owl. -- Ear.

ornithologist.definition: One skilled in ornithology; a student of ornithology; one who describes birds.

coll.definition: To embrace. "They coll and kiss him." Latimer.

sleuth.definition: The track of man or beast as followed by the scent. [Scot.] Halliwell.

counterirritate.definition: To produce counter irritation in; to treat with one morbid process for the purpose of curing another.

sleight.definition: Cunning; craft; artful practice. "His sleight and his covin." Chaucer. 2. An artful trick; sly artifice; a feat so dexterous that the manner of performance escapes observation. The world hath many subtle sleights. Latimer. 3. Dexterous practice; dexterity; skill. Chaucer. "The juggler's sleight." Hu.

imbrocata.definition: A hit or thrust. B. Jonson.

auricular.definition: Of or pertaining to the ear, or to the sense of hearing; as, auricular nerves. 2. Told in the ear, i. e., told privately; as, auricular confession to the priest. This next chapter is a penitent confession of the king, and the strangest . . . that ever was auricular. Milton. 3. Recognized by the ear;.

moot-house.definition: A hall for public meetings; a hall of judgment. "The moot-hall of Herod." Wyclif.

ret.definition:
See Aret. Chaucer.

To prepare for use, as flax, by separating the fibers from the woody part by process of soaking, macerating, and other treatment. Ure.

tupian.definition: Designating, or pert. to, a linguistic stock of South American Indians comprising the most important Brazilian tribes. Agriculture, pottery, and stone working were practiced by them at the time of the conquest. The Tupi and the Guarani were originally the most powerful of the stock, which is hence a.

esophagus.definition: That part of the alimentary canal between the pharynx and the stomach; the gullet. See Illust. of Digestive apparatus, under Digestive. [Written also .].

malign.definition: Having an evil disposition toward others; harboring violent enmity; malevolent; malicious; spiteful; -- opposed to benign. Witchcraft may be by operation of malign spirits. Bacon. 2. Unfavorable; unpropitious; pernicious; tending to injure; as, a malign aspect of planets. 3. Malignant; as, a malign.

typal.definition: Relating to a type or types; belonging to types; serving as a type; typical. Owen.
