disobedience.definition: Neglect or refusal to obey; violation of a command or prohibition. He is undutiful to him other actions, and lives in open disobedience. Tillotson.

fleam.definition: A sharp instrument used for opening veins, lancing gums, etc.; a kind of lancet. Fleam tooth, a tooth of a saw shaped like an isosceles triangle; a peg tooth. Knight.

cafenet.definition: A humble inn or house of rest for travelers, where coffee is sold. [Turkey].

amorosity.definition: The quality of being amorous; lovingness. Galt.

transcendence.definition: The quality or state of being transcendent; superior excellence; supereminence. The Augustinian theology rests upon the transcendence of Deity at its controlling principle. A. V. G. Allen. 2. Elevation above truth; exaggeration. "Where transcendencies are more allowed." Bacon.

turko.definition: One of a body of native Algerian tirailleurs in the French army, dressed as a Turk. [Written also Turco.].

backsaw.definition: A saw (as a tenon saw) whose blade is stiffened by an added metallic back.

bestrew.definition: To strew or scatter over; to besprinkle. [Spelt also bestrow.] Milton.

patent-hammered.definition: Having a surface dressed by cutting with a hammer the head of which consists of broad thin chisels clamped together.

jugger.definition: An East Indian falcon. See Lugger.

vulnerary.definition: Useful in healing wounds; adapted to the cure of external injuries; as, vulnerary plants or potions. "Such vulnerary remedies." Sir W. Scott. -- n. Etym: [Cf. F. vulnéraire.] (Med.)  A vulnerary remedy.

benzile.definition: A yellowish crystalline substance, C6H5.CO.CO.C6H5, formed from benzoin by the action of oxidizing agents, and consisting of a doubled benzoyl radical.

ptyxis.definition: The way in which a leaf is sometimes folded in the bud.

agnostic.definition:
Professing ignorance; involving no dogmatic; pertaining to or involving agnosticism. -- Ag*nos"tic*al*ly, adv.

One who professes ignorance, or denies that we have any knowledge, save of phenomena; one who supports agnosticism, neither affirming nor denying the existence of a personal Deity, a futur.

gynecology.definition: The science which treats of the structure and diseases of women. -- Gyn`e*col"o*gist.

bonbon.definition: Sugar confectionery; a sugarplum; hence, any dainty.

murrelet.definition: One of several species of sea birds of the genera Synthliboramphus and Brachyramphus, inhabiting the North Pacific. They are closely related to the murres.

tride.definition: Short and ready; fleet; as, a tride pace; -- a term used by sportsmen. Bailey.

panspermic.definition: Of or pertaining to panspermy; as, the panspermic hypothesis.

amends.definition: Compensation for a loss or injury; recompense; reparation. [Now const. with sing. verb.] "An honorable amends." Addison. Yet thus far fortune maketh us amends. Shak.

gorgonize.definition: To have the effect of a Gorgon upon; to turn into stone; to petrify.

demolisher.definition: One who, or that which, demolishes; as, a demolisher of towns.

crossruff.definition: The play in whist where partners trump each a different suit, and lead to each other for that purpose; -- called also seesaw.

anthology.definition: A discourses on flowers. 2. A collection of flowers; a garland. 3. A collection of flowers of literature, that is, beautiful passages from authors; a collection of poems or epigrams; -- particularly applied to a collection of ancient Greek epigrams. 4. (Gr. Ch.)  A service book containing a selectio.

virgularian.definition: Any one of numerous species of long, slender Alcyonaria belonging to Virgularia and allied genera of the family Virgularidæ. These corals are allied to the sea-pens, but have a long rodlike rhachis inclosing a slender, round or square, calcareous axis. The polyps are arranged in transverse rows or c.

pneumogastric.definition: Of or pertaining to the lungs and the stomach. -- n.  The pneumogastric nerve. Pneumogastric nerve (Anat.), one of the tenth pair of cranial nerves which are distributed to the pharynx, esophagus, larynx, lungs, heart, stomach, liver, and spleen, and, in fishes and many amphibia, to the branchial ap.

bayard.definition: Etym: [OF. bayard, baiart, bay horse; bai bay + -ard. See Bay, a., and -ard.]  Properly, a bay horse, but often any horse. Commonly in the phrase blind bayard, an old blind horse. Blind bayard moves the mill. Philips. 2. Etym: [Cf. F. bayeur, fr. bayer to gape.]  A stupid, clownish fellow. B. Jonson.

bullfighting.definition: A barbarous sport, of great antiquity, in which men torment, and fight with, a bull or bulls in an arena, for public amusement, -- still popular in Spain. -- Bull"fight`er (, n.

snarler.definition:
One who snarls; a surly, growling animal; a grumbling, quarrelsome fellow.

One who makes use of a snarling iron.

bismuthine.definition: Native bismuth sulphide; -- sometimes called bismuthite.

piprine.definition: Of or pertaining to the pipras, or the family Pipridæ.

pyrocoll.definition: A yellow crystalline substance allied to pyrrol, obtained by the distillation of gelatin.

stultiloquy.definition: Foolish talk; silly discource; babbling. Jer. Taylor.

panshon.definition: An earthen vessel wider at the top than at the bottom, -- used for holding milk and for various other purposes. Halliwell.

urn-shaped.definition: Having the shape of an urn; as, the urn-shaped capsules of some mosses.

intemperament.definition: A bad state; as, the intemperament of an ulcerated part. Harvey.

pasteurize.definition: To subject to pasteurization. 2. To treat by pasteurizm.

glumpy.definition: Glum; sullen; sulky. "He was glumpy enough." T. Hook.

gerah.definition: A small coin and weight; 1-20th of a shekel. Note: The silver gerah is supposed to have been worth about three cents; the gold about fifty-four cents; the weight equivalent to about thirteen grains.

way-going.definition: Going away; departing; of or pertaining to one who goes away. Way-going crop (Law of Leases), a crop of grain to which tenants for years are sometimes entitled by custom; grain sown in the fall to be reaped at the next harvest; a crop which will not ripen until after the termination of the lease. Bu.

alluring.definition: That allures; attracting; charming; tempting. -- Al*lur"ing*ly, adv. -- Al*lur"ing*ness, n.

box-iron.definition: A hollow smoothing iron containing a heater within.

presphenoid.definition: Situated in front of the sphenoid bone; of or pertaining to the anterior part of the sphenoid bone (i. e., the presphenoid bone). Presphenoid bone (Anat.), the anterior part of the body of the sphenoid bone in front of the basisphenoid. It is usually a separate bone in the young or fetus, but become.

principality.definition: Sovereignty; supreme power; hence, superiority; predominance; high, or the highest, station. Sir P. Sidney. Your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory. Jer. xiii. 18. The prerogative and principality above everything else. Jer. Taylor. 2. A prince; one invested with sovereignt.

fan-nerved.definition: Having the nerves or veins arranged in a radiating manner; -- said of certain leaves, and of the winfs of some insects.

countryman.definition: An inhabitant or native of a region. Shak. 2. One born in the same country with another; a compatriot; -- used with a possessive pronoun. In perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen. 2 Cor. xi. 26. 3. One who dwells in the country, as distinguished from a townsman or.

klamaths.definition: A collective name for the Indians of several tribes formerly living along the Klamath river, in California and Oregon, but now restricted to a reservation at Klamath Lake; -- called also Clamets and Hamati.

redemptive.definition: Serving or tending to redeem; redeeming; as, the redemptive work of Christ.

crocin.definition: (a) The coloring matter of Chinese yellow pods, the fruit of Gardenia grandiflora. Watts. (b) A red powder (called also polychroite), which is made from the saffron (Crocus sativus). See Polychroite.

whim.definition:
The European widgeon.

1. A sudden turn or start of the mind; a temporary eccentricity; a freak; a fancy; a capricious notion; a humor; a caprice. Let every man enjoy his whim. Churchill. 2. (Mining)  A large capstan or vertical drum turned by horse power or steam power, for raising ore or water, et.

volatility.definition: Quality or state of being volatile; disposition to evaporate; changeableness; fickleness. Syn. -- See Levity.

sopition.definition: The act of putting to sleep, or the state of being put to sleep; sleep. Dementation and sopition of reason. Sir T. Browne.

mete.definition:
Meat. Chaucer.

To meet. Chaucer.

To dream; also impersonally; as, me mette, I dreamed. "I mette of him all night." Chaucer.

To find the quantity, dimensions, or capacity of, by any rule or standard; to measure.

To measure. Mark iv. 24.

Measure; limit; boundary; -- used chiefly in the plural, an.

abnegator.definition: One who abnegates, denies, or rejects anything.

striate.definition:
To mark with striaæ. "Striated longitudinally." Owen.

Marked with striaæ, or fine grooves, or lines of color; showing narrow structural bands or lines; as, a striated crystal; striated muscular fiber.

frondation.definition: The act of stripping, as trees, of leaves or branches; a kind of pruning. Evelyn.

terma.definition: The terminal lamina, or thin ventral part, of the anterior wall of the third ventricle of the brain. B. G. Wilder.

cenogamy.definition: The state of a communty which permits promiseuous sexual intercourse among its members, as in certain societies practicing communism.

glauberite.definition: A mineral, consisting of the sulphates of soda and lime. GLAUBER'S SALT; GLAUBER'S SALTS Glau"ber's salt` or; Glau"ber's salts` (. Etym: [G. glaubersalz, from Glauber, a German chemist who discovered it. See Glauberite.]  Sulphate of soda, a well-known cathartic. It is a white crystalline substance,.

annotine.definition: A bird one year old, or that has once molted.

fiacre.definition: A kind of French hackney coach.

carnin.definition: A white crystalline nitrogenous substance, found in extract of meat, and related to xanthin.

demosthenic.definition: Pertaining to, or in the style of, Demosthenes, the Grecian orator.

tasty.definition: Having a good taste; -- applied to persons; as, a tasty woman. See Taste, n., 5. 2. Being in conformity to the principles of good taste; elegant; as, tasty furniture; a tasty dress.

bondholder.definition: A person who holds the bonds of a public or private corporation for the payment of money at a certain time.

incurvity.definition: A state of being bent or curved; incurvation; a bending inwards. Sir T. Browne.

caudate.definition: Having a taill; having a termination like a tail.

alphabetics.definition: The science of representing spoken sounds by letters.

quadratrix.definition: A curve made use of in the quadrature of other curves; as the quadratrix, of Dinostratus, or of Tschirnhausen.

labiatifloral.definition:
Having labiate flowers, as the snapdragon.

Having labiate flowers, as the snapdragon.

gue.definition: A sharper; a rogue. J. Webstar.

mortifying.definition: Tending to mortify; affected by, or having symptoms of, mortification; as, a mortifying wound; mortifying flesh. 2. Subduing the appetites, desires, etc.; as, mortifying penances. 3. Tending to humble or abase; humiliating; as, a mortifying repulse.

refringency.definition: The power possessed by a substance to refract a ray; as, different substances have different refringencies. Nichol.

jeremiad.definition: A tale of sorrow, disappointment, or complaint; a doleful story; a dolorous tirade; -- generally used satirically. He has prolonged his complaint into an endless jeremiad. Lamb.

champ.definition:
To bite with repeated action of the teeth so as to be heard. Foamed and champed the golden bit. Dryden. 2. To bite into small pieces; to crunch. Steele.

To bite or chew impatiently. They began . . . irefully to champ upon the bit. Hooker.

The field or ground on which carving appears in relief.

enseam.definition:
To sew up; to inclose by a seam; hence, to include; to contain. Camden.

To cover with grease; to defile; to pollute. In the rank sweat of an enseamed bed. Shak.

kirmess.definition: In Europe, particularly in Belgium and Holland, and outdoor festival and fair; in the United States, generally an indoor entertainment and fair combined.

symmetry.definition: A due proportion of the several parts of a body to each other; adaptation of the form or dimensions of the several parts of a thing to each other; the union and conformity of the members of a work to the whole. 2. (Biol.)  The law of likeness; similarity of structure; regularity in form and arrangem.

ungracious.definition: Not gracious; showing no grace or kindness; being without good will; unfeeling. Shak. 2. Having no grace; graceless; wicked. Shak. 3. Not well received; offensive; unpleasing; unacceptable; not favored. Anything of grace toward the Irish rebels was as ungracious at Oxford as at London. Clarendon. --.

summerliness.definition: The quality or state of being like summer. Fuller.

syrian.definition: Of or pertaining to Syria; Syriac. -- n.  A native of Syria.

chivy.definition: To goad, drive, hunt, throw, or pitch. [Slang, Eng.] Dickens.

thermoneurosis.definition: (a) A neurosis caused by exposure to heat. (b) A neurosis causing rise or fall of a body's temperature.

porbeagle.definition: A species of shark (Lamna cornubica), about eight feet long, having a pointed nose and a crescent-shaped tail; -- called also mackerel shark. [Written also probeagle.].

divedapper.definition: A water fowl; the didapper. See Dabchick.

curialist.definition: One who belongs to the ultramontane party in the Latin Church. Shipley.

metoche.definition: (a) The space between two dentils. (b) The space between two triglyphs.

pruner.definition: One who prunes, or removes, what is superfluous. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any one of several species of beetles whose larvæ gnaw the branches of trees so as to cause them to fall, especially the American oak pruner (Asemum moestum), whose larva eats the pith of oak branches, and when mature gnaws a circular furr.

vanadium.definition: A rare element of the nitrogen-phosphorus group, found combined, in vanadates, in certain minerals, and reduced as an infusible, grayish-white metallic powder. It is intermediate between the metals and the non-metals, having both basic and acid properties. Sumbol V (or Vd, rarely). Atomic weight 51.

skein.definition: A quantity of yarn, thread, or the like, put up together, after it is taken from the reel, -- usually tied in a sort of knot. Note: A skein of cotton yarn is formed by eighty turns of the thread round a fifty-four inch reel. 2. (Wagon Making)  A metallic strengthening band or thimble on the wooden a.

nidorous.definition: Resembling the smell or taste of roast meat, or of corrupt animal matter.

testaceography.definition: The science which treats of testaceans, or shellfish; the description of shellfish.

vasoformative.definition: Concerned in the development and formation of blood vessels and blood corpuscles; as, the vasoformative cells.

newfangle.definition:
Eager for novelties; desirous of changing. So newfangel be they of their meat. Chaucer.

To change by introducing novelties.

wardship.definition: The office of a ward or keeper; care and protection of a ward; guardianship; right of guardianship. Wardship is incident to tenure in socage. Blackstone. 2. The state of begin under a guardian; pupilage. It was the wisest act . . . in my wardship. B. Jonson.

trifoliated.definition: Having three leaves or leaflets, as clover. See Illust. of Shamrock.

exoteric.definition: External; public; suitable to be imparted to the public; hence, capable of being readily or fully comprehended; -- opposed to esoteric, or secret. The foppery of an exoteric and esoteric doctrine. De Quincey.

bordeller.definition: A keeper or a frequenter of a brothel. Gower.

preconcerted.definition: Previously arranged; agreed upon beforehand. -- Pre`con*cert"ed*ly, adv. -- Pre`con*cert"ed*ness, n.

rallentando.definition: Slackening; -- a direction to perform a passage with a gradual decrease in time and force; ritardando.

benzoate.definition: A salt formed by the union of benzoic acid with any salifiable base.

abiogenesis.definition: The supposed origination of living organisms from lifeless matter; such genesis as does not involve the action of living parents; spontaneous generation; -- called also abiogeny, and opposed to biogenesis. I shall call the . . . doctrine that living matter may be produced by not living matter, the h.

inturbidate.definition: To render turbid; to darken; to confuse. The confusion of ideas and conceptions under the same term painfully inturbidates his theology. Coleridge.

otozoum.definition: An extinct genus of huge vertebrates, probably dinosaurs, known only from four-toed tracks in Triassic sandstones.

spilth.definition: Anything spilt, or freely poured out; slop; effusion. [Archaic] "With drunken spilth of wine." Shak. Choicest cates, and the flagon's best spilth. R. Browning.

vex.definition: To to White curl the waves, and the vexed ocean roars. Pope. 2. To make angry or annoyed by little provocations; to irritate; to plague; to torment; to harass; to afflict; to trouble; to tease. "I will not vex your souls." Shak. Then thousand torments vex my heart. Prior. 3. To twist; to weave. Some.

disquieter.definition: One who, or that which, disquiets, or makes uneasy; a disturber.

lingam.definition: The phallic symbol under which Siva is principally worshiped in his character of the creative and reproductive power. Whitworth. E. Arnold.

welsher.definition: One who cheats at a horse race; one who bets, without a chance of being able to pay; one who receives money to back certain horses and absconds with it. [Written also welcher.] [Slang, Eng.].

nard.definition: (Bot.)  An East Indian plant (Nardostachys Jatamansi) of the Valerian family, used from remote ages in Oriental perfumery. 2. An ointment prepared partly from this plant. See Spikenard. 3. (Bot.)  A kind of grass (Nardus stricta) of little value, found in Europe and Asia.

caloriduct.definition: A tube or duct for conducting heat; a caliduct.

symphyla.definition: An order of small apterous insects having an elongated body, with three pairs of thoracic and about nine pairs of abdominal legs. They are, in many respects, intermediate between myriapods and true insects.

couch.definition: To lay upon a bed or other resting place. Where unbruised youth, with unstuffed brain, Does couch his limbs, there golden sleep doth reign. Shak. 2. To arrauge or dispose as in a bed; -- sometimes followed by the reflexive pronoun. The waters couch themselves as may be to the center of this globe, i.

surety.definition: The state of being sure; certainty; security. Know of a surety, that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs. Gen. xv. 13. For the more surety they looked round about. Sir P. Sidney. 2. That which makes sure; that which confirms; ground of confidence or security. [We] our happy sta.

vinatico.definition: Madeira mahogany; the coarse, dark-colored wood of the Persea Indica.

discurrent.definition: Not current or free to circulate; not in use. Sir E. Sandys.

beete.definition: To mend; to repair. Chaucer. 2. To renew or enkindle (a fire). Chaucer.

agronomics.definition: The science of the distribution and management of land.

nondecane.definition: A hydrocarbon of the paraffin series, a white waxy substance, C19H40; -- so called from the number of carbon atoms in the molecule.

manurable.definition: Capable of cultivation. Sir M. Hale. 2. Capable of receiving a fertilizing substance.

parallactic.definition: Of or pertaining to a parallax.

ascensive.definition: Rising; tending to rise, or causing to rise. Owen. 2. (Gram.)  Augmentative; intensive. Ellicott.

cowslipped.definition: Adorned with cowslips. "Cowslipped lawns." Keats. COW'S LUNGWORT Cow's" lung"wort` (kouz" lng"wrt`).  Mullein.

bivious.definition: Having, or leading, two ways. Bivious theorems and Janus-faced doctrines. Sir T. Browne.

dead-stroke.definition: Making a stroke without recoil; deadbeat. Dead-stroke hammer (Mach.), a power hammer having a spring interposed between the driving mechanism and the hammer head, or helve, to lessen the recoil of the hammer and reduce the shock upon the mechanism.

interlucation.definition: Act of thinning a wood to let in light. Evelyn.

loricate.definition:
To cover with some protecting substance, as with lute, a crust, coating, or plates.

Covered with a shell or exterior made of plates somewhat like a coat of mail, as in the armadillo.

An animal covered with bony scales, as crocodiles among reptiles, and the pangolins among mammals.

preconcert.definition:
To concert or arrange beforehand; to settle by previous agreement.

Something concerted or arranged beforehand; a previous agreement.

cetacea.definition: An order of marine mammals, including the whales. Like ordinary mammals they breathe by means of lungs, and bring forth living young which they suckle for some time. The anterior limbs are changed to paddles; the tail flukes are horizontal. There are two living suborders: (a) The Mysticete or whaleb.

gasalier.definition: A chandelier arranged to burn gas.

postdiluvial.definition: Being or happening after the flood in Noah's days.

debenture.definition: A writing acknowledging a debt; a writing or certificate signed by a public officer, as evidence of a debt due to some person; the sum thus due. 2. A customhouse certificate entitling an exporter of imported goods to a drawback of duties paid on their importation. Burrill. Note: It is applied in Eng.

sophism.definition: The doctrine or mode of reasoning practiced by a sophist; hence, any fallacy designed to deceive. When a false argument puts on the appearance of a true one, then it is properly called a sophism, or "fallacy". I. Watts. Let us first rid ourselves of sophisms, those of depraved men, and those of hear.

spongin.definition: The chemical basis of sponge tissue, a nitrogenous, hornlike substance which on decomposition with sulphuric acid yields leucin and glycocoll.

quillback.definition: An American fresh-water fish (Ictiobus, or Carpiodes, cyprinus); -- called also carp sucker, sailfish, spearfish, and skimback.

freebootery.definition: The act, practice, or gains of a freebooter; freebooting. Booth.

photolithography.definition: The art or process of producing photolithographs.

tentacular.definition: Of or pertaining to a tentacle or tentacles.

calceiform.definition: Shaped like a plipper, as one petal of the lady's-slipper; calceolate.

centrum.definition: The body, or axis, of a vertebra. See Vertebra.

circulary.definition: Circular; illogical. [Obs. & .] "Cross and circulary speeches." Hooker.

vitrify.definition:
To convert into, or cause to resemble, glass or a glassy substance, by heat and fusion.

To become glass; to be converted into glass. Chymists make vessels of animal substances, calcined, which will not vitrify in the fire. Arbuthnot.

motherland.definition: The country of one's ancestors; -- same as fatherland.

sloat.definition: A narrow piece of timber which holds together large pieces; a slat; as, the sloats of a cart.

lustless.definition: Lacking vigor; weak; spiritless. Spenser. 2. Free from sexual lust.

nigritic.definition: Pertaining to, or having the characteristics of, negroes, or of the Negritos, Papuans, and the Melanesian races; negritic.

actiniform.definition: Having a radiated form, like a sea anemone.

draconic.definition: Relating to Draco, the Athenian lawgiver; or to the constellation Draco; or to dragon's blood.

erasion.definition: The act of erasing; a rubbing out; obliteration.

pregravate.definition: To bear down; to depress. Bp. Hall.

saveloy.definition: A kind of dried sausage. McElrath.

sneck.definition:
To fasten by a hatch; to latch, as a door. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.] Sneck up, be silent; shut up; hold your peace. Shak.

A door latch. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.] Sneck band, a latchstring. Burns. -- Sneck drawer, a latch lifter; a bolt drawer; hence, a sly person; a cozener; a cheat; -- called also sneckdraw.

decedent.definition:
Removing; departing. Ash.

A deceased person. Bouvier.

inhibition.definition: The act of inhibiting, or the state of being inhibited; restraint; prohibition; embargo. 2. (Physiol.)  A stopping or checking of an already present action; a restraining of the function of an organ, or an agent, as a digestive fluid or ferment, etc.; as, the inhibition of the respiratory center by.

pestilence.definition: Specifically, the disease known as the plague; hence, any contagious or infectious epidemic disease that is virulent and devastating. The pestilence That walketh in darkness. Ps. xci. 6. 2. Fig.: That which is pestilent, noxious, or pernicious to the moral character of great numbers. I'll pour this.

comfrey.definition: A rough, hairy, perennial plant of several species, of the genus Symphytum. Note: A decoction of the mucilaginous root of the "common comfrey" (S. officinale) is used in cough mixtures, etc.; and the gigantic "prickly comfrey" (S. asperrimum) is somewhat cultivated as a forage plant.

orthotropic.definition: Having the longer axis vertical; -- said of erect stems. Encyc. Brit.

apheliotropic.definition: Turning away from the sun; -- said of leaves, etc. Darwin.

bom.definition: A large American serpent, so called from the sound it makes.

mexicanize.definition:
To cause to be like the Mexicans, or their country, esp. in respect of frequent revolutions of government.

To become like the Mexicans, or their country or government.

sedulity.definition: The quality or state of being sedulous; diligent and assiduous application; constant attention; unremitting industry; sedulousness. The industrious bee, by his sedulity in summer, lives in honey all the winter. Feltham.

congeries.definition: A collection of particles or bodies into one mass; a heap; an aggregation.

externality.definition: State of being external; exteriority; (Metaph.)  separation from the perceiving mind. Pressure or resistance necessarily supposes externality in the thing which presses or resists. A. Smith.

myomancy.definition: Divination by the movements of mice.

festucous.definition: Formed or consisting of straw. Sir T. Browne.

cabiri.definition: Certain deities originally worshiped with mystical rites by the Pelasgians in Lemnos and Samothrace and afterwards throughout Greece; -- also called sons of Hephæstus (or Vulcan), as being masters of the art of working metals. [Written also Cabeiri.] Liddell & Scott.

cyclostomi.definition: A glass of fishes having a suckerlike mouth, without jaws, as the lamprey; the Marsipobranchii.

countersecure.definition: To give additional security to or for. Burke.

emu.definition: A large Australian bird, of two species (Dromaius Novæ- Hollandiæ and D. irroratus), related to the cassowary and the ostrich. The emu runs swiftly, but is unable to fly. [Written also emeu and emew.] Note: The name is sometimes erroneously applied, by the Brazilians, to the rhea, or South American.

smeller.definition: One who smells, or perceives by the sense of smell; one who gives out smell. 2. The nose. [Pugilists' Slang].

censorial.definition: Belonging to a censor, or to the correction of public morals. Junius. 2. Full of censure; censorious. The censorial declamation of Juvenal. T. Warton.

indevotion.definition: Want of devotion; impiety; irreligion. "An age of indevotion." Jer. Taylor.

cowhage.definition: A leguminous climbing plant of the genus Mucuna, having crooked pods covered with sharp hairs, which stick to the fingers, causing intolerable itching. The spiculæ are sometimes used in medicine as a mechanical vermifuge. [Written also couhage, cowage, and cowitch.].

loathful.definition: Full of loathing; hating; abhorring. "Loathful eyes." Spenser. 2. Causing a feeling of loathing; disgusting. Above the reach of loathful, sinful lust. Spenser.

sidesaddle.definition: A saddle for women, in which the rider sits with both feet on one side of the animal mounted. Sidesaddle flower (Bot.), a plant with hollow leaves and curiously shaped flowers; -- called also huntsman's cup. See Sarracenia.

anatron.definition: Native carbonate of soda; natron. 2. Glass gall or sandiver. 3. Saltpeter. Coxe. Johnson.

consummate.definition:
Carried to the utmost extent or degree; of the highest quality; complete; perfect. "A man of perfect and consummate virtue." Addison. The little band held the post with consummate tenacity. Motley

To bring to completion; to raise to the highest point or degree; to complete; to finish; to perfect; t.

axiomatical.definition: Of or pertaining to an axiom; having the nature of an axiom; self-evident; characterized by axioms. "Axiomatical truth." Johnson. The stores of axiomatic wisdom. I. Taylor.

sarracenia.definition: A genus of American perrenial herbs growing in bogs; the American pitcher plant. Note: They have hollow pitcher-shaped or tubular leaves, and solitary flowers with an umbrella-shaped style. Sarracenia purpurea, the sidesaddle flower, is common at the North; S. flava, rubra, Drummondii, variolaris, a.

heptachord.definition: (Anc. Mus.) (a) A system of seven sounds. (b) A lyre with seven chords. 2. (Anc. Poet.)  A composition sung to the sound of seven chords or tones. Moore (Encyc. of Music).

easting.definition: The distance measured toward the east between two meridians drawn through the extremities of a course; distance of departure eastward made by a vessel.

fat-kidneyed.definition: Gross; lubberly. Peace, ye fat-kidneyed rascal ! Shak.

proverbialize.definition: To turn into a proverb; to speak in proverbs.

lysis.definition: The resolution or favorable termination of a disease, coming on gradually and not marked by abrupt change. Note: It is usually contrasted with crisis, in which the improvement is sudden and marked; as, pneumonia ends by crisis, typhoid fever by lysis.

unsceptered.definition: Etym: [Pref. un- not + sceptered.]  Having no scepter. 2. Etym: [1st pref. un- + scepter.]  Deprived of a scepter.

vastidity.definition: Vastness; immensity. "All the world's vastidity." Shak.

elul.definition: The sixth month of the Jewish year, by the sacred reckoning, or the twelfth, by the civil reckoning, corresponding nearly to the month of September.

truthful.definition: Full of truth; veracious; reliable. -- Truth"ful*ly, adv. -- Truth"ful*ness, n.

lethargize.definition: To make lethargic. All bitters are poison, and act by stilling, and depressing, and lethargizing the irritability. Coleridge.

geogony.definition: The branch of science which treats of the formation of the earth.

megaric.definition: Belonging, or pertaining, to Megara, a city of ancient Greece. Megarian, or Megaric, school, a school of philosophy established at Megara, after the death of Socrates, by his disciples, and remarkable for its logical subtlety.

rajpoot.definition: A Hindoo of the second, or royal and military, caste; a Kshatriya; especially, an inhabitant of the country of Rajpootana, in northern central India.

oscillating.definition: That oscillates; vibrating; swinging. Oscillating engine, a steam engine whose cylinder oscillates on trunnions instead of being permanently fixed in a perpendicular or other direction. Weale.

temptability.definition: The quality or state of being temptable; lability to temptation.

impartment.definition: The act of imparting, or that which is imparted, communicated, or disclosed. It beckons you to go away with it, As if it some impartment did desire To you alone. Shak.

respire.definition: To take breath again; hence, to take rest or refreshment. Spenser. Here leave me to respire. Milton. From the mountains where I now respire. Byron. 2. (Physiol.)  To breathe; to inhale air into the lungs, and exhale it from them, successively, for the purpose of maintaining the vitality of the blood.

dispauper.definition: To deprive of the claim of a pauper to public support; to deprive of the privilege of suing in forma pauperis.

parqueted.definition: Formed in parquetry; inlaid with wood in small and differently colored figures. One room parqueted with yew, which I liked well. Evelyn.

reclining.definition: (a) Bending or curving gradually back from the perpendicular. (b) Recumbent. Reclining dial, a dial whose plane is inclined to the vertical line through its center. Davies & Peck (Math. Dict.).

forgetful.definition: Apt to forget; easily losing remembrance; as, a forgetful man should use helps to strengthen his memory. 2. Heedless; careless; neglectful; inattentive. Be not forgetful to entertain strangers. Heb. xiii. 2. 3. Causing to forget; inducing oblivion; oblivious. [Archaic or Poetic] "The forgetful wine.

sniveler.definition: One who snivels, esp. one who snivels habitually.

prelect.definition:
To read publicly, as a lecture or discourse.

To discourse publicly; to lecture. Spitting . . . was publicly prelected upon. De. Quincey. To prelect upon the military art. Bp. Horsley.

arguer.definition: One who argues; a reasoner; a disputant.

discretionally.definition: At discretion; according to one's discretion or judgment.

recouch.definition: To retire again to a couch; to lie down again. Sir H. Wotton.

snowy.definition: White like snow. "So shows a snowy dove trooping with crows." Shak. 2. Abounding with snow; covered with snow. "The snowy top of cold Olympus." Milton. 3. Fig.: Pure; unblemished; unstained; spotless. There did he lose his snowy innocence. J. Hall (1646). Snowy heron (Zoöl.), a white heron, or egret.

sordid.definition: Filthy; foul; dirty. A sordid god; down from his hoary chin A length of beard descends, uncombed, unclean. Dryden. 2. Vile; base; gross; mean; as, vulgar, sordid mortals. "To scorn the sordid world." Milton. 3. Meanly avaricious; covetous; niggardly. He may be old, And yet sordid, who refuses gold.

defoul.definition: To tread down. Wyclif. 2. To make foul; to defile. Wyclif.

melodize.definition:
To make melodious; to form into, or set to, melody.

To make melody; to compose melodies; to harmonize.

retrocession.definition: The act of retroceding. 2. The state of being retroceded, or granted back. 3. (Med.)  Metastasis of an eruption or a tumor from the surface to the interior of the body.

contumacy.definition: Stubborn perverseness; pertinacious resistance to authority. The bishop commanded him . . . to be thrust into the stocks for his manifest and manifold contumacy. Strype. 2. (Law)  A willful contempt of, and disobedience to, any lawful summons, or to the rules and orders of court, as a refusal to app.

velours.definition: One of many textile fabrics having a pile like that of velvet.

trey.definition: Three, at cards, dice, or dominoes; a card, die, or domino of three spots or pips. Seven is my chance and thine is cinq and trey. Chaucer.

esthesiometer.definition:
An instrument to measure the degree of sensation, by determining at how short a distance two impressions upon the skin can be distinguished, and thus to determine whether the condition of tactile sensibility is normal or altered.

Same as Æsthesiometer.

toponymy.definition: A system of toponyms; the use of toponyms. -- To*pon"y*mal (#), Top`o*nym"ic (#), Top`o*nym"ic*al (#), a.

pessimist.definition:
(Metaph.)  One who advocates the doctrine of pessimism; -- opposed to Ant: optimist. 2. One who looks on the dark side of things.

Of or pertaining to pessimism; characterized by pessimism; gloomy; foreboding. "Giving utterance to pessimistic doubt." Encyc. Brit.

phenicious.definition: Of a red color with a slight mixture of gray. Dana.

wringer.definition: One who, or that which, wrings; hence, an extortioner. 2. A machine for pressing water out of anything, particularly from clothes after they have been washed.

offscouring.definition: That which is scoured off; hence, refuse; rejected matter; that which is vile or despised. Lam. iii. 45.

free-minded.definition: Not perplexed; having a mind free from care. Bacon.

blackcap.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) A small European song bird (Sylvia atricapilla), with a black crown; the mock nightingale. (b) An American titmouse (Parus atricapillus); the chickadee. 2. (Cookery)  An apple roasted till black, to be served in a dish of boiled custard. 3. The black raspberry.

inodorous.definition: Emitting no odor; wthout smell; scentless; odorless. -- In*o"dor*ous*ness, n.

dustpan.definition: A shovel-like utensil for conveying away dust brushed from the floor.

fertilize.definition: To make fertile or enrich; to supply with nourishment for plants; to make fruitful or productive; as, to fertilize land, soil, ground, and meadows. And fertilize the field that each pretends to gain. Byron. 2. To fecundate; as, to fertilize flower. A. R. Wallace.

cathead.definition: A projecting piece of timber or iron near the bow of vessel, to which the anchor is hoisted and secured.

parallelogrammic.definition: Having the properties of a parallelogram.

plain-spoken.definition: Speaking with plain, unreserved sincerity; also, spoken sincerely; as, plain-spoken words. Dryden.

treasure-trove.definition: Any money, bullion, or the like, found in the earth, or otherwise hidden, the owner of which is not known. In England such treasure belongs to the crown; whereas similar treasure found in the sea, or upon the surface of the land, belongs to the finder if no owner appears.

terminer.definition: A determining; as, in oyer and terminer. See Oyer.

engrain.definition: To dye in grain, or of a fast color. See Ingrain. Leaves engrained in lusty green. Spenser. 2. To incorporate with the grain or texture of anything; to infuse deeply. See Ingrain. The stain hath become engrained by time. Sir W. Scott. 3. To color in imitation of the grain of wood; to grain. See Grai.

metate.definition: A flat or somewhat hollowed stone upon which grain or other food is ground, by means of a smaller stone or pestle. [Southwestern U. S. & Sp. Amer.].

nodosarine.definition: Resembling in form or structure a foraminiferous shell of the genus Nodosaria. -- n. (Zoöl.)  A foraminifer of the genus Nodosaria or of an allied genus.

zygobranchiate.definition: Of or pertaining to the Zygobranchia.

irrelation.definition: The quality or state of being irrelative; want of connection or relation.

cataphysical.definition: Unnatural; contrary to nature. Some artists . . . have given to Sir Walter Scott a pile of forehead which is unpleassing and cataphysical. De Quincey.

tonguester.definition: One who uses his tongue; a talker; a story-teller; a gossip. [Poetic.] Step by step we rose to greatness; through the tonguesters we may fall. Tennyson.

pyrotic.definition: Caustic. See Caustic. -- n. (Med.)  A caustic medicine.

dislikelihood.definition: The want of likelihood; improbability. Sir W. Scott.

hike.definition: To hike one's self; specif., to go with exertion or effort; to tramp; to march laboriously. [Dial. or Colloq.] "If you persist in heaving and hiking like this."  Kipling. It's hike, hike, hike (march) till you stick in the mud, and then you hike back again a little slower than you went. Scribner's M.

mulattress.definition: A female mulatto. G. W. Gable.

gazelle.definition: One of several small, swift, elegantly formed species of antelope, of the genus Gazella, esp. G. dorcas; -- called also algazel, corinne, korin, and kevel. The gazelles are celebrated for the luster and soft expression of their eyes. [Written also gazel.] Note: The common species of Northern Africa.

cerebro-spinal.definition: Of or pertaining to the central nervous system consisting of the brain and spinal cord. Cerebro-spinal fluid (Physiol.), a serous fluid secreted by the membranes covering the brain and spinal cord. -- Cerebro-spinal meningitis, Cerebro-spinal fever (Med.), a dangerous epidemic, and endemic, febrile.

involuntariness.definition: The quality or state of being involuntary; unwillingness; automatism.

clinker-built.definition: Having the side planks (af a boat) so arranged that the lower edge of each overlaps the upper edge of the plank next below it like clapboards on a house. See Lapstreak.

experiencer.definition: One who experiences. 2. An experimenter. Sir. K. Gigby.

gyrose.definition: Turned round like a crook, or bent to and fro. Loudon.

octoate.definition: A salt of an octoic acid; a caprylate.

mugginess.definition: The condition or quality of being muggy.

ubiquist.definition: One of a school of Lutheran divines which held that the body of Christ is present everywhere, and especially in the eucharist, in virtue of his omnipresence.  Called also Ubiquitist, Ubiquitary.

toxiphobia.definition: An insane or greatly exaggerated dread of poisons.

inducteous.definition: Rendered electro-polar by induction, or brought into the opposite electrical state by the influence of inductive bodies.

goblet.definition: A kind of cup or drinking vessel having a foot or standard, but without a handle. We love not loaded boards and goblets crowned. Denham.

scathless.definition: Unharmed. R. L. Stevenson. He, too, . . . is to be dismissed scathless. Sir W. Scott.

ultraviolet.definition: Lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end; -- said of rays more refrangible than the extreme violet rays of the spectrum.

klipdachs.definition: A small mammal (Hyrax Capensis), found in South Africa. It is of about the size of a rabbit, and closely resembles the daman. Called also rock rabbit.

britannic.definition: Of or pertaining to Great Britain; British; as, her Britannic Majesty.

transduction.definition: The act of conveying over. Entick.

incompetency.definition: The quality or state of being incompetent; want of physical, intellectual, or moral ability; insufficiency; inadequacy; as, the incompetency of a child hard labor, or of an idiot for intellectual efforts. "Some inherent incompetency." Gladstone. 2. (Law)  Want of competency or legal fitness; incapac.

hunkers.definition: In the phrase on one's hunkers, in a squatting or crouching position. [Scot. & Local, U. S.] Sit on your hunkers -- and pray for the bridge. Kipling.

electrolyzation.definition: The act or the process of electrolyzing.

volador.definition: (a) A flying fish of California (Exocoetus Californicus): -- called also volator. (b) The Atlantic flying gurnard. See under Flying.

organific.definition: Making an organic or organized structure; producing an organism; acting through, or resulting from, organs. Prof. Park.

perturber.definition: One who, or that which, perturbs, or cause perturbation.

granitoid.definition: Resembling granite in granular appearance; as, granitoid gneiss; a granitoid pavement.

opisthoglypha.definition: A division of serpents which have some of the posterior maxillary teeth grooved for fangs.

embower.definition: To cover with a bower; to shelter with trees. [Written also imbower.] [Poetic] Milton. -- v. i.  To lodge or rest in a bower. [Poetic] "In their wide boughs embow'ring. " Spenser.

discontinuee.definition: One whose possession of an estate is broken off, or discontinued; one whose estate is subject to discontinuance.

ecclesiology.definition: The science or theory of church building and decoration.

viscidity.definition: The quality or state of being viscid; also, that which is viscid; glutinous concretion; stickiness.

alphabet.definition:
The letters of a language arranged in the customary order; the series of letters or signs which form the elements of written language. 2. The simplest rudiments; elements. The very alphabet of our law. Macaulay. Deaf and dumb alphabet. See Dactylology.

To designate by the letters of the alphabet; t.

pott.definition: A size of paper. See under Paper.

ecrasement.definition: The operation performed with an écraseur.

dysenteric.definition: Of or pertaining to dysentery; having dysentery; as, a dysenteric patient. "Dysenteric symptoms." Copland.

fisk.definition: To run about; to frisk; to whisk. He fisks abroad, and stirreth up erroneous opinions. Latimer.

barbicel.definition: One of the small hooklike processes on the barbules of feathers.

partisanship.definition: The state of being a partisan, or adherent to a party; feelings or conduct appropriate to a partisan.

abalienation.definition: The act of abalienating; alienation; estrangement.

shiraz.definition: A kind of Persian wine; -- so called from the place whence it is brought.

timidity.definition: The quality or state of being timid; timorousness; timidness.

acromial.definition: Of or pertaining to the acromion. Dunglison.

shipbuilder.definition: A person whose occupation is to construct ships and other vessels; a naval architect; a shipwright.

intext.definition: The text of a book. Herrick.

systole.definition: (Gram.)  The shortening of the long syllable. 2. (Physiol.)  The contraction of the heart and arteries by which the blood is forced onward and the circulation kept up; -- correlative to diastole.

althorn.definition: An instrument of the saxhorn family, used exclusively in military music, often replacing the French horn. Grove.

angina.definition: Any inflammatory affection of the throat or faces, as the quinsy, malignant sore throat, croup, etc., especially such as tends to produce suffocation, choking, or shortness of breath. Angina pectoris, a peculiarly painful disease, so named from a sense of suffocating contraction or tightening of the.

enterdeal.definition: Mutual dealings; intercourse. The enterdeal of princes strange. Spenser.

orientness.definition: The quality or state of being orient or bright; splendor. Fuller.

dartoid.definition: Like the dartos; dartoic; as, dartoid tissue.

defiler.definition: One who defiles; one who corrupts or violates; that which pollutes.

ataunt.definition: Fully rigged, as a vessel; with all sails set; set on end or set right.

epitrope.definition: A figure by which permission is either seriously or ironically granted to some one, to do what he proposes to do; e. g., "He that is unjust, let him be unjust still.".

jantu.definition: A machine of great antiquity, used in Bengal for raising water to irrigate land. Knight.

clavated.definition: Club-shaped; having the form of a club; growing gradually thicker toward the top. Note: [See Illust. of Antennae.].

abraxas.definition: A mystical word used as a charm and engraved on gems among the ancients; also, a gem stone thus engraved.

luffa.definition: (a) A small genus of tropical cucurbitaceous plants having white flowers, the staminate borne in racemes, and large fruits with a dry fibrous pericarp. The fruit of several species and the species themselves, esp. L. Ægyptiaca, are called dishcloth gourds. (b) Any plant of this genus, or its fruit.

presential.definition: Implying actual presence; present, immediate. God's mercy is made presential to us. Jer. Taylor. -- Pre*sen"tial*ly, adv.

uterus.definition: (Anat.)  The organ of a female mammal in which the young are developed previous to birth; the womb. Note: The uterus is simply an enlargement of the oviduct, and in the lower mammals there is one on each side, but in the higher forms the two become more or less completely united into one. In many ma.

aurate.definition: A combination of auric acid with a base; as, aurate or potassium.

girasole.definition: (Bot.)  See Heliotrope. 2. (Min.)  A variety of opal which is usually milk white, bluish white, or sky blue; but in a bright light it reflects a reddish color.

labrus.definition: A genus of marine fishes, including the wrasses of Europe. See Wrasse.

eruption.definition: The act of breaking out or bursting forth; as: (a) A violent throwing out of flames, lava, etc., as from a volcano of a fissure in the earth's crust. (b) A sudden and overwhelming hostile movement of armed men from one country to another. Milton. (c) A violent commotion. All Paris was quiet . . . to.

prothorax.definition: The first or anterior segment of the thorax in insects. See Illusts. of Butterfly and Coleoptera.

diffluency.definition: A flowing off on all sides; fluidity.

tameless.definition: Incapable of being tamed; wild; untamed; untamable. Bp. Hall. -- Tame"less*ness, n.

cudgeler.definition: One who beats with a cudgel. [Written also cudgeller.].

allhallowtide.definition: The time at or near All Saints, or November 1st.

bowsprit.definition: A large boom or spar, which projects over the stem of a ship or other vessel, to carry sail forward.

recognizable.definition: Capable of being recognized. [Written also recognisable.] -- Rec"og*ni`za*bly, adv.

weather-bit.definition: A turn of the cable about the end of the windlass, without the bits.

curricle.definition: A small or short course. Upon a curricle in this world depends a long course of the next. Sir T. Browne. 2. A two-wheeled chaise drawn by two horses abreast.

knitch.definition: A number of things tied or knit together; a bundle; a fagot. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Halliwell. When they [stems of asphodel] be dried, they ought to be made up into knitchets, or handfuls. Holland.

surbased.definition: (a) Having a surbase, or molding above the base. (b) Etym: [F. surbaissé.]  Having the vertical height from springing line to crown less than the half span; -- said of an arch; as, a segmental arch is surbased.

evolute.definition: A curve from which another curve, called the involute or evolvent, is described by the end of a thread gradually wound upon the former, or unwound from it. See Involute. It is the locus of the centers of all the circles which are osculatory to the given curve or evolvent. Note: Any curve may be an e.

sarcasm.definition: A keen, reproachful expression; a satirical remark uttered with some degree of scorn or contempt; a taunt; a gibe; a cutting jest. The sarcasms of those critics who imagine our art to be a matter of inspiration. Sir J. Reynolds. Syn. -- Satire; irony; ridicule; taunt; gibe.

alto-cumulus.definition: A fleecy cloud formation consisting of large whitish or grayish globular cloudlets with shaded  portions, often grouped in flocks or rows.

presswork.definition: The art of printing from the surface of type, plates, or engravings in relief, by means of a press; the work so done. MacKellar.

crare.definition: A slow unwieldy trading vessel. [Written also crayer, cray, and craie.] Shak.

beefy.definition: Having much beef; of the nature of beef; resembling beef; fleshy.

craftsman.definition: One skilled in some trade or manual occupation; an artificer; a mechanic.

apocryphalness.definition: The quality or state of being apocryphal; doubtfulness of credit or genuineness.

jet-black.definition: Black as jet; deep black. JET D'EAU Jet` d'eau", pl. Jets d'eau (. Etym: [F., a throw of water. See Jet a shooting forth.]  A stream of water spouting from a fountain or pipe (especially from one arranged to throw water upward), in a public place or in a garden, for ornament.

ruffler.definition: One who ruffles; a swaggerer; a bully; a ruffian. Assaults, if not murders, done at his own doors by that crew of rufflers. Milton. 2. That which ruffles; specifically, a sewing machine attachment for making ruffles.

foreshow.definition: To show or exhibit beforehand; to give foreknowledge of; to prognosticate; to foretell. Your looks foreshow You have a gentle heart. Shak. Next, like Aurora, Spenser rose, Whose purple blush the day foreshows. Denham.

outguard.definition: A guard or small body of troops at a distance from the main body of an army, to watch for the approach of an enemy; hence, anything for defense placed at a distance from the thing to be defended.

veinless.definition: Having no veins; as, a veinless leaf.

earshot.definition: Reach of the ear; distance at which words may be heard. Dryden.

tetradynamous.definition: Belonging to the order Tetradynamia; having six stamens, four of which are uniformly longer than the others.

reaumur.definition: Of or pertaining to René Antoine Ferchault de Réaumur; conformed to the scale adopted by Réaumur in graduating the thermometer he invented. -- n.  A Réaumur thermometer or scale. Note: The Réaumur thermometer is so graduated that 0º marks the freezing point and 80º the boiling point of water. Freque.

naphthalate.definition: A salt of naphthalic acid; a phthalate.

shanny.definition: The European smooth blenny (Blennius pholis). It is olive-green with irregular black spots, and without appendages on the head. SHAN'T Shan't.  A contraction of shall not.

stereoelectric.definition: Of or pertaining to the generation of electricity by means of solid bodies alone; as, a stereoelectric current is one obtained by means of solids, without any liquid.

meerschaum.definition: (Min.)  A fine white claylike mineral, soft, and light enough when in dry masses to float in water. It is a hydrous silicate of magnesia, and is obtained chiefly in Asia Minor. It is manufacturd into tobacco pipes, cigar holders, etc. Also called sepiolite. 2. A tobacco pipe made of this mineral.

nundinate.definition: To buy and sell at fairs or markets.

piccage.definition: Money paid at fairs for leave to break ground for booths. Ainsworth.

resorcylic.definition: Of, or pertaining to, or producing, resorcin; as, resorcylic acid.

lackaday.definition: Alack the day; alas; -- an expression of sorrow, regret, dissatisfaction, or surprise.

zygapophysis.definition: One of the articular processes of a vertebra, of which there are usually four, two anterior and two posterior. See under Vertebra. -- Zyg`ap*o*phys"i*al, a.

ethiopian.definition:
A native or inhabitant of Ethiopia; also, in a general sense, a negro or black man.

Of or relating to Ethiopia or the Ethiopians.

bearable.definition: Capable of being borne or endured; tolerable. -- Bear"a*bly, adv.

bimedial.definition: Applied to a line which is the sum of two lines commensurable only in power (as the side and diagonal of a square).

tussocky.definition: Having the form of tussocks; full of, or covered with, tussocks, or tufts.

rebuttal.definition: The giving of evidence on the part of a plaintiff to destroy the effect of evidence introduced by the defendant in the same suit.

frostbow.definition: A white arc or circle in the sky attending frosty weather and formed by reflection of sunlight from ice crystals floating in the air; the parhelic circle whose center is at the zenith.

invertible.definition:
Capable of being inverted or turned. 2. (Chem.)  Capable of being changed or converted; as, invertible sugar.

Incapable of being turned or changed. An indurate and invertible conscience. Cranmer.

apathist.definition: One who is destitute of feeling.

roundfish.definition: (a) Any ordinary market fish, exclusive of flounders, sole, halibut, and other flatfishes. (b) A lake whitefish (Coregonus quadrilateralis), less compressed than the common species. It is very abundant in British America and Alaska.

glucinum.definition: A rare metallic element, of a silver white color, and low specific gravity (2.1), resembling magnesium. It never occurs naturally in the free state, but is always combined, usually with silica or alumina, or both; as in the minerals phenacite, chrysoberyl, beryl or emerald, euclase, and danalite. It.

coalsack.definition: Any one of the spaces in the Milky Way which are very black, owing to the nearly complete absence of stars; esp., the large space near the Southern Cross sometimes called the Black Magellanic Cloud.

nonalienation.definition: Failure to alienate; also, the state of not being alienated.

waterflood.definition: A flood of water; an inundation.

exterraneous.definition: Foreign; belonging to, or coming from, abroad.

alife.definition: On my life; dearly. "I love that sport alife." Beau. & Fl.

siderealize.definition: To elevate to the stars, or to the region of the stars; to etherealize. German literature transformed, siderealized, as we see it in Goethe, reckons Winckelmann among its initiators. W. Pater.

difficile.definition: Difficult; hard to manage; stubborn. -- Dif"fi*cile*ness, n. Bacon.

unimpeachable.definition: Not impeachable; not to be called in question; exempt from liability to accusation; free from stain, guilt, or fault; irreproachable; blameless; as, an unimpeachable reputation; unimpeachable testimony. Burke. -- Un`im*peach"a*ble*ness, n. -- Un`im*peach"a*bly, adv.

fellness.definition: The quality or state of being fell or cruel; fierce barbarity. Spenser.

bethlehem.definition: A hospital for lunatics; -- corrupted into bedlam. 2. (Arch.)  In the Ethiopic church, a small building attached to a church edifice, in which the bread for the eucharist is made. Audsley.

chronical.definition: Chronic. Partly on a chronical, and partly on a topical method. J. A. Alexander.

palladiumize.definition: To cover or coat with palladium.

astronomer.definition: An astrologer. Shak. 2. One who is versed in astronomy; one who has a knowledge of the laws of the heavenly orbs, or the principles by which their motions are regulated, with their various phenomena. An undevout astronomer is mad. Young.

supratrochlear.definition: Situated over or above a trochlea or trochlear surface; -- applied esp. to one of the subdivisions of the trigeminal nerve.

planimetry.definition: The mensuration of plane surfaces; -- distinguished from stereometry, or the mensuration of volumes.

gradin.definition: Any member like a step, as the raised back of an altar or the like; a set raised over another. "The gradines of the amphitheeater." Layard.

dactylitis.definition: An inflammatory affection of the fingers. Gross.

reliant.definition: Having, or characterized by, reliance; confident; trusting.

threepence.definition: A small silver coin of three times the value of a penny. [Eng.].

unguinous.definition: Consisting of, or resembling, fat or oil; oily; unctuous; oleaginous.

van-courier.definition: One sent in advance; an avant-courier; a precursor.

clumsiness.definition: The quality of being clusy. The drudging part of life is chiefly owing to clumsiness and ignorance. Collier.

radicate.definition:
Radicated.

To take root; to become rooted. Evelyn.

To cause to take root; to plant deeply and firmly; to root. Time should . . . rather confirm and radicate in us the remembrance of God's goodness. Barrow.

scrat.definition:
To scratch. Burton.

To rake; to search. Mir. for Mag.

An hermaphrodite. Skinner.

mercaptide.definition: A compound of mercaptan formed by replacing its sulphur hydrogen by a metal; as, potassium mercaptide, C2H5SK.

alecost.definition: The plant costmary, which was formerly much used for flavoring ale.

artiad.definition: Even; not odd; -- said of elementary substances and of radicals the valence of which is divisible by two without a remainder.

faradize.definition: To stimulate with, or subject to, faradic, or inducted, electric currents. --Far"a*diz`er (#), n.

mandingos.definition: ; sing. Mandingo. (Ethnol.) An extensive and powerful tribe of West African negroes.

thetine.definition: Any one of a series of complex basic sulphur compounds analogous to the sulphines.

spectatress.definition: A female beholder or looker-on. "A spectatress of the whole scene." Jeffrey.

punctually.definition: In a punctual manner; promptly; exactly.

snuff.definition:
The part of a candle wick charred by the flame, whether burning or not. If the burning snuff happens to get out of the snuffers, you have a chance that it may fall into a dish of soup. Swift.

To crop the snuff of, as a candle; to take off the end of the snuff of. To snuff out, to extinguish by snuf.

semi-pelagianism.definition: The doctrines or tenets of the Semi-Pelagians.

meroistic.definition: Applied to the ovaries of insects when they secrete vitelligenous cells, as well as ova.

polystyle.definition: Having many columns; -- said of a building, especially of an interior part or court; as, a polystyle hall. -- n.  A polystyle hall or edifice.

orology.definition: The science or description of mountains.

dinosaurian.definition: One of the Dinosauria. [Written also deinosaur, and deinosaurian.].

gad.definition: The point of a spear, or an arrowhead. 2. A pointed or wedge-shaped instrument of metal, as a steel wedge used in mining, etc. I will go get a leaf of brass, And with a gad of steel will write these words. Shak. 3. A sharp-pointed rod; a goad. 4. A spike on a gauntlet; a gadling. Fairholt. 5. A wedg.

boughten.definition: Purchased; not obtained or produced at home. Coleridge.

auditive.definition: Of or pertaining to hearing; auditory. Cotgrave.

fint.definition: 3d pers. sing. pr. of Find, for findeth. Chaucer.

rowel.definition: The little wheel of a spur, with sharp points. With sounding whip, and rowels dyed in blood. Cowper. 2. A little flat ring or wheel on horses' bits. The iron rowels into frothy foam he bit. Spenser. 3. (Far.)  A roll of hair, silk, etc., passed through the flesh of horses, answering to a seton in hu.

soberness.definition: The quality or state of being sober.

squamella.definition: A diminutive scale or bractlet, such as those found on the receptacle in many composite plants; a palea.

idioelectric.definition: Electric by virtue of its own peculiar properties; capable of becoming electrified by friction; -- opposed to anelectric. -- n.  An idioelectric substance.

esculin.definition: A glucoside obtained from the Æsculus hippocastanum, or horse- chestnut, and characterized by its fine blue fluorescent solutions. [Written also æsculin.].

nurl.definition: To cut with reeding or fluting on the edge of, as coins, the heads of screws, etc.; to knurl.

cacaemia.definition: A degenerated or poisoned condition of the blood.

autocrat.definition: An absolute sovereign; a monarch who holds and exercises the powers of government by claim of absolute right, not subject to restriction; as, Autocrat of all the Russias (a title of the Czar). 2. One who rules with undisputed sway in any company or relation; a despot. The autocrat of the breakfast t.

capsulitis.definition: Inflammation of a capsule, as that of the crystalline lens.

spectrology.definition: The science of spectrum analysis in any or all of its relations and applications.

athrepsia.definition: Profound debility of children due to lack of food and to unhygienic surroundings. --A*threp"tic (#), a.

orvietan.definition: A kind of antidote for poisons; a counter poison formerly in vogue.

jowler.definition: A dog with large jowls, as the beagle.

cark.definition:
A noxious or corroding care; solicitude; worry. [Archaic.] His heavy head, devoid of careful cark. Spenser. Fling cark and care aside. Motherwell. Ereedom from the cares of money and the cark of fashion. R. D. Blackmore.

To be careful, anxious, solicitous, or troubles in mind; to worry or grieve. B.

dibble.definition:
A pointed implement used to make holes in the ground in which no set out plants or to plant seeds.

To dib or dip frequently, as in angling. Walton.

1. To plant with a dibble; to make holes in (soil) with a dibble, for planting. 2. To make holes or indentations in, as if with a dibble. The clayey s.

subdiversify.definition: To diversify aggain what is already diversified. Sir M. Hale.

martingal.definition: A strap fastened to a horse's girth, passing between his fore legs, and fastened to the bit, or now more commonly ending in two rings, through which the reins pass. It is intended to hold down the head of the horse, and prevent him from rearing. 2. (Naut.)  A lower stay of rope or chain for the jib.

egoism.definition: (Philos.)  The doctrine of certain extreme adherents or disciples of Descartes and Johann Gottlieb Fichte, which finds all the elements of knowledge in the ego and the relations which it implies or provides for. 2. Excessive love and thought of self; the habit of regarding one's self as the center o.

footrope.definition: (a) The rope rigged below a yard, upon which men stand when reefing or furling; -- formerly called a horse. (b) That part of the boltrope to which the lower edge of a sail is sewed.

otorrhoea.definition: A flow or running from the ear, esp. a purulent discharge.

sowle.definition: To pull by the ears; to drag about. hak.

sciential.definition: Pertaining to, or producing, science. Milton.

magneto-electricity.definition: Electricity evolved by the action of magnets. 2. (Physics)  That branch of science which treats of the development of electricity by the action of magnets; -- the counterpart of electro- magnetism.

eros.definition: Love; the god of love; -- by earlier writers represented as one of the first and creative gods, by later writers as the son of Aphrodite, equivalent to the Latin god Cupid.

spiculispongiae.definition: A division of sponges including those which have independent siliceous spicules.

jailer.definition: The keeper of a jail or prison. [Written also jailor, gaoler.].

psychian.definition: Any small moth of the genus Psyche and allied genera (family Psychidæ). The larvæ are called basket worms. See Basket worm, under Basket.

insearch.definition: To make search after; to investigate or examine; to ensearch.

libel.definition: A brief writing of any kind, esp. a declaration, bill, certificate, request, supplication, etc. Chaucer. A libel of forsaking [divorcement]. Wyclif (Matt. v. 31). 2. Any defamatory writing; a lampoon; a satire. 3. (Law)  A malicious publication expressed either in print or in writing, or by pictures.

crispate.definition: Having a crisped appearance; irregularly curled or twisted.

glyoxal.definition: A white, amorphous, deliquescent powder, (CO.H)2, obtained by the partial oxidation of glycol. It is a double aldehyde, between glycol and oxalic acid.

miscreated.definition: Formed unnaturally or illegitimately; deformed. Spenser. Milton.

roscoelite.definition: A green micaceous mineral occurring in minute scales. It is essentially a silicate of aluminia and potash containing vanadium.

vitellus.definition: (Biol.)  The contents or substance of the ovum; egg yolk. See Illust. of Ovum. 2. (Bot.)  Perisperm in an early condition.

cropper.definition: One that crops. 2. A variety of pigeon with a large crop; a pouter. 3. (Mech.)  A machine for cropping, as for shearing off bolts or rod iron, or for facing cloth. 4. A fall on one's head when riding at full speed, as in hunting; hence, a sudden failure or collapse. [Slang.].

basilisk.definition: A fabulous serpent, or dragon. The ancients alleged that its hissing would drive away all other serpents, and that its breath, and even its look, was fatal. See Cockatrice. Make me not sighted like the basilisk. Shak. 2. (Zoöl.)  A lizard of the genus Basiliscus, belonging to the family Iguanidæ. No.

jutlander.definition: A native or inhabitant of Jutland in Denmark.

meed.definition:
That which is bestowed or rendered in consideration of merit; reward; recompense. A rosy garland was the victor's meed. Spenser. 2. Merit or desert; worth. My meed hath got me fame. Shak. 3. A gift; also, a bride. Chaucer.

1. To reward; to repay. Waytt. 2. To deserve; to merit. Heywood.

xenelasia.definition: A Spartan institution which prohibited strangers from residing in Sparta without permission, its object probably being to preserve the national simplicity of manners.

chap.definition:
To cause to open in slits or chinks; to split; to cause the skin of to crack or become rough. Then would unbalanced heat licentious reign, Crack the dry hill, and chap the russet plain. Blackmore. Nor winter's blast chap her fair face. Lyly. 2. To strike; to beat. [Scot.]

1. To crack or open in sli.

croise.definition: A pilgrim bearing or wearing a cross. 2. A crusader. The conquesta of the croises extending over Palestine. Burke.

imitate.definition: To follow as a pattern, model, or example; to copy or strive to copy, in acts, manners etc. Despise wealth and imitate a dog. Cowlay. 2. To produce a semblance or likeness of, in form, character, color, qualities, conduct, manners, and the like; to counterfeit; to copy. A place picked out by choice.

contrariness.definition: state or quality of being contrary; opposition; inconsistency; contrariety; perverseness; obstinancy.

upflow.definition: To flow or stream up. Southey.

pentalpha.definition: A five-pointed star, resembling five alphas joined at their bases; -- used as a symbol.

neoterist.definition: One ho introduces new word Fitzed Hall.

benthos.definition: The bottom of the sea, esp. of the deep oceans; hence (Bot. & Zoöl.), the fauna and flora of the sea bottom; -- opposed to plankton.

cirrose.definition: (a) Bearing a tendril or tendrils; as, a cirrose leaf. (b) Resembling a tendril or cirrus. [Spelt also cirrhose.].

ecballium.definition: A genus of cucurbitaceous plants consisting of the single species Ecballium agreste (or Elaterium), the squirting cucumber. Its fruit, when ripe, bursts and violently ejects its seeds, together with a mucilaginous juice, from which elaterium, a powerful cathartic medicine, is prepared.

autograph.definition:
That which is written with one's own hand; an original manuscript; a person's own signature or handwriting.

In one's own handwriting; as, an autograph letter; an autograph will.

abluvion.definition: That which is washed off. Dwight.

flix.definition:
Down; fur. [Obs. or Eng.] J. Dyer.

The flux; dysentery. Udall. Flix weed (Bot.), the Sisymbrium Sophia, a kind of hedge mustard, formerly used as a remedy for dysentery.

hirling.definition: The young of the sea trout.

strouding.definition: Material for strouds; a kind of coarse cloth used in trade with the North American Indians.

lophophore.definition: A disk which surrounds the mouth and bears the tentacles of the Bryozoa. See Phylactolemata.

steeple.definition: A spire; also, the tower and spire taken together; the whole of a structure if the roof is of spire form. See Spire. "A weathercock on a steeple." Shak. Rood steeple. See Rood tower, under Rood. -- Steeple bush (Bot.), a low shrub (Spiræa tomentosa) having dense panicles of minute rose-colored flowe.

aguise.definition:
Dress. Dr. H. More.

To dress; to attire; to adorn. Above all knights ye goodly seem aguised. Spenser.

wellhead.definition: A source, spring, or fountain. At the wellhead the purest streams arise. Spenser. Our public-school and university life is a great wellhead of new and irresponsible words. Earle.

martlet.definition: (Zoöl.)  The European house martin. 2. Etym: [Cf. F. merlette.] (Her.)  A bird without beak or feet; -- generally assumed to represent a martin. As a mark of cadency it denotes the fourth son.

barmecidal.definition: Unreal; illusory. "A sort of Barmecidal feast." Hood.

aleutic.definition: Of or pertaining to a chain of islands between Alaska and Kamtchatka; also, designating these islands.

prelatically.definition: In a prelatical manner; with reference to prelates. Milton. The last Georgic was a good prelude to the Æneis.

syndic.definition: An officer of government, invested with different powers in different countries; a magistrate. 2. (Law)  An agent of a corporation, or of any body of men engaged in a business enterprise; an advocate or patron; an assignee. Note: In France, syndics are appointed by the creditors of a bankrupt to man.

tenebrificous.definition: Tenebrific. Authors who are tenebrificous stars. Addison.

vexillation.definition: A company of troops under one vexillum.

awkward.definition: Wanting dexterity in the use of the hands, or of instruments; not dexterous; without skill; clumsy; wanting ease, grace, or effectiveness in movement; ungraceful; as, he was awkward at a trick; an awkward boy. And dropped an awkward courtesy. Dryden. 2. Not easily managed or effected; embarrassing.

assentive.definition: Giving assent; of the nature of assent; complying. -- As*sent"ive*ness, n.

planometry.definition: The art or process of producing or gauging a plane surface.

bdellomorpha.definition: An order of Nemertina, including the large leechlike worms (Malacobdella) often parasitic in clams.

curly.definition: Curling or tending to curl; having curls; full of ripples; crinkled.

lactucin.definition: A white, crystalline substance, having a bitter taste and a neutral reaction, and forming one of the essential ingredients of lactucarium.

lambdoid.definition: Shaped like the Greek letter lambda (as, the lambdoid suture between the occipital and parietal bones of the skull.

eisteddfod.definition: Am assembly or session of the Welsh bards; an annual congress of bards, minstrels and literati of Wales, -- being a patriotic revival of the old custom.

pustulate.definition:
To form into pustules, or blisters.

Covered with pustulelike prominences; pustular; pustulous; as, a pustulate leaf; a pustulate shell or coral.

shortcoming.definition: The act of falling, or coming short; as: (a) The failure of a crop, or the like. (b) Neglect of, or failure in, performance of duty.

clod.definition: A lump or mass, especially of earth, turf, or clay. "Clods of a slimy substance." Carew. "Clods of iron and brass." Milton. "Clods of blood." E. Fairfax. The earth that casteth up from the plow a great clod, is not so good as that which casteth up a smaller clod. Bacon. 2. The ground; the earth; a s.

orthoceratite.definition: An orthoceras; also, any fossil shell allied to Orthoceras.

ejector.definition: One who, or that which, ejects or dispossesses. 2. (Mech.)  A jet jump for lifting water or withdrawing air from a space. Ejector condenser (Steam Engine), a condenser in which the vacuum is maintained by a jet pump.

gangliform.definition: Having the form of a ganglion.

colonist.definition: A member or inhabitant of a colony.

inhibitory-motor.definition: A term applied to certain nerve centers which govern or restrain subsidiary centers, from which motor impressions issue. McKendrick.

vilayet.definition: One of the chief administrative divisions or provinces of the Ottoman Empire; -- formerly called eyalet.

dairymaid.definition: A female servant whose business is the care of the dairy.

scratcher.definition: One who, or that which, scratches; specifically (Zoöl.), any rasorial bird.

immorality.definition: The state or quality of being immoral; vice. The root of all immorality. Sir W. Temple. 2. An immoral act or practice. Luxury and sloth and then a great drove of heresies and immoralities broke loose among them. Milton.

subrogation.definition: The act of subrogating. Specifically: (Law)  The substitution of one person in the place of another as a creditor, the new creditor succeeding to the rights of the former; the mode by which a third person who pays a creditor succeeds to his rights against the debtor. Bouvier. Burrill. Abbott.

kendal.definition: A cloth colored green by dye obtained from the woad-waxen, formerly used by Flemish weavers at Kendal, in Westmoreland, England. J. Smith (Dict. Econ. Plants). How couldst thou know these men in Kendal green Shak.

tu-whoo.definition: Words imitative of the notes of the owl. Thy tu-whits are lulled, I wot, Thy tu-whoos of yesternight. Tennyson.

shearer.definition: One who shears. Like a lamb dumb before his shearer. Acts viii. 32. 2. A reaper. [Scot.] Jamieson.

seemly.definition: Suited to the object, occasion, purpose, or character; suitable; fit; becoming; comely; decorous. He had a seemly nose. Chaucer. I am a woman, lacking wit To make a seemly answer to such persons. Shak. Suspense of judgment and exercise of charity were safer and seemlier for Christian men than the ho.

incrassate.definition: To make thick or thicker; to thicken; especially, in pharmacy, to thicken (a liquid) by the mixture of another substance, or by evaporating the thinner parts. Acids dissolve or attenuate; alkalies precipitate or incrassate. Sir I. Newton. Liquors which time hath incrassated into jellies. Sir T. Brow.

peristyle.definition: A range of columns with their entablature, etc.; specifically, a complete system of columns, whether on all sides of a court, or surrounding a building, such as the cella of a temple. Used in the former sense, it gives name to the larger and inner court of a Roman dwelling, the peristyle. See Colonn.

trivalve.definition: Anything having three valves, especially a shell.

panurgic.definition: Skilled in all kinds of work. "The panurgic Diderot." J. Morley.

tipple.definition: To drink spirituous or strong liquors habitually; to indulge in the frequent and improper used of spirituous liquors; especially, to drink frequently in small quantities, but without absolute drunkeness. Few of those who were summoned left their homes, and those few generally found it more agreeable.

writative.definition: Inclined to much writing; -- correlative to talkative. Pope.

carucate.definition: A plowland; as much land as one team can plow in a year and a day; -- by some said to be about 100 acres. Burrill.

shiner.definition: That which shines. Specifically: (a) A luminary. (b) A bright piece of money. [Slang] Has she the shiners, d' ye think Foote. black eye. (c) (Zoöl.) Any one of numerous species of small freshwater American cyprinoid fishes, belonging to Notropis, or Minnilus, and allied genera; as the redfin (Notrop.

leontodon.definition: A genus of liguliflorous composite plants, including the fall dandelion (L. autumnale), and formerly the true dandelion; -- called also lion's tooth.

autophony.definition: An auscultatory process, which consists in noting the tone of the observer's own voice, while he speaks, holding his head close to the patient's chest. Dunglison.

thallus.definition: A solid mass of cellular tissue, consisting of one or more layers, usually in the form of a flat stratum or expansion, but sometimes erect or pendulous, and elongated and branching, and forming the substance of the thallogens.

isoperimetry.definition: The science of figures having equal perimeters or boundaries.

lactobutyrometer.definition: An instrument for determining the amount of butter fat contained in a given sample of milk.

interpubic.definition: Between the pubic bones or cartilages; as, the interpubic disk.

pavonine.definition: (Zoöl.)  Like, or pertaining to, the genus Pavo. 2. Characteristic of a peacock; resembling the tail of a peacock, as in colors; iridescent. P. Cleaveland.

volti.definition: Turn, that is, turn over the leaf. Volti subito Etym: [It.] (Mus.), turn over quickly.

photochemical.definition: Of or pertaining to chemical action of light, or produced by it; as, the photochemical changes of the visual purple of the retina.

prolicide.definition: The crime of destroying one's offspring, either in the womb or after birth. Bouvier.

arboretum.definition: A place in which a collection of rare trees and shrubs is cultivated for scientific or educational purposes.

evincement.definition: The act of evincing or proving, or the state of being evinced.

blindness.definition: State or condition of being blind, literally or figuratively. Darwin. Color blindness, inability to distinguish certain color. See Daltonism.

polander.definition: A native or inhabitant of Poland; a Pole.

anabranch.definition: A branch of a river that reënters, or anastomoses with, the main stream; also, less properly, a branch which loses itself in sandy soil. [Australia] Such branches of a river as after separation reunite, I would term anastomosing branches; or, if a word might be coined, anabranches, and the islands t.

clangous.definition: Making a clang, or a ringing metallic sound.

heartener.definition: One who, or that which, heartens, animates, or stirs up. W. Browne.
