garniture.definition: That which garnishes; ornamental appendage; embellishment; furniture; dress. The pomp of groves and garniture of fields. Beattie.

eyesore.definition: Something offensive to the eye or sight; a blemish. Mordecai was an eyesore to Haman. L'Estrange.

sauerkraut.definition: Cabbage cut fine and allowed to ferment in a brine made of its own juice with salt, -- a German dish.

conicalness.definition: State or quality of being conical.

counterchanged.definition: Exchanged. 2. (Her.)  Having the tinctures exchanged mutually; thus, if the field is divided palewise, or and azure, and cross is borne counterchanged, that part of the cross which comes on the azure side will be or, and that on the or side will be azure.

fossane.definition: A species of civet (Viverra fossa) resembling the genet.

neuron.definition: The brain and spinal cord; the cerebro-spinal axis; myelencephalon. B. G. Wilder.

arthrodynia.definition: An affection characterized by pain in or about a joint, not dependent upon structural disease.

zygodactylic.definition: Yoke-footed; having the toes disposed in pairs; -- applied to birds which have two toes before and two behind, as the parrot, cuckoo, woodpecker, etc.

birthwort.definition: A genus of herbs and shrubs (Aristolochia), reputed to have medicinal properties.

prick.definition: That which pricks, penetrates, or punctures; a sharp and slender thing; a pointed instrument; a goad; a spur, etc.; a point; a skewer. Pins, wooden pricks, nails, sprigs of rosemary. Shak. It is hard for thee to kick against the pricks. Acts ix. 5. 2. The act of pricking, or the sensation of being p.

hun.definition: One of a warlike nomadic people of Northern Asia who, in the 5th century, under Atilla, invaded and conquered a great part of Europe.

liberate.definition: To release from restraint or bondage; to set at liberty; to free; to manumit; to disengage; as, to liberate a slave or prisoner; to liberate the mind from prejudice; to liberate gases. Syn. -- To deliver; free; release. See Deliver.

arsenic.definition: (Chem.)  One of the elements, a solid substance resembling a metal in its physical properties, but in its chemical relations ranking with the nonmetals. It is of a steel-gray color and brilliant luster, though usually dull from tarnish. It is very brittle, and sublimes at 356º Fahrenheit. It is some.

gutwort.definition: A plant, Globularia Alypum, a violent purgative, found in Africa.

exceptioner.definition: One who takes exceptions or makes objections. Milton.

trapeze.definition: (Geom.)  A trapezium. See Trapezium, 1. 2. A swinging horizontal bar, suspended at each end by a rope; -- used by gymnasts.

coleperch.definition: A kind of small black perch.

frenzied.definition: Affected with frenzy; frantic; maddened. -- Fren"zied-ly, adv. The people frenzied by centuries of oppression. Buckle. Up starting with a frenzied look. Sir W Scott.

extrusive.definition: Forced out at the surface; as, extrusive rocks; -- contrasted with intrusive.

clubbish.definition: Rude; clownish. 2. Disposed to club together; as, a clubbish set.

cisleithan.definition: On the Austrian side of the river Leitha; Austrian.

ametropia.definition: Any abnormal condition of the refracting powers of the eye. -- Am`e*trop"ic, a.

tralatitiously.definition: , adv. In a tralatitious manner; metephorically. Holder.

well-seen.definition: Having seen much; hence, accomplished; experienced. Beau. & Fl. Well-seen in arms and proved in many a fight. Spenser.

ultroneous.definition: Spontaneous; voluntary. Jer. Taylor. -- Ul*tro"ne*ous*ly, adv. -- Ul*tro"ne*ous*ness, n.

taskwork.definition: Work done as a task; also, work done by the job; piecework.

suave.definition: Sweet; pleasant; delightful; gracious or agreeable in manner; bland. -- Suave"ly, adv.

malkin.definition: Originally, a kitchenmaid; a slattern. Chaucer. 2. A mop made of clouts, used by the kitchen servant. 3. A scarecrow. 4. (Mil.)  A mop or sponge attached to a jointed staff for swabbing out a cannon.

ghastliness.definition: The state of being ghastly; a deathlike look.

sonant.definition: Of or pertaining to sound; sounding. 2. (Phonetics)  Uttered, as an element of speech, with tone or proper vocal sound, as distinguished from mere breath sound; intonated; voiced; tonic; the opposite of nonvocal, or surd; -- sid of the vowels, semivowels, liquids, and nasals, and particularly of the.

bashi-bazouk.definition: A soldier belonging to the irregular troops of the Turkish army.

paralogism.definition: A reasoning which is false in point of form, that is, which is contrary to logical rules or formulæ; a formal fallacy, or pseudo- syllogism, in which the conclusion does not follow from the premises.

femme.definition: A woman. See Feme, n. Femme de chambre. Etym: [F.] A lady's maid; a chambermaid.

euclidian.definition: Related to Euclid, or to the geometry of Euclid. Euclidian space (Geom.), the kind of space to which the axioms and definitions of Euclid, relative to straight lines and parallel lines, apply; -- called also flat space, and homaloidal space.

photozincography.definition: A process, analogous to photolithography, for reproducing photographed impressions transferred to zinc plate.

pitahaya.definition: A cactaceous shrub (Cereus Pitajaya) of tropical America, which yields a delicious fruit.

alatern.definition: An ornamental evergreen shrub (Rhamnus alaternus) belonging to the buckthorns.

wurraluh.definition: The Australian white-quilled honey eater (Entomyza albipennis).

kinepox.definition: See Cowpox. Kin"e*scope (, n.  See Kinetoscope.

methodic.definition: Arranged with regard to method; disposed in a suitable manner, or in a manner to illustrate a subject, or to facilitate practical observation; as, the methodical arrangement of arguments; a methodical treatise. "Methodical regularity." Addison. 2. Proceeding with regard to method; systematic. "Arist.

commencement.definition: The first existence of anything; act or fact of commencing; rise; origin; beginnig; start. The time of Henry VII . . . nearly coincides with the commencement of what is termed "modern history." 2. The day when degrees are conferred by colleges and universities upon students and others.

distributary.definition: Tending to distribute or be distributed; that distributes; distributive.

endoblastic.definition: Relating to the endoblast; as, the endoblastic layer.

experimentarian.definition: Relying on experiment or experience. "an experimentarian philosopher." Boyle. -- n.  One who relies on experiment or experience.

semiquintile.definition: An aspect of the planets when distant from each other half of the quintile, or thirty-six degrees.

paternity.definition: The relation of a father to his child; fathership; fatherhood; family headship; as, the divine paternity. The world, while it had scarcity of people, underwent no other dominion than paternity and eldership. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. Derivation or descent from a father; male parentage; as, the paternity of.

elongate.definition:
To lengthen; to extend; to stretch; as, to elongate a line. 2. To remove further off. Sir T. Browne.

To depart to, or be at, a distance; esp., to recede apparently from the sun, as a planet in its orbit.

Drawn out at length; elongated; as, an elongate leaf. "An elongate form." Earle.

probator.definition: An examiner; an approver. Maydman. 2. (O. Eng. Law)  One who, when indicted for crime, confessed it, and accused others, his accomplices, in order to obtain pardon; a state's evidence.

enrobe.definition: To invest or adorn with a robe; to attire.

winter-rig.definition: To fallow or till in winter. WINTER'S BARK Win"ter's bark`. (Bot.)  The aromatic bark of tree (Drimys, or Drymis, Winteri) of the Magnolia family, which is found in Southern Chili. It was first used as a cure for scurvy by its discoverer, Captain John Winter, vice admiral to sir Francis Drake, in 15.

interfusion.definition: The act of interfusing, or the state of being interfused. Coleridge.

skimmington.definition: A word employed in the phrase, To ride Skimmington; that is to ride on a horse with a woman, but behind her, facing backward, carrying a distaff, and accompanied by a procession of jeering neighbors making mock music; a cavalcade in ridicule of a henpecked man. The custom was in vogue in parts of En.

impetus.definition: A property possessed by a moving body in virtue of its weight and its motion; the force with which any body is driven or impelled; momentum. Note: Momentum is the technical term, impetus its popular equivalent, yet differing from it as applied commonly to bodies moving or moved suddenly or violently.

sacculus.definition: A little sac; esp., a part of the membranous labyrinth of the ear. See the Note under Ear.

mugger.definition: The common crocodile (Crocodilus palustris) of India, the East Indies, etc. It becomes twelve feet or more long.

cucurbitive.definition: Having the shape of a gourd seed; -- said of certain small worms.

exoterics.definition: The public lectures or published writings of Aristotle. See Esoterics.

ductile.definition: Easily led; tractable; complying; yielding to motives, persuasion, or instruction; as, a ductile people. Addison. Forms their ductile minds To human virtues. Philips. 2. Capable of being elongated or drawn out, as into wire or threads. Gold . . . is the softest and most ductile of all metals. Dryden.

sumpitan.definition: A kind of blowgun for discharging arrows, -- used by the savages of Borneo and adjacent islands.

apocalyptic.definition:
Of or pertaining to a revelation, or, specifically, to the Revelation of St. John; containing, or of the nature of, a prophetic revelation. Apocolyptic number, the number 666, mentioned in Rev. xiii. 18. It has been variously interpreted.

The writer of the Apocalypse.

interviewer.definition: One who interviews; especially, one who obtains an interview with another for the purpose of eliciting his opinions or obtaining information for publication. It would have made him the prince of interviewers in these days. Leslie Stephen.

corsak.definition: A small foxlike mammal (Cynalopex corsac), found in Central Asia. [Written also corsac.].

redfish.definition: (a) The blueback salmon of the North Pacific; -- called also nerka. See Blueback. (b). (b) The rosefish. (c) A large California labroid food fish (Trochocopus pulcher); -- called also fathead. (d) The red bass, red drum, or drumfish. See the Note under Drumfish.

carbonatation.definition: The saturation of defecated beet juice with carbonic acid gas. Knight.

trimyarian.definition: A lamellibranch which has three muscular scars on each valve.

rhopalic.definition: Applied to a line or verse in which each successive word has one more syllable than the preceding.

convallamarin.definition: A white, crystalline, poisonous substance, regarded as a glucoside, extracted from the lily of the valley (Convallaria Majalis). Its taste is first bitter, then sweet.

lengthiness.definition: The state or quality of being lengthy; prolixity.

impersonate.definition: To invest with personality; to endow with the form of a living being. 2. To ascribe the qualities of a person to; to personify. 3. To assume, or to represent, the person or character of; to personate; as, he impersonated Macbeth. Benedict impersonated his age. Milman.

uppertendom.definition: The highest class in society; the upper ten. See Upper ten, under Upper.

wishedly.definition: According to wish; conformably to desire. Chapman.

mnemosyne.definition: The goddess of memory and the mother of the Muses.

hagiology.definition: The history or description of the sacred writings or of sacred persons; a narrative of the lives of the saints; a catalogue of saints. J. H. Newman.

speck.definition:
The blubber of whales or other marine mammals; also, the fat of the hippopotamus. Speck falls (Naut.), falls or ropes rove through blocks for hoisting the blubber and bone of whales on board a whaling vessel.

1. A small discolored place in or on anything, or a small place of a color different from.

carnation.definition: The natural color of flesh; rosy pink. Her complexion of the delicate carnation. Ld. Lytton. 2. pl. (Paint.)  Those parts of a picture in which the human body or any part of it is represented in full color; the flesh tints. The flesh tints in painting are termed carnations. Fairholt. 3. (Bot.)  A sp.

parasiticide.definition: Anything used to destroy parasites. Quain.

hypocaust.definition: A furnace, esp. one connected with a series of small chambers and flues of tiles or other masonry through which the heat of a fire was distributed to rooms above. This contrivance, first used in bath, was afterwards adopted in private houses.

broadaxe.definition: An ancient military weapon; a battle-ax. 2. An ax with a broad edge, for hewing timber.

desquamative.definition: Of, pertaining to, or attended with, desquamation.

urinator.definition: One who dives under water in search of something, as for pearls; a diver. Ray.

buffoonly.definition: Low; vulgar. Apish tricks and buffoonly discourse. Goodman.

deconcentrate.definition: To withdraw from concentration; to decentralize.

anchored.definition: Held by an anchor; at anchor; held safely; as, an anchored bark; also, shaped like an anchor; forked; as, an anchored tongue. 2. (Her.)  Having the extremities turned back, like the flukes of an anchor; as, an anchored cross. [Sometimes spelt ancred.].

self-righteousness.definition: The quality or state of being self-righteous; pharisaism.

volatilize.definition: To render volatile; to cause to exhale or evaporate; to cause to pass off in vapor. The water . . . dissolving the oil, and volatilizing it by the action. Sir I. Newton.

doleritic.definition: Of the nature of dolerite; as, much lava is doleritic lava. Dana.

almagest.definition: The celebrated work of Ptolemy of Alexandria, which contains nearly all that is known of the astronomical observations and theories of the ancients. The name was extended to other similar works.

casuarina.definition: A genus of leafles trees or shrubs, with drooping branchlets of a rushlike appearance, mostly natives of Australia. Some of them are large, producing hard and heavy timber of excellent quality, called beefwood from its color.

concrescive.definition: Growing together, or into union; uniting. Eclec. Rev.

affamish.definition: To afflict with, or perish from, hunger. Spenser.

imposthume.definition:
A collection of pus or purulent matter in any part of an animal body; an abscess.

Same as Imposthumate.

subtilty.definition: The quality or state of being subtile; thinness; fineness; as, the subtility of air or light. 2. Refinement; extreme acuteness; subtlety. Intelligible discourses are spoiled by too much subtility in nice divisions. Locke. 3. Cunning; skill; craft. To learn a lewd man this subtility. Chaucer. 4. Slyn.

underthing.definition: Something that is inferior and of little worth. Beau. & Fl.

sorely.definition: In a sore manner; grievously; painfully; as, to be sorely afflicted.

teaseling.definition: The cutting and gathering of teasels; the use of teasels. [Written also teaselling, teazling.].

hydrostat.definition: A contrivance or apparatus to prevent the explosion of steam boilers.

jesuitism.definition: The principles and practices of the Jesuits. 2. Cunning; deceit; deceptive practices to effect a purpose; subtle argument; -- an opprobrious use of the word.

philosophical.definition: Of or pertaining to philosophy; versed in, or imbued with, the principles of philosophy; hence, characterizing a philosopher; rational; wise; temperate; calm; cool. -- Phil`o*soph"ic*al*ly, adv.

implantation.definition: The act or process of implantating.

exotery.definition: That which is obvious, public, or common. Dealing out exoteries only to the vulgar. A. Tucker.

galvanize.definition: To affect with galvanism; to subject to the action of electrical currents. 2. To plate, as with gold, silver, etc., by means of electricity. 3. To restore to consciousness by galvanic action (as from a state of suspended animation); hence, to stimulate or excite to a factitious animation or activity.

herisson.definition: A beam or bar armed with iron spikes, and turning on a pivot; - - used to block up a passage.

multiplicative.definition: Tending to multiply; having the power to multiply, or incease numbers.

dependancy.definition: See Dependent, Dependence, Dependency. Note: The forms dependant, dependance, dependancy are from the French; the forms dependent, etc., are from the Latin. Some authorities give preference to the form dependant when the word is a noun, thus distinguishing it from the adjective, usually written depe.

maieutical.definition: Serving to assist childbirth. Cudworth. 2. Fig. : Aiding, or tending to, the definition and interpretation of thoughts or language. Payne.

foundry.definition: The act, process, or art of casting metals. 2. The buildings and works for casting metals. Foundry ladle, a vessel for holding molten metal and conveying it from cupola to the molds.

bruit.definition:
Report; rumor; fame. The bruit thereof will bring you many friends. Shak. 2. [French pron. (Med.)  An abnormal sound of several kinds, heard on auscultation.

To report; to noise abroad. I find thou art no less than fame hath bruited. Shak.

peirastic.definition: Fitted for trail or test; experimental; tentative; treating of attempts.

diorism.definition: Definition; logical direction. Dr. H. More.

consubstantial.definition: Of the same kind or nature; having the same substance or essence; coessential. Christ Jesus . . . coeternal and consubstantial with the Father and with the Holy Ghost. Foxe.

pinery.definition: A pine forest; a grove of pines. 2. A hothouse in which pineapples are grown.

mortiferous.definition: Bringing or producing death; deadly; destructive; as, a mortiferous herb. Gov. of Tongue.

incorporative.definition: Incorporating or tending to incorporate; as, the incorporative languages (as of the Basques, North American Indians, etc. ) which run a whole phrase into one word. History demonstrates that incorporative unions are solid and permanent; but that a federal union is weak. W. Belsham.

unethes.definition: With difficulty; scarcely. See Uneath. [Written also unethe, unneth, unnethe, unnethes, etc.] Chaucer.

ectomere.definition: The more transparent cells, which finally become external, in many segmenting ova, as those of mammals.

assertive.definition: Positive; affirming confidently; affirmative; peremptory. In a confident and assertive form. Glanvill. As*sert"ive*ly, adv. -- As*sert"ive*ness, n.

teg.definition: A sheep in its second year; also, a doe in its second year. Halliwell.

leden.definition: Language; speech; voice; cry. Chaucer. Spenser.

externalize.definition: To make external; to manifest by outward form. Thought externalizes itself in language. Soyce.

emasculate.definition:
To deprive of virile or procreative power; to castrate power; to castrate; to geld. 2. To deprive of masculine vigor or spirit; to weaken; to render effeminate; to vitiate by unmanly softness. Luxury had not emasculated their minds. V. Knox.

Deprived of virility or vigor; unmanned; weak. "Emasculat.

wealthiness.definition: The quality or state of being wealthy, or rich; richness; opulence.

atheroma.definition: (a) An encysted tumor containing curdy matter. (b) A disease characterized by thickening and fatty degeneration of the inner coat of the arteries.

yare.definition:
Ready; dexterous; eager; lively; quick to move. "Be yare in thy preparation." Shak. The lesser [ship] will come and go, leave or take, and is yare; whereas the greater is slow. Sir W. Raleigh.

Soon. Cursor Mundi.

associative.definition: Having the quality of associating; tending or leading to association; as, the associative faculty. Hugh Miller.

pipefish.definition: Any lophobranch fish of the genus Siphostoma, or Syngnathus, and allied genera, having a long and very slender angular body, covered with bony plates. The mouth is small, at the end of a long, tubular snout. The male has a pouch on his belly, in which the incubation of the eggs takes place.

gradatory.definition:
Proceeding step by step, or by gradations; gradual. Could we have seen [Macbeth's] crimes darkening on their progress . . . could this gradatory apostasy have been shown us. A. Seward. 2. (Zoöl.)  Suitable for walking; -- said of the limbs of an animal when adapted for walking on land.

A series of.

maidenly.definition:
Like a maid; suiting a maid; maiden-like; gentle, modest, reserved. Must you be blushing . . . What a maidenly man-at-arms are you become ! Shak.

In a maidenlike manner. "Maidenly demure." Skelton.

embodiment.definition: The act of embodying; the state of being embodied. 2. That which embodies or is embodied; representation in a physical body; a completely organized system, like the body; as, the embodiment of courage, or of courtesy; the embodiment of true piety.

zillah.definition: A district or local division, as of a province. [India].

exhaustibility.definition: Capability of being exhausted. I was seriously tormented by the thought of the exhaustibility of musical combinations. J. S. Mill.

splenius.definition: A flat muscle of the back of the neck.

unsad.definition: Unsteady; fickle. O, stormy people, unsad and ever untrue. Chaucer.

benzonaphthol.definition: A white crystalline powder used as an intestinal antiseptic; beta-naphthol benzoate.

greco-roman.definition: Having characteristics that are partly Greek and partly Roman; as, Greco-Roman architecture.

cornbind.definition: A weed that binds stalks of corn, as Convolvulus arvensis, Polygonum Convolvulus.

octagonal.definition: Having eight sides and eight angles.

thermovoltaic.definition: Of or relating to heat and electricity; especially, relating to thermal effects produced by voltaic action. Faraday.

topgallant.definition: (Naut.)  Situated above the topmast and below the royal mast; designatb, or pertaining to, the third spars in order from the deck; as, the topgallant mast, yards, braces, and the like. See Illustration of Ship. 2. Fig.: Highest; elevated; splendid. "The consciences of topgallant sparks." L'Estrange.

hegelian.definition: Pertaining to Hegelianism. -- n.  A follower of Hegel.

obtend.definition: To oppose; to hold out in opposition. Dryden. 2. To offer as the reason of anything; to pretend. Dryden.

monembryony.definition: The condition of an ovule having but a single embryo. -- Mon*em`bry*on"ic, a.

bandana.definition: A species of silk or cotton handkerchief, having a uniformly dyed ground, usually of red or blue, with white or yellow figures of a circular, lozenge, or other simple form. 2. A style of calico printing, in which white or bright spots are produced upon cloth previously dyed of a uniform red or dark.

consistorial.definition: Of or pertaining to a consistory. "Consistorial laws." Hooker. "Consistorial courts." Bp. Hoadley.

spew.definition:
To eject from the stomach; to vomit. 2. To cast forth with abhorrence or disgust; to eject. Because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth. Rev. ii. 16.

1. To vomit. Chaucer. 2. To eject seed, as wet land swollen with frost.

That which is vomited; vomit.

multiversant.definition: Turning into many shapes; assuming many forms; protean.

pericranial.definition: Of or pertaining to the pericranium.

apostemate.definition: To form an abscess; to swell and fill with pus. Wiseman.

cross-birth.definition: Any preternatural labor, in whiche the boly of the child lies across the pelvis of the mother, so that the shoulder, arm, or trunk is the part first presented at the mouth of the uterus.

tripody.definition: Three metrical feet taken together, or included in one measure.

scincoidian.definition: Any one of numerous species of lizards of the family Scincidæ or tribe Scincoidea. The tongue is not extensile. The body and tail are covered with overlapping scales, and the toes are margined. See Illust. under Skink.

comprobation.definition: Joint attestation; proof. Sir T. Browne. 2. Approbation. Foxe.

rown.definition:
To whisper. [obs.] Gower. Another rouned to his fellow low. Chaucer.

see Roun. Chaucer.

nefand.definition: Unfit to speak of; unmentionable; impious; execrable. "Nefand adominations." Sheldon. "Nefandous high treason." Cotton Mather.

peremptorily.definition: In a peremptory manner; absolutely; positively. Bacon.

vexillar.definition: Of or pertaining to an ensign or standard. 2. (Bot.)  Of or pertaining to the vexillum, or upper petal of papilionaceous flowers. Vexilary æstivation (Bot.), a mode of æstivation in which one large upper petal folds over, and covers, the other smaller petals, as in most papilionaceous plants.

bywork.definition: Work aside from regular work; subordinate or secondary business.

ekaluminium.definition: The name given to a hypothetical element, -- later discovered and called gallium. See Gallium, and cf. Ekabor.

tenace.definition: The holding by the fourth hand of the best and third best cards of a suit led; also, sometimes, the combination of best with third best card of a suit in any hand.

mescal.definition: A distilled liquor prepared in Mexico from a species of agave. See Agave.

quinquevir.definition: One of five commissioners appointed for some special object.

pteridologist.definition: One who is versed in pteridology.

columbium.definition: A rare element of the vanadium group, first found in a variety of the mineral columbite occurring in Connecticut, probably at Haddam. Atomic weight 94.2. Symbol Cb or Nb. Now more commonly called niobium.

dab.definition:
A skillful hand; a dabster; an expert. One excels at a plan or the titlepage, another works away at the body of the book, and the therd is a dab at an index. Goldsmith.

A name given to several species of Pleuronectes . TheAmerican rough dab is Hippoglossoides platessoides.

1. To strike or touch ge.

vicuna.definition: A South American mammal (Auchenia vicunna) native of the elevated plains of the Andes, allied to the llama but smaller. It has a thick coat of very fine reddish brown wool, and long, pendent white hair on the breast and belly. It is hunted for its wool and flesh.

handfastly.definition: In a handfast or publicly pledged manner. Holinshed.

scaffolding.definition: A scaffold; a supporting framework; as, the scaffolding of the body. Pope. 2. Materials for building scaffolds.

tallwood.definition: Firewood cut into billets of a certain length. [Eng.].

hypethral.definition: Exposed to the air; wanting a roof; -- applied to a building or part of a building. Gwilt.

grinte.definition: imp. of Grin, v. i., 1. [He] grinte with his teeth, so was he wroth. Chaucer.

spongiose.definition: Somewhat spongy; spongelike; full of small cavities like sponge; as, spongious bones.

suradanni.definition: A valuable kind of wood obtained on the shores of the Demerara River in South America, much used for timbers, rails, naves and fellies of wheels, and the like.

easy-going.definition: Moving easily; hence, mild-tempered; ease-loving; inactive.

mykiss.definition: A salmon (Salmo mykiss, syn. S. purpuratus) marked with black spots and a red throat, found in most of the rivers from Alaska to the Colorado River, and in Siberia; -- called also black-spotted trout, cutthroat trout, and redthroat trout.

perspicacity.definition: The state of being perspicacious; acuteness of sight or of intelligence; acute discernment. Sir T. Browne.

aryanize.definition: To make Aryan (a language, or in language). K. Johnston.

featherness.definition: The state or condition of being feathery.

blunt-witted.definition: Dull; stupid. Blunt-witted lord, ignoble in demeanor! Shak.

glockenspiel.definition: An instrument, originally a series of bells on an iron rod, now a set of flat metal bars, diatonically tuned, giving a bell-like tone when played with a mallet; a carillon.

hoopoo.definition: A European bird of the genus Upupa (U. epops), having a beautiful crest, which it can erect or depress at pleasure. Called also hoop, whoop. The name is also applied to several other species of the same genus and allied genera.

hesperus.definition: Venus when she is the evening star; Hesper. 2. Evening. [Poetic] The Sun was sunk, and after him the Star Of Hesperus. Milton.

parting.definition: Serving to part; dividing; separating. 2. Given when departing; as, a parting shot; a parting salute. "Give him that parting kiss." Shak. 3. Departing. "Speed the parting guest." Pope. 4. Admitting of being parted; partible. Parting fellow, a partner. Chaucer. -- Parting pulley. See under Pulley. --.

radiatiform.definition: Having the marginal florets enlarged and radiating but not ligulate, as in the capitula or heads of the cornflower, Gray.

centimetre.definition: The hundredth part of a meter; a measure of length equal to rather more than thirty-nine hundredths (0.3937) of an inch. See Meter.

photoheliograph.definition: A modified kind of telescope adapted to taking photographs of the sun.

propend.definition: To lean toward a thing; to be favorably inclined or disposed; to incline; to tend. Shak. We shall propend to it, as a stone falleth down. Barrow.

rubellite.definition: A variety of tourmaline varying in color from a pale rose to a deep ruby, and containing lithium.

incloud.definition: To envelop as in clouds; to darken; to obscure. Milton.

clubfist.definition: A large, heavy fist. 2. A coarse, brutal fellow. Mir. for Mag.

bheesty.definition: A water carrier, as to a household or a regiment. [India].

levitate.definition:
To rise, or tend to rise, as if lighter than the surrounding medium; to become buoyant; -- opposed to gravitate. Sir. J. Herschel.

To make buoyant; to cause to float in the air; as, to levitate a table. [Cant].

pathos.definition: That quality or property of anything which touches the feelings or excites emotions and passions, esp., that which awakens tender emotions, such as pity, sorrow, and the like; contagious warmth of feeling, action, or expression; pathetic quality; as, the pathos of a picture, of a poem, or of a cry.

urethroscope.definition: An instrument for viewing the interior of the urethra.

apozemical.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, a decoction. J. Whitaker.

basommatophora.definition: A group of Pulmonifera having the eyes at the base of the tentacles, including the common pond snails.

dissiliency.definition: The act of leaping or starting asunder. Johnson.

orectic.definition: Of or pertaining to the desires; hence, impelling to gratification; appetitive.

canard.definition: An extravagant or absurd report or story; a fabricated sensational report or statement; esp. one set afloat in the newspapers to hoax the public.

hydramine.definition: One of a series of artificial, organic bases, usually produced as thick viscous liquids by the action of ammonia on ethylene oxide. They have the properties both of alcohol and amines.

apostemation.definition: The formation of an aposteme; the process of suppuration. [Written corruptly imposthumation.] Wiseman.

thewy.definition: Having strong or large thews or muscles; muscular; sinewy; strong.

mushroom.definition: (Bot.) (a) An edible fungus (Agaricus campestris), having a white stalk which bears a convex or oven flattish expanded portion called the pileus. This is whitish and silky or somewhat scaly above, and bears on the under side radiating gills which are at first flesh-colored, but gradually become brow.

spoondrift.definition: Spray blown from the tops waves during a gale at sea; also, snow driven in the wind at sea; -- written also spindrift.

drachma.definition: A silver coin among the ancient Greeks, having a different value in different States and at different periods. The average value of the Attic drachma is computed to have been about 19 cents. 2. A gold and silver coin of modern Greece worth 19.3 cents. 3. Among the ancient Greeks, a weight of about 6.

underjoin.definition: To join below or beneath; to subjoin. Wyclif.

abirritate.definition: To diminish the sensibility of; to debilitate.

ramoon.definition: A small West Indian tree (Trophis Americana) of the Mulberry family, whose leaves and twigs are used as fodder for cattle.

montant.definition: (Fencing)  An upward thrust or blow. Shak. 2. (Arch.)  An upright piece in any framework; a mullion or muntin; a stile. See Stile.

unbeat.definition: To deliver from the form or nature of a beast.

eradicate.definition: To pluck up by the roots; to root up; as, an oak tree eradicated. 2. To root out; to destroy utterly; to extirpate; as, to eradicate diseases, or errors. This, although now an old an inveterate evil, might be eradicated by vigorous treatment. Southey. Syn. -- To extirpate; root out; exterminate; des.

theriaca.definition: (Old Med.)  An ancient composition esteemed efficacious against the effects of poison; especially, a certain compound of sixty-four drugs, prepared, pulverized, and reduced by means of honey to an electuary; -- called also theriaca Andromachi, and Venice treacle. 2. Treacle; molasses. British Pharm.

epithumetical.definition: Pertaining to sexual desire; sensual. Sir T. Browne.

overlogical.definition: Excessively logical; adhering too closely to the forms or rules of logic.

convictive.definition: Convincing. The best and most convictive argument. Glanwill. -- Con*vict"ive*ly, adv. -- Con*vict"ive*ness, n.

aphthoid.definition: Of the nature of aphthæ; resembling thrush.

lapidify.definition:
To convert into stone or stony material; to petrify.

To become stone or stony.

connascent.definition: Born together; produced at the same time. Craig.

ragnarok.definition:
The so-called "Twilight of the Gods" (called in German Götterdämmerung), the final destruction of the world in the great conflict between the Æsir (gods) on the one hand, and on the other, the gaints and the powers of Hel under the leadership of Loki (who is escaped from bondage).

The so-called "Tw.

geotropism.definition: A disposition to turn or incline towards the earth; the influence of gravity in determining the direction of growth of an organ. Note: In plants, organs which grow towards the center of the earth are said to be positively geotropic, and those growing in the opposite direction negatively geotropic. I.

racemose.definition: Resembling a raceme; growing in the form of a raceme; as, (Bot.) racemose berries or flowers; (Anat.) the racemose glands, in which the ducts are branched and clustered like a raceme. Gray.

anecdotic.definition: Pertaining to, consisting of, or addicted to, anecdotes. "Anecdotical traditions." Bolingbroke.

apocrisiary.definition: A delegate or deputy; especially, the pope's nuncio or legate at Constantinople.

oxyphenic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, the phenol formerly called oxyphenic acid, and now oxyphenol and pyrocatechin. See Pyrocatechin.

tenuirostral.definition: Thin-billed; -- applied to birds with a slender bill, as the humming birds.

skunkhead.definition: (a) The surf duck. (b) A duck (Camptolaimus Labradorus) which formerly inhabited the Atlantic coast of New England. It is now supposed to be extinct. Called also Labrador duck, and pied duck.

accumb.definition: To recline, as at table. Bailey.

xanthorhamnin.definition: A glucoside extracted from Persian berries as a yellow crystalline powder, used as a dyestuff.

bluecap.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) The bluepoll. (b) The blue bonnet or blue titmouse. 2. A Scot; a Scotchman; -- so named from wearing a blue bonnet. [Poetic] Shak.

dyspepsia.definition: A kind of indigestion; a state of the stomach in which its functions are disturbed, without the presence of other diseases, or, if others are present, they are of minor importance. Its symptoms are loss of appetite, nausea, heartburn, acrid or fetid eructations, a sense of weight or fullness in the.

unrealize.definition: To make unreal; to idealize. His fancy . . . unrealizes everything at a touch. Lowell.

bregma.definition: The point of junction of the coronal and sagittal sutures of the skull.

vineyard.definition: An inclosure or yard for grapevines; a plantation of vines producing grapes.

disquietous.definition: Causing uneasiness. So distasteful and disquietous to a number of men. Milton.

obscurer.definition: One who, or that which, obscures.

sanskrit.definition: The ancient language of the Hindoos, long since obsolete in vernacular use, but preserved to the present day as the literary and sacred dialect of India. It is nearly allied to the Persian, and to the principal languages of Europe, classical and modern, and by its more perfect preservation of the ro.

unstrained.definition: Not strained; not cleared or purified by straining; as, unstrained oil or milk. 2. Not forced; easy; natural; as, a unstrained deduction or inference. Hakewill.

glyphography.definition: A process similar to etching, in which, by means of voltaic electricity, a raised copy of a drawing is made, so that it can be used to print from.

periwinkle.definition: Any small marine gastropod shell of the genus Littorina. The common European species (Littorina littorea), in Europe extensively used as food, has recently become naturalized abundantly on the American coast. See Littorina. Note: In America the name is often applied to several large univalves, as Fu.

notself.definition: The negative of self. "A cognizance of notself." Sir. W. Hamilton.

synesis.definition: A construction in which adherence to some element in the sense causes a departure from strict syntax, as in "Philip went down to Samaria and preached Christ unto them.".

bloodwit.definition: A fine or amercement paid as a composition for the shedding of blood; also, a riot wherein blood was spilled.

alternately.definition: In reciprocal succession; succeeding by turns; in alternate order. 2. (Math.)  By alternation; when, in a proportion, the antecedent term is compared with antecedent, and consequent.

knap.definition:
A protuberance; a swelling; a knob; a button; hence, rising ground; a summit. See Knob, and Knop. The highest part and knap of the same island. Holland.

1. To bite; to bite off; to break short. [Obs. or Prov. Eng. ] He will knap the spears apieces with his teeth. Dr. H. More. He breaketh the bow, a.

splendor.definition: Great brightness; brilliant luster; brilliancy; as, the splendor ot the sun. B. Jonson. 2. Magnifience; pomp; parade; as, the splendor of equipage, ceremonies, processions, and the like. "Rejoice in splendor of mine own." Shak. 3. Brilliancy; glory; as, the splendor of a victory. Syn. -- Luster; bri.

forspent.definition: Wasted in strength; tired; exhausted. [Archaic] A gentleman almost forspent with speed. Shak.

uncombine.definition: To separate, as substances in combination; to release from combination or union. Daniel.

eurasian.definition:
A child of a European parent on the one side and an Asiatic on the other. 2. One born of European parents in Asia.

Of European and Asiatic descent; of or pertaining to both Europe and Asia; as, the great Eurasian plain.

demarch.definition:
March; walk; gait.

A chief or ruler of a deme or district in Greece.

fly-catching.definition: Having the habit of catching insects on the wing.

catagmatic.definition: Having the quality of consolidating broken bones.

sincere.definition: Pure; unmixed; unadulterated. There is no sincere acid in any animal juice. Arbuthnot. A joy which never was sincere till now. Dryden. 2. Whole; perfect; unhurt; uninjured. The inviolable body stood sincere. Dryden. 3. Being in reality what it appears to be; having a character which corresponds with.

perineum.definition: The region which is included within the outlet of the pelvis, and is traversed by the urinogenital canal and the rectum.

roughsetter.definition: A mason who builds rough stonework.

geometrician.definition: One skilled in geometry; a geometer; a mathematician.

myroxylon.definition: A genus of leguminous trees of tropical America, the different species of which yield balsamic products, among which are balsam of Peru, and balsam of Tolu. The species were formerly referred to Myrospermum.

pooh-pooh.definition: To make light of; to treat with derision or contempt, as if by saying pooh! pooh! Thackeray.

exclusionary.definition: Tending to exclude; causing exclusion; exclusive.

girth.definition: A band or strap which encircles the body; especially, one by which a saddle is fastened upon the back of a horse. 2. The measure round the body, as at the waist or belly; the circumference of anything. He's a lu sty, jolly fellow, that lives well, at least three yards in the girth. Addison. 3. A sma.

monomorphic.definition: Having but a single form; retaining the same form throughout the various stages of development; of the same or of an essentially similar type of structure; -- opposed to dimorphic, trimorphic, and polymorphic.

chopboat.definition: A licensed lighter employed in the transportation of goods to and from vessels. [China] S. W. Williams.

pyrite.definition: A common mineral of a pale brass-yellow color and brilliant metallic luster, crystallizing in the isometric system; iron pyrites; iron disulphide. Hence sable coal his massy couch extends, And stars of gold the sparkling pyrite blends. E. Darwin.

cold-short.definition: Brittle when cold; as, cold-short iron.

novennial.definition: Done or recurring every ninth year.

denay.definition:
To deny. That with great rage he stoutly doth denay. Spenser.

Denial; refusal. Shak.

ejaculate.definition:
To throw out suddenly and swiftly, as if a dart; to dart; to eject. [Archaic or Technical] Its active rays ejaculated thence. Blackmore. 2. To throw out, as an exclamation; to utter by a brief and sudden impulse; as, to ejaculate a prayer.

To utter ejaculations; to make short and hasty exclamations.

hairdresser.definition: One who dresses or cuts hair; a barber.

sherbet.definition: A refreshing drink, common in the East, made of the juice of some fruit, diluted, sweetened, and flavored in various ways; as, orange sherbet; lemon sherbet; raspberry sherbet, etc. 2. A flavored water ice. 3. A preparation of bicarbonate of soda, tartaric acid, sugar, etc., variously flavored, for.

vulturine.definition: Of or pertaining to a vulture; resembling a vulture in qualities or looks; as, the vulturine sea eagle (Gypohierax Angolensis); vulturine rapacity. The vulturine nose, which smells nothing but corruption, is no credit to its possessor. C. Kingsley.

denudation.definition: The act of stripping off covering, or removing the surface; a making bare. 2. (Geol.)  The laying bare of rocks by the washing away of the overlying earth, etc.; or the excavation and removal of them by the action of running water.

necessarianism.definition: The doctrine of philosophical necessity; necessitarianism. Hixley.

omer.definition: A Hebrew measure, the tenth of an ephah. See Ephah. Ex. xvi. 36.

corky.definition: Consisting of, or like, cork; dry shriveled up. Bind fast hiss corky arms. Shak. 2. Tasting of cork.

nymphal.definition: Of or pertaining to a nymph or nymphs; nymphean.

trophic.definition: Of or connected with nutrition; nitritional; nourishing; as, the so-called trophic nerves, which have a direct influence on nutrition.

waldenses.definition: A sect of dissenters from the ecclesiastical system of the Roman Catholic Church, who in the 13th century were driven by persecution to the valleys of Piedmont, where the sect survives. They profess substantially Protestant principles.

recenter.definition: To center again; to restore to the center. Coleridge.

antecede.definition: To go before in time or place; to precede; to surpass. Sir M. Hale.

reorganize.definition: To organize again or anew; as, to reorganize a society or an army.

rouse.definition:
To pull or haul strongly and all together, as upon a rope, without the assistance of mechanical appliances.

1. A bumper in honor of a toast or health. Shak. 2. A carousal; a festival; a drinking frolic. Fill the cup, and fill the can, Have a rouse before the morn. Tennyson.

1. To cause to start fr.

tetanization.definition: The production or condition of tetanus.

staminate.definition:
(a) Furnished with stamens; producing stamens. (b) Having stamens, but lacking pistils.

To indue with stamina.

sudorous.definition: Consisting of sweat. Sir T. Browne.

mentum.definition: The front median plate of the labium in insects. See Labium.

bittersweet.definition:
Sweet and then bitter or bitter and then sweet; esp. sweet with a bitter after taste; hence (Fig.), pleasant but painful.

1. Anything which is bittersweet. 2. A kind of apple so called. Gower. 3. (Bot.) (a) A climbing shrub, with oval coral-red berries (Solanum dulcamara); woody nightshade. The who.

arid.definition: Exhausted of moisture; parched with heat; dry; barren. "An arid waste." Thomson.

pestilential.definition: Having the nature or qualities of a pestilence. "Sends the pestilential vapors." Longfellow. 2. Hence: Mischievous; noxious; pernicious; morally destructive. So pestilential, so infectious a thing is sin. Jer. Taylor.

calyx.definition: (Bot.)  The covering of a flower. See Flower. Note: The calyx is usually green and foliaceous, but becomes delicate and petaloid in such flowers as the anemone and the four-o'clock. Each leaf of the calyx is called a sepal. 2. (Anat.)  A cuplike division of the pelvis of the kidney, which surrounds.

stultify.definition: To make foolish; to make a fool of; as, to stultify one by imposition; to stultify one's self by silly reasoning or conduct. Burke. 2. To regard as a fool, or as foolish. The modern sciolist stultifies all understanding but his own, and that which he conceives like his own. Hazlitt. 3. (Law)  To all.

deadlatch.definition: A kind of latch whose bolt may be so locked by a detent that it can not be opened from the inside by the handle, or from the outside by the latch key. Knight.

xylic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or related to, xylene; specifically, designating any one of several metameric acids produced by the partial oxidation of mesitylene and pseudo-cumene.

politicly.definition: In a politic manner; sagaciously; shrewdly; artfully. Pope.

trampler.definition: One who tramples; one who treads down; as, a trampler on nature's law. Cowper.

adaptability.definition: The quality of being adaptable; suitableness. "General adaptability for every purpose." Farrar.

confidentially.definition: In confidence; in reliance on secrecy.

paltry.definition: Mean; vile; worthless; despicable; contemptible; pitiful; trifling; as, a paltry excuse; paltry gold. Cowper. The paltry prize is hardly worth the cost. Byron. Syn. -- See Contemptible.

rosolic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, a complex red dyestuff (called rosolic acid) which is analogous to rosaniline and aurin. It is produced by oxidizing a mixture of phenol and cresol, as a dark red amorphous mass, C20H16O3, which forms weak salts with bases, and stable ones with acids. Called also methy.

lepidodendrid.definition: One of an extinct family of trees allied to the modern club mosses, and including Lepidodendron and its allies.

tubiporite.definition: Any fossil coral of the genus Syringopora consisting of a cluster of upright tubes united together by small transverse tubules.

malleable.definition: Capable of being extended or shaped by beating with a hammer, or by the pressure of rollers; -- applied to metals. Malleable iron, iron that is capable of extension or of being shaped under the hammer; decarbonized cast iron. See under Iron. -- Malleable iron castings, articles cast from pig iron an.

medallic.definition: Of or pertaining to a medal, or to medals. "Our medallic history." Walpole.

strappado.definition:
A military punishment formerly practiced, which consisted in drawing an offender to the top of a beam and letting him fall to the length of the rope, by which means a limb was often dislocated. Shak.

To punish or torture by the strappado. Milton.

quieter.definition: One who, or that which, quiets.

tetany.definition: A morbid condition resembling tetanus, but distinguished from it by being less severe and having intermittent spasms.

spirillum.definition: A genus of common motile microörganisms (Spirobacteria) having the form of spiral-shaped filaments. One species is said to be the cause of relapsing fever.

portico.definition: A colonnade or covered ambulatory, especially in classical styles of architecture; usually, a colonnade at the entrance of a building.

steem.definition:
See Esteem. Spenser.

See 1st and 2nd Stem. Chaucer.

To gleam. His head bald, that shone as any glass, . . . [And] stemed as a furnace of a leed [caldron]. Chaucer.

A gleam of light; flame.

mollifier.definition: One who, or that which, mollifies. Bacon.

siderosis.definition: A sort of pneumonia occuring in iron workers, produced by the inhalation of particles of iron.

chironomy.definition: The art of moving the hands in oratory or in pantomime; gesture.

aubin.definition: A broken gait of a horse, between an amble and a gallop; -- commonly called a Canterbury gallop.

deflate.definition: To reduce from an inflated condition.

wing-footed.definition: Having wings attached to the feet; as, wing-footed Mercury; hence, swift; moving with rapidity; fleet. Drayton. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) Having part or all of the feet adapted for flying. (b) Having the anterior lobes of the foot so modified as to form a pair of winglike swimming organs; -- said of the pterop.

autotypy.definition: The art or process of making autotypes.

northerly.definition:
Of or pertaining to the north; toward the north, or from the north; northern.

Toward the north.

enneahedron.definition: A figure having nine sides; a nonagon.

ance.definition: A suffix signifying action; also, quality or state; as, assistance, resistance, appearance, elegance. See -ancy. Note: All recently adopted words of this class take either -ance or - ence, according to the Latin spelling.

lava.definition: The melted rock ejected by a volcano from its top or fissured sides. It flows out in streams sometimes miles in length. It also issues from fissures in the earth's surface, and forms beds covering many square miles, as in the Northwestern United States. Note: Lavas are classed, according to their st.

adenography.definition: That part of anatomy which describes the glands.

mite.definition: (Zoöl.)  A minute arachnid, of the order Acarina, of which there are many species; as, the cheese mite, sugar mite, harvest mite, etc. See Acarina. 2. Etym: [D. mijt; prob. the same word.]  A small coin formerly circulated in England, rated at about a third of a farthing. The name is also applied to.

photolithographer.definition: One who practices, or one who employs, photolithography.

garganey.definition: A small European duck (Anas querquedula); -- called also cricket teal, and summer teal.

loimic.definition: Of or pertaining to the plague or contagious disorders.

exode.definition: Departure; exodus; esp., the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt. L. Coleman. Bolingbroke. 2. (Gr. Drama)  The final chorus; the catastrophe. 3. (Rom. Antig.)  An afterpiece of a comic description, either a farce or a travesty.

savvy.definition:
To understand; to comprehend; know. [Slang, U. S.]

Comprehension; knowledge of affairs; mental grasp. [Slang, U. S.].

termless.definition: Having no term or end; unlimited; boundless; unending; as, termless time. "Termless joys." Sir W. Raleigh. 2. Inexpressible; indescribable. Shak.

prizer.definition:
One who estimates or sets the value of a thing; an appraiser. Shak.

One who contends for a prize; a prize fighter; a challenger. Shak. Appeareth no man yet to answer the prizer. B. Jonson.

utilitarian.definition:
Of or pertaining to utility; consisting in utility; as, utilitarian narrowness; a utilitarian indifference to art. 2. Of or pertaining to utilitarianism; supporting utilitarianism; as, the utilitarian view of morality; the Utilitarian Society. J. S. Mill.

One who holds the doctrine of utilitarianis.

bedrabble.definition: To befoul with rain and mud; to drabble.

giddy-head.definition: A person without thought fulness, prudence, or judgment. Burton.

hymenogeny.definition: The production of artificial membranes by contact of two fluids, as albumin and fat, by which the globules of the latter are surrounded by a thin film of the former.

berg.definition: A large mass or hill, as of ice. Glittering bergs of ice. Tennyson .

sawmill.definition: A mill for sawing, especially one for sawing timber or lumber.

xylographical.definition: Of or pertaining to xylography, or wood engraving.

creditably.definition: In a creditable manner; reputably; with credit.

stoor.definition:
To rise in clouds, as dust.

Strong; powerful; hardy; bold; audacious. [Obs. or Scot.] O stronge lady stoor, what doest thou Chaucer.

thrall-less.definition: (a) Having no thralls. (b) Not enslaved; not subject to bonds.

detention.definition: The act of detaining or keeping back; a withholding. 2. The state of being detained (stopped or hindered); delay from necessity. 3. Confinement; restraint; custody. The archduke Philip . . . found himself in a sort of honorable detention at Henry's court. Hallam.

gasoscope.definition: An apparatus for detecting the presence of any dangerous gas, from a gas leak in a coal mine or a dwelling house.

jerquing.definition:
The searching of a ship for unentered goods. [Eng.] [Written also jerguer.]

The searching of a ship for unentered goods. [Eng.].

intellectualize.definition: To treat in an intellectual manner; to discuss intellectually; to reduce to intellectual form; to express intellectually; to idealize. Sentiment is intellectualized emotion. Lowell. 2. To endow with intellect; to bestow intellectual qualities upon; to cause to become intellectual.

plower.definition: One who plows; a plowman; a cultivator.

zizith.definition: The tassels of twisted cords or threads on the corners of the upper garment worn by strict Jews. The Hebrew for this word is translated in both the Authorized and Revised Versions (Deut. xxii. 12) by the word "fringes.".

instrumentalism.definition: The view that the sanction of truth is its utility, or that truth is genuine only in so far as it is a valuable instrument. -- In`stru*men"tal*ist, n. Instrumentalism views truth as simply the value belonging to certain ideas in so far as these ideas are biological functions of our organisms, and ps.

placeman.definition: One who holds or occupies a place; one who has office under government. Sir W. Scott.

belles-lettres.definition: Polite or elegant literature; the humanities; -- used somewhat vaguely for literary works in which imagination and taste are predominant.

taper.definition:
A small wax candle; a small lighted wax candle; hence, a small light. Get me a taper in my study, Lucius. Shak. 2. A tapering form; gradual diminution of thickness in an elongated object; as, the taper of a spire.

Regularly narrowed toward the point; becoming small toward one end; conical; pyramidi.

disentitle.definition: To deprive of title or claim. Every ordinary offense does not disentitle a son to the love of his father. South.

oneirocritical.definition: Of or pertaining to the interpretation of dreams. Addison.

protozoon.definition: (a) One of the Protozoa. (b) A single zooid of a compound protozoan.

orle.definition: (Her.)  A bearing, in the form of a fillet, round the shield, within, but at some distance from, the border. 2. (Her.)  The wreath, or chaplet, surmounting or encircling the helmet of a knight and bearing the crest. In orle, round the escutcheon, leaving the middle of the field vacant, or occupied b.

set-stitched.definition: Stitched according to a formal pattern. "An old set-stiched chair, valanced, and fringed with party-colored worsted bobs." Sterne.

headborrow.definition: The chief of a frankpledge, tithing, or decennary, consisting of ten families; -- called also borsholder, boroughhead, boroughholder, and sometimes tithingman. See Borsholder. [Eng.] Blackstone. 2. (Modern Law)  A petty constable. [Eng.].

desperado.definition: A reckless, furious man; a person urged by furious passions, and regardless of consequence; a wild ruffian.

wore.definition:
imp. of Wear.

imp. of Ware.

metacetone.definition: A colorless liquid of an agreeable odor, C6H10O, obtained by distilling a mixture of sugar and lime; -- so called because formerly regarded as a polymeric modification of acetone.

bribe.definition: A gift begged; a present. Chaucer. 2. A price, reward, gift, or favor bestowed or promised with a view to prevent the judgment or corrupt the conduct of a judge, witness, voter, or other person in a position of trust. Undue reward for anything against justice is a bribe. Hobart. 3. That which seduce.

remeant.definition: Coming back; returning. "Like the remeant sun." C. Kingsley.

escarpment.definition: A steep descent or declivity; steep face or edge of a ridge; ground about a fortified place, cut away nearly vertically to prevent hostile approach. See Scarp.

cog.definition: To seduce, or draw away, by adulation, artifice, or falsehood; to wheedle; to cozen; to cheat. I'll . . . cog their hearts from them. Shak. 2. To obtrude or thrust in, by falsehood or deception; as, to cog in a word; to palm off. Fustian tragedies . . . have, by concerted applauses, been cogged upon.

tectonic.definition: Of or pertaining to building or construction; architectural.

lockage.definition: Materials for locks in a canal, or the works forming a lock or locks. 2. Toll paid for passing the locks of a canal. 3. Amount of elevation and descent made by the locks of a canal. The entire lock will be about fifty feet. De Witt Clinton.

plantar.definition: Of or pertaining to the sole of the foot; as, the plantar arteries.

sarcastic.definition: Expressing, or expressed by, sarcasm; characterized by, or of the nature of, sarcasm; given to the use of sarcasm; bitterly satirical; scornfully severe; taunting. What a fierce and sarcastic reprehension would this have drawn from the friendship of the world! South.

thrivingness.definition: The quality or condition of one who thrives; prosperity; growth; increase. THRO' Thro'.  A contraction of Through.

ballistic.definition: Of or pertaining to the ballista, or to the art of hurling stones or missile weapons by means of an engine. 2. Pertaining to projection, or to a projectile. Ballistic pendulum, an instrument consisting of a mass of wood or other material suspended as a pendulum, for measuring the force and velocity.

grindle.definition: The bowfin; -- called also Johnny Grindle. [Local, U. S.].

catechism.definition: A form of instruction by means of questions answers. 2. A book containing a summary of principles, especially of religious doctrine, reduced to the form of questions and answers. The Jews, even till this day, have their catechisms. Hooker. The Larger Catechism, The Shorter Catechism. See Westminster.

freewheel.definition: A clutch fitted in the rear hub of a cycle, which engages the rear sprocket with the rear wheel when the pedals are rotated forwards, but permits the rear wheel to run on free from the rear sprocket when the pedals are stopped or rotated backwards. Freewheelcycles are usually fitted with hub brakes.

ubication.definition: The quality or state of being in a place; local relation; position or location; whereness. Glanvill.

remuneration.definition: The act of remunerating. 2. That which is given to remunerate; an equivalent given, as for services, loss, or sufferings. Shak. Syn. -- Reward; recompense; compensation; pay; payment; repayment; satisfaction; requital.

sauropoda.definition: An extinct order of herbivorous dinosaurs having the feet of a saurian type, instead of birdlike, as they are in many dinosaurs. It includes the Largest Known land animals, belonging to Brontosaurus, Camarasaurus, and alied genera. See Illustration in Appendix.

salam.definition: A salutation or compliment of ceremony in the east by word or act; an obeisance, performed by bowing very low and placing the right palm on the forehead. [Written also salaam.].

joinhand.definition: Writing in which letters are joined in words; -- distinguished from writing in single letters. Addison.

panoistic.definition: Producing ova only; -- said of the ovaries of certain insects which do not produce vitelligenous cells.

loculus.definition: (Zoöl.)  One of the spaces between the septa in the Anthozoa. 2. (Bot.)  One of the compartments of a several-celled ovary; loculament.

stupefy.definition: To make stupid; to make dull; to blunt the faculty of perception or understanding in; to deprive of sensibility; to make torpid. The fumes of drink discompose and stupefy the brain. South. 2. To deprive of material mobility. It is not malleable; but yet is not fluent, but stupefied. Bacon.

injudicable.definition: Not cognizable by a judge. Bailey.

marbled.definition: Made of, or faced with, marble. "The marbled mansion." Shak. 2. Made to resemble marble; veined or spotted like marble. "Marbled paper." Boyle. 3. (zoöl.)  Varied with irregular markings, or witch a confused blending of irregular spots and streaks.

sorrow.definition: The uneasiness or pain of mind which is produced by the loss of any good, real or supposed, or by diseappointment in the expectation of good; grief at having suffered or occasioned evil; regret; unhappiness; sadness. Milton. How great a sorrow suffereth now Arcite! Chaucer. The safe and general anti.

tomentum.definition: The closely matted hair or downy nap covering the leaves or stems of some plants.

tewan.definition: A tribe of American Indians including many of the Pueblos of New Mexico and adjacent regions.

aflush.definition:
In a flushed or blushing state.

On a level. The bank is . . . aflush with the sea. Swinburne.

allspice.definition: The berry of the pimento (Eugenia pimenta), a tree of the West Indies; a spice of a mildly pungent taste, and agreeably aromatic; Jamaica pepper; pimento. It has been supposed to combine the flavor of cinnamon, nutmegs, and cloves; and hence the name. The name is also given to other aromatic shrubs;.

pillage.definition: The act of pillaging; robbery. Shak. 2. That which is taken from another or others by open force, particularly and chiefly from enemies in war; plunder; spoil; booty. Which pillage they with merry march bring home. Shak. Syn. -- Plunder; rapine; spoil; depredation. -- Pillage, Plunder. Pillage refer.

heathenishness.definition: The state or quality of being heathenish. "The . . . heathenishness and profaneness of most playbooks." Prynne.

antholite.definition: A fossil plant, like a petrified flower.

rigorist.definition: One who is rigorous; -- sometimes applied to an extreme Jansenist.

willowed.definition: Abounding with willows; containing willows; covered or overgrown with willows. "Willowed meads." Collins.

renne.definition:
To plunder; -- only in the phrase "to rape and renne." See under Rap, v. t., to snatch. Chaucer.

To run. Chaucer.

leaden.definition: Made of lead; of the nature of lead; as, a leaden ball. 2. Like lead in color, etc. ; as, a leaden sky. 3. Heavy; dull; sluggish. "Leaden slumber." Shak.

impercipient.definition: Not perceiving, or not able to perceive. A. Baxter.

sickly.definition: Somewhat sick; disposed to illness; attended with disease; as, a sickly body. This physic but prolongs thy sickly days. Shak. 2. Producing, or tending to, disease; as, a sickly autumn; a sickly climate. Cowper. 3. Appearing as if sick; weak; languid; pale. The moon grows sickly at the sight of day.

rangership.definition: The office of the keeper of a forest or park. [Eng.].

termly.definition:
Occurring every term; as, a termly fee. Bacon.

Term by term; every term. "Fees . . . that are termly given." Bacon.

morbific.definition: Causing disease; generating a sickly state; as, a morbific matter.

proficience.definition: The quality of state of being proficient; advance in the acquisition of any art, science, or knowledge; progression in knowledge; improvement; adeptness; as, to acquire proficiency in music.

condemnation.definition: The act of condemning or pronouncing to be wrong; censure; blame; disapprobation. In every other sense of condemnation, as blame, censure, reproof, private judgment, and the like. Paley. 2. The act of judicially condemning, or adjudging guilty, unfit for use, or forfeited; the act of dooming to puni.

clench.definition: See Clinch. CLEOPATRA'S NEEDLE Cle`o*pa"tra's nee"dle. [So named after Cleopatra, queen of Egypt.]  Either of two obelisks which were moved in ancient times from Heliopolis to Alexandria, one of which is now on the Thames Embankment in London, and the other in Central Park, in the City of New York.

roxburgh.definition: A style of bookbinding in which the back is plain leather, the sides paper or cloth, the top gilt-edged, but the front and bottom left uncut.

millier.definition: A weight of the metric system, being one million grams; a metric ton.

columelliform.definition: Shaped like a little column, or columella.

secretitious.definition: Parted by animal secretion; as, secretitious humors. Floyer.

forayer.definition: One who makes or joins in a foray. They might not choose the lowand road, For the Merse forayers were abroad. Sir W. Scott.

pleuronectoid.definition: Pertaining to the Pleuronectidæ, or Flounder family.

fruity.definition: Having the odor, taste, or appearance of fruit; also, fruitful. Dickens.

epilogistic.definition: Of or pertaining to epilogue; of the nature of an epilogue. T. Warton.

hopeless.definition: Destitute of hope; having no expectation of good; despairing. I am a woman, friendless, hopeless. Shak. 2. Giving no ground of hope; promising nothing desirable; desperate; as, a hopeless cause. The hopelessword of "never to return" Breathe I against thee, upon pain of life. Shak. 3. Unhoped for; de.

kalong.definition: A fruit bat, esp. the Indian edible fruit bat (Pteropus edulis).

statism.definition: The art of governing a state; statecraft; policy. The enemies of God . . . call our religion statism. South.

ochreate.definition: Wearing or furnished with an ochrea or legging; wearing boots; booted. A scholar undertook...to address himself ochreated unto the vice chancellor. Fuller. 2. (Bot.)  Provided with ochrea, or sheathformed stipules, as the rhubarb, yellow dock, and knotgrass.

babyship.definition: The quality of being a baby; the personality of an infant.

grillage.definition: A framework of sleepers and crossbeams forming a foundation in marshy or treacherous soil.

archetypally.definition: With reference to the archetype; originally. "Parts archetypally distinct." Dana.

typhoid.definition: Of or pertaining to typhus; resembling typhus; of a low grade like typhus; as, typhoid symptoms. Typhoid fever, a disease formerly confounded with typhus, but essentially different from the latter. It is characterized by fever, lasting usually three or more weeks, diarrhæa with evacuations resemblin.

braize.definition:
A European marine fish (Pagrus vulgaris) allied to the American scup; the becker. The name is sometimes applied to the related species. [Also written brazier.]

1. Charcoal powder; breeze. 2. (Cookery)  Braised meat.

See Braise.

nigger.definition: A negro; -- in vulgar derision or depreciation.

reviviscence.definition: The act of reviving, or the state of being revived; renewal of life. In this age we have a sort of reviviscence, not, I fear, of the power, but of a taste for the power, of the early times. Coleridge.

skeleton.definition: (Anat.) (a) The bony and cartilaginous framework which supports the soft parts of a vertebrate animal. Note: [See Illust. of the Human Skeleton, in Appendix.] (b) The more or less firm or hardened framework of an invertebrate animal. Note: In a wider sense, the skeleton includes the whole connective.

lipothymic.definition: Tending to swoon; fainting. [Written also leipothymic.].

segno.definition: A sign. See Al segno, and Dal segno.

fougade.definition: A small mine, in the form of a well sunk from the surface of the ground, charged with explosive and projectiles. It is made in a position likely to be occupied by the enemy.

meacock.definition: An uxorious, effeminate, or spiritless man. Johnson.

dinothere.definition: A large extinct proboscidean mammal from the miocene beds of Europe and Asia. It is remarkable fora pair of tusks directed downward from the decurved apex of the lower jaw.

quasi.definition: As if; as though; as it were; in a manner sense or degree; having some resemblance to; qualified; -- used as an adjective, or a prefix with a noun or an adjective; as, a quasi contract, an implied contract, an obligation which has arisen from some act, as if from a contract; a quasi corporation, a b.

taperness.definition: The quality or state of being taper; tapering form; taper. Shenstone.

amphistomous.definition: Having a sucker at each extremity, as certain entozoa, by means of which they adhere.

high-minded.definition: Proud; arrogant. Be not high-minded, but fear. Rom. xi. 20. 2. Having, or characterized by, honorable pride; of or pertaining to elevated principles and feelings; magnanimous; -- opposed to mean. High-minded, manly recognition of those truths. A. Norton.

ullmannite.definition: A brittle mineral of a steel-gray color and metallic luster, containing antimony, arsenic, sulphur, and nickel.

lex.definition: Law; as, lex talionis, the law of retaliation; lex terræ, the law of the land; lex fori, the law of the forum or court; lex loci, the law of the place; lex mercatoria, the law or custom of merchants.

untruthful.definition: Not truthful; unveracious; contrary to the truth or the fact. -- Un*truth"ful*ly, adv. -- Un*truth"ful*ness, n.

barbule.definition: A very minute barb or beard. Booth. 2. (Zoöl.)  One of the processes along the edges of the barbs of a feather, by which adjacent barbs interlock. See Feather.

gallant.definition: Showy; splendid; magnificent; gay; well-dressed. The town is built in a very gallant place. Evelyn. Our royal, good and gallant ship. Shak. 2. Noble in bearing or spirit; brave; high-spirited; courageous; heroic; magnanimous; as, a gallant youth; a gallant officer. That gallant spirit hath aspired t.

infrasternal.definition: Below the sternum; as, the infrasternal depression, or pit of the stomach.

ravage.definition: Desolation by violence; violent ruin or destruction; devastation; havoc; waste; as, the ravage of a lion; the ravages of fire or tempest; the ravages of an army, or of time. Would one think 't were possible for love To make such ravage in a noble soul Addison. Syn. -- Despoilment; devastation; desol.

atlantean.definition: Of or pertaining to the isle Atlantis, which the ancients allege was sunk, and overwhelmed by the ocean. 2. Pertaining to, or resembling, Atlas; strong. With Atlantean shoulders, fit to bear The weight of mightiest monarchies. Milton.

enwomb.definition: To conceive in the womb. Spenser. 2. To bury, as it were in a womb; to hide, as in a gulf, pit, or cavern. Donne.

amphiscians.definition: The inhabitants of the tropic, whose shadows in one part of the year are cast to the north, and in the other to the south, according as the sun is south or north of their zenith.

denim.definition: A coarse cotton drilling used for overalls, etc.

applicatory.definition: Having the property of applying; applicative; practical. -- n.  That which applies.

eger.definition:
Sharp; bitter; acid; sour. The egre words of thy friend. Chaucer.

An impetuous flood; a bore. See Eagre.

hydrobarometer.definition: An instrument for determining the depth of the sea water by its pressure.

vivify.definition: To endue with life; to make to be living; to quicken; to animate. Sitting on eggs doth vivify, not nourish. Bacon.

savoury.definition: An aromatic labiate plant (Satireia hortensis), much used in cooking; -- also called summer savory. [Written also savoury.].

abnet.definition: The girdle of a Jewish priest or officer.

jetton.definition: A metal counter used in playing cards.

quadrat.definition: (Print.)  A block of type metal lower than the letters, -- used in spacing and in blank lines. [Abbrev. quad.] 2. An old instrument used for taking altitudes; -- called also geometrical square, and line of shadows.

cabeca.definition: The finest kind of silk received from India.

metasilicic.definition: Designating an acid derived from silicic acid by the removal of water; of or pertaining to such an acid. Note: The salts of metasilicic acid are often called bisilicates, in mineralogy, as Wollastonite (CaSiO3). Metasilicic acid (Chem.), a gelatinous substance, or white amorphous powder, analogous t.

flair.definition: Smell; odor. 2.  Sense of smell; scent; fig., discriminating sense.

aquatile.definition: Inhabiting the water. Sir T. Browne.

imbricate.definition: Bent and hollowed like a roof or gutter tile. 2. Lying over each other in regular order, so as to "break joints," like tiles or shingles on a roof, the scales on the leaf buds of plants and the cups of some acorns, or the scales of fishes; overlapping each other at the margins, as leaves in æstivati.

occupant.definition: One who occupies, or takes possession; one who has the actual use or possession, or is in possession, of a thing. Note: This word, in law, sometimes signifies one who takes the first possession of a thing that has no owner. 2. A prostitute. Marston.

anear.definition:
Near. "It did not come anear." Coleridge. The measure of misery anear us. I. Taylor.

To near; to approach. [Archaic].

ceroplastic.definition: (a) Relating to the art of modeling in wax. (b) Modeled in wax; as, a ceroplastic figure.

laced.definition: Fastened with a lace or laces; decorated with narrow strips or braid. See Lace, v. t. 2. Decorated with the fabric lace. A shirt with laced ruffles. Fielding. Laced mutton, a prostitute. [Old slang] -- Laced stocking, a strong stocking which can be tightly laced; -- used in cases of weak legs, varic.

alloyage.definition: The act or art of alloying metals; also, the combination or alloy.

squawweed.definition: The golden ragwort. See under Ragwort.

regreet.definition:
To greet again; to resalute; to return a salutation to; to greet. Shak.

A return or exchange of salutation.

whereupon.definition: Upon which; in consequence of which; after which. The townsmen mutinied and sent to Essex; whereupon he came thither. Clarendon.

solidist.definition: An advocate of, or believer in, solidism. Dunglison.

gelose.definition: An amorphous, gummy carbohydrate, found in Gelidium, agar-agar, and other seaweeds.

abstemiousness.definition: The quality of being abstemious, temperate, or sparing in the use of food and strong drinks. It expresses a greater degree of abstinence than temperance.

goutwort.definition: A coarse umbelliferous plant of Europe (Ægopodium Podagraria); -- called also bishop's weed, ashweed, and herb gerard.

schist.definition: Any crystalline rock having a foliated structure (see Foliation) and hence admitting of ready division into slabs or slates. The common kinds are mica schist, and hornblendic schist, consisting chiefly of quartz with mica or hornblende and often feldspar.

vellon.definition: A word occurring in the phrase real vellon. See the Note under Its Real.

rosary.definition: A bed of roses, or place where roses grow. "Thick rosaries of scented thorn." Tennyson. 2. (R.C.Ch.)  A series of prayers (see Note below) arranged to be recited in order, on beads; also, a string of beads by which the prayers are counted. His idolized book, and the whole rosary of his prayers. Milt.

laryngismus.definition: A spasmodic state of the glottis, giving rise to contraction or closure of the opening.

granilla.definition: Small grains or dust of cochineal or the coccus insect.

misbehavior.definition: Improper, rude, or uncivil behavior; ill conduct. Addison.

sarcosin.definition: A crystalline nitrogenous substance, formed in the decomposition of creatin (one of the constituents of muscle tissue). Chemically, it is methyl glycocoll.

restem.definition: To force back against the current; as, to restem their backward course. Shak. 2. To stem, or as, to restem a current.

sophime.definition: Sophism. I trow ye study aboute some sophime. Chaucer.

oleic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or contained in, oil; as, oleic acid, an acid of the acrylic acid series found combined with glyceryl in the form of olein in certain animal and vegetable fats and oils, such as sperm oil, olive oil, etc. At low temperatures the acid is crystalline, but melts to an oily.

taxgatherer.definition: One who collects taxes or revenues. -- Tax"gath`er*ing, n.

spicula.definition: (a) A little spike; a spikelet. (b) A pointed fleshy appendage.

mulish.definition: Like a mule; sullen; stubborn. -- Mul"ish*ly, adv. -- Mul"ish*ness, n.

adight.definition: To set in order; to array; to attire; to deck, to dress.

tremulant.definition: Tremulous; trembling; shaking. " With tremulent white rod." Carlyle.

tetric.definition: Forward; perverse; harsh; sour; rugged. -- Tet"ric*al*ness, n.

buffoonism.definition: The practices of a buffoon; buffoonery.

diphygenic.definition: Having two modes of embryonic development.

intertwist.definition: To twist together one with another; to intertwine.

ambassadorship.definition: The state, office, or functions of an ambassador.

downgyved.definition: Hanging down like gyves or fetters. [Poetic & Rare] Shak.

cerberean.definition: Of or pertaining to, or resembling, Cerberus. [Written also Cerberian.] With wide Cerberean mouth. Milton.

theocrat.definition: One who lives under a theocratic form of government; one who in civil affairs conforms to divine law.

nauseous.definition: Causing, or fitted to cause, nausea; sickening; loathsome; disgusting; exciting abhorrence; as, a nauseous drug or medicine. -- Nau"seous*ly, adv. -- Nau"seous*ness, n. The nauseousness of such company disgusts a reasonable man. Dryden.

precede.definition: To go before in order of time; to occur first with relation to anything. "Harm precedes not sin." Milton. 2. To go before in place, rank, or importance. 3. To cause to be preceded; to preface; to introduce; -- used with by or with before the instrumental object. It is usual to precede hostilities by.

neolithic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or designating, an era characterized by late remains in stone. The Neolithic era includes the latter half of the "Stone age;" the human relics which belong to it are associated with the remains of animals not yet extinct. The kitchen middens of Denmark, the lake dwellings of Swi.

gerundively.definition: In the manner of a gerund; as, or in place of, a gerund.

keloid.definition: Applied to a variety of tumor forming hard, flat, irregular excrescences upon the skin. -- n.  A keloid tumor.

solecism.definition: An impropriety or incongruity of language in the combination of words or parts of a sentence; esp., deviation from the idiom of a language or from the rules of syntax. A barbarism may be in one word; a solecism must be of more. Johnson. 2. Any inconsistency, unfitness, absurdity, or impropriety, as.

puristic.definition: Of or pertaining to purists or purism.

deperdit.definition: That which is lost or destroyed. Paley.

isotropy.definition: Uniformity of physical properties in all directions in a body; absence of all kinds of polarity; specifically, equal elasticity in all directions.

munchausenism.definition: An extravagant fiction embodying an account of some marvelous exploit or adventure.
