frogmouth.definition: One of several species of Asiatic and East Indian birds of the genus Batrachostomus (family Podargidæ); -- so called from their very broad, flat bills.

oordoba.definition: The monetary unit of Nicaragua, equivalent to the United States gold dollar.

agiotage.definition: Exchange business; also, stockjobbing; the maneuvers of speculators to raise or lower the price of stocks or public funds. Vanity and agiotage are to a Parisian the oxygen and hydrogen of life. Landor.

monopodium.definition: A single and continuous vegetable axis; -- opposed to sympodium.

haversian.definition: Pertaining to, or discovered by, Clopton Havers, an English physician of the seventeenth century. Haversian canals (Anat.), the small canals through which the blood vessels ramify in bone.

autopathic.definition: Dependent upon, or due or relating to, the structure and characteristics of the diseased organism; endopathic; as, an autopathic disease; an autopathic theory of diseases.

mesne.definition: Middle; intervening; as, a mesne lord, that is, a lord who holds land of a superior, but grants a part of it to another person, in which case he is a tenant to the superior, but lord or superior to the second grantee, and hence is called the mesne lord. Mesne process, intermediate process; process i.

arapaima.definition: A large fresh-water food fish of South America.

nervomuscular.definition: Of or pertaining to both nerves and muscles; of the nature of nerves and muscles; as, nervomuscular energy.

odometry.definition: Measurement of distances by the odometer.

poind.definition: To impound, as cattle. [Obs. or Scot.] Flavel. 2. To distrain. [Scot.] Sir W. Scott.

provisor.definition: One who provides; a purveyor. "The chief provisor of our horse." Ford. 2. (R. C. Ch.) (a) The purveyor, steward, or treasurer of a religious house. Cowell. (b) One who is regularly inducted into a benefice. See Provision, 5. P. Plowman. 3. (Eng. Hist.)  One who procures or receives a papal provision.

disguise.definition: To change the guise or appearance of; especially, to conceal by an unusual dress, or one intended to mislead or deceive. Bunyan was forced to disguise himself as a wagoner. Macaulay. 2. To hide by a counterfeit appearance; to cloak by a false show; to mask; as, to disguise anger; to disguise one's s.

wantonize.definition: To behave wantonly; to frolic; to wanton. Lamb.

rosier.definition: A rosebush; roses, collectively. Crowned with a garland of sweet rosier. Spenser.

surgeful.definition: Abounding in surges; surgy. "Tossing the surgeful tides." Drayton.

alembroth.definition: The salt of wisdom of the alchemists, a double salt composed of the chlorides of ammonium and mercury. It was formerly used as a stimulant. Brande & C.

allegheny.definition: Of or pertaining to the Allegheny Mountains, or the region where they are situated. Also Al"le*gha`ny. 2.  [From the Allegheny River, Pennsylvania.] (Geol.) Pertaining to or designating a subdivision of the Pennsylvanian coal measure.

ictus.definition: (Pros.)  The stress of voice laid upon accented syllable of a word. Cf. Arsis. 2. (Med.)  A stroke or blow, as in a sunstroke, the sting of an insect, pulsation of an artery, etc.

upstand.definition: To stand up; to be erected; to rise. Spenser. Milton. At once upstood the monarch, and upstood The wise Ulysses. Cowper.

implicit.definition: Infolded; entangled; complicated; involved. Milton. In his woolly fleece I cling implicit. Pope. 2. Tacitly comprised; fairly to be understood, though not expressed in words; implied; as, an implicit contract or agreement. South. 3. Resting on another; trusting in the word or authority of another, w.

plano-convex.definition: Plane or flat on one side, and convex on the other; as, a plano-convex lens. See Convex, and Lens.

mahout.definition: The keeper and driver of an elephant. [East Indies].

freeman.definition: One who enjoys liberty, or who is not subject to the will of another; one not a slave or vassal. 2. A member of a corporation, company, or city, possessing certain privileges; a member of a borough, town, or State, who has the right to vote at elections. See Liveryman. Burrill. Both having been made.

exogenetic.definition: Arising or growing from without; exogenous.

whitewood.definition: The soft and easily-worked wood of the tulip tree (Liriodendron). It is much used in cabinetwork, carriage building, etc. Note: Several other kinds of light-colored wood are called whitewood in various countries, as the wood of Bignonia leucoxylon in the West Indies, of Pittosporum bicolor in Tasman.

reprimer.definition: A machine or implement for applying fresh primers to spent cartridge shells, so that the shells be used again.

squinting.definition: a. & n. from Squint, v. -- Squint"ing*ly, adv.

sunshiny.definition: Bright with the rays of the sun; clear, warm, or pleasant; as, a sunshiny day. 2. Bright like the sun; resplendent. Flashing beams of that sunshiny shield. Spenser. 3. Beaming with good spirits; cheerful. "Her sunshiny face." Spenser.

alphol.definition: A crystalline derivative of salicylic acid, used as an antiseptic and antirheumatic.

genu.definition: (a) The knee. (b) The kneelike bend, in the anterior part of the callosum of the brain.

swath.definition: A line of grass or grain cut and thrown together by the scythe in mowing or cradling. 2. The whole sweep of a scythe, or the whole breadth from which grass or grain is cut by a scythe or a machine, in mowing or cradling; as, to cut a wide swath. 3. A band or fillet; a swathe. Shak. Swath bank, a row.

whereat.definition: At which; upon which; whereupon; -- used relatively. They vote; whereat his speech he thus renews. Milton. Whereat he was no less angry and ashamed than desirous to obey Zelmane. Sir P. Sidney. 2. At what; -- used interrogatively; as, whereat are you offended.

fluegel.definition: A grand piano or a harpsichord, both being wing-shaped.

glomerate.definition:
Gathered together in a roundish mass or dense cluster; conglomerate.

To gather or wind into a ball; to collect into a spherical form or mass, as threads.

merestead.definition: The land within the boundaries of a farm; a farmstead or farm. [Archaic.] Longfellow.

pyral.definition: Of or pertaining to a pyre.

uraeus.definition: A serpent, or serpent's head and neck, represented on the front of the headdresses of divinities and sovereigns as an emblem of supreme power.

granddaughter.definition: The daughter of one's son or daughter.

stile.definition:
A pin set on the face of a dial, to cast a shadow; a style. See Style. Moxon. 2. Mode of composition. See Style. May I not write in such a stile as this Bunyan.

1. A step, or set of steps, for ascending and descending, in passing a fence or wall. There comes my master . . . over the stile, this way.

arctation.definition: Constriction or contraction of some natural passage, as in constipation from inflammation.

unboundably.definition: Infinitely. I am . . . unboundably beholding to you. J. Webster (1607).

gradine.definition:
Any member like a step, as the raised back of an altar or the like; a set raised over another. "The gradines of the amphitheeater." Layard.

A toothed chised by sculptors.

unpursed.definition: Robbed of a purse, or of money. Pollock. 2. Taken from the purse; expended. Gower.

mutilate.definition:
Deprived of, or having lost, an important part; mutilated. Sir T. Browne. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having finlike appendages or flukes instead of legs, as a cetacean.

A cetacean, or a sirenian.

1. To cut off or remove a limb or essential part of; to maim; to cripple; to hack; as, to mutilate the body, a statue.

argosy.definition: A large ship, esp. a merchant vessel of the largest size. Where your argosies with portly sail . . . Do overpeer the petty traffickers. Shak.

ineffervescent.definition: Not effervescing, or not susceptible of effervescence; quiescent.

centumviral.definition: Of or pertaining to the centumviri, or to a centumvir.

hornwork.definition: An outwork composed of two demibastions joined by a curtain. It is connected with the works in rear by long wings.

agha.definition: In Turkey, a commander or chief officer. It is used also as a title of respect.

stillage.definition: A low stool to keep the goods from touching the floor. Knight.

comet-finder.definition: A telescope of low power, having a large field of view, used for finding comets.

pyrogen.definition: Electricity. 2. (Physiol. Chem.)  A poison separable from decomposed meat infusions, and supposed to be formed from albuminous matter through the agency of bacteria.

rectal.definition: Of or pertaining to the rectum; in the region of the rectum.

copple-crown.definition: A created or high-topped crown or head. "Like the copple-crown the lapwing has." T. Randolph. -- Cop"ple-crowned`, a.

unnest.definition: To eject from a nest; to unnestle. T. Adams.

deadhead.definition: One who receives free tickets for theaters, public conveyances, etc. [Colloq. U. S.] 2. (Naut.)  A buoy. See under Dead, a.

jambes.definition: In the Middle Ages, armor for the legs below the knees. [Written also giambeux.] Chaucer.

plebs.definition: The commonalty of ancient Rome who were citizens without the usual political rights; the plebeians; -- distinguished from the patricians. 2.  Hence, the common people; the populace; --construed as a pl.

taxidermic.definition: Of or pertaining to the art of preparing and preserving the skins of animals.

gladiatorship.definition: Conduct, state, or art, of a gladiator.

alexiterical.definition: Resisting poison; obviating the effects of venom; alexipharmic.

paigle.definition: A species of Primula, either the cowslip or the primrose. [Written also pagle, pagil, peagle, and pygil.].

anagrammatism.definition: The act or practice of making anagrams. Camden.

jeerer.definition: A scoffer; a railer; a mocker.

panorpid.definition: Any neuropterous insect of the genus Panorpa, and allied genera. The larvæ feed on plant lice.

plutocratic.definition: Of or pertaining to plutocracy; as, plutocratic ideas. Bagehot.

morendo.definition: Dying; a gradual decrescendo at the end of a strain or cadence.

reentrant.definition: Reëntering; pointing or directed inwardds; as, a re angle.

macrodome.definition: A dome parallel to the longer lateral axis of an orthorhombic crystal. See Dome, n., 4.

renege.definition:
To deny; to disown. Shak. All Europe high (all sorts of rights reneged) Against the trith and thee unholy leagued. Sylvester.

1. To deny. Shak. 2. (Card Playing)  To revoke.

abjunctive.definition: Exceptional. It is this power which leads on from the accidental and abjunctive to the universal. I. Taylor.

viny.definition: Of or pertaining to vines; producing, or abounding in, vines. P. Fletcher.

decapodous.definition: Belonging to the decapods; having ten feet; ten-footed.

etamine.definition: A light textile fabric, like a fine bunting.

rhythmic.definition: Pertaining to, or of the nature of, rhythm DAy and night I worked my rhythmic thought. Mrs. Browning. Rhythmical accent. (Mus.) See Accent, n., 6 (c).

aria.definition: An air or song; a melody; a tune. Note: The Italian term is now mostly used for the more elaborate accompanied melodies sung by a single voice, in operas, oratorios, cantatas, anthems, etc., and not so much for simple airs or tunes.

menhaden.definition: An American marine fish of the Herring familt (Brevoortia tyrannus), chiefly valuable for its oil and as a component of fertilizers; -- called also mossbunker, bony fish, chebog, pogy, hardhead, whitefish, etc.

parachronism.definition: An error in chronology, by which the date of an event is set later than the time of its occurrence.

heliolite.definition: A fossil coral of the genus Heliolites, having twelve-rayed cells. It is found in the Silurian rocks.

gaby.definition: A simpleton; a dunce; a lout.

sluggard.definition:
A person habitually lazy, idle, and inactive; a drone. Go to the ant, thou sluggard; considered her ways, and be wise. Prov. vi. 6.

Sluggish; lazy. Dryden.

citied.definition: Belonging to, or resembling, a city. "Smoky, citied towns" Drayton. 2. Containing, or covered with, cities. "The citied earth." Keats.

triplicate.definition:
Made thrice as much; threefold; tripled. Triplicate ratio (Math.), the ratio of the cubes of two quantities; thus, the triplicate ratio of a to b is a3: b3.

A third thing corresponding to two others of the same kind.

utro.definition: - (connection with, or relation to, the uterus; as in utro- ovarian.

shortener.definition: One who, or that which, shortens.

somnambulation.definition: The act of walking in sleep.

ulmus.definition: A genus of trees including the elm.

immolator.definition: One who offers in sacrifice; specifically, one of a sect of Russian fanatics who practice self-mutilatio and sacrifice.

impatient.definition: Not patient; not bearing with composure; intolerant; uneasy; fretful; restless, because of pain, delay, or opposition; eager for change, or for something expected; hasty; passionate; -- often followed by at, for, of, and under. A violent, sudden, and impatient necessity. Jer. Taylor. Fame, impatient.

lingism.definition: A mode of treating certain diseases, as obesity, by gymnastics; -- proposed by Pehr Henrik Ling, a Swede. See Kinesiatrics.

stature.definition: The natural height of an animal body; -- generally used of the human body. Foreign men of mighty stature came. Dryden.

scorpionwort.definition: A leguminous plant (Ornithopus scorpides) of Southern Europe, having curved pods.

aspectable.definition: Capable of being; visible. "The aspectable world." Ray. "Aspectable stars." Mrs. Browning.

ouster.definition: A putting out of possession; dispossession; ejection; disseizin. Ouster of the freehold is effected by abatement, intrusion, disseizin, discontinuance, or deforcement. Blackstone. Ouster le main. Etym: [Ouster + F. la main the hand, L. manus.] (Law) A delivery of lands out of the hands of a guardian.

infrequent.definition: Seldom happening or occurring; rare; uncommon; unusual. The act whereof is at this day infrequent or out of use among all sorts of men. Sir T. Elyot.

involuntary.definition: Not having will of the power of choice. 2. Not under the influence or control of the will; not voluntary; as, the involuntary movements of the body; involuntary muscle fibers. 3. Not proceeding from choice; done unwillingly; reluctant; compulsory; as, involuntary submission.

sibilancy.definition: The quality or state of being sibilant; sibilation. Milton would not have avoided them for their sibilancy, he who wrote . . . verses that hiss like Medusa's head in wrath. Lowell.

mulier.definition: A woman. 2. (Law) (a) Lawful issue born in wedlock, in distinction from an elder brother born of the same parents before their marriage; a lawful son. (b) (Civ. Law) A woman; a wife; a mother. Blount. Cowell.

loper.definition: One who, or that which, lopes; esp., a horse that lopes. [U.S.] 2. (Rope Making)  A swivel at one end of a ropewalk, used in laying the strands.

cockroach.definition: An orthopterus insect of the genus Blatta, and allied genera. Note: The species are numerous, especially in hot countries. Those most commonly infesting houses in Europe and North America are Blatta orientalis, a large species often called black beetle, and the Croton bug (Ectobia Germanica).

arpeggio.definition: The production of the tones of a chord in rapid succession, as in playing the harp, and not simultaneously; a strain thus played.

deliverance.definition: The act of delivering or freeing from restraint, captivity, peril, and the like; rescue; as, the deliverance of a captive. He hath sent me to heal the broken-hearted, to preach deliverance to the captives. Luke iv. 18. One death or one deliverance we will share. Dryden. 2. Act of bringing forth chil.

thundercloud.definition: A cloud charged with electricity, and producing lightning and thunder.

vasectomy.definition: Resection or excision of the vas deferens.

paracentric.definition: Deviating from circularity; changing the distance from a center. Paracentric curve (Math.), a curve having the property that, when its plane is placed vertically, a body descending along it, by the force of gravity, will approach to, or recede from, a fixed point or center, by equal distances in equ.

battlement.definition: (a) One of the solid upright parts of a parapet in ancient fortifications. (b) pl. The whole parapet, consisting of alternate solids and open spaces. At first purely a military feature, afterwards copied on a smaller scale with decorative features, as for churches.

rallies.definition: A French political group, also known as the Constitutional Right from its position in the Chambers, mainly monarchists who rallied to the support of the Republic in obedience to the encyclical put forth by Pope Leo XIII. in Feb., 1892.

scintillant.definition: Emitting sparks, or fine igneous particles; sparkling. M. Green.

begohm.definition: A unit of resistance equal to one billion ohms, or one thousand megohms.

refrigerative.definition: Cooling; allaying heat. -- n.  A refrigerant. Crazed brains should come under a refrigerative treatment. I. Taylor.

insignificance.definition: The condition or quality of being insignificant; want of significance, sense, or meaning; as, the insignificance of words or phrases. 2. Want of force or effect; unimportance; pettiness; inefficacy; as, the insignificance of human art. 3. Want of claim to consideration or notice; want of influence o.

afterbirth.definition: The placenta and membranes with which the fetus is connected, and which come away after delivery.

stichwort.definition: A kind of chickweed (Stellaria Holostea). [Written also stitchwort.].

incorruptible.definition:
Not corruptible; incapable of corruption, decay, or dissolution; as, gold is incorruptible. Our bodies shall be changed into incorruptible and immortal substances. Wake. 2. Incapable of being bribed or morally corrupted; inflexibly just and upright.

One of a religious sect which arose in Alexandria.

paratactic.definition: Of pertaining to, or characterized by, parataxis.

strapwork.definition: A kind of ornament consisting of a narrow fillet or band folded, crossed, and interlaced.

goutiness.definition: The state of being gouty; gout.

kiver.definition: To cover. -- n.  A cover. [Disused except in illiterate speech.].

lyrist.definition: A musician who plays on the harp or lyre; a composer of lyrical poetry. Shelley.

dayfly.definition: A neuropterous insect of the genus Ephemera and related genera, of many species, and inhabiting fresh water in the larval state; the ephemeral fly; -- so called because it commonly lives but one day in the winged or adult state. See Ephemeral fly, under Ephemeral.

hyoscyamine.definition: An alkaloid found in henbane (Hyoscyamus niger), and regarded as its active principle. It is also found with other alkaloids in the thorn apple and deadly nightshade. It is extracted as a white crystalline substance, with a sharp, offensive taste. Hyoscyamine is isomeric with atropine, is very poiso.

saccade.definition: A sudden, violent check of a horse by drawing or twitching the reins on a sudden and with one pull.

equivoke.definition: An ambiguous term; a word susceptible of different significations. Coleridge. 2. An equivocation; a guibble. B. Jonson.

alogian.definition: One of an ancient sect who rejected St. John's Gospel and the Apocalypse, which speak of Christ as the Logos. Shipley.

pleadable.definition: Capable of being pleaded; capable of being alleged in proof, defense, or vindication; as, a right or privilege pleadable at law. Dryden.

disgregate.definition: To disperse; to scatter; -- opposite of congregate.

coequality.definition: The state of being on an equality, as in rank or power.

expiable.definition: Capable of being expiated or atoned for; as, an expiable offense; expiable guilt. Bp. Hall.

low-lived.definition: Characteristic of, or like, one bred in a low and vulgar condition of life; mean dishonorable; contemptible; as, low-lived dishonesty.

grogshop.definition: A shop or room where strong liquors are sold and drunk; a dramshop.

sothic.definition: Of or pertaining to Sothis, the Egyptian name for the Dog Star; taking its name from the Dog Star; canicular. Sothiac, or Sothic, year (Chronol.), the Egyptian year of 365 days and 6 hours, as distinguished from the Egyptian vague year, which contained 365 days. The Sothic period consists of 1,460 S.

thereunto.definition: Unto that or this; thereto; besides. Shak.

trencher-man.definition: A feeder; a great eater; a gormandizer. Shak. 2. A cook. The skillfulest trencher-men of Media. Sir P. Sidney. 3. A table companion; a trencher mate. Thackeray.

erasure.definition: The act of erasing; a scratching out; obliteration.

bombycinous.definition: Silken; made of silk. Coles. 2. Being of the color of the silkworm; transparent with a yellow tint. E. Darwin.

talpa.definition: A genus of small insectivores including the common European mole.

anthotaxy.definition: The arrangement of flowers in a cluster; the science of the relative position of flowers; inflorescence.

godless.definition: Having, or acknowledging, no God; without reverence for God; impious; wicked. -- God"less*ly, adv. -- God"less*ness, n.

silicoidea.definition: An extensive order of Porifera, which includes those that have the skeleton composed mainly of siliceous fibers or spicules.

sidereal.definition: Relating to the stars; starry; astral; as, sidereal astronomy. 2. (Astron.)  Measuring by the apparent motion of the stars; designated, marked out, or accompanied, by a return to the same position in respect to the stars; as, the sidereal revolution of a planet; a sidereal day. Sidereal clock, day,.

short-jointed.definition: Having short intervals between the joints; -- said of a plant or an animal, especially of a horse whose pastern is too short.

ministrant.definition: Performing service as a minister; attendant on service; acting under command; subordinate. "Princedoms and dominations ministrant." Milton. -- n.  One who ministers.

subtriplicate.definition: Expressed by the cube root; -- said especially of ratios. Subtriplicate ratio, the ratio of the cube root; thus, the subtriplicate ratio of a to b is cube roota to cube rootb, or cube roota/b.

nonsubmission.definition: Want of submission; failure or refusal to submit.

etymic.definition: Relating to the etymon; as, an etymic word.

speciosity.definition: The quality or state of being specious; speciousness. Professions built so largely on speciosity, instead of performance. Carlyle. 2. That which is specious. Dr. H. More.

baraesthesiometer.definition: An instrument for determining the delicacy of the sense of pressure. -- Bar`æs*the`si*o*met"ric, Bar`es*the`si*o*met"ric (#), a.

overhip.definition: To pass over by, or as by a hop; to skip over; hence, to overpass. "When the time is overhipt." Holland.

rebuild.definition: To build again, as something which has been demolished; to construct anew; as, to rebuild a house, a wall, a wharf, or a city.

worshiper.definition: One who worships; one who pays divine honors to any being or thing; one who adores. [Written also worshipper.].

hangmanship.definition: The office or character of a hangman.

inductive.definition: Leading or drawing; persuasive; tempting; -- usually followed by to. A brutish vice, Inductive mainly to the sin of Eve. Milton. 2. Tending to induce or cause. They may be . . . inductive of credibility. Sir M. Hale. 3. Leading to inferences; proceeding by, derived from, or using, induction; as, ind.

frigidity.definition: The condition or quality of being frigid; coldness; want of warmth. Ice is water congealed by the frigidity of the air. Sir T. Browne. 2. Want of ardor, animation, vivacity, etc.; coldness of affection or of manner; dullness; stiffness and formality; as, frigidity of a reception, of a bow, etc. 3. W.

hayloft.definition: A loft or scaffold for hay.

facultative.definition: Having relation to the grant or exercise faculty, or authority, privilege, license, or the like hence, optional; as, facultative enactments, or those which convey a faculty, or permission; the facultative referendum of Switzerland is one that is optional with the people and is necessary only when de.

overblow.definition:
To blow over, or be subdued. Spenser. 2. (Mus.)  To force so much wind into a pipe that it produces an overtone, or a note higher than the natural note; thus, the upper octaves of a flute are produced by overblowing.

To blow away; to dissipate by wind, or as by wind. When this cloud of sorrow's ove.

centuriate.definition:
Pertaining to, or divided into, centuries or hundreds. Holland.

To divide into hundreds.

screaming.definition: Uttering screams; shrieking. 2. Having the nature of a scream; like a scream; shrill; sharp. The fearful matrons raise a screaming cry. Dryden.

bedbug.definition: A wingless, bloodsucking, hemipterous insect (Cimex Lectularius), sometimes infesting houses and especially beds. See Illustration in Appendix.

tankard.definition: A large drinking vessel, especially one with a cover. Marius was the first who drank out of a silver tankard, after the manner of Bacchus. Arbuthnot.

doltish.definition: Doltlike; dull in intellect; stupid; blockish; as, a doltish clown. -- Dolt"ish*ly, adv. -- Dolt"ish*ness, n.

cotenant.definition: A tenant in common, or a joint tenant.

thiller.definition: The horse which goes between the thills, or shafts, and supports them; also, the last horse in a team; -- called also thill horse.

denunciate.definition: To denounce; to condemn publicly or solemnly. To denunciate this new work. Burke.

delphinoidea.definition: The division of Cetacea which comprises the dolphins, porpoises, and related forms.

katabolism.definition: Destructive or downward metabolism; regressive metamorphism; -- opposed to anabolism. See Disassimilation.

tarn.definition: A mountain lake or pool. A lofty precipice in front, A silent tarn below. Wordsworth.

bailiwick.definition: The precincts within which a bailiff has jurisdiction; the limits of a bailiff's authority.

beakhead.definition: (Arch.)  An ornament used in rich Norman doorways, resembling a head with a beak. Parker. 2. (Naut.) (a) A small platform at the fore part of the upper deck of a vessel, which contains the water closets of the crew. (b) (Antiq.) Same as Beak, 3.

pomey.definition: A figure supposed to resemble an apple; a roundel, -- always of a green color.

pullulate.definition: To germinate; to bud; to multiply abundantly. Warburton.

unshell.definition: To strip the shell from; to take out of the shell; to hatch.

epitithides.definition: The uppermost member of the cornice of an entablature.

retinalite.definition: A translucent variety of serpentine, of a honey yellow or greenish yellow color, having a waxy resinlike luster.

athlete.definition: (Antiq.)  One who contended for a prize in the public games of ancient Greece or Rome. 2. Any one trained to contend in exercises requiring great physical agility and strength; one who has great activity and strength; a champion. 3. One fitted for, or skilled in, intellectual contests; as, athletes.

piffle.definition:
To be sequeamish or delicate; hence, to act or talk triflingly or ineffectively; to twaddle; piddle. [Dial. or Slang]

Act of piffling; trifling talk or action; piddling; twaddle. [Dial. or Slang] "Futile piffle." Kipling.

abidance.definition: The state of abiding; abode; continuance; compliance (with). The Christians had no longer abidance in the holy hill of Palestine. Fuller. A judicious abidance by rules. Helps.

consequentially.definition: With just deduction of consequence; with right connection of ideas; logically. The faculty of writing consequentially. Addison. 2. By remote consequence; not immediately; eventually; as, to do a thing consequentially. South. 3. In a regular series; in the order of cause and effect; with logical conc.

reichstag.definition: The Diet, or House of Representatives, of the German empire, which is composed of members elected for a term of three years by the direct vote of the people. See Bundesrath.

restrain.definition: To draw back again; to hold back from acting, proceeding, or advancing, either by physical or moral force, or by any interposing obstacle; to repress or suppress; to keep down; to curb. Restrain in me the cursed thoughts that nature Gives way to in repose! Shak. 2. To draw back toghtly, as a rein. S.

feud.definition: A combination of kindred to avenge injuries or affronts, done or offered to any of their blood, on the offender and all his race. 2. A contention or quarrel; especially, an inveterate strife between families, clans, or parties; deadly hatred; contention satisfied only by bloodshed. Mutual feuds and.

hobo.definition: A professional tramp; one who spends his life traveling from place to place, esp. by stealing rides on trains, and begging for a living. [U. S.] -- Ho"bo*ism (#), n.

mickle.definition: Much; great. [Written also muckle and mockle.] [Old Eng. & Scot.] "A man of mickle might." Spenser.

swimbel.definition: A moaning or sighing sound or noise; a sough. Chaucer.

motorize.definition: To substitute motor-driven vehicles, or automobiles, for the horses and horse-drawn vehicles of (a fire department, city, etc.). - -Mo`tor*i*za"tion (#), n.

goosefoot.definition: A genus of herbs (Chenopodium) mostly annual weeds; pigweed.

bullen-nail.definition: A nail with a round head and short shank, tinned and lacquered.

co-meddle.definition: To mix; to mingle, to temper. Shak.

mammonish.definition: Actuated or prompted by a devotion to money getting or the service of Mammon. Carlyle.

parde.definition: Certainly; surely; truly; verily; -- originally an oath. [Written also pardee, pardieux, perdie, etc.] He was, parde, an old fellow of yours. Chaucer.

caliginous.definition: Affected with darkness or dimness; dark; obscure. Blount. The caliginous regions of the air. Hallywell. -- Ca*lig"i*nous*ly, adv. -- Ca*lig"i*nous*ness, n.

omnipotency.definition: The state of being omnipotent; almighty power; hence, one who is omnipotent; the Deity. Will Omnipotence neglect to save The suffering virtue of the wise and brave Pope. 2. Unlimited power of a particular kind; as, love's omnipotence. Denham.

concise.definition: Expressing much in a few words; condensed; brief and compacted; -- used of style in writing or speaking. The concise style, which expresseth not enough, but leaves somewhat to be understood. B. Jonson. Where the author is . . . too brief and concise, amplify a little. I. Watts. Syn. -- Laconic; ters.

bollen.definition:
See Boln, a.

Swollen; puffed out. Thin, and boln out like a sail. B. Jonson.

mislay.definition: To lay in a wrong place; to ascribe to a wrong source. The fault is generally mislaid upon nature. Locke. 2. To lay in a place not recollected; to lose. The... charter, indeed, was unfortunately mislaid: and the prayer of their petition was to obtain one of like import in its stead. Hallam.

poignancy.definition: The quality or state of being poignant; as, the poignancy of satire; the poignancy of grief. Swift.

presbyterianism.definition: That form of church government which invests presbyters with all spiritual power, and admits no prelates over them; also, the faith and polity of the Presbyterian churches, taken collectively.

dative.definition: (Gram.)  Noting the case of a noun which expresses the remoter object, and is generally indicated in English by to or for with the objective. 2. (Law) (a) In one's gift; capable of being disposed of at will and pleasure, as an office. (b) Removable, as distinguished from perpetual; -- said of an off.

uncork.definition: To draw the cork from; as, to uncork a bottle.

radiometry.definition: The use of the radiometer, or the measurement of radiation. -- Ra`di*o*met"ric (#), a.

thunderer.definition: One who thunders; -- used especially as a translation of L. tonans, an epithet applied by the Romans to several of their gods, esp. to Jupiter. That dreadful oath which binds the Thunderer. Pope.

enchylemma.definition: The basal substance of the cell nucleus; a hyaline or granular substance, more or less fluid during life, in which the other parts of the nucleus are imbedded.

light-hearted.definition: Free from grief or anxiety; gay; cheerful; merry. -- Light"-heart`ed*ly, adv. -- Light"-heart"ed*ness, n.

invert.definition: To turn over; to put upside down; to upset; to place in a contrary order or direction; to reverse; as, to invert a cup, the order of words, rules of justice, etc. That doth invert the attest of eyes and ears, As if these organs had deceptious functions. Shak. Such reasoning falls like an inverted co.

intensely.definition: Intently. J. Spencer. 2. To an extreme degree; as, weather intensely cold.

irrepressibly.definition: In a manner or to a degree that can not be repressed.

outkeeper.definition: An attachment to a surveyor's compass for keeping tally in chaining.

urcelate.definition: Shaped like a pitcher or urn; swelling below, and contrasted at the orifice, as a calyx or corolla.

toxodonta.definition: An extinct order of Mammalia found in the South American Tertiary formation. The incisor teeth were long and curved and provided with a persistent pulp. They are supposed to be related both to the rodents and ungulates. Called also Toxodontia.

superiority.definition: The quality, state, or condition of being superior; as, superiority of rank; superiority in merit. Syn. -- Preëminence; excellence; predominancy; prevalence; ascendency; odds; advantage.

lamellibranchiate.definition: Having lamellar gills; belonging to the Lamellibranchia. -- n.  One of the Lamellibranchia.

dele.definition:
Erase; remove; -- a direction to cancel something which has been put in type; usually expressed by a peculiar form of d, thus: .

To erase; to cancel; to delete; to mark for omission.

To deal; to divide; to distribute. Chaucer.

correctioner.definition: One who is, or who has been, in the house of correction. Shak.

augmentative.definition:
Having the quality or power of augmenting; expressing augmentation. -- Aug*ment"a*tive*ly, adv.

A word which expresses with augmented force the idea or the properties of the term from which it is derived; as, dullard, one very dull. Opposed to diminutive. Gibbs.

exactness.definition: The condition of being exact; accuracy; nicety; precision; regularity; as, exactness of jurgement or deportment. 2. Careful observance of method and conformity to truth; as, exactness in accounts or business. He had . . . that sort of exactness which would have made him a respectable antiquary. Maca.

wedded.definition: Joined in wedlock; married. Let wwedded dame. Pope. 2. Of or pertaining to wedlock, or marriage. "Wedded love." Milton.

fluty.definition: Soft and clear in tone, like a flute.

rep-silver.definition: Money anciently paid by servile tenants to their lord, in lieu of the customary service of reaping his corn or grain.

outport.definition: A harbor or port at some distance from the chief town or seat of trade. Macaulay.

unearthly.definition: Not terrestrial; supernatural; preternatural; hence, weird; appalling; terrific; as, an unearthly sight or sound. -- Un*earth"li*ness, n.

clasp.definition:
To shut or fasten together with, or as with, a clasp; to shut or fasten (a clasp, or that which fastens with a clasp). 2. To inclose and hold in the hand or with the arms; to grasp; to embrace. 3. To surround and cling to; to entwine about. "Clasping ivy." Milton.

1. An adjustable catch, bent plate.

depredator.definition: One who plunders or pillages; a spoiler; a robber.

first-rate.definition:
Of the highest excellence; preëminent in quality, size, or estimation. Our only first-rate body of contemporary poetry is the German. M. Arnold. Hermocrates . . . a man of first-rate ability. Jowett (Thucyd).

A war vessel of the highest grade or the most powerful class.

ulotrichous.definition: Having woolly or crispy hair; -- opposed to leiotrichous.

crenel.definition:
See Crenelle.

1. An embrasure or indentation in a battlement; a loophole in a fortress; an indentation; a notch. See Merlon, and Illust. of Battlement. 2. (Bot.)  Same as Crenature.

emend.definition: To purge of faults; to make better; to correct; esp., to make corrections in (a literary work); to alter for the better by textual criticism, generally verbal. Syn. -- To amend; correct; improve; better; reform; rectify. See Amend.

haste.definition: Celerity of motion; speed; swiftness; dispatch; expedition; -- applied only to voluntary beings, as men and other animals. The king's business required haste. 1 Sam. xxi. 8. 2. The state of being urged or pressed by business; hurry; urgency; sudden excitement of feeling or passion; precipitance; veh.

homologize.definition: To determine the homologies or structural relations of.

domical.definition: Relating to, or shaped like, a dome.

traps.definition: Small or portable articles for dress, furniture, or use; goods; luggage; things.

dibasic.definition: Having two acid hydrogen atoms capable of replacement by basic atoms or radicals, in forming salts; bibasic; -- said of acids, as oxalic or sulphuric acids. Cf. Diacid, Bibasic. Note: In the case of certain acids dibasic and divalent are not synonymous; as, tartaric acid is tetravalent and dibasic,.

loyal.definition: Faithful to law; upholding the lawful authority; faithful and true to the lawful government; faithful to the prince or sovereign to whom one is subject; unswerving in allegiance. Welcome, sir John ! But why come you in arms -To help King Edward in his time of storm, As every loyal subject ought to d.

coquina.definition: A soft, whitish, coral-like stone, formed of broken shells and corals, found in the southern United States, and used for roadbeds and for building material, as in the fort at St. Augustine, Florida.

stemple.definition: A crossbar of wood in a shaft, serving as a step.

addression.definition: The act of addressing or directing one's course. [Rare & Obs.] Chapman.

dietetics.definition: That part of the medical or hygienic art which relates to diet or food; rules for diet. To suppose that the whole of dietetics lies in determining whether or not bread is more nutritive than potatoes. H. Spencer.

underfurnish.definition: To supply with less than enough; to furnish insufficiently. Collier.

granite.definition: A crystalline, granular rock, consisting of quartz, feldspar, and mica, and usually of a whitish, grayish, or flesh-red color. It differs from gneiss in not having the mica in planes, and therefor in being destitute of a schistose structure. Note: Varieties containing hornblende are common. See also.

skirmisher.definition: One who skirmishes. Specifically: pl. (Mil.)  Soldiers deployed in loose order, to cover the front or flanks of an advancing army or a marching column.

dialyze.definition: To separate, prepare, or obtain, by dialysis or osmose; to pass through an animal membrane; to subject to dialysis. [Written also dialyse.].

stagirite.definition: A native of, or resident in, Stagira, in ancient Macedonia; especially, Aristotle. [Written also Stagyrite.].

elevatory.definition:
Tending to raise, or having power to elevate; as, elevatory forces.

See Elevator, n. (e). Dunglison.

dreamy.definition: Abounding in dreams or given to dreaming; appropriate to, or like, dreams; visionary. "The dreamy dells." Tennyson.

aforesaid.definition: Said before, or in a preceding part; already described or identified.

morris-chair.definition: A kind of easy-chair with a back which may be lowered or raised.

enmanche.definition: Resembling, or covered with, a sleeve; -- said of the chief when lines are drawn from the middle point of the upper edge upper edge to the sides.

yardarm.definition: Either half of a square-rigged vessel's yard, from the center or mast to the end. Note: Ships are said to be yardarm and yardarm when so near as to touch, or interlock yards.

dyscrasy.definition: Dycrasia. Sin is a cause of dycrasies and distempers. Jer. Taylor.

hard-handed.definition: Having hard hands, as a manual laborer. Hard-handed men that work in Athens here. Shak.

isonandra.definition: A genus of sapotaceous trees of India. Isonandra Gutta is the principal source of gutta-percha.

squirrel.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of numerous species of small rodents belonging to the genus Sciurus and several allied genera of the famly Sciuridæ. Squirrels generally have a bushy tail, large erect ears, and strong hind legs. They are commonly arboreal in their habits, but many species live in burrows. Note: Amo.

wherethrough.definition: Through which. "Wherethrough that I may know." Chaucer. Windows . . . wherethrough the sun Delights to peep, to gaze therein on thee. Shak.

tomb.definition: A pit in which the dead body of a human being is deposited; a grave; a sepulcher. As one dead in the bottom of a tomb. Shak. 2. A house or vault, formed wholly or partly in the earth, with walls and a roof, for the reception of the dead. "In tomb of marble stones." Chaucer. 3. A monument erected to.

topmost.definition: Highest; uppermost; as, the topmost cliff; the topmost branch of a tree. The nightngale may claim the topmost bough. Cowper.

ponderousness.definition: The quality or state of being ponderous; ponderosity.

shropshire.definition: An English breed of black-faced hornless sheep similar to the Southdown, but larger, now extensively raised in many parts of the world.

suprarenal.definition: Situated above, or anterior to, the kidneys. -- n.  A suprarenal capsule. Suprarenal capsules (Anat.), two small bodies of unknown function in front of, or near, the kidneys in most vertebrates. Also called renal capsules, and suprarenal bodies.

whey-faced.definition: Having a pale or white face, as from fright. "Whey-faced cavaliers." Aytoun.

oblivion.definition: The act of forgetting, or the state of being forgotten; cessation of remembrance; forgetfulness. Second childishness and mere oblivion. Shak. Among our crimes oblivion may be set. Dryden The origin of our city will be buried in eternal oblivion. W. Irving. 2. Official ignoring of offenses; amnesty,.

organon.definition: An organ or instrument; hence, a method by which philosophical or scientific investigation may be conducted; -- a term adopted from the Aristotelian writers by Lord Bacon, as the title ("Novum Organon") of part of his treatise on philosophical method. Sir. W. Hamilton.

residentiaryship.definition: The office or condition of a residentiary.

latitudinarian.definition: Not restrained; not confined by precise limits. 2. Indifferent to a strict application of any standard of belief or opinion; hence, deviating more or less widely from such standard; lax in doctrine; as, latitudinarian divines; latitudinarian theology. Latitudinarian sentiments upon religious subject.

wasteness.definition: The quality or state of being waste; a desolate state or condition; desolation. A day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness. Zeph. i. 15. 2. That which is waste; a desert; a waste. Through woods and wasteness wide him daily sought. Spenser.

venerability.definition: The quality or state of being venerable; venerableness. Dr. H. More.

ellipsoid.definition: A solid, all plane sections of which are ellipses or circles. See Conoid, n., 2 (a). Note: The ellipsoid has three principal plane sections, a, b, and c, each at right angles to the other two, and each dividing the solid into two equal and symmetrical parts. The lines of meeting of these principal s.

malefaction.definition: A crime; an offense; an evil deed. Shak.

tetraphyllous.definition: Having four leaves; consisting of four distinct leaves or leaflets.

hew.definition: To cut with an ax; to fell with a sharp instrument; -- often with down, or off. Shak. 2. To form or shape with a sharp instrument; to cut; hence, to form laboriously; -- often with out; as, to hew out a sepulcher. Look unto the rock whence ye are hewn. Is. li. 1. Rather polishing old works than hewi.

mineralizer.definition: An element which is combined with a metal, thus forming an ore. Thus, in galena, or lead ore, sulphur is a mineralizer; in hematite, oxygen is a mineralizer.

rasure.definition: The act of rasing, scraping, or erasing; erasure; obliteration. 2. A mark by which a letter, word, or any part of a writing or print, is erased, effaced, or obliterated; an erasure. Ayliffe.

sheol.definition: The place of departed spirits; Hades; also, the grave. For thou wilt not leave my soul to sheel. Ps. xvi. 10. (Rev. Ver.).

pyrometric.definition: Pertaining to, or obtained by, the pyrometer; as, pyrometrical instruments; pyrometrical measurements.

auroral.definition: Belonging to, or resembling, the aurora (the dawn or the northern lights); rosy. Her cheeks suffused with an auroral blush. Longfellow.

madrague.definition: A large fish pound used for the capture of the tunny in the Mediterranean; also applied to the seines used for the same purpose.

befool.definition: To fool; to delude or lead into error; to infatuate; to deceive. This story . . . contrived to befool credulous men. Fuller. 2. To cause to behave like a fool; to make foolish. "Some befooling drug." G. Eliot.

irresistible.definition: That can not be successfully resisted or opposed; superior to opposition; resistless; overpowering; as, an irresistible attraction. An irresistible law of our nature impels us to seek happiness. J. M. Mason.

toot.definition:
To stand out, or be prominent. Howell. 2. To peep; to look narrowly. Latimer. For birds in bushes tooting. Spenser.

To see; to spy. P. Plowman.

To blow or sound a horn; to make similar noise by contact of the tongue with the root of the upper teeth at the beginning and end of the sound; also, to g.

high-church.definition: Of or pertaining to, or favoring, the party called the High Church, or their doctrines or policy. See High Church, under High, a.

feminize.definition: To make womanish or effeminate. Dr. H. More.

superordination.definition: The ordination of a person to fill a station already occupied; especially, the ordination by an ecclesiastical official, during his lifetime, of his successor. Fuller.

xanthochroic.definition: Having a yellowish or fair complexion; of or pertaining to the Xanthochroi.

extispicious.definition: Relating to the inspection of entrails for prognostication. Sir T. Browne.

brontozoum.definition: An extinct animal of large size, known from its three-toed footprints in Mesozoic sandstone. Note: The tracks made by these reptiles are found eighteen inches in length, and were formerly referred to gigantic birds; but the discovery of large bipedal three-toed dinosaurs has suggested that they were.

felonwort.definition: The bittersweet nightshade (Solanum Dulcamara). See Bittersweet.

beetlehead.definition: A stupid fellow; a blockhead. Sir W. Scott. 2. (Zoöl.)  The black-bellied plover, or bullhead (Squatarola helvetica). See Plover.

iambically.definition: In a iambic manner; after the manner of iambics.

detortion.definition: The act of detorting, or the state of being detorted; a twisting or warping.

gyle.definition: Fermented wort used for making vinegar. Gyle tan (Brewing), a large vat in which wort ferments.

postman.definition: A post or courier; a letter carrier. 2. (Eng. Law)  One of the two most experienced barristers in the Court of Exchequer, who have precedence in motions; -- so called from the place where he sits. The other of the two is called the tubman. Whishaw.

senna.definition: (Med.)  The leaves of several leguminous plants of the genus Cassia. (C. acutifolia. C. angustifolia, etc.). They constitute a valuable but nauseous cathartic medicine. 2. (Bot.)  The plants themselves, native to the East, but now cultivated largely in the south of Europe and in the West Indies. Bla.

murk.definition:
Dark; murky. He can not see through the mantle murk. J. R. Drake.

Darkness; mirk. [Archaic] Shak.

The refuse of fruit, after the juice has been expressed; marc.

juise.definition: Judgment; justice; sentence. Up [on] pain of hanging and high juise. Chaucer.

begod.definition: To exalt to the dignity of a god; to deify. "Begodded saints." South.

chalice.definition: A cup or bowl; especially, the cup used in the sacrament of the Lord's Supper.

gondola.definition: A long, narrow boat with a high prow and stern, used in the canals of Venice. A gondola is usually propelled by one or two oarsmen who stand facing the prow, or by poling. A gondola for passengers has a small open cabin amidships, for their protection against the sun or rain. A sumptuary law of Veni.

niggerhead.definition: A strong black chewing tobacco, usually in twisted plug form; negro head.

logomachy.definition: Contention in words merely, or a contention about words; a war of words. The discussion concerning the meaning of the word " justification" . . . has largely been a mere logomachy. L. Abbott. 2. A game of word making.

carapato.definition: A south American tick of the genus Amblyamma. There are several species, very troublesome to man and beast.

mesocuniform.definition: One of the bones of the tarsus. See 2d Cuneiform.

oop.definition: To bind with a thread or cord; to join; to unite. [Scot.] Jamieson.

miliolitic.definition: Of or pertaining to the genus Miliola; containing miliolites.

congener.definition: A thing of the same genus, species, or kind; a thing allied in nature, character, or action. The cherry tree has been often grafted on the laurel, to which it is a congener. P. Miller. Our elk is more polygamous in his habits than any other deer except his congener, the red deer of Europe. Caton.

cycloganoid.definition:
Of or pertaining to the Cycloganoidei.

One of the Cycloganoidei.

laudableness.definition: The quality of being laudable; praiseworthiness; commendableness.

sundown.definition: The setting of the sun; sunset. "When sundown skirts the moor." Tennyson. 2. A kind of broad-brimmed sun hat worn by women.

grouse.definition: ) Any of the numerous species of gallinaceous birds of the family Tetraonidæ, and subfamily Tetraoninæ, inhabiting Europe, Asia, and North America. They have plump bodies, strong, well-feathered legs, and usually mottled plumage. The group includes the ptarmigans (Lagopus), having feathered feet. No.

maudeline.definition: An aromatic composite herb, the costmary; also, the South European Achillea Ageratum, a kind of yarrow.

algebraize.definition: To perform by algebra; to reduce to algebraic form.

gibberish.definition:
Rapid and inarticulate talk; unintelligible language; unmeaning words; jargon. He, like a gypsy, oftentimes would go; All kinds of gibberish he had learnt to known. Drayton. Such gibberish as children may be heard amusing themselves with. Hawthorne.

Unmeaning; as, gibberish language.

veinous.definition: Marked with veins; veined; veiny. The excellent old gentleman's nails are long and leaden, and his hands lean and veinous. Dickens.

myelonal.definition: Of or pertaining to the myelon; as, the myelonal, or spinal, nerves.

tang.definition:
A coarse blackish seaweed (Fuscus nodosus). Dr. Prior. Tang sparrow (Zoöl.), the rock pipit.

1. A strong or offensive taste; especially, a taste of something extraneous to the thing itself; as, wine or cider has a tang of the cask. 2. Fig.: A sharp, specific flavor or tinge. Cf. Tang a twang. Such.

rhythmometer.definition: An instrument for marking time in musical movements. See Metronome.

sieva.definition: A small variety of the Lima bean (Phaseolus lunatus).

overproduction.definition: Excessive production; supply beyond the demand. J. S. Mill.

formidableness.definition: The quality of being formidable, or adapted to excite dread. Boyle.

antihysteric.definition: Counteracting hysteria. -- n.  A remedy for hysteria.

sequester.definition: (Law)  To separate from the owner for a time; to take from parties in controversy and put into the possession of an indifferent person; to seize or take possession of, as property belonging to another, and hold it till the profits have paid the demand for which it is taken, or till the owner has per.

intraaxillary.definition: Situated below the point where a leaf joins the stem.

rollejee.definition: A kind of sausage, made in a bag of tripe, sliced and fried, famous among the Dutch of New Amsterdam and still known, esp. in New Jersey.

spurge.definition:
To emit foam; to froth; -- said of the emission of yeast from beer in course of fermentation. W. Cartright.

Any plant of the genus Euphobia. See Euphorbia. Spurge flax, an evergreen shrub (Daphne Gnidium) with crowded narrow leaves. It is native of Southern Europe. -- Spurge laurel, a European shru.

intercollegiate.definition: Existing or carried on between colleges or universities; as, intercollegiate relations, rivalry, games, etc.

paleocrinoidea.definition: A suborder of Crinoidea found chiefly in the Paleozoic rocks.

metergram.definition: A measure of energy or work done; the power exerted in raising one gram through the distance of one meter against gravitation.

deipnosophist.definition: One of an ancient sect of philosophers, who cultivated learned conversation at meals.

floe.definition: A low, flat mass of floating ice. Floe rat (Zoöl.), a seal (Phoca foetida).

calamite.definition: A fossil plant of the coal formation, having the general form of plants of the modern Equiseta (the Horsetail or Scouring Rush family) but sometimes attaining the height of trees, and having the stem more or less woody within. See Acrogen, and Asterophyllite.

preternaturalism.definition: The state of being preternatural; a preternatural condition.

seismometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the direction, duration, and force of earthquakes and like concussions.

hedger.definition: One who makes or mends hedges; also, one who hedges, as, in betting.

notch.definition:
A hollow cut in anything; a nick; an indentation. And on the stick ten equal notches makes. Swift. 2. A narrow passage between two elevation; a deep, close pass; a defile; as, the notch of a mountain.

1. To cut or make notches in ; to indent; also, to score by notches; as, to notch a stick. 2. To f.

recency.definition: The state or quality of being recent; newness; new state; late origin; lateness in time; freshness; as, the recency of a transaction, of a wound, etc.

infinitely.definition: Without bounds or limits; beyond or below assignable limits; as, an infinitely large or infinitely small quantity. 2. Very; exceedingly; vastly; highly; extremely. "Infinitely pleased." Dryden.

anaks.definition: A race of giants living in Palestine.

lienal.definition: Of or pertaining to the spleen; splenic.

livelihood.definition:
Subsistence or living, as dependent on some means of support; support of life; maintenance. The opportunities of gaining an honest livelihood. Addison. It is their profession and livelihood to get their living by practices for which they deserve to forfeit their lives. South.

Liveliness; appearance.

dishonorary.definition: Bringing dishonor on; tending to disgrace; lessening reputation. Holmes.

nuthook.definition: A hook at the end of a pole to pull down boughs for gathering the nuts. 2. A thief who steals by means of a hook; also, a bailiff who hooks or seizes malefactors. Shak.

forcipal.definition: Forked or branched like a pair of forceps; constructed so as to open and shut like a pair of forceps. Sir T. Browne.

plattdeutsch.definition: The modern dialects spoken in the north of Germany, taken collectively; modern Low German. See Low German, under German.

hoopoe.definition: A European bird of the genus Upupa (U. epops), having a beautiful crest, which it can erect or depress at pleasure. Called also hoop, whoop. The name is also applied to several other species of the same genus and allied genera.

flowery-kirtled.definition: Dressed with garlands of flowers. [Poetic & Rare] Milton.

upspurner.definition: A spurner or contemner; a despiser; a scoffer. Joye.

ciderkin.definition: A kind of weak cider made by steeping the refuse pomace in water. Ciderkin is made for common drinking, and supplies the place of small beer. Mortimer.

gastrocnemius.definition: The muscle which makes the greater part of the calf of the leg.

martineta.definition: A species of tinamou (Calopezus elegans), having a long slender crest.

cascade.definition:
A fall of water over a precipice, as in a river or brook; a waterfall less than a cataract. The silver brook . . . pours the white cascade. Longjellow. Now murm'ring soft, now roaring in cascade. Cawper.

1. To fall in a cascade. Lowell. 2. To vomit. [Slang] Smollett.

derain.definition: To prove or to refute by proof; to clear (one's self).

bion.definition: The physiological individual, characterized by definiteness and independence of function, in distinction from the morphological individual or morphon.

pustulation.definition: The act of producing pustules; the state of being pustulated.

reconcile.definition: To cause to be friendly again; to conciliate anew; to restore to friendship; to bring back to harmony; to cause to be no longer at variance; as, to reconcile persons who have quarreled. Propitious now and reconciled by prayer. Dryden. The church [if defiled] is interdicted till it be reconciled [i.e.

crescive.definition: Increasing; growing. Unseen, yet crescive in his faculty. Shak.

reillumine.definition: To illumine again or anew; to reillume.

vill.definition: A small collection of houses; a village. "Every manor, town, or vill." Sir M. Hale. Not should e'er the crested fowl From thorp or vill his matins sound for me. Wordsworth. Note: A word of various significations in English, law; as, a manor; a tithing; a town; a township; a parish; a part of a paris.

morphology.definition: That branch of biology which deals with the structure of animals and plants, treating of the forms of organs and describing their varieties, homologies, and metamorphoses. See Tectology, and Promorphology.

retortion.definition: Act of retorting or throwing back; reflection or turning back. [Written also retorsion.] It was, however, necessary to possess some single term expressive of this intellectual retortion. Sir W. Hamilton. 2. (Law)  Retaliation. Wharton.

decretive.definition: Having the force of a decree; determining. The will of God is either decretive or perceptive. Bates.

lammas.definition: The first day of August; -- called also Lammas day, and Lammastide.

water-bound.definition: Prevented by a flood from proceeding.

waterfowl.definition: Any bird that frequents the water, or lives about rivers, lakes, etc., or on or near the sea; an aquatic fowl; -- used also collectively. Note: Of aquatic fowls, some are waders, or furnished with long legs; others are swimmers, or furnished with webbed feet.

biding.definition: Residence; habitation. Rowe. BIELA'S COMET Bie"la's com"et. (Astron.)  A periodic coment, discovered by Biela in 1826, which revolves around the sun in 6.6 years. The November meteors (Andromedes or Bielids) move in its orbit, and may be fragments of the comet.

tomjohn.definition: A kind of open sedan used in Ceylon, carried by a single pole on men's shoulders.

septennial.definition: Lasting or continuing seven years; as, septennial parliaments. 2. Happening or returning once in every seven years; as, septennial elections in England.

assoilment.definition:
Act of assoiling, or state of being assoiled; absolution; acquittal.

A soiling; defilement.

thunderclap.definition: A sharp burst of thunder; a sudden report of a discharge of atmospheric electricity. "Thunderclaps that make them quake." Spenser. When suddenly the thunderclap was heard. Dryden.

cogman.definition: A dealer in cogware or coarse cloth. Wright.

leaseholder.definition: A tenant under a lease. -- Lease"hold`ing, a. & n.

multiplicity.definition: The quality of being multiple, manifold, or various; a state of being many; a multitude; as, a multiplicity of thoughts or objects. "A multiplicity of goods." South.

murrayin.definition: A glucoside found in the flowers of a plant (Murraya exotica) of South Asia, and extracted as a white amorphous slightly bitter substance.

farctate.definition: Stuffed; filled solid; as, a farctate leaf, stem, or pericarp; -- opposed to tubular or hollow.

noctidial.definition: Comprising a night and a day; a noctidial day. Holder.

outname.definition: To exceed in naming or describing. 2. To exceed in name, fame, or degree. And found out one to outname thy other faults. Beau. & Fl.

puffball.definition: A kind of ball-shaped fungus (Lycoperdon giganteum, and other species of the same genus) full of dustlike spores when ripe; -- called also bullfist, bullfice, puckfist, puff, and puffin.

dendroid.definition: Resembling a shrub or tree in form; treelike.

urostyle.definition: A styliform process forming the posterior extremity of the vertebral column in some fishes and amphibians.

vergeboard.definition: The ornament of woodwork upon the gable of a house, used extensively in the 15th century. It was generally suspended from the edge of the projecting roof (see Verge, n., 4), and in position parallel to the gable wall. Called also bargeboard.

kauri.definition: A lofty coniferous tree of New Zealand Agathis, or Dammara, australis), furnishing valuable timber and yielding one kind of dammar resin. [Written also kaudi, cowdie, and cowrie.].

whip-shaped.definition: Shaped like the lash of a whip; long, slender, round, and tapering; as, a whip-shaped root or stem.

croatian.definition: Of or pertaining to Croatia. -- n.  A Croat.

rhombic.definition: Shaped like a rhomb. 2. (Crystallog.)  Same as Orthorhombic.

banquetter.definition: One who banquets; one who feasts or makes feasts.

spaad.definition: A kind of spar; earth flax, or amianthus. oodward.

goral.definition: An Indian goat antelope (Nemorhedus goral), resembling the chamois.

strengthful.definition: Abounding in strength; full of strength; strong. -- Strength"ful*ness, n. Florence my friend, in court my faction Not meanly strengthful. Marston.

archiannelida.definition: A group of Annelida remarkable for having no external segments or distinct ventral nerve ganglions.

indistinction.definition: Want of distinction or distinguishableness; confusion; uncertainty; indiscrimination. The indistinction of many of the same name . . . hath made some doubt. Sir T. Browne. An indistinction of all persons, or equality of all orders, is far from being agreeable to the will of God. Sprat.

chitterling.definition: The frill to the breast of a shirt, which when ironed out resembled the small entrails. See Chitterlings. Gascoigne.

able-bodied.definition: Having a sound, strong body; physically competent; robust. "Able-bodied vagrant." Froude. -- A`ble-bod"ied*ness, n..

publican.definition: (Rom. Antiq.)  A farmer of the taxes and public revenues; hence, a collector of toll or tribute. The inferior officers of this class were often oppressive in their exactions, and were regarded with great detestation. As Jesus at meat . . . many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and hi.

hydromagnesite.definition: A hydrous carbonate of magnesia occurring in white, early, amorphous masses.

avoidance.definition: The act of annulling; annulment. 2. The act of becoming vacant, or the state of being vacant; -- specifically used for the state of a benefice becoming void by the death, deprivation, or resignation of the incumbent. Wolsey, . . . on every avoidance of St. Peter's chair, was sitting down therein, wh.

resistless.definition: Having no power to resist; making no opposition. [Obs. or R.] Spenser. 2. Incapable of being resisted; irresistible. Masters' commands come with a power resistless To such as owe them absolute subjection. Milton. -- Re*sist"less*ly, adv. -- Re*sist"less*ness, n.

diazeuctic.definition: Disjoining two fourths; as, the diazeutic tone, which, like that from F to G in modern music, lay between two fourths, and, being joined to either, made a fifth.

well-liking.definition: Being in good condition. [Obs. or Archaic] They also shall bring forth more fruit in their age, and shall be fat and well-liking. Bk. of Com. Prayer (Ps. xcii.).

pomology.definition: The science of fruits; a treatise on fruits; the cultivation of fruits and fruit trees.

damned.definition: Sentenced to punishment in a future state; condemned; consigned to perdition. 2. Hateful; detestable; abominable. But, O, what damned minutes tells he o'er Who doats, yet doubts, suspects, yet strongly loves. Shak.

prophylactic.definition:
A medicine which preserves or defends against disease; a preventive.

Defending or preserving from disease; preventive. Coxe.

sustaltic.definition: Mournful; -- said of a species of music among the ancient Greeks. Busby.

ostrea.definition: A genus of bivalve Mollusca which includes the true oysters.

silva.definition: (a) The forest trees of a region or country, considered collectively. (b) A description or history of the forest trees of a country.

mistressship.definition: Female rule or dominion. 2. Ladyship, a style of address; -- with the personal pronoun. Massinger.

trichoscolices.definition: An extensive group of wormlike animals characterized by being more or less covered with cilia.

sharptail.definition: (a) The pintail duck. (b) The pintail grouse, or prairie chicken.

dolomite.definition: A mineral consisting of the carbonate of lime and magnesia in varying proportions. It occurs in distinct crystals, and in extensive beds as a compact limestone, often crystalline granular, either white or clouded. It includes much of the common white marble. Also called bitter spar.

interdigital.definition: Between the fingers or toes; as, interdigital space.

waiter.definition: One who, or that which, waits; an attendant; a servant in attendance, esp. at table. The waiters stand in ranks; the yeomen cry, "Make room," as if a duke were passing by. Swift. 2. A vessel or tray on which something is carried, as dishes, etc.; a salver. Coast waiter. See under Coast, n.

indigitation.definition: The act of pointing out as with the finger; indication. Dr. H. More.

divinify.definition: To render divine; to deify. "Blessed and divinified soul." Parth. Sacra (1633).

codling.definition:
(a) An apple fit to stew or coddle. (b) An immature apple. A codling when 't is almost an apple. Shak. Codling moth (Zoöl.), a small moth (Carpocapsa Pomonella), which in the larval state (known as the apple worm) lives in apples, often doing great damage to the crop.

A young cod; also, a hake.

chesstree.definition: A piece of oak bolted perpendicularly on the side of a vessel, to aid in drawing down and securing the clew of the mainsail.

insectile.definition: Pertaining to, or having the nature of, insects. Bacon.

greeve.definition:
See Grieve, an overseer.

A manager of a farm, or overseer of any work; a reeve; a manorial bailiff. [Scot.] Their children were horsewhipped by the grieve. Sir W. Scott.

delph.definition:
Delftware. Five nothings in five plates of delph. Swift.

The drain on the land side of a sea embankment. Knight.

betrothment.definition: The act of betrothing, or the state of being betrothed; betrothal.

predestinate.definition:
Predestinated; foreordained; fated. "A predestinate scratched face." Shak.

To predetermine or foreordain; to appoint or ordain beforehand by an unchangeable purpose or decree; to preëlect. Whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son. Rom. viii. 29. Syn. --.

tarnisher.definition: One who, or that which, tarnishes.

soggy.definition: Filled with water; soft with moisture; sodden; soaked; wet; as, soggy land or timber.

parrotry.definition: Servile imitation or repetition. Coleridge. "The supine parrotry." Fitzed. Hall. PARROT'S-BILL Par"rot's-bill`, n. Etym: [So called from the resemblance of its curved superior petal to a parrot's bill.] (Bot.)  The glory pea. See under Glory.

countingroom.definition: The house or room in which a merchant, trader, or manufacturer keeps his books and transacts business.

haemocytotrypsis.definition: A breaking up of the blood corpuscles, as by pressure, in distinction from solution of the corpuscles, or hæmcytolysis.

gravidity.definition: The state of being gravidated; pregnancy.

to-rend.definition: To rend in pieces. The wolf hath many a sheep and lamb to-rent. Chaucer.

rot.definition: To undergo a process common to organic substances by which they lose the cohesion of their parts and pass through certain chemical changes, giving off usually in some stages of the process more or less offensive odors; to become decomposed by a natural process; to putrefy; to decay. Fixed like a pla.

antihemorrhagic.definition: Tending to stop hemorrhage. -- n.  A remedy for hemorrhage.

ingraft.definition: To insert, as a scion of one tree, shrub, or plant in another for propagation; as, to ingraft a peach scion on a plum tree; figuratively, to insert or introduce in such a way as to make a part of something. This fellow would ingraft a foreign name Upon our stock. Dryden. A custom . . . ingrafted int.

fusil.definition:
Capable of being melted or rendered fluid by heat; fusible. "A kind of fusil marble" Woodward. 2. Running or flowing, as a liquid. "A fusil sea." J. Philips. 3. Formed by melting and pouring into a mold; cast; founded. Milton.

A light kind of flintlock musket, formerly in use.

A bearing of a rhomb.

multiferous.definition: Bearing or producing much or many.

collum.definition: (Anat.)  A neck or cervix. Dunglison. 2. (Bot.)  Same as Collar. Gray.

millennialism.definition: Belief in, or expectation of, the millennium; millenarianism.

artilize.definition: To make resemble. If I was a philosopher, says Montaigne, I would naturalize art instead of artilizing nature. Bolingbroke.

specht.definition: A woodpecker. [Obs. or prov. Eng.] Sherwood.

quitch.definition: (Bot.)  Same as Quitch grass. 2. Figuratively: A vice; a taint; an evil. To pick the vicious quitch Of blood and custom wholly out of him. Tennyson .

academician.definition: A member of an academy, or society for promoting science, art, or literature, as of the French Academy, or the Royal Academy of arts. 2. A collegian. Chesterfield.

bafta.definition: A coarse stuff, usually of cotton, originally made in India. Also, an imitation of this fabric made for export.

beggar.definition:
One who begs; one who asks or entreats earnestly, or with humility; a petitioner. 2. One who makes it his business to ask alms. 3. One who is dependent upon others for support; -- a contemptuous or sarcastic use. 4. One who assumes in argument what he does not prove. Abp. Tillotson.

1. To reduce to.

benzosol.definition: Guaiacol benzoate, used as an intestinal antiseptic and as a substitute for creosote in phthisis. It is a colorless crystalline pewder.

irisated.definition: Exhibiting the prismatic colors; irised; iridescent. W. Phillips.

oppositeness.definition: The quality or state of being opposite.

sonorific.definition: Producing sound; as, the sonorific quality of a body. I. Watts.

countenancer.definition: One who countenances, favors, or supports.

monothelite.definition: One of an ancient sect who held that Christ had but one will as he had but one nature. Cf. Monophysite. Gibbon.

impenetrable.definition: Incapable of being penetrated or pierced; not admitting the passage of other bodies; not to be entered; impervious; as, an impenetrable shield. Highest woods impenetrable To star or sunlight. Milton. 2. (Physics)  Having the property of preventing any other substance from occupying the same space at.

cystolith.definition: (Bot.)  A concretion of mineral matter within a leaf or other part of a plant. 2. (Med.)  A urinary calculus.

zooemelanin.definition: A pigment giving the black color to the feathers of many birds.

encyclopedism.definition: The art of writing or compiling encyclopedias; also, possession of the whole range of knowledge; encyclopedic learning.

sandemanianism.definition: The faith or system of the Sandemanians. A. Fuller.

suasion.definition: The act of persuading; persuasion; as, moral suasion.

imping.definition: The act or process of grafting or mending. [Archaic] 2. (Falconry)  The process of repairing broken feathers or a deficient wing.

compensator.definition: One who, or that which, compensates; -- a name applied to various mechanical devices. 2. (Naut.)  An iron plate or magnet placed near the compass on iron vessels to neutralize the effect of the ship's attraction on the needle.

gammadion.definition: A cross formed of four capital gammas, formerly used as a mysterious ornament on ecclesiastical vestments, etc. See Fylfot.

plight.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Plight, to pledge. Chaucer.

imp. & p. p. of Pluck. Chaucer.

To weave; to braid; to fold; to plait. "To sew and plight." Chaucer. A plighted garment of divers colors. Milton.

A network; a plait; a fold; rarely a garment. "Many a folded plight." Spenser.

1. That which is exposed to.

sadden.definition: To make sad. Specifically: (a) To render heavy or cohesive. Marl is binding, and saddening of land is the great prejudice it doth to clay lands. Mortimer. (b) To make dull- or sad-colored, as cloth. (c) To make grave or serious; to make melancholy or sorrowful. Her gloomy presence saddens all the sc.

styrolene.definition: An unsaturated hydrocarbon, C8H8, obtained by the distillation of storax, by the decomposition of cinnamic acid, and by the condensation of acetylene, as a fragrant, aromatic, mobile liquid; -- called also phenyl ethylene, vinyl benzene, styrol, styrene, and cinnamene.

dimeter.definition: Having two poetical measures or meters. -- n.  A verse of two meters.

geyser.definition: A boiling spring which throws forth at frequent intervals jets of water, mud, etc., driven up by the expansive power of steam. Note: Geysers were first known in Iceland, and later in New Zealand. In the Yellowstone region in the United States they are numerous, and some of them very powerful, throwi.

redintegration.definition: Restoration to a whole or sound state; renewal; renovation. Dr. H. More. 2. (Chem.)  Restoration of a mixed body or matter to its former nature and state. [Achaic.] Coxe. 3. (Psychology)  The law that objects which have been previously combined as part of a single mental state tend to recall or sugg.

eunuch.definition:
A male of the human species castrated; commonly, one of a class of such persons, in Oriental countries, having charge of the women's apartments. Some of them, in former times, gained high official rank.

To make a eunuch of; to castrate. as a man. Creech. Sir. T. Browne.

thereabouts.definition: Near that place. 2. Near that number, degree, or quantity; nearly; as, ten men, or thereabouts. Five or six thousand horse . . . or thereabouts. Shak. Some three months since, or thereabout. Suckling. 3. Concerning that; about that. What will ye dine I will go thereabout. Chaucer. They were much per.

undercurrent.definition: A current below the surface of water, sometimes flowing in a contrary direction to that on the surface. Totten. 2. Hence, figuratively, a tendency of feeling, opinion, or the like, in a direction contrary to what is publicly shown; an unseen influence or tendency; as, a strong undercurrent of sentim.

plurilocular.definition: Having several cells or loculi; specifically (Bot.),  having several divisions containing seeds; as, the lemon and the orange are plurilocular fruits. Plurilocular sporangia (Bot.), many-celled sporangia, each cell containing a single spore, as in many algæ.

knacker.definition:
One who makes knickknacks, toys, etc. Mortimer. 2. One of two or more pieces of bone or wood held loosely between the fingers, and struck together by moving the hand; -- called also clapper. Halliwell.

1. a harness maker. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Halliwell. 2. One who slaughters worn-out horses and sel.

illude.definition: To play upon by artifice; to deceive; to mock; to excite and disappoint the hopes of.

graphite.definition: Native carbon in hexagonal crystals, also foliated or granular massive, of black color and metallic luster, and so soft as to leave a trace on paper. It is used for pencils (improperly called lead pencils), for crucibles, and as a lubricator, etc. Often called plumbago or black lead. Graphite batter.

indisposedness.definition: The condition or quality of being indisposed. Bp. Hall.

teleostean.definition: Of or pertaining to the teleosts. -- n.  A teleostean fish.

deadworks.definition: The parts of a ship above the water when she is laden.

rache.definition: A dog that pursued his prey by scent, as distinguished from the greyhound.

transfusible.definition: Capable of being transfused; transferable by transfusion.

verisimilitude.definition: The quality or state of being verisimilar; the appearance of truth; probability; likelihood. Verisimilitude and opinion are an easy purchase; but true knowledge is dear and difficult. Glanvill. All that gives verisimilitude to a narrative. Sir. W. Scott.

astigmatism.definition: A defect of the eye or of a lens, in consequence of which the rays derived from one point are not brought to a single focal point, thus causing imperfect images or indistictness of vision. Note: The term is applied especially to the defect causing images of lines having a certain direction to be ind.

cyclical.definition: Of or pertaining to a cycle or circle; moving in cycles; as, cyclical time. Coleridge. Cyclic chorus, the chorus which performed the songs and dances of the dithyrambic odes at Athens, dancing round the altar of Bacchus in a circle. -- Cyclic poets, certain epic poets who followed Homer, and wrote m.

noonday.definition:
Midday; twelve o'clock in the day; noon.

Of or pertaining to midday; meridional; as, the noonday heat. "Noonday walks." Addison.

riotry.definition: The act or practice of rioting; riot. "Electioneering riotry." Walpole.

piston.definition: A sliding piece which either is moved by, or moves against, fluid pressure. It usually consists of a short cylinder fitting within a cylindrical vessel along which it moves, back and forth. It is used in steam engines to receive motion from the steam, and in pumps to transmit motion to a fluid; also.

cataphractic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or resembling, a cataphract.

diametrically.definition: In a diametrical manner; directly; as, diametrically opposite. Whose principles were diametrically opposed to his. Macaulay.

hockday.definition: A holiday commemorating the expulsion of the Danes, formerly observed on the second Tuesday after Easter; -- called also hocktide. [Eng.] [Written also hokeday.].

transgressive.definition: Disposed or tending to transgress; faulty; culpable. -.

looper.definition: An instrument, as a bodkin, for forming a loop in yarn, a cord, etc. 2. (Zoöl.)  The larva of any species of geometrid moths. See Geometrid.

cateran.definition: A Highland robber: a kind of irregular soldier. [Scot.] Sir W. Scott.

westering.definition: Passing to the west. Toward heaven's descent had sloped his westering wheel. Milton.

aggroup.definition: To bring together in a group; to group. Dryden.

triclinium.definition: (a) A couch for reclining at meals, extending round three sides of a table, and usually in three parts. (b) A dining room furnished with such a triple couch.

uphasp.definition: To hasp or faster up; to close; as, sleep uphasps the eyes. Stanyhurst.
