tempting.definition: Adapted to entice or allure; attractive; alluring; seductive; enticing; as, tempting pleasures. -- Tempt"ing*ly, adv. -- Tempt"ing*ness, n.

plane-parallel.definition: Having opposite surfaces exactly plane and parallel, as a piece of glass.

tenne.definition: A tincture, rarely employed, which is considered as an orange color or bright brown. It is represented by diagonal lines from sinister to dexter, crossed by vertical lines.

distention.definition: The act of distending; the act of stretching in breadth or in all directions; the state of being Distended; as, the distention of the lungs. 2. Breadth; extent or space occupied by the thing distended.

daysman.definition: An umpire or arbiter; a mediator. Neither is there any daysman betwixt us. Job ix. 33.

inviolated.definition: Not violated; uninjured; unhurt; unbroken. His fortune of arms was still inviolate. Bacon. 2. Not corrupted, defiled, or profaned; chaste; pure. "Inviolate truth." Denham. There chaste Alceste lives inviolate. Spenser.

missingly.definition: With a sense of loss. Shak.

pattypan.definition: A pan for baking patties. 2. A patty.

overstate.definition: To state in too strong terms; to exaggerate. Fuller.

redif.definition: A reserve force in the Turkish army, or a soldier of the reserve. See Army organization, above.

fumade.definition: A salted and smoked fish, as the pilchard.

tenrec.definition: A small insectivore (Centetes ecaudatus), native of Madagascar, but introduced also into the islands of Bourbon and Mauritius; -- called also tanrec. The name is applied to other allied genera. See Tendrac.

munificent.definition: Very liberal in giving or bestowing; lavish; as, a munificent benefactor. -- Mu*nif"i*cent*ly, adv. Syn. -- Bounteous; bountiful; liberal; generous.

preexist.definition: To exist previously; to exist before something else.

malaxation.definition: The act of softening by mixing with a thinner substance; the formation of ingredients into a mass for pills or plasters.

germicide.definition: Destructive to germs; -- applied to any agent which has a destructive action upon living germs, particularly bacteria, or bacterial germs, which are considered the cause of many infectious diseases. -- n.  A germicide agent.

mesmerist.definition: One who practices, or believes in, mesmerism.

promerit.definition: To oblige; to confer a favor on. Bp. Hall. 2. To deserve; to procure by merit. Davenant.

concessionaire.definition: The beneficiary of a concession or grant.

intensation.definition: The act or process of intensifying; intensification; climax. Carlyle.

faille.definition: A soft silk, heavier than a foulard and not glossy.

windlestrae.definition: A grass used for making ropes or for plaiting, esp. Agrostis Spica-ventis. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Shelley.

hetaera.definition: A female paramour; a mistress, concubine, or harlot. -- He*tæ"ric, He*tai"ric (#), a.

nether.definition: Situated down or below; lying beneath, or in the lower part; having a lower position; belonging to the region below; lower; under; -- opposed to upper. 'Twixt upper, nether, and surrounding fires. Milton. This darksome nether world her light Doth dim with horror and deformity. Spenser. All my nether.

gigantesque.definition: Befitting a giant; bombastic; magniloquent. The sort of mock-heroic gigantesque With which we bantered little Lilia first. Tennyson.

foreleader.definition: One who leads others by his example; aguide.

praeoral.definition: Same as Preoral, Prepubis, Prescapula, etc.

madrilenian.definition: Of or pertaining to Madrid in Spain, or to its inhabitants. -- n.  A native or inhabitant of Madrid.

cavilous.definition: Characterized by caviling, or disposed to cavil; quibbing. -- Cav"il*ous*ly, adv. -- Cav"il*ous*ness, n.

assaulter.definition: One who assaults, or violently attacks; an assailant. E. Hall.

laocoon.definition: (Class. Myth.)  A priest of Apollo, during the Trojan war. (See 2.) 2. (Sculp.)  A marble group in the Vatican at Rome, representing the priest Laocoön, with his sons, infolded in the coils of two serpents, as described by Virgil.

hydrargyrism.definition: A diseased condition produced by poisoning with hydrargyrum, or mercury; mercurialism.

casing.definition: The act or process of inclosing in, or covering with, a case or thin substance, as plaster, boards, etc. 2. An outside covering, for protection or ornament, or to precent the radiation of heat. 3. An inclosing frame; esp. the framework around a door or a window. See Case, n., 4.

epicranium.definition: (Anat.)  The upper and superficial part of the head, including the scalp, muscles, etc. 2. (Zoöl.)  The dorsal wall of the head of insects.

stearic.definition: Pertaining to, or obtained from, stearin or tallow; resembling tallow. Stearic acid (Chem.), a monobasic fatty acid, obtained in the form of white crystalline scales, soluble in alcohol and ether. It melts to an oily liquid at 69°C.C18H36O2, CH3.(CH2)16.COOH; sodium stearate, with sodium palmitate,.

rubidium.definition: A rare metallic element. It occurs quite widely, but in small quantities, and always combined. It is isolated as a soft yellowish white metal, analogous to potassium in most of its properties. Symbol Rb. Atomic weight, 85.2.

contra.definition: A Latin adverb and preposition, signifying against, contrary, in opposition, etc., entering as a prefix into the composition of many English words. Cf. Counter, adv. & pref.

chronometer.definition: An instrument for measuring time; a timekeeper. 2. A portable timekeeper, with a heavy compensation balance, and usually beating half seconds; -- intended to keep time with great accuracy for use an astronomical observations, in determining longitude, etc. 3. (Mus.)  A metronome. Box chronometer. Se.

catalepsis.definition: A sudden suspension of sensation and volition, the body and limbs preserving the position that may be given them, while the action of the heart and lungs continues.

unhoused.definition: Etym: [Properly p. p. of unhouse.]  Driven from a house; deprived of shelter. 2. Etym: [Pref. un- + housed.]  Not provided with a house or shelter; houseless; homeless.

magazining.definition: The act of editing, or writing for, a magazine. Byron.

weregild.definition: The price of a man's head; a compensation paid of a man killed, partly to the king for the loss of a subject, partly to the lord of a vassal, and partly to the next of kin. It was paid by the murderer. [Written also weregeld, weregelt, etc.] Blackstone.

bituminous.definition: Having the qualities of bitumen; compounded with bitumen; containing bitumen. Near that bituminous lake where Sodom flamed. Milton. Bituminous coal, a kind of coal which yields, when heated, a considerable amount of volatile bituminous matter. It burns with a yellow smoky flame. -- Bituminous limest.

samarskite.definition: A rare mineral having a velvet-black color and submetallic luster. It is a niobate of uranium, iron, and the yttrium and cerium metals.

corrodent.definition:
Corrosive. Bp. King.

Anything that corrodes. Bp. King.

lizard.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of the numerous species of reptiles belonging to the order Lacertilia; sometimes, also applied to reptiles of other orders, as the Hatteria. Note: Most lizards have an elongated body, with four legs, and a long tail; but there are some without legs, and some with a short, thick tail.

ichthyomorphic.definition: Fish-shaped; as, the ichthyomorphic idols of ancient Assyria.

stellate.definition: Resembling a star; pointed or radiated, like the emblem of a star. 2. (Bot.)  Starlike; having similar parts radiating from a common center; as, stellate flowers.

vasodilator.definition: Causing dilation or relaxation of the blood vessels; as, the vasodilator nerves, stimulation of which causes dilation of the blood vessels to which they go. These nerves are also called vaso- inhibitory, and vasohypotonic nerves, since their stimulation causes relaxation and rest.

insusceptibility.definition: Want of susceptibility, or of capacity to feel or perceive.

nomadic.definition: Of or pertaining to nomads, or their way of life; wandering; moving from place to place for subsistence; as, a nomadic tribe. -- No*mad"ic*al*ly, adv.

interarboration.definition: The interweaving of branches of trees. Sir T. Browne.

collodion.definition: A solution of pyroxylin (soluble gun cotton) in ether containing a varying proportion of alcohol. It is strongly adhesive, and is used by surgeons as a containing for wounds; but its chief application is as a vehicle for the sensitive film in photography. Collodion process (Photog.), a process in wh.

peytrel.definition: The breastplate of a horse's armor or harness. [Spelt also peitrel.] See Poitrel. Chaucer.

execratory.definition: Of the nature of execration; imprecatory; denunciatory. C. Kingsley. -- n.  A formulary of execrations. L. Addison.

saymaster.definition: A master of assay; one who tries or proves. "Great saymaster of state." D. Jonson.

jetsam.definition: (Mar. Law)  Goods which sink when cast into the sea, and remain under water; -- distinguished from flotsam, goods which float, and ligan, goods which are sunk attached to a buoy. 2. Jettison. See Jettison, 1.

rootery.definition: A pile of roots, set with plants, mosses, etc., and used as an ornamental object in gardening.

hendiadys.definition: A figure in which the idea is expressed by two nouns connected by and, instead of by a noun and limiting adjective; as, we drink from cups and gold, for golden cups.

putridity.definition: The quality of being putrid; putrefaction; rottenness.

discontinuor.definition: One who deprives another of the possession of an estate by discontinuance. See Discontinuance, 2.

loathing.definition: Extreme disgust; a feeling of aversion, nausea, abhorrence, or detestation. The mutual fear and loathing of the hostile races. Macaulay.

hatband.definition: A band round the crown of a hat; sometimes, a band of black cloth, crape, etc., worn as a badge of mourning.

ammunition.definition: Military stores, or provisions of all kinds for attack or defense. 2. Articles used in charging firearms and ordnance of all kinds; as powder, balls, shot, shells, percussion caps, rockets, etc. 3. Any stock of missiles, literal or figurative. Ammunition bread, shoes, etc., such as are contracted fo.

academism.definition: The doctrines of the Academic philosophy. Baxter.

carbonometer.definition: An instrument for detecting and measuring the amount of carbon which is present, or more esp. the amount of carbon dioxide, by its action on limewater or by other means.

demicircle.definition: An instrument for measuring angles, in surveying, etc. It resembles.

pyrgom.definition: A variety of pyroxene; -- called also fassaite.

cnidoblast.definition: One of the cells which, in the Coelenterata, develop into cnidæ.

fash.definition:
To vex; to tease; to trouble. [Scot.]

Vexation; anxiety; care. [Scot.] Without further fash on my part. De Quincey.

haloid.definition: Resembling salt; -- said of certain binary compounds consisting of a metal united to a negative element or radical, and now chiefly applied to the chlorides, bromides, iodides, and sometimes also to the fluorides and cyanides. -- n.  A haloid substance.

discalced.definition: Unshod; barefooted; -- in distinction from calced. "The foundation of houses of discalced friars." Cardinal Manning's St. Teresa.

incommutable.definition: Not commutable; not capable of being exchanged with, or substituted for, another. Cudworth. -- In`com*mut"a*ble*ness, n. -- In`com*mut"a*bly, adv.

glyphic.definition: Of or pertaining to sculpture or carving of any sort, esp. to glyphs.

curled.definition: Having curls; curly; sinuous; wavy; as, curled maple (maple having fibers which take a sinnuous course). Curled hair (Com.), the hair of the manes and tails of horses, prepared for upholstery purposes. McElrath.

undispensable.definition: Indispensable. 2. Unavoidable; inevitable. Fuller. 3. Not to be freed by dispensation.

bubo.definition: An inflammation, with enlargement, of a limphatic gland, esp. in the groin, as in syphilis.

saracenic.definition: Of or pertaining to the Saracens; as, Saracenic architecture. "Saracenic music." Sir W. Scott.

springlet.definition: A little spring. But yet from out the little hill Oozes the slender springlet still. Sir W. Scott.

torula.definition: (a) A chain of special bacteria. (b) A genus of budding fungi. Same as Saccharomyces. Also used adjectively.

asiatic.definition: Of or pertaining to Asia or to its inhabitants. -- n.  A native, or one of the people, of Asia.

foreadvise.definition: To advise or counsel before the time of action, or before the event. Shak.

caudated.definition: Having a taill; having a termination like a tail.

abator.definition: (a) One who abates a nuisance. (b) A person who, without right, enters into a freehold on the death of the last possessor, before the heir or devisee. Blackstone.

iwis.definition: Indeed; truly. See Ywis. [Written also iwys, iwisse, etc.] Ascham. I. W. W. I. W. W. (Abbrev.)  Industrial Workers of the World (the name of two American labor organizations, one of which advocates syndicalism).

utricularia.definition: A genus of aquatic flowering plants, in which the submersed leaves bear many little utricles, or ascidia. See Ascidium,.

insincerity.definition: The quality of being insincere; want of sincerity, or of being in reality what one appears to be; dissimulation; hypocritical; deceitfulness; hollowness; untrustworthiness; as, the insincerity of a professed friend; the insincerity of professions of regard. What men call policy and knowledge of the.

disheveled.definition: Having in loose disorder; disarranged; as, disheveled hair. 2. Having the hair in loose disorder. The dancing maidens are disheveled Mænads. J. A. Symonds.

pragmatism.definition: The quality or state of being pragmatic; in literature, the pragmatic, or philosophical, method. The narration of this apparently trifling circumstance belongs to the pragmatism of the history. A. Murphy.

tergiversator.definition: One who tergiversates; one who suffles, or practices evasion.

traverser.definition: One who, or that which, traverses, or moves, as an index on a scale, and the like. 2. (Law)  One who traverses, or denies. 3. (Railroad)  A traverse table. See under Traverse, n.

unship.definition: To take out of a ship or vessel; as, to unship goods. 2. (Naut.)  To remove or detach, as any part or implement, from its proper position or connection when in use; as, to unship an oar; to unship capstan bars; to unship the tiller.

bequest.definition:
The act of bequeathing or leaving by will; as, a bequest of property by A. to B. 2. That which is left by will, esp. personal property; a legacy; also, a gift.

To bequeath, or leave as a legacy. "All I have to bequest." Gascoigne.

plucky.definition: Having pluck or courage; characterized by pluck; displaying pluck; courageous; spirited; as, a plucky race. If you're plucky, and not over subject to fright. Barham.

frogbit.definition: (a) A European plant (Hydrocharis Morsus-ranæ), floating on still water and propagating itself by runners. It has roundish leaves and small white flowers. (b) An American plant (Limnobium Spongia), with similar habits.

plaited.definition: Folded; doubled over; braided; figuratively, involved; intricate; artful. Time shall unfold what plaited cunning hides. Shak.

metasternum.definition: (Anat.)  The most posterior element of the sternum; the ensiform process; xiphisternum. 2. (Zoöl.)  The ventral plate of the third or last segment of the thorax of insects.

coulisse.definition: A piece of timber having a groove in which something glides. 2. One of the side scenes of the stage in a theater, or the space included between the side scenes.

poco.definition: A little; -- used chiefly in phrases indicating the time or movement; as, poco più allegro, a little faster; poco largo, rather slow. Poco a poco Etym: [It.] (Mus.) Little by little; as, poco a poco crescendo, gradually increasing in loudness.

mauger.definition: In spite of; in opposition to; notwithstanding. A man must needs love maugre his heed. Chaucer. This mauger all the world will I keep safe. Shak.

regress.definition:
The act of passing back; passage back; return; retrogression. "The progress or regress of man". F. Harrison. 2. The power or liberty of passing back. Shak.

To go back; to return to a former place or state. Sir T. Browne.

sickliness.definition: The quality or state of being sickly.

alterant.definition:
Altering; gradually changing. Bacon.

An alterative. Chambers.

torved.definition: Stern; grim. See Torvous. But yesterday his breath Awed Rome, and his least torved frown was death. J. Webster (1654).

fossorious.definition: Adapted for digging; -- said of the legs of certain insects.

jolt.definition:
To shake with short, abrupt risings and fallings, as a carriage moving on rough ground; as, the coach jolts.

To cause to shake with a sudden up and down motion, as in a carriage going over rough ground, or on a high-trotting horse; as, the horse jolts the rider; fast driving jolts the carriage and.

floriation.definition: Ornamentation by means of flower forms, whether closely imitated or conventionalized. 2. Any floral ornament or decoration. Rock.

vitrella.definition: One of the transparent lenslike cells in the ocelli of certain arthropods.

swish.definition:
To flourish, so as to make the sound swish. Coleridge. 2. To flog; to lash. [Slang] Thackeray.

To dash; to swash.

1. A sound of quick movement, as of something whirled through the air. 2. (Naut.)  Light driven spray. [Eng.].

geranine.definition: (Med.)  A valuable astringet obtained from the root of the Geranium maculatum or crane's-bill. 2. (Chem.)  A liquid terpene, obtained from the crane's-bill (Geranium maculatum), and having a peculiar mulberry odor. [Written also geranium.].

wifelike.definition: Of, pertaining to, or like, a wife or a woman. " Wifelike government." Shak.

immanation.definition: A flowing or entering in; -- opposed to emanation. Good.

iowas.definition: ; sing. Iowa. (Ethnol.) A tribe of Indians which formerly occupied the region now included in the State of Iowa.

geniting.definition: A species of apple that ripens very early. Bacon.

elucidate.definition: To make clear or manifest; to render more intelligible; to illustrate; as, an example will elucidate the subject.

sharpen.definition: To make sharp. Specifically: (a) To give a keen edge or fine point to; to make sharper; as, to sharpen an ax, or the teeth of a saw. (b) To render more quick or acute in perception; to make more ready or ingenious. The air . . . sharpened his visual ray To objects distant far. Milton. He that wrestl.

eyebar.definition: A bar with an eye at one or both ends.

shivery.definition: Tremulous; shivering. Mallet. 2. Easily broken; brittle; shattery.

indetermination.definition: Want of determination; an unsettled or wavering state, as of the mind. Jer. Taylor. 2. Want of fixed or stated direction. Abp. Bramhall.

nonsonant.definition: Not sonant. -- n.  A nonsonant or nonvocal consonant.

papillose.definition: Covered with, or bearing, papillæ; resembling papillæ; papillate; papillar; papillary.

gallnut.definition: A round gall produced on the leaves and shoots of various species of the oak tree. See Gall, and Nutgall.

chirrup.definition:
To quicken or animate by chirping; to cherup.

To chirp. Tennyson. The criket chirrups on the hearth. Goldsmith.

The act of chirping; a chirp. The sparrows' chirrup on the roof. Tennyson.

cross-fertilize.definition: To fertilize, as the stigmas of a flower or plant, with the pollen from another individual of the  same species.

buffeter.definition: One who buffets; a boxer. Jonson.

cropful.definition: Having a full crop or belly; satiated. Milton.

feathering.definition: (Arch.)  Same as Foliation. 2. The act of turning the blade of the oar, as it rises from the water in rowing, from a vertical to a horizontal position. See To feather an oar, under Feather, v. t. 3. A covering of feathers. Feathering float (Naut.), the float or paddle of a feathering wheel. -- Feath.

overlap.definition:
To lap over; to lap.

1. The lapping of one thing over another; as, an overlap of six inches; an overlap of a slate on a roof. 2. (Geol.)  An extension of geological beds above and beyond others, as in a conformable series of beds, when the upper beds extend over a wider space than the lower, either.

subtiliate.definition: To make thin or rare. Harvey. -- Sub`til*i*a"tion, n. Boyle.

catoptrical.definition: Of or pertaining to catoptrics; produced by reflection. Catoptric light, a light in which the rays are concentrated by reflectors into a beam visible at a distance.

perissodactyla.definition: A division of ungulate mammals, including those that have an odd number of toes, as the horse, tapir, and rhinoceros; -- opposed to Artiodactyla.

hartbeest.definition: A large South African antelope (Alcelaphus caama), formerly much more abundant than it is now. The face and legs are marked with black, the rump with white. [Written also hartebeest, and hartebest.].

hilding.definition: A base, menial wretch. -- a.  Base; spiritless. Shak.

revoluble.definition: Capable of revolving; rotatory; revolving. Us, then, to whom the thrice three year Hath filled his revoluble orb since our arrival here, I blame not. Chapman.

impunibly.definition: Without punishment; with impunity. J. Ellis.

amontillado.definition: A dry kind of cherry, of a light color. Simmonds.

substitutional.definition: Of or pertaining to substitution; standing in the place of another; substituted. -- Sub`sti*tu"tion*al*ly, adv.

cannele.definition: A style of interweaving giving to fabrics a channeled or fluted effect; also, a fabric woven so as to have this effect; a rep.

infrabranchial.definition: Below the gills; -- applied to the ventral portion of the pallial chamber in the lamellibranchs.

lectual.definition: Confining to the bed; as, a lectual disease.

spate.definition: A river flood; an overflow or inundation. Burns. Gareth in a showerful spring Stared at the spate. Tennyson.

imbibe.definition: To drink in; to absorb; to suck or take in; to receive as by drinking; as, a person imbibes drink, or a sponge imbibes moisture. 2. To receive or absorb into the mind and retain; as, to imbibe principles; to imbibe errors. 3. To saturate; to imbue. "Earth, imbibed with . . . acid." Sir I. Newton.

aurum.definition: Gold. Aurum fulminans (See Fulminate. -- Aurum mosaicum (See Mosaic.

irp.definition:
A fantastic grimace or contortion of the body. Smirks and irps and all affected humors. B. Jonson .

Making irps. B. Jonson.

laureate.definition: Crowned, or decked, with laurel. Chaucer. To strew the laureate hearse where Lycid lies. Milton. Soft on her lap her laureate son reclines. Pope. Poet laureate. (b) One who received an honorable degree in grammar, including poetry and rhetoric, at the English universities; -- so called as being pres.

scrod.definition: A young codfish, especially when cut open on the back and dressed. [Written also escrod.] [Local, U.S.].

barbarize.definition:
To become barbarous. The Roman empire was barbarizing rapidly from the time of Trajan. De Quincey. 2. To adopt a foreign or barbarous mode of speech. The ill habit . . . of wretched barbarizing against the Latin and Greek idiom, with their untutored Anglicisms. Milton.

To make barbarous. The hideou.

oarsman.definition: One who uses, or is skilled in the use of, an oar; a rower. At the prow of the boat, rose one of the oarsmen. Longfellow.

contingently.definition: In a contingent manner; without design or foresight; accidentally.

pernoctalian.definition: One who watches or keeps awake all night.

capsheaf.definition: The top sheaf of a stack of grain: (fig.) the crowning or finishing part of a thing.

otorrhea.definition: A flow or running from the ear, esp. a purulent discharge.

adunque.definition: Hooked; as, a parrot has an adunc bill.

unruly.definition: Not submissive to rule; disregarding restraint; disposed to violate; turbulent; ungovernable; refractory; as, an unruly boy; unruly boy; unruly conduct. But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison. James iii. 8.

intrusive.definition: Apt to intrude; characterized by intrusion; entering without right or welcome. Intrusive rocks (Geol.), rocks which have been forced, while in a plastic or melted state, into the cavities or between the cracks or layers of other rocks. The term is sometimes used as equivalent to plutonic rocks. It i.

cylindraceous.definition: Cylindrical, or approaching a cylindrical form.

gymnasiarch.definition: An Athenian officer who superintended the gymnasia, and provided the oil and other necessaries at his own expense.

make-game.definition: An object of ridicule; a butt. Godwin.

sasse.definition: A sluice or lock, as in a river, to make it more navigable. Pepys.

approbatory.definition: Containing or expressing approbation; commendatory. Sheldon.

phyllous.definition: Homologous with a leaf; as, the sepals, petals, stamens, and pistils are phyllous organs.

spawn.definition:
To produce or deposit (eggs), as fishes or frogs do. 2. To bring forth; to generate; -- used in contempt. One edition [of books] spawneth another. Fuller.

1. To deposit eggs, as fish or frogs do. 2. To issue, as offspring; -- used contemptuously.

1. The ova, or eggs, of fishes, oysters, and other.

mohicans.definition: A tribe of Lenni-Lenape Indians who formerly inhabited Western Connecticut and Eastern New York. [Written also Mohegans.].

cablegram.definition: A message sent by a submarine telegraphic cable. Note: [A recent hybrid, sometimes found in the newspapers.].

plurifarious.definition: Of many kinds or fashions; multifarious.

bluestocking.definition: A literary lady; a female pedant. Note: As explained in Boswell's "Life of Dr. Johnson", this term is derived from the name given to certain meetings held by ladies, in Johnson's time, for conversation with distinguished literary men. An eminent attendant of these assemblies was a Mr. Stillingfleet,.

madjoun.definition: An intoxicating confection from the hemp plant; -- used by the Turks and Hindoos. [Written also majoun.].

selenium.definition: A nonmetallic element of the sulphur group, and analogous to sulphur in its compounds. It is found in small quantities with sulphur and some sulphur ores, and obtained in the free state as a dark reddish powder or crystalline mass, or as a dark metallic- looking substance. It exhibits under the acti.

quartering.definition:
(Naut.)  Coming from a point well abaft the beam, but not directly astern; -- said of waves or any moving object. 2. (Mach.)  At right angles, as the cranks of a locomotive, which are in planes forming a right angle with each other.

1. A station. Bp. Montagu. 2. Assignment of quarters for soldiers;.

viripotent.definition: Developed in manhood; hence, able to beget; marriageable. Being not of ripe years, not viripotent. Holinshed.

phenanthroline.definition: Either of two metameric nitrogenous hydrocarbon bases, C12H8N2, analogous to phenanthridine, but more highly nitrogenized.

nowthe.definition:
Just now; at present. But thereof needeth not to speak as nouthe. Chaucer.

See Nouthe. Chaucer.

somite.definition: One of the actual or ideal serial segments of which an animal, esp. an articulate or vertebrate, is composed; somatome; metamere. -- So*mit`ic, a.

remissible.definition: Capable of being remitted or forgiven. Feltham.

obstructionism.definition: The act or the policy of obstructing progress. Lond. Lit. World.

neologize.definition: To introduce or use new words or terms or new uses of old words. 2. To introduce innovations in doctrine, esp. in theological doctrine.

peery.definition: Inquisitive; suspicious; sharp. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] "Two peery gray eyes." Sir W. Scott.

indicatrix.definition: A certain conic section supposed to be drawn in the tangent plane to any surface, and used to determine the accidents of curvature of the surface at the point of contact. The curve is similar to the intersection of the surface with a parallel to the tangent plane and indefinitely near it. It is an e.

phlogistic.definition: (Old Chem.)  Of or pertaining to phlogiston, or to belief in its existence. 2. (Med.)  Inflammatory; belonging to inflammations and fevers.

hasten.definition:
To press; to drive or urge forward; to push on; to precipitate; to accelerate the movement of; to expedite; to hurry. I would hasten my escape from the windy storm. Ps. lv. 8.

To move celerity; to be rapid in motion; to act speedily or quickly; to go quickly. I hastened to the spot whence the noise.

tangibility.definition: The quality or state of being tangible.

zufolo.definition: A little flute or flageolet, especially that which is used to teach birds. [Written also zuffolo.].

barleycorn.definition: A grain or "corn" of barley. 2. Formerly , a measure of length, equal to the average length of a grain of barley; the third part of an inch. John Barleycorn, a humorous personification of barley as the source of malt liquor or whisky.

sketchbook.definition: A book of sketches or for sketches.

grisliness.definition: The quality or state of being grisly; horrid. Sir P. Sidney.

chaffwax.definition: Formerly a chancery officer who fitted wax for sealing writs and other documents.

parenthood.definition: The state of a parent; the office or character of a parent.

dedication.definition: The act of setting apart or consecrating to a divine Being, or to a sacred use, often with religious solemnities; solemn appropriation; as, the dedication of Solomon's temple. 2. A devoting or setting aside for any particular purpose; as, a dedication of lands to public use. 3. An address to a patro.

foolhardy.definition: Daring without judgment; foolishly adventurous and bold. Howell. Syn. -- Rash; venturesome; venturous; precipitate; reckless; headlong; incautious. See Rash.

apposed.definition: Placed in apposition; mutually fitting, as the mandibles of a bird's beak.

fulminating.definition: Thundering; exploding in a peculiarly sudden or violent manner. 2. Hurling denunciations, menaces, or censures. Fulminating oil, nitroglycerin. -- Fulminating powder (Chem.) any violently explosive powder, but especially one of the fulminates, as mercuric fulminate.

dynamiter.definition: One who uses dynamite; esp., one who uses it for the destruction of life and property.

pensioner.definition: One in receipt of a pension; hence, figuratively, a dependent. The fickle pensioners of Morpheus' train. Milton. Old pensioners . . . of Chelsea Hospital. Macaulay. 2. One of an honorable band of gentlemen who attend the sovereign of England on state occasions, and receive an annual pension, or allo.

ligation.definition: The act of binding, or the state of being bound. 2. That which binds; bond; connection. Tied with tape, and sealed at each fold and ligation. Sir W. Scott.

peruvian.definition: Of or pertaining to Peru, in South America. -- n.  A native or an inhabitant of Peru. Peruvian balsam. See Balsam of Peru, under Balsam. -- Peruvian bark, the bitter bark of trees of various species of Cinchona. It acts as a powerful tonic, and is a remedy for malarial diseases. This property is due.

photochronography.definition: Art of recording or measuring intervals of time by the photochronograph. -- Pho`to*chron`o*graph"ic (#), -graph"ic*al (#), a. -- -graph"ic*al*ly, adv.

reng.definition: A rank; a row. "In two renges fair." Chaucer. 2. A rung or round of a ladder. Chaucer.

struma.definition: (Med.)  Scrofula. 2. (Bot.)  A cushionlike swelling on any organ; especially, that at the base of the capsule in many mosses.

corradial.definition: Radiating to or from the same point. Coleridge.

liberator.definition: One who, or that which, liberates; a deliverer.

multiphase.definition: Having many phases; specif. (Elec.),  pertaining to, or designating, a generator producing, or any system conveying or utilizing, two or more waves of pressure, or electromotive force, not in phase with each other; polyphase.

proliferous.definition: (Bot.)  Bearing offspring; -- applied to a flower from within which another is produced, or to a branch or frond from which another rises, or to a plant which is reproduced by buds or gemmæ. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) Producing young by budding. (b) Producing sexual zooids by budding; -- said of the blastostyle.

wierangle.definition: Same as Wariangle. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.].

narrower.definition: One who, or that which, narrows or contracts. Hannah More.

hexacid.definition: Having six atoms or radicals capable of being replaced by acids; hexatomic; hexavalent; -- said of bases; as, mannite is a hexacid base.

spermatogenetic.definition: Relating to, or connected with, spermatogenesis; as, spermatogenetic function.

anhelation.definition: Short and rapid breathing; a panting; asthma. Glanvill.

baenomere.definition: One of the somites (arthromeres) that make up the thorax of Arthropods. Packard.

multidentate.definition: Having many teeth, or toothlike processes.

laker.definition: (a) One of the poets of the Lake school. See Lake poets, under Lake, n. (b) (Zoöl.) A fish living in, or taken from, a lake, esp. the namaycush. (c) A lake steamer or canal boat. The bridge tender . . . thought the Cowies "a little mite" longer than that laker. The Century.

upcast.definition:
Cast up; thrown upward; as, with upcast eyes. Addison.

1. (Bowling)  A cast; a throw. Shak. 2. (Mining.)  The ventilating shaft of a mine out of which the air passes after having circulated through the mine; -- distinguished from the downcast. Called also upcast pit, and upcast shaft. 3. An upset,.

quadratojugal.definition: (a) Of or pertaining to the quadrate and jugal bones. (b) Of or pertaining to the quadratojugal bone. -- n.  The quadratojugal bone. Quadratojugal bone (Anat.), a bone at the base of the lower jaw in many animals.

nubian.definition: Of or pertaining to Nubia in Eastern Africa. -- n.  A native of Nubia.

condurrite.definition: A variety of the mineral domeykite, or copper arsenide, from the Condurra mine in Cornwall, England.

washtub.definition: A tub in which clothes are washed.

coracle.definition: A boat made by covering a wicker frame with leather or oilcloth. It was used by the ancient Britons, and is still used by fisherman in Wales and some parts of Ireland. Also, a similar boat used in Thibet and in Egypt.

playa.definition: A beach; a strand; in the plains and deserts of Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona, a broad, level spot, on which subsequently becomes dry by evaporation. Bartlett.

optometry.definition: (Med.) Measurement of the range of vision, esp. by means of the optometer. 2.  As defined (with minor variations) in the statutes of various States of the United States: (a) "The employment of subjective and objective mechanical means to determine the accomodative and refractive states of the eye an.

equalization.definition: The act of equalizing, or state of being equalized. Their equalization with the rest of their fellow subjects. Burke.

dismally.definition: In a dismal manner; gloomily; sorrowfully; uncomfortably.

precalculate.definition: To calculate or determine beforehand; to prearrange. Masson.

titularly.definition: In a titular manner; nominally; by title only.

excitatory.definition: Tending to excite; containing excitement; excitative.

cerebrum.definition: The anterior, and in man the larger, division of the brain; the seat of the reasoning faculties and the will. See Brain.

desultory.definition: Leaping or skipping about. I shot at it [a bird], but it was so desultory that I missed my aim. Gilbert White. 2. Jumping, or passing, from one thing or subject to another, without order or rational connection; without logical sequence; disconnected; immethodical; aimless; as, desultory minds. Atter.

glove.definition: A cover for the hand, or for the hand and wrist, with a separate sheath for each finder. The latter characteristic distinguishes the glove from the mitten. 2. A boxing glove. Boxing glove. See under Boxing. -- Glove fight, a pugilistic contest in wich the fighters wear boxing gloves. -- Glove money.

terre-verte.definition: An olive-green earth used as a pigment. See Glauconite.

sesquitertianal.definition: Having the ratio of one and one third to one (as 4 : 3).

coinage.definition: The act or process of converting metal into money. The care of the coinage was committed to the inferior magistrates. Arbuthnot. 2. Coins; the aggregate coin of a time or place. 3. The cost or expense of coining money. 4. The act or process of fabricating or inventing; formation; fabrication; that w.

shriek.definition:
To utter a loud, sharp, shrill sound or cry, as do some birds and beasts; to scream, as in a sudden fright, in horror or anguish. It was the owl that shrieked. Shak. At this she shrieked aloud; the mournful train Echoed her grief. Dryden.

To utter sharply and shrilly; to utter in or with a shriek o.

dipteran.definition: An insect of the order Diptera.

overhold.definition: To hold or value too highly; to estimate at too dear a rate. Shak.

petrologist.definition: One who is versed in petrology.

obstetricate.definition:
To perform the office of midwife. "Nature does obstetricate." Evelyn.

To assist as a midwife. E. Waterhouse.

illuminer.definition: One who, or that which, illuminates.

polyphotal.definition: Pertaining to or designating arc lamps so constructed that more than one can be used on a single circuit.

recriminate.definition:
To return one charge or accusation with another; to chargeback fault or crime upon an accuser. It is not my business to recriminate, hoping sufficiently toBp. Stillingfleet.

To accuse in return. South.

brunt.definition: The heat, or utmost violence, of an onset; the strength or greatest fury of any contention; as, the brunt of a battle. 2. The force of a blow; shock; collision. "And heavy brunt of cannon ball." Hudibras. It is instantly and irrecoverably scattered by our first brunt with some real affair of common.

giblets.definition: The inmeats, or edible viscera (heart, gizzard, liver, etc.), of poultry.

emulge.definition: To milk out; to drain. Bailey.

evilly.definition: In an evil manner; not well; ill. "Good deeds evilly bestowed." Shak.

indolent.definition: Free from toil, pain, or trouble. 2. Indulging in ease; avoiding labor and exertion; habitually idle; lazy; inactive; as, an indolent man. To waste long nights in indolent repose. Pope. 3. (Med.)  Causing little or no pain or annoyance; as, an indolent tumor. Syn. -- Idle; lazy; slothful; sluggish;.

defilement.definition:
The protection of the interior walls of a fortification from an enfilading fire, as by covering them, or by a high parapet on the exposed side.

The act of defiling, or state of being defiled, whether physically or morally; pollution; foulness; dirtiness; uncleanness. Defilements of the flesh. Hopki.

anemogram.definition: A record made by an anemograph.

denary.definition:
Containing ten; tenfold; proceeding by tens; as, the denary, or decimal, scale.

1. The number ten; a division into ten. 2. A coin; the Anglicized form of denarius. Udall.

roture.definition: The condition of being a roturier. 2.  (Fr. & Canadian Law) A feudal tenure of lands by one who has no privileges of nobility, but is permitted to discharge all his obligations to his feudal lord or superior by a payment of rent in money or kind and without rendering any personal services.

internally.definition: Inwardly; within the enveloping surface, or the boundary of a thing; within the body; beneath the surface. 2. Hence: Mentally; spiritually. Jer. Taylor.

misreport.definition:
To report erroneously; to give an incorrect account of. Locke.

An erroneous report; a false or incorrect account given. Denham. South.

anaesthetic.definition:
(a) Capable of rendering insensible; as, anæsthetic agents. (b) Characterized by, or connected with, insensibility; as, an anæsthetic effect or operation.

That which produces insensibility to pain, as chloroform, ether, etc.

erebus.definition: (Greek Myth.)  A place of nether darkness, being the gloomy space through which the souls passed to Hades. See Milton's "Paradise Lost," Book II., line 883. 2. (Greek Myth.)  The son of Chaos and brother of Nox, who dwelt in Erebus. To the infernal deep, with Erebus and tortures vile. Shak.

scalp.definition:
A bed of oysters or mussels. [Scot.]

1. That part of the integument of the head which is usually covered with hair. By the bare scalp of Robin Hodd's fat friar, This fellow were a king for our wild faction! Shak. 2. A part of the skin of the head, with the hair attached, cut or torn off from an ene.

corallaceous.definition: Like coral, or partaking of its qualities.

leggiadro.definition: Light or graceful; in a light, delicate, and brick style.

univocacy.definition: The quality or state of being univocal. Sir T. Browne.

diagnose.definition: To ascertain by diagnosis; to diagnosticate. See Diagnosticate.

rotular.definition: Of or pertaining to the rotula, or kneepan.

hektoliter.definition: Same as Hectare, Hectogram, Hectoliter, and Hectometer.

turf.definition: That upper stratum of earth and vegetable mold which is filled with the roots of grass and other small plants, so as to adhere and form a kind of mat; sward; sod. At his head a grass-green turf. Shak. The Greek historian sets her in the field on a high heap of turves. Milton. 2. Peat, especially whe.

elumbated.definition: Weak or lame in the loins.

polythalamous.definition: Many-chambered; -- applied to shells of Foraminifera and cephalopods. See Illust. of Nautilus.

indebt.definition: To bring into debt; to place under obligation; -- chiefly used in the participle indebted. Thy fortune hath indebted thee to none. Daniel.

pituitous.definition: Consisting of, or resembling, pituite or mucus; full of mucus; discharging mucus. Pituitous fever (Med.), typhoid fever; enteric fever.

crithomancy.definition: A kind of divination by means of the dough of the cakes offered in the ancient sacrifices, and the meal strewed over the victims.

misinterpretable.definition: Capable of being misinterpreted; liable to be misunderstood.

capot.definition:
A winning of all the tricks at the game of piquet. It counts for forty points. Hoyle.

To win all the tricks from, in playing at piquet.

transversion.definition: The act of changing from prose into verse, or from verse into prose.

proleptics.definition: The art and science of predicting in medicine. Laycock.

decalcomania.definition: The art or process of transferring pictures and designs to china, glass, marble, etc., and permanently fixing them thereto.

porthole.definition: An embrasure in a ship's side. See 3d Port.

confession.definition: Acknowledgment; avowal, especially in a matter pertaining to one's self; the admission of a debt, obligation, or crime. With a crafty madness keeps aloof, When we would bring him on to some confession Of his true state. Shak. 2. Acknowledgment of belief; profession of one's faith. With the mouth con.

porridge.definition: A food made by boiling some leguminous or farinaceous substance, or the meal of it, in water or in milk, making of broth or thin pudding; as, barley porridge, milk porridge, bean porridge, etc.

maltin.definition: The fermentative principle of malt; malt diastase; also, a name given to various medicinal preparations made from or containing malt.

familiarize.definition: To make familiar or intimate; to habituate; to accustom; to make well known by practice or converse; as, to familiarize one's self with scenes of distress. 2. To make acquainted, or skilled, by practice or study; as, to familiarize one's self with a business, a book, or a science.

monitorial.definition: Of or pertaining to a monitor or monitors. 2. Done or performed by a monitor; as, monitorial work; conducted or taught by monitors; as, a monitorial school; monitorial instruction.

fatalistic.definition: Implying, or partaking of the nature of, fatalism.

divisor.definition: The number by which the dividend is divided. Common divisor. (Math.) See under Common, a.

weakly.definition:
In a weak manner; with little strength or vigor; feebly.

Not strong of constitution; infirm; feeble; as, a weakly woman; a man of a weakly constitution.

brinjaree.definition: A rough-haired East Indian variety of the greyhound.

inconvincibly.definition: In a manner not admitting of being convinced.

kneadable.definition: That may be kneaded; capable of being worked into a mass.

tactical.definition: Of or pertaining to the art of military and naval tactics. -- Tac"tic*al*ly, adv.

porphyrogenitism.definition: The principle of succession in royal families, especially among the Eastern Roman emperors, by which a younger son, if born after the accession of his father to the throne, was preferred to an elder son who was not so born. Sir T. Palgrave.

decentralization.definition: The action of decentralizing, or the state of being decentralized. "The decentralization of France." J. P. Peters.

cobalt.definition: (Chem.)  A tough, lustrous, reddish white metal of the iron group, not easily fusible, and somewhat magnetic. Atomic weight 59.1. Symbol Co. Note: It occurs in nature in combination with arsenic, sulphur, and oxygen, and is obtained from its ores, smaltite, cobaltite, asbolite, etc. Its oxide colors.

nematocalyx.definition: One of a peculiar kind of cups, or calicles, found upon hydroids of the family Plumularidæ. They contain nematocysts. See Plumularia.

buckety.definition: Paste used by weavers to dress their webs. Buchanan.

stola.definition: A long garment, descending to the ankles, worn by Roman women. The stola was not allowed to be worn by courtesans, or by women who had been divorced from their husbands. Fairholt.

zeolitiform.definition: Having the form of a zeolite.

redoubtable.definition: Formidable; dread; terrible to foes; as, a redoubtable hero; hence, valiant; -- often in contempt or burlesque. [Written also redoutable.].

basipterygium.definition: A bar of cartilage at the base of the embryonic fins of some fishes. It develops into the metapterygium. -- Ba*sip`ter*yg"i*al (, a.

breadstuff.definition: Grain, flour, or meal of which bread is made.

stercoranist.definition: A nickname formerly given to those who held, or were alleged to hold, that the consecrated elements in the eucharist undergo the process of digestion in the body of the recipient.

confabulate.definition: To talk familiarly together; to chat; to prattle. I shall not ask Jean Jaques Rousseau If birds confabulate or no. Cowper.

fusarole.definition: A molding generally placed under the echinus or quarter round of capitals in the Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders of architecture.

martialism.definition: The quality of being warlike; exercises suitable for war.

posteriors.definition: The hinder parts, as of an animal's body. Swift.

pseudo-hyperthophic.definition: Falsely hypertrophic; as, pseudo-hypertrophic paralysis, a variety of paralysis in which the muscles are apparently enlarged, but are really degenerated and replaced by fat.

boatswain.definition: (Naut.)  An officer who has charge of the boats, sails, rigging, colors, anchors, cables, cordage, etc., of a ship, and who also summons the crew, and performs other duties. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) The jager gull. (b) The tropic bird. Boatswain's mate, an assistant of the boatswain. Totten.

hematic.definition:
Same as Hæmatic.

A medicine designed to improve the condition of the blood.

myohaematin.definition: A red-colored respiratory pigment found associated with hemoglobin in the muscle tissue of a large number of animals, both vertebrate and invertebrate.

lester.definition: A dry sirocco in the Madeira Islands.

energetic.definition: Having energy or energies; possessing a capacity for vigorous action or for exerting force; active. "A Being eternally energetic." Grew. 2. Exhibiting energy; operating with force, vigor, and effect; forcible; powerful; efficacious; as, energetic measures; energetic laws. Syn. -- Forcible; powerful;.

indistancy.definition: Want of distance o Bp. Pearson.

bakehouse.definition: A house for baking; a bakery.

circumposition.definition: The act of placing in a circle, or round about, or the state of being so placed. Evelyn.

tideway.definition: Channel in which the tide sets.

ouananiche.definition: A small landlocked variety of the Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar ounaniche) of Lake St. John, Canada, and neighboring waters, noted for its vigor and activity, and habit of leaping from the water when hooked.

athanasia.definition: The quality of being deathless; immortality. Is not a scholiastic athanasy better than none Lowell.

warely.definition: Cautiously; warily. They bound him hand and foot with iron chains, And with continual watch did warely keep. Spenser.

hoax.definition:
A deception for mockery or mischief; a deceptive trick or story; a practical joke. Macaulay.

To deceive by a story or a trick, for sport or mischief; to impose upon sportively. Lamb.

trustiness.definition: The quality or state of being trusty.

gang-flower.definition: The common English milkwort (Polygala vulgaris), so called from blossoming in gang week. Dr. Prior.

reconjoin.definition: To join or conjoin anew. Boyle.

putty.definition: A kind of thick paste or cement compounded of whiting, or soft carbonate of lime, and linseed oil, when applied beaten or kneaded to the consistence of dough, -- used in fastening glass in sashes, stopping crevices, and for similar purposes. Putty powder, an oxide of tin, or of tin and lead in vario.

ceylonese.definition: Of or pertaining to Ceylon. -- n. sing. & pl.  A native or natives of Ceylon. C.G.S. C.G.S.  An abbreviation for Centimeter, Gram, Second. -- applied to a system of units much empoyed in physical science, based upon the centimeter as the unit of length, the gram as the unit of weight or mass, and th.

eccritic.definition: A remedy which promotes discharges, as an emetic, or a cathartic.

catery.definition: The place where provisions are deposited.

dynamical.definition: Of or pertaining to dynamics; belonging to energy or power; characterized by energy or production of force. Science, as well as history, has its past to show, -- a past indeed, much larger; but its immensity is dynamic, not divine. J. Martineau. The vowel is produced by phonetic, not by dynamic, cau.

orthostichy.definition: A longitudinal rank, or row, of leaves along a stem.

dendriform.definition: Resembling in structure a tree or shrub.

judger.definition: One who judges. Sir K. Digby.

idiomuscular.definition: Applied to a semipermanent contraction of a muscle, produced by a mechanical irritant.

incuriosity.definition: Want of curiosity or interest; inattentiveness; indifference. Sir H. Wotton.

amel.definition:
Enamel. Boyle.

To enamel. Enlightened all with stars, And richly ameled. Chapman.

atmological.definition: Of or pertaining to atmology. "Atmological laws of heat." Whewell.

efficacy.definition: Power to produce effects; operation or energy of an agent or force; production of the effect intended; as, the efficacy of medicine in counteracting disease; the efficacy of prayer. "Of noxious efficacy." Milton. Syn. -- Virtue; force; energy; potency; efficiency.

electro-kinetics.definition: That branch of electrical science which treats of electricity in motion.

platetrope.definition: One of a pair of a paired organs.

porphyrization.definition: The act of porphyrizing, or the state of being porphyrized.

disannul.definition: To annul completely; to render void or of no effect. For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul Isaiah xiv. 27. Note: The prefix in this word an its derivatives is intensive, and not negative.

trucking.definition: The business of conveying goods on trucks.

upridged.definition: Raised up in a ridge or ridges; as, a billow upridged. Cowper.

anthropophaginian.definition: One who east human flesh. [Ludicrous] Shak.

blackwood.definition: A name given to several dark-colored timbers. The East Indian black wood is from the tree Dalbergia latifolia. Balfour.

wrong-timed.definition: Done at an improper time; ill-timed.

eductor.definition: One who, or that which, brings forth, elicits, or extracts. Stimulus must be called an eductor of vital ether. E. Darwin.

gaelic.definition:
Of or pertaining to the Gael, esp. to the Celtic Highlanders of Scotland; as, the Gaelic language.

The language of the Gaels, esp. of the Highlanders of Scotland. It is a branch of the Celtic.

endysis.definition: The act of developing a new coat of hair, a new set of feathers, scales, etc.; -- opposed to ecdysis.

manless.definition: Destitute of men. Bakon. 2. Unmanly; inhuman. Chapman.

unbowel.definition: To deprive of the entrails; to disembowel. Dr. H. More.

inmesh.definition: To bring within meshes, as of a net; to enmesh.

lubber.definition: A heavy, clumsy, or awkward fellow; a sturdy drone; a clown. Lingering lubbers lose many a penny. Tusser. Land lubber, a name given in contempt by sailors to a person who lives on land. -- Lubber grasshopper (Zoöl.), a large, stout, clumsy grasshopper; esp., Brachystola magna, from the Rocky Mountai.

dysphony.definition: A difficulty in producing vocal sounds; enfeebled or depraved voice.

housewifery.definition: The business of the mistress of a family; female management of domestic concerns.

hautpas.definition: A raised part of the floor of a large room; a platform for a raised table or throne. See Dais.

digladiate.definition: To fight like gladiators; to contend fiercely; to dispute violently. Digladiating like Æschines and Demosthenes. Hales.

indictment.definition: The act of indicting, or the state of being indicted. 2. (Law)  The formal statement of an offense, as framed by the prosecuting authority of the State, and found by the grand jury. Note: To the validity of an indictment a finding by the grand jury is essential, while an information rests only on pr.

prognathism.definition: Projection of the jaws. -- Prog"na*thy, n.

haffle.definition: To stammer; to speak unintelligibly; to prevaricate. Halliwell.

anthropic.definition: Like or related to man; human. Owen.

frictional.definition: Relating to friction; moved by friction; produced by friction; as, frictional electricity. Frictional gearing, wheels which transmit motion by surface friction instead of teeth. The faces are sometimes made more or less V-shaped to increase or decrease friction, as required.

araba.definition: A wagon or cart, usually heavy and without springs, and often covered. [Oriental] The araba of the Turks has its sides of latticework to admit the air Balfour (Cyc. of India).

receivability.definition: The quality of being receivable; receivableness.

myronic.definition: Pertaining to, or obtained from, mustard; -- used specifically to designate a glucoside called myronic acid, found in mustard seed.

ennuyee.definition: A woman affected with ennui. Mrs. Jameson.

keeled.definition: (Bot.)  Keel-shaped; having a longitudinal prominence on the back; as, a keeled leaf. 2. (Zoöl.)  Having a median ridge; carinate; as, a keeled scale.

bannition.definition: The act of expulsion. Abp. Laud.

fagot.definition: A bundle of sticks, twigs, or small branches of trees, used for fuel, for raising batteries, filling ditches, or other purposes in fortification; a fascine. Shak. 2. A bundle of pieces of wrought iron to be worked over into bars or other shapes by rolling or hammering at a welding heat; a pile. 3. (.

monogyny.definition: Marriage with the one woman only. 2. (Bot.)  The state or condition of being monogynous.

unpredict.definition: To retract or falsify a previous prediction. Milton.

persevering.definition: Characterized by perseverance; persistent. -- Per`se*ver"ing*ly, adv.

pentastich.definition: A composition consisting of five verses.

pargetory.definition: Something made of, or covered with, parget, or plaster. Milton.

cherubic.definition: Of or pertaining to cherubs; angelic. "The cherubic host." Milton.

doughnut.definition: A small cake (usually sweetened) fried in a kettle of boiling lard.

fratricelli.definition: (a) The name which St. Francis of Assisi gave to his followers, early in the 13th century. (b) A sect which seceded from the Franciscan Order, chiefly in Italy and Sicily, in 1294, repudiating the pope as an apostate, maintaining the duty of celibacy and poverty, and discountenancing oaths. Called a.

panelation.definition: The act of impaneling a jury. [Written also panellation.] Wood.

neonomianism.definition: The doctrines or belief of the neonomians.

appurtenant.definition:
Annexed or pertaining to some more important thing; accessory; incident; as, a right of way appurtenant to land or buildings. Blackstone. Common appurtenatn. (Law) See under Common, n.

Something which belongs or appertains to another thing; an appurtenance. Mysterious appurtenants and symbols of re.

legibleness.definition: The state or quality of being legible.

rankle.definition: To become, or be, rank; to grow rank or strong; to be inflamed; to fester; -- used literally and figuratively. A malady that burns and rankles inward. Rowe. This would have left a rankling wound in the hearts of the people. Burke. 2. To produce a festering or inflamed effect; to cause a sore; -- use.

anacanths.definition: A group of teleostean fishes destitute of spiny fin-rays, as the cod.

infiltration.definition: The act or process of infiltrating, as if water into a porous substance, or of a fluid into the cells of an organ or part of the body. 2. The substance which has entered the pores or cavities of a body. Addison. Calcareous infiltrations filling the cavities. Kirwan. Fatty infiltration. (Med.) See un.

ranterism.definition: The practice or tenets of the Ranters.

chaliced.definition: Having a calyx or cup; cupshaped. "Chaliced flowers." Shak.

deer-neck.definition: A deerlike, or thin, ill-formed neck, as of a horse.

flax-plant.definition: A plant in new Zealand (Phormium tenax), allied to the lilies and aloes. The leaves are two inches wide and several feet long, and furnish a fiber which is used for making ropes, mats, and coarse cloth.

indigency.definition: Indigence. New indigencies founded upon new desires. South.

demobilization.definition: The disorganization or disarming of troops which have previously been mobilized or called into active service; the change from a war footing to a peace footing.

outwell.definition:
To pour out. Spenser.

To issue forth. Thomson.

bicipital.definition: (Anat.) (a) Having two heads or origins, as a muscle. (b) Pertaining to a biceps muscle; as, bicipital furrows, the depressions on either side of the biceps of the arm. 2. (Bot.)  Dividing into two parts at one extremity; having two heads or two supports; as, a bicipital tree.

elleck.definition: The red gurnard or cuckoo fish.

handiness.definition: The quality or state of being handy.

tipstock.definition: The detachable or movable fore part of a gunstock, lying beneath the barrel or barrels, and forming a hold for the left hand.

capsicum.definition: A genus of plants of many species, producing capsules or dry berries of various forms, which have an exceedingly pungent, biting taste, and when ground form the red of Cayenne pepper of commerce. Note: The most important species are Capsicum baccatum or birs pepper. C, annuum or chili pepper, C. fru.

bicker.definition:
A small wooden vessel made of staves and hoops, like a tub.

1. To skirmish; to exchange blows; to fight. Two eagles had a conflict, and bickered together. Holland. 2. To contend in petulant altercation; to wrangle. Petty things about which men cark and bicker. Barrow. 3. To move quickly and unstead.

mahovo.definition: A device for saving power in stopping and starting a railroad car, by means of a heavy fly wheel.

whiggish.definition: Of or pertaining to Whigs; partaking of, or characterized by, the principles of Whigs.

picoline.definition: Any one of three isometric bases (C6H7N) related to pyridine, and obtained from bone oil, acrolein ammonia, and coal-tar naphtha, as colorless mobile liquids of strong odor; -- called also methyl pyridine.

micrological.definition: Of or pertaining to micrology; very minute; as, micrologic examination. -- Mi`cro*log"ic*al*ly, adv.

electrizer.definition: One who, or that which, electrizes.

paludicolae.definition: A division of birds, including the cranes, rails, etc.

parsonage.definition: (Eng. Eccl. Law)  A certain portion of lands, tithes, and offerings, for the maintenance of the parson of a parish. 2. The glebe and house, or the house only, owned by a parish or ecclesiastical society, and appropriated to the maintenance or use of the incumbent or settled pastor. 3. Money paid for.

ombre.definition:
A game at cards, borrowed from the Spaniards, and usually played by three persons. Pope. When ombre calls, his hand and heart are free, And, joined to two, he fails not to make three. Young.

A large Mediterranean food fish (Umbrina cirrhosa): -- called also umbra, and umbrine.

pentelican.definition: Of or pertaining to Mount Pentelicus, near Athens, famous for its fine white marble quarries; obtained from Mount Pentelicus; as, the Pentelic marble of which the Parthenon is built.

scaphocerite.definition: A flattened plate or scale attached to the second joint of the antennæ of many Crustacea.

semipenniform.definition: Half or partially penniform; as, a semipenniform muscle.

microtomical.definition: Of or pert. to the microtome or microtomy; cutting thin slices.

dissonance.definition: A mingling of discordant sounds; an inharmonious combination of sounds; discord. Filled the air with barbarous dissonance. Milton. 2. Want of agreement; incongruity. Milton.

semblance.definition: Seeming; appearance; show; figure; form. Thier semblance kind, and mild their gestures were. Fairfax. 2. Likeness; resemblance, actual or apparent; similitude; as, the semblance of worth; semblance of virtue. Only semblances or imitations of shells. Woodward.

salience.definition: That quality or condition of being salient; a leaping; a springing forward; an assaulting. 2. The quality or state of projecting, or being projected; projection; protrusion. Sir W. Hamilton.

marginally.definition: In the margin of a book.

batture.definition: An elevated river bed or sea bed.

underfringe.definition: A lower fringe; a fringe underneath something. Broad-faced, with underfringe of russet beard. Tennyson.

preexistence.definition: Existence in a former state, or previous to something else. Wisdom declares her antiquity and preëxistence to all the works of this earth. T. Burnet. 2. Existence of the soul before its union with the body; -- a doctrine held by certain philosophers. Addison.

outpass.definition: To pass beyond; to exceed in progress.

undercraft.definition: A sly trick or device; as, an undercraft of authors. Sterne.

supralapsarian.definition: One of that class of Calvinists who believed that God's decree of election determined that man should fall, in order that the opportunity might be furnished of securing the redemption of a part of the race, the decree of salvation being conceived of as formed before or beyond, and not after or follo.

imbuement.definition: The act of imbuing; the state of being imbued; hence, a deep tincture.

dulcimer.definition: (a) An instrument, having stretched metallic wires which are beaten with two light hammers held in the hands of the performer. (b) An ancient musical instrument in use among the Jews. Dan. iii. 5. It is supposed to be the same with the psaltery.

cognizor.definition: One who ackowledged the right of the plaintiff or cognizee in a fine; the defendant. Blackstone.

dithyrambic.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, a dithyramb; wild and boisterous. "Dithyrambic sallies." Longfellow. -- n.  A dithyrambic poem; a dithyramb.

synonymist.definition: One who collects or explains synonyms.

hymenopteral.definition: Like, or characteristic of, the Hymenoptera; pertaining to the Hymenoptera.

deodorization.definition: The act of depriving of odor, especially of offensive odors resulting from impurities.

preoccupancy.definition: The act or right of taking possession before another; as, the preoccupancy of wild land.

antiparallel.definition: Running in a contrary direction. Hammond.

sisyphean.definition: Relating to Sisyphus; incessantly recurring; as, Sisyphean labors.

pseudo-bulb.definition: An aërial corm, or thickened stem, as of some epiphytic orchidaceous plants.

binturong.definition: A small Asiatic civet of the genus Arctilis.

velutina.definition: Any one of several species of marine gastropods belonging to Velutina and allied genera.

yedding.definition: The song of a minstrel; hence, any song. Chaucer.

A large tree (Celtis australis), found in the south of Europe. It has a hard wood, and bears a cherrylike fruit. Called also nettle tree. Eng. Cyc.

annuloida.definition: A division of the Articulata, including the annelids and allied groups; sometimes made to include also the helminths and echinoderms. [Written also Annuloidea.].

ideality.definition: The quality or state of being ideal. 2. The capacity to form ideals of beauty or perfection. 3. (Phren.)  The conceptive faculty.

rescribe.definition: To write back; to write in reply. Ayliffe. 2. To write over again. Howell.

vacher.definition: A keeper of stock or cattle; a herdsman. [Southwestern U. S.] Bartlett.

hawm.definition:
See Haulm, straw.

A fee offered to professional men for their services; as, an honorarium of one thousand dollars. S. Longfellow. 2. (Law)  An honorary payment, usually in recognition of services for which it is not usual or not lawful to assign a fixed business price. Heumann.

whomsoever.definition: The objective of whosoever. See Whosoever. The Most High ruleth in the kingdow of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will. Dan. iv. 17.

sebat.definition: The eleventh month of the ancient Hebrew year, approximately corresponding with February. W. Smith (Bibl. Dict. ).

alkaloidal.definition: Pertaining to, resembling, or containing, alkali.

rivery.definition: Having rivers; as, a rivery country. Drayton.

acerate.definition:
A combination of aceric acid with a salifiable base.

Acerose; needle-shaped.

servite.definition: One of the order of the Religious Servants of the Holy Virgin, founded in Florence in 1223.

lacquering.definition: The act or business of putting on lacquer; also, the coat of lacquer put on.

prorate.definition: To divide or distribute proportionally; to assess pro rata. [U.S.].

monodelphous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Monodelphia.

ergotized.definition: Affected with the ergot fungus; as, ergotized rye.

stylopodium.definition: An expansion at the base of the style, as in umbelliferous plants.

maltreat.definition: To treat ill; to abuse; to treat roughly.

actuality.definition: The state of being actual; reality; as, the actuality of God's nature. South.

A hind in the year of its age. [Eng.] Wright.

To make love to women; to play the male flirt. You can't go philandering after her again. G. Eliot.

A lover. Congreve.

spetches.definition: Parings and refuse of hides, skins, etc., from which glue is made.

grosgrain.definition: Of a coarse texture; -- applied to silk with a heavy thread running crosswise.

sculptural.definition: Of or pertaining to sculpture. G. Eliot.
