hedonic.definition: Pertaining to pleasure. 2. Of or relating to Hedonism or the Hedonic sect.

primeness.definition: The quality or state of being first. 2. The quality or state of being prime, or excellent.

unspell.definition: To break the power of (a spell); to release (a person) from the influence of a spell; to disenchant. Such practices as these, . . . The more judicious Israelites unspelled. Dryden.

scandalously.definition: In a manner to give offense; shamefully. His discourse at table was scandalously unbecoming the digmity of his station. Swift. 2. With a disposition to impute immorality or wrong. Shun their fault, who, scandalously nice, Will needs mistake an author into vice. Pope.

planing.definition: a. & vb. n. fr. Plane, v. t. Planing machine. (a) See Planer. (b) A complex machine for planing wood, especially boards, containing usually a rapidly revolving cutter, which chips off the surface in small shavings as the piece to be planed is passed under it by feeding apparatus.

syndicalist.definition: One who advocates or practices syndicalism. --Syn`dic*al*is"tic (#), a.

russophobe.definition: One who dreads Russia or Russian influence. [Words sometimes found in the newspapers.].

glyptic.definition: Of or pertaining to gem engraving. 2. (Min.)  Figured; marked as with figures.

heterocarpism.definition: The power of producing two kinds of reproductive bodies, as in Amphicarpæa, in which besides the usual pods, there are others underground.

dissatisfaction.definition: The state of being dissatisfied, unsatisfied, or discontented; uneasiness proceeding from the want of gratification, or from disappointed wishes and expectations. The ambitious man has little happiness, but is subject to much uneasiness and dissatisfaction. Addison. Syn. -- Discontent; discontentmen.

moll.definition: Minor; in the minor mode; as, A moll, that is, A minor.

hornbook.definition: The first book for children, or that from which in former times they learned their letters and rudiments; -- so called because a sheet of horn covered the small, thin board of oak, or the slip of paper, on which the alphabet, digits, and often the Lord's Prayer, were written or printed; a primer. "H.

dowlas.definition: A coarse linen cloth made in the north of England and in Scotland, now nearly replaced by calico. Shak.

archducal.definition: Of or pertaining to an archduke or archduchy.

moccasin.definition: A shoe made of deerskin, or other soft leather, the sole and upper part being one piece. It is the customary shoe worn by the American Indians. 2. (Zoöl.)  A poisonous snake of the Southern United States. The water moccasin (Ancistrodon piscivorus) is usually found in or near water. Above, it is oli.

sluttery.definition: The qualities and practices of a slut; sluttishness; slatternlines. Drayton.

usnic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, a complex acid obtained, as a yellow crystalline substance, from certain genera of lichens (Usnea, Parmelia, etc.).

pantometer.definition: An instrument for measuring angles for determining elevations, distances, etc.

exactress.definition: A woman who is an exactor. B. Jonson.

morbosity.definition: A diseased state; unhealthiness. Sir T. Browne.

nephelodometer.definition: An instrument for reckoning the distances or velocities of clouds.

gonoph.definition: A pickpocket or thief. [Eng. Slang] Dickens.

diswont.definition: To deprive of wonted usage; to disaccustom. Bp. Hall.

combing.definition: The act or process of using a comb or a number of combs; as, the combing of one's hair; the combing of wool. Note: The process of combing is used in straightening wool of long staple; short wool is carded. 2. pl. (a) That which is caught or collected with a comb, as loose, tangled hair. (b) Hair arr.

noninhabitant.definition: One who is not an inhabitant; a stranger; a foreigner; a nonresident.

pirry.definition: A rough gale of wind. Sir T. Elyot.

coloration.definition: The act or art of coloring; the state of being colored. Bacon. The females . . . resemble each other in their general type of coloration. Darwin.

antisepalous.definition: Standing before a sepal, or calyx leaf.

carving.definition: The act or art of one who carves. 2. A piece of decorative work cut in stone, wood, or other material. "Carving in wood." Sir W. Temple. 3. The whole body of decorative sculpture of any kind or epoch, or in any material; as, the Italian carving of the 15th century.

gunnel.definition: A gunwale. 2. (Zoöl.)  A small, eel-shaped, marine fish of the genus Murænoides; esp., M. gunnellus of Europe and America; -- called also gunnel fish, butterfish, rock eel.

leucomaine.definition: An animal base or alkaloid, appearing in the tissue during life; hence, a vital alkaloid, as distinguished from a ptomaine or cadaveric poison.

ichthyopsida.definition: A grand division of the Vertebrata, including the Amphibia and Fishes.

cachaemia.definition:
A degenerated or poisoned condition of the blood.

A degenerated or poisoned condition of the blood. --Ca*chæ"mic, Ca*che"mic (#), a.

sententiary.definition: One who read lectures, or commented, on the Sentences of Peter Lombard, Bishop of Paris (1159-1160), a school divine. R. Henry.

gearing.definition: Harness. 2. (Mach.)  The parts by which motion imparted to one portion of an engine or machine is transmitted to another, considered collectively; as, the valve gearing of locomotive engine; belt gearing; esp., a train of wheels for transmitting and varying motion in machinery. Frictional gearing. S.

perusal.definition: The act of carefully viewing or examining. Tatler. 2. The act of reading, especially of reading through or with care. Woodward.

self-condemnation.definition: Condemnation of one's self by one's own judgment.

squacco.definition: A heron (Ardea comata) found in Asia, Northern Africa, and Southern Europe.

trigastric.definition: Having three bellies; -- said of a muscle. Dunglison.

zantiot.definition: A native or inhabitant of Zante, one of the Ionian Islands.

terutero.definition: The South American lapwing (Vanellus Cayennensis). Its wings are furnished with short spurs. Called also Cayenne lapwing.

inker.definition: One who, or that which, inks; especially, in printing, the pad or roller which inks the type.

burnettize.definition: To subject (wood, fabrics, etc.) to a process of saturation in a solution of chloride of zinc, to prevent decay; -- a process invented by Sir William Burnett.

araroba.definition: Goa powder. 2.  A fabaceous tree of Brazil (Centrolobium robustum) having handsomely striped wood; --called also zebrawood.

dissembling.definition: That dissembles; hypocritical; false. -- Dis*sem"bling*ly, adv.

hexeikosane.definition: A hydrocarbon, C26H54, resembling paraffine; -- so called because each molecule has twenty-six atoms of carbon. [Written also hexacosane.].

adder.definition:
One who, or that which, adds; esp., a machine for adding numbers.

1. A serpent. "The eddre seide to the woman." Wyclif. Gen. iii. 4. ) 2. (Zoöl.) (a) A small venomous serpent of the genus Vipera. The common European adder is the Vipera (or Pelias) berus. The puff adders of Africa are species of Clo.

intersert.definition: To put in between other things; to insert. Brerewood.

laughter.definition: A movement (usually involuntary) of the muscles of the face, particularly of the lips, with a peculiar expression of the eyes, indicating merriment, satisfaction, or derision, and usually attended by a sonorous and interrupted expulsion of air from the lungs. See Laugh, v. i. The act of laughter, wh.

bellibone.definition: A woman excelling both in beauty and goodness; a fair maid. Spenser.

sexualist.definition: One who classifies plants by the sexual method of Linnæus.

quick-sighted.definition: Having quick sight or acute discernment; quick to see or to discern. Locke. --Quick"-sight`ed*ness, n.

sudorific.definition: Causing sweat; as, sudorific herbs. -- n.  A sudorific medicine. Cf. Diaphoretic.

peninsular.definition: Of or pertaining to a peninsula; as, a peninsular form; peninsular people; the peninsular war.

foreground.definition: On a painting, and sometimes in a bas-relief, mosaic picture, or the like, that part of the scene represented, which is nearest to the spectator, and therefore occupies the lowest part of the work of art itself. Cf. Distance, n., 6.

applicability.definition: The quality of being applicable or fit to be applied.

imporosity.definition: The state or quality of being imporous; want of porosity; compactness. "The . . . imporosity betwixt the tangible parts." Bacon.

nebulated.definition: Clouded with indistinct color markings, as an animal.

kriegsspiel.definition: A game of war, played for practice, on maps. Farrow.

thready.definition: Like thread or filaments; slender; as, the thready roots of a shrub. 2. Containing, or consisting of, thread.

quadricornous.definition: Having four horns, or hornlike organs; as, a quadricornous beetle.

tilde.definition: The accentual mark placed over n, and sometimes over l, in Spanish words [thus, ñ, l], indicating that, in pronunciation, the sound of the following vowel is to be preceded by that of the initial, or consonantal, y.

propugner.definition: A defender; a vindicator. "Zealous propugners." Gov. of Tongue.

laidly.definition: Ugly; loathsome. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] This laidly and loathsome worm. W. Howitt.

betulin.definition: A substance of a resinous nature, obtained from the outer bark of the common European birch (Betula alba), or from the tar prepared therefrom; -- called also birch camphor. Watts.

devoutful.definition: Full of devotion. 2. Sacred. To take her from austerer check of parents, To make her his by most devoutful rights. Marston.

messidor.definition: The tenth month of the French republican calendar dating from September 22, 1792. It began June 19, and ended July 18. See VendÉmiaire.

oxytone.definition:
Having an acute sound; (Gr. Gram.), having an acute accent on the last syllable.

1. An acute sound. 2. (Gr. Gram.)  A word having the acute accent on the last syllable.

encyclopedical.definition: Pertaining to, or of the nature of, an encyclopedia; embracing a wide range of subjects.

roquelaure.definition: A cloak reaching about to, or just below, the knees, worn in the 18th century. [Written also roquelo.].

knighthead.definition: A bollard timber. See under Bollard.

knee-high.definition: Rising or reaching upward to the knees; as, the water is knee- high.

tubulous.definition: Resembling, or in the form of, a tube; longitudinally hollow; specifically (Bot.), having a hollow cylindrical corolla, often expanded or toothed at the border; as, a tubulose flower. 2. Containing, or consisting of, small tubes; specifically (Bot.), composed wholly of tubulous florets; as, a tubulo.

insteep.definition: To steep or soak; to drench. "In gore he lay insteeped." Shak.

insociate.definition: Not associate; without a companion; single; solitary; recluse. "The insociate virgin life." B. Jonson.

philanthropinism.definition: A system of education on so-called natural principles, attempted in Germany in the last century by Basedow, of Dessau.

architeuthis.definition: A genus of gigantic cephalopods, allied to the squids, found esp. in the North Atlantic and about New Zealand.

light-heeled.definition: Lively in walking or running; brisk; light-footed.

corage.definition: See Courage To Canterbury with full devout corage. Chaucer.

sheaf.definition:
A sheave.

1. A quantity of the stalks and ears of wheat, rye, or other grain, bound together; a bundle of grain or straw. The reaper fills his greedy hands, And binds the golden sheaves in brittle bands. Dryden. 2. Any collection of things bound together; a bundle; specifically, a bundle of arrows.

extensor.definition: A muscle which serves to extend or straighten any part of the body, as an arm or a finger; -- opposed to flexor.

ruffianly.definition: Like a ruffian; bold in crimes; characteristic of a ruffian; violent; brutal.

hemihedral.definition: Having half of the similar parts of a crystals, instead of all; consisting of half the planes which full symmetry would require, as when a cube has planes only on half of its eight solid angles, or one plane out of a pair on each of its edges; or as in the case of a tetrahedron, which is hemihedral.

confectionery.definition: Sweetmeats, in general; things prepared and sold by a confectioner; confections; candies. 2. A place where candies, sweetmeats, and similar things are made or sold.

thermotype.definition: A picture (as of a slice of wood) obtained by first wetting the object slightly with hydrochloric or dilute sulphuric acid, then taking an impression with a press, and next strongly heating this impression.

soutage.definition: That in which anything is packed; bagging, as for hops. Halliwell.

unconsiderate.definition: Inconsiderate; heedless; careless. Daniel. -- Un`con*sid"er*ate*ness, n. Hales.

zaimet.definition: A district from which a Zaim draws his revenue. Smart.

ant-cattle.definition: Various kinds of plant lice or aphids tended by ants for the sake of the honeydew which they secrete. See Aphips.

tobie.definition: A kind of inferior cigar of a long slender shape, tapered at one end. [Local, U. S.].

grolier.definition: The name by which Jean Grolier de Servier (1479-1565), a French bibliophile, is commonly known; -- used in naming a certain style of binding, a design, etc. Grolier binding, a book binding decorated with a pattern imitated from those given covers of books bound for Jean Grolier, and bearing his name.

washstand.definition: A piece of furniture holding the ewer or pitcher, basin, and other requisites for washing the person.

limaceous.definition: Pertaining to, or like, Limax, or the slugs.

bashaw.definition: A Turkish title of honor, now written pasha. See Pasha. 2. Fig.: A magnate or grandee. 3. (Zoöl.)  A very large siluroid fish (Leptops olivaris) of the Mississippi valley; -- also called goujon, mud cat, and yellow cat.

fulcible.definition: Capable of being propped up. Cockeram.

socager.definition: A tennant by socage; a socman.

effulge.definition:
To cause to shine with abundance of light; to radiate; to beam. His eyes effulging a peculiar fire. Thomson.

To shine forth; to beam.

imbue.definition: To tinge deeply; to dye; to cause to absorb; as, clothes thoroughly imbued with black. 2. To tincture deply; to cause to become impressed or penetrated; as, to imbue the minds of youth with good principles. Thy words with grace divine Imbued, bring to their sweetness no satiety. Milton.

diathermic.definition: Affording a free passage to heat; as, diathermic substances. Melloni.

siva.definition: One of the triad of Hindoo gods. He is the avenger or destroyer, and in modern worship symbolizes the reproductive power of nature.

choriambus.definition: A foot consisting of four syllables, of which the first and last are long, and the other short (- ~ ~ -); that is, a choreus, or trochee, and an iambus united.

logaoedic.definition: Composed of dactyls and trochees so arranged as to produce a movement like that of ordinary speech.

explicator.definition: One who unfolds or explains; an expounder; an explainer.

intoxicatedness.definition: The state of being intoxicated; intoxication; drunkenness.

oscitancy.definition: The act of gaping or yawning. 2. Drowsiness; dullness; sluggishness. Hallam. It might proceed from the oscitancy of transcribers. Addison.

banian.definition: A Hindoo trader, merchant, cashier, or money changer. [Written also banyan.] 2. A man's loose gown, like that worn by the Banians. 3. (Bot.)  The Indian fig. See Banyan. Banian days (Naut.), days in which the sailors have no flesh meat served out to them. This use seems to be borrowed from the Bania.

incorruptness.definition: Freedom or exemption from decay or corruption. 2. Probity; integrity; honesty. Woodward.

distinguisher.definition: One who, or that which, distinguishes or separates one thing from another by marks of diversity. Sir T. Browne. 2. One who discerns accurately the difference of things; a nice or judicious observer. Dryden.

incapability.definition: The quality of being incapable; incapacity. Suckling. 2. (Law)  Want of legal qualifications, or of legal power; as, incapability of holding an office.

jackman.definition: One wearing a jack; a horse soldier; a retainer. See 3d Jack, n. Christie . . . the laird's chief jackman. Sir W. Scott. 2. A cream cheese. Sir T. Elyot. JACK-O'-LANTERN Jack"-o'-lan`tern, n.  See Jack-with-a-lantern, under 2d Jack. JACKPOT Jackpot  1. (a) See "jack pot" under jack; (b) any larger-t.

biliteral.definition: Consisting of two letters; as, a biliteral root of a Sanskrit verb. Sir W. Jones. -- n.  A word, syllable, or root, consisting of two letters.

pentine.definition: An unsaturated hydrocarbon, C5H8, of the acetylene series. Same as Valerylene.

auricularia.definition: A kind of holothurian larva, with soft, blunt appendages. See Illustration in Appendix.

irritation.definition: The act of irritating, or exciting, or the state of being irritated; excitement; stimulation, usually of an undue and uncomfortable kind; especially, excitement of anger or passion; provocation; annoyance; anger. The whole body of the arts and sciences composes one vast machinery for the irritation.

amalgam.definition:
An alloy of mercury with another metal or metals; as, an amalgam of tin, bismuth, etc. Note: Medalists apply the term to soft alloys generally. 2. A mixture or compound of different things. 3. (Min.)  A native compound of mercury and silver.

To amalgamate. Boyle. B. Jonson.

responsive.definition: That responds; ready or inclined to respond. 2. Suited to something else; correspondent. The vocal lay responsive to the strings. Pope. 3. Responsible. Jer. Taylor. -- Re*spon"sive*ly, adv. -- Re*spon"sive*ness, n.

chou.definition: A cabbage. 2.  A kind of light pastry, usually in the form of a small round cake, and with a filling, as of jelly or cream. 3.  A bunch, knot, or rosette of ribbon or other material, used as an ornament in women's dress.

espinel.definition: A kind of ruby. See Spinel.

sermoning.definition: The act of discoursing; discourse; instruction; preaching. Chaucer.

trochaic.definition:
A trochaic verse or measure. Dryden.

Of or pertaining to trochees; consisting of trochees; as, trochaic measure or verse.

apoplexy.definition: Sudden diminution or loss of consciousness, sensation, and voluntary motion, usually caused by pressure on the brain. Note: The term is now usually limited to cerebral apoplexy, or loss of consciousness due to effusion of blood or other lesion within the substance of the brain; but it is sometimes e.

buckshot.definition: A coarse leaden shot, larger than swan shot, used in hunting deer and large game.

unequivocal.definition: Not equivocal; not doubtful; not ambiguous; evident; sincere; plain; as, unequivocal evidence; unequivocal words. -- Un`e*quiv"o*cal*ly, adv. -- Un`e*quiv"o*cal*ness, n.

acetonemia.definition: A morbid condition characterized by the presence of acetone in the blood, as in diabetes.

cautioner.definition: One who cautions or advises. 2. (Scots Law)  A surety or sponsor.

capsular.definition: Of or pertaining to a capsule; having the nature of a capsula; hollow and fibrous. Capsular ligament (Anat.), a ligamentous bag or capsule surrounding many movable joints in the skeleton.

divestiture.definition: The act of stripping, or depriving; the state of being divested; the deprivation, or surrender, of possession of property, rights, etc.

bazaar.definition: In the East, an exchange, marketplace, or assemblage of shops where goods are exposed for sale. 2. A spacious hall or suite of rooms for the sale of goods, as at a fair. 3. A fair for the sale of fancy wares, toys, etc., commonly for a charitable objects. Macaulay.

overhauling.definition: A strict examination with a view to correction or repairs.

suint.definition: A peculiar substance obtained from the wool of sheep, consisting largely of potash mixed with fatty and earthy matters. It is used as a source of potash and also for the manufacture of gas.

peaky.definition: Having a peak or peaks. Tennyson. 2. Sickly; peaked.

hogger-pipe.definition: The upper terminal pipe of a mining pump. Raymond.

vow.definition: A solemn promise made to God, or to some deity; an act by which one consecrates or devotes himself, absolutely or conditionally, wholly or in part, for a longer or shorter time, to some act, service, or condition; a devotion of one's possessions; as, a baptismal vow; a vow of poverty. "Nothing . . .

scillitin.definition: A bitter principle extracted from the bulbs of the squill (Scilla), and probably consisting of a complex mixture of several substances.

hygrology.definition: The science which treats of the fluids of the body.

vaginated.definition: Invested with, or as if with, a sheath; as, a vaginate stem, or one invested by the tubular base of a leaf.

connote.definition: To mark along with; to suggest or indicate as additional; to designate by implication; to include in the meaning; to imply. fireman.definition: A man whose business is to extinguish fires in towns; a member of a fire company. 2. A man who tends the fires, as of a steam engine; a stocker.

ungainliness.definition: The state or quality of being ungainly; awkwardness.

publishable.definition: Capable of being published; suitable for publication.

quinazol.definition: A complex nitrogenous base related to cinnoline. [Written also chinazol.].

catchwork.definition: A work or artificial watercourse for throwing water on lands that lie on the slopes of hills; a catchdrain.

self-knowing.definition: Knowing one's self, or one's own character, powers, and limitations. 2. Knowing of itself, without help from another.

impartation.definition: The act of imparting, or the thing imparted. The necessity of this impartation. I. Taylor.

parseeism.definition: The religion and customs of the Parsees.

irrefragability.definition: The quality or state of being irrefragable; incapability of being refuted.

snuffbox.definition: A small box for carrying snuff about the person.

topographical.definition: Of or pertaining to topography; descriptive of a place. -- Top`o*graph"ic*al*ly, adv. Topographical map. See under Cadastral. -- Topographical surveying. See under Surveying.

nightgown.definition: A loose gown used for undress; also, a gown used for a sleeping garnment.

aldehydic.definition: Of or pertaining to aldehyde; as, aldehydic acid. Miller.

stercorary.definition: A place, properly secured from the weather, for containing dung.

augustness.definition: The quality of being august; dignity of mien; grandeur; magnificence.

lig.definition: To recline; to lie still. [Obs. or Scot.] Chaucer. Spenser.

assigner.definition: One who assigns, appoints, allots, or apportions.

layshaft.definition: A secondary shaft, as in a sliding change gear for an automobile; a cam shaft operated by a two-to-one gear in an internal- combustion engine. avoider.definition: The person who carries anything away, or the vessel in which things are carried away. Johnson. 2. One who avoids, shuns, or escapes.

daub.definition: To smear with soft, adhesive matter, as pitch, slime, mud, etc.; to plaster; to bedaub; to besmear. She took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch. Ex. ii. 3. 2. To paint in a coarse or unskillful manner. If a picture is daubed with many bright and glaring colors, the.

primipilar.definition: Of or pertaining to the captain of the vanguard of a Roman army. Barrow.

immailed.definition: Wearing mail or armor; clad of armor. W. Browne.

baggager.definition: One who takes care of baggage; a camp follower. Sir W. Raleigh.

dune.definition: A low hill of drifting sand usually formed on the coats, but often carried far inland by the prevailing winds. [Written also dun.] Three great rivers, the Rhine, the Meuse, and the Scheldt, had deposited their slime for ages among the dunes or sand banks heaved up by the ocean around their mouths. M.

stove.definition:
imp. of Stave.

1. A house or room artificially warmed or heated; a forcing house, or hothouse; a drying room; -- formerly, designating an artificially warmed dwelling or room, a parlor, or a bathroom, but now restricted, in this sense, to heated houses or rooms used for horticultural purposes or in.

footfight.definition: A conflict by persons on foot; -- distinguished from a fight on horseback. Sir P. Sidney.

troglodytic.definition: Of or pertaining to a troglodyte, or dweller in caves.

catacaustic.definition:
Relating to, or having the properties of, a caustic curve formed by reflection. See Caustic, a. Nichol.

A caustic curve formed by reflection of light. Nichol.

pentaglot.definition: A work in five different tongues.

hymning.definition:
Praising with hymns; singing. "The hymning choir." G. West.

The singing of hymns. Milton.

partridge.definition: Any one of numerous species of small gallinaceous birds of the genus Perdix and several related genera of the family Perdicidæ, of the Old World. manure.definition: To cultivate by manual labor; to till; hence, to develop by culture. To whom we gave the strand for to manure. Surrey. Manure thyself then; to thyself be improved; And with vain, outward things be no more moved. Donne. 2. To apply manure to; to enrich, as land, by the application of a fertilizing su.

pip.definition:
A contagious disease of fowls, characterized by hoarseness, discharge from the nostrils and eyes, and an accumulation of mucus in the mouth, forming a "scale" on the tongue. By some the term pip is restricted to this last symptom, the disease being called roup by them.

A seed, as of an apple or ora.

airy.definition: Consisting of air; as, an airy substance; the airy parts of bodies. 2. Relating or belonging to air; high in air; aërial; as, an airy flight. "The airy region." Milton. 3. Open to a free current of air; exposed to the air; breezy; as, an airy situation. 4. Resembling air; thin; unsubstantial; not ma.

searcloth.definition:
Cerecloth. Mortimer.

To cover, as a sore, with cerecloth.

monetization.definition: The act or process of converting into money, or of adopting as money; as, the monetization of silver.

waterfall.definition: A fall, or perpendicular descent, of the water of a river or stream, or a descent nearly perpendicular; a cascade; a cataract. 2. (Hairdressing)  An arrangement of a woman's back hair over a cushion or frame in some resemblance to a waterfall. 3. A certain kind of neck scarf. T. Hughes.

roadside.definition: Land adjoining a road or highway; the part of a road or highway that borders the traveled part. Also used ajectively.

poulard.definition: A pullet from which the ovaries have been removed to produce fattening; hence, a fat pullet.

quat.definition:
(a) A pustule. (b) An annoying, worthless person. Shak.

To satiate; to satisfy.

aphthous.definition: Pertaining to, or caused by, aphthæ; characterized by aphtæ; as, aphthous ulcers; aphthous fever.

inadvertent.definition: Not turning the mind to a matter; heedless; careless; negligent; inattentive. An inadvertent step may crush the snail That crawls at evening in the public path. Cowper. -- In`ad*vert"ent*ly, adv.

nummulite.definition: A fossil of the genus Nummulites and allied genera.

subduple.definition: Indicating one part of two; in the ratio of one to two. Subduple ratio, the ratio of 1 to 2: thus, 3:6 is a subduple ratio, as 6:3 is a duple ratio.

showy.definition: , a. Etym: [Compar. Showier (; superl. Showiest.]  Making a show; attracting attention; presenting a marked appearance; ostentatious; gay; gaudy. A present of everything that was rich and showy. Addison. Syn. -- Splendid; gay; gaudy; gorgeous; fine; magnificent; grand; stately; sumptuous; pompous.

turnkey.definition: A person who has charge of the keys of a prison, for opening and fastening the doors; a warder. 2. (Dentistry)  An instrument with a hinged claw, -- used for extracting teeth with a twist.

overruling.definition: Exerting controlling power; as, an overruling Providence. -- O`ver*rul"ing*ly, adv.

postulated.definition: Assumed without proof; as, a postulated inference. Sir T. Browne.

caret.definition:
A mark [^] used by writers and proof readers to indicate that something is interlined above, or inserted in the margin, which belongs in the place marked by the caret.

The hawkbill turtle. See Hawkbill.

bodied.definition: Having a body; -- usually in composition; as, able-bodied. A doe . . . not altogether so fat, but very good flesh and good bodied. Hakluyt.

predigestion.definition: Digestion too soon performed; hasty digestion. Bacon. 2. (Med.)  Artificial digestion of food for use in illness or impaired digestion.

sirenia.definition: An order of large aquatic herbivorous mammals, including the manatee, dugong, rytina, and several fossil genera. Note: The hind limbs are either rudimentary or wanting, and the front ones are changed to paddles. They have horny plates on the front part of the jaws, and usually flat-crowned molar tee.

wolffian.definition: Discovered, or first described, by Caspar Friedrich Wolff (1733-1794), the founder of modern embryology. Wolffian body, the mesonephros. -- Wolffian duct, the duct from the Wolffian body.

precautionary.definition: Of or pertaining to precaution, or precautions; as, precautionary signals.

sextic.definition: Of the sixth degree or order. -- n. (Alg.)  A quantic of the sixth degree.

therewithal.definition: Over and above; besides; moreover. Daniel. And therewithal it was full poor and bad. Chaucer. 2. With that or this; therewith; at the same time. Thy slanders I forgive; and therewithal Remit thy other forfeits. Shak. And therewithal one came and seized on her, And Enid started waking. Tennyson.

auctary.definition: That which is superadded; augmentation. Baxter.

shiah.definition:
Same as Shiite.

A member of that branch of the Mohammedans to which the Persians belong. They reject the first three caliphs, and consider Ali as being the first and only rightful successor of Mohammed. They do not acknowledge the Sunna, or body of traditions respecting Mohammed, as any part of the.

preterient.definition: Passed through; antecedent; previous; as, preterient states.

placental.definition:
Of or pertaining to the placenta; having, or characterized by having, a placenta; as, a placental mammal. 2. (Zoöl.)  Of or pertaining to the Placentalia.

One of the Placentalia.

frugalness.definition: , n. Quality of being frugal; frugality.

chess-apple.definition: The wild service of Europe (Purus torminalis).

primrose.definition: (a) An early flowering plant of the genus Primula (P. vulgaris) closely allied to the cowslip. There are several varieties, as the white-, the red-, the yellow-flowered, etc. Formerly called also primerole, primerolles. (b) Any plant of the genus Primula. Evening primrose, an erect biennial herb (En.

hobgoblin.definition: A frightful goblin; an imp; a bugaboo; also, a name formerly given to the household spirit, Robin Goodfellow. Macaulay.

lactarene.definition: A preparation of casein from milk, used in printing calico.

burinist.definition: One who works with the burin. For. Quart. Rev.

urinate.definition: To discharge urine; to make water.

blowess.definition: A prostitute; a courtesan; a strumpet. [Low] Smart.

labium.definition: A lip, or liplike organ. 2. The lip of an organ pipe. 3. pl. (Anat.)  The folds of integument at the opening of the vulva. 4. (Zoöl.) (a) The organ of insects which covers the mouth beneath, and serves as an under lip. It consists of the second pair of maxillæ, usually closely united in the middle l.

forktail.definition: (a) One of several Asiatic and East Indian passerine birds, belonging to Enucurus, and allied genera. The tail is deeply forking. (b) A salmon in its fourth year's growth.

cancrine.definition: Having the qualities of a crab; crablike.

detumescence.definition: Diminution of swelling; subsidence of anything swollen. Cudworth.

displenish.definition: To deprive or strip, as a house of furniture, or a barn of stock. [Scot.].

gunpowder.definition: A black, granular, explosive substance, consisting of an intimate mechanical mixture of niter, charcoal, and sulphur. It is used in gunnery and blasting. Note: Gunpowder consists of from 70 to 80 per cent of niter, with 10 to 15 per cent of each of the other ingredients. Its explosive energy is due.

manly.definition: Having qualities becoming to a man; not childish or womanish; manlike, esp. brave, courageous, resolute, noble. Let's briefly put on manly readiness. Shak. Serene and manly, hardened to sustain The load of life. Dryden. Syn. -- Bold; daring; brave; courageous; firm; undaunted; hardy; dignified; stat.

metanephritic.definition: Of or pertaining to the metanephros.

contravention.definition: The act of contravening; opposition; obstruction; transgression; violation. Warrants in contravention of the acts of Parliament. Macaulay. In contravention of all his marriage stipulations. Motley.

nodulose.definition: Having small nodes or knots; diminutively nodose.

anaglyptograph.definition: An instrument by which a correct engraving of any embossed object, such as a medal or cameo, can be executed. Brande & C.

conglobation.definition: The act or process of forming into a ball. Sir T. Browne. 2. A round body.

festi-val.definition: A time of feasting or celebration; an anniversary day of joy, civil or religious. The morning trumpets festival proclaimed. Milton. Syn. -- Feast; banquet; carousal. See Feast.

gerund.definition: A kind of verbal noun, having only the four oblique cases of the singular number, and governing cases like a participle. 2. (AS. Gram.)  A verbal noun ending in -e, preceded by to and usually denoting purpose or end; -- called also the dative infinitive; as, "Ic hæbbe mete tô etanne" (I have meat to.

ashery.definition: A depository for ashes. 2. A place where potash is made.

proselytize.definition:
To convert to some religion, system, opinion, or the like; to bring, or cause to come, over; to proselyte. One of those whom they endeavor to proselytize. Burke.

To make converts or proselytes.

maugre.definition:
In spite of; in opposition to; notwithstanding. A man must needs love maugre his heed. Chaucer. This mauger all the world will I keep safe. Shak.

To defy. J. Webster.

skillful.definition: Discerning; reasonable; judicious; cunning. "Of skillful judgment." Chaucer. 2. Possessed of, or displaying, skill; knowing and ready; expert; well-versed; able in management; as, a skillful mechanic; -- often followed by at, in, or of; as, skillful at the organ; skillful in drawing. And they shall.

necklaced.definition: Wearing a necklace; marked as with a necklace. The hooded and the necklaced snake. Sir W. Jones.

wreck-master.definition: A person appointed by law to take charge of goods, etc., thrown on shore after a shipwreck.

townsman.definition: An inhabitant of a town; one of the same town with another. Pope. 2. A selectman, in New England. See Selectman.

aurochloride.definition: The trichloride of gold combination with the chloride of another metal, forming a double chloride; -- called also chloraurate.

mellowness.definition: Quality or state of being mellow.

corniculum.definition: A small hornlike part or process.

postgeniture.definition: The condition of being born after another in the same family; - - distinguished from primogeniture. Sir T. Browne.

hatable.definition: Capable of being, or deserving to be, hated; odious; detestable.

imply.definition: To infold or involve; to wrap up. "His head in curls implied." Chapman. 2. To involve in substance or essence, or by fair inference, or by construction of law, when not include virtually; as, war implies fighting. Where a mulicious act is proved, a mulicious intention is implied. Bp. Sherlock. When.

pauperization.definition: The act or process of reducing to pauperism. C. Kingsley.

pentastyle.definition: Having five columns in front; -- said of a temple or portico in classical architecture. -- n.  A portico having five columns.

surcease.definition:
Cessation; stop; end. "Not desire, but its surcease." Longfellow. It is time that there were an end and surcease made of this immodest and deformed manner of writing. Bacon.

To cause to cease; to end. "The waves . . . their range surceast." Spenser. The nations, overawed, surceased the fight. Dryde.

proslavery.definition: Favoring slavery. -- n.  Advocacy of slavery.

discapacitate.definition: To deprive of capacity; to incapacitate.

incan.definition: Of or pertaining to the Incas.

subdue.definition: To bring under; to conquer by force or the exertion of superior power, and bring into permanent subjection; to reduce under dominion; to vanquish. I will subdue all thine enemies. 1 Chron. xvii. 10. 2. To overpower so as to disable from further resistance; to crush. Nothing could have subdued nature.

half-timbered.definition: Constructed of a timber frame, having the spaces filled in with masonry; -- said of buildings.

anights.definition: In the night time; at night. [Archaic] Does he hawk anights still Marston.

unparalleled.definition: Having no parallel, or equal; unequaled; unmatched. The unparalleled perseverance of the armies of the United States, under every suffering and discouragement, was little short of a miracle. Washington.

satirize.definition: To make the object of satire; to attack with satire; to censure with keenness or severe sarcasm. It is as hard to satirize well a man of distinguished vices, as to praise well a man of distinguished virtues. Swift.

biotite.definition: Mica containing iron and magnesia, generally of a black or dark green color; -- a common constituent of crystalline rocks. See Mica.

tittuppy.definition: Given to tittuping; gay; lively; prancing; also, shaky; unsteady.

isoprene.definition: An oily, volatile hydrocarbon, obtained by the distillation of caoutchouc or guttaipercha.C5H8 -- unsaturated, and used to make synthetic rubber by polymerization. In organic chemistry, viewed conceptually as the building block of the terpene series of hydrocarbons.

envier.definition: One who envies; one who desires inordinately what another possesses.

soaker.definition: One who, or that which, soaks. 2. A hard drinker. [Slang] South.

zamang.definition: An immense leguminous tree (Pithecolobium Saman) of Venezuela. Its branches form a hemispherical mass, often one hundred and eighty feet across. The sweet pulpy pods are used commonly for feeding cattle. Also called rain tree. J. Smith (Dict. Econ. Plants).

ingeny.definition: Natural gift or talent; ability; wit; ingenuity. [Written also ingenie.] Becon.

delineatory.definition: That delineates; descriptive; drawing the outline; delineating.

lacrosse.definition: A game of ball, originating among the North American Indians, now the popular field sport of Canada, and played also in England and the United States. Each player carries a long-handled racket, called a "crosse". The ball is not handled but caught with the crosse and carried on it, or tossed from it.

orchidaceous.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, a natural order (Orchidaceæ) of endogenous plants of which the genus Orchis is the type. They are mostly perennial herbs having the stamens and pistils united in a single column, and normally three petals and three sepals, all adherent to the ovary. The flowers are curi.

manichee.definition: A believer in the doctrines of Manes, a Persian of the third century A. D., who taught a dualism in which Light is regarded as the source of Good, and Darkness as the source of Evil. The Manichæans stand as representatives of dualism pushed to its utmost development. Tylor.

banquette.definition: (Fort.)  A raised way or foot bank, running along the inside of a parapet, on which musketeers stand to fire upon the enemy. 2. (Arch.)  A narrow window seat; a raised shelf at the back or the top of a buffet or dresser.

outsit.definition: To remain sitting, or in session, longer than, or beyond the time of; to outstay.

ratter.definition: One who, or that which, rats, as one who deserts his party. 2. Anything which catches rats; esp., a dog trained to catch rats; a rat terrier. See Terrier.

higgle.definition: To hawk or peddle provisions. 2. To chaffer; to stickle for small advantages in buying and selling; to haggle. A person accustomed to higgle about taps. Jeffry. To truck and higgle for a private good. Emerson.

ineffaceable.definition: Incapable of being effaced; indelible; ineradicable.

porism.definition: (Geom.)  A proposition affirming the possibility of finding such conditions as will render a certain determinate problem indeterminate or capable of innumerable solutions. Playfair. 2. (Gr. Geom.)  A corollary. Brande & C. Note: Three books of porisms of Euclid have been lost, but several attempts t.

eerie.definition: Serving to inspire fear, esp. a dread of seeing ghosts; wild; weird; as, eerie stories. She whose elfin prancer springs By night to eery warblings. Tennyson. 2. Affected with fear; affrighted. Burns.

ghibelline.definition: One of a faction in Italy, in the 12th and 13th centuries, which favored the German emperors, and opposed the Guelfs, or adherents of the poses. Brande & C.

marbler.definition: One who works upon marble or other stone. Fuller. 2. One who colors or stains in imitation of marble.

honorably.definition: In an honorable manner; in a manner showing, or consistent with, honor. The reverend abbot . . . honorably received him. Shak. Why did I not more honorably starve Dryden. 2. Decently; becomingly. "Do this message honorably." Shak. Syn. -- Magnanimously; generously; nobly; worthily; justly; equitably.

acrase.definition: To craze. Grafton. 2. To impair; to destroy. Hacket.

equisetaceous.definition: Belonging to the Equisetaceæ, or Horsetail family.

necromantical.definition: Of or pertaining to necromancy; performed by necromancy. -- Nec`ro*man"tic*al*ly, adv.

evilness.definition: The condition or quality of being evil; badness; viciousness; malignity; vileness; as, evilness of heart; the evilness of sin.

uncompromising.definition: Not admitting of compromise; making no truce or concessions; obstinate; unyielding; inflexible. -- Un*com"pro*mi`sing*ly, adv.

lunt.definition: The match cord formerly used in firing cannon. 2. A puff of smoke. [Scotch.] Burns.

rochelle.definition: A seaport town in France. Rochelle powders. Same as Seidlitz powders. -- Rochelle salt (Chem.), the double tartrate of sodium and potassium, a white crystalline substance. It has a cooling, saline, slightly bitter taste and is employed as a mild purgative. It was discovered by Seignette, an apotheca.

petronel.definition: A sort of hand cannon, or portable firearm, used in France in the 15th century.

oophyte.definition: Any plant of a proposed class or grand division (collectively termed oöphytes or Oöphyta), which have their sexual reproduction accomplished by motile antherozoids acting on oöspheres, either while included in their oögonia or after exclusion. Note: This class was at first called Oösporeæ, and is ma.

familiarity.definition: The state of being familiar; intimate and frequent converse, or association; unconstrained intercourse; freedom from ceremony and constraint; intimacy; as, to live in remarkable familiarity. 2. Anything said or done by one person to another unceremoniously and without constraint; esp., in the pl., s.

datary.definition: (R. C. Ch.)  An officer in the pope's court, having charge of the Dataria. 2. The office or employment of a datary.

proximad.definition: Toward a proximal part; on the proximal side of; proximally.

serge.definition:
A woolen twilled stuff, much used as material for clothing for both sexes. Silk serge, a twilled silk fabric used mostly by tailors for lining parts of gentlemen's coats.

A large wax candle used in the ceremonies of various churches.

hypnum.definition: The largest genus of true mosses; feather moss.

tiglic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, an acid, C4H7CO2H (called also methyl crotonic acid), homologous with crotonic acid, and obtained from croton oil (from Croton Tiglium) as a white crystalline substance.

watchmaker.definition: One whose occupation is to make and repair watches.

unitable.definition: Capable of union by growth or otherwise. Owen.

voyageur.definition: A traveler; -- applied in Canada to a man employed by the fur companies in transporting goods by the rivers and across the land, to and from the remote stations in the Northwest.

penner.definition: One who pens; a writer. Sir T. North. 2. A case for holding pens.

puncto.definition: A nice point of form or ceremony. Bacon. 2. A term applied to the point in fencing. Farrow.

algates.definition: Always; wholly; everywhere. Ulna now he algates must forego. Spenser. Note: Still used in the north of England in the sense of "everywhere." 2. By any or means; at all events. Fairfax. 3. Notwithstanding; yet. Chaucer.

exalt.definition: To raise high; to elevate; to lift up. I will exalt my throne above the stars of God. Is. xiv. 13. Exalt thy towery head, and lift thine eyes Pope. 2. To elevate in rank, dignity, power, wealth, character, or the like; to dignify; to promote; as, to exalt a prince to the throne, a citizen to the pre.

pedagogism.definition: The system, occupation, character, or manner of pedagogues. Milton. Avocation of pedantry and pedagogism. De Foe.

belled.definition: Hung with a bell or bells.

plastography.definition: The art of forming figures in any plastic material. 2. Imitation of handwriting; forgery.

yellowwort.definition: A European yellow-flowered, gentianaceous (Chlora perfoliata). The whole plant is intensely bitter, and is sometimes used as a tonic, and also in dyeing yellow.

marai.definition: A sacred inclosure or temple; -- so called by the islanders of the Pacific Ocean.

wassailer.definition: One who drinks wassail; one who engages in festivity, especially in drinking; a reveler. The rudeness and swilled insolence Of such late wassailers. Milton.

inexpert.definition: Destitute of experience or of much experience. Milton. 2. Not expert; not skilled; destitute of knowledge or dexterity derived from practice. Akenside.

animator.definition: One who, or that which, animates; an animater. Sir T. Browne.

unreprievable.definition: Not capable of being reprieved. Shak.

sphaerenchyma.definition: Vegetable tissue composed of thin-walled rounded cells, -- a modification of parenchyma.

marble-edged.definition: Having the edge veined or spotted with different colors like marble, as a book.

flinty.definition: Consisting of, composed of, abounding in, or resembling, flint; as, a flinty rock; flinty ground; a flinty heart. Flinty rockFlinty state, a siliceous slate; -- basanite is here included. See Basanite.

polypterus.definition: An African genus of ganoid fishes including the bichir.

tyrant.definition: An absolute ruler; a sovereign unrestrained by law or constitution; a usurper of sovereignty. Note: Free governments [in Greece] having superseded the old hereditary sovereignties (basilei^ai), all who obtained absolute power in a state were called ty\rannoi, tyrants, or rather despots; - - for the.

tinean.definition: Any species of Tinea, or of the family Tineidæ, which includes numerous small moths, many of which are injurious to woolen and fur goods and to cultivated plants. Also used adjectively.

inexpressibles.definition: Breeches; trousers. [Colloq. or Slang] Ld. Lytton.

borachte.definition: A large leather bottle for liquors, etc., made of the skin of a goat or other animal. Hence: A drunkard. You're an absolute borachio. Congreve.

cinnabarine.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, cinnabar; consisting of cinnabar, or containing it; as, cinnabarine sand.

tenable.definition: Capable of being held, naintained, or defended, as against an assailant or objector, or againts attempts to take or process; as, a tenable fortress, a tenable argument. If you have hitherto concealed his sight, Let it be tenable in your silence still. Shak. I would be the last man in the world to gi.

cadrans.definition: An instrument with a graduated disk by means of which the angles of gems are measured in the process of cutting and polishing.

gypsography.definition: The act or art of engraving on gypsum.

tablebook.definition: A tablet; a notebook. Put into your tablebook whatever you judge worthly. Dryden.

bead.definition: A prayer. 2. A little perforated ball, to be strung on a thread, and worn for ornament; or used in a rosary for counting prayers, as by Roman Catholics and Mohammedans, whence the phrases to tell beads, to at one's beads, to bid beads, etc., meaning, to be at prayer. 3. Any small globular body; as,.

malefic.definition: Doing mischief; causing harm or evil; nefarious; hurtful. Chaucer.

autoptic.definition: Seen with one's own eyes; belonging to, or connected with, personal observation; as, autoptic testimony or experience.

symbranchii.definition: An order of slender eel-like fishes having the gill openings confluent beneath the neck. The pectoral arch is generally attached to the skull, and the entire margin of the upper jaw is formed by the premaxillary. Called also Symbranchia.

synanthesis.definition: The simultaneous maturity of the anthers and stigmas of a blossom. Gray.

siphonophoran.definition: Belonging to the Siphonophora. -- n.  One of the Siphonophora.

prescient.definition: Having knowledge of coming events; foreseeing; conscious beforehand. Pope. Henry . . . had shown himself sensible, and almost prescient, of this event. Bacon.

topstone.definition: A stone that is placed on the top, or which forms the top.

gooroo.definition: A spiritual teacher, guide, or confessor amoung the Hindoos. Malcom.

propodium.definition: (a) The anterior portion of the foot of a mollusk. (b) The segment which forms the posterior part of the thorax of a hymenopterous insect. [Written also propodeum.].

screwer.definition: One who, or that which, screws.

oscitation.definition: The act of yawning or gaping. Addison.

unlace.definition: To loose by undoing a lacing; as, to unlace a shoe. 2. To loose the dress of; to undress; hence, to expose; to disgrace. What's the matter, That you unlace your reputation thus Shak. 3. (Naut.)  To loose, and take off, as a bonnet from a sail, or to cast off, as any lacing in any part of the rigging.

durability.definition: The state or quality of being durable; the power of uninterrupted or long continuance in any condition; the power of resisting agents or influences which tend to cause changes, decay, or dissolution; lastingness. A Gothic cathedral raises ideas of grandeur in our minds by the size, its height, . . .

nematogene.definition: One of the dimorphic forms of the species of Dicyemata, which produced vermiform embryos; -- opposed to Ant: rhombogene.

mazame.definition: A goatlike antelope (Haplocerus montanus) which inhabits the Rocky Mountains, frequenting the highest parts; -- called also mountain goat.

gruesome.definition:
, Grue"some, a. Etym: [From a word akin to Dan. gru horror, terror + -some; cf. D. gruwzaam, G. grausam. Cf. Grisly.]  Ugly; frightful. Grewsome sights of war. C. Kingsley.

Same as Grewsome. [Scot.].

invariability.definition: The quality of being invariable; invariableness; constancy; uniformity.

custrel.definition:
An armor-bearer to a knight.

See Costrel. Ainsworth.

jeel.definition: A morass; a shallow lake. [Written also jhil.] [India] Whitworth.

propensity.definition: The quality or state of being propense; natural inclination; disposition to do good or evil; bias; bent; tendency. "A propensity to utter blasphemy." Macaulay. Syn. -- Disposition; bias; inclination; proclivity; proneness; bent; tendency.

peribolos.definition: In ancient architecture, an inclosed court, esp., one surrounding a temple.

buzzingly.definition: In a buzzing manner; with a buzzing sound.

pedimanous.definition: Having feet resembling hands, or with the first toe opposable, as the opossums and monkeys.

zamite.definition: A fossil cycad of the genus Zamia.

discinct.definition: Ungirded; loosely dressed. Sir W. Scott.

reformed.definition: Corrected; amended; restored to purity or excellence; said, specifically, of the whole body of Protestant churches originating in the Reformation. Also, in a more restricted sense, of those who separated from Luther on the doctrine of consubstantiation, etc., and carried the Reformation, as they cla.

polygenism.definition: The doctrine that animals of the same species have sprung from more than one original pair.

indecision.definition: Want of decision; want of settled purpose, or of firmness; indetermination; wavering of mind; irresolution; vacillation; hesitation. The term indecision . . . implies an idea very nicely different from irresolution; yet it has a tendency to produce it. Shenstone. Indecision . . . is the natural acco.

scioptic.definition: Of or pertaining to an optical arrangement for forming images in a darkened room, usually called scioptic ball. Scioptic ball (Opt.), the lens of a camera obscura mounted in a wooden ball which fits a socket in a window shutter so as to be readily turned, like the eye, to different parts of the land.

demurely.definition: In a demure manner; soberly; gravely; -- now, commonly, with a mere show of gravity or modesty. They . . . looked as demurely as they could; for 't was a hanging matter to laugh unseasonably. Dryden.

decametre.definition: A measure of length in the metric system; ten meters, equal to about 393.7 inches.

gaussage.definition: The intensity of a magnetic field expressed in C.G.S. units, or gausses.

wooded.definition: Supplied or covered with wood, or trees; as, land wooded and watered. The brook escaped from the eye down a deep and wooded dell. Sir W. Scott.

epidemiological.definition: Connected with, or pertaining to, epidemiology.

dogmatics.definition: The science which treats of Christian doctrinal theology.

pressive.definition: Pressing; urgent; also, oppressive; as, pressive taxation. Bp. Hall.

risker.definition: One who risks or hazards. Hudibras.

malacozoa.definition: An extensive group of Invertebrata, including the Mollusca, Brachiopoda, and Bryozoa. Called also Malacozoaria.

snail.definition: (Zoöl.) (a) Any one of numerous species of terrestrial air-breathing gastropods belonging to the genus Helix and many allied genera of the family Helicidæ. They are abundant in nearly all parts of the world except the arctic regions, and feed almost entirely on vegetation; a land sanil. (b) Any gast.

underneath.definition:
Beneath; below; in a lower place; under; as, a channel underneath the soil. Or sullen mole, that runneth underneath. Milton.

Under; beneath; below. Underneath this stone lie As much beauty as could die. B. Jonson.

anaplasty.definition: The art of operation of restoring lost parts or the normal shape by the use of healthy tissue.

annularity.definition: Annular condition or form; as, the annularity of a nebula. J. Rogers.

expiator.definition: One who makes expiation or atonement.

colicroot.definition: A bitter American herb of the Bloodwort family, with the leaves all radical, and the small yellow or white flowers in a long spike (Aletris farinosa and A. aurea). Called sometimes star grass, blackroot, blazing star, and unicorn root.

clifted.definition: Broken; fissured. Climb the Andeclifted side. Grainger.

capsize.definition:
To upset or overturn, as a vessel or other body. But what if carrying sail capsize the boat Byron.

An upset or overturn.

well-bred.definition: Having good breeding; refined in manners; polite; cultivated. I am as well-bred as the earl's granddaughter. Thackera.

sugarplum.definition: A kind of candy or sweetneat made up in small balls or disks.

tweak.definition:
To pinch and pull with a sudden jerk and twist; to twitch; as, to tweak the nose. Shak.

1. A sharp pinch or jerk; a twist or twitch; as, a tweak of the nose. Swift. 2. Trouble; distress; tweag. 3. A prostitute. Brathwait.

overofficious.definition: Too busy; too ready to intermeddle; too officious. Collier.

puccoon.definition: Any one of several plants yielding a red pigment which is used by the North American Indians, as the bloodroot and two species of Lithospermum (L. hirtum, and L. canescens); also, the pigment itself.

subterranity.definition: A place under ground; a subterrany. Sir T. Browne.

slabber.definition:
To let saliva or some liquid fall from the mouth carelessly, like a child or an idiot; to drivel; to drool. [Written also slaver, and slobber.]

1. To wet and foul spittle, or as if with spittle. He slabbered me over, from cheek to cheek, with his great tongue. Arbuthnot. 2. To spill liquid upon; to.

overbold.definition: Excessively or presumptuously bold; impudent. Shak. -- O"ver*bold"ly, adv.

enravish.definition: To transport with delight; to enrapture; to fascinate. Spenser.

verminly.definition: Resembling vermin; in the manner of vermin. Gauden.

allegoric.definition: Belonging to, or consisting of, allegory; of the nature of an allegory; describing by resemblances; figurative. "An allegoric tale." Falconer. "An allegorical application." Pope. Allegorical being . . . that kind of language which says one thing, but means another. Max Miller. Al`le*gor"ic*al*ly, ad.

bewray.definition:
To soil. See Beray.

To expose; to reveal; to disclose; to betray. [Obs. or Archaic] The murder being once done, he is in less fear, and in more hope that the deed shall not be bewrayed or known. Robynson (More's Utopia. ) Thy speech bewrayeth thee. Matt. xxvi. 73.

hundredfold.definition: A hundred times as much or as many. He shall receive as hundredfold now in this time. Mark x. 30.

vernal.definition: Of or pertaining to the spring; appearing in the spring; as, vernal bloom. 2. Fig.: Belonging to youth, the spring of life. When after the long vernal day of life. Thomson. And seems it hard thy vernal years Few vernal joys can show Keble. Vernal equinox (Astron.), the time when the sun crosses the.

beaker.definition: A large drinking cup, with a wide mouth, supported on a foot or standard. 2. An open-mouthed, thin glass vessel, having a projecting lip for pouring; -- used for holding solutions requiring heat. Knight.

plainant.definition: One who makes complaint; the plaintiff.

chemiotaxis.definition: The sensitiveness exhibited by small free-swimming organisms, as bacteria, zoöspores of algæ, etc., to chemical substances held in solution. They may be attracted (positive chemotaxis) or repelled (negative chemotaxis). -- Chem`o*tac"tic (#), a. -- Chem`o*tac"tic*al*ly, adv.

tentage.definition: A collection of tents; an encampment. Drayton.

shoading.definition: The tracing of veins of metal by shoads. [Written also shoding.] Pryce.

testy.definition: Fretful; peevish; petulant; easily irritated. Must I observe you must I stand and crouch Under your testy humor Shak. I was displeased with myself; I was testy. Latimer.

jockey.definition:
A professional rider of horses in races. Addison. 2. A dealer in horses; a horse trader. Macaulay. 3. A cheat; one given to sharp practice in trade.

1. " To jostle by riding against one." Johnson. 2. To play the jockey toward; to cheat; to trick; to impose upon in trade; as, to jockey a customer.

sclerotic.definition: Hard; firm; indurated; -- applied especially in anatomy to the firm outer coat of the eyeball, which is often cartilaginous and sometimes bony. 2. (Anat.)  Of or pertaining to the sclerotic coat of the eye; sclerotical. 3. (Med.) Affected with sclerosis; sclerosed. Sclerotic parenchyma (Bot.), scler.

suster.definition: Sister. Chaucer. There are seven sustren, that serve truth ever. Piers Plowman.

chalcedony.definition: A cryptocrystalline, translucent variety of quartz, having usually a whitish color, and a luster nearly like wax. [Written also calcedony.] Note: When chalcedony is variegated with with spots or figures, or arranged in differently colored layers, it is called agate; and if by reason of the thickness.

deminatured.definition: Having half the nature of another. Shak.

heptoic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, heptane; as, heptoic acid.

fond.definition:
imp. of Find. Found. Chaucer.

1. Foolish; silly; simple; weak. [Archaic] Grant I may never prove so fond To trust man on his oath or bond. Shak. 2. Foolishly tender and loving; weakly indulgent; over-affectionate. 3. Affectionate; loving; tender; -- in a good sense; as, a fond mother or wife. Addis.

petrosal.definition: (a) Hard; stony; petrous; as, the petrosal bone; petrosal part of the temporal bone. (b) Of, pertaining to, or in the region of, the petrous, or petrosal, bone, or the corresponding part of the temporal bone. Petrosal bone (Anat.), a bone corresponding to the petrous portion of the temporal bone of.

congregationalism.definition: That system of church organization which vests all ecclesiastical power in the assembled brotherhood of each local church. 2. The faith and polity of the Congregational churches, taken collectively. Note: In this sense (which is its usual signification) Congregationalism is the system of faith and p.

surveying.definition: That branch of applied mathematics which teaches the art of determining the area of any portion of the earth's surface, the length and directions of the bounding lines, the contour of the surface, etc., with an accurate delineation of the whole on paper; the act or occupation of making surveys. Geod.

astronomize.definition: To study or to talk astronomy. They astronomized in caves. Sir T. Browne.

disembossom.definition: To separate from the bosom. Young.

cynanthropy.definition: A kind of madness in which men fancy themselves changed into dogs, and imitate the voice and habits of that animal.

defluxion.definition: A discharge or flowing of humors or fluid matter, as from the nose in catarrh; -- sometimes used synonymously with inflammation. Dunglison.

seljukian.definition:
Of or pertaining to Seljuk, a Tartar chief who embraced Mohammedanism, and began the subjection of Western Asia to that faith and rule; of or pertaining to the dynasty founded by him, or the empire maintained by his descendants from the 10th to the 13th century. J. H. Newman.

A member of the family.

patchy.definition: Full of, or covered with, patches; abounding in patches.

bihydroguret.definition: A compound of two atoms of hydrogen with some other substance.

fizgig.definition:
A fishing spear. Sandys.

A firework, made of damp powder, which makes a fizzing or hissing noise when it explodes.

A gadding, flirting girl. Gosson.

froth.definition: The bubbles caused in fluids or liquors by fermentation or agitation; spume; foam; esp., a spume of saliva caused by disease or nervous excitement. 2. Any empty, senseless show of wit or eloquence; rhetoric without thought. Johnson. It was a long speech, but all froth. L'Estrange. 3. Light, unsubsta.

twelvepence.definition: A shilling sterling, being about twenty-four cents.

inceptive.definition:
Beginning; expressing or indicating beginning; as, an inceptive proposition; an inceptive verb, which expresses the beginning of action; -- called also inchoative. -- In*cep"tive*ly, adv.

An inceptive word, phrase, or clause.

astheny.definition: Want or loss of strength; debility; diminution of the vital forces.

eugenol.definition: A colorless, aromatic, liquid hydrocarbon, C10H12O2 resembling the phenols, and hence also called eugenic acid. It is found in the oils of pimento and cloves.

deplorate.definition: Deplorable. A more deplorate estate. Baker.

spiraea.definition: A genus of shrubs or perennial herbs including the meadowsweet and the hardhack.

pollard.definition:
A tree having its top cut off at some height above the ground, that may throw out branches. Pennant. 2. A clipped coin; also, a counterfeit. Camden. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) A fish, the chub. (b) A stag that has cast its antlers. (c) A hornless animal (cow or sheep).

To lop the tops of, as trees; to poll; as.

humus.definition: That portion of the soil formed by the decomposition of animal or vegetable matter. It is a valuable constituent of soils. Graham.

vindicable.definition: Capable of being vindicated. -- Vin`di*ca*bil"i*ty, n.

cutlery.definition: The business of a cutler. 2. Edged or cutting instruments, collectively.

besiege.definition: To beset or surround with armed forces, for the purpose of compelling to surrender; to lay siege to; to beleaguer; to beset. Till Paris was besieged, famished, and lost. Shak. Syn. -- To environ; hem in; invest; encompass.

woofy.definition: Having a close texture; dense; as, a woofy cloud. J. Baillie.

commatic.definition: Having short clauses or sentences; brief; concise.

antipole.definition: The opposite pole; anything diametrically opposed. Geo. Eliot.

linga.definition: The phallic symbol under which Siva is principally worshiped in his character of the creative and reproductive power. Whitworth. E. Arnold.

isogeothermic.definition: Pertaining to, having the nature of, or marking, isogeotherms; as, an isogeothermal line or surface; as isogeothermal chart. -- n.  An isogeotherm.

middlemost.definition: Being in the middle, or nearest the middle; midmost.

polygonaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to a natural order of apetalous plants (Polygonaceæ), of which the knotweeds (species of Polygonum) are the type, and which includes also the docks (Rumex), the buckwheat, rhubarb, sea grape (Coccoloba), and several other genera.

tutorship.definition: The office, duty, or care of a tutor; guardianship; tutelage. Hooker.

aleurone.definition: An albuminoid substance which occurs in minute grains ("protein granules") in maturing seeds and tubers; -- supposed to be a modification of protoplasm.

carotte.definition: A cylindrical roll of tobacco; as, a carotte of perique.

cottier.definition: In Great Britain and Ireland, a person who hires a small cottage, with or without a plot of land. Cottiers commonly aid in the work of the landlord's farm. [Written also cottar and cotter.].

younker.definition: A young person; a stripling; a yonker. [Obs. or Colloq.] That same younker soon was overthrown. Spenser.

humid.definition: Containing sensible moisture; damp; moist; as, a humidair or atmosphere; somewhat wet or watery; as, humid earth; consisting of water or vapor. Evening cloud, or humid bow. Milton.

bummery.definition: See Bottomery. There was a scivener of Wapping brought to hearing for relief against a bummery bond. R. North.

anent.definition: Over against; as, he lives anent the church. 2. About; concerning; in respect; as, he said nothing anent this particular.

corndodger.definition: A cake made of the meal of Indian corn, wrapped in a covering of husks or paper, and baked under the embers. [U.S.] Bartlett.

gallinaceous.definition: Resembling the domestic fowls and pheasants; of or pertaining to the Gallinae.

swearing.definition: from Swear, v. Idle swearing is a cursedness. Chaucer.

squawk.definition:
To utter a shrill, abrupt scream; to squeak harshly. Squawking thrush (Zoöl.), the missel turush; -- so called from its note when alarmed.

1. Act of squawking; a harsh squeak. 2. (Zoöl.)  The American night heron. See under Night. Squawk duck (Zoöl.), the bimaculate duck (Anas glocitans). It has pa.

vicunya.definition: A South American mammal (Auchenia vicunna) native of the elevated plains of the Andes, allied to the llama but smaller. It has a thick coat of very fine reddish brown wool, and long, pendent white hair on the breast and belly. It is hunted for its wool and flesh.

coextensive.definition: Equally extensive; having as, consciousness and knowledge are coextensive. Sir W. Hamilton. -- Co`ex*ten"sive*ly, adv. -- Co`ex*ten"sive*ness, n.

twining.definition:
Winding around something; twisting; embracing; climbing by winding about a support; as, the hop is a twinning plant.

The act of one who, or that which, twines; (Bot.) the act of climbing spirally.

reimport.definition: To import again; to import what has been exported; to bring back. Young.

formicaroid.definition: Like or pertaining to the family Formicaridæ or ant thrushes.

undeceive.definition: To cause to be no longer deceived; to free from deception, fraud, fallacy, or mistake. South.

clavigerous.definition: Bearing a club or a key.

materialization.definition: The act of materializing, or the state of being materialized.

covenantor.definition: The party who makes a covenant. Burrill.

sivatherium.definition: A genus of very large extinct ruminants found in the Tertiary formation of India. The snout was prolonged in the form of a proboscis. The male had four horns, the posterior pair being large and branched. It was allied to the antelopes, but very much larger than any exsisting species.

foxearth.definition: A hole in the earth to which a fox resorts to hide himself.

phimosis.definition: A condition of the penis in which the prepuce can not be drawn back so as to uncover the glans penis.

gracious.definition: Abounding in grace or mercy; manifesting love,. or bestowing mercy; characterized by grace; beneficent; merciful; disposed to show kindness or favor; condescending; as, his most gracious majesty. A god ready to pardon, gracious and merciful. Neh. ix. 17. So hallowed and so gracious in the time. Shak.

scholasticism.definition: The method or subtitles the schools of philosophy; scholastic formality; scholastic doctrines or philosophy. The spirit of the old scholasticism . . . spurned laborious investigation and slow induction. J. P. Smith.

cooperage.definition: Work done by a cooper. 2. The price paid for coopers; work. 3. A place where coopers' work is done.

gyrostat.definition: A modification of the gyroscope, consisting essentially of a fly wheel fixed inside a rigid case to which is attached a thin flange of metal for supporting the instrument. It is used in studying the dynamics of rotating bodies.

rhodochrosite.definition: Manganese carbonate, a rose-red mineral sometimes occuring crystallized, but generally massive with rhombohedral cleavage like calcite; -- called also dialogite.

conversableness.definition: The quality of being conversable; disposition to converse; sociability.

intensively.definition: In an intensive manner; by increase of degree. Abp. Bramhall.

economist.definition: One who economizes, or manages domestic or other concerns with frugality; one who expends money, time, or labor, judiciously, and without waste. "Economists even to parsimony." Burke. 2. One who is conversant with political economy; a student of economics.

driftless.definition: Having no drift or direction; without aim; purposeless.

subdeaconship.definition: The order or office of subdeacon.

substantiveness.definition: The quality or state of being substantive.

bowfin.definition: A voracious ganoid fish (Amia calva) found in the fresh waters of the United States; the mudfish; -- called also Johnny Grindle, and dogfish.

umbriferous.definition: Casting or making a shade; umbrageous. -- Um*brif"er*ous*ly, adv.

homosystemic.definition: Developing, in the case of multicellular organisms, from the same embryonic systems into which the secondary unit (gastrula or plant enbryo) differentiates.

slugabed.definition: One who indulges in lying abed; a sluggard. "Fie, you slugabed!" Shak.

cochleare.definition: A spoon. Andrews. 2. (Med)  A spoonful. Dungleson.

pestillation.definition: The act of pounding and bruising with a pestle in a mortar. Sir T. Browne.

rush-bearing.definition: A kind of rural festival at the dedication of a church, when the parishioners brought rushes to strew the church. [Eng.] Nares.

wig.definition: A covering for the head, consisting of hair interwoven or united by a kind of network, either in imitation of the natural growth, or in abundant and flowing curls, worn to supply a deficiency of natural hair, or for ornament, or according to traditional usage, as a part of an official or professiona.

colophonite.definition: A coarsely granular variety of garnet.

saccule.definition: A little sac; specifically, the sacculus of the ear.

sannup.definition: A male Indian; a brave; -- correlative of squaw.

subriguous.definition: Watered or wet beneath; well-watered. Blount.

modality.definition: The quality or state of being modal. 2. (Logic & Metaph.)  A modal relation or quality; a mode or point of view under which an object presents itself to the mind. According to Kant, the quality of propositions, as assertory, problematical, or apodeictic.

puzzledom.definition: The domain of puzzles; puzzles, collectively. C. Kingsley.

lanneret.definition: A long-tailed falcon (Falco lanarius), of Southern Europe, Asia, and Northern Africa, resembling the American prairie falcon.

affirmant.definition: One who affirms or asserts. 2. (Law)  One who affirms of taking an oath.

impropriation.definition: The act of impropriating; as, the impropriation of property or tithes; also, that which is impropriated. 2. (Eng. Eccl. Law) (a) The act of putting an ecclesiastical benefice in the hands of a layman, or lay corporation. (b) A benefice in the hands of a layman, or of a lay corporation.

rubian.definition: One of several color-producing glycosides found in madder root.

day-star.definition: The morning star; the star which ushers in the day. A dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts. 2 Peter i. 19. 2. The sun, as the orb of day. [Poetic] So sinks the day-star in the ocean bed, And yet anon repairs his drooping head, And tricks his beams, and with new-spang.

diaper.definition: Any textile fabric (esp. linen or cotton toweling) woven in diaper pattern. See 2. 2. (Fine Arts)  Surface decoration of any sort which consists of the constant repetition of one or more simple figures or units of design evenly spaced. 3. A towel or napkin for wiping the hands, etc. Let one attend h.

chastened.definition: Corrected; disciplined; refined; purified; toned down. Sir. W. Scott. Of such a finished chastened purity. Tennyson.

salutation.definition: The act of saluting, or paying respect or reverence, by the customary words or actions; the act of greeting, or expressing good will or courtesy; also, that which is uttered or done in saluting or greeting. In all public meetings or private addresses, use those forms of salutation, reverence, and de.

chrysosperm.definition: The seed of gold; a means of creating gold. B. Jonson.

arcturus.definition: A fixed star of the first magnitude in the constellation Boötes. Note: Arcturus has sometimes been incorrectly used as the name of the constellation, or even of Ursa Major. Canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons [Rev. Ver.: "the Bear with her train"]. Job xxxviii. 32.

puree.definition: A dish made by boiling any article of food to a pulp and rubbing it through a sieve; as, a purée of fish, or of potatoes; especially, a soup the thickening of which is so treated.

confessionalism.definition: An exaggerated estimate of the importance of giving full assent to any particular formula of the Christian faith. Shaff.

philomathy.definition: The love of learning or letters.

aroideous.definition: Belonging to, or resembling, the Arum family of plants.

curtana.definition: The pointless sword carried before English monarchs at their coronation, and emblematically considered as the sword of mercy; -- also called the sword of Edward the Confessor.

bulldog.definition: (Zoöl.)  A variety of dog, of remarkable ferocity, courage, and tenacity of grip; -- so named, probably, from being formerly employed in baiting bulls. 2. (Metal.)  A refractory material used as a furnace lining, obtained by calcining the cinder or slag from the puddling furnace of a rolling mill.

decagynian.definition: Belonging to the Decagynia; having ten styles.

philanthropic.definition: Of or pertaining to philanthropy; characterized by philanthropy; loving or helping mankind; as, a philanthropic enterprise. -- Phil`an*throp"ic*al*ly, adv.

school-teacher.definition: One who teaches or instructs a school. -- School"-teach`ing, n.

oxonian.definition:
Of or relating to the city or the university of Oxford, England. Macaulay.

A student or graduate of Oxford University, in England.

forceless.definition: Having little or no force; feeble. These forceless flowers like sturdy trees support me. Shak.

lithotype.definition:
A kind of stereotype plate made by lithotypy; also, that which in printed from it. See Lithotypy.

To prepare for printing with plates made by the process of lithotypy. See Lithotypy.

consonancy.definition: (Mus.)  Accord or agreement of sounds produced simultaneously, as a note with its third, fifth, and eighth. 2. Agreement or congruity; harmony; accord; consistency; suitableness. The perfect consonancy of our persecuted church to the doctrines of Scripture and antiquity. Hammond. The optic nerve res.

besetter.definition: One who, or that which, besets.

sharpsaw.definition: The great titmouse; -- so called from its harsh call notes.

unprayed.definition: Not prayed for. Sir T. More.

emotionalism.definition: The cultivation of an emotional state of mind; tendency to regard things in an emotional manner.

meretricious.definition: Of or pertaining to prostitutes; having to do with harlots; lustful; as, meretricious traffic. 2. Resembling the arts of a harlot; alluring by false show; gaudily and deceitfully ornamental; tawdry; as, meretricious dress or ornaments. -- Mer`e*tri"cious*ly, adv. -- Mer`e*tri"cious*ness, n.

drie.definition: To endure. So causeless such drede for to drie. Chaucer.

araneiform.definition: Having the form of a spider. Kirby.

literalist.definition: One who adheres to the letter or exact word; an interpreter according to the letter.

bibbs.definition: Pieces of timber bolted to certain parts of a mast tp support the trestletrees.

drooper.definition: One who, or that which, droops.

copperas.definition: Green vitriol, or sulphate of iron; a green crystalline substance, of an astringent taste, used in making ink, in dyeing black, as a tonic in medicine, etc. It is made on a large scale by the oxidation of iron pyrites. Called also ferrous sulphate. Note: The term copperas was formerly synonymous wit.

smeir.definition: A salt glaze on pottery, made by adding common salt to an earthenware glaze.

icily.definition: In an icy manner; coldly. Faultily faultless, icily regular, splendidly null, Dead perfection, no more. Tennyson.

vaccinator.definition: One who, or that which, vaccinates.

obstetrical.definition: Of or pertaining to midwifery, or the delivery of women in childbed; as, the obstetric art. Obstetrical toad (Zoöl.), a European toad of the genus Alytes, especially A. obstetricans. The eggs are laid in a string which the male winds around his legs, and carries about until the young are hatched.

darg.definition: A day's work; also, a fixed amount of work, whether more or less than that of a day. [Local, Eng. & Scott].

self-fertilized.definition: Fertilized by pollen from the same flower.

aplanatic.definition: Having two or more parts of different curvatures, so combined as to remove spherical aberration; -- said of a lens.
