rhinoceros.definition: Any pachyderm belonging to the genera Rhinoceros, Atelodus, and several allied genera of the family Rhinocerotidæ, of which several living, and many extinct, species are known. They are large and powerful, and usually have either one or two stout conical median horns on the snout. Note: The Indian,.

hoppestere.definition: An unexplained epithet used by Chaucer in reference to ships. By some it is defined as "dancing (on the wave)"; by others as "opposing," "warlike." T. R. Lounsbury.

collagen.definition: The chemical basis of ordinary connective tissue, as of tendons or sinews and of bone. On being boiled in water it becomes gelatin or glue.

nearhand.definition: Near; near at hand; closely. [Obs. or Scot.] Bacon.

heatingly.definition: In a heating manner; so as to make or become hot or heated.

capacious.definition: Having capacity; able to contain much; large; roomy; spacious; extended; broad; as, a capacious vessel, room, bay, or harbor. In the capacious recesses of his mind. Bancroft. 2. Able or qualified to make large views of things, as in obtaining knowledge or forming designs; comprehensive; liberal. "A.

foreskirt.definition: The front skirt of a garment, in distinction from the train. Honor's train Is longer than his foreskirt. Shak.

transnatation.definition: The act of swimming across, as a river.

embroyde.definition: To embroider; to adorn. Embrowded was he, as it were a mead All full of fresshe flowers, white and red. Chaucer.

intimation.definition: The act of intimating; also, the thing intimated. 2. Announcement; declaration. Macaulay. They made an edict with an intimation that whosoever killed a stork, should be banished. Holland. 3. A hint; an obscure or indirect suggestion or notice; a remote or ambiguous reference; as, he had given only i.

objectiveness.definition: Objectivity. Is there such a motion or objectiveness of external bodies, which produceth light Sir M. Hale.

strepitores.definition: A division of birds, including the clamatorial and picarian birds, which do not have well developed singing organs.

phylarchy.definition: The office of a phylarch; government of a class or tribe.

phonotypic.definition: Of or pertaining to phonotypy; as, a phonotypic alphabet.

gainage.definition: (a) The horses, oxen, plows, wains or wagons and implements for carrying on tillage. (b) The profit made by tillage; also, the land itself. Bouvier.

tungstenic.definition: Of or pertaining to tungsten; containing tungsten; as, tungstenic ores.

frangible.definition: Capable of being broken; brittle; fragile; easily broken.

chrysocolla.definition: A hydrous silicate of copper, occurring massive, of a blue or greenish blue color.

petitioning.definition: The act of presenting apetition; a supplication.

disobliging.definition: Not obliging; not disposed to do a favor; unaccommodating; as, a disobliging person or act. 2. Displeasing; offensive. Cov. of Tongue. -- Dis`o*bli"ging*ly, adv. -- Dis`o*bli"ging*ness, n.

macaronic.definition:
Pertaining to, or like, macaroni (originally a dish of mixed food); hence, mixed; confused; jumbled. 2. Of or pertaining to the burlesque composition called macaronic; as, macaronic poetry.

1. A heap of thing confusedly mixed together; a jumble. 2. A kind of burlesque composition, in which the vern.

cumulus.definition: One of the four principal forms of clouds. SeeCloud.

theomancy.definition: A kind of divination drawn from the responses of oracles among heathen nations.

ozonometer.definition: An instrument for ascertaining the amount of ozone in the atmosphere, or in any gaseous mixture. Faraday.

photographical.definition: Of or pertaining to photography; obtained by photography; used ib photography; as a photographic picture; a photographic camera. -- Pho`to*graph"ic*al*ly, adv. Photographic printing, the process of obtaining pictures, as on chemically prepared paper, from photographic negatives, by exposure to light.

pulpiteer.definition: One who speaks in a pulpit; a preacher; -- so called in contempt. Howell. We never can think it sinful that Burns should have been humorous on such a pulpiteer. Prof. Wilson.

kennel.definition:
The water course of a street; a little canal or channel; a gutter; also, a puddle. Bp. Hall.

1. A house for a dog or for dogs, or for a pack of hounds. A dog sure, if he could speak, had wit enough to describe his kennel. Sir P. Sidney. 2. A pack of hounds, or a collection of dogs. Shak. 3. The hol.

incorruptibility.definition: The quality of being incorruptible; incapability of corruption. Holland.

mercenariness.definition: The quality or state of being mercenary; venality. Boyle.

libertine.definition: (Rom. Antiq.)  A manumitted slave; a freedman; also, the son of a freedman. 2. (Eccl. Hist.)  One of a sect of Anabaptists, in the fifteenth and early part of the sixteenth century, who rejected many of the customs and decencies of life, and advocated a community of goods and of women. 3. One free f.

autopneumatic.definition: Acting or moving automatically by means of compressed air.

defeasanced.definition: Liable to defeasance; capable of being made void or forfeited.

viscounty.definition: The quality, rank, or office of a viscount.

friendless.definition: Destitute of friends; forsaken. -- Friend"less*ness, n.

inconcerning.definition: Unimportant; trifling. "Trifling and inconcerning matters." Fuller.

warble.definition:
(Far.) (a) A small, hard tumor which is produced on the back of a horse by the heat or pressure of the saddle in traveling. (b) A small tumor produced by the larvæ of the gadfly in the backs of horses, cattle, etc. Called also warblet, warbeetle, warnles. 2. (Zoöl.)  See Wormil.

abasia.definition: Inability to coördinate muscular actions properly in walking. - - A*ba"sic (#), a.

ilvaite.definition: A silicate of iron and lime occurring in black prismatic crystals and columnar masses. I'M I'm  . A contraction of I am.

cerement.definition: (a) A cerecloth used for the special purpose of enveloping a dead body when embalmed. (b) Any shroud or wrapping for the dead.

apocalyptical.definition: Of or pertaining to a revelation, or, specifically, to the Revelation of St. John; containing, or of the nature of, a prophetic revelation. Apocolyptic number, the number 666, mentioned in Rev. xiii. 18. It has been variously interpreted.

musculophrenic.definition: Pertaining to the muscles and the diaphragm; as, the musculophrenic artery.

outhaul.definition: A rope used for hauling out a sail upon a spar; -- opposite of inhaul.

appressed.definition: Pressed close to, or lying against, something for its whole length, as against a stem, Gray.

thwart.definition:
Situated or placed across something else; transverse; oblique. Moved contrary with thwart obliquities. Milton. 2. Fig.: Perverse; crossgrained. Shak.

Thwartly; obliquely; transversely; athwart. Milton.

Across; athwart. Spenser. Thwart ships. See Athwart ships, under Athwart.

A seat in an open boa.

caress.definition:
An act of endearment; any act or expression of affection; an embracing, or touching, with tenderness. Wooed her with his soft caresses. Langfellow. He exerted himself to win by indulgence and caresses the hearts of all who were under his command. Macaulay.

To treat with tokens of fondness, affectio.

wishly.definition: According to desire; longingly; with wishes. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Chapman.

limpet.definition: In a general sense, any hatshaped, or conical, gastropod shell. 2. Any one of many species of marine shellfish of the order Docoglossa, mostly found adhering to rocks, between tides. Note: The common European limpets of the genus Patella (esp. P. vulgata) are extensively used as food. The common New.

derogate.definition: To annul in part; to repeal partly; to restrict; to limit the action of; -- said of a law. By several contrary customs, . . . many of the civil and canon laws are controlled and derogated. Sir M. Hale. 2. To lessen; to detract from; to disparage; to depreciate; -- said of a person or thing. Anything.

ensue.definition:
To follow; to pursue; to follow and overtake. "Seek peace, and ensue it." 1 Pet. iii. 11. To ensue his example in doing the like mischief. Golding.

To follow or come afterward; to follow as a consequence or in chronological succession; to result; as, an ensuing conclusion or effect; the year ensuin.

gewgaw.definition:
A showy trifle; a toy; a splendid plaything; a pretty but worthless bauble. A heavy gewgaw called a crown. Dryden.

Showy; unreal; pretentious. Seeing his gewgaw castle shine. Tennyson.

lollardy.definition: The doctrines or principles of the Lollards.

patriotic.definition: Inspired by patriotism; actuated by love of one's country; zealously and unselfishly devoted to the service of one's country; as, a patriotic statesman, vigilance.

omelet.definition: Eggs beaten up with a little flour, etc., and cooked in a frying pan; as, a plain omelet.

alongside.definition: Along or by the side; side by side with; -- often with of; as, bring the boat alongside; alongside of him; alongside of the tree.

addible.definition: Capable of being added. "Addible numbers." Locke.

postillation.definition: The act of postillating; exposition of Scripture in preaching.

hexavalent.definition: Having a valence of six; -- said of hexads.

indeprehensible.definition: Incapable of being found out. Bp. Morton.

damourite.definition: A kind of Muscovite, or potash mica, containing water.

why-not.definition: A violent and peremptory procedure without any assigned reason; a sudden conclusive happening. When the church Was taken with a why-not in the lurch. Hudibras. This game . . . was like to have been lost with a why-not. Nugæ Antiq.

euphrasy.definition: The plant eyesight (euphrasia officionalis), formerly regarded as beneficial in disorders of the eyes. Then purged with euphrasy and rue The visual nerve, for he had much to see. Milton.

predigest.definition: To subject (food) to predigestion or artificial digestion.

charmel.definition: A fruitful field. Libanus shall be turned into charmel, and charmel shall be esteemed as a forest. Isa. xxix. 17 (Douay version).

clem.definition: To starve; to famish. B. Jonson.

syruped.definition: Moistened, covered, or sweetened with sirup, or sweet juice.

flushness.definition: The state of being flush; abundance.

pogamoggan.definition: An aboriginal weapon consisting of a stone or piece of antler fastened to the end of a slender wooden handle, used by American Indians from the Great Plains to the Mackenzie River.

repentant.definition:
Penitent; sorry for sin. Chaucer. Thus they, in lowliest plight, repentant stood. Millton. 2. Expressing or showing sorrow for sin; as, repentant tears; repentant ashes. "Repentant sighs and voluntary pains." Pope.

One who repents, especially one who repents of sin; a penitent.

tonophant.definition: A modification of the kaleidophon, for showing composition of acoustic vibrations. It consists of two thin slips of steel welded together, their length being adjystable by a screw socket.

depiction.definition: A painting or depicting; a representation.

dextrally.definition: (adv. Towards the right; as, the hands of a watch rotate dextrally.

fiesta.definition: Among Spanish, a religious festival; a saint's day or holiday; also, a holiday or festivity. Even . . . a bullfight is a fiesta. Am. Dialect Notes. Some fiesta, when all the surrounding population were expected to turn out in holiday dress for merriment. The Century.

barbastel.definition: A European bat (Barbastellus communis), with hairy lips.

darby.definition: A plasterer's float, having two handles; -- used in smoothing ceilings, etc.

pronunciamento.definition: A proclamation or manifesto; a formal announcement or declaration.

soreness.definition: The quality or state of being sore; tenderness; painfull; as, the soreness of a wound; the soreness of an affliction.

spinous.definition: Spinose; thorny. 2. Having the form of a spine or thorn; spinelike. Spinous process of a vertebra (Anat.), the dorsal process of the neural arch of a vertebra; a neurapophysis.

discompliance.definition: Failure or refusal to comply; noncompliance. A compliance will discommend me to Mr. Coventry, and a discompliance to my lord chancellor. Pepys.

empyreumatic.definition: Of or pertaining to empyreuma; as, an empyreumatic odor. Empyreumatic oils, oils obtained by distilling various organic substances at high temperatures. Brande & C.

photodrome.definition: An apparatus consisting of a large wheel with spokes, which when turning very rapidly is illuminated by momentary flashes of light passing through slits in a rotating disk. By properly timing the succession of flashes the wheel is made to appear to be motionless, or to rotate more or less slowly in.

culinarily.definition: In the manner of a kitchen; in connection with a kitchen or cooking.

uranic.definition: Of or pertaining to the heavens; celestial; astronomical. On I know not what telluric or uranic principles. Carlyle. 2. (Chem.)  Pertaining to, resembling, or containing uranium; specifically, designating those compounds in which uranium has a valence relatively higher than in uranous compounds.

bagreef.definition: The lower reef of fore and aft sails; also, the upper reef of topsails. Ham. Nav. Encyc.

incommunicable.definition: Not communicable; incapable of being communicated, shared, told, or imparted, to others. Health and understanding are incommunicable. Southey. Those incommunicable relations of the divine love. South. -- In`com*mu"ni*ca*ble*ness, n. -- In`com*mu"ni*ca*bly, adv.

nepeta.definition: A genus of labiate plants, including the catnip and ground ivy.

cahincic.definition: Pertaining to, or derived from, cahinca, the native name of a species of Brazilian Chiococca, perhaps C. recemosa; as, cahincic acid.

mittened.definition: Covered with a mitten or mittens. "Mittened hands." Whittier.

indenizen.definition: To invest with the privileges of a denizen; to naturalize. Words indenizened, and commonly used as English. B. Jonson.

terricolae.definition: A division of annelids including the common earthworms and allied species.

bevy.definition: A company; an assembly or collection of persons, especially of ladies. What a bevy of beaten slaves have we here ! Beau. & Fl. 2. A flock of birds, especially quails or larks; also, a herd of roes.

fingrigo.definition: A prickly, climbing shrub of the genus Pisonia. The fruit is a kind of berry.

microlestes.definition: An extinct genus of small Triassic mammals, the oldest yet found in European strata.

dire.definition: Ill-boding; portentous; as, dire omens. 2. Evil in great degree; dreadful; dismal; horrible; terrible; lamentable. Dire was the tossing, deep the groans. Milton. Gorgons and hydras and chimeras dire. Milton.

morphine.definition: A bitter white crystalline alkaloid found in opium, possessing strong narcotic properties, and much used as an anodyne; -- called also morphia, and morphina.

dissolubility.definition: The quality of being dissoluble; capacity of being dissoluble; capacity of being dissolved by heat or moisture, and converted into a fluid.

maxilliform.definition: Having the form, or structure, of a maxilla.

hylic.definition: Of or pertaining to matter; material; corporeal; as, hylic influences.

jehu.definition: A coachman; a driver; especially, one who drives furiously.

presentific.definition: Making present. -- Pres`en*tif"ic*ly, adv. Dr. H. More.

fettle.definition:
To repair; to prepare; to put in order. Carlyle. 2. (Metal.)  To cover or line with a mixture of ore, cinders, etc., as the hearth of a puddling furnace.

To make preparations; to put things in order; to do trifling business. Bp. Hall.

The act of fettling. Wright. In fine fettle, in good spirits.

hungerer.definition: One who hungers; one who longs. Lamb.

terebratulid.definition: Any species of Terebratula or allied genera. Used also adjectively.

velocipedist.definition: One who rides on a velocipede.

apostrophe.definition: (Rhet.)  A figure of speech by which the orator or writer suddenly breaks off from the previous method of his discourse, and addresses, in the second person, some person or thing, absent or present; as, Milton's apostrophe to Light at the beginning of the third book of "Paradise Lost." 2. (Gram.)  T.

disaggregate.definition: To destroy the aggregation of; to separate into component parts, as an aggregate mass.

devilish.definition: Resembling, characteristic of, or pertaining to, the devil; diabolical; wicked in the extreme. "Devilish wickedness." Sir P. Sidney. This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish. James iii. 15. 2. Extreme; excessive. Dryden. Syn. -- Diabolical; infernal; hellish; satanic;.

self-esteem.definition: The holding a good opinion of one's self; self-complacency.

corrosive.definition: Eating away; having the power of gradually wearing, changing, or destroying the texture or substance of a body; as, the corrosive action of an acid. "Corrosive liquors." Grew. "Corrosive famine."Thomson. 2. Having the quality of fretting or vexing. Care is no cure, but corrosive. Shak. Corrosive sub.

titlark.definition: Any one of numerous small spring birds belonging to Anthus, Corydalla, and allied genera, which resemble the true larks in color and in having a very long hind claw; especially, the European meadow pipit (Anthus pratensis).

zein.definition: A nitrogenous substance of the nature of gluten, obtained from the seeds of Indian corn (Zea) as a soft, yellowish, amorphous substance. [Formerly written zeine.].

cock-a-hoop.definition: Boastful; defiant; exulting. Also used adverbially.

craspedote.definition: Of or pertaining to the Craspedota.

tighter.definition: A ribbon or string used to draw clothes closer.

diversify.definition: To make diverse or various in form or quality; to give variety to; to variegate; to distinguish by numerous differences or aspects. Separated and diversified on from another. Locke. Its seven colors, that diversify all the face of nature. I. Taylor.

sporophyte.definition: In plants exhibiting alternation of generations, the generation which bears asexual spores; -- opposed to gametophyte. It is not clearly differentiated in the life cycle of the lower plants. -- Spo`ro*phyt"ic (#), a.

oroide.definition: An alloy, chiefly of copper and zinc or tin, resembling gold in color and brilliancy. [Written also oreide.].

traditionalism.definition: A system of faith founded on tradition; esp., the doctrine that all religious faith is to be based solely upon what is delivered from competent authority, exclusive of rational processes.

cossic.definition: Of or relating to algebra; as, cossic numbers, or the cossic art. "Art of numbers cossical." Digges (1579).

gentlewoman.definition: A woman of good family or of good breeding; a woman above the vulgar. Bacon. 2. A woman who attends a lady of high rank. Shak.

stagworm.definition: The larve of any species of botfly which is parasitic upon the stag, as , which burrows beneath the skin, and Cephalomyia auribarbis, which lives in the nostrils.

uncared.definition: Not cared for; not heeded; -- with for.

benzine.definition: A liquid consisting mainly of the lighter and more volatile hydrocarbons of petroleum or kerosene oil, used as a solvent and for cleansing soiled fabrics; -- called also petroleum spirit, petroleum benzine. Varieties or similar products are gasoline, naphtha, rhigolene, ligroin, etc. 2. Same as Benz.

photozincograph.definition: A print made by photozincography. -- Pho`to*zin`co*graph"ic, a.

teeter.definition: To move up and down on the ends of a balanced plank, or the like, as children do for sport; to seesaw; to titter; to titter- totter. [U. S.] [The bobolink] alit upon the flower, and teetered up and down. H. W. Beecher.

nash.definition: Firm; stiff; hard; also, chilly. Halliwell.

rawly.definition: In a raw manner; unskillfully; without experience. 2. Without proper preparation or provision. Shak.

amphitheatrical.definition: Of, pertaining to, exhibited in, or resembling, an amphitheater.

ecthyma.definition: A cutaneous eruption, consisting of large, round pustules, upon an indurated and inflamed base. Dunglison.

overperch.definition: To perch upon; to fly over. Shak.

reticulated.definition: Resembling network; having the form or appearance of a net; netted; as, a reticulated structure. 2. Having veins, fibers, or lines crossing like the threads or fibers of a network; as, a reticulate leaf; a reticulated surface; a reticulated wing of an insect. Reticulated glass, ornamental ware made.

cuesta.definition: A sloping plain, esp. one with the upper end at the crest of a cliff; a hill or ridge with one face steep and the opposite face gently sloping. [Southwestern U. S.].

sabellian.definition:
Pertaining to the doctrines or tenets of Sabellius. See Sabellian, n.

A follower of Sabellius, a presbyter of Ptolemais in the third century, who maintained that there is but one person in the Godhead, and that the Son and Holy Spirit are only different powers, operations, or offices of the one God.

remiped.definition:
Having feet or legs that are used as oars; -- said of certain crustaceans and insects.

(a) An animal having limbs like oars, especially one of certain crustaceans. (b) One of a group of aquatic beetles having tarsi adapted for swimming. See Water beetle.

sphex.definition: Any one of numerous species of sand wasps of the genus Sphex and allied genera. These wasps have the abdomen attached to the thorax by a slender pedicel. See Illust. of Sand wasp, under Sand. Sphex fly (Zoöl.), any one of numerous species of small dipterous flies of the genus Conops and allied gener.

incession.definition: Motion on foot; progress in walking. The incession or local motion of animals. Sir T. Browne.

senhora.definition: A Spanish title of courtesy given to a lady; Mrs.; Madam; also, a lady.

entophytic.definition: Of or pertaining to entophytes; as, an entophytic disease.

hilal.definition: Of or pertaining to a hilum.

modal.definition: Of or pertaining to a mode or mood; consisting in mode or form only; relating to form; having the form without the essence or reality. Glanvill. 2. (Logic & Metaph.)  Indicating, or pertaining to, some mode of conceiving existence, or of expressing thought.

gantline.definition: A line rigged to a mast; -- used in hoisting rigging; a girtline.

equicrescent.definition: Increasing by equal increments; as, an equicrescent variable.

cheiropterous.definition: Belonging to the Cheiroptera, or Bat family.

barong.definition: A kind of cutting weapon with a thick back and thin razorlike edge, used by the Moros of the Philippine Islands.

pharmacopolist.definition: One who sells medicines; an apothecary.

millionairess.definition: A woman who is a millionaire, or the wife of a millionaire. [Humorous] Holmes.

podder.definition: One who collects pods or pulse.

dixie.definition: A colloquial name for the Southern portion of the United States, esp. during the Civil War. [U.S.].

exhaustive.definition: Serving or tending to exhaust; exhibiting all the facts or arguments; as, an exhaustive method. Ex*haust"ive*ly, adv.

precognition.definition: Previous cognition. Fotherby. 2. (Scots Law)  A preliminary examination of a criminal case with reference to a prosecution. Erskine.

unnerve.definition: To deprive of nerve, force, or strength; to weaken; to enfeeble; as, to unnerve the arm. Unequal match'd, . . . The unnerved father falls. Shak.

apophthegm.definition:
See Apothegm.

A short, pithy, and instructive saying; a terse remark, conveying some important truth; a sententious precept or maxim. Note: [Apothegm is now the prevalent spelling in the United States.].

ritualism.definition: A system founded upon a ritual or prescribed form of religious worship; adherence to, or observance of, a ritual. 2. Specifically :(a) The principles and practices of those in the Church of England, who in the development of the Oxford movement, so- called, have insisted upon a return to the use in.

strophic.definition: Pertaining to, containing, or consisting of, strophes.

stem-winding.definition: Wound by mechanism connected with the stem; as, a stem-winding watch.

bronchotomy.definition: An incision into the windpipe or larynx, including the operations of tracheotomy and laryngotomy.

ipecacuanha.definition: The root of a Brazilian rubiaceous herb (Cephaëlis Ipecacuanha), largely employed as an emetic; also, the plant itself; also, a medicinal extract of the root. Many other plants are used as a substitutes; among them are the black or Peruvian ipecac (Psychotria emetica), the white ipecac (Ionidium Ipe.

lamia.definition: A monster capable of assuming a woman's form, who was said to devour human beings or suck their blood; a vampire; a sorceress; a with.

stop-over.definition: Permitting one to stop over; as, a stop-over check or ticket. See To stop over, under Stop, v. i. [Railroad Cant, U.S.].

advertent.definition: Attentive; heedful; regardful. Sir M. Hale. -- Ad*vert"ent*ly, adv.

cordonnet.definition: Doubled and twisted thread, made of coarse silk, and used for tassels, fringes, etc. McElrath.

disapprobation.definition: The act of disapproving; mental condemnation of what is judged wrong, unsuitable, or inexpedient; feeling of censure. We have ever expressed the most unqualified disapprobation of all the steps. Burke.

unifilar.definition: Having only one thread; involving the use of only one thread, wire, fiber, or the like; as, unifilar suspension. Unifilar magnetometer (Physics), an instrument which consists of a magnetic bar suspended at its center of gravity by a long thread, constituting a delicate means for accurately measuring.

tetragynia.definition: A Linnæan order of plants having four styles.

anneal.definition: To subject to great heat, and then cool slowly, as glass, cast iron, steel, or other metal, for the purpose of rendering it less brittle; to temper; to toughen. 2. To heat, as glass, tiles, or earthenware, in order to fix the colors laid on them.

zechstein.definition: The upper division of the Permian (Dyas) of Europe. The prevailing rock is a magnesian limestone.

amygdalin.definition: A glucoside extracted from bitter almonds as a white, crystalline substance.

cowleech.definition: One who heals disease of cows; a cow doctor.

unremitting.definition: Not remitting; incessant; continued; persevering; as, unremitting exertions. Cowper. -- Un`re*mit"ting*ly, adv. -- Un`re*mit"ting*ness, n.

barnburner.definition: A member of the radical section of the Democratic party in New York, about the middle of the 19th century, which was hostile to extension of slavery, public debts, corporate privileges, etc., and supported Van Buren against Cass for president in 1848; --opposed to Hunker. [Political Cant, U. S.].

ducal.definition: Of or pertaining to a duke. His ducal cap was to be exchanged for a kingly crown. Motley.

transcendency.definition: The quality or state of being transcendent; superior excellence; supereminence. The Augustinian theology rests upon the transcendence of Deity at its controlling principle. A. V. G. Allen. 2. Elevation above truth; exaggeration. "Where transcendencies are more allowed." Bacon.

colatitude.definition: The complement of the latitude, or the difference between any latitude and ninety degrees.

deceptious.definition: Tending deceive; delusive. As if those organs had deceptious functions. Shak.

transmitter.definition: One who, or that which, transmits; specifically, that portion of a telegraphic or telephonic instrument by means of which a message is sent; -- opposed to receiver.

parasphenoid.definition: Near the sphenoid bone; -- applied especially to a bone situated immediately beneath the sphenoid in the base of the skull in many animals. -- n.  The parasphenoid bone.

supervention.definition: The act of supervening. Bp. Hall.

dromatherium.definition: A small extinct triassic mammal from North Carolina, the earliest yet found in America.

institutively.definition: In conformity with an institution. Harrington.

insurable.definition: Capable of being insured against loss, damage, death, etc.; proper to be insured. The French law annuls the latter policies so far as they exceed the insurable interest which remained in the insured at the time of the subscription thereof. Walsh.

long-tongued.definition: Having a long tongue. 2. Talkative; babbling; loquacious. Shak.

oneiromancy.definition: Divination by means of dreams. De Quincey.

irregulate.definition: To make irregular; to disorder. Sir T. Browne.

schismatic.definition:
Of or pertaining to schism; implying schism; partaking of the nature of schism; tending to schism; as, schismatic opinions or proposals.

One who creates or takes part in schism; one who separates from an established church or religious communion on account of a difference of opinion. "They were pop.

negotiate.definition: To transact business; to carry on trade. Hammond. 2. To treat with another respecting purchase and sale or some business affair; to bargain or trade; as, to negotiate with a man for the purchase of goods or a farm. 3. To hold intercourse respecting a treaty, league, or convention; to treat with, res.

farraginous.definition: Formed of various materials; mixed; as, a farraginous mountain. Kirwan. AA farraginous concurrence of all conditions, tempers, sexes, and ages. Sir T. Browne.

flusteration.definition: The act of flustering, or the state of being flustered; fluster.

incensant.definition: A modern term applied to animals (as a boar) when borne as raging, or with furious aspect.

censurable.definition: Deserving of censure; blamable; culpable; reprehensible; as, a censurable person, or censurable conduct. -- Cen"sur*a*bleness, n. -- Cen"sur*a*bly, adv.

kevel.definition:
(Naut.)  A strong cleat to which large ropes are belayed. 2. A stone mason's hammer. [Written also cavil.] Kevel head (Naut.), a projecting end of a timber, used as a kevel.

The gazelle.

pericranium.definition: The periosteum which covers the cranium externally; the region around the cranium.

kaoline.definition: A very pure white clay, ordinarily in the form of an impalpable powder, and used to form the paste of porcelain; China clay; porcelain clay. It is chiefly derived from the decomposition of common feldspar. Note: The name is now applied to all porcelain clays which endure the fire without discolorati.

bore.definition: To perforate or penetrate, as a solid body, by turning an auger, gimlet, drill, or other instrument; to make a round hole in or through; to pierce; as, to bore a plank. I'll believe as soon this whole earth may be bored. Shak. 2. To form or enlarge by means of a boring instrument or apparatus; as, t.

hiss.definition: To make with the mouth a prolonged sound like that of the letter s, by driving the breath between the tongue and the teeth; to make with the mouth a sound like that made by a goose or a snake when angered; esp., to make such a sound as an expression of hatred, passion, or disapproval. The merchants.

blacking.definition: Any preparation for making things black; esp. one for giving a black luster to boots and shoes, or to stoves. 2. The act or process of making black.

biplicity.definition: The state of being twice folded; reduplication. Bailey.

chachalaca.definition: The texan guan (Ortalis vetula). [written also chiacalaca.].

materialism.definition: The doctrine of materialists; materialistic views and tenets. The irregular fears of a future state had been supplanted by the materialism of Epicurus. Buckminster. 2. The tendency to give undue importance to material interests; devotion to the material nature and its wants. 3. Material substances i.

prest.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Press.

1. Ready; prompt; prepared. All prest to such battle he was. R. of Gloucester. 2. Neat; tidy; proper. Tusser. Prest money, money formerly paid to men when they enlisted into the British service; -- so called because it bound those that received it to be ready for service when.

jackal.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of several species of carnivorous animals inhabiting Africa and Asia, related to the dog and wolf. They are cowardly, nocturnal, and gregarious. They feed largely on carrion, and are noted for their piercing and dismal howling. Note: The common species of Southern Asia (Canis aureus.

zooesperm.definition: One of the spermatic particles; spermatozoid.

abord.definition:
Manner of approaching or accosting; address. Chesterfield.

To approach; to accost. Digby.

melanuric.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, a complex nitrogenous acid obtained by decomposition of melam, or of urea, as a white crystalline powder; -- called also melanurenic acid.

mesmerism.definition: The art of inducing an extraordinary or abnormal state of the nervous system, in which the actor claims to control the actions, and communicate directly with the mind, of the recipient. See Animal magnetism, under Magnetism.

intermeddlesome.definition: Inclined or disposed to intermeddle. -- In`ter*med"dle*some*ness, n.

maybird.definition: (a) The whimbrel; -- called also May fowl, May curlew, and May whaap. (b) The knot. [Southern U. S.] (c) The bobolink.

isomorphism.definition: A similarity of crystalline form between substances of similar composition, as between the sulphates of barium (BaSO4) and strontium (SrSO4). It is sometimes extended to include similarity of form between substances of unlike composition, which is more properly called homoeomorphism.

carousing.definition: That carouses; relating to a carouse.

aland.definition: On land; to the land; ashore. "Cast aland." Sir P. Sidney.

aphanitic.definition: Resembling aphanite; having a very fine-grained structure.

demilancer.definition: A soldier of light cavalry of the 16th century, who carried a demilance.

vindictive.definition: Disposed to revenge; prompted or characterized by revenge; revengeful. I am vindictive enough to repel force by force. Dryden. 2. Punitive. Vindictive damages. (Law) See under Damage, n. -- Vin*dic"tive*ly, adv. -- Vin*dic"tive*ness, n.

besaile.definition: A great-grandfather. 2. (Law)  A kind of writ which formerly lay where a great-grandfather died seized of lands in fee simple, and on the day of his death a stranger abated or entered and kept the heir out. This is now abolished. Blackstone.

planted.definition: Fixed in place, as a projecting member wrought on a separate piece of stuff; as, a planted molding.

almeh.definition: An Egyptian dancing girl; an Alma. The Almehs lift their arms in dance. Bayard Taylor.

poop.definition:
See 2d Poppy.

To make a noise; to pop; also, to break wind.

A deck raised above the after part of a vessel; the hindmost or after part of a vessel's hull; also, a cabin covered by such a deck. See Poop deck, under Deck. See also Roundhouse. With wind in poop, the vessel plows the sea. Dryden. The.

maggotish.definition: Full of whims or fancies; maggoty.

straight-joint.definition: Having straight joints. Specifically: (a) Applied to a floor the boards of which are so laid that the joints form a continued line transverse to the length of the boards themselves. Brandle & C. (b) In the United States, applied to planking or flooring put together without the tongue and groove, the.

rhomboid-ovate.definition: Between rhomboid and ovate, or oval, in shape.

inofficially.definition: Without the usual forms, or not in the official character.

tayra.definition: A South American carnivore (Galera barbara) allied to the grison. The tail is long and thick. The length, including the tail, is about three feet. [Written also taira.].

pilon.definition: A conical loaf of sugar. 2.  A gratuity given by tradesmen to customers settling their accounts. [Southern U. S.].

applaud.definition: To show approval of by clapping the hands, acclamation, or other significant sign. I would applaud thee to the very echo, That should applaud again. Shak. 2. To praise by words; to express approbation of; to commend; to approve. By the gods, I do applaud his courage. Shak. Syn. -- To praise; extol;.

vizard.definition: A mask; a visor. [Archaic] "A grotesque vizard." Sir W. Scott. To mislead and betray them under the vizard of law. Milton.

bichloride.definition: A compound consisting of two atoms of chlorine with one or more atoms of another element; -- called also dichloride. Bichloride of mercury, mercuric chloride; -- sometimes called corrosive sublimate.

disgruntle.definition: To dissatisfy; to disaffect; to anger.

sheepbite.definition: To bite or nibble like a sheep; hence, to practice petty thefts. Shak.

sackbut.definition: A brass wind instrument, like a bass trumpet, so contrived that it can be lengthened or shortened according to the tone required; -- said to be the same as the trombone. [Written also sagbut.] Moore (Encyc. of Music). Note: The sackbut of the Scriptures is supposed to have been a stringed instrument.

onycha.definition: An ingredient of the Mosaic incense, probably the operculum of some kind of strombus. Ex. xxx. 34. 2. The precious stone called onyx.

scriptory.definition: Of or pertaining to writing; expressed in writing; used in writing; as, scriptory wills; a scriptory reed. Swift.

contortionist.definition: One who makes or practices contortions.

abatement.definition: The act of abating, or the state of being abated; a lessening, diminution, or reduction; removal or putting an end to; as, the abatement of a nuisance is the suppression thereof. 2. The amount abated; that which is taken away by way of reduction; deduction; decrease; a rebate or discount allowed. 3.

bacchanalia.definition: (Myth.)  A feast or an orgy in honor of Bacchus. 2. Hence: A drunken feast; drunken reveler.

clapcake.definition: Oatmeal cake or bread clapped or beaten till it is thin. Halliwell.

somber.definition:
Dull; dusky; somewhat dark; gloomy; as, a somber forest; a somber house. 2. Melancholy; sad; grave; depressing; as, a somber person; somber reflections. The dinner was silent and somber; happily it was also short. Beaconsfield.

To make somber, or dark; to make shady.

Gloom; obscurity; duskiness; s.

amenable.definition: (Old Law)  Easy to be led; governable, as a woman by her husband. Jacob. 2. Liable to be brought to account or punishment; answerable; responsible; accountable; as, amenable to law. Nor is man too diminutive . . . to be amenable to the divine government. I. Taylor. 3. Liable to punishment, a charge,.

omniscient.definition: Having universal knowledge; knowing all things; infinitely knowing or wise; as, the omniscient God. -- Om*nis"cient*ly, adv. For what can scape the eye Of God all-seeing, or deceive his heart Omniscient Milton.

shadrach.definition: A mass of iron on which the operation of smelting has failed of its intended effect; -- so called from Shadrach, one of the three Hebrews who came forth unharmed from the fiery furnace of Nebuchadnezzar. (See Dan. iii. 26, 27.).

antiscorbutic.definition: Counteracting scurvy. -- n.  A remedy for scurvy.

defiliation.definition: Abstraction of a child from its parents. Lamb.

selenide.definition: A binary compound of selenium, or a compound regarded as binary; as, ethyl selenide.

implorator.definition: One who implores. Mere implorators of unholy suits. Shak.

fleshmonger.definition: One who deals in flesh; hence, a pimp; a procurer; a pander. Shak.

atlantides.definition: The Pleiades or seven stars, fabled to have been the daughters of Atlas.

scioptics.definition: The art or process of exhibiting luminous images, especially those of external objects, in a darkened room, by arrangements of lenses or mirrors.

pleuroptera.definition: A group of Isectivora, including the colugo.

shragger.definition: One who lops; one who trims trees. Huloet.

bloodstroke.definition: Loss of sensation and motion from hemorrhage or congestion in the brain. Dunglison.

exterminatory.definition: Of or pertaining to extermination; tending to exterminate. "Exterminatory war." Burke.

mutch.definition: The close linen or muslin cap of an old woman. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.].

arrected.definition: Lifted up; raised; erect. 2. Attentive, as a person listening. God speaks not the idle and unconcerned hearer, but to the vigilant and arrect. Smalridge.

intercolline.definition: Situated between hills; -- applied especially to valleys lying between volcanic cones.

lied.definition: A lay; a German song. It differs from the French chanson, and the Italian canzone, all three being national. The German Lied is perhaps the most faithful reflection of the national sentiment. Grove.

efficience.definition: The quality of being efficient or producing an effect or effects; efficient power; effectual agency. The manner of this divine efficiency being far above us. Hooker. 2. (Mech.)  The ratio of useful work to energy expended. Rankine. Efficiency of a heat engine, the ratio of the work done an engine, t.

tabularization.definition: The act of tabularizing, or the state of being tabularized; formation into tables; tabulation.

offtake.definition: Act of taking off; specif., the taking off or purchase of goods. 2.  Something taken off; a deduction. 3.  A channel for taking away air or water; also, the point of beginning of such a channel; a take-off.

matagasse.definition: A shrike or butcher bird; -- called also mattages.

perineal.definition: Of or pertaining to the perineum.

meconin.definition: A substance regarded as an anhydride of meconinic acid, existing in opium and extracted as a white crystalline substance. Also erroneously called meconina, meconia, etc., as though it were an alkaloid.

serpent.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any reptile of the order Ophidia; a snake, especially a large snake. See Illust. under Ophidia. Note: The serpents are mostly long and slender, and move partly by bending the body into undulations or folds and pressing them against objects, and partly by using the free edges of their ventra.

lamaism.definition: A modified form of Buddhism which prevails in Thibet, Mongolia, and some adjacent parts of Asia; -- so called from the name of its priests. See 2d Lama.

hippogriff.definition: A fabulous winged animal, half horse and half griffin. Milton.

internodal.definition: Of or pertaining to internodes; intervening between nodes or joints.

bog.definition: A quagmire filled with decayed moss and other vegetable matter; wet spongy ground where a heavy body is apt to sink; a marsh; a morass. Appalled with thoughts of bog, or caverned pit, Of treacherous earth, subsiding where they tread. R. Jago. 2. A little elevated spot or clump of earth, roots, and g.

blending.definition: The act of mingling. 2. (Paint.)  The method of laying on different tints so that they may mingle together while wet, and shade into each other insensibly. Weale.

pressurage.definition: Pressure. 2. The juice of the grape extracted by the press; also, a fee paid for the use of a wine press.

molding.definition: The act or process of shaping in or on a mold, or of making molds; the art or occupation of a molder. 2. Anything cast in a mold, or which appears to be so, as grooved or ornamental bars of wood or metal. 3. (Arch.)  A plane, or curved, narrow surface, either sunk or projecting, used for decoration.

clayey.definition: Consisting of clay; abounding with clay; partaking of clay; like clay.

paleozoic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or designating, the older division of geological time during which life is known to have existed, including the Silurian, Devonian, and Carboniferous ages, and also to the life or rocks of those ages. See Chart of Geology.

quirkish.definition: , Consisting of quirks; resembling a quirk. Barrow.

unsighted.definition: Not sighted, or seen. Suckling. 2. (Gun.)  Not aimed by means of a sight; also, not furnished with a sight, or with a properly adjusted sight; as, to shoot and unsighted rife or cannon.

leaky.definition: Permitting water or other fluid to leak in or out; as, a leaky roof or cask. 2. Apt to disclose secrets; tattling; not close.

chemist.definition: A person versed in chemistry or given to chemical investigation; an analyst; a maker or seller of chemicals or drugs.

by-view.definition: A private or selfish view; self-interested aim or purpose. No by-views of his own shall mislead him. Atterbury.

compulsatory.definition: Operating with force; compelling; forcing; constraininig; resulting from, or enforced by, compulsion. To recover of us, by strong hand And terms compulsatory, those foresaid lands. Shak.

ethnarch.definition: The governor of a province or people. Lew Wallace.

valuably.definition: So as to be of value.

iridian.definition: Of or pertaining to the iris or rainbow.

ogre.definition: An imaginary monster, or hideous giant of fairy tales, who lived on human beings; hence, any frightful giant; a cruel monster. His schoolroom must have resembled an ogre's den. Maccaulay.

genterie.definition: Nobility of birth or of character; gentility. Chaucer.

misfortune.definition:
Bad fortune or luck; calamity; an evil accident; disaster; mishap; mischance. Consider why the change was wrought, You 'll find his misfortune, not his fault. Addison. Syn. -- Calamity; mishap; mischance; misadventure; ill; harm; disaster. See Calamity.

To happen unluckily or unfortunately; to misc.

myomorpha.definition: An extensive group of rodents which includes the rats, mice, jerboas, and many allied forms.

nummulary.definition: Of or pertaining to coin or money; pecuniary; as, the nummulary talent. 2. (Pathol.)  Having the appearance or form of a coin. "Nummular sputa." Sir T. Watson.

asomatous.definition: Without a material body; incorporeal. Todd.

fecial.definition: Pertaining to heralds, declarations of war, and treaties of peace; as, fecial law. Kent.

vaccination.definition: The act, art, or practice of vaccinating, or inoculating with the cowpox, in order to prevent or mitigate an attack of smallpox. Cf. Inoculation. Note: In recent use, vaccination sometimes includes inoculation with any virus as a preventive measure; as, vaccination of cholera.

ignition.definition: The act of igniting, kindling, or setting on fire. 2. The state of being ignited or kindled. Sir T. Browne.

odometrical.definition: Of or pertaining to the odometer, or to measurements made with it.

practicality.definition: The quality or state of being practical; practicalness.

boyism.definition: Boyhood. T. Warton. 2. The nature of a boy; childishness. Dryden. BOYLE'S LAW Boyle's" law`.  See under Law.

guarantor.definition: (a) One who makes or gives a guaranty; a warrantor; a surety. (b) One who engages to secure another in any right or possession.

decertation.definition: Contest for mastery; contention; strife. Arnway.

surgy.definition: Rising in surges or billows; full of surges; resembling surges in motion or appearance; swelling. "Over the surgy main." Pope.

sharper.definition: A person who bargains closely, especially, one who cheats in bargains; a swinder; also, a cheating gamester. Sharpers, as pikes, prey upon their own kind. L'Estrange. Syn. -- Swindler; cheat; deceiver; trickster; rogue. See Swindler.

cornercap.definition: The chief ornament. Thou makest the triumviry the cornercap of society. Shak.

emacerate.definition: To make lean or to become lean; to emaciate. Bullokar.

decussated.definition: Crossed; intersected. 2. (Bot.)  Growing in pairs, each of which is at right angles to the next pair above or below; as, decussated leaves or branches. 3. (Rhet.)  Consisting of two rising and two falling clauses, placed in alternate opposition to each other; as, a decussated period.

perioecians.definition: Those who live on the same parallel of latitude but on opposite meridians, so that it is noon in one place when it is midnight in the other. Compare Antoeci.

exostome.definition: The small aperture or foremen in the outer coat of the ovule of a plant.

golgotha.definition: Calvary. See the Note under Calvary.

calcific.definition: Calciferous. Specifically: (Zoöl.) of or pertaining to hte portion of the which forms the eggshell in birds and reptiles. Huxley.

preceptial.definition: Preceptive. [Passion] would give preceptial medicine to rage. Shak.

kedge.definition:
To move (a vessel) by carrying out a kedge in a boat, dropping it overboard, and hauling the vessel up to it.

A small anchor used whenever a large one can be dispensed witch. See Kedge, v. t., and Anchor, n.

episcopalianism.definition: The doctrine and usages of Episcopalians; episcopacy.

ploughwright.definition: One who makes or repairs plows.

solidification.definition: Act of solidifying, or state of being solidified.

detonator.definition: One who, or that which, detonates.

cooey.definition: A peculiar whistling sound made by the Australian aborigenes as a call or signal. [Written also cooie.].

redan.definition: (Fort.)  A work having two parapets whose faces unite so as to form a salient angle toward the enemy. 2. A step or vertical offset in a wall on uneven ground, to keep the parts level.

sulcated.definition: Scored with deep and regular furrows; furrowed or grooved; as, a sulcated stem.

probative.definition: Serving for trial or proof; probationary; as, probative judgments; probative evidence. South.

withered.definition: Faded; dried up; shriveled; wilted; wasted; wasted away. -- With"ered*ness, n. Bp. Hall.

fudge.definition:
A made-up story; stuff; nonsense; humbug; -- often an exclamation of contempt.

1. To make up; to devise; to contrive; to fabricate. Fudged up into such a smirkish liveliness. N. Fairfax. 2. To foist; to interpolate. That last "suppose" is fudged in. Foote .

reefer.definition: (Naut.)  One who reefs; -- a name often given to midshipmen. Marryat. 2. A close-fitting lacket or short coat of thick cloth.

lacker.definition:
One who lacks or is in want.

See Lacquer.

monatomic.definition: (a) Consisting of, or containing, one atom; as, the molecule of mercury is monatomic. (b) Having the equivalence or replacing power of an atom of hydrogen; univalent; as, the methyl radical is monatomic.

counterbalance.definition: To oppose with an equal weight or power; to counteract the power or effect of; to countervail; to equiponderate; to balance. The remaining air was not able to counterbalance the mercurial cylinder. Boyle. The cstudy of mind is necessary to counterbalance and correct the influence of the study of nat.

bawd.definition:
A person who keeps a house of prostitution, or procures women for a lewd purpose; a procurer or procuress; a lewd person; -- usually applied to a woman.

To procure women for lewd purposes.

falconer.definition: A person who breeds or trains hawks for taking birds or game; one who follows the sport of fowling with hawks. Johnson.

vanning.definition: A process by which ores are washed on a shovel, or in a vanner.

lithy.definition: Easily bent; pliable. Lithy tree (Bot.), a European shrub (Viburnum Lantana); -- so named from its tough and flexible stem.

cauterization.definition: The act of searing some morbid part by the application of a cautery or caustic; also, the effect of such application.

contendent.definition: n antagonist; a contestant. In all notable changes and revolutions the contendents have been still made a prey to the third party. L'Estrange.

marysole.definition: A large British fluke, or flounder (Rhombus megastoma); -- called also carter, and whiff. marchpane.

afloat.definition: Borne on the water; floating; on board ship. On such a full sea are we now afloat. Shak. 2. Moving; passing from place to place; in general circulation; as, a rumor is afloat. 3. Unfixed; moving without guide or control; adrift; as, our affairs are all afloat.

disembrangle.definition: To free from wrangling or litigation. Berkeley.

metronomy.definition: Measurement of time by an instrument.

slubbing.definition: from Slub. Slubbing billy, or Slubbing machine, the machine by which slubs are formed.

dysphoria.definition: Impatience under affliction; morbid restlessness; dissatisfaction; the fidgets.

medalist.definition: A person that is skilled or curious in medals; a collector of medals. Addison. 2. A designer of medals. Macaulay. 3. One who has gained a medal as the reward of merit.

socialistic.definition: Pertaining to, or of the nature of, socialism.

galingale.definition: A plant of the Sedge family (Cyperus longus) having aromatic roots; also, any plant of the same genus. Chaucer. Meadow, set with slender galingale. Tennyson.

orcadian.definition: Of or pertaining to the Orkney Islands.

handbarrow.definition: A frame or barrow, without a wheel, carried by hand.

hype.definition:
A throw in which the wrestler lifts his opponent from the ground, swings him to one side, knocks up his nearer thigh from the back with the knee, and throws him on his back.

Intense publicity for a future event, performed in a showy or excessively dramatic manner suggesting an importance not justif.

solacement.definition: The act of solacing, or the state of being solaced; also, that which solaces.

polyzonal.definition: Consisting of many zones or rings. Polyzonal lens (Opt.), a lens made up of pieces arranged zones or rings, -- used in the lanterns of lighthouses.

dichromic.definition: Furnishing or giving two colors; -- said of defective vision, in which all the compound colors are resolvable into two elements instead of three. Sir J. Herschel.

relativeness.definition: The state of being relative, or having relation; relativity.

self-control.definition: Control of one's self; restraint exercised over one's self; self-command.

tress.definition: A braid, knot, or curl, of hair; a ringlet. Her yellow hair was braided in a tress. Chaucer. Fair tresses man's imperial race insnare. Pope. 2. Fig.: A knot or festoon, as of flowers. Keats.

vitrescent.definition: Capable of being formed into glass; tending to become glass.

versionist.definition: One who makes or favors a version; a translator.

aerodynamics.definition: The science which treats of the air and other gaseous bodies under the action of force, and of their mechanical effects.

engross.definition: To make gross, thick, or large; to thicken; to increase in bulk or quantity. Waves . . . engrossed with mud. Spenser. Not sleeping, to engross his idle body. Shak. 2. To amass. To engross up glorious deeds on my behalf. Shak. 3. To copy or write in a large hand (en gross, i. e., in large); to write.

awl.definition: A pointed instrument for piercing small holes, as in leather or wood; used by shoemakers, saddlers, cabinetmakers, etc. The blade is differently shaped and pointed for different uses, as in the brad awl, saddler's awl, shoemaker's awl, etc.

incarnadine.definition:
Flesh-colored; of a carnation or pale red color. Lovelace.

To dye red or crimson. Will all great Neptune's ocean wash this blood Clean from my hand No; this my hand will rather The multitudinous seas incarnadine, Making the green one red. Shak.

identically.definition: In an identical manner; with respect to identity. "Identically the same." Bp. Warburton. "Identically different." Ross.

acrimonious.definition: Acrid; corrosive; as, acrimonious gall. [Archaic] Harvey. 2. Caustic; bitter-tempered' sarcastic; as, acrimonious dispute, language, temper.

motivate.definition: To provide with a motive; to move; impel; induce; incite. -- Mo`ti*va"tion (#), n.  William James.

plasticity.definition: The quality or state of being plastic. 2. (Physiol.)  Plastic force. Dunglison.

celtiberian.definition: Of or pertaining to the ancient Celtiberia (a district in Spain lying between the Ebro and the Tagus) or its inhabitants the Celtiberi (Celts of the river Iberus). -- n.  An inhabitant of Celtiberia.

shamefaced.definition: Easily confused or put out of countenance; diffident; bashful; modest. Your shamefaced virtue shunned the people's prise. Dryden. Note: Shamefaced was once shamefast, shamefacedness was shamefastness, like steadfast and steadfastness; but the ordinary manifestations of shame being by the face, have.

odometrous.definition: Serving to measure distance on a road. Sydney Smith.

sampan.definition: A Chinese boat from twelve to fifteen feet long, covered with a house, and sometimes used as a permanent habitation on the inland waters. [Written also sanpan.].

checkered.definition: Marked with alternate squares or checks of different color or material. Dancing in the checkered shade. Milton. 2. Diversified or variegated in a marked manner, as in appearance, character, circumstances, etc. This checkered narrative. Macaulay.

disregard.definition:
Not to regard; to pay no heed to; to omit to take notice of; to neglect to observe; to slight as unworthy of regard or notice; as, to disregard the admonitions of conscience. Studious of good, man disregarded fame. Blackmore.

The act of disregarding, or the state of being disregarded; intentional n.

vulgarize.definition: To make vulgar, or common. Exhortation vulgarized by low wit. V. Knox.

immense.definition: Immeasurable; unlimited. In commonest use: Very great; vast; huge. "Immense the power" Pope. "Immense and boundless ocean." Daniel. O Goodness infinite! Goodness immense! Milton. Syn. -- Infinite; immeasurable; illimitable; unbounded; unlimited; interminable; vast; prodigious; enormous; monstrous. S.

isocheim.definition: A line connecting places on the earth having the same mean winter temperature. Cf. Isothere.

demulcent.definition:
Softening; mollifying; soothing; assuasive; as, oil is demulcent.

A substance, usually of a mucilaginous or oily nature, supposed to be capable of soothing an inflamed nervous membrane, or protecting i.

polemarch.definition: In Athens, originally, the military commanderin-chief; but, afterward, a civil magistrate who had jurisdiction in respect of strangers and sojourners. In other Grecian cities, a high military and civil officer.

rheumatismoid.definition: Of or resembling rheum or rheumatism.

bos.definition: A genus of ruminant quadrupeds, including the wild and domestic cattle, distinguished by a stout body, hollow horns, and a large fold of skin hanging from the neck.

jaw-fall.definition: Depression of the jaw; hence, depression of spirits. M. Griffith (1660).

favoritism.definition: The disposition to favor and promote the interest of one person or family, or of one class of men, to the neglect of others having equal claims; partiality. A spirit of favoritism to the Bank of the United States. A. Hamilton.

indusial.definition: Of, pertaining to, or containing, the petrified cases of the larvæ of certain insects. Indusial limestone (Geol.), a fresh-water limestone, largely composed of the agglomerated cases of caddice worms, or larvæ of caddice flies (Phryganea). It is found in Miocene strata of Auvergne, France, and some.

sonance.definition: A sound; a tune; as, to sound the tucket sonance. Shak. 2. The quality or state of being sonant.

wildering.definition: A plant growing in a state of nature; especially, one which has run wild, or escaped from cultivation.

bottomless.definition: Without a bottom; hence, fathomless; baseless; as, a bottomless abyss. "Bottomless speculations." Burke.

deathbed.definition: The bed in which a person dies; hence, the closing hours of life of one who dies by sickness or the like; the last sickness. That often-quoted passage from Lord Hervey in which the Queen's deathbed is described. Thackeray.

haemochromogen.definition: A body obtained from hemoglobin, by the action of reducing agents in the absence of oxygen.

tonsorial.definition: Of or pertaining to a barber, or shaving.

monophanous.definition: Having one the same appearance; having a mutual resemblance.

legioned.definition: Formed into a legion or legions; legionary. Shelley.

versicolor.definition: Having various colors; changeable in color. "Versicolor, sweet- smelling flowers." Burton.

home-felt.definition: Felt in one's own breast; inward; private. "Home-felt quiet. Pope.

outstrip.definition: To go faster than; to outrun; to advance beyond; to leave behing. Appetites which . . . had outstripped the hours. Southey. He still outstript me in the race. Tennyson.

speechmaker.definition: One who makes speeches; one accustomed to speak in a public assembly.

erythema.definition: A disease of the skin, in which a diffused inflammation forms rose-colored patches of variable size.

ruttle.definition: A rattling sound in the throat arising from difficulty of breathing; a rattle.

coworker.definition: One who works with another; a co.

bacillar.definition: Shaped like a rod or staff.

gabionade.definition: (Fort.)  A traverse made with gabions between guns or on their flanks, protecting them from enfilading fire. 2. A structure of gabions sunk in lines, as a core for a sand bar in harbor improvements.

stroll.definition:
To wander on foot; to ramble idly or leisurely; to rove. These mothers stroll to beg sustenance for their helpless infants. Swift. Syn. -- To rove; roam; range; stray.

A wandering on foot; an idle and leisurely walk; a ramble.

platband.definition: A border of flowers in a garden, along a wall or a parterre; hence, a border. 2. (Arch.) (a) A flat molding, or group of moldings, the width of which much exceeds its projection, as the face of an architrave. (b) A list or fillet between the flutings of a column.

curbstone.definition: A stone Curbstone broker.See under Broker.

prescience.definition: Knowledge of events before they take place; foresight. God's certain prescience of the volitions of moral agents. J. Edwards.

ticklish.definition: Sensible to slight touches; easily tickled; as, the sole of the foot is very ticklish; the hardened palm of the hand is not ticklish. Bacon. 2. Standing so as to be liable to totter and fall at the slightest touch; unfixed; easily affected; unstable. Can any man with comfort lodge in a condition so.

infidel.definition:
Not holding the faith; -- applied esp. to one who does not believe in the inspiration of the Scriptures, and the supernatural origin of Christianity. The infidel writer is a great enemy to society. V. Knox.

One who does not believe in the prevailing religious faith; especially, one who does not bel.

lytta.definition: A fibrous and muscular band lying within the longitudinal axis of the tongue in many mammals, as the dog.

reflectent.definition: Bending or flying back; reflected. "The ray descendent, and the ray reflectent flying with so great a speed." Sir K. Digby. 2. Reflecting; as, a reflectent body. Sir K. Digby.

univariant.definition: Having one degree of freedom or variability.

boskage.definition: Same as Boscage. Thridding the somber boskage of the wood. Tennyson.

jambooree.definition: A noisy or unrestrained carousal or frolic; a spree. [Slang] Kipling. A Calcutta-made pony cart had been standing in front of the manager's bungalow when Raja Singh started on his jamboree. W. A. Fraser.

umhofo.definition: An African two-horned rhinoceros (Atelodus, or Rhinoceros, simus); -- called also chukuru, and white rhinoceros.

remissory.definition: Serving or tending to remit, or to secure remission; remissive. "A sacrifice expiatory or remissory." Latimer.

spongious.definition: Somewhat spongy; spongelike; full of small cavities like sponge; as, spongious bones.

philopena.definition: A present or gift which is made as a forfeit in a social game that is played in various ways; also, the game itself. [Written also fillipeen and phillippine.] Note: One of the ways may be stated as follows: A person finding a nut with two kernels eats one, and gives the other to a person of the oppo.

gristmill.definition: A mill for grinding grain; especially, a mill for grinding grists, or portions of grain brought by different customers; a custom mill.

treen.definition:
Made of wood; wooden. " Treen cups." Camden. 2. Relating to, or drawn from, trees. Spenser. Treen liquors, especially that of the date. Evelyn.

pl. of Tree. " The shady treen." Fairfax.

grist.definition: Ground corn; that which is ground at one time; as much grain as is carried to the mill at one time, or the meal it produces. Get grist to the mill to have plenty in store. Tusser. Q. 2. Supply; provision. Swift. 3. In rope making, a given size of rope, common grist being a rope three inches in circu.

unwell.definition: Not well; indisposed; not in good health; somewhat ill; ailing. 2. (Med.)  Specifically, ill from menstruation; affected with, or having, catamenial; menstruant. Note: This word was formerly regarded as an Americanism, but is now in common use among all who speak the English language.

labefaction.definition: The act of labefying or making weak; the state of being weakened; decay; ruin. There is in it such a labefaction of all principles as may be injurious to morality. Johnson.

blossom.definition: The flower of a plant, or the essential organs of reproduction, with their appendages; florescence; bloom; the flowers of a plant, collectively; as, the blossoms and fruit of a tree; an apple tree in blossom. Note: The term has been applied by some botanists, and is also applied in common usage, to.

exegetic.definition: Pertaining to exegesis; tending to unfold or illustrate; explanatory; expository. Walker. Ex`e*get"ic*al*ly, adv.

hierogrammatist.definition: A writer of hierograms; also, one skilled in hieroglyphics. Greenhill.

knowleche.definition: See Knowl, edge. We consider and knowleche that we have offended. Chaucer.

impi.definition: A body of Kaffir warriors; a body of native armed men. [South Africa] As early as 1862 he crossed assagais with and defeated a Matabili impi (war band). James Bryce.

embrangle.definition: To confuse; to entangle. I am lost and embrangled in inextricable difficulties. Berkeley.

typist.definition: A person who operates a typewriting machine; a typewriter.

quid.definition:
A portion suitable to be chewed; a cud; as, a quid of tobacco.

To drop from the mouth, as food when partially chewed; -- said of horses. Youatt.

alcoranist.definition: One who adheres to the letter of the Koran, rejecting all traditions.

brambling.definition: The European mountain finch (Fringilla montifringilla); -- called also bramble finch and bramble.

tenancy.definition: (a) A holding, or a mode of holding, an estate; tenure; the temporary possession of what belongs to another. (b) (O. Eng. Law) A house for habitation, or place to live in, held of another. Blount. Blackstone. Wharton.

sneb.definition: To reprimand; to sneap. "Scold and sneb the good oak." Spenser.

chromule.definition: A general name for coloring matter of plants other than chlorophyll, especially that of petals.

subderisorious.definition: Ridiculing with moderation. Dr. H. More.

cerosin.definition: A waxy substance obtained from the bark of the sugar cane, and crystallizing in delicate white laminæ.

protagon.definition: A nitrogenous phosphorized principle found in brain tissue. By decomposition it yields neurine, fatty acids, and other bodies.

exposition.definition: The act of exposing or laying open; a setting out or displaying to public view. 2. The act of expounding or of laying open the sense or meaning of an author, or a passage; explanation; interpretation; the sense put upon a passage; a law, or the like, by an interpreter; hence, a work containing expla.

bodkin.definition: A dagger. When he himself might his quietus make With a bare bodkin. Shak. 2. (Needlework)  An implement of steel, bone, ivory, etc., with a sharp point, for making holes by piercing; a 3. (Print.)  A sharp tool, like an awl, used for picking 4. A kind of needle with a large eye and a blunt point, f.

novilunar.definition: Of or pertaining to the new moon.

untwain.definition: To rend in twain; to tear in two. Skelton.

harvestless.definition: Without harvest; lacking in crops; barren. "Harvestless autumns." Tennyson.

erd.definition: The earth. Wright. Erd shrew (Zoöl.), the common European shrew (Sorex vulgaris); the shrewmouse.

insane.definition: Exhibiting unsoundness or disorded of mind; not sane; mad; deranged in mind; delirious; distracted. See Insanity, 2. 2. Used by, or appropriated to, insane persons; as, an insane hospital. 3. Causing insanity or madness. Or have we eaten on the insaneroot That takes the reason prisoner Shak. 4. Char.

lapidification.definition: The act or process of lapidifying; fossilization; petrifaction.

medle.definition: To mix; to mingle; to meddle. [Written also medly.] Chaucer.

cowled.definition: Wearing a cowl; hooded; as, a cowled monk. "That cowled churchman." Emerson.

nasutness.definition: Quickness of scent; hence, nice discernment; acuteness. Dr. H. More.

tapster.definition: One whose business is to tap or draw ale or other liquor.

sunna.definition: A collection of traditions received by the orthodox Mohammedans as of equal authority with the Koran.

far-stretched.definition:
Stretched beyond ordinary limits.

Stretched beyond ordinary limits.

manteltree.definition: The lintel of a fireplace when of wood, as frequently in early houses.

cabalistic.definition: Of or pertaining to the cabala; containing or conveying an occult meaning; mystic. The Heptarchus is a cabalistic of the first chapter of Genesis. Hallam.

accentually.definition: In an accentual manner; in accordance with accent.

nitranilic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or designating, a complex organic acid produced as a white crystalline substance by the action of nitrous acid on hydroquinone.

homely.definition: Belonging to, or having the characteristics of, home; domestic; familiar; intimate. [Archaic] With all these men I was right homely, and communed with, them long and oft. Foxe. Their homely joys, and destiny obscure. Gray. 2. Plain; unpretending; rude in appearance; unpolished; as, a homely garment;.

fracho.definition: A shallow iron pan to hold glass ware while being annealed.

orsellinic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an organic acid obtained by a partial decomposition of orsellic acid as a white crystalline substance, and related to protocatechuic acid.

visionary.definition: Of or pertaining to a visions or visions; characterized by, appropriate to, or favorable for, visions. The visionary hour When musing midnight reigns. Thomson. 2. Affected by phantoms; disposed to receive impressions on the imagination; given to reverie; apt to receive, and act upon, fancies as if t.

translatorship.definition: The office or dignity of a translator.

misalliance.definition: A marriage with a person of inferior rank or social station; an improper alliance; a mesalliance. A Leigh had made a misalliance, and blushed A Howard should know it. Mrs. Browning.

inculcation.definition: A teaching and impressing by frequent repetitions. Bp. Hall.

sectoral.definition: Of or pertaining to a sector; as, a sectoral circle.

malaria.definition: Air infected with some noxious substance capable of engendering disease; esp., an unhealthy exhalation from certain soils, as marshy or wet lands, producing fevers; miasma. Note: The morbific agent in malaria is supposed by some to be a vegetable microbe or its spores, and by others to be a very min.

abstractitious.definition: Obtained from plants by distillation. Crabb.

seconder.definition: One who seconds or supports what another attempts, affirms, moves, or proposes; as, the seconder of an enterprise or of a motion.

collimation.definition: The act of collimating; the adjustment of the line of the sights, as the axial line of the telescope of an instrument, into its proper position relative to the other parts of the instrument. Error of collimation, the deviation of the line collimation of an astronomical instrument from the position i.

practic.definition: Practical. 2. Artful; deceitful; skillful. "Cunning sleights and practick knavery." Spenser.

monophyodont.definition: Having but one set of teeth; -- opposed to diphyodont.

tait.definition: A small nocturnal and arboreal Australian marsupial (Tarsipes rostratus) about the size of a mouse. It has a long muzzle, a long tongue, and very few teeth, and feeds upon honey and insects. Called also noolbenger.

thousandth.definition: Next in order after nine hundred and ninty-nine; coming last of a thousand successive individuals or units; -- the ordinal of thousand; as, the thousandth part of a thing. 2. Constituting, or being one of, a thousand equal parts into which anything is divided; the tenth of a hundredth. 3. Occurring.

opisthography.definition: A writing upon the back of anything, as upon the back of a leaf or sheet already written upon on one side. Scudamore.

dolerite.definition: A dark-colored, basic, igneous rock, composed essentially of pyroxene and a triclinic feldspar with magnetic iron. By many authors it is considered equivalent to a coarse-grained basalt.

tottery.definition: Trembling or vaccilating, as if about to fall; unsteady; shaking. Johnson.

formidable.definition: Exciting fear or apprehension; impressing dread; adapted to excite fear and deter from approach, encounter, or undertaking; alarming. They seemed to fear the formodable sight. Dryden. I swell my preface into a volume, and make it formidable, when you see so many pages behind. Drydn. Syn. -- Dreadful.

swanmark.definition: A mark of ownership cut on the bill or swan. [Eng.] Encyc. Brit.

hippocrene.definition: A fountain on Mount Helicon in Boeotia, fabled to have burst forth when the ground was struck by the hoof of Pegasus. Also, its waters, which were supposed to impart poetic inspiration. Keats. Nor maddening draughts of Hippocrene. Longfellow.

majorat.definition: The right of succession to property according to age; -- so termed in some of the countries of continental Europe. 2. (French Law)  Property, landed or funded, so attached to a title of honor as to descend with it.

renate.definition: Born again; regenerate; renewed. Beau & Fl.

orgyia.definition: A genus of bombycid moths whose caterpillars (esp. those of Orgyia leucostigma) are often very injurious to fruit trees and shade trees. The female is wingless. Called also vaporer moth.

preferably.definition: In preference; by choice. To choose Plautus preferably to Terence. Dennis.

woolpack.definition: A pack or bag of wool weighing two hundred and forty pounds.

interloper.definition: One who interlopes; one who interlopes; one who unlawfully intrudes upon a property, a station, or an office; one who interferes wrongfully or officiously. The untrained man, . . . the interloper as to the professions. I. Taylor.

transferrer.definition: One who makes a transfer or conveyance.

pyrotartaric.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid obtained as a white crystalline substance by the distillation of tartaric acid.

incarn.definition:
To cover or invest with flesh. Wiseman.

To develop flesh. Wiseman.

ebullioscope.definition: An instrument for observing the boiling point of liquids, especially for determining the alcoholic strength of a mixture by the temperature at which it boils.

bruisewort.definition: A plant supposed to heal bruises, as the true daisy, the soapwort, and the comfrey.

balladry.definition: Ballad poems; the subject or style of ballads. "Base balladry is so beloved." Drayton.

sinecurism.definition: The state of having a sinecure.

destroyable.definition: Destructible. Plants . . . scarcely destroyable by the weather. Derham.

transatlantic.definition: Lying or being beyond the Atlantic Ocean. Note: When used by a person in Europe or Africa, transatlantic signifies being in America; when by a person in America, it denotes being or lying in Europe or Africa, especially the former. 2. Crossing the Atlantic Ocean.

foggy.definition: Filled or abounding with fog, or watery exhalations; misty; as, a foggy atmosphere; a foggy morning. Shak. 2. Beclouded; dull; obscure; as, foggy ideas. Your coarse, foggy, drowsy conceit. Hayward.

complacency.definition: Calm contentment; satisfaction; gratification. The inward complacence we find in acting reasonably and virtuously. Atterbury. Others proclaim the infirmities of a great man with satisfaction and complacency, if they discover none of the like in themselves. Addison. 2. The cause of pleasure or joy. ".

tandem.definition:
One after another; -- said especially of horses harnessed and driven one before another, instead of abreast.

A team of horses harnessed one before the other. "He drove tandems." Thackeray. Tandem engine, a compound steam engine having two or more steam cylinders in the same axis, close to one anoth.

uneven.definition: Not even; not level; not uniform; rough; as, an uneven road or way; uneven ground. 2. Not equal; not of equal length. Hebrew verse consists of uneven feet. Peacham. 3. Not divisible by two without a remainder; odd; -- said of numbers; as, 3, 7, and 11 are uneven numbers. Un*e"ven*ly, adv. -- Un*e"ve.

mercurammonium.definition: A radical regarded as derived from ammonium by the substitution of mercury for a portion of the hydrogen.

residentiary.definition:
Having residence; as, a canon residentary; a residentiary guardian. Dr. H. More.

1. One who is resident. The residentiary, or the frequent visitor of the favored spot, . . . will discover that both have been there. Coleridge. 2. An ecclesiastic who keeps a certain residence. Syn. -- Inhabitant; inh.

amylaceous.definition: Pertaining to starch; of the nature of starch; starchy.

divest.definition: To unclothe; to strip, as of clothes, arms, or equipage; -- opposed to invest. 2. Fig.: To strip; to deprive; to dispossess; as, to divest one of his rights or privileges; to divest one's self of prejudices, passions, etc. Wretches divested of every moral feeling. Goldsmith. The tendency of the lang.

workhouse.definition: A house where any manufacture is carried on; a workshop. 2. A house in which idle and vicious persons are confined to labor. 3. A house where the town poor are maintained at public expense, and provided with labor; a poorhouse.

setout.definition: A display, as of plate, equipage, etc.; that which is displayed. [Coloq.] Dickens.

marionette.definition: A puppet moved by strings, as in a puppet show. 2. (Zoöl.)  The buffel duck. MARIOTTE'S LAW Ma`ri*otte's law`. (Physics.)  See Boyle's law, under Law.

trichinous.definition: Of or pertaining to trichinæ or trichinosis; affected with, or containing, trichinæ; as, trichinous meat.

magniloquence.definition: The quality of being magniloquent; pompous discourse; grandiloquence.

macrozooespore.definition: A large motile spore having four vibratile cilia; -- found in certain green algæ.

effluviable.definition: Capable of being given off as an effluvium. "Effluviable matter." Boyle.

noncondensing.definition: Not condensing; discharging the steam from the cylinder at a pressure nearly equal to or above that of the atmosphere and not into a condenser.

millrind.definition: A figure supposed to represent the iron which holds a millstone by being set into its center.

epipleural.definition: Arising from the pleurapophysis of a vertebra. Owen.

gentile.definition: One of a non-Jewish nation; one neither a Jew nor a Christian; a worshiper of false gods; a heathen. Note: The Hebrews included in the term goyim, or nations, all the tribes of men who had not received the true faith, and were not circumcised. The Christians translated goyim by the L. gentes, and im.

flake.definition: A paling; a hurdle. [prov. Eng.] 2. A platform of hurdles, or small sticks made fast or interwoven, supported by stanchions, for drying codfish and other things. You shall also, after they be ripe, neither suffer them to have straw nor fern under them, but lay them either upon some smooth table, boa.
