standardize.definition: To reduce to a normal standard; to calculate or adjust the strength of, by means of, and for uses in, analysis.

protuberate.definition: To swell, or be prominent, beyond the adjacent surface; to bulge out. S. Sharp.

conte.definition: A short narrative or tale, esp. one dealing with surprising or marvelous events. The conte (sic) is a tale something more than a sketch, it may be, and something less than a short story. . . . The "Canterbury Tales" are contes, most of them, if not all, and so are some of the "Tales of a Wayside Inn.

connaturally.definition: By the act of nature; originally; from birth. Sir M. Hale.

hospitalize.definition: To render (a building) unfit for habitation, by long continued use as a hospital.

universologist.definition: One who is versed in universology.

edict.definition: A public command or ordinance by the sovereign power; the proclamation of a law made by an absolute authority, as if by the very act of announcement; a decree; as, the edicts of the Roman emperors; the edicts of the French monarch. It stands as an edict in destiny. Shak. Edict of Nantes (French Hist.

coatless.definition: Not wearing a coat; also, not possessing a coat.

cathode.definition: The part of a voltaic battery by which the electric current leaves substances through which it passes, or the surface at which the electric current passes out of the electrolyte; the negative pole; -- opposed to anode. Faraday. Cathode ray (Phys.), a kind of ray generated at the cathode in a vacuum.

sixteenth.definition:
Sixth after the tenth; next in order after the fifteenth. 2. Constituting or being one of sixteen equal parts into which anything is divided. Sixteenth note (Mus.), the sixteenth part of a whole note; a semiquaver.

1. The quotient of a unit divided by sixteen; one of sixteen equal parts of one whol.

revert.definition: To turn back, or to the contrary; to reverse. Till happy chance revert the cruel scence. Prior. The tumbling stream . . . Reverted, plays in undulating flow. Thomson. 2. To throw back; to reflect; to reverberate. 3. (Chem.)  To change back. See Revert, v. i. To revert a series (Alg.), to treat a ser.

oilcloth.definition: Cloth treated with oil or paint, and used for marking garments, covering flooors, etc.

skeptic.definition: One who is yet undecided as to what is true; one who is looking or inquiring for what is true; an inquirer after facts or reasons. 2. (Metaph.)  A doubter as to whether any fact or truth can be certainly known; a universal doubter; a Pyrrhonist; hence, in modern usage, occasionally, a person who que.

disclaunder.definition: To injure one's good name; to slander.

brier.definition: A plant with a slender woody stem bearing stout prickles; especially, species of Rosa, Rubus, and Smilax. 2. Fig.: Anything sharp or unpleasant to the feelings. The thorns and briers of reproof. Cowper. Brier root, the root of the southern Smilax laurifolia and S. Walleri; -- used for tobacco pipes.

hexad.definition: An atom whose valence is six, and which can be theoretically combined with, substituted for, or replaced by, six monad atoms or radicals; as, sulphur is a hexad in sulphuric acid. Also used as an adjective.

complexionary.definition: Pertaining to the complexion, or to the care of it. Jer. Taylor.

pueblo.definition: A communistic building erected by certain Indian tribes of Arizona and New Mexico. It is often of large size and several stories high, and is usually built either of stone or adobe. The term is also applied to any Indian village in the same region. Pueblo Indians (Ethnol.), any tribe or community of.

roadster.definition: (Naut.)  A clumsy vessel that works its way from one anchorage to another by means of the tides. Ham. Nav. Encyc. 2. A horse that is accustomed to traveling on the high road, or is suitable for use on ordinary roads. A sound, swift, well-fed hunter and roadster. Thackeray. 3. A bicycle or tricycle a.

inexhaustibility.definition: The state or quality of being inexhaustible; abundance.

ranine.definition: (Zoöl.)  Of or pertaining to the frogs and toads. 2. (Anat.)  Pertaining to, or designating, a swelling under the tongue; also, pertaining to the region where the swelling occurs; -- applied especially to branches of the lingual artery and lingual vein.

triseralous.definition: Having three sepals, or calyx leaves.

deconsecrate.definition: To deprive of sacredness; to secularize. -- De*con`se*cra"tion, n.

shelfy.definition: Abounding in shelves; full of dangerous shallows. "A shelfy coast." Dryden. 2. Full of strata of rock. The tillable fields are in some places . . . so shelfy that the corn hath much ado to fasten its root. Carew.

conservant.definition: Having the power or quality of conservation.

stoichiometric.definition: Of or pertaining to stoichiometry; employed in, or obtained by, stoichiometry.

herbivorous.definition: Eating plants; of or pertaining to the Herbivora.

synantherous.definition: Having the stamens united by their anthers; as, synantherous flowers.

billman.definition: One who uses, or is armed with, a bill or hooked ax. "A billman of the guard." Savile.

concretion.definition: The process of concreting; the process of uniting or of becoming united, as particles of matter into a mass; solidification. 2. A mass or nodule of solid matter formed by growing together, by congelation, condensation, coagulation, induration, etc.; a clot; a lump; a calculus. Accidental ossificatio.

sawyer.definition: One whose occupation is to saw timber into planks or boards, or to saw wood for fuel; a sawer. 2. A tree which has fallen into a stream so that its branches project above the surface, rising and falling with a rocking or swaying motion in the current. [U.S.] 3. (Zoöl.)  The bowfin. [Local, U.S.].

vitiation.definition: The act of vitiating, or the state of being vitiated; depravation; corruption; invalidation; as, the vitiation of the blood; the vitiation of a contract. The vitiation that breeds evil acts. G. Eliot.

embryogeny.definition: The production and development of an embryo.

ooetooid.definition: A half oviparous, or an oviparous, mammal; a marsupial or monotreme.

adventitious.definition: Added extrinsically; not essentially inherent; accidental or causal; additional; supervenient; foreign. To things of great dimensions, if we annex an adventitious idea of terror, they become without comparison greater. Burke. 2. (Nat. Hist.)  Out of the proper or usual place; as, adventitious buds o.

confineless.definition: Without limitation or end; boundless. Shak.

agreeable.definition: Pleasing, either to the mind or senses; pleasant; grateful; as, agreeable manners or remarks; an agreeable person; fruit agreeable to the taste. A train of agreeable reveries. Goldsmith. 2. Willing; ready to agree or consent. These Frenchmen give unto the said captain of Calais a great sum of money,.

sapucaia.definition: A Brazilian tree. See Lecythis, and Monkey-pot. [Written also sapucaya.] Sapucaia nut (Bot.), the seed of the sapucaia; -- called also paradise nut.

autoplasty.definition: The process of artificially repairing lesions by taking a piece of healthy tissue, as from a neighboring part, to supply the deficiency caused by disease or wounds.

alderman.definition: A senior or superior; a person of rank or dignity. Note: The title was applied, among the Anglo-Saxons, to princes, dukes, earls, senators, and presiding magistrates; also to archbishops and bishops, implying superior wisdom or authority. Thus Ethelstan, duke of the East-Anglians, was called Alderma.

excoct.definition: To boil out; to produce by boiling. Bacon.

ganocephala.definition: A group of fossil amphibians allied to the labyrinthodonts, having the head defended by bony, sculptured plates, as in some ganoid fishes.

sapindaceous.definition: Of or pertaining to an order of trees and shrubs (Sapindaceæ), including the (Typical) genus Sapindus, the maples, the margosa, and about seventy other genera.

giver.definition: One who gives; a donor; a bestower; a grantor; one who imparts or distributes. It is the giver, and not the gift, that engrosses the heart of the Christian. Kollock.

cycloidei.definition: An order of fishes, formerly proposed by Agassiz, for those with thin, smooth scales, destitute of marginal spines, as the herring and salmon. The group is now regarded as artificial.

disinclination.definition: The state of being disinclined; want of propensity, desire, or affection; slight aversion or dislike; indisposition. Disappointment gave him a disinclination to the fair sex. Arbuthnot. Having a disinclination to books or business. Guardian. Syn. -- Unwillingness; disaffection; alienation; dislike;.

feracity.definition: The state of being feracious or fruitful. Beattie.

allonym.definition: The name of another person assumed by the author of a work. 2. A work published under the name of some one other than the author.

hornblower.definition: One who, or that which, blows a horn.

dismarry.definition: To free from the bonds of marriage; to divorce. Ld. Berners.

intermundane.definition: Being, between worlds or orbs. "Intermundane spaces." Locke.

ascription.definition: The act of ascribing, imputing, or affirming to belong; also, that which is ascribed.

bejuco.definition: Any climbing woody vine of the tropics with the habit of a liane; in the Philippines, esp. any of various species of Calamus, the cane or rattan palm.

mammee.definition: A fruit tree of tropical America, belonging to the genus Mammea (M. Americana); also, its fruit. The latter is large, covered with a thick, tough ring, and contains a bright yellow pulp of a pleasant taste and fragrant scent. It is often called mammee apple.

rump-fed.definition: A Shakespearean word of uncertain meaning. Perhaps "fattened in the rump, pampered." "The rump-fed ronyon.".

saponacity.definition: The quality or state of being saponaceous.

ren.definition:
See Renne. Chaucer.

A run. Chaucer.

ministration.definition: The act of ministering; service; ministry. "The days of his ministration." Luke i. 23.

cinchona.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of trees growing naturally on the Andes in Peru and adjacent countries, but now cultivated in the East Indies, producing a medicinal bark of great value. 2. (Med.)  The bark of any species of cinchona containing three per cent. or more of bitter febrifuge alkaloids; Peruvian bark; Je.

psyche.definition: (Class Myth.)  A lovely maiden, daughter of a king and mistress of Eros, or Cupid. She is regarded as the personification of the soul. 2. The soul; the vital principle; the mind. 3. Etym: [F. psyché.]  A cheval glass.

quarry-faced.definition: Having a face left as it comes from the quarry and not smoothed with the chisel or point; -- said of stones.

bolection.definition: A projecting molding round a panel. Same as Bilection. Gwilt.

shifter.definition: One who, or that which, shifts; one who plays tricks or practices artifice; a cozener. 'T was such a shifter that, if truth were known, Death was half glad when he had got him down. Milton. 2. (Naut.)  An assistant to the ship's cook in washing, steeping, and shifting the salt provisions. 3. (Mach.).

symbolization.definition: The act of symbolizing; symbolical representation. Sir T. Browne.

cognition.definition: The act of knowing; knowledge; perception. I will not be myself nor have cognation Of what I feel: I am all patience. Shak. 2. That which is known.

overdrown.definition: To wet or drench to excess. W. Browne.

stephanion.definition: The point on the side of the skull where the temporal line, or upper edge of the temporal fossa, crosses the coronal suture.

anergy.definition: Lack of energy; inactivity. -- An*er"gic (#), a.

voiceful.definition: Having a voice or vocal quality; having a loud voice or many voices; vocal; sounding. Beheld the Iliad and the Odyssey Rise to the swelling of the voiceful sea. Coleridge.

floricomous.definition: Having the head adorned with flowers.

fetich.definition: A material object supposed among certain African tribes to represent in such a way, or to be so connected with, a supernatural being, that the possession of it gives to the possessor power to control that being. 2. Any object to which one is excessively devoted.

plaided.definition: Of the material of which plaids are made; tartan. "In plaided vest." Wordsworth. 2. Wearing a plaid. Campbell.

washout.definition: The washing out or away of earth, etc., especially of a portion of the bed of a road or railroad by a fall of rain or a freshet; also, a place, especially in the bed of a road or railroad, where the earth has been washed away.

arpentator.definition: The Anglicized form of the French arpenteur, a land surveyor.

premonishment.definition: Previous warning or admonition; forewarning. Sir H. Wotton.

anharmonic.definition: Not harmonic. The anharmonic function or ratio of four points abcd on a straight line is the quantity (ac/ad):(bc/bd), where the segments are to regarded as plus or minus, according to the order of the letters.

ridotto.definition:
A favorite Italian public entertainment, consisting of music and dancing, -- held generally on fast eves. Brande & C. There are to be ridottos at guinea tickets. Walpole.

To hold ridottos. J. G. Cooper.

lapillation.definition: The state of being, or the act of making, stony.

purge.definition: To cleanse, clear, or purify by separating and carrying off whatever is impure, heterogeneous, foreign, or superfluous. "Till fire purge all things new." Milton. 2. (Med.)  To operate on as, or by means of, a cathartic medicine, or in a similar manner. 3. To clarify; to defecate, as liquors. 4. To c.

troupial.definition: Any one of numerous species of bright-colored American birds belonging to Icterus and allied genera, especially Icterus icterus, a native of the West Indies and South America. Many of the species are called orioles in America. [Written also troopial.].

prohibit.definition: To forbid by authority; to interdict; as, God prohibited Adam from eating of the fruit of a certain tree; we prohibit a person from doing a thing, and also the doing of the thing; as, the law prohibits men from stealing, or it prohibits stealing. Note: Prohibit was formerly followed by to with the i.

confiscate.definition:
Seized and appropriated by the government to the public use; forfeited. Lest that your goods too soon be confiscate. Shak.

To seize as forfeited to the public treasury; to appropriate to the public use. It was judged that he should be banished and his whole estate confiscated and seized. Bacon.

alkalescence.definition: A tendency to become alkaline; or the state of a substance in which alkaline properties begin to be developed, or to predominant. Ure.

institutive.definition: Tending or intended to institute; having the power to establish. Barrow. 2. Established; depending on, or characterized by, institution or order. "Institutive decency." Milton.

triglyceride.definition: A glyceride formed by the replacement of three hydrogen atoms in glycerin by acid radicals.

illicium.definition: A genus of Asiatic and American magnoliaceous trees, having star-shaped fruit; star anise. The fruit of Illicium anisatum is used as a spice in India, and its oil is largely used in Europe for flavoring cordials, being almost identical with true oil of anise.

intercarpal.definition: Between the carpal bone; as, intercarpal articulations, ligaments.

necromancer.definition: One who practices necromancy; a sorcerer; a wizard.

dishful.definition: As much as a dish holds when full.

amphioxus.definition: A fishlike creature (Amphioxus lanceolatus), two or three inches long, found in temperature seas; -- also called the lancelet. Its body is pointed at both ends. It is the lowest and most generalized of the vertebrates, having neither brain, skull, vertebræ, nor red blood. It forms the type of the gr.

sovran.definition: A variant of Sovereign. [Poetic] On thy bald, awful head, O sovran Blanc. Coleridge.

suitor.definition: One who sues, petitions, or entreats; a petitioner; an applicant. She hath been a suitor to me for her brother. Shak. 2. Especially, one who solicits a woman in marriage; a wooer; a lover. Sir P. Sidney. 3. (a) (Law) One who sues or prosecutes a demand in court; a party to a suit, as a plaintiff, pe.

catilinarian.definition: Pertaining to Catiline, the Roman conspirator; resembling Catiline's conspiracy.

filasse.definition: Vegetable fiber, as jute or ramie, prepared for manufacture.

pestle.definition:
An implement for pounding and breaking or braying substances in a mortar. 2. A constable's or bailiff's staff; -- so called from its shape. Chapman. 3. The leg and leg bone of an animal, especially of a pig; as, a pestle of pork.

To pound, pulverize, bray, or mix with a pestle, or as with a pestle;.

generically.definition: With regard to a genus, or an extensive class; as, an animal generically distinct from another, or two animals or plants generically allied.

cuckoldry.definition: The state of being a cuckold; the practice of making cuckolds. CUCKOLD'S KNOT Cuck"old's knot` (kk"ldz nt`). (Naut.)  A hitch or knot, by which a rope is secured to a spar, the two parts of the rope being crossed and seized together; -- called also cuckold's neck. Ham. Nav. Encyc.

atheneum.definition: A temple of Athene, at Athens, in which scholars and poets were accustomed to read their works and instruct students. 2. A school founded at Rome by Hadrian. 3. A literary or scientific association or club. 4. A building or an apartment where a library, periodicals, and newspapers are kept for use.

epicycle.definition: (Ptolemaic Astron.)  A circle, whose center moves round in the circumference of a greater circle; or a small circle, whose center, being fixed in the deferent of a planet, is carried along with the deferent, and yet, by its own peculiar motion, carries the body of the planet fastened to it round its.

tuberose.definition:
A plant (Polianthes tuberosa) with a tuberous root and a liliaceous flower. It is much cultivated for its beautiful and fragrant white blossoms.

Tuberous.

lief.definition:
Same as Lif.

1. Dear; beloved. [Obs., except in poetry.] "My liefe mother." Chaucer. "My liefest liege." Shak. As thou art lief and dear. Tennyson. 2. Note: (Used with a form of the verb to be, and the dative of the personal pronoun.)  Pleasing; agreeable; acceptable; preferable. See Lief, adv., an.

ribald.definition:
A low, vulgar, brutal, foul-mouthed wretch; a lewd fellow. Spenser. Pope. Ribald was almost a class name in the feudal system . . . He was his patron's parasite, bulldog, and tool . . . It is not to be wondered at that the word rapidly became a synonym for everything ruffianly and brutal. Earle.

Lo.

beglerbeg.definition: The governor of a province of the Ottoman empire, next in dignity to the grand vizier.

silt.definition:
Mud or fine earth deposited from running or standing water.

To choke, fill, or obstruct with silt or mud.

To flow through crevices; to percolate.

beautifier.definition: One who, or that which, beautifies or makes beautiful.

inferiae.definition: Sacrifices offered to the souls of deceased heroes or friends.

sorehead.definition: One who is disgruntled by a failure in politics, or the like. [Slang, U.S.].

transumption.definition: Act of taking from one place to another. South.

pseudomorphous.definition: Not having the true form. Pseudomorphous crystal, one which has a form that does not result from its own powers of crystallization.

webfoot.definition: A foot the toes of which are connected by a membrane. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any web-footed bird.

spermatin.definition: A substance allied to alkali albumin and to mucin, present in semen, to which it is said to impart the mucilaginous character.

immortification.definition: Failure to mortify the passions. Jer. Taylor.

eath.definition: Easy or easily. "Eath to move with plaints." Fairfax.

viatic.definition: Of or pertaining to a journey or traveling.

drumstick.definition: A stick with which a drum is beaten. 2. Anything resembling a drumstick in form, as the tibiotarsus, or second joint, of the leg of a fowl.

uropoetic.definition: (Med.)  Producing, or favoring the production of, urine. 2. (Zoöl.)  Of, pertaining to, or designating, a system of organs which eliminate nitrogenous waste matter from the blood of certain invertebrates.

overheat.definition: To heat to excess; to superheat. Cowper.

criminate.definition: To accuse of, or charge with, a crime. To criminate, with the heavy and ungrounded charge of disloyalty and disaffection, an uncorrupt, independent, and reforming parliament. Burke. 2. To involve in a crime or in its consequences; to render liable to a criminal charge. Impelled by the strongest pres.

heteroclitic.definition: Deviating from ordinary forms or rules; irregular; anomalous; abnormal.

defiance.definition: The act of defying, putting in opposition, or provoking to combat; a challenge; a provocation; a summons to combat. A war without a just defiance made. Dryden. Stood for her cause, and flung defiance down. Tennyson. 2. A state of opposition; willingness to flight; disposition to resist; contempt of.

semuncia.definition: A Roman coin equivalent to one twenty-fourth part of a Roman pound.

redirect.definition: Applied to the examination of a witness, by the party calling him, after the cross-examination.

gid.definition: A disease of sheep, characterized by vertigo; the staggers. It is caused by the presence of the CC.

osteopterygious.definition: Having bones in the fins, as certain fishes.

limbec.definition:
An alembic; a still. Spenser. Shak.

To distill. Dryden.

decortication.definition: The act of stripping off the bark, rind, hull, or outer coat.

plumming.definition: The operation of finding, by means of a mine dial, the place where to sink an air shaft, or to bring an adit to the work, or to find which way the lode inclines.

simile.definition: A word or phrase by which anything is likened, in one or more of its aspects, to something else; a similitude; a poetical or imaginative comparison. A good swift simile, but something currish. Shak.

foolify.definition: To make a fool of; to befool. Holland.

andantino.definition: Rather quicker than andante; between that allegretto. Note: Some, taking andante in its original sense of "going," and andantino as its diminutive, or "less going," define the latter as slower than andante.

venesection.definition: The act or operation of opening a vein for letting blood; bloodletting; phlebotomy.

molehill.definition: A little hillock of earth thrown up by moles working under ground; hence, a very small hill, or an insignificant obstacle or difficulty. Having leapt over such mountains, lie down before a molehill. South.

scottering.definition: The burning of a wad of pease straw at the end of harvest.

crimination.definition: The act of accusing; accusation; charge; complaint. The criminations and recriminations of the adverse parties. Macaulay.

poorbox.definition: A receptacle in which money given for the poor is placed.

utricle.definition: A little sac or vesicle, as the air cell of fucus, or seaweed. 2. (Physiol.)  A microscopic cell in the structure of an egg, animal, or plant. 3. (Bot.)  A small, thin-walled, one-seeded fruit, as of goosefoot. Gray. 4. (Anat.)  A utriculus.

briarean.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, Briareus, a giant fabled to have a hundred hands; hence, hundred-handed or many-handed.

atramentous.definition: Of or pertaining to ink; inky; black, like ink; as, atramental galls; atramentous spots.

compotier.definition: A dish for holding compotes, fruit, etc.

aldine.definition: An epithet applied to editions (chiefly of the classics) which proceeded from the press of Aldus Manitius, and his family, of Venice, for the most part in the 16th century and known by the sign of the anchor and the dolphin. The term has also been applied to certain elegant editions of English works.

remorseful.definition: Full of remorse. The full tide of remorseful passion had abated. Sir W. Scott. 2. Compassionate; feeling tenderly. Shak. 3. Exciting pity; pitiable. Chapman. -- Re*morse"ful*ly, adv. -- Re*morse"ful*ness, n.

dichromate.definition: A salt of chromic acid containing two equivalents of the acid radical to one of the base; -- called also bichromate.

razorable.definition: Ready for the razor; fit to be shaved. Shak.

artillery.definition: Munitions of war; implements for warfare, as slings, bows, and arrows. And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad. 1 Sam. xx. 40. 2. Cannon; great guns; ordnance, including guns, mortars, howitzers, etc., with their equipment of carriages, balls, bombs, and shot of all kinds. Note: The word is som.

lapwork.definition: Work in which one part laps over another. Grew.

brigandage.definition: Life and practice of brigands; highway robbery; plunder.

diplopy.definition: The act or state of seeing double. Note: In crossed or heteronymous diplopia the image seen by the right eye is upon the left hand, and that seen by the left eye is upon the right hand. In homonymous diplopia the image seen by the right eye is on the right side, that by the left eye on the left side.

unsaturated.definition: Capable of absorbing or dissolving to a greater degree; as, an unsaturated solution. 2. (Chem.)  Capable of taking up, or of uniting with, certain other elements or compounds, without the elimination of any side product; thus, aldehyde, ethylene, and ammonia are unsaturated.

libelant.definition: One who libels; one who institutes a suit in an ecclesiastical or admiralty court. [Written also libellant.] Cranch.

spearwort.definition: A name given to several species of crowfoot (Ranunculus) which have spear-shaped leaves.

stipendiary.definition:
Receiving wages, or salary; performing services for a stated price or compensation. His great stipendiary prelates came with troops of evil-appointed horseman not half full. Knolles.

One who receives a stipend. If thou art become A tyrant's vile stipendiary. Glover.

idiophanous.definition: Exhibiting interference figures without the aid of a polariscope, as certain crystals.

deciduate.definition: Possessed of, or characterized by, a decidua.

skive.definition:
The iron lap used by diamond polishers in finishing the facets of the gem.

To pare or shave off the rough or thick parts of (hides or leather).

respecter.definition: One who respects. A respecter of persons, one who regards or judges with partiality. Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons. Acts x. 34.

lycopodite.definition: An old name for a fossil club moss.

mulierly.definition: In the manner or condition of a mulier; in wedlock; legitimately.

protoxidize.definition: To combine with oxygen, as any elementary substance, in such proportion as to form a protoxide.

preambulatory.definition: Preceding; going before; introductory. Simon Magus had preambulatory impieties. Jer. Taylor.

orthodromics.definition: The art of sailing in a direct course, or on the arc of a great circle, which is the shortest distance between any two points on the surface of the globe; great-circle sailing; orthodromy.

owe.definition: To possess; to have, as the rightful owner; to own. Thou dost here usurp The name thou ow'st not. Shak. 2. To have or possess, as something derived or bestowed; to be obliged to ascribe (something to some source); to be indebted or obliged for; as, he owed his wealth to his father; he owed his victo.

great-grandchild.definition: The child of one's grandson or granddaughter.

interspinal.definition: Between spines; esp., between the spinous processes of the vertebral column.

blastodermatic.definition: Of or pertaining to the blastoderm.

guerite.definition: A projecting turret for a sentry, as at the salient angles of works, or the acute angles of bastions.

vendible.definition:
Capable of being vended, or sold; that may be sold; salable. The regulating of prices of things vendible. Bacon. Note: Vendible differs from marketable; the latter signifies proper or fit for market, according to the laws or customs of a place. Vendible has no reference to such legal fitness.

Somet.

miasma.definition: Infectious particles or germs floating in the air; air made noxious by the presence of such particles or germs; noxious effluvia; malaria.

dewfall.definition: The falling of dew; the time when dew begins to fall.

dissociate.definition: To separate from fellowship or union; to disunite; to disjoin; as, to dissociate the particles of a concrete substance. Before Wyclif's death in 1384, John of Gaunt had openly dissociated himself from the reformer. A. W. Ward.

balsamation.definition: The act of imparting balsamic properties. 2. The art or process of embalming.

revendicate.definition: To reclaim; to demand the restoration of. Vattel (Trans. ).

nitrobenzene.definition: A yellow aromatic liquid (C6H5.NO2), produced by the action of nitric acid on benzene, and called from its odor imitation oil of bitter almonds, or essence of mirbane. It is used in perfumery, and is manufactured in large quantities in the preparation of aniline. Fornerly called also nitrobenzol.

bohemian.definition: Of or pertaining to Bohemia, or to the language of its ancient inhabitants or their descendants. See Bohemian, n., 2. 2. Of or pertaining to a social gypsy or "Bohemian" (see Bohemian, n., 3); vagabond; unconventional; free and easy. [Modern] Hers was a pleasant Bohemian life till she was five and t.

long-horned.definition: Having a long horn or horns; as, a long-horned goat, or cow; having long antennæ, as certain beetles (Longicornia).

nereocystis.definition: A genus of gigantic seaweeds. Note: Nereocystis Lutkeana, of the North Pacific, has a stem many fathoms long, terminating in a great vesicle, which is crowned with a tuft of long leaves. The stem is used by the Alaskans for fishing lines.

conductress.definition: A woman who leads or directs; a directress.

triangulate.definition: To divide into triangles; specifically, to survey by means of a series of triangles properly laid down and measured. 2. To make triangular, or three-cornered.

fantigue.definition: State of worry or excitment; fidget; ill humor. Dickens.

fetidness.definition: The quality or state of being fetid.

rabblement.definition: A tumultuous crowd of low people; a rabble. "Rude rablement." Spenser. And still, as he refused it, the rabblement hooted. Shak.

dime.definition: A silver coin of the United States, of the value of ten cents; the tenth of a dollar. Dime novel, a novel, commonly sensational and trashy, which is sold for a dime, or ten cents.

windfall.definition: Anything blown down or off by the wind, as fruit from a tree, or the tree itself, or a portion of a forest prostrated by a violent wind, etc. "They became a windfall upon the sudden." Bacon. 2. An unexpected legacy, or other gain. He had a mighty windfall out of doubt. B. Jonson.

sanders.definition: An old name of sandalwood, now applied only to the red sandalwood. See under Sandalwood.

seemingness.definition: Semblance; fair appearance; plausibility. Sir K. Digby.

rhombogene.definition: A dicyemid which produces infusorialike embryos; -- opposed to nematogene. See Dicyemata. [Written also rhombogen.].

conjurer.definition:
One who conjures; one who calls, entreats, or charges in a solemn manner.

1. One who practices magic arts; one who pretends to act by the aid super natural power; also, one who performs feats of legerdemain or sleight of hand. Dealing with witches and with conjurers. Shak. From the account the lose.

conventical.definition: Of or from, or pertaining to, a convent. "Conventical wages." Sterne. Conventical prior. See Prior.

pedalian.definition: Relating to the foot, or to a metrical foot; pedal. Maunder.

stahlian.definition:
Pertaining to, or taught by, Stahl, a German physician and chemist of the 17th century; as, the Stahlian theory of phlogiston.

A believer in, or advocate of, Stahlism.

trialogue.definition: A discourse or colloquy by three persons.

alibi.definition: The plea or mode of defense under which a person on trial for a crime proves or attempts to prove that he was in another place when the alleged act was committed; as, to set up an alibi; to prove an alibi.

tossing.definition: The act of throwing upward; a rising and falling suddenly; a rolling and tumbling. 2. (Mining) (a) A process which consists in washing ores by violent agitation in water, in order to separate the lighter or earhy particles; -- called also tozing, and treloobing, in Cornwall. Pryce. (b) A process for.

instore.definition: To store up; to inclose; to contain. Wyclif.

uncovenanted.definition: Not covenanted; not granted or entered into under a covenant, agreement, or contract. Bp. Horsley. 2. Not having joined in a league, or assented to a covenant or agreement, as to the Solemn League and Covenant of the Scottish people in the times of the Stuarts. In Scotland a few fanatical nonjurors.

suburbicary.definition: Being in the suburbs; -- applied to the six dioceses in the suburbs of Rome subject to the pope as bishop of Rome. The pope having stretched his authority beyond the bounds of his suburbicarian precincts. Barrow.

gavial.definition: A large Asiatic crocodilian (Gavialis Gangeticus); -- called also nako, and Gangetic crocodile. Note: The gavial has a long, slender muzzle, teeth of nearly uniform size, and feet completely webbed. It inhabits the Ganges and other rivers of India. The name is also applied to several allied fossil s.

analogize.definition: To employ, or reason by, analogy.

actinozoal.definition: Of or pertaining to the Actinozoa.

tartufish.definition: Like a tartuffe; precise; hypocritical. Sterne.

xylophilous.definition: Of or pertaining to the xylophilans.

manicheism.definition: The doctrines taught, or system of principles maintained, by the Manichæans.

subtilism.definition: The quality or state of being subtile; subtility; subtlety. The high orthodox subtilism of Duns Scotus. Milman.

rue.definition: (Bot.)  A perennial suffrutescent plant (Ruta graveolens), having a strong, heavy odor and a bitter taste; herb of grace. It is used in medicine. Then purged with euphrasy and rue The visual nerve, for he had much to see. Milton. They [the exorcists] are to try the devil by holy water, incense, sulp.

imbruement.definition: The act of imbruing or state of being imbrued.

shaftment.definition: A measure of about six inches.

maleficent.definition: Doing evil to others; harmful; mischievous.

tranquilizer.definition: One who, or that which, tranquilizes.

poleless.definition: Without a pole; as, a poleless chariot.

coracoid.definition:
Shaped like a crow's beak. 2. (Anat.)  Pertaining to a bone of the shoulder girdle in most birds, reptiles, and amphibians, which is reduced to a process of the scapula in most mammals.

The coracoid bone or process.

ghastly.definition:
Like a ghost in appearance; deathlike; pale; pallid; dismal. Each turned his face with a ghastly pang. Coleridge. His face was so ghastly that it could scarcely be recognized. Macaulay. 2. Horrible; shocking; dreadful; hideous. Mangled with ghastly wounds through plate and mail. Milton.

In a ghastl.

encage.definition: To confine in a cage; to coop up. Shak.

lustrical.definition: Pertaining to, or used for, purification.

waped.definition: Cast down; crushed by misery; dejected.

countersign.definition:
To sign on the opposite side of (an instrument or writing); hence, to sign in addition to the signature of a principal or superior, in order to attest the authenticity of a writing.

1. The signature of a secretary or other officer to a writing signed by a principal or superior, to attest its authen.

xiphoid.definition: (a) Like a sword; ensiform. (b) Of or pertaining to the xiphoid process; xiphoidian.

encarnalize.definition: To carnalize; to make gross. "Encarnalize their spirits." Tennyson.

proctocele.definition: Inversion and prolapse of the mucous coat of the rectum, from relaxation of the sphincter, with more or less swelling; prolapsus ani. Dunglison.

oxymel.definition: A mixture of honey, water, vinegar, and spice, boiled to a sirup. Sir T. Elyot.

squamose.definition: Covered with, or consisting of, scales; resembling a scale; scaly; as, the squamose cones of the pine; squamous epithelial cells; the squamous portion of the temporal bone, which is so called from a fancied resemblance to a scale. 2. (Anat.)  Of or pertaining to the squamosal bone; squamosal.

habit.definition: The usual condition or state of a person or thing, either natural or acquired, regarded as something had, possessed, and firmly retained; as, a religious habit; his habit is morose; elms have a spreading habit; esp., physical temperament or constitution; as, a full habit of body. 2. (Biol.)  The gen.

myelencephalous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Myelencephala.

sorehon.definition: Formerly, in Ireland, a kind of servile tenure which subjected the tenant to maintain his chieftain gratuitously whenever he wished to indulge in a revel. Spenser.

phrygian.definition: Of or pertaining to Phrygia, or to its inhabitants. Phrygian mode (Mus.), one of the ancient Greek modes, very bold and vehement in style; -- so called because fabled to have been invented by the Phrygian Marsyas. Moore (Encyc. of Music). -- Phrygian stone, a light, spongy stone, resembling a pumice.

photoplay.definition: A play for representation or exhibition by moving pictures; also, the moving-picture representation of a play.

protovertebra.definition: One of the primitive masses, or segments, into which the mesoblast of the vertebrate embryo breaks up on either side of the anterior part of the notochord; a mesoblastic, or protovertebral, somite. See Illust. of Ectoderm. Note: The protovertebræ were long regarded as rudiments of the permanent vert.

spekboom.definition: The purslane tree of South Africa, -- said to be the favorite food of elephants. Balfour (Cyc. of India).

symbiosis.definition: The living together in more or less imitative association or even close union of two dissimilar organisms. In a broad sense the term includes parasitism, or antagonistic, or antipathetic, symbiosis, in which the association is disadvantageous or destructive to one of the organisms, but ordinarily it.

genteel.definition: Possessing or exhibiting the qualities popularly regarded as belonging to high birth and breeding; free from vulgarity, or lowness of taste or behavior; adapted to a refined or cultivated taste; polite; well-bred; as, genteel company, manners, address. 2. Graceful in mien or form; elegant in appeara.

astronomical.definition: Of or pertaining to astronomy; in accordance with the methods or principles of astronomy. -- As`tro*nom"ic*al*ly, adv. Astronomical clock. See under Clock. -- Astronomical day. See under Day. -- Astronomical fractions, Astronomical numbers. See under Sexagesimal.

jacobitism.definition: The principles of the Jacobites. Mason.

iconoclasm.definition: The doctrine or practice of the iconoclasts; image breaking.

homoiousian.definition:
One of the semi-Arians of the 4th century, who held that the Son was of like, but not the same, essence or substance with the Father; -- opposed to homoousian.

Of or pertaining to Homoiousians, or their belief.

housecarl.definition: A household servant; also, one of the bodyguard of King Canute.

scrupulize.definition: To perplex with scruples; to regard with scruples. Bp. Montagu.

comprisal.definition: The act of comprising or comprehending; a compendium or epitome. A comprisal . . . and sum of all wickedness. Barrow.

smooth-chinned.definition: Having a smooth chin; beardless. Drayton.

gownman.definition: One whose professional habit is a gown, as a divine or lawyer, and particularly a member of an English university; hence, a civilian, in distinction from a soldier.

hieromancy.definition: Divination by observing the objects offered in sacrifice.

nympha.definition: (Zoöl.)  Same as Nymph, 3. 2. pl. (Anat.)  Two folds of mucous membrane, within the labia, at the opening of the vulva.

stupefacient.definition: Producing stupefaction; stupefactive. -- n. (Med.)  Anything promoting stupefaction; a narcotic.

morphinism.definition: A morbid condition produced by the excessive or prolonged use of morphine.

obolus.definition: (a) A small silver coin of Athens, the sixth part of a drachma, about three cents in value. (b) An ancient weight, the sixth part of a drachm.

oiled.definition: Covered or treated with oil; dressed with, or soaked in, oil. Oiled silk, silk rendered waterproof by saturation with boiled oil.

falx.definition: A curved fold or process of the dura mater or the peritoneum; esp., one of the partitionlike folds of the dura mater which extend into the great fissures of the brain.

bebloody.definition: To make bloody; to stain with blood. Sheldon.

malignify.definition: To make malign or malignant. "A strong faith malignified." Southey.

fourteenth.definition:
Next in order after the thirteenth; as, the fourteenth day of the month. 2. Making or constituting one of fourteen equal parts into which anything may be derived.

1. One of fourteen equal parts into which one whole may be divided; the quotient of a unit divided by fourteen; one next after the thirt.

endower.definition:
To endow. Waterhouse.

One who endows.

bing.definition: A heap or pile; as, a bing of wood. "Potato bings." Burns. "A bing of corn." Surrey. [Obs. or Dial. Eng. & Scot.].

eventuate.definition: To come out finally or in conclusion; to result; to come to pass.

nitromuriatic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or composed of, nitric acid and muriatic acid; nitrohydrochloric. See Nitrohydrochloric.

bettong.definition: A small, leaping Australian marsupial of the genus Bettongia; the jerboa kangaroo.

messinese.definition: Of or pertaining to Messina, or its inhabitans.

ramulus.definition: A small branch, or branchlet, of corals, hydroids, and similar organisms.

tilt-mill.definition: A mill where a tilt hammer is used, or where the process of tilting is carried on.

sickle.definition: A reaping instrument consisting of a steel blade curved into the form of a hook, and having a handle fitted on a tang. The sickle has one side of the blade notched, so as always to sharpen with a serrated edge. Cf. Reaping hook, under Reap. When corn has once felt the sickle, it has no more benefit.

quadrillion.definition: According to the French notation, which is followed also upon the Continent and in the United States, a unit with fifteen ciphers annexed; according to the English notation, the number produced by involving a million to the fourth power, or the number represented by a unit with twenty-four ciphers a.

uranography.definition: A description or plan of the heavens and the heavenly bodies; the construction of celestial maps, globes, etc.; uranology.

prairial.definition: The ninth month of the French Republican calendar, which dated from September 22, 1792. It began May, 20, and ended June 18. See Vendemiaire.

mistradition.definition: A wrong tradition. "Monsters of mistradition." Tennyson.

pourparler.definition: A consultation preliminary to a treaty.

borecole.definition: A brassicaceous plant of many varieties, cultivated for its leaves, which are not formed into a compact head like the cabbage, but are loose, and are generally curled or wrinkled; kale.

binder.definition: One who binds; as, a binder of sheaves; one whose trade is to bind; as, a binder of books. 2. Anything that binds, as a fillet, cord, rope, or band; a bandage; -- esp. the principal piece of timber intended to bind together any building.

moulder.definition:
One who, or that which, molds or forms into shape; specifically (Founding), one skilled in the art of making molds for castings.

To crumble into small particles; to turn to dust by natural decay; to lose form, or waste away, by a gradual separation of the component particles, without the presence o.

spitter.definition:
One who ejects saliva from the mouth.

1. One who puts meat on a spit. 2. (Zoöl.)  A young deer whose antlers begin to shoot or become sharp; a brocket, or pricket.

tortious.definition: Injurious; wrongful. "Tortious power." Spenser. 2. (Law)  Imploying tort, or privat injury for which the law gives damages; involing tort.

shortness.definition: The quality or state of being short; want of reach or extension; brevity; deficiency; as, the shortness of a journey; the shortness of the days in winter; the shortness of an essay; the shortness of the memory; a shortness of provisions; shortness of breath.

gynaecium.definition: The part of a large house, among the ancients, exclusively appropriated to women. [Written also gyneceum, gynecium.] Tennyson.

foxy.definition: Like or pertaining to the fox; foxlike in disposition or looks; wily. Modred's narrow, foxy face. Tennyson. 2. Having the color of a fox; of a yellowish or reddish brown color; -- applied sometimes to paintings when they have too much of this color. 3. Having the odor of a fox; rank; strong smeellin.

stoniness.definition: The quality or state of being stony.

capnomor.definition: A limpid, colorless oil with a peculiar odor, obtained from beech tar. Watts.

wing-handed.definition: Having the anterior limbs or hands adapted for flight, as the bats and pterodactyls.

perseus.definition: (Class. Myth.)  A Grecian legendary hero, son of Jupiter and Danaë, who slew the Gorgon Medusa. 2. (Astron.)  A consellation of the northern hemisphere, near Taurus and Cassiopea. It contains a star cluster visible to the naked eye as a nebula.

eyelet.definition: A small hole or perforation to receive a cord or fastener, as in garments, sails, etc. 2. A metal ring or grommet, or short metallic tube, the ends of which can be bent outward and over to fasten it in place; -- used to line an eyelet hole. Eyelet hole, a hole made for an eyelet. -- Eyelet punch, a.

tatta.definition: A bamboo frame or trellis hung at a door or window of a house, over which water is suffered to trickle, in order to moisten and cool the air as it enters. [India].

eaglewood.definition: A kind of fragrant wood. See Agallochum.

philostorgy.definition: Natural affection, as of parents for their children.

scut.definition: The tail of a hare, or of a deer, or other animal whose tail is short, sp. when carried erect; hence, sometimes, the animal itself. "He ran like a scut." Skelton. How the Indian hare came to have a long tail, wheras that part in others attains no higher than a scut. Sir T. Browne. My doe with the bl.

wapinschaw.definition: An exhibition of arms. according to the rank of the individual, by all persons bearing arms; -- formerly made at certain seasons in each district. [Scot.] Jamieson. Sir W. Scott.

dissensious.definition: Disposed to discord; contentious; dissentious. Ascham. -- Dis*sen"sious*ly, adv. Chapman.

camelbacked.definition: Having a back like a camel; humpbacked. Fuller.

armory.definition: A place where arms and instruments of war are deposited for safe keeping. 2. Armor: defensive and offensive arms. Celestial armory, shields, helms, and spears. Milton. 3. A manufactory of arms, as rifles, muskets, pistols, bayonets, swords. [U.S.] 4. Ensigns armorial; armorial bearings. Spensplw. 5.

mischief-making.definition: Causing harm; exciting enmity or quarrels. Rowe. -- n.  The act or practice of making mischief, inciting quarrels, etc.

irremovable.definition: Not removable; immovable; inflexible. Shak. -- Ir`re*mov"a*bly, adv.

phaeospore.definition: A brownish zoöspore, characteristic of an order (Phæosporeæ) of dark green or olive-colored algæ. -- Phæ`o*spor"ic, a.

roadmaster.definition: One who has charge of the track; --called also roadmaster.

labyrinthibranch.definition: Of or pertaining to the Labyrinthici. -- n.  One of the Labyrinthici.

queachy.definition: Yielding or trembling under the feet, as moist or boggy ground; shaking; moving. "The queachy fens." "Godwin's queachy sands." Drayton. 2. Like a queach; thick; bushy. Cockeram.

pommel.definition:
A knob or ball; an object resembling a ball in form; as: (a) The knob on the hilt of a sword. Macaulay. (b) The knob or protuberant part of a saddlebow. (c) The top (of the head). Chaucer. (d) A knob forming the finial of a turret or pavilion.

To beat soundly, as with the pommel of a sword, or with.

macrurous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Macrura; having a long tail.

microbiology.definition: The study of minute organisms, or microbes, as the bacteria. -- Mi`cro*bi`o*log"ic*al (#), a. -- Mi`cro*bi*ol"o*gist (#), n.

ogham.definition: A particular kind of writing practiced by the ancient Irish, and found in inscriptions on stones, metals, etc. [Written also ogam.].

ruba-dub.definition: The sound of a drum when continuously beaten; hence, a clamorous, repeated sound; a clatter. The rubadub of the abolition presses. D. Webster.

skeet.definition: A scoop with a long handle, used to wash the sides of a vessel, and formerly to wet the sails or deck.

courtesan.definition: A woman who prostitutes herself for hire; a prostitute; a harlot. Lasciviously decked like a courtesan. Sir H. Wotton.

potto.definition: (a) A nocturnal mammal (Perodictius potto) of the Lemur family, found in West Africa. It has rudimentary forefingers. Called also aposoro, and bush dog. (b) The kinkajou. POTT'S DISEASE Pott's" dis*ease". (Med.)  Caries of the vertebræ, frequently resulting in curvature of the spine and paralysis of.

banlieue.definition: The territory without the walls, but within the legal limits, of a town or city. Brande & C.

verge.definition: A rod or staff, carried as an emblem of authority; as, the verge, carried before a dean. 2. The stick or wand with which persons were formerly admitted tenants, they holding it in the hand, and swearing fealty to the lord. Such tenants were called tenants by the verge. [Eng.] 3. (Eng. Law)  The comp.

carnosity.definition: (Med.)  A fleshy excrescence; esp. a small excrescence or fungous growth. Wiseman. 2. Fleshy substance or quality; fleshy covering. [Consciences] overgrown with so hard a carnosity. Spelman. The olives, indeed be very small there, and bigger than capers; yet commended they are for their carnosity. H.

electrolysis.definition: The act or process of chemical decomposition, by the action of electricity; as, the electrolysis of silver or nickel for plating; the electrolysis of water.

partenope.definition: (Gr. Myth.)  One of the Sirens, who threw herself into the sea, in despair at not being able to beguile Ulysses by her songs. 2. One of the asteroids between Mars and Jupiter, descovered by M. de Gasparis in 1850.

exactitude.definition: The quality of being exact; exactness.

phlorol.definition: A liquid metameric with xylenol, belonging to the class of phenols, and obtained by distilling certain salts of phloretic acid.

ornithopoda.definition: An order of herbivorous dinosaurs with birdlike characteristics in the skeleton, esp. in the pelvis and hind legs, which in some genera had only three functional toes, and supported the body in walking as in Iguanodon. See Illust. in Appendix.

brabble.definition:
To clamor; to contest noisily.

A broil; a noisy contest; a wrangle. This petty brabble will undo us all. Shak.

steeve.definition:
To project upward, or make an angle with the horizon or with the line of a vessel's keel; -- said of the bowsprit, etc.

1. (Shipbuilding)  To elevate or fix at an angle with the horizon; -- said of the bowsprit, etc. 2. To stow, as bales in a vessel's hold, by means of a steeve. See Steeve, n. (b).

talmudic.definition: Of or pertaining to the Talmud; contained in the Talmud; as, Talmudic Greek; Talmudical phrases. Lightfoot.

caftan.definition:
A garment worn throughout the Levant, consisting of a long gown with sleeves reaching below the hands. It is generally fastened by a belt or sash.

To clothe with a caftan. The turbaned and caftaned damsel. Sir W. Scott.

mesoseme.definition: Having a medium orbital index; having orbits neither broad nor narrow; between megaseme and microseme.

begone.definition:
Go away; depart; get you gone.

Surrounded; furnished; beset; environed (as in woe-begone). Gower. Chaucer.

pyx.definition: ( R. C. Ch.)  The box, case, vase, or tabernacle, in which the host is reserved. 2. A box used in the British mint as a place of deposit for certain sample coins taken for a trial of the weight and fineness of metal before it is sent from the mint. Mushet. 3. (Naut.)  The box in which the compass is.

wrathily.definition: In a wrathy manner; very angrily; wrathfully.

ammonal.definition: An explosive consisting of a mixture of powdered aluminium and nitrate of ammonium.

blackguardly.definition: In the manner of or resembling a blackguard; abusive; scurrilous; ruffianly.

magically.definition: In a magical manner; by magic, or as if by magic.

vaporish.definition: Full of vapors; vaporous. 2. Hypochondriacal; affected by hysterics; splenetic; peevish; humorsome. Pallas grew vap'rish once and odd. Pope.

gaff.definition:
A barbed spear or a hook with a handle, used by fishermen in securing heavy fish. 2. (Naut.)  The spar upon which the upper edge of a fore-and-aft sail is extended. 3. Same as Gaffle, 1. Wright.

To strike with a gaff or barbed spear; to secure by means of a gaff; as, to gaff a salmon.

porite.definition: Any coral of the genus Porites, or family Poritidæ.

roundsman.definition: A patrolman; also, a policeman who acts as an inspector over the rounds of the patrolmen.

asarone.definition: A crystallized substance, resembling camphor, obtained from the Asarum Europæum; -- called also camphor of asarum.

castalian.definition: Of or pertaining to Castalia, a mythical fountain of inspiration on Mt. Parnassus sacred to the Muses. Milton.

chasable.definition: Capable of being chased; fit for hunting. Gower.

jacquerie.definition: The name given to a revolt of French peasants against the nobles in 1358, the leader assuming the contemptuous title, Jacques Bonhomme, given by the nobles to the peasantry. Hence, any revolt of peasants.

beneficiary.definition:
Holding some office or valuable possession, in subordination to another; holding under a feudal or other superior; having a dependent and secondary possession. A feudatory or beneficiary king of England. Bacon. 2. Bestowed as a gratuity; as, beneficiary gifts.

1. A feudatory or vassal; hence, one w.

cassimere.definition: A thin, twilled, woolen cloth, used for men's garments. [Written also kerseymere.].

angling.definition: The act of one who angles; the art of fishing with rod and line. Walton.

blae.definition: Dark blue or bluish gray; lead-colored. [Scot.].

sophomore.definition: One belonging to the second of the four classes in an American college, or one next above a freshman. [Formerly written also sophimore.].

whipsaw.definition: A saw for dividing timber lengthwise, usually set in a frame, and worked by two persons; also, a fret saw.

triableness.definition: Quality or state of being triable.

passant.definition: Passing from one to another; in circulation; current. Many opinions are passant. Sir T. Browne. 2. Curs On a passant rewiew of what I wrote to the bishop. Sir P. Pett. 3. Surpassing; excelling. Chaucer. 4. (Her.)  Walking; -- said of any animal on an escutcheon, which is represented as walking with.

shellfish.definition: Any aquatic animal whose external covering consists of a shell, either testaceous, as in oysters, clams, and other mollusks, or crustaceous, as in lobsters and crabs.

suavity.definition: Sweetness to the taste. Sir T. Browne. 2. The quality of being sweet or pleasing to the mind; agreeableness; softness; pleasantness; gentleness; urbanity; as, suavity of manners; suavity of language, conversation, or address. Glanvill.

ideo-motor.definition: Applied to those actions, or muscular movements, which are automatic expressions of dominant ideas, rather than the result of distinct volitional efforts, as the act of expressing the thoughts in speech, or in writing, while the mind is occupied in the composition of the sentence. Carpenter.

phenalgin.definition: An ammoniated compound of phenyl and acetamide, used as an analgesic and antipyretic. It resembles phenacetin in its therapeutic action.

hade.definition:
The descent of a hill. 2. (Mining)  The inclination or deviation from the vertical of any mineral vein.

To deviate from the vertical; -- said of a vein, fault, or lode.

lugmark.definition: A mark cut into the ear of an animal to identify it; an earmark.

ebb.definition:
The European bunting.

1. The reflux or flowing back of the tide; the return of the tidal wave toward the sea; -- opposed to flood; as, the boats will go out on the ebb. Thou shoreless flood which in thy ebb and flow Claspest the limits of morality! Shelley. 2. The state or time of passing away; a f.

caperer.definition: One who capers, leaps, and skips about, or dances. The nimble capperer on the cord. Dryden.

cockal.definition: A game played with sheep's bones instead of dice 2. The bone used in playing the game; -- called also huckle bone. Nares. A little transverse bone Which boys and bruckeled children call (Playing for points and pins) cockal. Herrick.

appallment.definition: Depression occasioned by terror; dismay. Bacon.

naturism.definition: The belief or doctrine that attributes everything to nature as a sanative agent.

oviduct.definition: A tube, or duct, for the passage of ova from the ovary to the exterior of the animal or to the part where further development takes place. In mammals the oviducts are also called Fallopian tubes.

underestimate.definition:
To set to

The act of underestimating; too low an estimate.

conscionable.definition: Governed by, or according to, conscience; reasonable; just. Let my debtors have conscionable satisfaction. Sir H. Wotton.

tupi.definition: An Indian of the tribe from which the Tupian stock takes its name, dwelling, at the advent of the Portuguese, about the mouth of the Amazon. Also, their language, which is the basis of the Indian trade language of the Amazon.

commonness.definition: State or quality of being common or usual; as, the commonness of sunlight. 2. Triteness; meanness.

persuasion.definition: The act of persuading; the act of influencing the mind by arguments or reasons offered, or by anything that moves the mind or passions, or inclines the will to a determination. For thou hast all the arts of fine persuasion. Otway. 2. The state of being persuaded or convinced; settled opinion or conv.

brazen.definition: Pertaining to, made of, or resembling, brass. 2. Sounding harsh and loud, like resounding brass. 3. Impudent; immodest; shameless; having a front like brass; as, a brazen countenance. Brazen age. (a) (Myth.) The age of war and lawlessness which succeeded the silver age. (b) (Archæol.) See under Bron.

distad.definition: Toward a distal part; on the distal side of; distally.

icefall.definition: A frozen waterfall, or mass of ice resembling a frozen waterfall. Coleridge.

griever.definition: One who, or that which, grieves.

cicatricle.definition: The germinating point in the embryo of a seed; the point in the yolk of an egg at which development begins.

regma.definition: A kind of dry fruit, consisting of three or more cells, each which at length breaks open at the inner angle.

brash.definition:
Hasty in temper; impetuous. Grose.

Brittle, as wood or vegetables. [Colloq., U. S.] Bartlett.

1. A rash or eruption; a sudden or transient fit of sickness. 2. Refuse boughs of trees; also, the clippings of hedges. Wright. 3. (Geol.)  Broken and angular fragments of rocks underlying alluvial deposi.

pharmaceutist.definition: One skilled in pharmacy; a druggist. See the Note under Apothecary.

guereza.definition: A beautiful Abyssinian monkey (Colobus guereza), having the body black, with a fringe of long, silky, white hair along the sides, and a tuft of the same at the end of the tail. The frontal band, cheeks, and chin are white.

flabbiness.definition: Quality or state of being flabby.

pertain.definition: To belong; to have connection with, or dependence on, something, as an appurtenance, attribute, etc.; to appertain; as, saltness pertains to the ocean; flowers pertain to plant life. Men hate those who affect that honor by ambition which pertaineth not to them. Hayward. 2. To have relation or refere.

revocable.definition: Capable of being revoked; as, a revocable edict or grant; a revocable covenant. -- Rev"o*ca*ble*ness, n. -- Rev"o*ca*bly, adv.

agile.definition: Having the faculty of quick motion in the limbs; apt or ready to move; nimble; active; as, an agile boy; an agile tongue. Shaking it with agile hand. Cowper. Syn. -- Active; alert; nimble; brisk; lively; quick.

fenestral.definition:
(Arch.)  Pertaining to a window or to windows. 2. (Anat.)  Of or pertaining to a fenestra.

A casement or window sash, closed with cloth or paper instead of glass. Weale.

mump.definition: To move the lips with the mouth closed; to mumble, as in sulkiness. He mumps, and lovers, and hangs the lip. Taylor, 1630. 2. To talk imperfectly, brokenly, or feebly; to chatter unintelligibly. 3. To cheat; to deceive; to play the beggar. And then when mumping with a sore leg, ... canting and whini.

magdala.definition: Designating an orange-red dyestuff obtained from naphthylamine, and called magdala red, naphthalene red, etc.

pelecoid.definition: A figure, somewhat hatched-shaped, bounded by a semicircle and two inverted quadrants, and equal in area to the square ABCD inclosed by the chords of the four quadrants. [Written also pelicoid.] Math. Dict.

upsend.definition: To send, cast, or throw up. As when some island situate afar . . . Upsends a smoke to heaven. Cowper.

hydropic.definition: Dropsical, or resembling dropsy. Every lust is a kind of hydropic distemper, and the more we drink the more we shall thirst. Tillotson.

hectare.definition: A measure of area, or superficies, containing a hundred ares, or 10,000 square meters, and equivalent to 2.471 acres.

outlearn.definition: To excel or surpass in learing. 2. To learn out [i. e., completely, utterly]; to exhaust knowledge of. Naught, according to his mind, He could outlearn. Spenser. Men and gods have not outlearned it [love]. Emerson.

paronymy.definition: The quality of being paronymous; also, the use of paronymous words.

impotency.definition: The quality or condition of being impotent; want of strength or power, animal, intellectual, or moral; weakness; feebleness; inability; imbecility. Some were poor by impotency of nature; as young fatherless children, old decrepit persons, idiots, and cripples. Hayward. O, impotence of mind in body s.

proportional.definition: Having a due proportion, or comparative relation; being in suitable proportion or degree; as, the parts of an edifice are proportional. Milton. 2. Relating to, or securing, proportion. Hutton. 3. (Math.) Constituting a proportion; having the same, or a constant, ratio; as, proportional quantities; m.

fermentable.definition: Capable of fermentation; as, cider and other vegetable liquors are fermentable.

purflew.definition: A hem, border., or trimming, as of embroidered work. 2. (Her.)  A border of any heraldic fur.

illustrious.definition: Possessing luster or brightness; brilliant; luminous; splendid. Quench the light; thine eyes are guides illustrious. Beau. & Fl. 2. Characterized by greatness, nobleness, etc.; eminent; conspicuous; distinguished. Illustrious earls, renowened everywhere. Drayton. 3. Conferring luster or honor; renow.

horseman.definition: A rider on horseback; one skilled in the management of horses; a mounted man. 2. (Mil.)  A mounted soldier; a cavalryman. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) A land crab of the genus Ocypoda, living on the coast of Brazil and the West Indies, noted for running very swiftly. (b) A West Indian fish of the genus Eques, as.

strake.definition:
imp. of Strike. Spenser.

1. A streak. Spenser."White strake." Gen. xxx. 37. 2. An iron band by which the fellies of a wheel are secured to each other, being not continuous, as the tire is, but made up of separate pieces. 3. (Shipbuilding)  One breadth of planks or plates forming a continuous range.

propaganda.definition: (R. C. Ch.) (a) A congregation of cardinals, established in 1622, charged with the management of missions. (b) The college of the Propaganda, instituted by Urban VIII. (1623- 1644) to educate priests for missions in all parts of the world. 2. Hence, any organization or plan for spreading a particula.

basilic.definition:
Basilica.

1. Royal; kingly; also, basilican. 2. (Anat.)  Pertaining to certain parts, anciently supposed to have a specially important function in the animal economy, as the middle vein of the right arm.

outdream.definition: To pass, or escape, while dreaming. "To oultdream dangers." Beau. & Fl.

bevilled.definition: Notched with an angle like that inclosed by a carpenter's bevel; -- said of a partition line of a shield.

superimpose.definition: To lay or impose on something else; as, a stratum of earth superimposed on another stratum. -- Su`per*im`po*si"tion, n.

straddle.definition:
To part the legs wide; to stand or to walk with the legs far apart. 2. To stand with the ends staggered; -- said of the spokes of a wagon wheel where they join the hub.

To place one leg on one side and the other on the other side of; to stand or sit astride of; as, to straddle a fence or a horse.

multinuclear.definition: Containing many nuclei; as, multinuclear cells.

naphthoic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or related to, naphthalene; -- used specifically to designate any one of a series of carboxyl derivatives, called naphthoic acids.

sakiyeh.definition: A kind of water wheel used in Egypt for raising water, from wells or pits, in buckets attached to its periphery or to an endless rope.

epicentral.definition: Arising from the centrum of a vertebra. Owen.

zemni.definition: The blind mole rat (Spalax typhlus), native of Eastern Europe and Asia. Its eyes and ears are rudimentary, and its fur is soft and brownish, more or less tinged with gray. It constructs extensive burrows.

betacismus.definition: Excessive or extended use of the b sound in speech, due to conversion of other sounds into it, as through inability to distinguish them from  b, or because of difficulty in pronouncing them.

ambassy.definition: See Embassy, the usual spelling. Helps.

unsocket.definition: To loose or take from a socket.

dumfound.definition: To strike dumb; to confuse with astonishment. [Written also dumbfound.] Spectator.

three-color.definition: Designating, or pert. to, a photomechanical process employing printings in three colors, as red, yellow, and blue.

tincture.definition: A tinge or shade of color; a tint; as, a tincture of red. 2. (Her.)  One of the metals, colors, or furs used in armory. Note: There are two metals: gold, called or, and represented in engraving by a white surface covered with small dots; and silver, called argent, and represented by a plain white su.

bitterweed.definition: A species of Ambrosia (A. artemisiæfolia); Roman worm wood. Gray.

coachman.definition: A man whose business is to drive a coach or carriage. 2. (Zoöl.)  A tropical fish of the Atlantic ocean (Dutes auriga); -- called also charioteer. The name refers to a long, lashlike spine of the dorsal fin.

lentor.definition: Tenacity; viscidity; viscidity, as of fluids. 2. Slowness; delay; sluggishness. Arbuthnot.

collocate.definition:
Set; placed. Bacon.

To set or place; to set; to station. To marshal and collocate in order his battalions. E. Hall.

overlight.definition:
Too strong a light. Bacon.

Too light or frivolous; giddy.

cata.definition: The Latin and English form of a Greek preposition, used as a prefix to signify down, downward, under, against, contrary or opposed to, wholly, completely; as in cataclysm, catarrh. It sometimes drops the final vowel, as in catoptric; and is sometimes changed to cath, as in cathartic, catholic.

spenserian.definition: Of or pertaining to the English poet Spenser; -- specifically applied to the stanza used in his poem "The Faërie Queene.".

dissuasory.definition: A dissuasive. This virtuous and reasonable person, however, has ill luck in all his dissuasories. Jeffrey.

episcopacy.definition: Government of the church by bishops; church government by three distinct orders of ministers -- bishops, priests, and deacons -- of whom the bishops have an authority superior and of a different kind.

emblazon.definition: To depict or represent; -- said of heraldic bearings. See Blazon. 2. To deck in glaring colors; to set off conspicuously; to display pompously; to decorate. The walls were . . . emblazoned with legends in commemoration of the illustrious pair. Prescott.

radiothorium.definition: A radioactive substance apparently formed as a product from thorium.

demissive.definition: Downcast; submissive; humble. They pray with demissive eyelids. Lord (1630).

top-cloth.definition: A piece of canvas used to cover the hammocks which are lashed to the top in action to protect the topmen.

impolarly.definition: Not according to or in, the direction of the poles. Sir T. Browne.

chablis.definition: A white wine made near Chablis, a town in France.

cylindrically.definition: In the manner or shape of a cylinder; so as to be cylindrical.

earshrift.definition: A nickname for auricular confession; shrift. Cartwright.

scrotocele.definition: A rupture or hernia in the scrotum; scrotal hernia.

crinet.definition: A very fine, hairlike feather. Booth.

excambion.definition: Exchange; barter; -- used commonly of lands.

versification.definition: The act, art, or practice, of versifying, or making verses; the construction of poetry; metrical composition.

interspinous.definition: Between spines; esp., between the spinous processes of the vertebral column.

shopgirl.definition: A girl employed in a shop.

subduer.definition: One who, or that which, subdues; a conqueror. Spenser.

hemorrhoidal.definition: Of or pertaining to, or of the nature of, hemorrhoids. 2. (Anat.)  Of or pertaining to the rectum; rectal; as, the hemorrhoidal arteries, veins, and nerves.

voided.definition: Emptied; evacuated. 2. Annulled; invalidated. 3. (Her.)  Having the inner part cut away, or left vacant, a narrow border being left at the sides, the tincture of the field being seen in the vacant space; -- said of a charge.

naturalistic.definition: Belonging to the doctrines of naturalism. 2. Closely resembling nature; realistic. "Naturalistic bit of pantomime." W. D. Howells.

variate.definition: To alter; to make different; to vary.

nuncupate.definition: To declare publicly or solemnly; to proclaim formally. In whose presence did St. Peter nuncupate it Barrow. 2. To dedicate by declaration; to inscribe; as, to nuncupate a book. Evelyn.

pennyworth.definition: A penny's worth; as much as may be bought for a penny. "A dear pennyworth." Evelyn. 2. Hence: The full value of one's penny expended; due return for money laid out; a good bargain; a bargain. The priests sold the better pennyworths. Locke. 3. A small quantity; a trifle. Bacon.

gilding.definition: The art or practice of overlaying or covering with gold leaf; also, a thin coating or wash of gold, or of that which resembles gold. 2. Gold in leaf, powder, or liquid, for application to any surface. 3. Any superficial coating or appearance, as opposed to what is solid and genuine. Gilding metal, a.

dormant.definition: Sleeping; as, a dormant animal; hence, not in action or exercise; quiescent; at rest; in abeyance; not disclosed, asserted, or insisted on; as, dormant passions; dormant claims or titles. It is by lying dormant a long time, or being . . . very rarely exercised, that arbitrary power steals upon a peo.

protectorship.definition: , The office of a protector or regent; protectorate.

appulsive.definition: Striking against; impinging; as, the appulsive influence of the planets. P. Cyc.

catechetically.definition: In a catechetical manner; by question and answer.

acroterium.definition: (a) One of the small pedestals, for statues or other ornaments, placed on the apex and at the basal angles of a pediment. Acroteria are also sometimes placed upon the gables in Gothic architecture. J. H. Parker. (b) One of the pedestals, for vases or statues, forming a part roof balustrade.

philology.definition: Criticism; grammatical learning. Johnson. 2. The study of language, especially in a philosophical manner and as a science; the investigation of the laws of human speech, the relation of different tongues to one another, and historical development of languages; linguistic science. Note: Philology com.

pneumoskeleton.definition: A chitinous structure which supports the gill in some invertebrates.

stepdaughter.definition: A daughter of one's wife or husband by a former marriage.

worsen.definition:
To make worse; to deteriorate; to impair. It is apparent that, in the particular point of which we have been conversing, their condition is greatly worsened. Southey. 2. To get the better of; to worst.

To grow or become worse. De Quincey. Indifferent health, which seemed rather to worsen than impro.

quaternity.definition: The number four. Sir T. Browne. 2. The union of four in one, as of four persons; -- analogous to the theological term trinity.

femininity.definition: The quality or nature of the female sex; womanliness. 2. The female form. O serpent under femininitee. Chaucer.

pedipalpi.definition: A division of Arachnida, including the whip scorpions (Thelyphonus) and allied forms. Sometimes used in a wider sense to include also the true scorpions.

acalephae.definition: A group of Coelenterata, including the Medusæ or jellyfishes, and hydroids; -- so called from the stinging power they possess. Sometimes called sea nettles.

prytaneum.definition: A public building in certain Greek cities; especially, a public hall in Athens regarded as the home of the community, in which official hospitality was extended to distinguished citizens and strangers.

rabidly.definition: In a rabid manner; with extreme violence.

delundung.definition: An East Indian carnivorous mammal (Prionodon gracilis), resembling the civets, but without scent pouches. It is handsomely spotted.

repellency.definition: The principle of repulsion; the quality or capacity of repelling; repulsion.

frater.definition: A monk; also, a frater house. Shipley. Frater house, an apartament in a convent used as an eating room; a refectory; -- called also a fratery.

iodism.definition: A morbid state produced by the use of iodine and its compounds, and characterized by palpitation, depression, and general emaciation, with a pustular eruption upon the skin.

winebibber.definition: One who drinks much wine. Prov. xxiii. 20. -- Wine"bib`bing, n.

susurrous.definition: Whispering; rustling; full of whispering sounds.

tragi-comic.definition: Of or pertaining to tragi-comedy; partaking of grave and comic scenes. -- Trag`-com"ic*al*ly, adv. Julian felt toward him that tragi-comic sensation which makes us pity the object which excites it not the less that we are somewhat inclined to laugh amid our sympathy. Sir W. Scott.

tartareous.definition:
Of or pertaining to Tartarus; hellish.

1. Consisting of tartar; of the nature of tartar. 2. (Bot.)  Having the surface rough and crumbling; as, many lichens are tartareous.

sloyd.definition: Lit., skilled mechanical work, such as that required in wood carving; trade work; hence, a system (usually called the sloyd system) of manual training in the practical use of the tools and materials used in the trades, and of instruction in the making and use of the plans and specifications connecte.

uranium.definition: An element of the chromium group, found in certain rare minerals, as pitchblende, uranite, etc., and reduced as a heavy, hard, nickel-white metal which is quite permanent. Its yellow oxide is used to impart to glass a delicate greenish-yellow tint which is accompanied by a strong fluorescence, and i.

yead.definition: Properly, a variant of the defective imperfect yode, but sometimes mistaken for a present. See the Note under Yede. Years yead away and faces fair deflower. Drant.

obeah.definition: Same as Obi. -- a.  Of or pertaining to obi; as, the obeah man. B. Edwards.

continuative.definition: (Logic)  A term or expression denoting continuance. To these may be added continuatives; as, Rome remains to this day; which includes, at least, two propositions, viz., Rome was, and Rome is. I. Watts. 2. (Gram.)  A word that continues the connection of sentences or subjects; a connective; a conjunc.

erythrophyll.definition: The red coloring matter of leaves, fruits, flowers, etc., in distinction from chlorophyll.

monasticism.definition: The monastic life, system, or condition. Milman.

depressant.definition: An agent or remedy which lowers the vital powers.

quoth.definition: Said; spoke; uttered; -- used only in the first and third persons in the past tenses, and always followed by its nominative, the word or words said being the object; as, quoth I. quoth he. "Let me not live, quoth he." Shak.

forslugge.definition: To lsoe by idleness or slotch. Chaucer.

chaps.definition: The jaws, or the fleshy parts about them. See Chap. "Open your chaps again." Shak.

confiteor.definition: A form of prayer in which public confession of sins is made.

exothecium.definition: The outer coat of the anther.

dipsomania.definition: A morbid an uncontrollable craving (often periodic) for drink, esp. for alcoholic liquors; also improperly used to denote acute and chronic alcoholism.

pantisocratist.definition: One who favors or supports the theory of a pantisocracy. Macaulay.

biggen.definition: To make or become big; to enlarge. [Obs. or Dial.] Steele.

bibliopegistic.definition: Pertaining to the art of binding books. Dibdin.

seabeard.definition: A green seaweed (Cladophora rupestris) growing in dense tufts.

whimmy.definition: Full of whims; whimsical. The study of Rabbinical literature either finds a man whimmy or makes him so. Coleridge.

parsonish.definition: Appropriate to, or like, a parson; -- used in disparagement.

cumshaw.definition:
A present or bonus; -- originally applied to that paid on ships which entered the port of Canton. S. Wells Williams.

To give or make a present to.

circumfluent.definition: Flowing round; surrounding in the manner of a fluid. "The deep, circumfluent waves." Pope.

valeritrine.definition: A base, C15H27N, produced together with valeridine, which it resembles.

bungle.definition:
To act or work in a clumsy, awkward manner.

To make or mend clumsily; to manage awkwardly; to botch; -- sometimes with up. I always had an idea that it would be bungled. Byron.

A clumsy or awkward performance; a botch; a gross blunder. Those errors and bungles which are committed. Cudworth.

hurlbone.definition: See Whirlbone. 2. (Far.)  A bone near the middle of the buttock of a horse. Crabb.

diffident.definition: Wanting confidence in others; distrustful. [Archaic] You were always extremely diffident of their success. Melmoth. 2. Wanting confidence in one's self; distrustful of one's own powers; not self-reliant; timid; modest; bashful; characterized by modest reserve. The diffident maidens, Folding their ha.

enfree.definition: To set free. "The enfreed Antenor." Shak.

worldly.definition: Relating to the world; human; common; as, worldly maxims; worldly actions. "I thus neglecting worldly ends." Shak.
