Many years it hath continued, standing by no other worldly mean but that one only hand which erected it. Hooker. 2. Pertaining to this world or life, in contradistinction from the life.

limpness.definition: The quality or state of being limp.

cannibal.definition:
A human being that eats human flesh; hence, any that devours its own kind. Darwin.

Relating to cannibals or cannibalism. "Cannibal terror." Burke.

mousing.definition:
Impertinently inquisitive; prying; meddlesome. "Mousing saints." L'Estrange.

1. The act of hunting mice. 2. (Naut.)  A turn or lashing of spun yarn or small stuff, or a metallic clasp or fastening, uniting the point and shank of a hook to prevent its unhooking or straighening out. 3. A ratchet move.

onager.definition: (Rom.Antiq.)  A military engine acting like a sling, which threw stones from a bag or wooden bucket, and was operated by machinery. Fairholt. 2. (Zoöl.)  A wild ass, especially the koulan.

whithersoever.definition: To whatever place; to what place soever; wheresoever; as, I will go whithersoever you lead.

clarendon.definition: A style of type having a narrow and heave face. It is made in all sizes. Note: This line is in nonpareil Clarendon.

segmented.definition: Divided into segments or joints; articulated.

requisitor.definition: One who makes reqisition; esp., one authorized by a requisition to investigate facts.

deportation.definition: The act of deporting or exiling, or the state of being deported; banishment; transportation. In their deportations, they had often the favor of their conquerors. Atterbury.

propertied.definition: Possessing property; holding real estate, or other investments of money. "The propertied and satisfied classes." M. Arnold.

geniculate.definition:
Bent abruptly at an angle, like the knee when bent; as, a geniculate stem; a geniculate ganglion; a geniculate twin crystal.

To form joints or knots on. Cockeram.

bescorn.definition: To treat with scorn. "Then was he bescorned." Chaucer.

spalpeen.definition: A scamp; an Irish term for a good-for-nothing fellow; -- often used in good-humored contempt or ridicule.

neufchatel.definition: A kind of soft sweet-milk cheese; -- so called from Neufchâtel- en-Bray in France.

admix.definition: To mingle with something else; to mix.

antiquarian.definition:
Pertaining to antiquaries, or to antiquity; as, antiquarian literature.

1. An antiquary. 2. A drawing paper of large size. See under Paper, n.

glycyrrhizin.definition: A glucoside found in licorice root (Glycyrrhiza), in monesia bark (Chrysophyllum), in the root of the walnut, etc., and extracted as a yellow, amorphous powder, of a bittersweet taste.

paradigm.definition: An example; a model; a pattern. "The paradigms and patterns of all things." Cudworth. 2. (Gram.)  An example of a conjugation or declension, showing a word in all its different forms of inflection. 3. (Rhet.)  An illustration, as by a parable or fable.

prerogatived.definition: Endowed with a prerogative, or exclusive privilege. Shak.

carvelbuilt.definition: Having the planks meet flush at the seams, instead of lapping as in a clinker-built vessel.

arrear.definition:
To or in the rear; behind; backwards. Spenser.

That which is behind in payment, or which remains unpaid, though due; esp. a remainder, or balance which remains due when some part has been paid; arrearage; -- commonly used in the plural, as, arrears of rent, wages, or taxes. Locke. For much I dread.

sway.definition: To move or wield with the hand; to swing; to wield; as, to sway the scepter. As sparkles from the anvil rise, When heavy hammers on the wedge are swayed. Spenser. 2. To influence or direct by power and authority; by persuasion, or by moral force; to rule; to govern; to guide. The will of man is by h.

coparcenary.definition: Partnership in inheritance; joint heirship; joint right of sucession to an inheritance.

firing.definition: The act of disharging firearms. 2. The mode of introducing fuel into the furnace and working it. Knight. 3. The application of fire, or of a cautery. Dunglison. 4. The process of partly vitrifying pottery by exposing it to intense heat in a kiln. 5. Fuel; firewood or coal. Mortimer. Firing iron, an.

baresthesiometer.definition: An instrument for determining the delicacy of the sense of pressure. -- Bar`æs*the`si*o*met"ric, Bar`es*the`si*o*met"ric (#), a.

colewort.definition: A variety of cabbage in which the leaves never form a compact head. 2. Any white cabbage before the head has become firm.

stirring.definition: Putting in motion, or being in motion; active; active in business; habitually employed in some kind of business; accustomed to a busy life. A more stirring and intellectual age than any which had gone before it. Southey. Syn. -- Animating; arousing; awakening; stimulating; quickening; exciting.

sunproof.definition: Impervious to the rays of the sun. "Darksome yew, sunproof." Marston.

usure.definition:
To practice usury; to charge unlawful interest. "The usuringb senate." Shak. I usured not ne to me usured any man. Wyclif (Jer. xv. 10).

Usury. Wyclif. Foul usure and lucre of villainy. Chaucer.

disprofit.definition:
Loss; damage. Foxe.

To be, or to cause to be, without profit or benefit. [Obs. or Archaic] Bale.

immurement.definition: The act iif immuring, or the state of being immured; imprsonment.

pinfold.definition: A place in which stray cattle or domestic animals are confined; a pound; a penfold. Shak. A parish pinfold begirt by its high hedge. Sir W. Scott.

docetic.definition: Pertaining to, held by, or like, the Docetæ. "Docetic Gnosticism." Plumptre.

solvability.definition: The quality or state of being solvable; as, the solvability of a difficulty; the solvability of a problem. 2. The condition of being solvent; ability to pay all just debts; solvency; as, the solvability of a merchant.

finlander.definition: A native or inhabitant of Finland.

stereotomical.definition: Of or pertaining to stereotomy; performed by stereotomy.

dominus.definition: Master; sir; -- a title of respect formerly applied to a knight or a clergyman, and sometimes to the lord of a manor. Cowell.

stereographically.definition: In a stereographical manner; by delineation on a plane.

emergence.definition: The act of rising out of a fluid, or coming forth from envelopment or concealment, or of rising into view; sudden uprisal or appearance. The white color of all refracted light, at its very first emergence . . . is compounded of various colors. Sir I. Newton. When from the deep thy bright emergence s.

undifferentiated.definition: Not differentiated; specifically (Biol.), homogenous, or nearly so; -- said especially of young or embryonic tissues which have not yet undergone differentiation (see Differentiation, 3), that is, which show no visible separation into their different structural parts.

levitically.definition: After the manner of the Levites; in accordance with the levitical law.

breadwinner.definition: The member of a family whose labor supplies the food of the family; one who works for his living. H. Spencer.

scorification.definition: The act, process, or result of scorifying, or reducing to a slag; hence, the separation from earthy matter by means of a slag; as, the scorification of ores.

pathway.definition: A footpath; a beaten track; any path or course. Also used figuratively. Shak. In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof is no death. Prov. xii. 28. We tread the pathway arm in arm. Sir W. Scott.

recelebrate.definition: To celebrate again, or anew. -- Re*cel`e*bra"tion, n.

umbelliferous.definition: (a) Producing umbels. (b) Of or pertaining to a natural order (Umbelliferæ) of plants, of which the parsley, carrot, parsnip, and fennel are well-known examples.

fervor.definition: Heat; excessive warmth. The fevor of ensuing day. Waller. 2. Intensity of feeling or expression; glowing ardor; passion; holy zeal; earnestness. Hooker. Winged with fervor of her love. Shak. Syn. -- Fervor, Ardor. Fervor is a boiling heat, and ardor is a burning heat. Hence, in metaphor, we commonly.

electro-telegraphic.definition: Pertaining to the electric telegraph, or by means of it.

priest-ridden.definition: Controlled or oppressed by priests; as, a priest-ridden people. Swift.

amitosis.definition: Cell division in which there is first a simple cleavage of the nucleus without change in its structure (such as the formation of chromosomes), followed by the division of the cytoplasm; direct cell division; -- opposed to mitosis. It is not the usual mode of division, and is believed by many to occu.

unicostate.definition: Having a single rib or strong nerve running upward from the base; -- said of a leaf.

propulsion.definition: The act driving forward or away; the act or process of propelling; as, steam propulsion. 2. An impelling act or movement. God works in all things; all obey His first propulsion. Whittier.

smatter.definition:
To talk superficially or ignorantly; to babble; to chatter. Of state affairs you can not smatter. Swift. 2. To have a slight taste, or a slight, superficial knowledge, of anything; to smack.

1. To talk superficially about. 2. To gain a slight taste of; to acquire a slight, superficial knowledge of;.

mutuary.definition: One who borrows personal chattels which are to be consumed by him, and which he is to return or repay in kind. Bouvier.

elf.definition: An imaginary supernatural being, commonly a little sprite, much like a fairy; a mythological diminutive spirit, supposed to haunt hills and wild places, and generally represented as delighting in mischievous tricks. Every elf, and fairy sprite, Hop as light as bird from brier. Shak. 2. A very diminu.

affectioned.definition: Disposed. [Archaic] Be kindly affectioned one to another. Rom. xii. 10. 2. Affected; conceited. Shak.

hamite.definition:
A fossil cephalopod of the genus Hamites, related to the ammonites, but having the last whorl bent into a hooklike form.

A descendant of Ham, Noah's second son. See Gen. x. 6-20.

indefectible.definition: Not defectible; unfailing; not liable to defect, failure, or decay. An indefectible treasure in the heavens. Barrow. A state of indefectible virtue and happiness. S. Clarke.

wit-cracker.definition: One who breaks jests; a joker. Shak.

newfangly.definition: In a newfangled manner; with eagerness for novelty. Sir T. More.

aufklarung.definition: A philosophic movement of the 18th century characterized by a lively questioning of authority, keen interest in matters of politics and general culture, and an emphasis on empirical method in science. It received its impetus from the unsystematic but vigorous skepticism of Pierre Bayle, the physical.

clinometric.definition: Pertaining to, or ascertained by, the clinometer. 2. Pertaining to the oblique crystalline forms, or to solids which have oblique angles between the axes; as, the clinometric systems.

dulciana.definition: A sweet-toned stop of an organ.

pur.definition:
To utter a low, murmuring, continued sound, as a cat does when pleased. [Written also purr.]

To signify or express by purring. Gray.

The low, murmuring sound made by a cat to express contentment or pleasure. [Written also purr.].

mitten.definition: A covering for the hand, worn to defend it from cold or injury. It differs from a glove in not having a separate sheath for each finger. Chaucer. 2. A cover for the wrist and forearm. To give the mitten to, to dismiss as a lover; to reject the suit of. -- To handle without mittens, to treat roughly;.

edingtonite.definition: A grayish white zeolitic mineral, in tetragonal crystals. It is a hydrous silicate of alumina and baryta.

melodiograph.definition: A contrivance for preserving a record of music, by recording the action of the keys of a musical instrument when played upon.

autopsorin.definition: That which is given under the doctrine of administering a patient's own virus.

incantatory.definition: Dealing by enchantment; magical. Sir T. Browne.

tendriled.definition: Furnished with tendrils, or with such or so many, tendrils. "The thousand tendriled vine." Southey.

curability.definition: The state of being curable; curableness.

chelonia.definition: An order of reptiles, including the tortoises and turtles, perculiar in having a part of the vertebræ, ribs, and sternum united with the dermal plates so as to form a firm shell. The jaws are covered by a horny beak. See Reptilia; also, Illust. in Appendix.

physicological.definition: Of or pertaining to physicologic. Swift.

frenchism.definition: A French mode or characteristic; an idiom peculiar to the French language. Earle.

ploughshare.definition: The share of a plow, or that part which cuts the slice of earth or sod at the bottom of the furrow. Plowshare bone (Anat.), the pygostyle.

commandant.definition: A commander; the commanding officer of a place, or of a body of men; as, the commandant of a navy-yard.

pentad.definition:
Any element, atom, or radical, having a valence of five, or which can be combined with, substituted for, or compared with, five atoms of hydrogen or other monad; as, nitrogen is a pentad in the ammonium compounds.

Having the valence of a pentad.

tralineate.definition: To deviate; to stray; to wander. Dryden.

aerator.definition: That which supplies with air; esp. an apparatus used for charging mineral waters with gas and in making soda water.

monoecism.definition: The state or condition of being monoecious.

abjectness.definition: The state of being abject; abasement; meanness; servility. Grew.

centilitre.definition: The hundredth part of a liter; a measure of volume or capacity equal to a little more than six tenths (0.6102) of a cubic inch, or one third (0.338) of a fluid ounce.

nonagrian.definition: Any moth of the genus Nonagria and allied genera, as the spindleworm and stalk borer.

perityphlitis.definition: Inflammation of the connective tissue about the cæcum.

peculate.definition: To appropriate to one's own use the property of the public; to steal public moneys intrusted to one's care; to embezzle. An oppressive, . . . rapacious, and peculating despotism. Burke.

brachydiagonal.definition:
Pertaining to the shorter diagonal, as of a rhombic prism. Brachydiagonal axis, the shorter lateral axis of an orthorhombic crystal.

The shorter of the diagonals in a rhombic prism.

brontotherium.definition: A genus of large extinct mammals from the miocene strata of western North America. They were allied to the rhinoceros, but the skull bears a pair of powerful horn cores in front of the orbits, and the fore feet were four-toed. See Illustration in Appendix.

interadditive.definition: Added or placed between the parts of another thing, as a clause inserted parenthetically in a sentence.

shaffle.definition: To hobble or limp; to shuffle. [Obs. or Prov.Eng.].

shorthand.definition: A compendious and rapid method or writing by substituting characters, abbreviations, or symbols, for letters, words, etc.; short writing; stenography. See Illust. under Phonography.

pastorium.definition: A parsonage; -- so called in some Baptist churches. [Southern U. S.].

hibernacle.definition: That which serves for protection or shelter in winter; winter quarters; as, the hibernacle of an animal or a plant. Martyn.

robing.definition: The act of putting on a robe. Robing room, a room where official robes are put on, as by judges, etc.

locative.definition: Indicating place, or the place where, or wherein; as, a locative adjective; locative case of a noun. -- n.  The locative case.

paradoxology.definition: The use of paradoxes. Sir T. Browne.

cushat.definition: The ringdove or wood pigeon. Scarce with cushat's homely song can vie. Sir W. Scott.

merry-andrew.definition: One whose business is to make sport for others; a buffoon; a zany; especially, one who attends a mountebank or quack doctor. Note: This term is said to have originated from one Andrew Borde, an English physician of the 16th century, who gained patients by facetious speeches to the multitude.

unjust.definition: Acting contrary to the standard of right; not animated or controlled by justice; false; dishonest; as, an unjust man or judge. 2. Contrary to justice and right; prompted by a spirit of injustice; wrongful; as, an unjust sentence; an unjust demand; an unjust accusation. -- Un*just"ly, adv. -- Un*just.

sperre.definition: To shut in; to support; to inclose; to fasten. "To sperre the gate." Spenser.

hilum.definition: (Bot.)  The eye of a bean or other seed; the mark or scar at the point of attachment of an ovule or seed to its base or support; -- called also hile. 2. (Anat.)  The part of a gland, or similar organ, where the blood vessels and nerves enter; the hilus; as, the hilum of the kidney.

umpire.definition: A person to whose sole decision a controversy or question between parties is referred; especially, one chosen to see that the rules of a game, as cricket, baseball, or the like, are strictly observed. A man, in questions of this kind, is able to be a skillful umpire between himself and others. Barro.

devexity.definition: A bending downward; a sloping; incurvation downward; declivity. Davies (Wit's Pilgr.).

organizability.definition: Quality of being organizable; capability of being organized.

pachyote.definition: One of a family of bats, including those which have thick external ears.

distinctly.definition: With distinctness; not confusedly; without the blending of one part or thing another; clearly; plainly; as, to see distinctly. 2. With meaning; significantly. Thou dost snore distinctly; There's meaning in thy snores. Shak. Syn. -- Separately; clearly; plainly; obviously.

cabal.definition: Tradition; occult doctrine. See Cabala Hakewill. 2. A secret. "The measuring of the temple, a cabal found out but lately." B. Jonson. 3. A number of persons united in some close design, usually to promote their private views and interests in church or state by intrigue; a secret association composed.

baybolt.definition: A bolt with a barbed shank.

remastication.definition: The act of masticating or chewing again or repeatedly.

abider.definition: One who abides, or continues. "Speedy goers and strong abiders." Sidney. 2. One who dwells; a resident. Speed.

tortility.definition: The quality or state of being tortile, twisted, or wreathed.

caltrop.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of herbaceous plants (Tribulus) of the order Zygophylleæ, having a hard several-celled fruit, armed with stout spines, and resembling the military instrument of the same name. The species grow in warm countries, and are often very annoying to cattle. 2. (Mil.)  An instrument with fou.

swarf.definition:
To grow languid; to faint. [Scot.] "To swarf for very hunger." Sir W. Scott.

The grit worn away from grindstones in grinding cutlery wet.

dichroism.definition: The property of presenting different colors by transmitted light, when viewed in two different directions, the colors being unlike in the direction of unlike or unequal axes.

formicate.definition: Resembling, or pertaining to, an ant or ants.

percher.definition: One who, or that which, perches. J. Burroughs. 2. One of the Insessores. 3. Etym: [From Perch a pole.]  A Paris candle anciently used in England; also, a large wax candle formerly set upon the altar. Bailey.

wearish.definition: Weak; withered; shrunk. "A wearish hand." Ford. A little, wearish old man, very melancholy by nature. Burton. 2. Insipid; tasteless; unsavory. Wearish as meat is that is not well tasted. Palsgrave.

disdeign.definition: To disdain. Guyon much disdeigned so loathly sight. Spenser.

blatter.definition: To prate; to babble; to rail; to make a senseless noise; to patter. [Archaic] "The rain blattered." Jeffrey. They procured . . . preachers to blatter against me, . . . so that they had place and time to belie me shamefully. Latimer.

trijugate.definition: In three pairs; as, a trijugate leaf, or a pinnate leaf with three pairs of leaflets.

bren.definition:
To burn. Chaucer. Consuming fire brent his shearing house or stall. W. Browne.

Bran. Chaucer.

viand.definition: An article of food; provisions; food; victuals; -- used chiefly in the plural. Cowper. Viands of various kinds allure the taste. Pope.

sassorol.definition: The rock pigeon. See under Pigeon.

gargol.definition: A distemper in swine; garget. Mortimer.

gestic.definition: Pertaining to deeds or feats of arms; legendary. And the gay grandsire, skilled in gestic lore. Goldsmith. 2. Relating to bodily motion; consisting of gestures; -- said especially with reference to dancing. Carried away by the enthusiasm of the gestic art. Sir W. Scott.

sapidity.definition: The quality or state of being sapid; taste; savor; savoriness. Whether one kind of sapidity is more effective than another. M. S. Lamson.

sprout.definition:
To shoot, as the seed of a plant; to germinate; to push out new shoots; hence, to grow like shoots of plants. 2. To shoot into ramifications. Bacon.

1. To cause to sprout; as, the rain will sprout the seed. 2. To deprive of sprouts; as, to sprout potatoes.

1. The shoot of a plant; a shoot from the.

cuvette.definition: A pot, bucket, or basin, in which molten plate glass is carried from the melting pot to the casting table. 2. (Fort.)  A cunette. 3. (Spectrometry) (Analytical chemistry)  A small vessel with at least two flat and transparent sides, used to hold a liquid sample to be analysed in the light path of a.

bargeman.definition: The man who manages a barge, or one of the crew of a barge.

tuberculose.definition: Having tubercles; affected with, or characterized by, tubercles; tubercular.

constellate.definition:
To join luster; to shine with united radiance, or one general light. The several things which engage our affections . . . shine forth and constellate in God. Boule.

1. To unite in one luster or radiane, as stars. Whe know how to constellate these lights. Boyle. 2. To set or adorn with stars or cons.

pessimism.definition: (Metaph.)  The opinion or doctrine that everything in nature is ordered for or tends to the worst, or that the world is wholly evil; -- opposed to Ant: optimism. 2. A disposition to take the least hopeful view of things.

sike.definition:
Such. See Such. "Sike fancies weren foolerie." Spenser.

A gutter; a stream, such as is usually dry in summer. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.]

A sick person.

To sigh. That for his wife weepeth and siketh sore. Chaucer.

A sigh. Chaucer.

derne.definition: To hide; to skulk. [Scot.] He at length escaped them by derning himself in a foxearth. H. Miller.

reconnaissance.definition: The act of reconnoitering; preliminary examination or survey. Specifically: (a) (Geol.) An examination or survey of a region in reference to its general geological character. (b) (Engin.)  An examination of a region as to its general natural features, preparatory to a more particular survey for the.

intersectional.definition: Pertaining to, or formed by, intersections.

archaeologist.definition: One versed in archæology; an antiquary. Wright.

nidor.definition: Scent or savor of meat or food, cooked or cooking. Jer. Taylor.

misnomer.definition:
The misnaming of a person in a legal instrument, as in a complaint or indictment; any misnaming of a person or thing; a wrong or inapplicable name or title. Many of the changes, by a great misnomer, called parliamentary "reforms". Burke. The word "synonym" is fact a misnomer. Whatel

To misname.

tempest.definition: An extensive current of wind, rushing with great velocity and violence, and commonly attended with rain, hail, or snow; a furious storm. [We] caught in a fiery tempest, shall be hurled, Each on his rock transfixed. Milton. 2. Fig.: Any violent tumult or commotion; as, a political tempest; a tempest.

beylic.definition: The territory ruled by a bey.

nodosity.definition: The quality of being knotty or nodose; resemblance to a node or swelling; knottiness. Holland. 2. A knot; a node.

flitter.definition:
To flutter. Chaucer.

To flutter; to move quickly; as, to flitter the cards. Lowell.

A rag; a tatter; a small piece or fragment.

blackmailing.definition: The act or practice of extorting money by exciting fears of injury other than bodily harm, as injury to reputation.

schizopod.definition:
one of the Schizopoda. Also used adjectively.

Of or pertaining to a schizopod, or the Schizopoda.

ceratohyal.definition: Pertaining to the bone, or carts, large, below the epihyal in the hyoid arch. -- n.  A ceratohyal bone, or cartilage, which, in man, forms one of the small horns of the hyoid.

conducible.definition: Conducive; tending; contributing. Bacon. All his laws are in themselves conducible to the temporal interest of them that observe them. Bentley.

trithing.definition: One of three ancient divisions of a county in England; -- now called riding. [Written also riding.] Blackstone.

subperiosteal.definition: Situated under the periosteum. Subperiosteal operation (Surg.), a removal of bone effected without taking away the periosteum.

nosesmart.definition: A kind of cress, a pungent cruciferous plant, including several species of the genus Nasturtium.

mortgagee.definition: The person to whom property is mortgaged, or to whom a mortgage is made or given.

prevenance.definition: A going before; anticipation in sequence or order. "The law of prevenance is simply the well-known law of phenomenal sequence." Ward.

maladministration.definition: Bad administration; bad management of any business, especially of public affairs. [Written also maleadministration.].

frigate.definition: Originally, a vessel of the Mediterranean propelled by sails and by oars. Frigates, from about 1750 to 1850, had one f.

shingling.definition: The act of covering with shingles; shingles, collectively; a covering made of shingles. 2. (Metal)  The process of expelling scoriæ and other impurities by hammering and squeezing, in the production of wrought iron. Shingling hammer, a ponderous hammer moved by machinery, used in shingling puddled i.

dimethyl.definition: Ethane; -- sometimes so called because regarded as consisting of two methyl radicals. See Ethane.

sidewalk.definition: A walk for foot passengers at the side of a street or road; a foot pavement. [U.S.].

antilopine.definition: Of or relating to the antelope.

ravine.definition:
Food obtained by violence; plunder; prey; raven. "Fowls of ravyne." Chaucer. Though Nature, red in tooth and claw With ravine, shrieked against his creed. Tennyson.

1. A torrent of water. Cotgrave. 2. A deep and narrow hollow, usually worn by a stream or torrent of water; a g.

firmness.definition: The state or quality of being firm. Syn. -- Firmness, Constancy. Firmness belongs to the will, and constancy to the affections and principles; the former prevents us from yielding, and the latter from fluctuating. Without firmness a man has no character; "without constancy," says Addison, "there is.

brownback.definition: The dowitcher or red-breasted snipe. See Dowitcher.

fuguist.definition: A musician who composes or performs fugues. Busby.

greekling.definition: A little Greek, or one of small esteem or pretensions. B. Jonson.

stovaine.definition: A substance, C14H22O2NCl, the hydrochloride of an amino compound containing benzol, used, in solution with strychnine, as a local anæsthetic, esp. by injection into the sheath of the spinal cord, producing anæsthesia below the point of introduction.

swallow-tailed.definition: Having a tail like that of a swallow; hence, like a swallow's tail in form; having narrow and tapering or pointed skirts; as, a swallow- tailed coat. 2. (Carp.)  United by dovetailing; dovetailed. Swallow-tailed duck (Zoöl.), the old squaw. -- Swallow-tailed gull (Zoöl.), an Arctic gull (Xema furcat.

muffin.definition: A light, spongy, cylindrical cake, used for breakfast and tea.

hemostatic.definition:
(Med.)  Of or relating to stagnation of the blood. 2. Serving to arrest hemorrhage; styptic.

A medicine or application to arrest hemorrhage.

suboxide.definition: An oxide containing a relatively small amount of oxygen, and less than the normal proportion; as, potassium suboxide, K4O.

dogship.definition: The character, or individuality, of a dog.

miniate.definition:
To paint or tinge with red lead or vermilion; also, to decorate with letters, or the like, painted red, as the page of a manuscript. T. Wharton.

Of or pertaining to the color of red lead or vermilion; painted with vermilion.

pasque.definition: See Pasch. Pasque flower (Bot.), a name of several plants of the genus Anemone, section Pulsatilla. They are perennial herbs with rather large purplish blossoms, which appear in early spring, or about Easter, whence the common name. Called also campana.

thysanopterous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Thysanoptera.

extensiveness.definition: The state of being extensive; wideness; largeness; extent; diffusiveness.

traitress.definition: A woman who betrays her country or any trust; a traitoress. Dryden.

virtuoso.definition: One devoted to virtu; one skilled in the fine arts, in antiquities, and the like; a collector or ardent admirer of curiosities, etc. Virtuoso the Italians call a man who loves the noble arts, and is a critic in them. Dryden. 2. (Mus.)  A performer on some instrument, as the violin or the piano, who.

houseless.definition: Destitute of the shelter of a house; shelterless; homeless; as, a houseless wanderer.

smarten.definition: To make smart or spruce; -- usually with up. She had to go and smarten herself up somewhat. W. Black.

archierey.definition: The higher order of clergy in Russia, including metropolitans, archbishops, and bishops. Pinkerton.

cithara.definition: An ancient instrument resembling the harp.

amused.definition: Diverted. 2. Expressing amusement; as, an amused look.

abdest.definition: Purification by washing the hands before prayer; -- a Mohammedan rite. Heyse.

musang.definition: A small animal of Java (Paradoxirus fasciatus), allied to the civets. It swallows, but does not digest, large quantities of ripe coffee berries, thus serving to disseminate the coffee plant; hence it is called also coffee rat.

chapelry.definition: The territorial disrict legally assigned to a chapel.

emendatory.definition: Pertaining to emendation; corrective. "Emendatory criticism."" Johnson.

pestiferous.definition: Pest-bearing; pestilential; noxious to health; malignant; infectious; contagious; as, pestiferous bodies. "Poor, pestiferous creatures begging alms." Evelyn. "Unwholesome and pestiferous occupations." Burke. 2. Noxious to peace, to morals, or to society; vicious; hurtful; destructive; as, a pestifer.

rhetoric.definition: The art of composition; especially, elegant composition in prose. 2. Oratory; the art of speaking with propriety, elegance, and force. Locke. 3. Hence, artificial eloquence; fine language or declamation without conviction or earnest feeling. 4. Fig. : The power of persuasion or attraction; that whic.

chartreuse.definition: A Carthusian monastery; esp. La Grande Chartreuse, mother house of the order, in the mountains near Grenoble, France. 2. An alcoholic cordial, distilled from aromatic herbs; -- made at La Grande Chartreuse.

immatureness.definition: The state or quality of being immature; immaturity. Boyle.

cystine.definition: A white crystalline substance, C3H7NSO2, containing sulphur, occuring as a constituent of certain rare urinary calculi, and occasionally found as a sediment in urine.

gerant.definition: The manager or acting partner of a company, joint-stock association, etc.

photochromatic.definition: Of or pertaining to photochromy; produced by photochromy.

plurality.definition: The state of being plural, or consisting of more than one; a number consisting of two or more of the same kind; as, a plurality of worlds; the plurality of a verb. 2. The greater number; a majority; also, the greatest of several numbers; in elections, the excess of the votes given for one candidate.

russ.definition:
A Russian, or the Russians. [Rare, except in poetry.] 2. The language of the Russians.

Of or pertaining to the Russians.

ovipara.definition: An artifical division of vertebrates, including those that lay eggs; -opposed to Vivipara.

grubworm.definition: See Grub, n., 1. And gnats and grubworms crowded on his view. C. Smart.

semi-diesel.definition: Designating an internal-combustion engine of a type resembling the Diesel engine in using as fuel heavy oil which is injected in a spray just before the end of the compression stroke and is fired without electrical ignition. The fuel is sprayed into an iron box (called a hot bulb or hot pot) opening.

southeaster.definition:
A storm, strong wind, or gale coming from the southeast.

Toward the southeast.

stramash.definition:
To strike, beat, or bang; to break; to destroy. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.]

A turmoil; a broil; a fray; a fight. [Scot. & Prov. Eng.] Barham.

trode.definition:
imp. of Tread. On burnished hooves his war-horse trode. Tennyson.

Tread; footing. [Written also troad.] Spenser.

portiere.definition: A curtain hanging across a doorway.

wordplay.definition: A more or less subtle playing upon the meaning of words.

mascagnin.definition: Native sulphate of ammonia, found in volcanic districts; -- so named from Mascagni, who discovered it.

sterner.definition: A director. [Obs. & R.] Dr. R. Clerke.

laudatory.definition: Of or pertaining praise, or to the expression of praise; as, laudatory verses; the laudatory powers of Dryden. Sir J. Stephen.

turfite.definition: A votary of the turf, or race course; hence, sometimes, a blackleg. Thackeray.

imitable.definition: Capble of being imitated or copied. The characters of man placed in lower stations of life are more usefull, as being imitable by great numbers. Atterbury. 2. Worthy of imitation; as, imitable character or qualities. Sir W. Raleigh.

leaven.definition: Any substance that produces, or is designed to produce, fermentation, as in dough or liquids; esp., a portion of fermenting dough, which, mixed with a larger quantity of dough, produces a general change in the mass, and renders it light; yeast; barm. 2. Anything which makes a general assimilating (e.

redigest.definition: To digest, or reduce to form, a second time. Kent.

shiny.definition: Bright; luminous; clear; unclouded. Like distant thunder on a shiny day. Dryden.

perbromic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, the highest oxygen acid, HBrO4, of bromine.

subspinous.definition: (a) (Anat.) Subvertebral. (b) (Med.) Situated beneath a spinous process, as that of the scapula; as, subspinous dislocation of the humerus.

severality.definition: Each particular taken singly; distinction. Bp. Hall.

favel.definition:
Yellow; fal Wright.

A horse of a favel or dun color. To curry favel. See To curry favor, under Favor, n.

Flattery; cajolery; deceit. Skeat.

ostentate.definition: To make an ambitious display of; to show or exhibit boastingly. Jer. Taylor.

pancratical.definition: Of or pertaining to the pancratium; athletic. Sir T. Browne.

aspersorium.definition: The stoup, basin, or other vessel for holy water in Roman Catholic churches. 2. A brush for sprinkling holy water; an aspergill.

percheron.definition: One of a breed of draught horses originating in Perche, an old district of France; -- called also Percheron-Norman.

rhizomatous.definition: Having the nature or habit of a rhizome or rootstock.

tottle.definition: To walk in a wavering, unsteady manner; to toddle; to topple.

differentia.definition: The formal or distinguishing part of the essence of a species; the characteristic attribute of a species; specific difference.

signalment.definition: The act of signaling, or of signalizing; hence, description by peculiar, appropriate, or characteristic marks. Mrs. Browning.

foot-sore.definition: Having sore or tender feet, as by reason of much walking; as, foot-sore cattle.

cornel.definition: (Bot.)  The cornelian cherry (Cornus Mas), a European shrub with clusters of small, greenish flowers, followed by very acid but edible drupes resembling cherries. 2. Any species of the genus Cornus, as C. florida, the flowering cornel; C. stolonifera, the osier cornel; C. Canadensis, the dwarf corne.

rollichie.definition: A kind of sausage, made in a bag of tripe, sliced and fried, famous among the Dutch of New Amsterdam and still known, esp. in New Jersey.

hagbutter.definition: A soldier armed with a hagbut or arquebus. [Written also hackbutter.] Froude.

conceptive.definition: Capable of conceiving. Sir T. Browne.

belock.definition: To lock, or fasten as with a lock. Shak.

allegorist.definition: One who allegorizes; a writer of allegory. Hume.

anhydrite.definition: A mineral of a white a slightly bluish color, usually massive. It is anhydrous sulphate of lime, and differs from gypsum in not containing water (whence the name).

heulandite.definition: A mineral of the Zeolite family, often occurring in amygdaloid, in foliated masses, and also in monoclinic crystals with pearly luster on the cleavage face. It is a hydrous silicate of alumina and lime.

acridity.definition: The quality of being acrid or pungent; irritant bitterness; acrimony; as, the acridity of a plant, of a speech.

displode.definition:
To discharge; to explode. In posture to displode their second tire Of thunder. Milton.

To burst with a loud report; to explode. "Disploding engines." Young.

radial.definition: Of or pertaining to a radius or ray; consisting of, or like, radii or rays; radiated; as, (Bot.) radial projections; (Zoöl.) radial vessels or canals; (Anat.) the radial artery. Radial symmetry. (Biol.) See under Symmetry.

pleaseman.definition: An officious person who courts favor servilely; a pickthank. Shak.

securement.definition: The act of securing; protection. Society condemns the securement in all cases of perpetual protection by means of perpetual imprisonment. C. A. Ives.

jacana.definition: Any of several wading birds belonging to the genus Jacana and several allied genera, all of which have spurs on the wings. They are able to run about over floating water weeds by means of their very long, spreading toes. Called also surgeon bird. Note: The most common South American species is Jacan.

overhandle.definition: To handle, or use, too much; to mention too often. Shak.

vatical.definition: Of or pertaining to a prophet; prophetical. Bp. Hall.

diction.definition: Choice of words for the expression of ideas; the construction, disposition, and application of words in discourse, with regard to clearness, accuracy, variety, etc.; mode of expression; language; as, the diction of Chaucer's poems. His diction blazes up into a sudden explosion of prophetic grandeur.

sheathbill.definition: Either one of two species of birds composing the genus Chionis, and family Chionidæ, native of the islands of the Antarctic.seas. Note: They are related to the gulls and the plovers, but more nearly to the latter. The base of the bill is covered with a saddle-shaped horny sheath, and the toes are on.

omnicorporeal.definition: Comprehending or including all bodies; embracing all substance. Cudworth.

southernly.definition: Somewhat southern. -- adv.  In a southerly manner or course; southward.

distinguishable.definition: Capable of being distinguished; separable; divisible; discernible; capable of recognition; as, a tree at a distance is distinguishable from a shrub. A simple idea being in itself uncompounded . . . is not distinguishable into different ideas. Locke. 2. Worthy of note or special regard. Swift.

acquainted.definition: Personally known; familiar. See To be acquainted with, under Acquaint, v. t.

braunite.definition: A native oxide of manganese, of dark brownish black color. It was named from a Mr. Braun of Gotha.

aciculated.definition: (a) Furnished with aciculæ. (b) Acicular. (c) Marked with fine irregular streaks as if scratched by a needle. Lindley.

gunstick.definition: A stick to ram down the charge of a musket, etc.; a rammer or ramrod.

ruedesheimer.definition: A German wine made near Rüdesheim, on the Rhine.

bothnian.definition: Of or pertaining to Bothnia, a country of northern Europe, or to a gulf of the same name which forms the northern part of the Baltic sea.

thalamocoele.definition: The cavity or ventricle of the thalamencephalon; the third ventricle.

undercut.definition:
The lower or under side of a sirloin of beef; the fillet.

To cut away, as the side of an object, so as to leave an overhanging portion.

bothersome.definition: Vexatious; causing bother; causing trouble or perplexity; troublesome.

nubile.definition: Of an age suitable for marriage; marriageable. Prior.

affectional.definition: Of or pertaining to the affections; as, affectional impulses; an affectional nature.

indignation.definition: The feeling excited by that which is unworthy, base, or disgraceful; anger mingled with contempt, disgust, or abhorrence. Shak. Indignation expresses a strong and elevated disapprobation of mind, which is also inspired by something flagitious in the conduct of another. Cogan. When Haman saw Mordecai.

sanguinaria.definition: (Bot.)  A genus of plants of the Poppy family. Note: Sanguinaria Canadensis, or bloodroot, is the only species. It has a perennial rootstock, which sends up a few roundish lobed leaves and solitary white blossoms in early spring. See Bloodroot. 2. The rootstock of the bloodroot, used in medicine as.

shock-headed.definition: Having a thick and bushy head of hair.

donjon.definition: The chief tower, also called the keep; a massive tower in ancient castles, forming the strongest part of the fortifications. See Illust. of Castle.

garcinia.definition: A genus of plants, including the mangosteen tree (Garcinia Mangostana), found in the islands of the Indian Archipelago; -- so called in honor of Dr. Garcin.

ideographics.definition: The system of writing in ideographic characters; also, anything so written.

garboard.definition: One of the planks next the keel on the outside, which form a garboard strake. Garboard strake or streak, the first range or strake of planks laid on a ship's bottom next the keel. Totten.

feathered.definition: Clothed, covered, or fitted with (or as with) feathers or wings; as, a feathered animal; a feathered arrow. Rise from the ground like feathered Mercury. Shak. Nonsense feathered with soft and delicate phrases and pointed with pathetic accent. Dr. J. Scott. 2. Furnished with anything featherlike; orn.

pericarpic.definition: Of or pertaining to a pericarp.

murexoin.definition: A complex nitrogenous compound obtained as a scarlet crystalline substance, and regarded as related to murexide.

cappeline.definition: A hood-shaped bandage for the head, the shoulder, or the stump of an amputated limb.

trevet.definition: A stool or other thing supported by three legs; a trivet.

thearchy.definition: Government by God; divine sovereignty; theocracy.

undecolic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid, C11H18O2, of the propiolic acid series, obtained indirectly from undecylenic acid as a white crystalline substance.

hewn.definition: Felled, cut, or shaped as with an ax; roughly squared; as, a house built of hewn logs. 2. Roughly dressed as with a hammer; as, hewn stone.

cravatted.definition: Wearing a cravat. The young men faultlessly appointed, handsomely cravatted. Thackeray.

galician.definition: Of or pertaining to Galicia, in Spain, or to Galicia, the kingdom of Austrian Poland. -- n.  A native of Galicia in Spain; -- called also Gallegan.

imp.definition: A shoot; a scion; a bud; a slip; a graft. Chaucer. 2. An offspring; progeny; child; scion. The tender imp was weaned. Fairfax. 3. A young or inferior devil; a little, malignant spirit; a puny demon; a contemptible evil worker. To mingle in the clamorous fray Of squabbling imps. Beattie. 4. Something.

oxhead.definition: Literally, the head of an ox (emblem of cuckoldom); hence, a dolt; a blockhead. Dost make a mummer of me, oxhead Marston.

thatch.definition:
Straw, rushes, or the like, used for making or covering the roofs of buildings, or of stacks of hay or grain. 2. (Bot.)  A name in the West Indies for several kinds of palm, the leaves of which are used for thatching. Thatch sparrow, the house sparrow.

To cover with, or with a roof of, straw, reeds.

exodus.definition: A going out; particularly (the Exodus), the going out or journey of the Israelites from Egypt under the conduct of Moses; and hence, any large migration from a place. 2. The second of the Old Testament, which contains the narrative of the departure of the Israelites from Egypt.

disestablish.definition: To unsettle; to break up (anything established); to deprive, as a church, of its connection with the state. M. Arnold.

para-anaesthesia.definition: Anæsthesia of both sides of the lower half of the body.

habitator.definition: A dweller; an inhabitant. Sir T. Browne.

circumfusion.definition: The act of pouring or spreading round; the state of being spread round. Swift.

brahminist.definition: An adherent of the religion of the Brahmans.

isoperimetrical.definition: Having equal perimeters of circumferences; as, isoperimetrical figures or bodies.

scrow.definition: A scroll. Palsgrave. 2. A clipping from skins; a currier's cuttings.

orpin.definition: A yellow pigment of various degrees of intensity, approaching also to red. 2. (Bot.)  The orpine.

polyanthus.definition: (a) The oxlip. So called because the peduncle bears a many-flowered umbel. See Oxlip. (b) A bulbous flowering plant of the genus Narcissus (N. Tazetta, or N. polyanthus of some authors). See Illust. of Narcissus.

caudad.definition: Backwards; toward the tail or posterior part.

utero.definition: - (connection with, or relation to, the uterus; as in utro- ovarian.

canaster.definition: A kind of tobacco for smoking, made of the dried leaves, coarsely broken; -- so called from the rush baskets in which it is packed in South America. McElrath.

demon.definition: (Gr. Antiq.)  A spirit, or immaterial being, holding a middle place between men and deities in pagan mythology. The demon kind is of an inSydenham. 2. One's genius; a tutelary spirit or internal voice; as, the demon of Socrates. [Often written dæmon.] 3. An evil spirit; a devil. That same demon that.

photogenic.definition: Of or pertaining to photogeny; producing or generating light.

parablastic.definition: Of or pertaining to the parablast; as, the parablastic cells.

plumcot.definition: A cross between the plum and apricot.

inanition.definition: The condition of being inane; emptiness; want of fullness, as in the vessels of the body; hence, specifically, exhaustion from want of food, either from partial or complete starvation, or from a disorder of the digestive apparatus, producing the same result. Feeble from inanition, inert from wearine.

aculeated.definition: Having a sharp point; armed with prickles; prickly; aculeate.

ventricose.definition: Swelling out on one side or unequally; bellied; ventricular; as, a ventricose corolla. Ventricose shell. (Zoöl.) (a) A spiral shell having the body whorls rounded or swollen in the middle. (b) A bivalve shell in which the valves are strongly convex.

archil.definition: A violet dye obtained from several species of lichen (Roccella tinctoria, etc.), which grow on maritime rocks in the Canary and Cape Verd Islands, etc. Tomlinson. 2. The plant from which the dye is obtained. [Written also orchal and orchil.].

abduce.definition: To draw or conduct away; to withdraw; to draw to a different part. If we abduce the eye unto either corner, the object will not duplicate. Sir T. Browne.

brownwort.definition: A species of figwort or Scrophularia (S. vernalis), and other species of the same genus, mostly perennials with inconspicuous coarse flowers.

estimableness.definition: The quality of deserving esteem or regard.

hectometer.definition: A measure of length, equal to a hundred meters. It is equivalent to 328.09 feet.

nurture.definition:
The act of nourishing or nursing; thender care; education; training. A man neither by nature nor by nurture wise. Milton. 2. That which nourishes; food; diet. Spenser.

1. To feed; to nourish. 2. To educate; to bring or train up. He was nurtured where he had been born. Sir H. Wotton. Syn. -- To nour.

underhang.definition: To hang under or down; to suspend. Holland.

essorant.definition: Standing, but with the wings spread, as if about to fly; -- said of a bird borne as a charge on an escutcheon.

altruism.definition: Regard for others, both natural and moral; devotion to the interests of others; brotherly kindness; -- opposed to egoism or selfishness. [Recent] J. S. Mill.

braid.definition: To weave, interlace, or entwine together, as three or more strands or threads; to form into a braid; to plait. Braid your locks with rosy twine. Milton. 2. To mingle, or to bring to a uniformly soft consistence, by beating, rubbing, or straining, as in some culinary operations. 3. To reproach. See U.

eschatology.definition: The doctrine of the last or final things, as death, judgment, and the events therewith connected.

reactance.definition: The influence of a coil of wire upon an alternating current passing through it, tending to choke or diminish the current, or the similar influence of a condenser; inductive resistance. Reactance is measured in ohms. The reactance of a circuit is equal to the component of the impressed electro-motive.

scopula.definition: (a) A peculiar brushlike organ found on the foot of spiders and used in the construction of the web. (b) A special tuft of hairs on the leg of a bee.

snip.definition: To cut off the nip or neb of, or to cut off at once with shears or scissors; to clip off suddenly; to nip; hence, to break off; to snatch away. Curbed and snipped in my younger years by fear of my parents from those vicious excrescences to which that age was subject. Fuller. The captain seldom order.

coccolite.definition: A granular variety of pyroxene, green or white in color.

stormful.definition: Abounding with storms. "The stormful east." Carlyle. -- Storm"ful*ness, n.

unarm.definition:
To disarm. Sir T. Browne.

To puff off, or lay down, one's arms or armor. "I'll unarm again." Shak.

cursedness.definition: The state of being under a curse or of being doomed to execration or to evil. 2. Wickedness; sin; cursing. Chaucer. 3. Shrewishness. "My wife's cursedness." Chaucer.

oculate.definition: Furnished with eyes. 2. Having spots or holes resembling eyes; ocellated.

berserker.definition: (Scand. Myth.)  One of a class of legendary heroes, who fought frenzied by intoxicating liquors, and naked, regardless of wounds. Longfellow. 2. One who fights as if frenzied, like a Berserker.

poak.definition: Waste matter from the preparation of skins, consisting of hair, lime, oil, etc.

bullbeggar.definition: Something used or suggested to produce terror, as in children or persons of weak mind; a bugbear. And being an ill-looked fellow, he has a pension from the church wardens for being bullbeggar to all the forward children in the parish. Mountfort (1691).

emptying.definition: The act of making empty. Shak. 2. pl.  The lees of beer, cider, etc.; yeast. [U.S.].

eudaemonist.definition: One who believes in eudemonism. I am too much of a eudæmonist; I hanker too much after a state of happiness both for myself and others. De Quincey.

calcar.definition:
A kind of oven, or reverberatory furnace, used for the calcination of sand and potash, and converting them into frit. Ure.

1. (Bot.)  A hollow tube or spur at the base of a petal or corolla. 2. (Zoöl.)  A slender bony process from the ankle joint of bats, which helps to support the posterior part o.

psaltery.definition: A stringed instrument of music used by the Hebrews, the form of which is not known. Praise the Lord with harp; sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings. Ps. xxxiii. 2.

usbeks.definition: A Turkish tribe which about the close of the 15th century conquered, and settled in, that part of Asia now called Turkestan. [Written also Uzbecks, and Uzbeks.].

fellowlike.definition: Like a companion; companionable; on equal terms; sympathetic. Udall.

cadene.definition: A species of inferior carpet imported from the Levant. McElrath.

uratic.definition: Of or containing urates; as, uratic calculi.

gip.definition:
To take out the entrails of (herrings).

A servant. See Gyp. Sir W. Scott.

perambulate.definition:
To walk through or over; especially, to travel over for the purpose of surveying or examining; to inspect by traversing; specifically, to inspect officially the boundaries of, as of a town or parish, by walking over the whole line.

To walk about; to ramble; to stroll; as, he perambulated in the par.

ornithology.definition: That branch of zoölogy which treats of the natural history of birds and their classification. 2. A treatise or book on this science.

reef-band.definition: A piece of canvas sewed across a sail to strengthen it in the part where the eyelet holes for reefing are made. Totten.

purificative.definition: Having power to purify; tending to cleanse.

transpicuous.definition: Transparent; pervious to the sight. "The wide, transpicuous air." Milton.

sarmatic.definition: Of or pertaining to Sarmatia, or its inhabitants, the ancestors of the Russians und the Poles.

comitiva.definition: A body of followers; -- applied to the lawless or brigand bands in Italy and Sicily.

floroon.definition: A border worked with flowers. Wright.

mauveine.definition: An artificial organic base, obtained by oxidizing a mixture of aniline and toluidine, and valuable for the dyestuffs it forms. [Written also mauvine.].

disclusion.definition: A shutting off; exclusion. Dr. H. More.

unhoped.definition: Not hoped or expected. "With unhoped success." Dryden. Blessings of friends, which to my door Unasked, unhoped, have come. J. N. Newman.

facete.definition: Facetious; witty; humorous. [Archaic] "A facete discourse." Jer. Taylor. "How to interpose" with a small, smart remark, sentiment facete, or unctuous anecdote. Prof. Wilson. -- Fa*cete"ly, adv. -- Fa*cete"ness, n.

pot-valiant.definition: Having the courage given by drink. Smollett.

bodian.definition: A large food fish (Diagramma lineatum), native of the East Indies.

subsultus.definition: A starting, twitching, or convulsive motion.

ditionary.definition:
Under rule; subject; tributary. Chapman.

A subject; a tributary. Eden.

shunter.definition: A person employed to shunt cars from one track to another.

sedgy.definition: Overgrown with sedge. On the gentle Severn''s sedgy bank. Shak.

sciuromorpha.definition: A tribe of rodents containing the squirrels and allied animals, such as the gophers, woodchucks, beavers, and others.

enmarble.definition: To make hard as marble; to harden. Spenser.

inquisitor.definition: An inquisitive person; one fond of asking questions. "Inquisitors are tatlers." Feltham. 2. (Law)  One whose official duty it is to examine and inquire, as coroners, sheriffs, etc. Mozley & W. 3. (R.C.Ch.)  A member of the Court of Inquisition.

pedicellina.definition: A genus of Bryozoa, of the order Entoprocta, having a bell- shaped body supported on a slender pedicel. See Illust. under Entoprocta.

dasyurine.definition: Pertaining to, or like, the dasyures.

cicely.definition: Any one of several umbelliferous plants, of the genera Myrrhis, Osmorrhiza, etc.

mesially.definition: In, near, or toward, the mesial plane; mesiad.

subcarbonate.definition: A carbonate containing an excess of the basic constituent.

fracas.definition: An uproar; a noisy quarrel; a disturbance; a brawl.

drawloom.definition: A kind of loom used in weaving figured patterns; -- called also drawboy. 2. A species of damask made on the drawloom.

entablature.definition: The superstructure which lies horizontally upon the columns. See Illust. of Column, Cornice. Note: It is commonly divided into architrave, the part immediately above the column; frieze, the central space; and cornice, the upper projecting moldings. Parker.

weariful.definition: Abounding in qualities which cause weariness; wearisome. -- Wea"ri*ful*ly, adv.

unsupportable.definition: Insupportable; unendurable. -- Un`sup*port"a*ble*ness, n. Bp. Wilkins. -- Un`sup*port"a*bly, adv.

euphuism.definition: An affectation of excessive elegance and refinement of language; high-flown diction.

monodical.definition: Belonging to a monody. 2. (Mus.) (a) For one voice; monophonic. (b) Homophonic; -- applied to music in which the melody is confined to one part, instead of being shared by all the parts as in the style called polyphonic.

sanderling.definition: A small gray and brown sandpiper (Calidris arenaria) very common on sandy beaches in America, Europe, and Asia. Called also curwillet, sand lark, stint, and ruddy plover.

resistibility.definition: The quality of being resistible; resistibleness. 2. The quality of being resistant; resitstance. The name "body" being the complex idea of extension and resistibility together in the same subject. Locke.

toty.definition:
Totty. My head is totty of my swink to-night. Chaucer.

A sailor or fisherman;-so called in some parts of the Pacific.

exprobrate.definition: To charge upon with reproach; to upbraid. Sir T. Browne.

unruled.definition: Not governed or controlled. "Unruled and undirected." Spenser. 2. Not ruled or marked with lines; as, unruled paper.

overpicture.definition: To surpass nature in the picture or representation of. "O'erpicturing that Venus." Shak.

baffling.definition: Frustrating; discomfiting; disconcerting; as, baffling currents, winds, tasks. -- Bafflingly, adv. -- Bafflingness, n.

forgetter.definition: One who forgets; a heedless person. Johnson.

verb.definition: A word; a vocable. South. 2. (Gram.)  A word which affirms or predicates something of some person or thing; a part of speech expressing being, action, or the suffering of action. Note: A verb is a word whereby the chief action of the mind [the assertion or the denial of a proposition] finds expressi.

problematize.definition: To propose problems. "Hear him problematize." B. Jonson.

sarcophaga.definition:
A suborder of carnivorous and insectivorous marsupials including the dasyures and the opossums.

A genus of Diptera, including the flesh flies.

myriologist.definition: One who composes or sings a myriologue.

mediocre.definition:
Of a middle quality; of but a moderate or low degree of excellence; indifferent; ordinary. " A very mediocre poet." Pope.

1. A mediocre person. 2. A young monk who was excused from performing a portion of a monk's duties. Shipley.

heterophyllous.definition: Having leaves of more than one shape on the same plant.

freieslebenite.definition: A sulphide of antimony, lead, and silver, occuring in monoclinic crystals.

pleurenchyma.definition: A tissue consisting of long and slender tubular cells, of which wood is mainly composed.

credibility.definition: The quality of being credible; credibleness; as, the credibility of facts; the credibility of witnesses.

esquire.definition: Originally, a shield-bearer or armor-bearer, an attendant on a knight; in modern times, a title of dignity next in degree below knight and above gentleman; also, a title of office and courtesy; -- often shortened to squire. Note: In England, the title of esquire belongs by right of birth to the elde.

amnion.definition: A thin membrane surrounding the embryos of mammals, birds, and reptiles.

clausular.definition: Consisting of, or having, clauses. Smart.

rafter.definition:
A raftsman.

Originally, any rough and somewhat heavy piece of timber. Now, commonly, one of the timbers of a roof which are put on sloping, according to the inclination of the roof. See Illust. of Queen-post. [Courtesy] oft is sooner found in lowly sheds, With smoky rafters, than in tapestry halls.

attorneyship.definition: The office or profession of an attorney; agency for another. Shak.

testate.definition:
Having made and left a will; as, a person is said to die testate. Ayliffe.

One who leaves a valid will at death; a testate person.

avaunt.definition:
Begone; depart; -- a word of contempt or abhorrence, equivalent to the phrase "Get thee gone."

1. To advance; to move forward; to elevate. Spenser. 2. To depart; to move away. Coverdale.

To vaunt; to boast. Chaucer.

A vaunt; to boast. Chaucer.

dividual.definition: Divided, shared, or participated in, in common with others. Milton.

horsefoot.definition: (Bot.)  The coltsfoot. 2. (Zoöl.)  The Limulus or horseshoe crab.

amish.definition:
The Amish Mennonites.

Of, pertaining to, or designating, the followers of Jacob Amman, a strict Mennonite of the 17th century, who even proscribed the use of buttons and shaving as "worldly conformity". There are several branches of Amish Mennonites in the United States.

creamery.definition: A place where butter and cheese are made, or where milk and cream are put up in cans for market. 2. A place or apparatus in which milk is set for raising cream. 3. An establishment where cream is sold.

scaphognathite.definition: A thin leafike appendage (the exopodite) of the second maxilla of decapod crustaceans. It serves as a pumping organ to draw the water through the gill cavity.

concertino.definition: A piece for one or more solo instruments with orchestra; -- more concise than the concerto.

subministrate.definition: To supply; to afford; to subminister. Harvey.

subsistent.definition: Having real being; as, a subsistent spirit. 2. Inherent; as, qualities subsistent in matter.

paled.definition: Striped. "[Buskins] . . . paled part per part." Spenser. 2. Inclosed with a paling. "A paled green." Spenser.

touchstone.definition: (Min.)  Lydian stone; basanite; -- so called because used to test the purity of gold and silver by the streak which is left upon the stone when it is rubbed by the metal. See Basanite. 2. Fig.:  Any test or criterion by which the qualities of a thing are tried. Hooker. The foregoing doctrine affords.

velum.definition: (Anat.)  Curtain or covering; -- applied to various membranous partitions, especially to the soft palate. See under Palate. 2. (Bot.) (a) See Veil, n., 3 (b). (b) A thin membrane surrounding the sporocarps of quillworts Isoetes). 3. (Zoöl.)  A veil-like organ or part. Especially: (a) The circular me.

nemophily.definition: Fondness for forest scenery; love of the woods.

hisingerite.definition: A soft black, iron ore, nearly earthy, a hydrous silicate of iron.

inalienable.definition: Incapable of being alienated, surrendered, or transferred to another; not alienable; as, in inalienable birthright.

sollar.definition:
See Solar, n. 2. (Mining)  A platform in a shaft, especially one of those between the series of ladders in a shaft.

To cover, or provide with, a sollar.

misween.definition: To ween amiss; to misjudge; to distrust; to be mistaken. Spenser.

yearth.definition: The earth. "Is my son dead or hurt or on the yerthe felled" Ld. Berners.

debacchate.definition: To rave as a bacchanal. Cockeram.

dogmaticalness.definition: The quality of being dogmatical; positiveness.

wordle.definition: One of several pivoted pieces forming the throat of an adjustable die used in drawing wire, lead pipe, etc. Knight.

henna.definition: (Bot.)  A thorny tree or shrub of the genus Lawsonia (L. alba). The fragrant white blossoms are used by the Buddhists in religious ceremonies. The powdered leaves furnish a red coloring matter used in the East to stain the hails and fingers, the manes of horses, etc. 2. (Com.)  The leaves of the hen.

canaanite.definition:
A descendant of Canaan, the son of Ham, and grandson of Noah. 2. A Native or inbabitant of the land of Canaan, esp. a member of any of the tribes who inhabited Canaan at the time of the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt.

A zealot. "Simon the Canaanite." Matt. x. 4. Note: This was the "Simon calle.

aorist.definition: A tense in the Greek language, which expresses an action as completed in past time, but leaves it, in other respects, wholly indeterminate.

cestus.definition:
(Antiq.)  A girdle; particularly that of Aphrodite (or Venus) which gave the wearer the power of exciting love. 2. (Zoöl.)  A genus of Ctenophora. The typical species (Cestus Veneris) is remarkable for its brilliant iridescent colors, and its long, girdlelike form.

A covering for the hands of boxer.

expletory.definition: Serving to fill up; expletive; superfluous; as, an expletory word. Bp. Burnet.

quinoline.definition: A nitrogenous base, C9H7N obtained as a pungent colorless liquid by the distillation of alkaloids, bones, coal tar, etc. It the nucleus of many organic bodies, especially of certain alkaloids and related substances; hence, by extension, any one of the series of alkaloidal bases of which quinoline pr.

gab.definition:
The hook on the end of an eccentric rod opposite the strap. See. Illust. of Eccentric.

The mouth; hence, idle prate; chatter; unmeaning talk; loquaciousness. Gift of gab, facility of expression.

1. To deceive; to lie. Chaucer. 2. To talk idly; to prate; to chatter. Holinshed.

tufaceous.definition: Pertaining to tufa; consisting of, or resembling, tufa.

zygobranchia.definition: A division of marine gastropods in which the gills are developed on both sides of the body and the renal organs are also paired. The abalone (Haliotis) and the keyhole limpet (Fissurella) are examples.

outstand.definition:
To stand out, or project, from a surface or mass; hence, to remain standing out.

1. To resist effectually; to withstand; to sustain without yielding. Woodward. 2. To stay beyond. "I have outstood my time." Shak.

pomarine.definition: Having the nostril covered with a scale. Pomarine jager (Zoöl.), a North Atlantic jager (Stercorarius pomarinus) having the elongated middle tail feathers obtuse. The adult is black.

tranquillization.definition: The act of tranquilizing, or the state of being tranquilized.

waketime.definition: Time during which one is awake. Mrs. Browning.

signalist.definition: One who makes signals; one who communicates intelligence by means of signals.

bowhead.definition: The great Arctic or Greenland whale. (Balæna mysticetus). See Baleen, and Whale.

chatwood.definition: Little sticks; twigs for burning; fuel. Johnson.

miscall.definition: To call by a wrong name; to name improperly. 2. To call by a bad name; to abuse. Fuller.

etherification.definition: The act or process of making ether; specifically, the process by which a large quantity of alcohol is transformed into ether by the agency of a small amount of sulphuric, or ethyl sulphuric, acid.

scandinavian.definition: Of or pertaining to Scandinavia, that is, Sweden, Norway, and Denmark. -- n.  A native or inhabitant of Scandinavia.

fourchette.definition: A table fork. 2. (Anat.) (a) A small fold of membrane, connecting the labia in the posterior part of the vulva. (b) The wishbone or furculum of birds. (c) The frog of the hoof of the horse and allied animals. 3. (Surg.)  An instrument used to raise and support the tongue during the cutting of the fr.

anemonic.definition: An acrid, poisonous, crystallizable substance, obtained from, the anemone, or from anemonin.

expedient.definition: Hastening or forward; hence, tending to further or promote a proposed object; fit or proper under the circumstances; conducive to self-interest; desirable; advisable; advantageous; -- sometimes contradistinguished from right. It is expedient for you that I go away. John xvi. 7. Nothing but the right.

open-hearted.definition: Candid; frank; generous. Dryden. -- O"pen-heart`ed*ly, adv. -- O"pen-heart`ed*ness, n. Walton.

docetae.definition: Ancient heretics who held that Christ's body was merely a phantom or appearance.

relive.definition:
To live again; to revive.

To recall to life; to revive.

stigmatically.definition: With a stigma, or mark of infamy or deformity.

delphinus.definition: (Zoöl.)  A genus of Cetacea, including the dolphin. See Dolphin, 1. 2. (Astron.)  The Dolphin, a constellation near the equator and east of Aquila.

byard.definition: A piece of leather crossing the breast, used by the men who drag sledges in coal mines.

designator.definition: (Rom. Antiq.)  An officer who assigned to each his rank and place in public shows and ceremonies. 2. One who designates.

bulge.definition:
The bilge or protuberant part of a cask. 2. A swelling, protuberant part; a bending outward, esp. when caused by pressure; as, a bulge in a wall. 3. (Naut.)  The bilge of a vessel. See Bilge, 2. Bulge ways. (Naut.) See Bilge ways.

1. To swell or jut out; to bend outward, as a wall when it yields to.

endorhizous.definition: Having the radicle of the embryo sheathed by the cotyledon, through which the embryo bursts in germination, as in many monocotyledonous plants.

solidness.definition: State or quality of being solid; firmness; compactness; solidity, as of material bodies. 2. Soundness; strength; truth; validity, as of arguments, reasons, principles, and the like.

felsite.definition: A finegrained rock, flintlike in fracture, consisting essentially of orthoclase feldspar with occasional grains of quartz.

lozenged.definition: Having the form of a lozenge or rhomb. The lozenged panes of a very small latticed window. C. Bronté.

quair.definition: A quire; a book. " The king's quhair." James I. (of Scotland).

upwreath.definition: To rise with a curling motion; to curl upward, as smoke. Longfellow.

cloud-compeller.definition: Cloud-gatherer; -- an epithet applied to Zeus. [Poetic.] Pope.

misthink.definition:
To think wrongly. "Adam misthought of her." Milton.

To have erroneous thoughts or judgment of; to think ill of. Shak.

blithesome.definition: Cheery; gay; merry. The blithesome sounds of wassail gay. Sir W. Scott. -- Blithe"some*ly, adv. -- Blithe"some*ness, n.

pleura.definition:
pl. of Pleuron.

1. (Anat.) (a) The smooth serous membrane which closely covers the lungs and the adjacent surfaces of the thorax; the pleural membrane. (b) The closed sac formed by the pleural membrane about each lung, or the fold of membrane connecting each lung with the body wall. 2. (Zoöl.)  Sam.

ominous.definition: Of or pertaining to an omen or to omens; being or exhibiting an omen; significant; portentous; -- formerly used both in a favorable and unfavorable sense; now chiefly in the latter; foreboding or foreshowing evil; inauspicious; as, an ominous dread. He had a good ominous name to have made a peace. B.

lithagogue.definition: A medicine having, or supposed to have, the power of expelling calculous matter with the urine. Hooper.

jungly.definition: Consisting of jungles; abounding with jungles; of the nature of a jungle.

monogoneutic.definition: Having but one brood in a season.

unbit.definition: To remove the turns of (a rope or cable) from the bits; as, to unbit a cable. Totten.

trica.definition: An apothecium in certain lichens, having a spherical surface marked with spiral or concentric ridges and furrows.

entropium.definition: The inversion or turning in of the border of the eyelids.

uroglaucin.definition: A body identical with indigo blue, occasionally found in the urine in degeneration of the kidneys. It is readily formed by oxidation or decomposition of indican.

saurian.definition: Of or pertaining to, or of the nature of, the Sauria. -- n.  One of the Sauria.

zoon.definition: (a) An animal which is the sole product of a single egg; -- opposed to zooid. H. Spencer. (b) Any one of the perfectly developed individuals of a compound animal.

piffara.definition: A fife; also, a rude kind of oboe or a bagpipe with an inflated skin for reservoir.

fetch.definition: To bear toward the person speaking, or the person or thing from whose point of view the action is contemplated; to go and bring; to get. Time will run back and fetch the age of gold. Milton. He called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink. And as she w.

tortrix.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of numerous species of small moths of the family Tortricidæ, the larvæ of which usually roll up the leaves of plants on which they live; -- also called leaf roller. 2. (Zoöl.)  A genus of tropical short-tailed snakes, which are not venomous. One species (Tortrix scytalæ) is handsome.

perigenesis.definition: A theory which explains inheritance by the transmission of the type of growth force possessed by one generation to another.

reremouse.definition:
The leather-winged bat (Vespertilio murinus). [Written also reermouse.]

A rearmouse.

chalcopyrite.definition: Copper pyrites, or yellow copper ore; a common ore of opper, containing copper, iron, and sulphur. It occurs massive and in tetragonal crystals of a bright brass yellow color.

expiate.definition: To extinguish the guilt of by sufferance of penalty or some equivalent; to make complete satisfaction for; to atone for; to make amends for; to make expiation for; as, to expiate a crime, a guilt, or sin. To expiate his treason, hath naught left. Milton. The Treasurer obliged himself to expiate the.

lychnoscope.definition: Same as Low side window, under Low, a.

kantism.definition: The doctrine or theory of Kant; the Kantian philosophy.

archilochian.definition: Of or pertaining to the satiric Greek poet Archilochus; as, Archilochian meter.

oxanilide.definition: a white crystalline substance, resembling oxanilamide, obtained by heating aniline oxalate, and regarded as a double anilide of oxalic acid; -- called also diphenyl oxamide.

penetrability.definition: The quality of being penetrable; susceptibility of being penetrated, entered, or pierced. Cheyne.

severy.definition: A bay or compartment of a vaulted ceiling. [Written also civery.].

adenoma.definition: A benign tumor of a glandlike structure; morbid enlargement of a gland. -- Ad`e*nom"a*tous, a.

perigee.definition: That point in the orbit of the moon which is nearest to the earth; -- opposed to Ant: apogee. It is sometimes, but rarely, used of the nearest points of other orbits, as of a comet, a planet, etc. Called also epigee, epigeum.

paintless.definition: Not capable of being painted or described. "In paintless patience." Savage.

concurrent.definition: Acting in conjunction; agreeing in the same act or opinion; contibuting to the same event of effect; coöperating. I join with these laws the personal presence of the kings' son, as a concurrent cause of this reformation. Sir J. Davies. The concurrent testimony of antiquity. Bp. Warburton. 2. Conjoin.

abranchiata.definition: A group of annelids, so called because the species composing it have no special organs of respiration.

perisarc.definition: The outer, hardened integument which covers most hydroids.

sapajou.definition: Any one of several species of South American monkeys of the genus Cebus, having long and prehensile tails. Some of the species are called also capuchins. The bonnet sapajou (C. subcristatus), the golden-handed sapajou (C. chrysopus), and the white-throated sapajou (C. hypoleucus) are well known spec.

sarcoid.definition: Resembling flesh, or muscle; composed of sarcode.

squamoid.definition: Resembling a scale; also, covered with scales; scaly.

spaniel.definition: (Zoöl.)  One of a breed of small dogs having long and thick hair and large drooping ears. The legs are usually strongly feathered, and the tail bushy. See Illust. under Clumber, and Cocker. Note: There are several varieties of spaniels, some of which, known as field spaniels, are used in hunting; ot.

traject.definition:
To throw or cast through, over, or across; as, to traject the sun's light through three or more cross prisms. Sir I. Newton.

1. A place for passing across; a passage; a ferry. Cotgrave. 2. The act of trajecting; trajection. 3. A trajectory. I. Taylor.

preceptorial.definition: Of or pertaining to a preceptor.

revolting.definition: Causing abhorrence mixed with disgust; exciting extreme repugnance; loathsome; as, revolting cruelty. -- Re*volt"ing*ly, adv.

demit.definition: To let fall; to depress. They [peacocks] demit and let fall the same [i. e., their train]. Sir T. Browne. 2. To yield or submit; to humble; to lower; as, to demit one's self to humble duties. 3. To lay down, as an office; to resign. [Scot.] General Conway demitted his office. Hume.

thinness.definition: The quality or state of being thin (in any of the senses of the word).

arboreal.definition: Of or pertaining to a tree, or to trees; of nature of trees. Cowley. 2. Attached to, found in or upon, or frequenting, woods or trees; as, arboreal animals. Woodpeckers are eminently arboreal. Darwin.

anomural.definition: Irregular in the character of the tail or abdomen; as, the anomural crustaceans. [Written also anomoural, anomouran.].

waggel.definition: The young of the great black-backed gull (Larus marinus), formerly considered a distinct species.

mochila.definition: A large leather flap which covers the saddletree. [Western U.S.].

dermatophyte.definition: A vegetable parasite, infesting the skin.

befringe.definition: To furnish with a fringe; to form a fringe upon; to adorn as with fringe. Fuller.

decigramme.definition: A weight in the metric system; one tenth of a gram, equal to 1.5432 grains avoirdupois.

authorless.definition: Without an author; without authority; anonymous.

espionage.definition: The practice or employment of spies; the practice of watching the words and conduct of others, to make discoveries, as spies or secret emissaries; secret watching.

triforium.definition: The gallery or open space between the vaulting and the roof of the aisles of a church, often forming a rich arcade in the interior of the church, above the nave arches and below the clearstory windows.

theatral.definition: Of or pertaining to a theater; theatrical.

vesical.definition: Of or pertaining to the bladder. Dunglison.

sloakan.definition: A species of seaweed. [Spelled also slowcawn.] See 3d Laver.

providore.definition: One who makes provision; a purveyor. De Foe.

handkercher.definition: A handkerchief. [Obs. or Colloq.] Chapman (1654). Shak.

roorback.definition: A defamatory forgery or falsehood published for purposes of political intrigue. [U.S.] Note: The word originated in the election canvass of 1844, when such a forgery was published, to the detriment of James K. Polk, a candidate for President, purporting to be an extract from the "Travels of Baron Ro.

tetragon.definition: (Geom.)  A plane figure having four sides and angles; a quadrangle, as a square, a rhombus, etc. 2. (Astrol.)  An aspect of two planets with regard to the earth when they are distant from each other ninety degrees, or the fourth of a circle. Hutton.

slovenly.definition:
Having the habits of a sloven; negligent of neatness and order, especially in dress. A slovenly, lazy fellow, bolling at his ease. L'Estrange. 2. Characteristic of a solven; lacking neatness and order; evincing negligence; as, slovenly dress.

a slovenly manner.

fipple.definition: A stopper, as in a wind instrument of music. Bacon.

chrysoberyl.definition: A mineral, found in crystals, of a yellow to green or brown color, and consisting of aluminia and glucina. It is very hard, and is often used as a gem.

genuflection.definition: The act of bending the knee, particularly in worship. Bp. Stillingfleet.

cousin.definition: One collaterally related more remotely than a brother or sister; especially, the son or daughter of an uncle or aunt. Note: The children of brothers and sisters are usually denominated first cousins, or cousins-german. In the second generation, they are called second cousins. See Cater-cousin, and Q.

duplicity.definition: Doubleness; a twofold state. [Archaic] Do not affect duplicities nor triplicities, nor any certain number of parts in your division of things. I. Watts. 2.
