Doubleness of heart or speech; insincerity; a sustained form of deception which consists in entertaining or pretending to entertain one of feeli.

nulled.definition: Turned so as to resemble nulls. Nulled work (Cabinetwork), ornamental turned work resembling nulls or beads strung on a rod.

emmetropia.definition: That refractive condition of the eye in which the rays of light are all brought accurately and without undue effort to a focus upon the retina; -- opposed to hypermetropia, myopia, an astigmatism.

alkarsin.definition: A spontaneously inflammable liquid, having a repulsive odor, and consisting of cacodyl and its oxidation products; -- called also Cadel's fuming liquid.

lowness.definition: The state or quality of being low.

enclitic.definition:
Affixed; subjoined; -- said of a word or particle which leans back upon the preceding word so as to become a part of it, and to lose its own independent accent, generally varying also the accent of the preceding word.

A word which is joined to another so closely as to lose its proper accent, as the.

betumble.definition: To throw into disorder; to tumble. From her betumbled couch she starteth. Shak.

boiled.definition: Dressed or cooked by boiling; subjected to the action of a boiling liquid; as, boiled meat; a boiled dinner; boiled clothes.

macrodont.definition: Having large teeth. -- n.  A macrodont animal.

philalethist.definition: A lover of the truth. Brathwait.

vacillating.definition: Inclined to fluctuate; wavering. Tennyson. -- Vac"il*la`ting*ly, adv.

olefine.definition: Olefiant gas, or ethylene; hence, by extension, any one of the series of unsaturated hydrocarbons of which ethylene is a type. See Ethylene.

venditate.definition: To cry up. as if for sale; to blazon. Holland.

palustrine.definition: Of, pertaining to, or living in, a marsh or swamp; marshy.

ideate.definition:
The actual existence supposed to correspond with an idea; the correlate in real existence to the idea as a thought or existence.

1. To form in idea; to fancy. The ideated man . . . as he stood in the intellect of God. Sir T. Browne. 2. To apprehend in thought so as to fix and hold in the mind; to m.

well-wish.definition: A wish of happiness. "A well-wish for his friends." Addison.

holaspidean.definition: Having a single series of large scutes on the posterior side of the tarsus; -- said of certain birds.

opisthobranchia.definition: A division of gastropod Mollusca, in which the breathing organs are usually situated behind the heart. It includes the tectibranchs and nudibranchs.

cowpox.definition: A pustular eruptive disease of the cow, which, when communicated to the human system, as by vaccination, protects from the smallpox; vaccinia; -- called also kinepox, cowpock, and kinepock. Dunglison.

gingival.definition: Of or pertaining to the gums. Holder.

goniatite.definition: One of an extinct genus of fossil cephalopods, allied to the Ammonites. The earliest forms are found in the Devonian formation, the latest, in the Triassic.

overpowering.definition: Excelling in power; too powerful; irresistible. -- O`ver*pow"er*ing*ly, adv.

reentrance.definition: The act entereing again; re Hooker.

rolliche.definition: A kind of sausage, made in a bag of tripe, sliced and fried, famous among the Dutch of New Amsterdam and still known, esp. in New Jersey.

cnidaria.definition: A comprehensive group equivalent to the true Coelenterata, i.e., exclusive of the sponges. They are so named from presence of stinging cells (cnidae) in the tissues. See Coelenterata.

leucite.definition: (Min.)  A mineral having a glassy fracture, occurring in translucent trapezohedral crystals. It is a silicate of alumina and potash. It is found in the volcanic rocks of Italy, especially at Vesuvius. 2. (Bot.)  A leucoplast.

disjoint.definition:
Disjointed; unconnected; -- opposed to conjoint. Milton.

Difficult situation; dilemma; strait. "I stand in such disjoint." Chaucer.

1. To separate the joints of; to separate, as parts united by joints; to put out of joint; to force out of its socket; to dislocate; as, to disjoint limbs; to disjoin.

metalbumin.definition: A form of albumin found in ascitic and certain serous fluids. It is sometimes regarded as a mixture of albumin and mucin.

lupercal.definition:
Of or pertaining to the Lupercalia.

A grotto on the Palatine Hill sacred to Lupercus, the Lycean Pan.

dangerful.definition: Full of danger; dangerous. -- Dan"ger*ful*ly, adv. Udall.

valetudinary.definition:
Infirm; sickly; valetudinarian. -- Val`e*tu"di*na*ri*ness, n. It renders the habit of society dangerously. Burke.

A valetudinarian.

tithing.definition: The act of levying or taking tithes; that which is taken as tithe; a tithe. To take tithing of their blood and sweat. Motley. 2. (O. Eng. Law)  A number or company of ten householders who, dwelling near each other, were sureties or frankpledges to the king for the good behavior of each other; a dece.

discontentment.definition: The state of being discontented; uneasiness; inquietude. Bacon.

punctuation.definition: The act or art of punctuating or pointing a writing or discourse; the art or mode of dividing literary composition into sentences, and members of a sentence, by means of points, so as to elucidate the author's meaning. Note: Punctuation, as the term is usually understood, is chiefly performed with f.

shotgun.definition: A light, smooth-bored gun, often double-barreled, especially designed for firing small shot at short range, and killing small game.

aldermanry.definition: The district or ward of an alderman. 2. The office or rank of an alderman. B. Jonson.

conjecturable.definition: Capable of being conjectured or guessed.

declaratively.definition: By distinct assertion; not impliedly; in the form of a declaration. The priest shall expiate it, that is, declaratively. Bates.

felonious.definition: Having the quality of felony; malignant; malicious; villainous; traitorous; perfidious; in a legal sense, done with intent to commit a crime; as, felonious homicide. O thievish Night, Why should'st thou, but for some felonious end, In thy dark lantern thus close up the stars Milton. -- Fe*lo"ni`ous*.

merismatic.definition: Dividing into cells or segments; characterized by separation into two or more parts or sections by the formation of internal partitions; as, merismatic growth, where one cell divides into many.

bell-shaped.definition: Having the shape of a widemouthed bell; campanulate. BELL'S PALSY Bell's palsy.  Paralysis of the facial nerve, producing distortion of one side of the face.

shilling.definition: A silver coin, and money of account, of Great Britain and its dependencies, equal to twelve pence, or the twentieth part of a pound, equivalent to about twenty-four cents of the United States currency. 2. In the United States, a denomination of money, differing in value in different States. It is no.

sanguinity.definition: The quality of being sanguine; sanguineness. Swift.

sponging.definition: a. & n. from Sponge, v. Sponging house (Eng. Law), a bailiff's or other house in which debtors are put before being taken to jail, or until they compromise with their creditors. At these houses extortionate charges are commonly made for food, lodging, etc.

testify.definition: To make a solemn declaration, verbal or written, to establish some fact; to give testimony for the purpose of communicating to others a knowledge of something not known to them. Jesus . . . needed not that any should testify of man, for he knew what was in man. John ii. 25. 2. (Law)  To make a solem.

dispossess.definition: To put out of possession; to deprive of the actual occupancy of, particularly of land or real estate; to disseize; to eject; -- usually followed by of before the thing taken away; as, to dispossess a king of his crown. Usurp the land, and dispossess the swain. Goldsmith.

cross-spale.definition: One of the temporary wooden braces, placed horizontally across a frame to hold it in position until the deck beams are in; a cross- pawl.

reconvey.definition: To convey back or to the former place; as, to reconvey goods. 2. To transfer back to a former owner; as, to reconvey an estate.

demoiselle.definition: A young lady; a damsel; a lady's maid. 2. (Zoöl.)  The Numidian crane (Antropoides virgo); -- so called on account of the grace and symmetry of its form and movements. 3. (Zoöl.)  A beautiful, small dragon fly of the genus Agrion.

supersensible.definition: Beyond the reach of the senses; above the natural powers of perception.

occupy.definition: To take or hold possession of; to hold or keep for use; to possess. Woe occupieth the fine [/end] of our gladness. Chaucer. The better apartments were already occupied. W. Irving . 2. To hold, or fill, the dimensions of; to take up the room or space of; to cover or fill; as, the camp occupies five a.

pitiful.definition: Full of pity; tender-hearted; compassionate; kind; merciful; sympathetic. The Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy. James v. 11. 2. Piteous; lamentable; eliciting compassion. A thing, indeed, very pitiful and horrible. Spenser. 3. To be pitied for littleness or meanness; miserable; paltry; cont.

admixtion.definition: A mingling of different things; admixture. Glanvill.

capitular.definition:
An act passed in a chapter. 2. A member of a chapter. The chapter itself, and all its members or capitulars. Ayliffe. 3. The head or prominent part.

1. (Eccl.)  Of or pertaining to a chapter; capitulary. From the pope to the member of the capitular body. Milman. 2. (Bot.)  Growing in, or pertaining.

glucoside.definition: One of a large series of amorphous or crystalline substances, occurring very widely distributed in plants, rarely in animals, and regarded as influental agents in the formation and disposition of the sugars. They are frequently of a bitter taste, but, by the action of ferments, or of dilute acids an.

prompt-book.definition: The book used by a prompter of a theater.

nautically.definition: In a nautical manner; with reference to nautical affais.

doublure.definition: (Bookbinding) The lining of a book cover, esp. one of unusual sort, as of tooled leather, painted vellum, rich brocade, or the like. 2.  (Paleon.) The reflexed margin of the trilobite carapace.

mary-bud.definition: The marigold; a blossom of the marigold. Shak.

goliard.definition: A buffoon in the Middle Ages, who attended rich men's tables to make sport for the guests by ribald stories and songs.

exorbitate.definition: To go out of the track; to deviate. Bentley.

redstart.definition: (a) A small, handsome European singing bird (Ruticilla phoenicurus), allied to the nightingale; -- called also redtail, brantail, fireflirt, firetail. The black redstart is P.tithys. The name is also applied to several other species of Ruticilla amnd allied genera, native of India. (b) An American f.

solidago.definition: A genus of yellow-flowered composite perennial herbs; golden- rod.

statesman.definition: A man versed in public affairs and in the principles and art of government; especially, one eminent for political abilities. The minds of some of our statesmen, like the pupil of the human eye, contract themselves the more, the stronger light there is shed upon them. More. 2. One occupied with the a.

veiny.definition: Full of veins; veinous; veined; as, veiny marble.

inhibitory.definition: Of or pertaining to, or producing, inhibition; consisting in inhibition; tending or serving to inhibit; as, the inhibitory action of the pneumogastric on the respiratory center. I would not have you consider these criticisms as inhibitory. Lamb. Inhibitory nerves (Physiol.), those nerves which modif.

kilogram.definition: A measure of weight, being a thousand grams, equal to 2.2046 pounds avoirdupois (15,432.34 grains). It is equal to the weight of a cubic decimeter of distilled water at the temperature of maximum density, or 39º Fahrenheit.

tachyglossa.definition: A division of monotremes which comprises the spiny ant-eaters of Australia and New Guinea. See Illust. under Echidna.

ahull.definition: With the sails furled, and the helm lashed alee; -- applied to ships in a storm. See Hull, n.

lucubrate.definition:
To study by candlelight or a lamp; to study by night.

To elaborate, perfect, or compose, by night study or by laborious endeavor.

wodegeld.definition: A geld, or payment, for wood. Burrill.

angevine.definition: Of or pertaining to Anjou in France. -- n. A native of Anjou.

repairer.definition: One who, or that which, repairs, restores, or makes amends.

brinishness.definition: State or quality of being brinish.

starched.definition: Stiffened with starch. 2. Stiff; precise; formal. Swift.

casein.definition: A proteid substance present in both the animal and the vegetable kingdom. In the animal kindom it is chiefly found in milk, and constitutes the main part of the curd separated by rennet; in the vegetable kingdom it is found more or less abundantly in the seeds of leguminous plants. Its reactions res.

creatinin.definition: A white, crystalline, nitrogenous body closely related to creatin but more basic in its properties, formed from the latter by the action of acids, and occurring naturally in muscle tissue and in urine. [Written also kretinine.].

livelong.definition: Whole; entire; long in passing; -- used of time, as day or night, in adverbial phrases, and usually with a sense of tediousness. The obscure bird Clamored the livelong night. Shak. How could she sit the livelong day, Yet never ask us once to play Swift. 2. Lasting; durable. Thou hast built thyself a.

roost.definition:
Roast. Chaucer.

See Roust, v. t.

1. The pole or other support on which fowls rest at night; a perch. He clapped his wings upon his roost. Dryden. 2. A collection of fowls roosting together. At roost, on a perch or roost; hence, retired to rest.

1. To sit, rest, or sleep, as fowls on a pole, limb.

encystment.definition: (Biol.)  A process which, among some of the lower forms of life, precedes reproduction by budding, fission, spore formation, etc. Note: The animal (a) first contracts its body to a globular mass (b) and then secretes a transparent cyst (c), after which the mass divides into two or more parts (as in.

outgush.definition:
A pouring out; an outburst. A passionate outgush of emotion. Thackeray.

To gush out; to flow forth.

menage.definition:
See Manage.

A collection of animals; a menagerie. Addison.

osteoma.definition: A tumor composed mainly of bone; a tumor of a bone.

globularity.definition: The state of being globular; globosity; sphericity.

rite.definition: The act of performing divine or solemn service, as established by law, precept, or custom; a formal act of religion or other solemn duty; a solemn observance; a ceremony; as, the rites of freemasonry. He looked with indifference on rites, names, and forms of ecclesiastical polity. Macaulay. Syn. --.

designment.definition: Delineation; sketch; design; ideal; invention. For though that some mean artist's skill were shown In mingling colors, or in placing light, Yet still the fair designment was his own. Dryden. 2. Design; purpose; scheme. Shak.

aleberry.definition: A beverage, formerly made by boiling ale with spice, sugar, and sops of bread. Their aleberries, caudles, possets. Beau. & Fl.

furfuration.definition: Falling of scurf from the head; desquamation.

asterophyllite.definition: A fossil plant from the coal formations of Europe and America, now regarded as the branchlets and foliage of calamites.

plunger.definition: One who, or that which, plunges; a diver. 2. A long solid cylinder, used, instead of a piston or bucket, as a forcer in pumps. 3. One who bets heavily and recklessly on a race; a reckless speculator. [Cant] 4. (Pottery)  A boiler in which clay is beaten by a wheel to a creamy consistence. Knight. 5.

prude.definition: A woman of affected modesty, reserve, or coyness; one who is overscrupulous or sensitive; one who affects extraordinary prudence in conduct and speech. Less modest than the speech of prudes. Swift.

retaliatory.definition: Tending to, or involving, retaliation; retaliative; as retaliatory measures.

welshman.definition: A native or inhabitant of Wales; one of the Welsh. 2. (Zoöl.) (a) A squirrel fish. (b) The large-mouthed black bass. See Black bass. [Southern U. S.].

mulewort.definition: A fern of the genus Hemionitis.

hob.definition: The hub of a wheel. See Hub. Washington. 2. The flat projection or iron shelf at the side of a fire grate, where things are put to be kept warm. Smart. 3. (Mech.)  A threaded and fluted hardened steel cutter, resembling a tap, used in a lathe for forming the teeth of screw chasers, worm wheels, etc.

hopyard.definition: A field where hops are raised.

iodizer.definition: One who, or that which, iodizes.

pterostigma.definition: A thickened opaque spot on the wings of certain insects.

arrowheaded.definition: Shaped like the head of an arow; cuneiform. Arrowheaded characters, characters the elements of which consist of strokes resembling arrowheads, nailheads, or wedges; -- hence called also nail-headed, wedge-formed, cuneiform, or cuneatic characters; the oldest written characters used in the country ab.

valvelet.definition: A little valve; a valvule; especially, one of the pieces which compose the outer covering of a pericarp.

red-handed.definition: Having hands red with blood; in the very act, as if with red or bloody hands; -- said of a person taken in the act of homicide; hence, fresh from the commission of crime; as, he was taken red-hand or red-handed.

carbineer.definition: A soldier armed with a carbine.

palatable.definition: Agreeable to the palate or taste; savory; hence, acceptable; pleasing; as, palatable food; palatable advice.

indolin.definition: A dark resinous substance, polymeric with indol, and obtained by the reduction of indigo white.

nominalistic.definition: Of or pertaining to the Nominalists.

christianization.definition: The act or process of converting or being converted to a true Christianity.

electro-telegraphy.definition: The art or science of constructing or using the electric telegraph; the transmission of messages by means of the electric telegraph.

jakie.definition: A South American striped frog (Pseudis paradoxa), remarkable for having a tadpole larger than the adult, and hence called also paradoxical frog.

indistinctly.definition: In an indistinct manner; not clearly; confusedly; dimly; as, certain ideas are indistinctly comprehended. In its sides it was bounded distinctly, but on its ends confusedly an indistinctly. Sir I. Newton.

payee.definition: The person to whom money is to be, or has been, paid; the person named in a bill or note, to whom, or to whose order, the amount is promised or directed to be paid. See Bill of exchange, under Bill.

strontic.definition: Of or pertaining to strontium; containing, or designating the compounds of, strontium.

uranographic.definition: Of or pertaining to uranography; as, an uranographic treatise.

insubmergible.definition: Not capable of being submerged; buoyant.

hair-brown.definition: Of a clear tint of brown, resembling brown human hair. It is composed of equal proportions of red and green.

sparkful.definition: Lively; brisk; gay. "Our sparkful youth." Camden.

therefrom.definition: From this or that. Turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left. John. xxiii. 6.

toise.definition: An old measure of length in France, containing six French feet, or about 6.3946 French feet.

oculus.definition: An eye; (Bot.) a leaf bud. 2. (Arch.)  A round window, usually a small one.

quiddle.definition:
To spend time in trifling employments, or to attend to useful subjects in an indifferent or superficial manner; to dawdle.

One who wastes his energy about trifles. Emerson.

equipaged.definition: Furnished with equipage. Well dressed, well bred. Well equipaged, is ticket good enough. Cowper.

fertilization.definition: The act or process of rendering fertile. 2. (Biol.)  The act of fecundating or impregnating animal or vegetable germs; esp., the process by which in flowers the pollen renders the ovule fertile, or an analogous process in flowerless plants; fecundation; impregnation. Close fertilization (Bot.), the.

lighten.definition:
To descend; to light. O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us. Book of Common Prayer [Eng. Ed.]

1. To burst forth or dart, as lightning; to shine with, or like, lightning; to display a flash or flashes of lightning; to flash. This dreadful night, That thunders, lightens, opens graves, and roars As do.

dresser.definition: One who dresses; one who put in order or makes ready for use; one who on clothes or ornaments. 2. (Mining)  A kind of pick for shaping large coal. 3. An assistant in a hospital, whose office it is to dress wounds, sores, etc. 4. Etym: [F. dressoir. See Dress, v. t.] (a) A table or bench on which mea.

venantes.definition: The hunting spiders, which run after, or leap upon, their prey.

petal.definition: (Bot.)  One of the leaves of the corolla, or the colored leaves of a flower. See Corolla, and Illust. of Flower. 2. (Zoöl.)  One of the expanded ambulacra which form a rosette on the black of certain Echini.

duality.definition: The quality or condition of being two or twofold; dual character or usage.

exchanger.definition: One who exchanges; one who practices exchange. Matt.

lithofracteur.definition: An explosive compound of nitroglycerin. See Nitroglycerin.

muffler.definition: Anything used in muffling; esp., a scarf for protecting the head and neck in cold weather; a tippet. Fortune is painted blind, with a muffler above her eyes. Shak. 2. (Mus.)  A cushion for terminating or softening a note made by a stringed instrument with a keyboard. 3. A kind of mitten or boxing gl.

outscout.definition: To overpower by disdain; to outface. Marston.

deerhound.definition: One of a large and fleet breed of hounds used in hunting deer; a staghound.

retraxit.definition: The withdrawing, or open renunciation, of a suit in court by the plaintiff, by which he forever lost his right of action. Blackstone.

talus.definition:
(Anat.)  The astragalus. 2. (Surg.)  A variety of clubfoot (Talipes calcaneus). See the Note under Talipes.

1. (Fort.)  A slope; the inclination of the face of a work. 2. (Geol.)  A sloping heap of fragments of rock lying at the foot of a precipice.

phloroglucin.definition: A sweet white crystalline substance, metameric with pyrogallol, and obtained by the decomposition of phloretin, and from certain gums, as catechu, kino, etc. It belongs to the class of phenols. [Called also phloroglucinol.].

sporogony.definition: The growth or development of an animal or a zooid from a nonsexual germ.

remord.definition:
To excite to remorse; to rebuke. Skelton.

To feel remorse. Sir T. Elyot.

theorbo.definition: An instrument made like large lute, but having two necks, with two sets of pegs, the lower set holding the strings governed by frets, while to the upper set were attached the long bass strings used as open notes. Note: A larger form of theorbo was also called the archlute, and was used chiefly, if n.

magnoliaceous.definition: Pertaining to a natural order (Magnoliaceæ) of trees of which the magnolia, the tulip tree, and the star anise are examples.

deliverer.definition: One who delivers or rescues; a preserver. 2. One who relates or communicates.

pinxit.definition: A word appended to the artist's name or initials on a painting, or engraved copy of a painting; as, Rubens pinxit, Rubens painted (this).

hewhole.definition: The European green woodpecker. See Yaffle.

deific.definition: Making divine; producing a likeness to God; god-making. "A deifical communion." Homilies.

gala.definition: Pomp, show, or festivity. Macaulay. Gala day, a day of mirth and festivity; a holiday.

smoother.definition: One who, or that which, smooths.

high-strung.definition: Strung to a high pitch; spirited; sensitive; as, a high-strung horse.

trilobite.definition: Any one of numerous species of extinct arthropods belonging to the order Trilobita. Trilobites were very common in the Silurian and Devonian periods, but became extinct at the close of the Paleozoic. So named from the three lobes usually seen on each segment.

catstitch.definition: To fold and sew down the edge of with a coarse zigzag stitch.

counterwork.definition: To work in oppositeion to; to counteract. That counterworksh folly and caprice. Pope.

pedireme.definition: A crustacean, some of whose feet serve as oars.

advocateship.definition: Office or duty of an advocate.

execrate.definition: To denounce evil against, or to imprecate evil upon; to curse; to protest against as unholy or detestable; hence, to detest utterly; to abhor; to abominate. "They . . . execrate their lct." Cowper.

papalize.definition:
To make papal.

To conform to popery. Cowper.

flaccid.definition: Yielding to pressure for want of firmness and stiffness; soft and weak; limber; lax; drooping; flabby; as, a flaccid muscle; flaccid flesh. Religious profession . . . has become flacced. I. Taylor. -- Flac"cid*ly, adv. -- Flac"cid*ness, n.

ideation.definition: The faculty or capacity of the mind for forming ideas; the exercise of this capacity; the act of the mind by which objects of sense are apprehended and retained as objects of thought. The whole mass of residua which have been accumulated . . . all enter now into the process of ideation. J. D. Morell.

chariot.definition:
(Antiq.)  A two-wheeled car or vehicle for war, racing, state processions, etc. First moved the chariots, after whom the foot. Cowper. 2. A four-wheeled pleasure or state carriage, having one seat. Shak.

To convey in a chariot. Milton.

militia.definition: In the widest sense, the whole military force of a nation, including both those engaged in military service as a business, and those competent and available for such service; specifically, the body of citizens enrolled for military instruction and discipline, but not subject to be called into actual.

organology.definition: The science of organs or of anything considered as an organic structure. The science of style, as an organ of thought, of style in relation to the ideas and feelings, might be called the organology of style. De Quincey. 2. That branch of biology which treats, in particular, of the organs of animals.

underplot.definition: A series of events in a play, proceeding collaterally with the main story, and subservient to it. Dryden. 2. A clandestine scheme; a trick. Addison.

galvanoscope.definition: An instrument or apparatus for detecting the presence of electrical currents, especially such as are of feeble intensity.

saccharomyces.definition: A genus of budding fungi, the various species of which have the power, to a greater or less extent, or splitting up sugar into alcohol and carbonic acid. They are the active agents in producing fermentation of wine, beer, etc. Saccharomyces cerevisiæ is the yeast of sedimentary beer. Also called Tor.

paradisiac.definition: Of or pertaining to paradise; suitable to, or like, paradise. C. Kingsley. T. Burnet. "A paradisiacal scene." Pope. The valley . . . is of quite paradisiac beauty. G. Eliot.

erinaceous.definition: Of the Hedgehog family; like, or characteristic of, a hedgehog.

wattless.definition: Without any power (cf. Watt); -- said of an alternating current or component of current when it differs in phase by ninety degrees from the electromotive force which produces it, or of an electromotive force or component thereof when the current it produces differs from it in phase by 90 degrees.

exsiccate.definition: To exhaust or evaporate moisture from; to dry up. Sir T. Browne.

osteoplastic.definition: (Physiol.)  Producing bone; as, osteoplastic cells. 2. (Med.)  Of or pertaining to the replacement of bone; as, an osteoplastic operation.

intern.definition:
Internal. Howell.

To put for safe keeping in the interior of a place or country; to confine to one locality; as, to intern troops which have fled for refuge to a neutral country.

inscription.definition: The act or process of inscribing. 2. That which is inscribed; something written or engraved; especially, a word or words written or engraved on a solid substance for preservation or public inspection; as, inscriptions on monuments, pillars, coins, medals, etc. 3. (Anat.)  A line of division or inter.

coromandel.definition: The west coast, or a portion of the west coast, of the Bay of Bengal. Coromandel gooseberry. See Carambola. -- Coromandel wood, Calamander wood.

heptarchic.definition: Of or pertaining to a heptarchy; constituting or consisting of a heptarchy. T. Warton.

agouty.definition: A rodent of the genus Dasyprocta, about the size of a rabbit, peculiar to South America and the West Indies. The most common species is the Dasyprocta agouti.

denotable.definition: Capable of being denoted or marked. Sir T. Browne.

palo.definition: A pole or timber of any kind; -- in the names of trees. [Sp. Amer.].

alburnum.definition: The white and softer part of wood, between the inner bark and the hard wood or duramen; sapwood.

zanyism.definition: State or character of a zany; buffoonery. Coleridge. H. Morley.

pinafore.definition: An apron for a child to protect the front part of dress; a tier.

embellish.definition: To make beautiful or elegant by ornaments; to decorate; to adorn; as, to embellish a book with pictures, a garden with shrubs and flowers, a narrative with striking anecdotes, or style with metaphors. Syn. -- To adorn; beautify; deck; bedeck; decorate; garnish; enrich; ornament; illustrate. See Ador.

darkly.definition: With imperfect light, clearness, or knowledge; obscurely; dimly; blindly; uncertainly. What fame to future times conveys but darkly down. Dryden. so softly dark and darkly pure. Byron. 2. With a dark, gloomy, cruel, or menacing look. Looking darkly at the clerguman. Hawthorne.

chaffy.definition: Abounding in, or resembling, chaff. Chaffy grain beneath the thresher's flail. Coleridge. 2. Light or worthless as chaff. Slight and chaffy opinion. Glanvill. 3. (Bot.) (a) Resembling chaff; composed of light dry scales. (b) Bearing or covered with dry scales, as the under surface of certain ferns,.

recapitulatory.definition: Of the nature of a recapitulation; containing recapitulation.

whacker.definition: One who whacks. 2. Anything very large; specif., a great lie; a whapper. Halliwell.

bedlamite.definition: An inhabitant of a madhouse; a madman. "Raving bedlamites." Beattie.

doggish.definition: Like a dog; having the bad qualities of a dog; churlish; growling; brutal. -- Dog"*gish*ly, adv. -- Dog"gish*ness, n.

overflow.definition:
To flow over; to cover woth, or as with, water or other fluid; to spread over; to inundate; to overwhelm. The northern nations overflowed all Christendom. Spenser. 2. To flow over the brim of; to fill more than full.

1. To run over the bounds. 2. To be superabundant; to abound. Rogers.

1. A flowin.

affreightment.definition: The act of hiring, or the contract for the use of, a vessel, or some part of it, to convey cargo.

phlebogram.definition: A tracing (with the sphygmograph) of the movements of a vein, or of the venous pulse.

indiscrete.definition: Indiscreet. Boyle. 2. Not discrete or separated; compact; homogenous. An indiscrete mass of confused matter. Pownall.

hymnic.definition: Relating to hymns, or sacred lyrics. Donne.

godmother.definition: A woman who becomes sponsor for a child in baptism. See Godfather.

mechanicalness.definition: The state or quality of being mechanical.

weighage.definition: A duty or toil paid for weighing merchandise. Bouvier.

tenantry.definition: The body of tenants; as, the tenantry of a manor or a kingdom. 2. Tenancy. Ridley.

peasweep.definition: (a) The pewit, or lapwing. (b) The greenfinch.

polymerous.definition: (Bot.)  Having many parts or members in each set. Gray. 2. (Chem.)  Polymeric.

bifoliolate.definition: Having two leaflets, as some compound leaves.

decubation.definition: Act of lying down; decumbence. Evelyn.

resend.definition: To send again; as, to resend a message. 2. To send back; as, to resend a gift. Shak. 3. (Telegraphy)  To send on from an intermediate station by means of a repeater.

pimaric.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid found in galipot, and isomeric with abietic acid.

misprofess.definition:
To make a false profession; to make pretensions to skill which is not possessed.

To make a false profession of.

procurator.definition: (Law)  One who manages another's affairs, either generally or in a special matter; an agent; a proctor. Chaucer. Shak. 2. (Rom. Antiq.)  A governor of a province under the emperors; also, one who had charge of the imperial revenues in a province; as, the procurator of Judea. Procurator fiscal (Scots.

grommet.definition: A ring formed by twisting on itself a single strand of an unlaid rope; also, a metallic eyelet in or for a sail or a mailbag. Sometimes written grummet. 2. (Mil.)  A ring of rope used as a wad to hold a cannon ball in place.

magistrally.definition: In a magistral manner. Abp. Bramhall.

aniline.definition: An organic base belonging to the phenylamines. It may be regarded as ammonia in which one hydrogen atom has been replaced by the radical phenyl. It is a colorless, oily liquid, originally obtained from indigo by distillation, but now largely manufactured from coal tar or nitrobenzene as a base from.

unweeting.definition: Unwitting. Chaucer. Spenser. -- Un*weet"ing*ly, adv. Milton.

lacustral.definition: Found in, or pertaining to, lakes or ponds, or growing in them; as, lacustrine flowers. Lacustrine deposits (Geol.), the deposits which have been accumulated in fresh-water areas. -- Lacustrine dwellings. See Lake dwellings, under Lake.

yautia.definition: In Porto Rico, any of several araceous plants or their starchy edible roots, which are cooked and eaten like yams or potatoes, as the taro.

hard-tack.definition: A name given by soldiers and sailors to a kind of hard biscuit or sea bread.

latinistic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or derived from, Latin; in the Latin style or idiom. "Latinistic words." Fitzed. Hall.

outrode.definition: An excursion. "Outrodes by the ways of Judea." Macc. xv. 41 (Geneva Bible).

helicin.definition: A glucoside obtained as a white crystalline substance by partial oxidation of salicin, from a willow (Salix Helix of Linnæus.).

hearted.definition: Having a heart; having (such) a heart (regarded as the seat of the affections, disposition, or character). 2. Shaped like a heart; cordate. Landor. 3. Seated or laid up in the heart. I hate the Moor: my cause is hearted. Shak. Note: This word is chiefly used in composition; as, hard-hearted, faint-h.

curcumin.definition: The coloring principle of turmeric, or curcuma root, extracted as an orange yellow crystalline substance, C14H14O4, with a green fluorescence. Note: It possesses acid properties and with alkalies forms brownish salts. This change in color from yellow to brown is the characteristic reaction of tumeri.

aggrieve.definition:
To give pain or sorrow to; to afflict; hence, to oppress or injure in one's rights; to bear heavily upon; -- now commonly used in the passive TO be aggrieved. Aggrieved by oppression and extortion. Macaulay.

To grieve; to lament.

dispose.definition: To distribute and put in place; to arrange; to set in order; as, to dispose the ships in the form of a crescent. Who hath disposed the whole world Job xxxiv. 13. All ranged in order and disposed with grace. Pope. The rest themselves in troops did else dispose. Spenser. 2. To regulate; to adjust; to.

throttler.definition: One who, or that which, throttles, or chokes. 2. (Zoöl.)  See Flasher, 3 (b).

marvelousness.definition: The quality or state of being marvelous; wonderfulness; strangeness.

cambrasine.definition: A kind of linen cloth made in Egypt, and so named from its resemblance to cambric.

overnice.definition: Excessively nice; fastidious. Bp. Hall. -- O"ver*nice"ly, adv. -- O"ver*nice"ness, n.

neptune.definition: (Rom. Myth.)  The son of Saturn and Ops, the god of the waters, especially of the sea. He is represented as bearing a trident for a scepter. 2. (Astron.)  The remotest known planet of our system, discovered -- as a result of the computations of Leverrier, of Paris -- by Galle, of Berlin, September 2.

feminity.definition: Womanliness; femininity. "Trained up in true feminity." Spenser.

forwards.definition:
Toward a part or place before or in front; onward; in advance; progressively; -- opposed to backward.

Same as Forward.

shoaliness.definition: The quality or state of being shoaly; little depth of water; shallowness.

profiling.definition: In the construction of fieldworks, the erection at proper intervals of wooden profiles, to show to the workmen the sectional form of the parapets at those points.

manzanita.definition: A name given to several species of Arctostaphylos, but mostly to A. glauca and A. pungens, shrubs of California, Oregon, etc., with reddish smooth bark, ovate or oval coriaceous evergreen leaves, and bearing clusters of red berries, which are said to be a favorite food of the grizzly bear.

obstriction.definition: The state of being constrained, bound, or obliged; that which constrains or obliges; obligation; bond. Milton.

zirconium.definition: A rare element of the carbon-silicon group, intermediate between the metals and nonmetals, obtained from the mineral zircon as a dark sooty powder, or as a gray metallic crystalline substance. Symbol Zr. Atomic weight, 90.4.

chandelier.definition: A candlestick, lamp, stand, gas fixture, or the like, having several branches; esp., one hanging from the ceiling. 2. (Fort.)  A movable parapet, serving to support fascines to cover pioneers.

xenyl.definition: The radical characteristic of xenylic compounds.

chairmanship.definition: The office of a chairman of a meeting or organized body.

symphyseal.definition: Of or pertaining to to symphysis.

rung.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Ring.

1. (Shipbuilding)  A floor timber in a ship. 2. One of the rounds of a ladder. 3. One of the stakes of a cart; a spar; a heavy staff. 4. (Mach.)  One of the radial handles projecting from the rim of a steering wheel; also, one of the pins or trundles of a lantern wheel.

puberty.definition: The earliest age at which persons are capable of begetting or bearing children, usually considered, in temperate climates, to be about fourteen years in males and twelve in females. 2. (Bot.)  The period when a plant first bears flowers.

ragman.definition:
A man who collects, or deals in, rags.

A document having many names or numerous seals, as a papal bull. Piers Plowman. RAGMAN'S ROLL Rag"man's roll`. Etym: [For ragman roll a long list of names, the devil's roll or list; where ragman is of Scand. origin; cf. Icel. ragmenni a craven person, Sw. ragg.

iambic.definition:
(Pros.)  Consisting of a short syllable followed by a long one, or of an unaccented syllable followed by an accented; as, an iambic foot. 2. Pertaining to, or composed of, iambics; as, an iambic verse; iambic meter. See Lambus.

1. (Pros.) (a) An iambic foot; an iambus. (b) A verse composed of iambi.

laconism.definition: A vigorous, brief manner of expression; laconic style. 2. An instance of laconic style or expression.

petaled.definition: Having petals; as, a petaled flower; -- opposed to Ant: apetalous, and much used in compounds; as, one-petaled, three- petaled, etc.

trigynous.definition: Having three pistils or styles; of or pertaining to the Trigynia.

lapper.definition: One who takes up food or liquid with his tongue.

unconditional.definition: Not conditional limited, or conditioned; made without condition; absolute; unreserved; as, an unconditional surrender. O, pass not, Lord, an absolute decree, Or bind thy sentence unconditional. Dryden. -- Un`con*di"tion*al*ly, adv.

vole.definition:
A deal at cards that draws all the tricks. Swift.

To win all the tricks by a vole. Pope.

Any one of numerous species of micelike rodents belonging to Arvicola and allied genera of the subfamily Arvicolinæ. They have a thick head, short ears, and a short hairy tail. Note: The water vole, or water r.

pipette.definition: A small glass tube, often with an enlargement or bulb in the middle, and usually graduated, -- used for transferring or delivering measured quantities.

stundist.definition: One of a large sect of Russian dissenters founded, about 1860, in the village of Osnova, near Odessa, by a peasant, Onishchenko, who had apparently been influenced by a German sect settled near there. They zealously practice Bible reading and reject priestly dominion and all external rites of worshi.

enneaspermous.definition: Having nine seeds; -- said of fruits.

augurous.definition: Full of augury; foreboding. "Augurous hearts." Chapman.

dramatical.definition: Of or pertaining to the drama; appropriate to, or having the qualities of, a drama; theatrical; vivid. The emperor . . . performed his part with much dramatic effect. Motley.

sedged.definition: Made or composed of sedge. With your sedged crowns and ever-harmless looks. Shak.

frostiness.definition: State or quality of being frosty.

tockay.definition: A spotted lizard native of India.

hyperbaton.definition: A figurative construction, changing or inverting the natural order of words or clauses; as, "echoed the hills" for "the hills echoed." With a violent hyperbaton to transpose the text. Milton.

perimetrical.definition: Of or pertaining to the perimeter, or to perimetry; as, a perimetric chart of the eye.

annul.definition: To reduce to nothing; to obliterate. Light, the prime work of God, to me's extinct. And all her various objects of delight Annulled. Milton. 2. To make void or of no effect; to nullify; to abolish; to do away with; -- used appropriately of laws, decrees, edicts, decisions of courts, or other establi.

dotish.definition: Foolish; weak; imbecile. Sir W. Scott.

ramble.definition: To walk, ride, or sail, from place to place, without any determinate object in view; to roam carelessly or irregularly; to rove; to wander; as, to ramble about the city; to ramble over the world. He that is at liberty to ramble in perfect darkness, what is his liberty better than if driven up and do.

forehearth.definition: The forward extension of the hearth of a blast furnace under the tymp.

gemel.definition:
Coupled; paired. Bars gemel (Her.), two barrulets placed near and parallel to each other.

1. One of the twins. Wyclif. 2. (Heb.)  One of the barrulets placed parallel and closed to each other. Cf. Bars gemel, under Gemel, a. Two gemels silver between two griffins passant. Strype. Gemel hinge (Locks.

diorite.definition: An igneous, crystalline in structure, consisting essentially of a triclinic feldspar and hornblende. It includes part of what was called greenstone.

fruitage.definition: Fruit, collectively; fruit, in general; fruitery. The trees . . . ambrosial fruitage bear. Milton. 2. Product or result of any action; effect, good or ill.

inferable.definition: Capable of being inferred or deduced from premises. [Written also inferrible.] H. Spencer. A sufficient argument . . . is inferable from these premises. Burke.

polynomial.definition:
An expression composed of two or more terms, connected by the signs plus or minus; as, a2 - 2ab + b2.

1. Containing many names or terms; multinominal; as, the polynomial theorem. 2. Consisting of two or more words; having names consisting of two or more words; as, a polynomial name; polynomial nome.

ectrotic.definition: Having a tendency to prevent the development of anything, especially of a disease.

whereinto.definition: Into which; -- used relatively. Where is that palace whereinto foul things Sometimes intrude not Shak. The brook, whereinto he loved to look. Emerson. 2. Into what; -- used interrogatively.

underboard.definition: Under the board, or table; hence, secretly; unfairly; underhand. See the Note under Aboveboard.

teest.definition: A tinsmith's stake, or small anvil.

apsidal.definition: (Astron.)  Of or pertaining to the apsides of an orbit. 2. (Arch.)  Of or pertaining to the apse of a church; as, the apsidal termination of the chancel.

self-action.definition: Action by, or originating in, one's self or itself.

waitress.definition: A female waiter or attendant; a waiting maid or waiting woman.

magpie.definition: Any one of numerous species of the genus Pica and related genera, allied to the jays, but having a long graduated tail. Note: The common European magpie (Pica pica, or P. caudata) is a black and white noisy and mischievous bird. It can be taught to speak. The American magpie (P. Hudsonica) is very s.

trumpets.definition: A plant (Sarracenia flava) with long, hollow leaves.

unlawful.definition: Not lawful; contrary to law. -- Un*law"ful*ly, adv. -- Un*law"ful*ness, n. Unlawful assembly. (Law) See under Assembly.

droll.definition: Queer, and fitted to provoke laughter; ludicrous from oddity; amusing and strange. Syn. -- Comic; comical; farcical; diverting; humorous; ridiculous; queer; odd; waggish; facetious; merry; laughable; ludicrous. -- Droll, Laughable, Comical. Laughable is the generic term, denoting anything exciting l.

serio-comic.definition: Having a mixture of seriousness and sport; serious and comical.

sanation.definition: The act of healing or curing. Wiseman.

permittee.definition: One to whom a permission or permit is given.

sippet.definition: A small sop; a small, thin piece of toasted bread soaked in milk, broth, or the like; a small piece of toasted or fried bread cut into some special shape and used for garnishing. Your sweet sippets in widows' houses. Milton.

self-dependent.definition: Dependent on one's self; self-depending; self-reliant.

succulent.definition: Full of juice; juicy. Succulent plants (Bot.), plants which have soft and juicy leaves or stems, as the houseleek, the live forever, and the species of Mesembryanthemum.

strainable.definition: Capable of being strained. 2. Violent in action. Holinshed.

stingo.definition: Old beer; sharp or strong liquor. [Old Slang] Shall I set a cup of old stingo at your elbow Addison.

irresolute.definition: Not resolute; not decided or determined; wavering; given to doubt or irresolution. Weak and irresolute is man. Cowper. Syn. -- Wavering; vacillating; undetermined; undecided; unsettled; fickle; changeable; inconstant. -- Ir*res"o*lute*ly, adv. -- Ir*res"o*lute*ness, n.

broccoli.definition: A plant of the Cabbage species (Brassica oleracea) of many varieties, resembling the cauliflower. The "curd," or flowering head, is the part used for food.

scutibranchiate.definition: Having the gills protected by a shieldlike shell; of or pertaining to the Scutibranchiata. -- n.  One of the Scutibranchiata.

burglarious.definition: Pertaining to burglary; constituting the crime of burglary. To come down a chimney is held a burglarious entry. Blackstone.

disenroll.definition: To erase from a roll or list. [Written also disenrol.] Donne.

breastplough.definition: A kind of plow, driven by the breast of the workman; -- used to cut or pare turf.

oostegite.definition: One of the plates which in some Crustacea inclose a cavity wherein the eggs are hatched.

browbound.definition: Crowned; having the head encircled as with a diadem. Shak.

intermittingly.definition: With intermissions; at intervals. W. Montagu.

metallist.definition: A worker in metals, or one skilled in metals.

kike.definition:
To gaze; to stare. Chaucer.

To kick Chaucer.

barillet.definition: A little cask, or something resembling one. Smart.

bergmeal.definition: (Min.) An earthy substance, resembling fine flour. It is composed of the shells of infusoria, and in Lapland and Sweden is sometimes eaten, mixed with flour or ground birch bark, in times of scarcity. This name is also given to a white powdery variety of calcite.

aurelia.definition: (a) The chrysalis, or pupa of an insect, esp. when reflecting a brilliant golden color, as that of some of the butterflies. (b) A genus of jellyfishes. See Discophora.

expugnation.definition: The act of taking by assault; conquest. Sandys.

polymorphous.definition: Having, or assuming, a variety of forms, characters, or styles; as, a polymorphous author. De Quincey. 2. (Biol.)  Having, or occurring in, several distinct forms; -- opposed to monomorphic.

humorist.definition: (Med.)  One who attributes diseases of the state of the humors. 2. One who has some peculiarity or eccentricity of character, which he indulges in odd or whimsical ways. He [Roger de Coverley] . . . was a great humorist in all parts of his life. Addison. 3. One who displays humor in speaking or writ.

scarn.definition: Dung. [Obs. or Prov. Eng.] Ray. Scarn bee (Zoöl.), a dung beetle.

juneating.definition: A kind of early apple. [Written also jenneting.].

notionist.definition: One whose opinions are ungrounded notions. Bp. Hopkins.

glowworm.definition: A coleopterous insect of the genus Lampyris; esp., the wingless females and larvæ of the two European species (L. noctiluca, and L. splendidula), which emit light from some of the abdominal segments. Like a glowworm in the night, The which hath fire in darkness, none in light. Shak. Note: The male i.

subcultrated.definition: Having a form resembling that of a colter, or straight on one side and curved on the other.

sketch.definition: An outline or general delineation of anything; a first rough or incomplete draught or plan of any design; especially, in the fine arts, such a representation of an object or scene as serves the artist's purpose by recording its chief features; also, a preliminary study for an original work. Syn. --.

epiphyllous.definition: Growing upon, or inserted into, the leaf.

umbrage.definition: Shade; shadow; obscurity; hence, that which affords a shade, as a screen of trees or foliage. Where highest woods, impenetrable To star or sunlight, spread their umbrage broad. Milton. 2. Shadowy resemblance; shadow. The opinion carries no show of truth nor umbrage of reason on its side. Woodward. 3.

virtu.definition: A love of the fine arts; a taste for curiosities. J. Spence. An article, or piece, of virtu, an object of art or antiquity; a curiosity, such as those found in museums or private collections. I had thoughts, in my chambers to place it in view, To be shown to my friends as a piece of virtù. Goldsmith.

bencher.definition: (Eng. Law)  One of the senior and governing members of an Inn of Court. 2. An alderman of a corporation. [Eng.] Ashmole. 3. A member of a court or council. Shak. 4. One who frequents the benches of a tavern; an idler.

palatopterygoid.definition: Pertaining to the palatine and pterygoid region of the skull; as, the palatopterygoid cartilage, or rod, from which the palatine and pterygoid bones are developed.

mullet.definition: (Zoöl.)  Any one of numerous fishes of the genus Mugil; -- called also gray mullets. They are found on the coasts of both continents, and are highly esteemed as food. Among the most valuable species are Mugil capito of Europe, and M. cephalus which occurs both on the European and American coasts. 2.

anatropous.definition: Having the ovule inverted at an early period in its development, so that the chalaza is as the apparent apex; -- opposed to orthotropous. Gray.

lactucone.definition: A white, crystalline, tasteless substance, found in the milky sap of species of Lactuca, and constituting an essential ingredient of lactucarium.

zymology.definition: A treatise on the fermentation of liquors, or the doctrine of fermentation. [Written also zumology.].

crabeater.definition: (a) The cobia. (b) An etheostomoid fish of the southern United States (Hadropterus nigrofasciatus). (c) A small European heron (Ardea minuta, and other allied species).

midrash.definition: A talmudic exposition of the Hebrew law, or of some part of it.

neighborship.definition: The state of being neighbors. J. Bailie.

deave.definition: To stun or stupefy with noise; to deafen. [Scot.].

danubian.definition: Pertainingto, or bordering on, the river Danube.

flurry.definition: A sudden and brief blast or gust; a light, temporary breeze; as, a flurry of wind. 2. A light shower or snowfall accompanied with wind. Like a flurry of snow on the whistling wind. Longfellow. 3. Violent agitation; commotion; bustle; hurry. The racket and flurry of London. Blakw. Mag. 4. The violent.

salvo.definition:
An exception; a reservation; an excuse. They admit many salvos, cautions, and reservations. Eilon Basilike.

1. (Mil.)  A concentrated fire from pieces of artillery, as in endeavoring to make a break in a fortification; a volley. 2. A salute paid by a simultaneous, or nearly simultaneous, firing of.

monomachia.definition: A duel; single combat. "The duello or monomachia." Sir W. Scott.

seaboat.definition: A boat or vessel adapted to the open sea; hence, a vessel considered with reference to her power of resisting a storm, or maintaining herself in a heavy sea; as, a good sea boat. 2. (Zoöl.)  A chitin.

hern.definition: A heron; esp., the common European heron. "A stately hern." Trench.

agistor.definition: (a) Formerly, an officer of the king's forest, who had the care of cattle agisted, and collected the money for the same; -- hence called gisttaker, which in England is corrupted into guest-taker. (b) Now, one who agists or takes in cattle to pasture at a certain rate; a pasturer. Mozley & W.

paneless.definition: Without panes. To patch his paneless window. Shenstone.

corse.definition: A living body or its bulk. For he was strong, and of so mighty corse As ever wielded spear in warlike hand. Spenser. 2. A corpse; the dead body of a human being. [Archaic or Poetic] Set down the corse; or, by Saint Paul, I'll make a corse of him that disobeys. Shak.

vavasor.definition: The vassal or tenant of a baron; one who held under a baron, and who also had tenants under him; one in dignity next to a baron; a title of dignity next to a baron. Burrill. "A worthy vavasour." Chaucer. [Also written vavasour, vavassor, valvasor, etc.] Vavasours subdivide again to vassals, exchangi.

arvicole.definition: A mouse of the genus Arvicola; the meadow mouse. There are many species.

nuptial.definition:
Of or pertaining to marriage; done or used at a wedding; as, nuptial rites and ceremonies. Then, all in heat, They light the nuptial torch. Milton.

Marriage; wedding; nuptial ceremony; -- now only in the plural. Celebration of that nuptial, which We two have sworn shall come. Shak. Preparations . .

mordicant.definition: Biting; acrid; as, the mordicant quality of a body. Boyle.

sappy.definition:
Abounding with sap; full of sap; juisy; succulent. 2. Hence, young, not firm; weak, feeble. When he had passed this weak and sapy age. Hayward. 3. Weak in intellect. [Low] 4. (Bot.)  Abounding in sap; resembling, or consisting lagerly of, sapwood.

Musty; tainted.

fatiscence.definition: A gaping or opening; state of being chinky, or having apertures. Kirwan.

explicative.definition: Serving to unfold or explain; tending to lay open to the understanding; explanatory. Sir W. Hamilton.

cudden.definition: A clown; a low rustic; a dolt. The slavering cudden, propped upon his staff. Dryden. 2. (Zoöl.)  The coalfish. See 3d Cuddy.

seg.definition:
Sedge. 2. The gladen, and other species of Iris. Prior.

A castrated bull. [Prov. Eng. & Scot.] Halliwell.

tensile.definition: Of or pertaining to extension; as, tensile strength. 2. Capable of extension; ductile; tensible. Bacon.

zoological.definition: Of or pertaining to zoölogy, or the science of animals.

quietness.definition: The quality or state of being quiet; freedom from noise, agitation, disturbance, or excitement; stillness; tranquillity; calmness. I would have peace and quietness. Shak.

disunionist.definition: An advocate of disunion, specifically, of disunion of the United States.

immiscibility.definition: Incapability of being mixed, or mingled.

dartos.definition: A thin layer of peculiar contractile tissue directly beneath the skin of the scrotum.

escalade.definition:
A furious attack made by troops on a fortified place, in which ladders are used to pass a ditch or mount a rampart. Sin enters, not by escalade, but by cunning or treachery. Buckminster.

To mount and pass or enter by means of ladders; to scale; as, to escalate a wall.

repugnant.definition: Disposed to fight against; hostile; at war with; being at variance; contrary; inconsistent; refractory; disobedient; also, distasteful in a high degree; offensive; -- usually followed by to, rarely and less properly by with; as, all rudeness was repugnant to her nature. [His sword] repugnant to comm.

verst.definition: A Russian measure of length containing 3,500 English feet. [Written also werst.].

fluocerine.definition: A fluoride of cerium, occuring near Fahlun in Sweden. Tynosite, from Colorado, is probably the same mineral.

kirkman.definition: A clergyman or officer in a kirk. [Scot.] 2. A member of the Church of Scotland, as distinguished from a member of another communion. [Scot.].

omahas.definition: A tribe of Indians who inhabited the south side of the Missouri River. They are now partly civilized and occupy a reservation in Nebraska.

immobilize.definition: To make immovable; in surgery, to make immovable (a naturally mobile part, as a joint) by the use of splints, or stiffened bandages.

fleck.definition:
A flake; also, a lock, as of wool. J. Martin.

A spot; a streak; a speckle. "A sunny fleck." Longfellow. Life is dashed with flecks of sin. tennyson.

To spot; to streak or stripe; to variegate; to dapple. Both flecked with white, the true Arcadian strain. Dryden. A bird, a cloud, flecking the sunny.

solacious.definition: Affording solace; as, a solacious voice. Bale.

ranal.definition: Having a general affinity to ranunculaceous plants. Ranal alliance (Bot.), a name proposed by Lindley for a group of natural orders, including Ranunculaceæ, Magnoliaceæ, Papaveraceæ, and others related to them.

hake.definition:
A drying shed, as for unburned tile.

One of several species of marine gadoid fishes, of the genera Phycis, Merlucius, and allies. The common European hake is M. vulgaris; the American silver hake or whiting is M. bilinearis. Two American species (Phycis chuss and P. tenius) are important food fishe.

lovable.definition: Having qualities that excite, or are fitted to excite, love; worthy of love. Elaine the fair, Elaine the lovable, Elaine, the lily maid of Astolat. Tennyson.

sanitarian.definition:
Of or pertaining to health, or the laws of health; sanitary.

An advocate of sanitary measures; one especially interested or versed in sanitary measures.

culvert.definition: A transverse drain or waterway of masonry under a road, railroad, canal, etc.; a small bridge.

forold.definition: Very old. A bear's skin, coal-black, forold. Chaucer.

parament.definition: Ornamental hangings, furniture, etc., as of a state apartment; rich and elegant robes worn by men of rank; -- chiefly in the plural. Lords in paraments on their coursers. Chaucer. Chamber of paraments, presence chamber of a monarch.

unspeakable.definition: Not speakable; incapable of being uttered or adequately described; inexpressible; unutterable; ineffable; as, unspeakable grief or rage. -- Un*speak"a*bly, adv. Ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory. 1 Pet. i. 8.

roust.definition:
To rouse; to disturb; as, to roust one out. [Prov. Eng. & Local, U.S.]

A strong tide or current, especially in a narrow channel. [Written also rost, and roost.] Jamieson.

seaward.definition:
Directed or situated toward the sea. Donne. Two still clouds . . . sparkled on their seaward edges like a frosted fleece. G. W. Cable.

Toward the sea. Drayton.

dysphonia.definition: A difficulty in producing vocal sounds; enfeebled or depraved voice.

incompressibility.definition: The quality of being incompressible, or incapable of reduction in volume by pressure; -- formerly supposed to be a property of liquids. The incompressibility of water is not absolute. Rees.

whorled.definition: Furnished with whorls; arranged in the form of a whorl or whorls; verticillate; as, whorled leaves.

fluoboric.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or consisting of, fluorine and boron. Fluoridic acid (Chem.), a double fluoride, consisting essentially of a solution of boron fluoride, in hydrofluoric acid. It has strong acid properties, and is the type of the borofluorides. Called also borofluoric acid.

relict.definition: A woman whose husband is dead; a widow. Eli dying without issue, Jacob was obbliged by law to marry his relict, and so to raise up seed to his brother Eli. South.

hummel.definition:
To separate from the awns; -- said of barley. [Scot.]

Having no awns or no horns; as, hummelcorn; a hummel cow. [Scot.].

bisulcate.definition: Having two grooves or furrows. 2. (Zoöl.)  Cloven; said of a foot or hoof.

rememoration.definition: A recalling by the faculty of memory; remembrance. [Obs. & R.] Bp. Montagu.

torquated.definition: Having or wearing a torque, or neck chain.

darksome.definition: Dark; gloomy; obscure; shaded; cheerless. [Poetic] He brought him through a darksome narrow pass To a broad gate, all built of beaten gold. Spenser.

palter.definition: To haggle. Cotgrave. 2. To act in insincere or deceitful manner; to play false; to equivocate; to shift; to dodge; to trifle. Romans, that have spoke the word, And will not palter. Shak. Who never sold the truth to serve the hour, Nor paltered with eternal God for power. Tennyson. 3. To babble; to c.

town-crier.definition: A town officer who makes proclamations to the people; the public crier of a town.

terebra.definition: (Zoöl.)  A genus of marine gastropods having a long, tapering spire. They belong to the Toxoglossa. Called also auger shell. 2. (Zoöl.)  The boring ovipositor of a hymenopterous insect.

grantor.definition: The person by whom a grant or conveyance is made.

autogenous.definition: (Biol.)  Self-generated; produced independently. 2. (Anat.)  Developed from an independent center of ossification. Owen. Autogenous soldering, the junction by fusion of the joining edges of metals without the intervention of solder.

beleper.definition: To infect with leprosy. Beau. & Fl.

separatrix.definition: The decimal point; the dot placed at the left of a decimal fraction, to separate it from the whole number which it follows. The term is sometimes also applied to other marks of separation.

amidships.definition: In the middle of a ship, with regard to her length, and sometimes also her breadth. Totten.

undersky.definition: The lower region of the sky. Floating about the undersky. Tennyson.

cambria.definition: The ancient Latin name of Wales. It is used by modern poets.

alated.definition: Winged; having wings, or side appendages like wings.

pseudo-cone.definition: One of the soft gelatinous cones found in the compound eyes of certain insects, taking the place of the crystalline cones of others.

cachiri.definition: A fermented liquor made in Cayenne from the grated root of the manioc, and resembling perry. Dunglison.

integumentation.definition: The act or process of covering with integuments; the state or manner of being thus covered.

bracteal.definition: Having the nature or appearance of a bract.

bonify.definition: To convert into, or make, good. To bonify evils, or tincture them with good. Cudworth.

striation.definition: The quality or condition of being striated. 2. A stria; as, the striations on a shell.

shred.definition:
A long, narrow piece cut or torn off; a strip. "Shreds of tanned leather." Bacon. 2. In general, a fragment; a piece; a particle. Shak.

1. To cut or tear into small pieces, particularly narrow and long pieces, as of cloth or leather. Chaucer. 2. To lop; to prune; to trim.

necrose.definition: To affect with necrosis; to unergo necrosis. Quain.

downhill.definition:
Towards the bottom of a hill; as, water runs downhill.

Declivous; descending; sloping. "A downhill greensward." Congrewe.

Declivity; descent; slope. On th' icy downhills of this slippery life. Du Bartas (Trans. ).

valvate.definition: Resembling, or serving as, a valve; consisting of, or opening by, a valve or valves; valvular. 2. (Bot.) (a) Meeting at the edges without overlapping; -- said of the sepals or the petals of flowers in æstivation, and of leaves in vernation. (b) Opening as if by doors or valves, as most kinds of caps.

wolframic.definition: Of or pertaining to wolframium. See Tungstic.

delsarte.definition: A system of calisthenics patterned on the theories of François Delsarte (1811 -- 71), a French teacher of dramatic and musical expression.

hummock.definition: A rounded knoll or hillock; a rise of ground of no great extent, above a level surface. 2. A ridge or pile of ice on an ice field. 3. Timbered land. See Hammock. [Southern U.S.].

belsire.definition: A grandfather, or ancestor. "His great belsire Brute." Drayton.

mixen.definition: A compost heap; a dunghill. Chaucer. Tennyson.

pythocenic.definition: Producing decomposition, as diseases which are supposed to be accompanied or caused by decomposition.

outerly.definition: Utterly; entirely. Chaucer. 2. Toward the outside. Grew.

emissary.definition: An agent employed to advance, in a covert manner, the interests of his employers; one sent out by any power that is at war with another, to create dissatisfaction among the people of the latter. Buzzing emissaries fill the ears Of listening crowds with jealousies and fears. Dryden. Syn. -- Emissary,.

tazza.definition: An ornamental cup or vase with a large, flat, shallow bowl, resting on a pedestal and often having handles.

deraignment.definition: The act of deraigning. 2. The renunciation of religious or monastic vows. Blount.

sitology.definition: A treatise on the regulation of the diet; dietetics. [Written also sitiology.].

moneyer.definition: A person who deals in money; banker or broker. [Obs. or R.] 2. An authorized coiner of money. Sir M. Hale. The Company of Moneyers, the officials who formerly coined the money of Great Britain, and who claimed certain prescriptive rights and privileges.

rimose.definition: Full of rimes, fissures, or chinks. 2. (Nat. Hist.)  Having long and nearly parallel clefts or chinks, like those in the bark of trees.

blare.definition:
To sound loudly and somewhat harshly. "The trumpet blared." Tennyson.

To cause to sound like the blare of a trumpet; to proclaim loudly. To blare its own interpretation. Tennyson.

The harsh noise of a trumpet; a loud and somewhat harsh noise, like the blast of a trumpet; a roar or bellowing. With.

candlepin.definition: (a) A form of pin slender and nearly straight like a candle. (b) The game played with such pins; -- in form candlepins, used as a singular.

antimason.definition: One opposed to Freemasonry. -- An`ti*ma*son"ic, a.

disserviceable.definition: Calculated to do disservice or harm; not serviceable; injurious; harmful; unserviceable. Shaftesbury. -- Dis*serv"ice*a*ble*ness, n. Norris. -- Dis*serv"ice*a*bly, adv.

sandarach.definition: (Min.)  Realgar; red sulphide of arsenic. [Archaic] 2. (Bot. Chem.)  A white or yellow resin obtained from a Barbary tree (Callitris quadrivalvis or Thuya articulata), and pulverized for pounce; -- probably so called from a resemblance to the mineral.

keyseat.definition: To form a key seat, as by cutting. See Key seat, under Key.

nas.definition:
Was not. Chaucer.

Has not. Spenser.

elvan.definition:
Pertaining to elves; elvish. 2. (Mining)  Of or pertaining to certain veins of feldspathic or porphyritic rock crossing metalliferous veins in the mining districts of Cornwall; as, an elvan course.

The rock of an elvan vein, or the elvan vein itself; an elvan course.

ichthyosauria.definition: An extinct order of marine reptiles, including Ichthyosaurus and allied forms; -- called also Ichthyopterygia. They have not been found later than the Cretaceous period.

equisonance.definition: An equal sounding; the consonance of the unison and its octaves.

quaternate.definition: Composed of, or arranged in, sets of four; quaternary; as, quaternate leaves.

mutage.definition: A process for checking the fermentation of the must of grapes.

hygroscopic.definition: Of or pertaining to, or indicated by, the hygroscope; not readily manifest to the senses, but capable of detection by the hygroscope; as, glass is often covered with a film of hygroscopic moisture. 2. Having the property of readily inbibing moisture from the atmosphere, or of the becoming coated wit.

disposed.definition: Inclined; minded. When he was disposed to pass into Achaia. Acts xviii. 27. 2. Inclined to mirth; jolly. Beau. & Fl. Well disposed, in good condition; in good health. Chaucer.

rancho.definition: A rude hut, as of posts, covered with branches or thatch, where herdsmen or farm laborers may live or lodge at night. 2. A large grazing farm where horses and cattle are raised; -- distinguished from hacienda, a cultivated farm or plantation. [Mexico & California] Bartlett.

mistrustful.definition: Having or causing mistrust, suspicions, or forebodings. Their light blown out in some mistrustful wood. Shak. -- Mis*trust"ful*ly, adv. -- Mis*trust"ful*ness, n.

dog-legged.definition: Noting a flight of stairs, consisting of two or more straight portions connected by a platform (landing) or platforms, and running in opposite directions without an intervening wellhole.

rotundity.definition: The state or quality of being rotu Smite flat the thick rotundity o'the world! Shak. 2. Hence, completeness; entirety; roundness. For the more rotundity of the number and grace of the matter, it passeth for a full thousand. Fuller. A boldness and rotundity of speech. Hawthorne.

jib.definition: (Naut.)  A triangular sail set upon a stay or halyard extending from the foremast or fore-topmast to the bowsprit or the jib boom. Large vessels often carry several jibe; as, inner jib; outer jib; flying jib; etc. 2. (Mach.)  The projecting arm of a crane, from which the load is suspended. Jib boom.

tardiness.definition: The quality or state of being tardy.

crumbly.definition: EAsily crumbled; friable; brittle. "The crumbly soil." Hawthorne.

cymling.definition: A scalloped or "pattypan" variety of summer squash.

ophiurioid.definition: Of or pertaining to the Ophiurioidea. -- n.  One of the Ophiurioidea. [Written also ophiuroid.].

gymnasium.definition: A place or building where athletic exercises are performed; a school for gymnastics. 2. A school for the higher branches of literature and science; a preparatory school for the university; -- used esp. of German schools of this kind. More like ordinary schools of gymnasia than universities. Hallam.

shatter.definition: To break at once into many pieces; to dash, burst, or part violently into fragments; to rend into splinters; as, an explosion shatters a rock or a bomb; too much steam shatters a boiler; an oak is shattered by lightning. A monarchy was shattered to pieces, and divided amongst revolted subjects. Lock.

dabble.definition:
To wet by little dips or strokes; to spatter; to sprinkle; to moisten; to wet. "Bright hair dabbled in blood." Shak.

1. To play in water, as with the hands; to paddle or splash in mud or water. Wher the duck dabbles Wordsworth. 2. To work in slight or superficial manner; to do in a small way; to ta.

reintegrate.definition: To renew with regard to any state or quality; to restore; to bring again together into a whole, as the parts off anything; to reas, to reintegrate a nation. Bacon.

septentrion.definition:
The north or northern regions. Shak. Both East West, South and Septentrioun. Chaucer.

Of or pertaining to the north; northern. "From cold septentrion blasts." Milton.

latescent.definition: Slightly withdrawn from view or knowledge; as, a latescent meaning. Sir W. Hamilton.

urbicolous.definition: Of or pertaining to a city; urban.

amniotic.definition: Of or pertaining to the amnion; characterized by an amnion; as, the amniotic fluid; the amniotic sac. Amniotic acid. (Chem.) See Allantoin.

persulphocyanogen.definition: An orange-yellow substance, produced by the action of chlorine or boiling dilute nitric acid and sulphocyanate of potassium; -- called also pseudosulphocyanogen, perthiocyanogen, and formerly sulphocyanogen.

syntactical.definition: Of or pertaining to syntax; according to the rules of syntax, or construction. -- Syn*tac"tic*al*ly, adv.

majestatal.definition: Majestic. E. Pocock. Dr. J. Scott.

abecedarian.definition:
One who is learning the alphabet; hence, a tyro. 2. One engaged in teaching the alphabet. Wood.

Pertaining to, or formed by, the letters of the alphabet; alphabetic; hence, rudimentary. Abecedarian psalms, hymns, etc., compositions in which (like the 119th psalm in Hebrew) distinct portions or vers.

book-learned.definition: Versed in books; having knowledge derived from books. [Often in a disparaging sense.] Whate'er these book-learned blockheads say, Solon's the veriest fool in all the play. Dryden.

morpho.definition: Any one of numerous species of large, handsome, tropical American butterflies, of the genus Morpho. They are noted for the very brilliant metallic luster and bright colors (often blue) of the upper surface of the wings. The lower surface is usually brown or gray, with eyelike spots.

expropriate.definition: To put out of one's possession; to surrender the ownership of; also, to deprive of possession or proprietary rights. Boyle. Expropriate these [bad landlords] as the monks were expropriated by Act of Parliament. M. Arnold.

cinchonic.definition: Belonging to, or obtained from, cinchona. Mayne.

multisyllable.definition: A word of many syllables; a polysyllable. -- Mul`ti*syl*lab"ic, a.

junkerism.definition: The principles of the aristocratic party in Prussia.

lernean.definition: One of a family (Lernæidæ) of parasitic Crustacea found attached to fishes and other marine animals. Some species penetrate the skin and flesh with the elongated head, and feed on the viscera. See Illust. in Appendix.

tray-trip.definition: An old game played with dice. Shak.

tarpum.definition: A very large marine fish (Megapolis Atlanticus) of the Southern United States and the West Indies. It often becomes six or more feet in length, and has large silvery scales. The scales are a staple article of trade, and are used in fancywork. Called also tarpon, sabalo, savanilla, silverfish, and je.

parrot.definition: (Zoöl.)  In a general sense, any bird of the order Psittaci. 2. (Zoöl.)  Any species of Psittacus, Chrysotis, Pionus, and other genera of the family Psittacidæ, as distinguished from the parrakeets, macaws, and lories. They have a short rounded or even tail, and often a naked space on the cheeks. Th.

fleetness.definition: Swiftness; rapidity; velocity; celerity; speed; as, the fleetness of a horse or of time.

lady-killing.definition: The art or practice of captivating the hearts of women. Better for the sake of womankind that this dangerous dog should leave off lady-killing. Thackeray.

temporally.definition: In a temporal manner; secularly. South.

stereographical.definition: Made or done according to the rules of stereography; delineated on a plane; as, a stereographic chart of the earth. Stereographic projection (Geom.), a method of representing the sphere in which the center of projection is taken in the surface of the sphere, and the plane upon which the projection i.

instop.definition: To stop; to close; to make fast; as, to instop the seams. Dryden.

lubberly.definition:
Like a lubber; clumsy. A great lubberly boy. Shak.

Clumsily; awkwardly. Dryden.

importunacy.definition: The quality of being importunate; importunateness.

gauffer.definition: To plait, crimp, or flute; to goffer, as lace. See Goffer.

flaring.definition: That flares; flaming or blazing unsteadily; shining out with a dazzling light. His [the sun's] flaring beams. Milton. 2. Opening or speading outwards.

cloggy.definition: Clogging, or having power to clog.

blear.definition:
Dim or sore with water or rheum; -- said of the eyes. His blear eyes ran in gutters to his chin. Dryden. 2. Causing or caused by dimness of sight; dim. Power to cheat the eye with blear illusion. Milton.

To make somewhat sore or watery, as the eyes; to dim, or blur, as the sight. Figuratively: To o.

epicolic.definition: Situated upon or over the colon; -- applied to the region of the abdomen adjacent to the colon.

mydaleine.definition: A toxic alkaloid (ptomaine) obtained from putrid flesh and from herring brines. As a poison it is said to execute profuse diarrhoea, vomiting, and intestinal inflammation. Brieger.

jeames.definition: A footman; a flunky. [Slang, Eng.] Thackeray.

smoothbore.definition: Having a bore of perfectly smooth surface; -- distinguished from rifled. -- n.  A smoothbore firearm.

investiture.definition: The act or ceremony of investing, or the of being invested, as with an office; a giving possession; also, the right of so investing. He had refused to yield up to the pope the investiture of bishops. Sir W. Raleigh. 2. (Feudal Law)  Livery of seizin. The grant of land or a feud was perfected by the.

kyanol.definition: (a) Aniline. (b) A base obtained from coal tar. Ure.

puna.definition: A cold arid table-land, as in the Andes of Peru.

bidigitate.definition: Having two fingers or fingerlike projections.

nasopalatine.definition: Connected with both the nose and the palate; as, the nasopalatine or incisor, canal connecting the mouth and the nasal chamber in some animals; the nasopalatine nerve.

amine.definition: One of a class of strongly basic substances derived from ammonia by replacement of one or more hydrogen atoms by a basic atom or radical.

manganese.definition: An element obtained by reduction of its oxide, as a hard, grayish white metal, fusible with difficulty, but easily oxidized. Its ores occur abundantly in nature as the minerals pyrolusite, manganite, etc. Symbol Mn. Atomic weight 54.8. Note: An alloy of manganese with iron (called ferromanganese) is.

setbolt.definition: An iron pin, or bolt, for fitting planks closely together. Craig. 2. A bolt used for forcing another bolt out of its hole.

toran.definition: A gateway, commonly of wood, but sometimes of stone, consisting of two upright pillars carrying one to three transverse lintels. It is often minutely carved with symbolic sculpture, and serves as a monumental approach to a Buddhist temple.

zygenid.definition: Any one of numerous species of moths of the family Zygænidæ, most of which are bright colored. The wood nymph and the vine forester are examples. Also used adjectively.

conversationism.definition: A word or phrase used in conversation; a colloqualism.

ctenophora.definition: A class of Coelenterata, commonly ellipsoidal in shape, swimming by means of eight longitudinal rows of paddles. The separate paddles somewhat resemble combs.

outfrown.definition: To frown down; to overbear by frowning. Shak.

rapture.definition: A seizing by violence; a hurrying along; rapidity with violence. That 'gainst a rock, or flat, her keel did dash With headlong rapture. Chapman. 2. The state or condition of being rapt, or carried away from one's self by agreeable excitement; violence of a pleasing passion; extreme joy or pleasure;.

zooephyte.definition: (a) Any one of numerous species of invertebrate animals which more or less resemble plants in appearance, or mode of growth, as the corals, gorgonians, sea anemones, hydroids, bryozoans, sponges, etc., especially any of those that form compound colonies having a branched or treelike form, as many co.
