puttyroot.definition: An American orchidaceous plant (Aplectrum hyemale) which flowers in early summer. Its slender naked rootstock produces each year a solid corm, filled with exceedingly glutinous matter, which sends up later a single large oval evergreen plaited leaf. Called also Adam-and-Eve.

shackle.definition:
Stubble. Pegge.

1. Something which confines the legs or arms so as to prevent their free motion; specifically, a ring or band inclosing the ankle or wrist, and fastened to a similar shackle on the other leg or arm, or to something else, by a chain or a strap; a gyve; a fetter. His shackles empty le.

marmoreal.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, marble; made of marble.

truelove.definition: One really beloved. 2. (Bot.)  A plant. See Paris. 3. An unexplained word occurring in Chaucer, meaning, perhaps, an aromatic sweetmeat for sweetening the breath. T. R. Lounsbury. Under his tongue a truelove he bore. Chaucer. Truelove knot, a complicated, involved knot that does not readily untie; t.

larcenous.definition: Having the character of larceny; as, a larcenous act; committing larceny. "The larcenous and burglarious world." Sydney Smith. -- Lar"ce*nous*ly, adv.

merino.definition:
Of or pertaining to a variety of sheep with very fine wool, originally bred in Spain. 2. Made of the wool of the merino sheep.

1. (Zoöl.)  A breed of sheep originally from Spain, noted for the fineness of its wool. 2. A fine fabric of merino wool.

inleague.definition: To ally, or form an alliance witgh; to unite; to combine. With a willingness inleague our blood With his, for purchase of full growth in friendship. Ford.

breadth.definition: Distance from side to side of any surface or thing; measure across, or at right angles to the length; width. 2. (Fine Arts) The quality of having the colors and shadows broad and massive, and the arrangement of objects such as to avoid to great multiplicity of details, producing an impression of lar.

pugilist.definition: One who fights with his fists; esp., a professional prize fighter; a boxer.

pulverulent.definition: Consisting of, or reducible to, fine powder; covered with dust or powder; powdery; dusty.

sentimentality.definition: The quality or state of being sentimental.

excavator.definition: One who, or that which, excavates or hollows out; a machine, as a dredging machine, or a tool, for excavating.

targum.definition: A translation or paraphrase of some portion of the Old Testament Scriptures in the Chaldee or Aramaic language or dialect.

catchpenny.definition: Made or contrived for getting small sums of money from the ignorant or unwary; as, a catchpenny book; a catchpenny show. -- n.  Some worthless catchpenny thing.

blazoner.definition: One who gives publicity, proclaims, or blazons; esp., one who blazons coats of arms; a herald. Burke.

distrustful.definition: Not confident; diffident; wanting confidence or thrust; modest; as, distrustful of ourselves, of one's powers. Distrustful sense with modest caution speaks. Pope. 2. Apt to distrust; suspicious; mistrustful. Boyle. -- Dis*trust"ful*ly, adv. -- Dis*trust"ful*ness, n.

karakul.definition: Astrakhan, esp. in fine grades. Cf. Caracul.

tisri.definition: The seventh month of the Jewish ecclesiastical year, answering to a part of September with a part of October.

paum.definition: To palm off by fraud; to cheat at cards. Swift.

ventriculite.definition: Any one of numerous species of siliceous fossil sponges belonging to Ventriculites and allied genera, characteristic of the Cretaceous period. Note: Many of them were shaped like vases, others like mushrooms. They belong to the hexactinellids, and are allied to the Venus's basket of modern seas.

anthroposophy.definition: Knowledge of the nature of man; hence, human wisdom.

effigiation.definition: The act of forming in resemblance; an effigy. Fuller.

juggle.definition:
To play tricks by sleight of hand; to cause amusement and sport by tricks of skill; to conjure. 2. To practice artifice or imposture. Be these juggling fiends no more believed. Shak.

To deceive by trick or artifice. Is't possible the spells of France should juggle Men into such strange mysteries Sh.

dungmeer.definition: A pit where dung and weeds rot for manure.

tawdry.definition: Bought at the festival of St. Audrey. And gird in your waist, For more fineness, with a tawdry lace. Spenser. 2. Very fine and showy in colors, without taste or elegance; having an excess of showy ornaments without grace; cheap and gaudy; as, a tawdry dress; tawdry feathers; tawdry colors. He rails.

ablaze.definition: On fire; in a blaze, gleaming. Milman. All ablaze with crimson and gold. Longfellow. 2. In a state of glowing excitement or ardent desire. The young Cambridge democrats were all ablaze to assist Torrijos. Carlyle.

verdure.definition: Green; greenness; freshness of vegetation; as, the verdure of the meadows in June. A wide expanse of living verdure, cultivated gardens, shady groves, fertile cornfields, flowed round it like a sea. Motley.

scrofula.definition: A constitutional disease, generally hereditary, especially manifested by chronic enlargement and cheesy degeneration of the lymphatic glands, particularly those of the neck, and marked by a tendency to the development of chronic intractable inflammations of the skin, mucous membrane, bones, joints,.

intendment.definition: Charge; oversight. Ford. 2. Intention; design; purpose. The intendment of God and nature. Jer. Taylor. 3. (Law)  The true meaning, understanding, or intention of a law, or of any legal instrument.

venenate.definition:
To poison; to infect with poison. Harvey.

Poisoned. Woodward.

semi-saxon.definition: Half Saxon; -- specifically applied to the language intermediate between Saxon and English, belonging to the period 1150- 1250.

aspidobranchia.definition: A group of Gastropoda, with limpetlike shells, including the abalone shells and keyhole limpets.

remontant.definition: Rising again; -- applied to a class of roses which bloom more than once in a season; the hybrid perpetual roses, of which the Jacqueminot is a well-known example.

condign.definition: Worthy; suitable; deserving; fit. Condign and worthy praise. Udall. Herself of all that rule she deemend most condign. Spenser. 2. Deserved; adequate; suitable to the fault or crime. "Condign censure." Milman. Unless it were a bloody murderer . . . I never gave them condign punishment. Shak.

bookkeeping.definition: The art of recording pecuniary or business transactions in a regular and systematic manner, so as to show their relation to each other, and the state of the business in which they occur; the art of keeping accounts. The books commonly used are a daybook, cashbook, journal, and ledger. See Daybook, C.

frost-bitten.definition: Nipped, withered, or injured, by frost or freezing.

mycological.definition: Of or relating to mycology, or the fungi.

ivory-bill.definition: A large, handsome, North American woodpecker (Campephilus principalis), having a large, sharp, ivory-colored beak. Its general color is glossy black, with white secondaries, and a white dorsal stripe. The male has a large, scarlet crest. It is now rare, and found only in the Gulf States.

iniquity.definition: Absence of, or deviation from, just dealing; want of rectitude or uprightness; gross injustice; unrighteousness; wickedness; as, the iniquity of bribery; the iniquity of an unjust judge. Till the world from his perfection fell Into all filth and foul iniquity. Spenser. 2. An iniquitous act or thing;.

mechanography.definition: The art of mechanically multiplying copies of a writing, or any work of art.

seniorize.definition: To exercise authority; to rule; to lord it. Fairfax.

pinfish.definition: (a) The sailor's choice (Diplodus, or Lagodon, rhomboides). (b) The salt-water bream (Diplodus Holbrooki). Note: Both are excellent food fishes, common on the coast of the United States south of Cape Hatteras. The name is also applied to other allied species.

frons.definition: The forehead; the part of the cranium between the orbits and the vertex.

oxysulphide.definition: A ternary compound of oxygen and sulphur.

sobriety.definition: Habitual soberness or temperance as to the use of spirituous liquors; as, a man of sobriety. Public sobriety is a relative duty. Blackstone. 2. Habitual freedom from enthusiasm, inordinate passion, or overheated imagination; calmness; coolness; gravity; seriousness; as, the sobriety of riper years.

crazing-mill.definition: A mill for grinding tin ore.

rockiness.definition: The state or quality of being rocky.

germogen.definition: (a) A polynuclear mass of protoplasm, not divided into separate cells, from which certain ova are developed. Balfour. (b) The primitive cell in certain embryonic forms. Balfour.

jahwist.definition: The author of the passages of the Old Testament, esp. those of the Hexateuch, in which God is styled Yahweh, or Jehovah; the author of the Yahwistic, or Jehovistic, Prophetic Document (J); also, the document itself.

silene.definition: A genus of caryophyllaceous plants, usually covered with a viscid secretion by which insects are caught; catchfly. Bon Silène. See Silène, in the Vocabulary.

patrimony.definition: A right or estate inherited from one's father; or, in a larger sense, from any ancestor. "'Reave the orphan of his patrimony." Shak. 2. Formerly, a church estate or endowment. Shipley.

schematism.definition: (Astrol.)  Combination of the aspects of heavenly bodies. 2. Particular form or disposition of a thing; an exhibition in outline of any systematic arrangement.

proa.definition: A sailing canoe of the Ladrone Islands and Malay Archipelago, having its lee side flat and its weather side like that of an ordinary boat. The ends are alike. The canoe is long and narrow, and is kept from overturning by a cigar-shaped log attached to a frame extending several feet to windward. It h.

jacky.definition: (a) A landsman's nickname for a seaman, resented by the latter. (b) English gin. [Dial. Eng.].

mysteriousness.definition: The state or quality of being mysterious. 2. Something mysterious; a mystery. Jer. Taylor.

tenotome.definition: A slender knife for use in the operation of tenotomy.

amovability.definition: Liability to be removed or dismissed from office. T. Jefferson.

stutter.definition:
To hesitate or stumble in uttering words; to speak with spasmodic repetition or pauses; to stammer. Trembling, stuttering, calling for his confessor. Macaulay.

1. The act of stuttering; a stammer. See Stammer, and Stuttering. 2. One who stutters; a stammerer. Bacon.

sledge.definition: A strong vehicle with low runners or low wheels; or one without wheels or runners, made of plank slightly turned up at one end, used for transporting loads upon the snow, ice, or bare ground; a sled. 2. A hurdle on which, formerly, traitors were drawn to the place of execution. [Eng.] Sir W. Scott.

winch.definition:
To wince; to shrink; to kick with impatience or uneasiness.

A kick, as of a beast, from impatience or uneasiness. Shelton.

1. A crank with a handle, for giving motion to a machine, a grindstone, etc. 2. An instrument with which to turn or strain something forcibly. 3. An axle or drum turned by a c.

chieftain.definition: A captain, leader, or commander; a chief; the head of a troop, army, or clan. Syn. -- Chief; commander; leader; head. See Chief.

polygraphy.definition: Much writing; writing of many books. Fuller. 2. The art of writing in various ciphers, and of deciphering the same. 3. The art or practice of using a polygraph.

hetman.definition: A Cossack headman or general. The title of chief hetman is now held by the heir to the throne of Russia.

crudeness.definition: A crude, undigested, or unprepared state; rawness; unripeness; immatureness; unfitness for a destined use or purpose; as, the crudeness of iron ore; crudeness of theories or plans.

alga.definition: A kind of seaweed; pl. the class of cellular cryptogamic plants which includes the black, red, and green seaweeds, as kelp, dulse, sea lettuce, also marine and fresh water confervæ, etc.

reedify.definition: To edify anew; to build again after destruction. Milton.

concite.definition: To excite or stir up. Cotgrave.

streamline.definition: Of or pert. to a stream line; designating a motion or flow that is free from turbulence, like that of a particle in a streamline; hence, designating a surface, body, etc., that is designed so as to afford an unbroken flow of a fluid about it, esp. when the resistance to flow is the least possible; a.

headsail.definition: Any sail set forward of the foremast. Totten.

emancipate.definition: To set free from the power of another; to liberate; as: (a) To set free, as a minor from a parent; as, a father may emancipate a child. (b) To set free from bondage; to give freedom to; to manumit; as, to emancipate a slave, or a country. Brasidas . . . declaring that he was sent to emancipate Hella.

thrasher.definition: One who, or that which, thrashes grain; a thrashing machine. 2. (Zoöl.)  A large and voracious shark (Alopias vulpes), remarkable for the great length of the upper lobe of its tail, with which it beats, or thrashes, its prey. It is found both upon the American and the European coasts. Called also fo.

legitimately.definition: In a legitimate manner; lawfully; genuinely.

lituus.definition: (Rom. Antig.) (a) A curved staff used by the augurs in quartering the heavens. (b) An instrument of martial music; a kind of trumpet of a somewhat curved form and shrill note. 2. (Math.)  A spiral whose polar equation is r2th = a; that is, a curve the square of whose radius vector varies inversely a.

armada.definition: A fleet of armed ships; a squadron. Specifically, the Spanish fleet which was sent to assail England, a. d. 1558.

zooegrapher.definition: One who describes animals, their forms and habits.

scyllarian.definition: One of a family (Scyllaridæ) of macruran Crustacea, remarkable for the depressed form of the body, and the broad, flat antennæ. Also used adjectively.

mastodon.definition: An extinct genus of mammals closely allied to the elephant, but having less complex molar teeth, and often a pair of lower, as well as upper, tusks, which are incisor teeth. The species were mostly larger than elephants, and their romains occur in nearly all parts of the world in deposits ranging fr.

descensory.definition: A vessel used in alchemy to extract oils.

polemoscope.definition: An opera glass or field glass with an oblique mirror arranged for seeing objects do not lie directly before the eye; -- called also diagonal, or side, opera glass.

syntonin.definition: A proteid substance (acid albumin) formed from the albuminous matter of muscle by the action of dilute acids; -- formerly called musculin. See Acid albumin, under Albumin.

cavo-rilievo.definition: Hollow relief; sculpture in relief within a sinking made for the purpose, so no part of it projects beyond the plain surface around.

apron.definition: An article of dress, of cloth, leather, or other stuff, worn on the fore part of the body, to keep the clothes clean, to defend them from injury, or as a covering. It is commonly tied at the waist by strings. 2. Something which by its shape or use suggests an apron; as, (a) The fat skin covering the.

endemiology.definition: The science which treats of endemic affections.

livingly.definition: In a living state. Sir T. Browne.

telemetrograph.definition: A combination of the camera lucida and telescope for drawing and measuring distant objects. -- Tel`e*me*trog"ra*phy (#), n. -- Tel`e*met`ro*graph"ic (#), a.

totemic.definition: Of or pertaining to a totem, or totemism.

rideau.definition: A small mound of earth; ground slightly elevated; a small ridge.

morulation.definition: The process of cleavage, or segmentation, of the ovum, by which a morula is formed.

hematinon.definition: A red consisting of silica, borax, and soda, fused with oxide of copper and iron, and used in enamels, mosaics, etc.

swelling.definition: The act of that which swells; as, the swelling of rivers in spring; the swelling of the breast with pride. Rise to the swelling of the voiceless sea. Coleridge. 2. A protuberance; a prominence; especially (Med.),  an unnatural prominence or protuberance; as, a scrofulous swelling. The superficies of.

osteology.definition: The science which treats of the bones of the vertebrate skeleton.

foliar.definition: Consisting of, or pertaining to, leaves; as, foliar appendages. Foliar gap (Bot.), an opening in the fibrovascular system of a stem at the point of origin of a leaf. -- Foliar trace (Bot.), a particular fibrovascular bundle passing down into the stem from a leaf.

kingtruss.definition: A truss, framed with a king-post; -- used in roofs, bridges, etc.

aaronical.definition: Pertaining to Aaron, the first high priest of the Jews. AARON'S ROD Aar"on's rod`. Etym: [See Exodus vii. 9 and Numbers xvii. 8] 1. (Arch.)  A rod with one serpent twined around it, thus differing from the caduceus of Mercury, which has two. 2. (Bot.)  A plant with a tall flowering stem; esp. the gr.

cureall.definition: A remedy for all diseases, o.

multiplication.definition: The act or process of multiplying, or of increasing in number; the state of being multiplied; as, the multiplication of the human species by natural generation. The increase and multiplication of the world. Thackeray. 2. (Math.)  The process of repeating, or adding to itself, any given number or qua.

ulna.definition: (Anat.)  The postaxial bone of the forearm, or branchium, corresponding to the fibula of the hind limb. See Radius. 2. (O. Eng. Law)  An ell; also, a yard. Burrill.

wedge-shell.definition: Any one of numerous species of small marine bivalves belonging to Donax and allied genera in which the shell is wedge-shaped.

transfiguration.definition: A change of form or appearance; especially, the supernatural change in the personal appearance of our Savior on the mount. 2. (Eccl.)  A feast held by some branches of the Christian church on the 6th of August, in commemoration of the miraculous change above mentioned.

caladium.definition: A genus of aroideous plants, of which some species are cultivated for their immense leaves (which are often curiously blotched with white and red), and others (in Polynesia) for food.

ceroplastics.definition: The art of modeling in wax.

dejeration.definition: The act of swearing solemnly. Bp. Hall.

exemptitious.definition: Separable. "Exemptitious from matter." Dr. H. More.

recompense.definition: To render an equivalent to, for service, loss, etc.; to requite; to remunerate; to compensate. He can not recompense me better. Shak. 2. To return an equivalent for; to give compensation for; to atone for; to pay for. God recompenseth the gift. Robynson (More's Utopia). To recompense My rash, but mo.

tensity.definition: The quality or state of being tense, or strained to stiffness; tension; tenseness.

herculean.definition: Requiring the strength of Hercules; hence, very great, difficult, or dangerous; as, an Herculean task. 2. Having extraordinary strength or size; as, Herculean limbs. "Herculean Samson." Milton.

pterosauria.definition: An extinct order of flying reptiles of the Mesozoic age; the pterodactyls; -- called also Pterodactyli, and Ornithosauria. Note: The wings were formed, like those of bats, by a leathery expansion of the skin, principally supported by the greatly enlarged outer or " little" fingers of the hands. The.

centesimo.definition: A copper coin of Italy and Spain equivalent to a centime.

consecration.definition: The act or ceremony of consecrating; the state of being consecrated; dedication. Until the days of your consecration be at an end. Lev. viii. 33. Consecration makes not a place sacred, but only solemny declares it so. South.

electrographic.definition: Of or pertaining to an electrograph or electrography.

convincible.definition: Capable of being convinced or won over. 2. Capable of being confuted and disproved by argument; refutable. Sir T. Browne.

thornbird.definition: A small South American bird (Anumbius anumbii) allied to the ovenbirds of the genus Furnarius). It builds a very large and complex nest of twigs and thorns in a bush or tree.

flabile.definition: Liable to be blown about. Bailey.

epicondyle.definition: A projection on the inner side of the distal end of the numerus; the internal condyle.

deadness.definition: The state of being destitute of life, vigor, spirit, activity, etc.; dullness; inertness; languor; coldness; vapidness; indifference; as, the deadness of a limb, a body, or a tree; the deadness of an eye; deadness of the affections; the deadness of beer or cider; deadness to the world, and the like.

lacturamic.definition: Pertaining to, or designating, an organic amido acid, which is regarded as a derivative of lactic acid and urea.

seron.definition: Same as Ceroon. Note: This word as expressing a quantity or weight has no definite signification. McElrath.

bolognian.definition: Bolognese. Bolognian stone. See Bologna stone, under Bologna.

asbestic.definition: Of, pertaining to, or resembling asbestus; inconsumable; asbestine.

degerm.definition: To extract the germs from, as from wheat grains.

syrtic.definition: Of or pertaining to a syrt; resembling syrt, or quicksand. Ed. Rev.

devolvement.definition: The act or process of devolving;; devolution.

actinic.definition: Of or pertaining to actinism; as, actinic rays.

constructional.definition: Pertaining to, or deduced from, construction or interpretation.

driftage.definition: Deviation from a ship's course due to leeway. 2. Anything that drifts.

calendrical.definition: Of or pertaining to a calendar.

phosphatic.definition: Pertaining to, or containing, phosphorus, phosphoric acid, or phosphates; as, phosphatic nodules. Phosphatic diathesis (Med.), a habit of body which leads to the undue excretion of phosphates with the urine.

ecclesiastically.definition: In an ecclesiastical manner; according ecclesiastical rules.

syrinx.definition: (Mus.)  A wind instrument made of reeds tied together; -- called also pandean pipes. 2. (Anat.)  The lower larynx in birds. Note: In birds there are two laringes, an upper or true, but voiceless, larynx in the usual position behind the tongue, and a lower one, at or near the junction of the trachea.

supplicate.definition: To entreat for; to seek by earnest prayer; to ask for earnestly and humbly; as, to supplicate blessings on Christian efforts to spread the gospel. 2. To address in prayer; to entreat as a supplicant; as, to supplicate the Deity. Syn. -- To beseech; entreat; beg; petition; implore; importune; solicit.

zeitgeist.definition: The spirit of the time; the general intellectual and moral state or temper characteristic of any period of time.

cacodyl.definition: Alkarsin; a colorless, poisonous, arsenical liquid, As2(CH3)4, spontaneously inflammable and possessing an intensely disagreeable odor. It is the type of a series of compounds analogous to the nitrogen compounds called hydrazines. [Written also cacodyle, and kakodyl.].

commensality.definition: Fellowship at table; the act or practice of eating at the same table. "Promiscuous commensality." Sir T. Browne.

drummer.definition: One whose office is to best the drum, as in military exercises and marching. 2. One who solicits custom; a commercial traveler. [Colloq. U.S.] Bartlett. 3. (Zoöl.)  A fish that makes a sound when caught; as: (a) The squeteague. (b) A California sculpin. 4. (Zoöl.)  A large West Indian cockroach (Bla.

stirless.definition: Without stirring; very quiet; motionless. "Lying helpless and stirless." Hare.

attorney-general.definition: The chief law officer of the state, empowered to act in all litigation in which the law-executing power is a party, and to advise this supreme executive whenever required. Wharton.

wayment.definition:
To lament; to grieve; to wail. [Written also waiment.] Thilke science . . . maketh a man to waymenten. Chaucer. For what boots it to weep and wayment, When ill is chanced Spenser.

Grief; lamentation; mourning. [Written also waiment.] Spenser.

maneh.definition: A Hebrew weight for gold or silver, being one hundred shekels of gold and sixty shekels of silver. Ezek. xlv. 12.

degender.definition: To degenerate. "Degendering to hate." Spenser. He degenereth into beastliness. Joye.

ronion.definition: A mangy or scabby creature. "Aroint thee, with!" the rump-fed ronyon cries. Shak.

decivilize.definition: To reduce from civilization to a savage state. Blackwood's Mag.

micrometry.definition: The art of measuring with a micrometer.

indiscerpible.definition: Not discerpible; inseparable. Bp. Butler. -- In`dis*cerp"i*ble*ness, n., In`dis*cerp"ti*ble*ness, n. -- In`dis*cerp"ti*bly, adv.

diastasis.definition: A forcible of bones without fracture.

kobellite.definition: A blackish gray mineral, a sulphide of antimony, bismuth, and lead.

wanty.definition: A surcingle, or strap of leather, used for binding a load upon the back of a beast; also, a leather tie; a short wagon rope.

fleury.definition: Finished at the ends with fleurs-de-lis; -- said esp. a cross so decorated.

hymnologist.definition: A composer or compiler of hymns; one versed in hymnology. Busby.

proem.definition:
Preface; introduction; preliminary observations; prelude. Thus much may serve by way of proem. Swift.

To preface. South.

story-teller.definition: One who tells stories; a narrator of anecdotes,incidents, or fictitious tales; as, an amusing story-teller. 2. An historian; -- in contempt. Swift. 3. A euphemism or child's word for "a liar.".

brelan.definition: (a) A French gambling game somewhat like poker. (b) In French games, a pair royal, or triplet.

tilth.definition: The state of being tilled, or prepared for a crop; culture; as, land is good tilth. The tilth and rank fertility of its golden youth. De Quincey. 2. That which is tilled; tillage ground. And so by tilth and grange . . . We gained the mother city. Tennyson.

bocking.definition: A coarse woolen fabric, used for floor cloths, to cover carpets, etc.; -- so called from the town of Bocking, in England, where it was first made.

wavellite.definition: A hydrous phosphate of alumina, occurring usually in hemispherical radiated forms varying in color from white to yellow, green, or black.

hammock.definition: A swinging couch or bed, usually made of netting or canvas about six feet wide, suspended by clews or cords at the ends. 2. A piece of land thickly wooded, and usually covered with bushes and vines. Used also adjectively; as, hammock land. [Southern U. S.] Bartlett. Hammock nettings (Naut.), formerl.

pouchong.definition: A superior kind of souchong tea. De Colange.

hautboy.definition: (Mus.)  A wind instrument, sounded through a reed, and similar in shape to the clarinet, but with a thinner tone. Now more commonly called oboe. See Illust. of Oboe. 2. (Bot.)  A sort of strawberry (Fragaria elatior).

tallyho.definition: The huntsman's cry to incite or urge on his hounds. 2. A tallyho coach. Tallyho coach, a pleasure coach. See under Coach.

ladylikeness.definition: The quality or state of being ladylike.

protagonist.definition: One who takes the leading part in a drama; hence, one who takes lead in some great scene, enterprise, conflict, or the like. Shakespeare, the protagonist on the great of modern poetry. De Quincey.

angustation.definition: The act or making narrow; a straitening or contacting. Wiseman.

snowplough.definition: An implement operating like a plow, but on a larger scale, for clearing away the snow from roads, railways, etc.

lacinia.definition: (Bot.) (a) One of the narrow, jagged, irregular pieces or divisions which form a sort of fringe on the borders of the petals of some flowers. (b) A narrow, slender portion of the edge of a monophyllous calyx, or of any irregularly incised leaf. 2. (Zoöl.)  The posterior, inner process of the stipes.

vegetarianism.definition: The theory or practice of living upon vegetables and fruits.

rapturous.definition: Ecstatic; transporting; ravishing; feeling, expressing, or manifesting rapture; as, rapturous joy, pleasure, or delight; rapturous applause.

streamer.definition: An ensign, flag, or pennant, which floats in the wind; specifically, a long, narrow, ribbonlike flag. Brave Rupert from afar appears, Whose waving streamers the glad general knows. Dryden. 3. A stream or column of light shooting upward from the horizon, constituting one of the forms of the aurora bo.

klipspringer.definition: A small, graceful South African antelope (Nanotragus oreotragus), which, like the chamois, springs from one crag to another with great agility; -- called also kainsi. [Written also klippspringer.].

trayful.definition: As much as a tray will hold; enough to fill a tray.

steinkirk.definition:
A kind of neckcloth worn in a loose and disorderly fashion.

Same as Steenkirk.

phatagin.definition: The long-tailed pangolin (Manis tetradactyla); -- called also ipi.

unbreathed.definition: Not breathed. 2. Not exercised; unpracticed. "Their unbreathed memories." Shak.

aphemia.definition: Loss of the power of speaking, while retaining the power of writing; -- a disorder of cerebral origin.

mare.definition:
The female of the horse and other equine quadrupeds.

Sighing, suffocative panting, intercepted utterance, with a sense of pressure across the chest, occurring during sleep; the incubus; -- obsolete, except in the compound nightmare. I will ride thee o' nights like the mare. Shak.

eighteenth.definition:
Next in order after the seventeenth. 2. Consisting of one of eighteen equal parts or divisions of a thing.

1. The quotient of a unit divided by eighteen; one of eighteen equal parts or divisions. 2. The eighth after the tenth.

arytenoid.definition: Ladle-shaped; -- applied to two small cartilages of the larynx, and also to the glands, muscles, etc., connected with them. The cartilages are attached to the cricoid cartilage and connected with the vocal cords.

regressive.definition: Passing back; returning. 2. Characterized by retrogression; retrogressive. Regressive metamorphism. (a) (Biol.) See Retrogression. (b) (Physiol.) See Katabolism.

organogenesis.definition: (Biol.)  The origin and development of organs in animals and plants. 2. (Biol.)  The germ history of the organs and systems of organs, -- a branch of morphogeny. Haeckel.

magnesic.definition: Pertaining to, or containing, magnesium; as, magnesic oxide.

cheeringly.definition: In a manner to cheer or encourage.

indubitable.definition: Not dubitable or doubtful; too evident to admit of doubt; unquestionable; evident; apparently certain; as, an indubitable conclusion. -- n.  That which is indubitable. Syn. -- Unquestionable; evident; incontrovertible; incontestable; undeniable; irrefragable.

charta.definition: (a) Material on which instruments, books, etc., are written; parchment or paper. (b) A charter or deed; a writing by which a grant is made. See Magna Charta.

surangular.definition: Above the angular bone; supra-angular; -- applied to a bone of the lower jaw in many reptiles and birds. -- n.  The surangular bone.

triton.definition: A fabled sea demigod, the son of Neptune and Amphitrite, and the trumpeter of Neptune. He is represented by poets and painters as having the upper part of his body like that of a man, and the lower part like that of a fish. He often has a trumpet made of a shell. Have sight of Proteus rising from th.

grandaunt.definition: The aunt of one's father or mother.

interpoint.definition: To point; to mark with stops or pauses; to punctuate. Her sighs should interpoint her words. Daniel.

spirituosity.definition: The quality or state of being spirituous; spirituousness.

megapode.definition: Any one of several species of large-footed, gallinaceous birds of the genera Megapodius and Leipoa, inhabiting Australia and other Pacific islands. See Jungle fowl (b) under Jungle, and Leipoa.

demonship.definition: The state of a demon. Mede.

coctile.definition: Made by baking, or exposing to heat, as a brick.

bonhomie.definition: good nature; pleasant and easy manner.

prithee.definition: A corruption of pray thee; as, I prithee; generally used without I. Shak. What was that scream for, I prithee L'Estrange. Prithee, tell me, Dimple-chin. E. C. Stedman.

prolificness.definition: The quality or state of being prolific; fruitfulness; prolificacy.

taffeta.definition: A fine, smooth stuff of silk, having usually the wavy luster called watering. The term has also been applied to different kinds of silk goods, from the 16th century to modern times. Lined with taffeta and with sendal. Chaucer.

scrofulide.definition: Any affection of the skin dependent on scrofula.

pigtailed.definition: Having a tail like a pig's; as, the pigtailed baboon.

chalybeate.definition:
Impregnated with salts of iron; having a taste like iron; as, chalybeate springs.

Any water, liquid, or medicine, into which iron enters as an ingredient.

auf.definition: A changeling or elf child, -- that is, one left by fairies; a deformed or foolish child; a simpleton; an oaf. Drayton.

bridesmaid.definition: A female friend who attends on a bride at her wedding.

meloplastic.definition: Of or pertaining to meloplasty, or the artificial formation of a new cheek.

unbred.definition: Not begotten; unborn. "Thou age unbred." Shak. 2. Not taught or trained; -- with to. Dryden. 3. Not well-bred; ill-bred. Locke.

catelectrode.definition: The negative electrode or pole of a voltaic battery. Faraday.

organum.definition: An organ or instrument; hence, a method by which philosophical or scientific investigation may be conducted; -- a term adopted from the Aristotelian writers by Lord Bacon, as the title ("Novum Organon") of part of his treatise on philosophical method. Sir. W. Hamilton.

archness.definition: The quality of being arch; cleverness; sly humor free from malice; waggishness. Goldsmith.

falconine.definition: Like a falcon or hawk; belonging to the Falconidæ.

repossess.definition: To possess again; as, to repossess the land. Pope. To repossess one's self of (something), to acquire again (something lost).

smudge.definition: A suffocating smoke. Grose. 2. A heap of damp combustibles partially ignited and burning slowly, placed on the windward side of a house, tent, or the like, in order, by the thick smoke, to keep off mosquitoes or other insects. [U. S.] Bartlett. 3. That which is smeared upon anything; a stain; a blot.

dipsy.definition:
Deep-sea; as, a dipsey line; a dipsy lead. [Sailor's Cant]

1. A sinker attached to a fishing line; also, a line having several branches, each with such a sinker, used in deep-sea fishing. [Local, U. S.] 2.  (Naut.) A deep-sea lead. [Rare].

pleurapophysis.definition: One of the ventral processes of a vertebra, or the dorsal element in each half of a hemal arch, forming, or corresponding to, a vertebral rib. -- Pleu*rap`o*phys"i*al, a. Owen.

paytine.definition: An alkaloid obtained from a white bark resembling that of the cinchona, first brought from Payta, in Peru.

intercolumnar.definition: Between columns or pillars; as, the intercolumnar fibers of Poupart's ligament; an intercolumnar statue.

bluff.definition: Having a broad, flattened front; as, the bluff bows of a ship. "Bluff visages." Irving. 2. Rising steeply with a flat or rounded front. "A bluff or bold shore." Falconer. Its banks, if not really steep, had a bluff and precipitous aspect. Judd. 3. Surly; churlish; gruff; rough. 4. Abrupt; roughly fr.

adduction.definition: The act of adducing or bringing forward. An adduction of facts gathered from various quarters. I. Taylor. 2. (Physiol.)  The action by which the parts of the body are drawn towards its axis]; -- opposed to abduction. Dunglison.

ecbasis.definition: A figure in which the orator treats of things according to their events consequences.

saki.definition: Any one of several species of South American monkeys of the genus Pithecia. They have large ears, and a long hairy tail which is not prehensile. Note: The black saki (Pithecia satanas), the white-headed (P.leucocephala), and the red-backed, or hand-drinking, saki (P.chiropotes), are among the best-k.

entreative.definition: Used in entreaty; pleading. "Entreative phrase." A. Brewer.

ponderosity.definition: The quality or state of being ponderous; weight; gravity; heaviness, ponderousness; as, the ponderosity of gold. Ray.

weka.definition: A New Zealand rail (Ocydromus australis) which has wings so short as to be incapable of flight.

rheae.definition: A suborder of struthious birds including the rheas.

filament.definition: A thread or threadlike object or appendage; a fiber; esp. (Bot.), the threadlike part of the stamen supporting the anther.

rakel.definition: Hasty; reckless; rash. Chaucer. -- Ra"kel*ness, n. Chaucer.

moule.definition: To contract mold; to grow moldy; to mold. Let us not moulen thus in idleness. Chaucer.

mange.definition: The scab or itch in cattle, dogs, and other beasts. Mange insect (Zoöl.), any one of several species of small parasitic mites, which burrow in the skin of cattle. horses, dogs, and other animals, causing the mange. The mange insect of the horse (Psoroptes, or Dermatodectes, equi), and that of cattle.

wield.definition: To govern; to rule; to keep, or have in charge; also, to possess. When a strong armed man keepeth his house, all things that he wieldeth ben in peace. Wyclif (Luke xi. 21). Wile [ne will] ye wield gold neither silver ne money in your girdles. Wyclif (Matt. x. 9.) 2. To direct or regulate by influenc.

endure.definition: To continue in the same state without perishing; to last; to remain. Their verdure still endure. Shak. He shall hold it [his house] fast, but it shall not endure. Job viii. 15. 2. To remain firm, as under trial or suffering; to suffer patiently or without yielding; to bear up under adversity; to hol.

distillery.definition: The building and works where distilling, esp. of alcoholic liquors, is carried on. 2. The act of distilling spirits. Todd.

degraded.definition: Reduced in rank, character, or reputation; debased; sunken; low; base. The Netherlands . . . were reduced practically to a very degraded condition. Motley. 2. (Biol.)  Having the typical characters or organs in a partially developed condition, or lacking certain parts. Some families of plants are de.

tithonicity.definition: The state or property of being tithonic; actinism.

poinder.definition: The keeper of a cattle pound; a pinder. [Obs. or Scot.] T. Adams. 2. One who distrains property. [Scot.] Jamieson.

dog-headed.definition: Having a head shaped like that of a dog; -- said of certain baboons.

defectionist.definition: One who advocates or encourages defection.

indent.definition: To notch; to jag; to cut into points like a row of teeth; as, to indent the edge of paper. 2. To dent; to stamp or to press in; to impress; as, indent a smooth surface with a hammer; to indent wax with a stamp. 3. Etym: [Cf. Indenture.]  To bind out by indenture or contract; to indenture; to apprent.

elapse.definition: To slip or glide away; to pass away silently, as time; -- used chiefly in reference to time. Eight days elapsed; at length a pilgrim came. Hoole.

mango.definition: The fruit of the mango tree. It is rather larger than an apple, and of an ovoid shape. Some varieties are fleshy and luscious, and others tough and tasting of turpentine. The green fruit is pickled for market. 2. A green muskmelon stuffed and pickled. Mango bird (Zoöl.), an oriole (Oriolus kundoo),.

minimization.definition: The act or process of minimizing. Bentham.

accuser.definition: One who accuses; one who brings a charge of crime or fault.

denouement.definition: The unraveling or discovery of a plot; the catastrophe, especially of a drama or a romance. 2. The solution of a mystery; issue; outcome.

satiny.definition: Like or composed of satin; glossy; as, to have a satiny appearance; a satiny texture.

campanulaceous.definition: Of pertaining to, or resembling, the family of plants (Camponulaceæ) of which Campanula is the type, and which includes the Canterbury bell, the harebell, and the Venus's looking-glass.

infundibuliform.definition: Having the form of a funnel or cone; funnel-shaped. 2. (Bot.)  Same as Funnelform.

alienor.definition: One who alienates or transfers property to another. Blackstone.

shram.definition: To cause to shrink or shrivel with cold; to benumb.

eminently.definition: In an eminent manner; in a high degree; conspicuously; as, to be eminently learned.

nutrication.definition: The act or manner of feeding. Sir T. Browne.

assignation.definition: The act of assigning or allotting; apportionment. This order being taken in the senate, as touching the appointment and assignation of those provinces. Holland. 2. An appointment of time and place for meeting or interview; -- used chiefly of love interviews, and now commonly in a bad sense. While ny.

accumulative.definition: Characterized by accumulation; serving to collect or amass; cumulative; additional. -- Ac*cu"mu*la*tive*ly, adv. -- Ac*cu"mu*la*tive*ness, n.

daguerreotypy.definition: The art or process of producing pictures by method of Daguerre.

falsifier.definition: One who falsifies, or gives to a thing a deceptive appearance; a liar.

decoloration.definition: The removal or absence of color. Ferrand.

stealer.definition: One who steals; a thief. 2. (Shipbuilding)  The endmost plank of a strake which stops short of the stem or stern.

mantologist.definition: One who is skilled in mantology; a diviner.

coinhere.definition: To inhere or exist together, as in one substance. Sir W. Hamilton.

cyclops.definition: (Gr. Myth.)  One of a race of giants, sons of Neptune and Amphitrite, having but one eye, and that in the middle of the forehead. They were fabled to inhabit Sicily, and to assist in the workshops of Vulcan, under Mt. Etna. Note: Pope, in his translation of the "Odyssey," uniformly spells this word.

dhow.definition: A coasting vessel of Arabia, East Africa, and the Indian Ocean. It has generally but one mast and a lateen sail. [Also written dow.].

incisory.definition: Having the quality of cutting; incisor; incisive.

interchange.definition: To put each in the place of the other; to give and take mutually; to exchange; to reciprocate; as, to interchange places; they interchanged friendly offices and services. I shall interchange My waned state for Henry's regal crown. Shak. 2. To cause to follow alternately; to intermingle; to vary; as,.

wariangle.definition: The red-backed shrike (Lanius collurio); -- called also würger, worrier, and throttler. [Written also warriangle, weirangle, etc.] [Obs. or Prov. Eng.].

evocative.definition: Calling forth; serving to evoke; developing. Evocative power over all that is eloquent and expressive in the better soul of man. W. Pater.

artificer.definition: An artistic worker; a mechanic or manufacturer; one whose occupation requires skill or knowledge of a particular kind, as a silversmith. 2. One who makes or contrives; a deviser, inventor, or framer. "Artificer of fraud." Milton. The great Artificer of all that moves. Cowper. 3. A cunning or artful.

handmaid.definition: A maid that waits at hand; a female servant or attendant.

neurosensiferous.definition: Pertaining to, or forming, both nerves and sense organs.

antasthmatic.definition: Opposing, or fitted to relieve, asthma. -- n.  A remedy for asthma.

serbonian.definition: Relating to the lake of Serbonis in Egypt, which by reason of the sand blowing into it had a deceptive appearance of being solid land, but was a bog. A gulf profound as that Serbonian bog . . . Where armies whole have sunk. Milton.

zayat.definition: A public shed, or portico, for travelers, worshipers, etc. [Burmah].

mastigure.definition: Any one of several large spiny-tailed lizards of the genus Uromastix. They inhabit Southern Asia and North Africa.

hamster.definition: A small European rodent (Cricetus frumentarius). It is remarkable for having a pouch on each side of the jaw, under the skin, and for its migrations.

androdioecious.definition: Having perfect and staminate flowers on different plants. -- An`dro*di*o"cism, -di*e"cism (#), n.

imbound.definition: To inclose in limits; to shut in. Shak.

approaching.definition: The act of ingrafting a sprig or shoot of one tree into another, without cutting it from the parent stock; -- called, also, inarching and grafting by approach.

deep-laid.definition: Laid deeply; formed with cunning and sagacity; as, deep-laid plans.

nasoturbinal.definition: Connected with, or near, both the turbinal and the nasal bones; as, the nasalturbinal bone, made up of the uppermost lammelæ of the ethmoturbinal, and sometimes united with the nasal. -- n.  The nasoturbinal bone.

interpellation.definition: The act of interpelling or interrupting; interruption. "Continual interpellations." Bp. Hall. 2. The act of interposing or interceding; intercession. Accepted by his interpellation and intercession. Jer. Taylor. 3. An act of interpellating, or of demanding of an officer an explanation of his action;.

domiciliary.definition: Of or pertaining to a domicile, or the residence of a person or family. The personal and domiciliary rights of the citizen scrupulously guarded. Motley. Domiciliary visit (Law), a visit to a private dwelling, particularly for searching it, under authority.

organoplastic.definition: Having the property of producing the tissues or organs of animals and plants; as, the organoplastic cells.

azotine.definition: An explosive consisting of sodium nitrate, charcoal, sulphur, and petroleum. 2.  = 1st Ammonite, 2.

rasante.definition: Sweeping; grazing; -- applied to a style of fortification in which the command of the works over each other, and over the country, is kept very low, in order that the shot may more effectually sweep or graze the ground before them. H. L. Scott.

slothful.definition: Addicted to sloth; inactive; sluggish; lazy; indolent; idle. He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster. Prov. xviii. 9. -- Sloth"ful*ly, adv. -- Sloth"ful*ness, n.

adhibition.definition: The act of adhibiting; application; use. Whitaker.

fanaticism.definition: Excessive enthusiasm, unreasoning zeal, or wild and extravagant notions, on any subject, especially religion; religious frenzy. Syn. -- See Superstition.

consumptively.definition: In a way tending to or indication consumption. Beddoes.

diseasefulness.definition: The quality of being diseaseful; trouble; trial. Sir P. Sidney.

jute.definition: The coarse, strong fiber of the East Indian Corchorus olitorius, and C. capsularis; also, the plant itself. The fiber is much used for making mats, gunny cloth, cordage, hangings, paper, etc.

britannia.definition: A white-metal alloy of tin, antimony, bismuth, copper, etc. It somewhat resembles silver, and isused for table ware. Called also Britannia metal.

sawder.definition: A corrupt spelling and pronunciation of solder. Soft sawder, seductive praise; flattery; blarney. [Slang].

oxidizer.definition: An agent employed in oxidation, or which facilitates or brings about combination with oxygen; as, nitric acid, chlorine, bromine, etc., are strong oxidizers.

phylloxanthin.definition: A yellow coloring matter extracted from chlorophyll.

polyphone.definition: A character or vocal sign representing more than one sound, as read, which is pronounced red or rèd.

hundredth.definition:
Coming last of a hundred successive individuals or units. 2. Forming one of a hundred equal parts into which anything is divided; the tenth of a tenth.

One of a hundred equal parts into which one whole is, or may be, divided; the quotient of a unit divided by a hundred.

prian.definition: A fine, white, somewhat friable clay; also, the ore contained in a mixture of clay and pebbles. [Written also pryan.].

tetrazin.definition: A hypothetical compound, C2H2N4 which  may be regarded as benzene with four CH groups replaced by nitrogen atoms; also, any of various derivatives of the same. There are three isomeric varieties.

patellar.definition: Of or pertaining to the patella, or kneepan.

semi-pelagian.definition: A follower of John Cassianus, a French monk (died about 448), who modified the doctrines of Pelagius, by denying human merit, and maintaining the necessity of the Spirit's influence, while, on the other hand, he rejected the Augustinian doctrines of election, the inability of man to do good, and the.

unceasable.definition: Not capable of being ended; unceasing.

pyrotechnics.definition: The art of making fireworks; the manufacture and use of fireworks; pyrotechny.

ramiform.definition: Having the form of a branch.

drake.definition:
The male of the duck kind. 2. Etym: [Cf. Dragon fly, under Dragon.]  The drake fly. The drake will mount steeple height into the air. Walton. Drake fly, a kind of fly, sometimes used in angling. The dark drake fly, good in August. Walton.

1. A dragon. Beowulf resolves to kill the drake. J. A. Harri.

invitrifiable.definition: Not admitting of being vitrified, or converted into glass. Kirwan.

thalassinian.definition: Any species of Thalaassinidæ, a family of burrowing macrurous Crustacea, having a long and soft abdomen.

defer.definition:
To put off; to postpone to a future time; to delay the execution of; to delay; to withhold. Defer the spoil of the city until night. Shak. God . . . will not long defer To vindicate the glory of his name. Milton.

To put off; to delay to act; to wait. Pius was able to defer and temporize at leisure.

lucidness.definition: The quality of being lucid; lucidity.

hemadynamometer.definition: An instrument by which the pressure of the blood in the arteries, or veins, is measured by the height to which it will raise a column of mercury; -- called also a hæmomanometer.

garish.definition: Showy; dazzling; ostentatious; attracting or exciting attention. "The garish sun." "A garish flag." Shak. "In . . . garish colors." Asham. "The garish day." J. H. Newman. Garish like the laughters of drunkenness. Jer. Taylor. 2. Gay to extravagance; flighty. It makes the mind loose and garish. South.

intermediary.definition:
Lying, coming, or done, between; intermediate; as, an intermediary project. Intermediary amputation (Surg.), an amputation for injury, performed after inflammation has set in.

One who, or that which, is intermediate; an interagent; a go- between.

freya.definition: The daughter of Njörd, aud goddess of love and beauty; the Scandinavian Venus; -- in Teutonic myths confounded with Frigga, but in Scandinavian, distinct. [Written also Frea, Fraying, and Ereyja.].

acephala.definition: That division of the Mollusca which includes the bivalve shells, like the clams and oysters; -- so called because they have no evident head. Formerly the group included the Tunicata, Brachiopoda, and sometimes the Bryozoa. See Mollusca.

diplomatic.definition:
Pertaining to diplomacy; relating to the foreign ministers at a court, who are called the diplomatic body. 2. Characterized by tact and shrewdness; dexterous; artful; as, diplomatic management. 3. Pertaining to diplomatics; paleographic. Astle.

A minister, official agent, or envoy to a foreign cour.

obligate.definition: To bring or place under obligation, moral or legal; to hold by a constraining motive. "Obligated by a sense of duty." Proudfit. That's your true plan -- to obligate The present ministers of state. Churchill. 2. To bind or firmly hold to an act; to compel; to constrain; to bind to any act of duty or.

protista.definition: A provisional group in which are placed a number of low microscopic organisms of doubtful nature. Some are probably plants, others animals.

microbicide.definition: Any agent detrimental to, or destructive of, the life of microbes or bacterial organisms.

tigress.definition: The female of the tiger. Holland.

outstay.definition: To stay beyond or longer than. She concluded to outstay him. Mad. D' Arblay.

cachinnation.definition: Loud or immoderate laughter; -- often a symptom of hysterical or maniacal affections. Hideous grimaces . . . attended this unusual cachinnation. Sir W. Scott.

condense.definition: To make more close, compact, or dense; to compress or concentrate into a smaller compass; to consolidate; to abridge; to epitomize. In what shape they choose, Dilated or condensed, bright or obscure. Milton. The secret course pursued at Brussels and at Madrid may be condensed into the usual formula,.

binocle.definition: A dioptric telescope, fitted with two tubes joining, so as to enable a person to view an object with both eyes at once; a double- barreled field glass or an opera glass.

clean-limbed.definition: With well-proportioned, unblemished limbs; as, a clean-limbed young fellow. Dickens.

anthropomorphist.definition: One who attributes the human form or other human attributes to the Deity or to anything not human.

pyrognostics.definition: The characters of a mineral observed by the use of the blowpipe, as the degree of fusibility, flame coloration, etc.

availably.definition: In an available manner; profitably; advantageously; efficaciously.

sophistry.definition: The art or process of reasoning; logic. 2. The practice of a sophist; fallacious reasoning; reasoning sound in appearance only. The juggle of sophistry consists, for the most part, in usig a word in one sense in the premise, and in another sense in the conclusion. Coleridge. Syn. -- See Fallacy.

polybromide.definition: A bromide containing more than one atom of bromine in the molecule.

mystagogical.definition: Of or pertaining to interpretation of mysteries or to mystagogue; of the nature of mystagogy.

queenship.definition: The state, rank, or dignity of a queen.

affectationist.definition: One who exhibits affectation. Fitzed. Hall.

unbeseem.definition: To be unbecoming or unsuitable to; to misbecome.

corkage.definition: The charge made by innkeepers for drawing the cork and taking care of bottles of wine bought elsewhere by a guest.

obuncous.definition: Hooked or crooked in an extreme degree. Maunder.

cavatina.definition: Originally, a melody of simpler form than the aria; a song without a second part and a da capo; -- a term now variously and vaguely used.

passacaglio.definition: An old Italian or Spanish dance tune, in slow three-four measure, with divisions on a ground bass, resembling a chaconne.

bilimbing.definition: The berries of two East Indian species of Averrhoa, of the Oxalideæ or Sorrel family. They are very acid, and highly esteemed when preserved or pickled. The juice is used as a remedy for skin diseases. [Written also blimbi and blimbing.].

cavalero.definition: A cavalier; a gallant; a libertine. Shak.

refragable.definition: Capable of being refuted; refutable. -- Ref"ra*ga*ble*ness, n. -- Ref`*ra*ga*bil"i*ty (-b, n.

wristlet.definition: An elastic band worn around the wrist, as for the purpose of securing the upper part of a glove.

colic.definition: A severe paroxysmal pain in the abdomen, due to spasm, obstruction, or distention of some one of the hollow viscera. Hepatic colic, the severe pain produced by the passage of a gallstone from the liver or gall bladder through the bile duct. -- Intestinal colic, or Ordinary colic, pain due to distent.

architrave.definition: (a) The lower division of an entablature, or that part which rests immediately on the column, esp. in classical architecture. See Column. (b) The group of moldings, or other architectural member, above and on both sides of a door or other opening, especially if square in form.

apostle.definition: Literally: One sent forth; a messenger. Specifically: One of the twelve disciples of Christ, specially chosen as his companions and witnesses, and sent forth to preach the gospel. He called unto him his disciples, and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles. Luke vi. 13. Note: The title.

regulize.definition: To reduce to regulus; to separate, as a metal from extraneous matter; as, to regulize antimony. [Archaic].

aortic.definition: Of or pertaining to the aorta.

chelidon.definition: The hollow at the flexure of the arm.

fluoroid.definition: A tetrahexahedron; -- so called because it is a common form of fluorite.

metapode.definition: The posterior division of the foot in the Gastropoda and Pteropoda.

sheetful.definition: Enough to fill a sheet; as much as a sheet can hold.

hydrophytology.definition: The branch of botany which treats of water plants.

praecava.definition: The superior vena cava. -- Præ"ca`val, a. B. G. Wilder.

scarifier.definition: One who scarifies. 2. (Surg.)  The instrument used for scarifying. 3. (Agric.)  An implement for stripping and loosening the soil, without bringing up a fresh surface. You have your scarifiers to make the ground clean. Southey.

taunting.definition: from Taunt, v. Every kind of insolent and taunting reflection. Burke.

deforciant.definition: (a) One who keeps out of possession the rightful owner of an estate. (b) One against whom a fictitious action of fine was brought. Burrill.

algidity.definition: Chilliness; coldness; especially (Med.),  coldness and collapse.

pause.definition: A temporary stop or rest; an intermission of action; interruption; suspension; cessation. 2. Temporary inaction or waiting; hesitation; suspence; doubt. I stand in pause where I shall first begin. Shak. 3. In speaking or reading aloud, a brief arrest or suspension of voice, to indicate the limits an.

torril.definition: A worthless woman; also, a worthless horse. Halliwell.

seedy.definition: Abounding with seeds; bearing seeds; having run to seeds. 2. Having a peculiar flavor supposed to be derived from the weeds growing among the vines; -- said of certain kinds of FRench brandy. 3. Old and worn out; exhausted; spiritless; also, poor and miserable looking; shabily clothed; shabby lookin.

arteriosclerosis.definition: Abnormal thickening and hardening of the walls of the arteries, esp. of the intima, occurring mostly in old age. -- Ar*te`ri*o*scle*rot"ic (#), a.

fascicle.definition: A small bundle or collection; a compact cluster; as, a fascicle of fibers; a fascicle of flowers or roots.

panamanian.definition: Of or pert. to Panama. -- n.  A native or citizen of Panama.

keckle.definition:
See Keck, v. i. & n.

To wind old rope around, as a cable, to preserve its surface from being fretted, or to wind iron chains around, to defend from the friction of a rocky bottom, or from the ice. Totten.

cyclamen.definition: A genus of plants of the Primrose family, having depressed rounded corms, and pretty nodding flowers with the petals so reflexed as to point upwards, whence it is called rabbit's ears. It is also called sow bread, because hogs are said to eat the corms.

palmated.definition: Having the shape of the hand; resembling a hand with the fingers spread. 2. (Bot.)  Spreading from the apex of a petiole, as the divisions of a leaf, or leaflets, so as to resemble the hand with outspread fingers. Gray. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) Having the anterior toes united by a web, as in most swimming bir.

workmaster.definition: The performer of any work; a master workman. Spenser. WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION ACT Workmen's compensation act. (Law)  A statute fixing the compensation that a workman may recover from an employer in case of accident, esp. the British act of 6 Edw. VII. c. 58 (1906) giving to a workman, except in certa.

rhamphorhynchus.definition: A genus of pterodactyls in which the elongated tail supported a leathery expansion at the tip.

chlorotic.definition: Pertaining to, or affected by, chlorosis.

galloon.definition: A narrow tapelike fabric used for binding hats, shoes, etc., -- sometimes made ornamental. 2. A similar bordering or binding of rich material, such as gold lace. Silver and gold galloons, with the like glittering gewgaws. Addison.

magaziner.definition: One who edits or writes for a magazine. Goldsmith.

polyspermy.definition: Fullness of sperm, or seed; the passage of more than one spermatozoön into the vitellus in the impregnation of the ovum.

chimpanzee.definition: An african ape (Anthropithecus troglodytes or Troglodytes niger) which approaches more nearly to man, in most respects, than any other ape. When full grown, it is from three to four feet high.

geolatry.definition: The worship of the earth. G. W. Cox. The Geological Series. Note: The science of geology, as treating of the history of the globe, involves a description of the different strata which compose its crust, their order of succession, characteristic forms of animal and vegetable life, etc. The principal.

heretical.definition: Containing heresy; of the nature of, or characterized by, heresy.

snape.definition: To bevel the end of a timber to fit against an inclined surface.

mumm.definition: To sport or make diversion in a mask or disguise; to mask. With mumming and with masking all around. Spenser.

nomocracy.definition: Government in accordance with a system of law. Milman.

self-posited.definition: Disposed or arranged by an action originating in one's self or in itself. These molecular blocks of salt are self-posited. Tyndall.

keeve.definition:
(Brewing)  A vat or tub in which the mash is made; a mash tub. Ure. 2. (Bleaching)  A bleaching vat; a kier. 3. (Mining)  A large vat used in dressing ores.

1. To set in a keeve, or tub, for fermentation. 2. To heave; to tilt, as a cart.

chasmy.definition: Of or pertaining to a chasm; abounding in chasms. Carlyle. They cross the chasmy torrent's foam-lit bed. Wordsworth.

graphology.definition: The art of judging of a person's character, disposition, and aptitude from his handwriting.

heterocyst.definition: A cell larger than the others, and of different appearance, occurring in certain algæ related to nostoc.

repositor.definition: An instrument employed for replacing a displaced organ or part.

tolsester.definition: A toll or tribute of a sextary of ale, paid to the lords of some manors by their tenants, for liberty to brew and sell ale. Cowell.

myopathia.definition: Any affection of the muscles or muscular system.

rectory.definition: The province of a rector; a parish church, parsonage, or spiritual living, with all its rights, tithes, and glebes. 2. A rector's mansion; a parsonage house.

incision.definition: The act of incising, or cutting into a substance. Milton. 2. That which is produced by incising; the separation of the parts of any substance made by a cutting or pointed instrument; a cut; a gash. 3. Separation or solution of viscid matter by medicines.

interluder.definition: An actor who performs in an interlude. B. Jonson.

aeration.definition: Exposure to the free action of the air; airing; as, aëration of soil, of spawn, etc. 2. (Physiol.)  A change produced in the blood by exposure to the air in respiration; oxygenation of the blood in respiration; arterialization. 3. The act or preparation of charging with carbonic acid gas or with oxy.

ecteron.definition: The external layer of the skin and mucous membranes; epithelium; ecderon. -- Ec`ter*on"ic, a.

pilement.definition: An accumulation; a heap. Bp. Hall.

bolster.definition: A long pillow or cushion, used to support the head of a person lying on a bed; -- generally laid under the pillows. And here I'll fling the pillow, there the bolster, This way the coverlet, another way the sheets. Shak. 2. A pad, quilt, or anything used to hinder pressure, support any part of the bo.

wesleyan.definition:
Of or pertaining to Wesley or Wesleyanism.

One who adopts the principles of Wesleyanism; a Methodist.

encamp.definition: To form and occupy a camp; to prepare and settle in temporary habitations, as tents or huts; to halt on a march, pitch tents, or form huts, and remain for the night or for a longer time, as an army or a company traveling. The host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim. 1 Chron. xi. 15.

infernally.definition: In an infernal manner; diabolically. "Infernally false." Bp. Hacket.

margarine.definition: Artificial butter; oleomargarine. The word margarine shall mean all substances, whether compounds or otherwise, prepared in imitation of butter, and whether mixed with butter or not. Margarine Act, 1887 (50 & 51 Vict. c. 29). 2.  Margarin.

twister.definition: One who twists; specifically, the person whose occupation is to twist or join the threads of one warp to those of another, in weaving. 2. The instrument used in twisting, or making twists. He, twirling his twister, makes a twist of the twine. Wallis. 3. (Carp.)  A girder. Craig. 4. (Man.)  The inner.

anti-trade.definition: A tropical wind blowing steadily in a direction opposite to the trade wind.

bundobust.definition: System; discipline. [India] He has more bundobust than most men. Kipling.

dzeron.definition: The Chinese yellow antelope (Procapra gutturosa), a remarkably swift-footed animal, inhabiting the deserts of Central Asia, Thibet, and China.

halfcock.definition: To set the cock of (a firearm) at the first notch. To go off halfcocked. (a) To be discharged prematurely, or with the trigger at half cock; -- said of a firearm. (b) To do or say something without due thought or care. [Colloq. or Low].

miocene.definition: Of or pertaining to the middle division of the Tertiary. -- n.  The Miocene period. See Chart of Geology.

steen.definition:
A vessel of clay or stone. "An huge great earth-pot steane." Spenser. 2. A wall of brick, stone, or cement, used as a lining, as of a well, cistern, etc.; a steening.

To line, as a well, with brick, stone, or other hard material. [Written also stean, and stein.].

assoilyie.definition: To absolve; to acquit by sentence of court. God assoilzie him for the sin of bloodshed. Sir W. Scott.

pleuropneumonia.definition: Inflammation of the pleura and lungs; a combination of pleurisy and pneumonia, esp. a kind of contagions and fatal lung plague of cattle.

artemia.definition: A genus of phyllopod Crustacea found in salt lakes and brines; the brine shrimp. See Brine shrimp.

ik.definition: I Piers Plowman. Note: The Northern dialectic form of I, in Early English, corresponding to ich of the Southern.

moline.definition: The crossed iron that supports the upper millstone by resting on the spindle; a millrind. Cross moline (Her.), a cross each arm of which is divided at the end into two rounded branches or divisions.

walty.definition: Liable to roll over; crank; as, a walty ship. Longfellow.

metaphorical.definition: Of or pertaining to metaphor; comprising a metaphor; not literal; figurative; tropical; as, a metaphorical expression; a metaphorical sense. -- Met`a*phor"ic*al*ly, adv. -- Met`a*phor"ic*al*ness, n.

centrifugal.definition: Tending, or causing, to recede from the center. 2. (Bot.) (a) Expanding first at the summit, and later at the base, as a flower cluster. (b) Having the radicle turned toward the sides of the fruit, as some embryos. Centrifugal force (Mech.), a force whose direction is from a center. Note: When a bod.

pepperer.definition: A grocer; -- formerly so called because he sold pepper.

fullness.definition: The state of being full, or of abounding; abundance; completeness. [Written also fulness.] "In thy presence is fullness of joy." Ps. xvi. 11.

wrymouth.definition: Any one of several species of large, elongated, marine fishes of the genus Cryptacanthodes, especially C. maculatus of the American coast. A whitish variety is called ghostfish.

sylphlike.definition: Like a sylph; airy; graceful. Sometimes a dance . . . Displayed some sylphlike figures in its maze. Byron.

diaeresis.definition: (Gram.)  The separation or resolution of one syllable into two; -- the opposite of synæresis. 2. A mark consisting of two dots [..], placed over the second of two adjacent vowels, to denote that they are to be pronounced as distinct letters; as, coöperate, aërial.

pentandrian.definition: Of or pertaining to the class Pentadria; having five stamens.

potlid.definition: The lid or cover of a pot. Potlid valve, a valve covering a round hole or the end of a pipe or pump barrel, resembling a potlid in form.

pomme.definition: Having the ends terminating in rounded protuberances or single balls; -- said of a cross.

perjurer.definition: One who is guilty of perjury; one who perjures or forswears, in any sense.

contrite.definition: Thoroughly bruised or broken. 2. Broken down with grief and penitence; deeply sorrowful for sin because it is displeasing to God; humbly and thoroughly penitent. A contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise. Ps. li. 17. Be penitent, and for thy fault contrite. Milton. Syn. -- Penitent; repentant;.

wain.definition: A four-wheeled vehicle for the transportation of goods, produce, etc.; a wagon. The wardens see nothing but a wain of hay. Jeffrey. Driving in ponderous wains their household goods to the seashore. Longfellow. 2. A chariot. The Wain. (Astron.) See Charles's Wain, in the Vocabulary. -- Wain rope, a c.

epilogue.definition: (Drama)  A speech or short poem addressed to the spectators and recited by one of the actors, after the conclusion of the play. A good play no epilogue, yet . . . good plays prove the better by the help of good epilogues. Shak. 2. (Rhet.)  The closing part of a discourse, in which the principal matt.

conically.definition: In the form of a cone.

mastication.definition: The act or operation of masticating; chewing, as of food. Mastication is a necessary preparation of solid aliment, without which there can be no good digestion. Arbuthnot.

phoneidoscope.definition: An instrument for studying the motions of sounding bodies by optical means. It consists of a tube across the end of which is stretched a film of soap solution thin enough to give colored bands, the form and position of which are affected by sonorous vibrations.

esox.definition: A genus of fresh-water fishes, including pike and pickerel.

superposable.definition: Capable of being superposed, as one figure upon another.

thetical.definition: Laid down; absolute or positive, as a law. Dr. H. More.

delightable.definition: Capable of delighting; delightful. Many a spice delightable. Rom. of R.

linotype.definition: (a) A kind of typesetting machine which produces castings, each of which corresponds to a line of separate types. By pressing upon keys like those of a typewriter the matrices for one line are properly arranged; the stereotype, or slug, is then cast and planed, and the matrices are returned to their.

gravic.definition: Pertaining to, or causing, gravitation; as, gravic forces; gravic attraction.

okapi.definition: A peculiar mammal (Okapia johnostoni) closely related to the giraffe, discovered in the deep forests of Belgian Kongo in 1900. It is smaller than an ox, and somewhat like a giraffe, except that the neck is much shorter. Like the giraffe, it has no dewclaws. There is a small prominence on each fronta.

polt-foot.definition: Having a distorted foot, or a clubfoot or clubfeet. B. Jonson.

kith.definition: Acquaintance; kindred. And my near kith for sore me shend. W. Browne. The sage of his kith and the hamlet. Longfellow. Kith and kin, kindred more or less remote.

interpetalary.definition: Between the petals of a flower.

quadrisyllable.definition: A word consisting of four syllables. De Quincey.

resinic.definition: Pertaining to, or obtained from, resin; as, the resinic acids.

melancholiness.definition: The state or quality of being melancholy. Hallywell.

sackcloth.definition: Linen or cotton cloth such a sacks are made of; coarse cloth; anciently, a cloth or garment worn in mourning, distress, mortification, or penitence. Gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. 2 Sam. iii. 31. Thus with sackcloth I invest my woe. Sandys.

burglariously.definition: With an intent to commit burglary; in the manner of a burglar. Blackstone.

bluntly.definition: In a blunt manner; coarsely; plainly; abruptly; without delicacy, or the usual forms of civility. Sometimes after bluntly giving his opinions, he would quietly lay himself asleep until the end of their deliberations. Jeffrey.

waterie.definition: The pied wagtail; -- so called because it frequents ponds.

rolly-pooly.definition: A game in which a ball, rolling into a certain place, wins. [Written also rouly-pouly.].

high-raised.definition: Elevated; raised aloft; upreared. 2. Elated with great ideas or hopes. Milton.

planipennia.definition: A suborder of Neuroptera, including those that have broad, flat wings, as the ant-lion, lacewing, etc. Called also Planipennes.

confabulation.definition: Familiar talk; easy, unrestrained, unceremonious conversation. Friends' confabulations are comfortable at all times, as fire in winter. Burton.

polymyoid.definition: Having numerous vocal muscles; of or pertaining to the Polymyodæ.

horntail.definition: Any one of family (Uroceridæ) of large hyminopterous insects, allied to the sawflies. The larvæ bore in the wood of trees. So called from the long, stout ovipositors of the females.

calandine.definition: A perennial herbaceous plant (Chelidonium majus) of the poppy family, with yellow flowers. It is used as a medicine in jandice, etc., and its acrid saffron-colored juice is used to cure warts and the itch; -- called also greater celandine and swallowwort. Lasser celandine, the pilewort (Ranunculus F.

intermedial.definition: Lying between; intervening; intermediate. "Intermedial colors." Evelyn.

melioration.definition: The act or operation of meliorating, or the state of being meliorated; improvement. Bacon.

overtake.definition: To come up with in a course, pursuit, progress, or motion; to catch up with. Follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say . . . Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good. Gen. xliv. 4. He had him overtaken in his flight. Spenser. 2. To come upon from behind; to discover; to surprise; t.

leveler.definition: One who, or that which, levels. 2. One who would remove social inequalities or distinctions; a socialist.

earthly-minded.definition: Having a mind devoted to earthly things; worldly-minded; -- opposed to spiritual-minded. -- Earth"ly-mind`ed*ness, n.

refurnishment.definition: The act of refurnishing, or state of being refurnished. The refurnishment was in a style richer than before. L. Wallace.

sanjak.definition: A district or a subvision of a vilayet. [Turkey].

sphacelate.definition:
To die, decay, or become gangrenous, as flesh or bone; to mortify.

To affect with gangrene.

Affected with gangrene; mortified.

annumerate.definition: To add on; to count in. Wollaston.

parturient.definition: Bringing forth, or about to bring forth, young; fruitful. Jer. Tailor.

contradictory.definition:
Affirming the contrary; implying a denial of what has been asserted; also, mutually contradicting; inconsistent. "Contradictory assertions." South. 2. Opposing or opposed; repugnant. Schemes . . . contradictory to common sense. Addisn.

1. A proposition or thing which denies or opposes another; cont.

aurin.definition: A red coloring matter derived from phenol; -- called also, in commerce, yellow coralin.

intrunk.definition: To inclose as in a trunk; to incase. Ford.

insultment.definition: Insolent treatment; insult. "My speech of insultment ended." Shak.

sausage.definition: An article of food consisting of meat (esp. pork) minced and highly seasoned, and inclosed in a cylindrical case or skin usually made of the prepared intestine of some animal. 2. A saucisson. See Saucisson. Wilhelm.

nap.definition:
To have a short sleep; to be drowsy; to doze. Chaucer. 2. To be in a careless, secure state. Wyclif. I took thee napping, unprepared. Hudibras.

A short sleep; a doze; a siesta. Cowper.

1. Woolly or villous surface of felt, cloth, plants, etc.; an external covering of down, of short fine hairs or f.

calcareous.definition: Partaking of the nature ofcalcite or calcium carbonate; consisting of, or containg, calcium carbonate or carbonate of lime. Clcareous spar. See as Calcite.

sclerema.definition: Induration of the cellular tissue. Sclerema of adults. See Scleroderma. -- Sclerema neonatorum ( Etym: [NL., of the newborn], an affection characterized by a peculiar hardening and rigidity of the cutaneous and subcutaneous tissues in the newly born. It is usually fatal. Called also skinbound diseas.

cocker.definition:
Th treat with too great tenderness; to fondle; to indulge; to pamper. Cocker thy child and he shall make thee afraid. Ecclesiasticus xxx. 9. Poor folks cannot afford to cocker themselves up. J. Ingelow.

1. One given to cockfighting. Steele. 2. (Zoöl.)  A small dog of the spaniel kind, used for star.

polychloride.definition: A chloride containing more than one atom of chlorine in the molecule.

gymnonoti.definition: The order of fishes which includes the Gymnotus or electrical eel. The dorsal fin is wanting.

quadrature.definition: (Math.)  The act of squaring; the finding of a square having the same area as some given curvilinear figure; as, the quadrature of a circle; the operation of finding an expression for the area of a figure bounded wholly or in part by a curved line, as by a curve, two ordinates, and the axis of absci.

udder.definition: (Anat.)  The glandular organ in which milk is secreted and stored; -- popularly called the bag in cows and other quadrupeds. See Mamma. A lioness, with udders all drawn dry. Shak. 2. One of the breasts of a woman. Yon Juno of majestic size, With cowlike udders, and with oxlike eyes. Pope.

posingly.definition: So as to pose or puzzle.

icteroid.definition: Of a tint resembling that produced by jaundice; yellow; as, an icteroid tint or complexion.

scarmoge.definition: A slight contest; a skirmish. See Skirmish. Such cruel game my scarmoges disarms. Spenser.

erectable.definition: Capable of being erected; as, an erectable feather. Col. G. Montagu.

trumpet-shaped.definition: Tubular with one end dilated, as the flower of the trumpet creeper.

samiel.definition: A hot and destructive wind that sometimes blows, in Turkey, from the desert. It is identical with the simoom of Arabia and the kamsin of Syria.

studfish.definition: Any one of several species of small American minnows of the genus Fundulus, as F. catenatus.

emulsive.definition: Softening; milklike. 2. Yielding oil by expression; as, emulsive seeds. 3. Producing or yielding a milklike substance; as, emulsive acids.

lixiviate.definition:
Of or pertaining to lye or lixivium; of the quality of alkaline salts. 2. Impregnated with salts from wood ashes. Boyle.

To subject to a washing process for the purpose of separating soluble material from that which is insoluble; to leach, as ashes, for the purpose of extracting the alkaline substa.

wool-dyed.definition: Dyed before being made into cloth, in distinction from piece- dyed; ingrain.

lactescence.definition: The state or quality of producing milk, or milklike juice; resemblance to milk; a milky color. This lactescence does commonly ensue when . . . fair water is suddenly poured upon the solution. Boyle. 2. (Bot.)  The latex of certain plants. See Latex.

emetical.definition: Inducing to vomit; producing vomiting; emetic. -- E*met"ic*al*ly, adv.

machination.definition: The act of machinating. Shak. 2. That which is devised; a device; a hostile or treacherous scheme; an artful design or plot. Devilish machinations come to naught. Milton. His ingenious machinations had failed. Macaulay.

sheepskin.definition: The skin of a sheep; or, leather prepared from it. 2. A diploma; -- so called because usually written or printed on parchment prepared from the skin of the sheep. [College Cant].
