segmentation.definition: The act or process of dividing into segments; specifically (Biol.), a self-division into segments as a result of growth; cell cleavage; cell multiplication; endogenous cell formation. Segmentation cavity (Biol.), the cavity formed by the arrangement of the cells in segmentation or cleavage of the ov.

quicksilver.definition: The metal mercury; -- so called from its resemblance to liquid silver. Quicksilver horizon, a mercurial artificial horizon. See under Horizon. -- Quicksilver water, a solution of mercury nitrate used in artificial silvering; quick water.

comrade.definition: A mate, companion, or associate. And turned my flying comrades to the charge. J. Baillie. I abjure all roofs, and choose . . . To be a comrade with the wolf and owl. Shak.

disloyal.definition: Not loyal; not true to a sovereign or lawful superior, or to the government under which one lives; false where allegiance is due; faithless; as, a subject disloyal to the king; a husband disloyal to his wife. Without a thought disloyal. Mrs. Browning. Syn. -- Disobedient; faithless; untrue; treacher.

androdiecious.definition: Having perfect and staminate flowers on different plants. -- An`dro*di*o"cism, -di*e"cism (#), n.

dedicate.definition:
Dedicated; set apart; devoted; consecrated. "Dedicate to nothing temporal." Shak. Syn. -- Devoted; consecrated; addicted.

1. To set apart and consecrate, as to a divinity, or for sacred uses; to devote formally and solemnly; as, to dedicate vessels, treasures, a temple, or a church, to a religious.

turbinated.definition: Whirling in the manner of a top. A spiral and turbinated motion of the whole. Bentley. 2. (Bot.)  Shaped like a top, or inverted cone; narrow at the base, and broad at the apex; as, a turbinated ovary, pericarp, or root. 3. (Anat.)  Turbinal. 4. (Zoöl.)  Spiral with the whorls decreasing rapidly fro.

thyrohyoid.definition: Of or pertaining to the thyroid cartilage of the larynx and the hyoid arch.

incrassation.definition: The act or process of thickening or making thick; the process of becoming thick or thicker. 2. The state of being incrassated or made thick; inspissation. Sir T. Browne.

orthid.definition: A brachiopod shell of the genus Orthis, and allied genera, of the family Orthidæ.

phillyrea.definition: A genus of evergreen plants growing along the shores of the Mediterranean, and breading a fruit resembling that of the olive.

pileus.definition: (Rom. Antiq.)  A kind of skull cap of felt. 2. (Bot.)  The expanded upper portion of many of the fungi. See Mushroom. 3. (Zoöl.)  The top of the head of a bird, from the bill to the nape.

color-blind.definition: Affected with color blindness. See Color blindness, under Color, n.

rattle-pated.definition: Rattle-headed. "A noisy, rattle-pated fellow." W. Irving.

righter.definition: One who sets right; one who does justice or redresses wrong. Shelton.

feofor.definition: One who enfeoffs or grants a fee.

seorita.definition: A Spanish title of courtesy given to a young lady; Miss; also, a young lady.

squib.definition: A little pipe, or hollow cylinder of paper, filled with powder or combustible matter, to be thrown into the air while burning, so as to burst there with a crack. Lampoons, like squibs, may make a present blaze. Waller. The making and selling of fireworks, and squibs . . . is punishable. Blackstone.

equableness.definition: Quality or state of being equable.

adipocere.definition: A soft, unctuous, or waxy substance, of a light brown color, into which the fat and muscle tissue of dead bodies sometimes are converted, by long immersion in water or by burial in moist places. It is a result of fatty degeneration.

cest.definition: A woman's girdle; a cestus. Collins.

flytting.definition: Contention; strife; scolding; specif., a kind of metrical contest between two persons, popular in Scotland in the 16th century. [Obs. or Scot.] These "flytings" consisted of alternate torrents of sheer Billingsgate poured upon each other by the combatants. Saintsbury.

involucrum.definition: (Bot.)  See Involucre. 2. (Zoöl.)  A sheath which surrounds the base of the lasso cells in the Siphonophora.

confessor.definition: One who confesses; one who acknowledges a fault, or the truth of a charge, at the risk of suffering; specifically, one who confesses himself a follower of Christ and endures persecution for his faith. He who dies for religion is a martyr; he who suffers for it is a confessor. Latham. Our religion wh.

sarcorhamphi.definition: A division of raptorial birds composing the vultures.

hypostome.definition: The lower lip of trilobites, crustaceans, etc.

vaginitis.definition: Inflammation of the vagina, or the genital canal, usually of its mucous living membrane.

kerchief.definition: A square of fine linen worn by women as a covering for the head; hence, anything similar in form or material, worn for ornament on other parts of the person; -- mostly used in compounds; as, neckerchief; breastkerchief; and later, handkerchief. He might put on a hat, a muffler, and a kerchief, and s.

dolabra.definition: A rude ancient ax or hatchet, seen in museums.

stapes.definition: The innermost of the ossicles of the ear; the stirrup, or stirrup bone; -- so called from its form. See Illust. of Ear.

homogenous.definition: Having a resemblance in structure, due to descent from a common progenitor with subsequent modification; homogenetic; -- applied both to animals and plants. See Homoplastic.

smerky.definition: Smart; jaunty; spruce. See Smirk, a. So smerk, so smooth, his pricked ears. Spenser.

pragmatic.definition: Of or pertaining to business or to affairs; of the nature of business; practical; material; businesslike in habit or manner. The next day . . . I began to be very pragmatical. Evelyn. We can not always be contemplative, diligent, or pragmatical, abroad; but have need of some delightful intermissions.

pinnipedia.definition: A suborder of aquatic carnivorous mammals including the seals and walruses; -- opposed to Fissipedia.

discriminant.definition: The eliminant of the n partial differentials of any homogenous function of n variables. See Eliminant.

hsien.definition: An administrative subdivision of a fu, or department, or of an independent chow; also, the seat of government of such a district.

grabble.definition: To grope; to feel with the hands. He puts his hands into his pockets, and keeps a grabbling and fumbling. Selden. 2. To lie prostrate on the belly; to sprawl on the ground; to grovel. Ainsworth.

intentioned.definition: Having designs; -- chiefly used in composition; as, well- intentioned, having good designs; ill-intentioned, having ill designs.

dinginess.definition: Quality of being dingy; a dusky hue.

renowned.definition: Famous; celebrated for great achievements, for distinguished qualities, or for grandeur; eminent; as, a renowned king. "Some renowned metropolis with glistering spires." Milton. These were the renouwned of the congregation. Num. i. 61. Syn. -- Famous; famed; distinguished; noted; eminent; celebrated.

interrenal.definition: Between the kidneys; as, the interrenal body, an organ found in many fishes. -- n.  The interrenal body.

dossier.definition: A bundle containing the papers in reference to some matter.

vedro.definition: A Russian liquid measure, equal to 3.249 gallons of U.S. standard measure, or 2.706 imperial gallons. McElrath.

nominative.definition: Giving a name; naming; designating; -- said of that case or form of a noun which stands as the subject of a finite verb. -- n.  The nominative case.

smorzando.definition: Growing gradually fainter and softer; dying away; morendo.

ambigenous.definition: Of two kinds. (Bot.)  Partaking of two natures, as the perianth of some endogenous plants, where the outer surface is calycine, and the inner petaloid.

pittle-pattle.definition: To talk unmeaningly; to chatter or prattle. Latimer.

extraprofessional.definition: Foreign to a profession; not within the ordinary limits of professional duty or business.

talma.definition: (a) A kind of large cape, or short, full cloak, forming part of the dress of ladies. (b) A similar garment worn formerly by gentlemen.

supersphenoidal.definition: Situated above, or on the dorsal side of, the body of the sphenoid bone.

toxin.definition: A poisonous product formed by pathogenic bacteria, as a toxic proteid or poisonous ptomaine.

impave.definition: To pave. [Poetic] Impaved with rude fidelity Of art mosaic. Wordsworth.

cachectical.definition: Having, or pertaining to, cachexia; as, cachectic remedies; cachectical blood. Arbuthnot.

daira.definition: Any of several valuable estates of the Egyptian khedive or his family. The most important are the Da"i*ra Sa"ni*eh, or Sa"ni*yeh, and the Da"i*ra Khas"sa, administered by the khedive's European bondholders, and known collectively as the Daira, or the Daira estates.

insolidity.definition: Want of solidity; weakness; as, the insolidity of an argument. Dr. H. More.

spontaneous.definition: Proceding from natural feeling, temperament, or disposition, or from a native internal proneness, readiness, or tendency, without constraint; as, a spontaneous gift or proportion. 2. Proceeding from, or acting by, internal impulse, energy, or natural law, without external force; as, spontaneous moti.

lamellate.definition: Composed of, or furnished with, thin plates or scales. See Illust. of Antennæ.

assuredly.definition: Certainly; indubitably. "The siege assuredly I'll raise." Shak.

shearwater.definition: Any one of numerous species of long-winged oceanic birds of the genus Puffinus and related genera. They are allied to the petrels, but are larger. The Manx shearwater (P. Anglorum), the dusky shearwater (P. obscurus), and the greater shearwater (P. major), are well-known species of the North Atlanti.

hough.definition:
(a) The joint in the hind limb of quadrupeds between the leg and shank, or tibia and tarsus, and corresponding to the ankle in man. (b) A piece cut by butchers, esp. in pork, from either the front or hind leg, just above the foot. 2. The popliteal space; the ham.

Same as Hock, a joint.

Same as Hoc.

sallowness.definition: The quality or condition of being sallow. Addison.

tapestry.definition: A fabric, usually of worsted, worked upon a warp of linen or other thread by hand, the designs being usually more or less pictorial and the stuff employed for wall hangings and the like. The term is also applied to different kinds of embroidery. Tapestry carpet, a kind of carpet, somewhat resembling.

futureless.definition: Without prospect of betterment in the future. W. D. Howells.

emotion.definition: A moving of the mind or soul; excitement of the feelings, whether pleasing or painful; disturbance or agitation of mind caused by a specific exciting cause and manifested by some sensible effect on the body. How different the emotions between departure and return! W. Irving. Some vague emotion of de.

pentacle.definition: A figure composed of two equilateral triangles intersecting so as to form a six-pointed star, -- used in early ornamental art, and also with superstitious import by the astrologers and mystics of the Middle Ages.

mucin.definition: (Bot. Chem.)  See Mucedin. 2. (Physiol. Chem.)  An albuminoid substance which is contained in mucus, and gives to the latter secretion its peculiar ropy character. It is found in all the secretions from mucous glands, and also between the fibers of connective tissue, as in tendons. See Illust. of De.

retract.definition: To draw back; to draw up or shorten; as, the cat can retract its claws; to retract a muscle. 2. Ti withdraw; to recall; to disavow; to recant; to take back; as, to retract an accusation or an assertion. I would as freely have retracted this charge of idolatry as I ever made it. Bp. Stillingfleet. 3.

conciliatory.definition: Tending to conciliate; pacific; mollifying; propitiating. The only alternative, therefore, was to have recourse to the conciliatory policy. Prescott.

preyer.definition: One who, or that which, preys; a plunderer; a waster; a devourer. Hooker.

dispersive.definition: Tending to disperse. Dispersive power (Opt.), the relative effect of a material in separating the different rays of light by refraction, as when the substance is formed into a prism. -- Dis*pers"ive*ness, n.

drawgloves.definition: An old game, played by holding up the fingers. Herrick.

remunerate.definition: To pay an equivalent to for any service, loss, expense, or other sacrifice; to recompense; to requite; as, to remunerate men for labor. Syn. -- To reward; recompense; compensate; satisfy; requite; repay; pay; reimburse.

andesite.definition: An eruptive rock allied to trachyte, consisting essentially of a triclinic feldspar, with pyroxene, hornblende, or hypersthene.

belamour.definition: A lover. Spenser. 2. A flower, but of what kind is unknown. Her snowy brows, like budded belamours. Spenser.

inequilobate.definition: Unequally lobed; cut into lobes of different shapes or sizes.

telerythin.definition: A red crystalline compound related to, or produced from, erythrin. So called because regarded as the end of the series of erythrin compounds.

catechist.definition: One who instructs by question and answer, especially in religions matters.

bicarburetted.definition: Containing two atoms or equivalents of carbon in the molecule. [Obs. or R.].

mundic.definition: Iron pyrites, or arsenical pyrites; -- so called by the Cornish miners.

agreeableness.definition: The quality of being agreeable or pleasing; that quality which gives satisfaction or moderate pleasure to the mind or senses. That author . . . has an agreeableness that charms us. Pope. 2. The quality of being agreeable or suitable; suitableness or conformity; consistency. The agreeableness of virt.

chiromancy.definition: The art or practice of foretelling events, or of telling the fortunes or the disposition of persons by inspecting the hand; palmistry.

undone.definition:
p. p. of Undo.

Not done or performed; neglected.

awakening.definition:
Rousing from sleep, in a natural or a figurative sense; rousing into activity; exciting; as, the awakening city; an awakening discourse; the awakening dawn. -- A*wak"en*ing*ly, adv.

The act of awaking, or ceasing to sleep. Specifically: A revival of religion, or more general attention to religious.

foraminifera.definition: An extensive order of rhizopods which generally have a chambered calcareous shell formed by several united zooids. Many of them have perforated walls, whence the name. Some species are covered with sand. See Rhizophoda.

arroba.definition: A Spanish weight used in Mexico and South America = 25.36 lbs. avoir.; also, an old Portuguese weight, used in Brazil = 32.38 lbs. avoir. 2. A Spanish liquid measure for wine = 3.54 imp. gallons, and for oil = 2.78 imp. gallons.

charioteer.definition: One who drives a chariot. 2. (Astron.)  A constellation. See Auriga, and Wagones.

tadpole.definition: (Zoöl.)  The young aquatic larva of any amphibian. In this stage it breathes by means of external or internal gills, is at first destitute of legs, and has a finlike tail. Called also polliwig, polliwog, porwiggle, or purwiggy. 2. (Zoöl.)  The hooded merganser. [Local, U.S.] Tadpole fish. (Zoöl.) Se.

fritter.definition: A small quantity of batter, fried in boiling lard or in a frying pan. Fritters are of various kinds, named from the substance inclosed in the batter; as, apple fritters, clam fritters, oyster fritters. 2. A fragment; a shred; a small piece. And cut whole giants into fritters. Hudibras. Corn fritter.

infraterritorial.definition: Within the territory of a state. Story.

roguish.definition: Vagrant. Spenser. His roguish madness Allows itself to anything. Shak. 2. Resembling, or characteristic of, a rogue; knavish. 3. Pleasantly mischievous; waggish; arch. The most bewitching leer with her eyes, the most roguish cast. Dryden. -- Rogu"ish*ly, adv. -- Rogu"ish*ness, n.

costumer.definition: One who makes or deals in costumes, as for theaters, fancy balls, etc.

cacoethes.definition: A bad custom or habit; an insatiable desire; as, cacoëthes scribendi, "The itch for writing". Addison. 2. (Med.)  A bad quality or disposition in a disease; an incurable ulcer.

maintainor.definition: One who, not being interested, maintains a cause depending between others, by furnishing money, etc., to either party. Bouvier. Wharton.

naughtily.definition: In a naughty manner; wickedly; perversely. Shak.

unright.definition:
Not right; wrong. Gower.

A wrong. Nor did I you never unright. Chaucer.

To cause (something right) to become wrong. Gower.

postponement.definition: The act of postponing; a deferring, or putting off, to a future time; a temporary delay. Macaulay.

parochiality.definition: The state of being parochial. Sir J. Marriot.

gemmuliferous.definition: Bearing or producing gemmules or buds.

bespangle.definition: To adorn with spangles; to dot or sprinkle with something brilliant or glittering. The grass . . . is all bespangled with dewdrops. Cowper.

onychia.definition: (a) A whitlow. (b) An affection of a finger or toe, attended with ulceration at the base of the nail, and terminating in the destruction of the nail.

heterogangliate.definition: Having the ganglia of the nervous system unsymmetrically arranged; -- said of certain invertebrate animals.

economizer.definition: One who, or that which, economizes. 2. Specifically: (Steam Boilers) An arrangement of pipes for heating feed water by waste heat in the gases passing to the chimney.

fellow-commoner.definition: A student at Cambridge University, England, who commons, or dines, at the Fellow's table.

brob.definition: A peculiar brad-shaped spike, to be driven alongside the end of an abutting timber to prevent its slipping.

decalogue.definition: The Ten Commandments or precepts given by God to Moses on Mount Sinai, and originally written on two tables of stone.

subalternant.definition: A universal proposition. See Subaltern, 2. Whately.

tiger-eye.definition: A siliceous stone of a yellow color and chatoyant luster, obtained in South Africa and much used for ornament. It is an altered form of the mineral crocidolite. See Crocidolite.

hexapoda.definition: The true, or six-legged, insects; insects other than myriapods and arachnids. Note: The Hexapoda have the head, thorax, and abdomen differentiated, and are mostly winged. They have three pairs of mouth organs, viz., mandibles, maxillæ, and the second maxillæ or labial palpi; three pairs of thoracic.

tare.definition:
Tore.

1. A weed that grows among wheat and other grain; -- alleged by modern naturalists to be the Lolium temulentum, or darnel. Didst not thou sow good seed in thy field From whence then hath it tares Matt. xiii. 27. The "darnel" is said to be the tares of Scripture, and is the only deleterious sp.

attributable.definition: Capable of being attributed; ascribable; imputable. Errors . . . attributable to carelessness. J. D. Hooker.

creak.definition:
To make a prolonged sharp grating or ssqueaking sound, as by the friction of hard substances; as, shoes creak. The creaking locusts with my voice conspire. Dryden. Doors upon their hinges creaked. Tennyson.

To produce a creaking sound with. Creaking my shoes on the plain masonry. Shak.

Thew sound.

testicular.definition: Of or pertaining to the testicle.

blickey.definition: A tin dinner pail. [Local, U. S.] Bartlett.

prehnite.definition: A pale green mineral occurring in crystalline aggregates having a botryoidal or mammillary structure, and rarely in distinct crystals. It is a hydrous silicate of alumina and lime.

acetify.definition:
To convert into acid or vinegar.

To turn acid. Encyc. Dom. Econ.

infame.definition: To defame; to make infamous. Milton. Livia is infamed for the poisoning of her husband. Bacon.

admonitor.definition: Admonisher; monitor. Conscience is at most times a very faithful and prudent admonitor. Shenstone.

decardinalize.definition: To depose from the rank of cardinal.

fin-footed.definition: (a) Having palmate feet. (b) Having lobate toes, as the coot and grebe.

lussheburgh.definition: A spurious coin of light weight imported into England from Luxemburg, or Lussheburgh, as it was formerly called. God wot, no Lussheburghes payen ye. Chaucer.

turriculate.definition: Furnished with, or formed like, a small turret or turrets; somewhat turreted.

brokenly.definition: In a broken, interrupted manner; in a broken state; in broken language. The pagans worship God . . . as it were brokenly and by piecemeal. Cudworth.

pusher.definition: One who, or that which, pushes.

quintic.definition: Of the fifth degree or order. -- n. (Alg.)  A quantic of the fifth degree. See Quantic.

religieux.definition: A person bound by monastic vows; a nun; a monk.

probe-pointed.definition: Having a blunt or button-shaped extremity; -- said of cutting instruments.

idealogue.definition: One given to fanciful ideas or theories; a theorist; a spectator. Mrs. Browning.

permissibility.definition: The quality of being permissible; permissibleness; allowableness.

techiness.definition: The quality or state of being techy.

sporangiophore.definition: The axis or receptacle in certain ferns (as Trichomanes), which bears the sporangia.

appreciable.definition: Capable of being appreciated or estimated; large enough to be estimated; perceptible; as, an appreciable quantity. -- Ap*pre"ci*a*bly, adv.

listerism.definition: The systematic use of antiseptics in the performance of operations and the treatment of wounds; -- so called from Joseph Lister, an English surgeon.

cluniac.definition: A monk of the reformed branch of the Benedictine Order, founded in 912 at Cluny (or Clugny) in France. -- Also used as a.

philoprogenitive.definition: Having the love of offspring; fond of children.

hagdon.definition: One of several species of sea birds of the genus Puffinus; esp., P. major, the greater shearwarter, and P. Stricklandi, the black hagdon or sooty shearwater; -- called also hagdown, haglin, and hag. See Shearwater.

amusive.definition: Having power to amuse or entertain the mind; fitted to excite mirth. -- A*mu"sive*ly, adv. -- A*mu"sive*ness, n.

querist.definition: One who inquires, or asks questions. Swift.

distal.definition: (a) Remote from the point of attachment or origin; as, the distal end of a bone or muscle; -- opposed to proximal. (b) Pertaining to that which is distal; as, the distal tuberosities of a bone.

infernal.definition: Of or pertaining to or suitable for the lower regions, inhabited, according to the ancients, by the dead; pertaining to Pluto's realm of the dead, the Tartarus of the ancients. The Elysian fields, the infernal monarchy. Garth. 2. Of or pertaining to, resembling, or inhabiting, hell; suitable for hel.

stockjobbing.definition: The act or art of dealing in stocks; the business of a stockjobber.

congregate.definition:
Collected; compact; close. Bacon.

To collect into an assembly or assemblage; to assemble; to bring into one place, or into a united body; to gather together; to mass; to compact. Any multitude of Christian men congregated may be termed by the name of a church. Hooker. Cold congregates all bodies. C.

protectorate.definition: Government by a protector; -- applied especially to the government of England by Oliver Cromwell. 2. The authority assumed by a superior power over an inferior or a dependent one, whereby the former protects the latter from invasion and shares in the management of its affairs.

chrysalis.definition: The pupa state of certain insects, esp. of butterflies, from which the perfect insect emerges. See Pupa, and Aurelia (a).

crinital.definition: Same as Crinite, 1. He the star crinital adoreth. Stanyhurst.

grossly.definition: In a gross manner; greatly; coarsely; without delicacy; shamefully; disgracefully.

wither.definition: To fade; to lose freshness; to become sapless; to become sapless; to dry or shrivel up. Shall he hot pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither Ezek. xvii. 9. 2. To lose or want animal moisture; to waste; to pin This is man, old, wrinkled, faded, withered. Shak. There w.

parthenogenesis.definition: (Biol.)  The production of new individuals from virgin females by means of ova which have the power of developing without the intervention of the male element; the production, without fertilization, of cells capable of germination. It is one of the phenomena of alternate generation. Cf. Heterogamy,.

aerocurve.definition: A modification of the aëroplane, having curved surfaces, the advantages of which were first demonstrated by Lilienthal.

do-all.definition: General manager; factotum. Under him, Dunstan was the do-all at court, being the king's treasurer, councilor, chancellor, confessor, all things. Fuller.

celandine.definition: A perennial herbaceous plant (Chelidonium majus) of the poppy family, with yellow flowers. It is used as a medicine in jandice, etc., and its acrid saffron-colored juice is used to cure warts and the itch; -- called also greater celandine and swallowwort. Lasser celandine, the pilewort (Ranunculus F.

referment.definition:
The act of referring; reference. Laud.

To ferment, or cause to ferment, again. Blackmore.

difflation.definition: A blowing apart or away. Bailey.

hallage.definition: A fee or toll paid for goods sold in a hall.

impure.definition: Not pure; not clean; dirty; foul; filthy; containing something which is unclean or unwholesome; mixed or impregnated extraneous substances; adulterated; as, impure water or air; impure drugs, food, etc. 2. Defiled by sin or guilt; unholy; unhallowed; -- said of persons or things. 3. Unchaste; lewd;.

storeship.definition: A vessel used to carry naval stores for a fleet, garrison, or the like.

picrite.definition: A dark green igneous rock, consisting largely of chrysolite, with hornblende, augite, biotite, etc.

wonders.definition: See Wondrous. They be wonders glad thereof. Sir T. More.

exemplifier.definition: One who exemplifies by following a pattern.

jubilant.definition: Uttering songs of triumph; shouting with joy; triumphant; exulting. "The jubilant age." Coleridge. While the bright pomp ascended jubilant. Milton.

blotter.definition: One who, or that which blots; esp. a device for absorbing superfluous ink. 2. (Com.)  A wastebook, in which entries of transactions are made as they take place.

plumber.definition: One who works in lead; esp., one who furnishes, fits, and repairs lead, iron, or glass pipes, and other apparatus for the conveyance of water, gas, or drainage in buildings.

astatki.definition: A thick liquid residuum obtained in the distillation of Russian petroleum, much used as fuel.

lusty.definition: Exhibiting lust or vigor; stout; strong; vigorous; robust; healthful; able of body. Neither would their old men, so many as were yet vigorous and lusty, be left at home. Milton. 2. Beautiful; handsome; pleasant. Spenser. 3. Of large size; big. " Three lusty vessels." Evelyn. Hence, sometimes, pregna.

slapper.definition:
One who, or that which, slaps. 2. Anything monstrous; a whopper. [Slang] Grose.

Very large; monstrous; big. [Slang.].

prink.definition:
To dress or adjust one's self for show; to prank.

To prank or dress up; to deck fantastically. "And prink their hair with daisies." Cowper.

accretive.definition: Relating to accretion; increasing, or adding to, by growth. Glanvill.

norse.definition:
Of or pertaining to ancient Scandinavia, or to the language spoken by its inhabitants.

The Norse language.

electro-metric.definition: Pertaining to electrometry; made by means of electrometer; as, an electrometrical experiment.

gleba.definition: The chambered sporogenous tissue forming the central mass of the sporophore in puff balls, stinkhorns, etc.

baken.definition: p. p. of Bake. [Obs. or. Archaic].

impark.definition: To inclose for a park; to sever from a common; hence, to inclose or shut up. They . . . impark them [the sheep] within hurdles. Holland.

mistrial.definition: A false or erroneous trial; a trial which has no result.

helispherical.definition: Spiral. Helispherical line (Math.). the rhomb line in navigation.

cosmogonist.definition: One who treats of the origin of the universe; one versed in cosmogony.

nilometer.definition: An instrument for measuring the rise of water in the Nile during its periodical flood.

archival.definition: Pertaining to, or contained in, archives or records. Tooke.

deduct.definition: To lead forth or out. A people deducted out of the city of Philippos. Udall. 2. To take away, separate, or remove, in numbering, estimating, or calculating; to subtract; -- often with from or out of. Deduct what is but vanity, or dress. Pope. Two and a half per cent should be deducted out of the pay.

intervert.definition: To turn to another course or use. Sir H. Wotton.

watermark.definition: A mark indicating the height to which water has risen, or at which it has stood; the usual limit of high or low water. 2. A letter, device, or the like, wrought into paper during the process of manufacture. Note: "The watermark in paper is produced by bending the wires of the mold, or by wires bent.

pheasantry.definition: A place for keeping and rearing pheasants. Gwilt.

tailboard.definition: The board at the rear end of a cart or wagon, which can be removed or let down, for convenience in loading or unloading.

ungodly.definition: Not godly; not having regard for God; disobedient to God; wicked; impious; sinful. 2. Polluted by sin or wickedness. The hours of this ungodly day. Shak. -- Un*god"li*ly, adv. -- Un*god"li*ness, n.

vender.definition: One who vends; one who transfers the exclusive right of possessing a thing, either his own, or that of another as his agent, for a price or pecuniary equivalent; a seller; a vendor.

dogged.definition: Sullen; morose. [Obs. or R.] The sulky spite of a temper naturally dogged. Sir W. Scott. 2. Sullenly obstinate; obstinately determined or persistent; as, dogged resolution; dogged work.

querl.definition:
To twirl; to turn or wind round; to coil; as, to querl a cord, thread, or rope. [Local, U.S.]

A coil; a twirl; as, the qwerl of hair on the fore leg of a blooded horse. [Local, U. S.].

wadmol.definition: A coarse, hairy, woolen cloth, formerly used for garments by the poor, and for various other purposes. [Spelled also wadmal, wadmeal, wadmoll, wadmel, etc.] Beck (Draper's Dict.). Sir W. Scott.

axinite.definition: A borosilicate of alumina, iron, and lime, commonly found in glassy, brown crystals with acute edges.

calcography.definition: The art of drawing with chalk.

quixotism.definition: That form of delusion which leads to extravagant and absurd undertakings or sacrifices in obedience to a morbidly romantic ideal of duty or honor, as illustrated by the exploits of Don Quixote in knight-errantry.

tryptic.definition: Relating to trypsin or to its action; produced by trypsin; as, trypsin digestion.

grind.definition: To reduce to powder by friction, as in a mill, or with the teeth; to crush into small fragments; to produce as by the action of millstones. Take the millstones, and grind meal. Is. xivii. 2. 2. To wear down, polish, or sharpen, by friction; to make smooth, sharp, or pointed; to whet, as a knife or d.

hypermeter.definition: (Pros.)  A verse which has a redundant syllable or foot; a hypercatalectic verse. 2. Hence, anything exceeding the ordinary standard. When a man rises beyond six foot, he is an hypermeter. Addison.

conundrum.definition: A kind of riddle based upon some fanciful or fantastic resemblance between things quite unlike; a puzzling question, of which the answer is or involves a pun. Or pun ambiguous, or conundrum quaint. J. Philips. 2. A question to which only a conjectural answer can be made. Do you think life is long en.

deferrer.definition: One who defers or puts off.

somatopleure.definition: The outer, or parietal, one of the two lamellæ into which the vertebrate blastoderm divides on either side of the notochord, and from which the walls of the body and the amnion are developed. See Splanchopleure.

gynaecophore.definition: A ventral canal or groove, in which the males of some dioecious trematodes carry the female. See Illust. of Hæmatozoa.

charbon.definition: (Far.)  A small black spot or mark remaining in the cavity of the corner tooth of a horse after the large spot or mark has become obliterated. 2. A very contagious and fatal disease of sheep, horses, and cattle. See Maligmant pustule.

hydric.definition: Pertaining to, or containing, hydrogen; as, hydric oxide. Hydric dioxide. (Chem.) See Hydrogen dioxide, under Hydrogen. -- Hydric oxide (Chem.), water. -- Hydric sulphate (Chem.), hydrogen sulphate or sulphuric acid.

ore.definition:
Honor; grace; favor; mercy; clemency; happy augry. Chaucer.

1. The native form of a metal, whether free and uncombined, as gold, copper, etc., or combined, as iron, lead, etc. Usually the ores contain the metals combined with oxygen, sulphur, arsenic, etc. (called mineralizers). 2. (Mining)  A nati.

matchmaker.definition: One who makes matches for burning or kinding. 2. One who tries to bring about marriages.

burly.definition: Having a large, strong, or gross body; stout; lusty; -- now used chiefly of human beings, but formerly of animals, in the sense of stately or beautiful, and of inanimate things that were huge and bulky. "Burly sacks." Drayton. In his latter days, with overliberal diet, [he was] somewhat corpulent an.

amoroso.definition:
A lover; a man enamored.

In a soft, tender, amatory style.

caducity.definition: Tendency to fall; the feebleness of old age; senility. [A] jumble of youth and caducity. Chesterfield.

plumbous.definition: Of, pertaining to, or containing, lead; -- used specifically to designate those compounds in which it has a lower valence as contrasted with plumbic compounds.

appellativeness.definition: The quality of being appellative. Fuller.

spicate.definition: Having the form of a spike, or ear; arranged in a spike or spikes. Lee.

renouncement.definition: The act of disclaiming or rejecting; renunciation. Shak.

unconning.definition: Not knowing; ignorant. Chaucer. -- n.  Ignorance.

deviator.definition: One who, or that which, deviates.

petechial.definition: Characterized by, or pertaining to, petechiæ; spotted. Petechial fever, a malignant fever, accompanied with livid spots on the skin.

planimeter.definition: An instrument for measuring the area of any plane figure, however irregular, by passing a tracer around the bounding line; a platometer.

phyllopodous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Phyllopoda.

cucullate.definition: Hooded; cowled; covered, as with a hood. Sir T. Browne. 2. (Bot.)  Having the edges toward the base rolled inward, as the leaf of the commonest American blue violet. 3. (Zoöl.) (a) Having the prothorax elevated so as to form a sort of hood, receiving the head, as in certain insects. (b) Having a hoo.

edgewise.definition: With the edge towards anything; in the direction of the edge. Glad to get in a word, as they say, edgeways. Sir W. Scott.

gravimeter.definition: (Physics) An instrument for ascertaining the specific gravity of bodies.

homogeneousness.definition: Sameness 9kind or nature; uniformity of structure or material.

potman.definition: A pot companion. Life of A. Wood (1663). 2. A servant in a public house; a potboy.

pharyngotomy.definition: (a) The operation of making an incision into the pharynx, to remove a tumor or anything that obstructs the passage. (b) Scarification or incision of the tonsils.

arquated.definition: Shaped like a bow; arcuate; curved.

crouch.definition: To bend down; to stoop low; to lie close to the ground with the logs bent, as an animal when waiting for prey, or in fear. Now crouch like a cur. Beau. & Fl. 2. To bend servilely; to stoop meanly; to fawn; to cringe. "A crouching purpose." Wordsworth. Must I stand and crouch Under your testy humor S.

indemnity.definition: Security; insurance; exemption from loss or damage, past or to come; immunity from penalty, or the punishment of past offenses; amnesty. Having first obtained a promise of indemnity for the riot they had committed. Sir W. Scott. 2. Indemnification, compensation, or remuneration for loss, damage, or.

kiefekil.definition: A species of clay; meerschaum. [Also written keffekil.].

mandil.definition: A loose outer garment worn the 16th and 17th centuries.

wheelwork.definition: A combination of wheels, and their connection, in a machine or mechanism.

reflower.definition: To flower, or cause to flower, again. Sylvester.

postremote.definition: More remote in subsequent time or order.

fundholder.definition: One who has money invested in the public funds. J. S. Mill.

embillow.definition: To swell or heave like a Lisle.

moneran.definition: Of or pertaining to the Monera. -- n.  One of the Monera.

verticillated.definition: Arranged in a transverse whorl or whorls like the rays of a wheel; as, verticillate leaves of a plant; a verticillate shell.

reins.definition: The kidneys; also, the region of the kidneys; the loins. 2. The inward impulses; the affections and passions; -- so called because formerly supposed to have their seat in the part of the body where the kidneys are. My reins rejoice, when thy lips speak right things. Prov. xxiii. 16. I am he which se.

laciniate.definition: Fringed; having a fringed border. 2. (Bot. & Zoöl.)  Cut into deep, narrow, irregular lobes; slashed.

mesophloeum.definition: The middle bark of a tree; the green layer of bark, usually soon covered by the outer or corky layer, and obliterated.

hammer-less.definition: Without a visible hammer; -- said of a gun having a cock or striker concealed from sight, and out of the way of an accidental touch.

ringlet.definition: A small ring; a small circle; specifically, a fairy ring. You demi-puppets, that By moonshine do the green sour ringlets make, Whereof the ewe not bites. Shak. 2. A curl; especially, a curl of hair. [Her golden tresses] in wanton ringlets waved. Milton.

gurt.definition: A gutter or channel for water, hewn out of the bottom of a working drift. Page.

detersive.definition: Cleansing; detergent. -- n.  A cleansing agent; a detergent.

lactiferous.definition: Bearing or containing milk or a milky fluid; as, the lactiferous vessels, cells, or tissue of various vascular plants.

bisulphate.definition: A sulphate in which but half the hydrogen of the acid is replaced by a positive element or radical, thus making the proportion of the acid to the positive or basic portion twice what it is in the normal sulphates; an acid sulphate.

extraneity.definition: State of being without or beyond a thing; foreignness.

rewin.definition: To win again, or win back. The Palatinate was not worth the rewinning. Fuller.

fraught.definition:
A freight; a cargo. Shak.

Freighted; laden; filled; stored; charged. A vessel of our country richly fraught. Shak. A discourse fraught with all the commending excellences oSouth. Enterprises fraught with world-wide benefits. I. Taylor.

To freight; to load; to burden; to fill; to crowd. Upon the tu.

stulm.definition: A shaft or gallery to drain a mine. [Local, Eng.] Bailey.

excrescential.definition: Pertaining to, or resembling, an excrescence. Hawthorne.

atrocity.definition: Enormous wickedness; extreme heinousness or cruelty. 2. An atrocious or extremely cruel deed. The atrocities which attend a victory. Macaulay.

breezy.definition: Characterized by, or having, breezes; airy. "A breezy day in May." Coleridge. 'Mid lawns and shades by breezy rivulets fanned. Wordsworth. 2. Fresh; brisk; full of life.

plenipotentiary.definition:
A person invested with full power to transact any business; especially, an ambassador or envoy to a foreign court, with full power to negotiate a treaty, or to transact other business.

Containing or conferring full power; invested with full power; as, plenipotentiary license; plenipotentiary minist.

corniform.definition: Having the shape of a horn; horn-shaped.

dungy.definition: Full of dung; filthy; vile; low. Shak.

unclasp.definition: To loose the clasp of; to open, as something that is fastened, or as with, a clasp; as, to unclasp a book; to unclasp one's heart.

parasol.definition:
A kind of small umbrella used by women as a protection from the sun.

To shade as with a parasol.

biologist.definition: A student of biology; one versed in the science of biology.

deligation.definition: A binding up; a bandaging. Wiseman.

cornish.definition:
Of or pertaining to Cornwall, in England. Cornish chough. See Chough. -- Cornish engine, a single-acting pumping engine, used in mines, in Cornwall and elsewhere, and for water works. A heavy pump rod or plunger, raised by the steam, forces up the water by its weight, in descending.

The dialect, or.

gleamy.definition: Darting beams of light; casting light in rays; flashing; coruscating. In brazed arms, that cast a gleamy ray, Swift through the town the warrior bends his way. Pope.

inoffensive.definition: Giving no offense, or provocation; causing no uneasiness, annoyance, or disturbance; as, an inoffensive man, answer, appearance. 2. Harmless; doing no injury or mischief. Dryden. 3. Not obstructing; presenting no interruption bindrance. Milton. So have Iseen a river gintly glide In a smooth course,.

seedlop.definition: A vessel in which a sower carries the seed to be scattered.

redeemableness.definition: The quality or state of being redeemable; redeemability.

succory.definition: A plant of the genus Cichorium. See Chicory.

birchen.definition: Of or relating to birch. He passed where Newark's stately tower Looks out from Yarrow's birchen bower. Sir W. Scott.

organically.definition: In an organic manner; by means of organs or with reference to organic functions; hence, fundamentally. Gladstone.

commanding.definition: Exercising authority; actually in command; as, a commanding officer. 2. Fitted to impress or control; as, a commanding look or presence. 3. Exalted; overlooking; having superior strategic advantages; as, a commanding position. Syn. -- Authoritative; imperative; imperious.

hemadromometry.definition: The act of measuring the velocity with which the blood circulates in the arteries; hæmotachometry.

ara.definition:
The Altar; a southern constellation, south of the tail of the Scorpion.

A name of the great blue and yellow macaw (Ara ararauna), native of South America.

piperazin.definition: A crystalline substance, (C2H4NH)2, formed by action of ammonia on ethylene bromide, by reduction of pyrazine, etc. It is a strong base, and is used as a remedy for gout.

foretaster.definition: One who tastes beforehand, or before another.

cawky.definition: Of or pertaining to cawk; like cawk.

sorbite.definition: A sugarlike substance, isomeric with mannite and dulcite, found with sorbin in the ripe berries of the sorb, and extracted as a sirup or a white crystalline substance. -- Sor*bit"ic, a.

dextrose.definition: A sirupy, or white crystalline, variety of sugar, C6H12O6 (so called from turning the plane of polarization to the right), occurring in many ripe fruits. Dextrose and levulose are obtained by the inversion of cane sugar or sucrose, and hence called invert sugar. Dextrose is chiefly obtained by the a.

guara.definition: (a) The scarlet ibis. See Ibis. (b) A large-maned wild dog of South America (Canis jubatus) -- named from its cry.

fatigue.definition: Weariness from bodily labor or mental exertion; lassitude or exhaustion of strength. 2. The cause of weariness; labor; toil; as, the fatigues of war. Dryden. 3. The weakening of a metal when subjected to repeated vibrations or strains. Fatigue call (Mil.), a summons, by bugle or drum, to perform fat.

homiletical.definition: Of or pertaining to familiar intercourse; social; affable; conversable; companionable. His virtues active, chiefly, and homiletical, not those lazy, sullen ones of the cloister. Atterbury. 2. Of or pertaining to homiletics; hortatory.

enargite.definition: An iron-black mineral of metallic luster, occurring in small orthorhombic crystals, also massive. It contains sulphur, arsenic, copper, and often silver.

asiphonida.definition: A group of bivalve mollusks destitute of siphons, as the oyster; the asiphonate mollusks.

toady.definition:
A mean flatterer; a toadeater; a sycophant. Before I had been standing at the window five minutes, they somehow conveyed to me that they were all toadies and humbugs. Dickens. 2. A coarse, rustic woman. Sir W. Scott.

To fawn upon with mean sycophancy.

abraham-man.definition: One of a set of vagabonds who formerly roamed through England, feigning lunacy for the sake of obtaining alms. Nares. To sham Abraham, to feign sickness. Goldsmith.

rumbling.definition: a. & n. from Rumble, v. i.

calmucks.definition: ; sing. Calmuck. A branch of the Mongolian race inbabiting parts of the Russian and Chinese empires; also (sing.), the language of the Calmucks. [Written also Kalmucks.].

popliteal.definition: Of or pertaining to the ham; in the region of the ham, or behind the knee joint; as, the popliteal space.

brize.definition: The breeze fly. See Breeze. Shak.

mistransport.definition: To carry away or mislead wrongfully, as by passion. Bp. Hall.

eyeful.definition: Filling or satisfying the eye; visible; remarkable. "Eyeful trophies." Chapman.

malamide.definition: The acid amide derived from malic acid, as a white crystalline substance metameric with asparagine.

stereotypography.definition: The act or art of printing from stereotype plates.

debeige.definition: A kind of woolen or mixed dress goods. [Written also debage.].

spruce.definition: (Bot.)  Any coniferous tree of the genus Picea, as the Norway spruce (P. excelsa), and the white and black spruces of America (P. alba and P. nigra), besides several others in the far Northwest. See Picea. 2. The wood or timber of the spruce tree. 3. Prussia leather; pruce. Spruce, a sort of leather.

tentiginous.definition: Stiff; stretched; strained. Johnson. 2. Lustful, or pertaining to lust. B. Jonson.

unmuzzle.definition: To loose from a muzzle; to remove a muzzle from.

lumber.definition: A pawnbroker's shop, or room for storing articles put in pawn; hence, a pledge, or pawn. They put all the little plate they had in the lumber, which is pawning it, till the ships came. Lady Murray. 2. Old or refuse household stuff; things cumbrous, or bulky and useless, or of small value. 3. Timber.

reinterrogate.definition: To interrogate again; to question repeatedly. Cotgrave.

chickadee.definition: A small bird, the blackcap titmouse (Parus atricapillus), of North America; -- named from its note.

navarrese.definition: Of or pertaining to Navarre. -- n. sing. & pl.  A native or inhabitant of Navarre; the people of Navarre.

pulverizable.definition: Admitting of being pulverized; pulverable. Barton.

cooptation.definition: The act of choosing; selection; choice. The first election and coöptation of a friend. Howell.

anarchy.definition: Absence of government; the state of society where there is no law or supreme power; a state of lawlessness; political confusion. Spread anarchy and terror all around. Cowper. 2. Hence, confusion or disorder, in general. There being then . . . an anarchy, as I may term it, in authors and their reFull.

sprit.definition:
To throw out with force from a narrow orifice; to eject; to spurt out. Sir T. Browne.

To sprout; to bud; to germinate, as barley steeped for malt.

A shoot; a sprout. Mortimer.

A small boom, pole, or spar, which crosses the sail of a boat diagonally from the mast to the upper aftmost corner, which.

stoma.definition: (Anat.)  One of the minute apertures between the cells in many serous membranes. 2. (Bot.) (a) The minute breathing pores of leaves or other organs opening into the intercellular spaces, and usually bordered by two contractile cells. (b) The line of dehiscence of the sporangium of a fern. It is usua.

tohubohu.definition: Chaos; confusion. Was ever such a tohubohu of people as there assembles Thuckeray.

libertarian.definition:
Pertaining to liberty, or to the doctrine of free will, as opposed to the doctrine of necessity.

One who holds to the doctrine of free will.

manuductor.definition: A conductor; an officer in the ancient church who gave the signal for the choir to sing, and who beat time with the hand, and regulated the music. Moore (Encyc. of Music.).

overshadow.definition: To throw a shadow, or shade, over; to darken; to obscure. There was a cloud that overshadowed them. Mark ix. 7. 2. Fig.: To cover with a superior influence. Milton.

sabbatarian.definition: One who regards and keeps the seventh day of the week as holy, aggreeably to the letter of the fourth commandment in the Decalogue. Note: There were Christians in the early church who held this opinion, and certain Christians, esp. the Seventh-day Baptists, hold it now. 2. A strict observer of the S.

neurocord.definition: A cordlike organ composed of elastic fibers situated above the ventral nervous cord of annelids, like the earthworm. -- Neu`ro*cor"dal, a.

obimbricate.definition: Imbricated, with the overlapping ends directed downward.

casal.definition: Of or pertaining to case; as, a casal ending.

infallibly.definition: In an infallible manner; certainly; unfailingly; unerringly. Blair.

concreate.definition: To create at the same time. If God did concreate grace with Adam. Jer. Taylor.

histrionize.definition: To act; to represent on the stage, or theatrically. Urquhart.

algology.definition: The study or science of algæ or seaweeds.

babiism.definition: The doctrine of a modern religious pantheistical sect in Persia, which was founded, about 1844, by Mirza Ali Mohammed ibn Rabhik (1820 -- 1850), who assumed the title of Bab-ed-Din (Per., Gate of the Faith). Babism is a mixture of Mohammedan, Christian, Jewish, and Parsi elements. This doctrine forb.

globated.definition: Having the form of a globe; spherical.

pontile.definition: Of or pertaining to the pons Varolii. See Pons.

inauration.definition: The act or process of gilding or covering with gold.

heart-whole.definition: Having the heart or affections free; not in love. Shak. 2. With unbroken courage; undismayed. 3. Of a single and sincere heart. If he keeps heart-whole towards his Master. Bunyan.

trophied.definition: Adorned with trophies. The trophied arches, storied halls, invade. Pope.

buckhound.definition: A hound for hunting deer. Master of the buckhounds, an officer in the royal household. [Eng.].

funest.definition: Lamentable; doleful. "Funest and direful deaths." Coleridge. A forerunner of something very funest. Evelyn.

plec-tognathous.definition: Of or pertaining to the Plectognathi.

londonism.definition: A characteristic of Londoners; a mode of speaking peculiar to London.

supernaturalize.definition: To treat or regard as supernatural.

underminister.definition: To serve, or minister to, in a subordinate relation. Wyclif.

badderlocks.definition: A large black seaweed (Alaria esculenta) sometimes eaten in Europe; -- also called murlins, honeyware, and henware.

hornbug.definition: A large nocturnal beetle of the genus Lucanus (as L. capreolus, and L. dama), having long, curved upper jaws, resembling a sickle. The grubs are found in the trunks of old trees.

decliner.definition: He who declines or rejects. A studious decliner of honors. Evelyn.

ultramontanism.definition: The principles of those within the Roman Catholic Church who maintain extreme views favoring the pope's supremacy; -- so used by those living north of the Alps in reference to the Italians; -- rarely used in an opposite sense, as referring to the views of those living north of the Alps and opposed t.

electro-muscular.definition: Pertaining the reaction (contraction) of the muscles under electricity, or their sensibility to it.

masterhood.definition: The state of being a master; hence, disposition to command or hector. C. Bronté.

improvidence.definition: The quality of being improvident; want of foresight or thrift. The improvidence of my neighbor must not make me inhuman. L'Estrange.

tacet.definition: It is silent; -- a direction for a vocal or instrumental part to be silent during a whole movement.

tralatition.definition: A change, as in the use of words; a metaphor.

stibium.definition: (Chem.)  The technical name of antimony. 2. (Min.)  Stibnite.

outbid.definition: To exceed or surpass in bidding. Prevent the greedy, and outbid the bold. Pope.

libyan.definition: Of or pertaining to Libya, the ancient name of that part of Africa between Egypt and the Atlantic Ocean, or of Africa as a whole.

loanin.definition: An open space between cultivated fields through which cattle are driven, and where the cows are sometimes milked; also, a lane. [Scot.] Sir W. Scott.

ribbonism.definition: The principles and practices of the Ribbonmen. See Ribbon Society, under Ribbon.

dyewood.definition: Any wood from which coloring matter is extracted for dyeing.

devenustate.definition: To deprive of beauty or grace.

hopeful.definition: Full of hope, or agreeable expectation; inclined to hope; expectant. Men of their own natural inclination hopeful and strongly conceited. Hooker. 2. Having qualities which excite hope; affording promise of good or of success; as, a hopeful youth; a hopeful prospect. "Hopeful scholars." Addison. -- H.

perspectograph.definition: An instrument for obtaining, and transferring to a picture, the points and outlines of objects, so as to represent them in their proper geometrical relations as viewed from some one point.

corroborant.definition: Strengthening; supporting; corroborating. Bacon. -- n.  Anything which gives strength or support; a tonic. The brain, with its proper corroborants, especially with sweet odors and with music. Southey.

pelusiac.definition: Of or pertaining to Pelusium, an ancient city of Egypt; as, the Pelusiac (or former eastern) outlet of the Nile.

spinosity.definition: The quality or state of being spiny or thorny; spininess.

dendrite.definition: A stone or mineral on or in which are branching figures resembling shrubs or trees, produced by a foreign mineral, usually an oxide of manganese, as in the moss agate; also, a crystallized mineral having an arborescent form, e. g., gold or silver; an arborization.

wigher.definition: To neigh; to whinny. Beau. & Fl.

cranial.definition: Of or pertaining to the cranium.

curing.definition: p. a. & vb. n. of Cure. Curing house, a building in which anything is cured; especially, in the West Indies, a building in which sugar is drained and dried.

syphilization.definition: Inoculation with the syphilitic virus, especially when employed as a preventive measure, like vaccination.

cloddy.definition: Consisting of clods; full of clods.

heteroptera.definition: A suborder of Hemiptera, in which the base of the anterior wings is thickened. See Hemiptera.

nodulous.definition: Having small nodes or knots; diminutively nodose.

hexacapsular.definition: Having six capsules or seed vessels.

brindle.definition:
The state of being brindled. 2. A brindled color; also, that which is brindled.

Brindled.

compassionable.definition: Deserving compassion or pity; pitiable. Barrow.

univalence.definition: The quality or state of being univalent.

rabbit.definition: A burrowing, gregarious, plant-eating mammal with long ears, long hind legs, and a short tail.

internet.definition: A global computer network providing a variety of information and communication facilities.

ephemeral.definition: Lasting for a very short time; transitory; fleeting.

serendipity.definition: The occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.

solitude.definition: The state or situation of being alone, especially a pleasant and tranquil one.

sonder.definition: The profound realization that each random passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as your own.

petrichor.definition: A pleasant, distinctive smell that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.

labyrinth.definition: An intricate network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze.
